articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料如何为现代机械提供动力

paras.en: Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?
paras.zh: 您有没有想过，从轰鸣的工程机械到耕地的农业机械，再到穿梭于工厂的工业设备，是什么让它们能够实现精确的启动、平稳的运行和可靠的制动？

paras.en: The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.
paras.zh: 答案就在于一个看似微不足道却至关重要的核心部件：摩擦材料。它充当机械的“安全卫士”和“动力纽带”，保证每一次制动都安全有效，每一次动力传递平稳无瑕。

paras.en: Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
paras.zh: 在众多的摩擦材料家族中，湿式摩擦材料因其卓越的可靠性、安全性和超长的使用寿命而成为现代机械的新宠。在湿式材料中，纸基摩擦材料以其优异的综合性能、成本效益和广阔的应用前景脱颖而出，成为主导力量。

paras.en: Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
paras.zh: 今天，让我们深入探究这个“无名英雄”——纸基摩擦材料的迷人世界。

paras.en: What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
paras.zh: 什么是纸基摩擦材料？ — 海绵状动力核心

paras.en: Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.
paras.zh: 想象一下有无数微小孔隙的“海绵”——这就是纸基摩擦材料最直观的形象。

paras.en: It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
paras.zh: 它是一种具有网状多孔结构的材料，由增强纤维、功能填料和粘结剂树脂三种核心成分组成。这种独特的结构赋予了它非凡的功能：

paras.en: - Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.
paras.zh: - 储油能力：多孔结构就像一个微型“油库”，能够储存大量润滑剂。

paras.en: - Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
paras.zh: - 动态润滑：当摩擦片和配合片接合并受到压力时，材料内的润滑剂立即被挤压到摩擦表面上，形成坚韧的润滑膜，从而实现平滑、温和的“湿”摩擦。

paras.en: - Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.
paras.zh: - 自我恢复：当摩擦片分离时，材料会像记忆海绵一样反弹，将润滑剂“吸收”回毛孔中，为下一次操作做好准备。

paras.en: It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
paras.zh: 正是这种“储油-挤油-回油”的动态循环，让纸基摩擦材料在油浴环境下表现良好，实现了高耐用性和稳定摩擦性能的完美结合。

paras.en: Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?
paras.zh: 探索核心绩效：三个关键因素如何影响它？

paras.en: The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料的性能并不是静态的。就像顶级运动员一样，其表现受到“场地”、“装备”和“条件”的影响。让我们来看看这三个关键因素如何影响其性能。

paras.en: Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants
paras.zh: 因素一：润滑油的“阶段效应”

paras.en: Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料对润滑剂高度敏感，不同的润滑剂为其性能创造了不同的“阶段”。即使是相同的摩擦材料，当接触不同的润滑剂时也会表现出明显不同的摩擦特性（尤其是动摩擦系数）。

paras.en: Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
paras.zh: 图 1：纸基摩擦材料在齿轮油中的动摩擦系数曲线

paras.en: Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil
paras.zh: 图2：同材质在液压油中的动摩擦系数曲线

paras.en: Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
paras.zh: 解读：上图清楚地表明，相同的材料在齿轮油和液压油中的表现截然不同。此外，润滑油中添加的各种添加剂（如分散剂和抗磨剂）会与材料表面发生复杂的相互作用，进一步影响其摩擦性能。因此，为纸基摩擦材料选择合适的油是实现最佳性能的第一步。

paras.en: Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.
paras.zh: 密度是纸基摩擦材料的王牌。它与材料的孔隙率直接相关，从而导致性能方面的微妙平衡。

paras.en: High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.
paras.zh: 高密度（低孔隙率）意味着材料更致密，从而具有更好的强度和导热性、更低的磨损率和更长的使用寿命。然而，其缺点是储油能力降低，这可能导致摩擦系数降低并损害动力传输。

paras.en: Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
paras.zh: 低密度（高孔隙率）意味着材料孔隙较多，从而产生更大的储油能力和更高的摩擦系数，从而可以提供更大的制动力或传递扭矩。但其缺点是机械强度和耐磨性降低，使用寿命缩短。

paras.en: Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
paras.zh: 图 3：不同密度材料的动摩擦系数比较（类型 2 至类型 6，密度增加）

paras.en: Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities
paras.zh: 图4：不同密度材料的磨损率比较

paras.en: Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
paras.zh: 解读：图3和图4生动地说明了这种平衡行为。没有绝对的好或坏，只有合适。选择纸基摩擦材料时，必须根据具体应用要求（例如高扭矩与长寿命）确定摩擦系数和耐用性之间的最佳权衡。

paras.en: Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions
paras.zh: 因素三：运行条件的极端挑战

paras.en: In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.
paras.zh: 除了油的类型和密度之外，实际操作条件，例如表面压力、滑动速度和油温，对纸基摩擦材料提出了极大的挑战。这些因素直接影响摩擦界面的温度、油膜的厚度和稳定性，从而动态地改变摩擦系数。

paras.en: Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
paras.zh: 因此，请记住：特定纸基摩擦材料的摩擦系数不是一个固定值，而是在特定操作条件下通过广泛和反复测试确定的性能范围。

paras.en: Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery
paras.zh: 广泛应用：为机械注入强大的“心脏”

paras.en: Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
paras.zh: 凭借其优异的综合性能和可定制性，卡莱制动摩擦材料纸基摩擦材料已成功应用于各类重型机械的核心部件，成为其强大而可靠的“心脏”。

paras.en: We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
paras.zh: 我们了解不同的机器和应用需要截然不同的摩擦材料。例如：

paras.en: - Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
paras.zh: - 工程机械（如挖掘机和装载机）的行车制动器需要能够在高负载下提供稳定、强大制动力的材料，以确保安全。

paras.en: - Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
paras.zh: - 农业机械（如拖拉机）的动力换档变速箱需要能够提供平稳接合和出色耐热性的材料，以应对频繁换档。

paras.en: - Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.
paras.zh: - 工业机械离合器需要响应快且使用寿命长的材料，以确保生产线连续高效运行。

paras.en: To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
paras.zh: 为此，卡莱制动摩擦开发了一系列针对不同应用场景的特种纸基摩擦材料，为每位客户提供最合适、最可靠的解决方案。

paras.en: Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
paras.zh: 持续创新，驱动未来

paras.en: Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.
paras.zh: 技术进步永无止境。为了满足日益苛刻的应用要求并拓宽市场前景，Carlisle Brake & Friction 始终走在创新的前沿。

paras.en: We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.
paras.zh: 我们不仅不断优化纸基摩擦材料的配方和加工工艺以突破其性能极限，而且还积极探索具有更高性能的下一代湿式摩擦材料。这些研发工作取得了重大进展，旨在为全球客户提供更多样化、更先进的选择，驱动未来机械的无限可能。

articles.title: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

paras.en: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees
paras.zh: 与麦地那市长和员工一起庆祝 100 周年

paras.en: MEDINA, OHIO — September 24, 2025 — Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF), a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-performance brake and friction solutions, today welcomed Medina Mayor Dennis Hanwell, Economic Development Director Kimberly Marshall, and Executive Director of the Medina Chamber of Commerce Jaclyn Ringstmeier, for a special photo op at the company’s headquarters, located at 920 Lake Road. The event was a commemorative celebration of CarlisleCBF’s 100-year anniversary and its enduring presence in the Medina community.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳 — 2025 年 9 月 24 日 — 高性能制动和摩擦解决方案开发和制造领域的全球领导者 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF) 今天欢迎梅迪纳市长 Dennis Hanwell、经济发展总监 Kimberly Marshall 和梅迪纳商会执行董事 Jaclyn Ringstmeier 在位于湖路 920 号的公司总部进行了特别合影。该活动是为了纪念 CarlisleCBF 成立 100 周年及其在麦地那社区的持久存在。

paras.en: The photo op featured Mayor Hanwell alongside Carlisle’s Operations Leader, David Smith, and a number of employees who have been with the company for decades. The occasion honored CarlisleCBF’s century of innovation and its deep roots in the Medina area, where it has been a significant employer and community partner.
paras.zh: 这张照片的主角是汉威尔市长、卡莱尔的运营负责人大卫·史密斯以及一些在公司工作了几十年的员工。此次活动旨在表彰 CarlisleCBF 的百年创新历程及其在麦地那地区的深厚根基，该公司一直是该地区重要的雇主和社区合作伙伴。

paras.en: "We are incredibly proud of our history and our strong connection to the city of Medina," said David Smith. "This milestone is a testament to the hard work and dedication of our employees, many of whom have been with us for decades. We are grateful for the continued support of Mayor Hanwell and the entire Medina community."
paras.zh: “我们对我们的历史以及我们与麦地那市的紧密联系感到无比自豪，”大卫·史密斯说。 “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的辛勤工作和奉献精神，其中许多人已经在我们身边工作了数十年。我们感谢汉威尔市长和整个麦地那社区的持续支持。”

paras.en: The photo op followed a recent employee and family event at the Medina plant that celebrated the 100-year milestone. The celebration was filled with games, face painting, food, and fun for all ages, reinforcing the company's commitment to its employees and their families.
paras.zh: 这张照片是在麦地那工厂最近举行的庆祝 100 周年里程碑的员工和家庭活动之后​​拍摄的。庆祝活动充满了适合各个年龄段的游戏、面部彩绘、美食和乐趣，强化了公司对员工及其家人的承诺。

paras.en: Mayor Hanwell expressed his gratitude for CarlisleCBF’s presence in the city. “Carlisle has been a part of the Medina community for nearly 65 years, providing good jobs and a strong economic foundation,” said Mayor Hanwell. "We are proud to celebrate their 100-year anniversary and recognize the significant role they have played in our city’s growth and prosperity."
paras.zh: 汉威尔市长对 CarlisleCBF 来到该市表示感谢。 “近 65 年来，卡莱尔一直是麦地那社区的一部分，提供了良好的就业机会和强大的经济基础，”汉威尔市长说。 “我们很自豪能够庆祝他们的 100 周年纪念日，并认识到他们在我们城市的发展和繁荣中发挥的重要作用。”

paras.en: CarlisleCBF, a brand of CentroMotion, was founded in 1925 and has grown to become a global leader in its field, serving a wide range of markets including agriculture, construction, and mining.
paras.zh: CarlisleCBF 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，成立于 1925 年，现已发展成为该领域的全球领导者，服务于农业、建筑和采矿等广泛市场。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a leading global provider of highly engineered and integrated brake and friction solutions for a wide range of industrial applications. With over 100 years of experience, the company is dedicated to delivering innovative, reliable, and high-performance products to its customers worldwide.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，是一家为各种工业应用提供精心设计的集成制动和摩擦解决方案的全球领先供应商。该公司拥有 100 多年的经验，致力于为全球客户提供创新、可靠和高性能的产品。

paras.en: Agritechnica 2025 was an incredible opportunity to connect with industry leaders, customers, and partners from around the world. We want to extend a sincere thank you to everyone who visited the CarlisleCBF and CentroMotion team at the show.

articles.title: ASE Education Foundation Launches $25M Federal Apprenticeship Grant
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The award comes through the Department’s Pay-for-Performance Incentive Payments Program, and the idea behind it is simple: reward registered apprenticeship sponsors for hiring apprentices and coaching them through the make-or-break first year on the job. Program sponsors — dealer groups, shop associations, franchise operators and similar organizations — can receive $3,500 for every apprentice they bring on and keep, paid in two parts as the new technician reaches 90 and 270 days on the job.
paras.zh: 该奖项来自该部门的绩效工资奖励计划，其背后的想法很简单：奖励注册学徒赞助商雇用学徒并指导他们度过工作成败的第一年。项目赞助商——经销商团体、商店协会、特许经营经营者和类似组织——每招收和留用一名学徒即可获得 3,500 美元，当新技术人员工作满 90 天和 270 天时分两部分支付。

paras.en: “This launch of this program lets us do something the industry has needed for a long time: open a clear, paid path into the trade, and give employers a proven way to invest in and grow the people who keep this country moving,” said Mike Coley, President, ASE Education Foundation. “We’re not just filling jobs. We’re building careers that can support a family for a lifetime, strengthening the shops and dealers that serve their communities, and protecting the motoring public who trusts all of us every time they start their car.”
paras.zh: ASE 教育基金会主席迈克·科利 (Mike Coley) 表示：“该计划的推出让我们能够做行业长期以来一直需要的事情：开辟一条清晰的、有偿的进入行业的道路，并为雇主提供一种行之有效的方法来投资和培养推动国家前进的人才。” “我们不仅仅是在填补工作岗位。我们正在建立能够养活一个家庭一生的职业，加强为社区服务的商店和经销商，并保护每次启动汽车时都信任我们的汽车公众。”

paras.en: The Foundation is actively recruiting partners in all 50 states, the five territories and the District of Columbia, and apprenticeships will be created all across the industry; in franchised dealerships, retail chains, fleets, body shops, truck and diesel repair shops, and independent auto repair shops. Current RA Program sponsors who are ready to step up, put apprentices to work, and start receiving incentive payments can apply today at ASEeducationFoundation.org/apprenticeship/sponsor-application.
paras.zh: 基金会正在全美 50 个州、五个地区和哥伦比亚特区积极招募合作伙伴，并将在整个行业内设立学徒岗位；特许经销商、零售连锁店、车队、车身维修店、卡车和柴油维修店以及独立汽车维修店。目前的 RA 计划赞助商如果准备好站出来，让学徒工作并开始接收奖励金，可以立即在 ASEeducationFoundation.org/apprenticeship/sponsor-application 进行申请。

articles.title: Texas adopts final right to appraisal rules with changes following comments
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: The Texas Department of Insurance (TDI) has adopted its final appraisal rules with some changes after receiving more than 1,000 letters from Texans, according to the TDI Advocates website ran by Auto Claims Specialists.
paras.zh: 据汽车索赔专家运营的 TDI Advocates 网站称，德克萨斯州保险部 (TDI) 在收到德克萨斯州民众的 1,000 多封来信后，已通过了最终评估规则，并进行了一些更改。

paras.en: Changes include giving the insured the right to choose the umpire selection method at the time of dispute. Another change gives the insured the contractual option to seek judicial appointment of an umpire.
paras.zh: 变化包括赋予被保险人在发生争议时选择裁判选择方法的权利。另一项变化为被保险人提供了寻求司法任命裁判员的合同选择权。

paras.en: TDI’s original proposed rule received pushback from the collision industry and consumers who said it stripped the bill of proponents’ intentions.
paras.zh: TDI 最初提出的规则遭到了碰撞行业和消费者的反对，他们表示该规则剥夺了支持者的意图。

paras.en: The state Legislature passed a right to appraisal (RTA) bill last year. The bill directs TDI to adopt rules for the code change.
paras.zh: 州立法机关去年通过了评估权（RTA）法案。该法案指示 TDI 采用代码更改规则。

paras.en: Robert McDorman, Auto Claims Specialists’ general manager and Auto Body Assocation of Texas (ABAT) representative, previously told RDN that the proposed rule removed the consumer’s judicial right to have a court-appointed umpire.
paras.zh: 汽车索赔专家总经理兼德克萨斯州汽车车身协会 (ABAT) 代表罗伯特·麦克多曼 (Robert McDorman) 此前告诉 RDN，拟议的规则取消了消费者要求法院指定裁判的司法权利。

paras.en: The proposed rule authorized insurers to include, in addition to judicial appointment, other methods of umpire appointment. A TDI explanation said that some residential property appraisal provisions currently provide for the umpire to be chosen by an independent vendor if the appraisers cannot agree.
paras.zh: 拟议的规则授权保险公司除司法任命外还可以采用其他任命裁判的方法。 TDI 的解释称，目前一些住宅房产评估条款规定，如果评估师不能达成一致，则可以由独立供应商选择仲裁员。

paras.en: According to the explanation, the insurer would have to include at least two vendors and let the policyholder select the vendor or allow only the policyholder to invoke this option.
paras.zh: 根据解释，保险公司必须包括至少两个供应商，并让投保人选择供应商或仅允许投保人调用此选项。

paras.en: Auto Claims Specialists’ campaigned for four changes to the proposed rule. Two of the four changes were made by TDI prior to approval.
paras.zh: 汽车索赔专家发起活动，要求对拟议规则进行四项修改。四项变更中有两项是 TDI 在获得批准之前进行的。

paras.en: One of the changes not adopted by TDI would have required insurers to disclose financial relationships with listed vendors in the policy. The other change not adopted would have required that if a vendor mechanism was used, the insurer bears the full cost, not the insured.
paras.zh: TDI 未采纳的一项变更要求保险公司在保单中披露与上市供应商的财务关系。另一项未采用的变更要求，如果使用供应商机制，则保险公司而非被保险人承担全部费用。

paras.en: “TDI declined to shift vendor or umpire costs to insurers and declined to cap umpire fees, saying the policyholder-only trigger for the vendor option already addresses the cost and fairness concern,” TDI Advocates’ webpage states.
paras.zh: TDI Advocates 的网页指出：“TDI 拒绝将供应商或裁判成本转嫁给保险公司，并拒绝限制裁判费用，称仅向保单持有人触发供应商选项已经解决了成本和公平问题。”

paras.en: Insurance companies have until March 1, 2027, to comply with the new rule.
paras.zh: 保险公司必须在 2027 年 3 月 1 日之前遵守新规定。

articles.title: BodyShop Marketing CEO gives three tips for marketing to AI during IDEAS Collide
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Daniel Burkholder, BodyShop Marketing CEO and founder, provided three steps collision shops can take to help AI apps recommend their business to consumers during the SCRS IDEAS Collide showcase at the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: BodyShop Marketing 首席执行官兼创始人 Daniel Burkholder 在 2026 年拉斯维加斯 SEMA 展会上的 SCRS IDEAS Collide 展示会上提供了碰撞店可以采取的三个步骤，以帮助人工智能应用程序向消费者推荐其业务。

paras.en: AI is changing the way that consumers find collision shops, Burkholder said. He said for 20 years or more, the game has been ranking.
paras.zh: 伯克霍尔德说，人工智能正在改变消费者寻找碰撞店的方式。他说，20年甚至更长时间以来，游戏一直在排名。

paras.en: This included getting on the map pack and learning search engine optimization (SEO), he said.
paras.zh: 他说，这包括使用地图包和学习搜索引擎优化（SEO）。

paras.en: “I’m going to tell you right now that it’s not wasted,” he said. “That is the foundation. But we now have a new layer on top.”
paras.zh: “我现在要告诉你，这并没有浪费，”他说。 “这是基础。但我们现在在上面有了新的一层。”

paras.en: He added that this isn’t the first time technology has changed marketing.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这并不是技术第一次改变营销。

paras.en: “How many of you remember the good old Yellow Pages?” Burkholder asked the crowd.
paras.zh: “你们中有多少人还记得古老的黄页？”伯克霍尔德向人群问道。

paras.en: It was replaced with Google and search engines, he added. Another change happened with mobile devices and then Google and Apple maps revolutionized how people search.
paras.zh: 他补充说，它已被谷歌和搜索引擎取代。移动设备发生了另一个变化，然后谷歌和苹果地图彻底改变了人们的搜索方式。

paras.en: “AI is the next big one,” he said. “I would dare say it’s bigger than all the others put together in how people are going to find your shop someday and how people are finding your shop today.”
paras.zh: “人工智能是下一个重要的领域，”他说。 “我敢说，在人们有一天如何找到你的商店以及今天人们如何找到你的商店方面，它比所有其他商店的总和还要大。”

paras.en: AI is now doing the heavy lifting for customers, Burkholder said.
paras.zh: 伯克霍尔德说，人工智能现在正在为客户承担繁重的工作。

paras.en: “They [consumers] don’t have to go to your website,” he said. “They don’t have to see your reviews. You have people that are calling you that may have never seen your website or your reviews. They might not even know your name. They’re just calling because their AI said that’s the thing to do.”
paras.zh: “他们（消费者）不必访问你的网站，”他说。 “他们不必看到你的评论。有人打电话给你，他们可能从未见过你的网站或你的评论。他们甚至可能不知道你的名字。他们打电话只是因为他们的人工智能告诉你应该这样做。”

paras.en: Answer engine optimization (AEO) is a new term being used, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，答案引擎优化（AEO）是一个正在使用的新术语。

paras.en: “SEO helps to get you into the list, AEO helps to get you into the answer, and you need both of those at this point,” Burkholder added.
paras.zh: “SEO 可以帮助您进入列表，AEO 可以帮助您找到答案，而此时您需要两者，”Burkholder 补充道。

paras.en: Consumers are no longer asking simple searches, he said. He explained they are asking longer, conversational types of searches.
paras.zh: 他说，消费者不再要求简单的搜索。他解释说，他们要求进行更长的、对话式的搜索。

paras.en: “Do I have to use the shop my insurance recommends?” he gave as an example. “I was just in an accident with my Honda Civic, what’s the best Honda repair shop near me.”
paras.zh: “我必须去我的保险推荐的商店吗？”他举了一个例子。 “我的本田思域刚刚出了事故，我附近最好的本田维修店是哪家。”

paras.en: AI tends to ask for more information. This could include what insurance carrier they use and what vehicle needs to be repaired.
paras.zh: 人工智能倾向于要求更多信息。这可能包括他们使用的保险公司以及需要维修的车辆。

paras.en: AI only knows what is written about your shop, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，人工智能只知道关于你商店的内容。

paras.en: “AI goes out and starts doing the research for these customers,” Burkholder said. “If your website has the answers to these questions, you become the authority.”
paras.zh: “人工智能走出去，开始为这些客户进行研究，”伯克霍尔德说。 “如果您的网站可以回答这些问题，您就成为权威。”

paras.en: Burkholder provided an example of a statement found on a collision shop website: “We offer full-service collision repair with state-of-the-art equipment and a commitment to quality.”
paras.zh: 伯克霍尔德提供了在碰撞店网站上找到的声明示例：“我们使用最先进的设备和对质量的承诺提供全方位的碰撞维修服务。”

paras.en: AI learns nothing from the statement, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，人工智能没有从这份声明中学到任何东西。

paras.en: In another example, the statement said, “We repair Honda, Toyota and Subaru vehicles at our downtown Las Vegas shop. Every repair follows the manufacturer’s procedures.”
paras.zh: 在另一个例子中，声明称，“我们在拉斯维加斯市中心的商店维修本田、丰田和斯巴鲁车辆。每次维修都遵循制造商的程序。”

paras.en: The two sentences provide examples of makes that are repaired at the shop, the location and a repair standard.
paras.zh: 这两个句子提供了在商店修理的品牌、地点和修理标准的示例。

paras.en: “The best scenario is having a web page for each of your services, so you can give very thorough, in-depth content to AI so it fully understands what you do,” Burkholder said.
paras.zh: “最好的方案是为你的每项服务提供一个网页，这样你就可以为人工智能提供非常全面、深入的内容，这样它就能完全理解你所做的事情，”伯克霍尔德说。

paras.en: Audience members were asked to test whether AI can find them by telling their favorite app that they had just been in an accident and then asking what the best repair shop is in the city their shop is located.
paras.zh: 观众被要求测试人工智能是否可以通过告诉他们最喜欢的应用程序他们刚刚遭遇事故，然后询问他们的商店所在的城市最好的维修店是哪家来测试人工智能是否可以找到他们。

paras.en: Many responded that AI did refer to their shop.
paras.zh: 许多人回应说AI确实指的是他们的商店。

paras.en: For those whom AI didn’t mention, Burkholder gave these three tips:
paras.zh: 对于那些 AI 没有提到的人，Burkholder 给出了以下三个提示：

paras.en: The answers to the questions that consumers are asking your front desk, should be on your website, he said. He said consumers are asking the same questions of AI.
paras.zh: 他说，消费者向前台提出的问题的答案应该在您的网站上。他表示，消费者对人工智能也提出了同样的问题。

paras.en: “If you have those answers on your website, it gives the authority to your website when AI goes looking,” Burkholder said.
paras.zh: “如果你的网站上有这些答案，那么当人工智能进行查找时，它就会赋予你的网站权威，”伯克霍尔德说。

paras.en: Information such as your business name and phone number should be the same on Google, Carwise, your website and Yelp, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，你的公司名称和电话号码等信息在 Google、Carwise、你的网站和 Yelp 上应该是相同的。

paras.en: ABC Collision on one site and ABC Collision Center on another site look like two different shops to a machine, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，一个站点上的 ABC Collision 和另一个站点上的 ABC Collision Center 对于一台机器来说就像是两个不同的商店。

paras.en: “AI trusts what others say about you more than what you say about yourself,” Burkholder said.
paras.zh: “人工智能更相信别人对你的评价，而不是你对自己的评价，”伯克霍尔德说。

paras.en: Automakers listing a shop as a certified shop on their website can help AI recommend a shop, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，汽车制造商在其网站上将商店列为经过认证的商店可以帮助人工智能推荐商店。

paras.en: Customer reviews also play a role in how AI sees you, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，客户评论也在人工智能如何看待你方面发挥着作用。

paras.en: “I’m not going to give you any to-do list,” he said. “You have plenty of those. But when you get back home, I’d like you to just pull up your website and find one big sentence and start with one sentence, and then rewrite it so a machine knows what you fix, where you fix it, and why you’re qualified to fix it.”
paras.zh: “我不会给你任何待办事项清单，”他说。 “你有很多这样的东西。但是当你回到家时，我希望你打开你的网站，找到一个大句子，从一句话开始，然后重写它，这样机器就知道你修复了什么，修复了哪里，以及为什么你有资格修复它。”

paras.en: For a free AI visibility check visit https://aicheck.bodyshopmarketing.io/
paras.zh: 如需免费的人工智能可见性检查，请访问 https://aicheck.bodyshopmarketing.io/

paras.en: Daniel Burkholder, BodyShop Marketing CEO and founder, speaks during IDEAS Collide at the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas. (Lurah Lowery/RDN)
paras.zh: BodyShop Marketing 首席执行官兼创始人 Daniel Burkholder 在拉斯维加斯 2026 年 SEMA 展会 IDEAS Collide 期间发表讲话。 （卢拉·洛厄里/RDN）

articles.title: ASE Education Foundation Launches $25M Apprenticeship Grant
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The award comes through the Department’s Pay-for-Performance Incentive Payments Program, and the idea behind it is simple: reward registered apprenticeship sponsors for hiring apprentices and coaching them through the make-or-break first year on the job. Program sponsors — dealer groups, shop associations, franchise operators and similar organizations — can receive $3,500 for every apprentice they bring on and keep, paid in two parts as the new technician reaches 90 and 270 days on the job.
paras.zh: 该奖项来自该部门的绩效工资奖励计划，其背后的想法很简单：奖励注册学徒赞助商雇用学徒并指导他们度过工作成败的第一年。项目赞助商——经销商团体、商店协会、特许经营经营者和类似组织——每招收和留用一名学徒即可获得 3,500 美元，当新技术人员工作满 90 天和 270 天时分两部分支付。

paras.en: “This launch of this program lets us do something the industry has needed for a long time: open a clear, paid path into the trade, and give employers a proven way to invest in and grow the people who keep this country moving,” said Mike Coley, President, ASE Education Foundation. “We’re not just filling jobs. We’re building careers that can support a family for a lifetime, strengthening the shops and dealers that serve their communities, and protecting the motoring public who trusts all of us every time they start their car.”
paras.zh: ASE 教育基金会主席迈克·科利 (Mike Coley) 表示：“该计划的推出让我们能够做行业长期以来一直需要的事情：开辟一条清晰的、有偿的进入行业的道路，并为雇主提供一种行之有效的方法来投资和培养推动国家前进的人才。” “我们不仅仅是在填补工作岗位。我们正在建立能够养活一个家庭一生的职业，加强为社区服务的商店和经销商，并保护每次启动汽车时都信任我们的汽车公众。”

paras.en: The Foundation is actively recruiting partners in all 50 states, the five territories and the District of Columbia, and apprenticeships will be created all across the industry; in franchised dealerships, retail chains, fleets, body shops, truck and diesel repair shops, and independent auto repair shops. Current RA Program sponsors who are ready to step up, put apprentices to work, and start receiving incentive payments can apply today at ASEeducationFoundation.org/apprenticeship/sponsor-application.
paras.zh: 基金会正在全美 50 个州、五个地区和哥伦比亚特区积极招募合作伙伴，并将在整个行业内设立学徒岗位；特许经销商、零售连锁店、车队、车身维修店、卡车和柴油维修店以及独立汽车维修店。目前的 RA 计划赞助商如果准备好站出来，让学徒工作并开始接收奖励金，可以立即在 ASEeducationFoundation.org/apprenticeship/sponsor-application 进行申请。

articles.title: New Paint Requires a Different Approach to Detailing
articles.author: Justin Glass

paras.en: A vehicle can leave a collision repair facility looking excellent under shop lighting and still present a completely different set of challenges when it reaches a detailer weeks or months later. From a detailing perspective, one of the most important things to understand is that refinished paint should not automatically be treated the same way as an untouched factory finish.
paras.zh: 一辆车辆在离开碰撞修复设施时，在车间照明下看起来非常出色，但在几周或几个月后到达维修人员手中时，仍然会面临一系列完全不同的挑战。从细节的角度来看，需要理解的最重要的事情之一是修补漆不应自动以与未触及的工厂饰面相同的方式处理。

paras.en: During more than 20 years of professional detailing, and as owner of Fort Lauderdale Precise Mobile Auto Detailing, I’ve worked on vehicles with original paint, repainted panels and combinations of both. Those jobs have taught me that the first step should never be reaching for a polisher. It should be determining what you’re actually working on.
paras.zh: 在 20 多年的专业细节设计生涯中，作为劳德代尔堡精确移动汽车细节公司的所有者，我曾对使用原漆、重新喷漆面板以及两者组合的车辆进行过研究。这些工作告诉我，第一步永远不应该是伸手去拿抛光机。它应该决定你实际上在做什么。

paras.en: Factory paint already varies considerably from manufacturer to manufacturer. Once collision repair and refinishing enter the picture, the variables increase. Film build, curing history, sanding and polishing performed during the repair, previous corrections and the condition of adjacent factory panels can all influence how the finish should be approached.
paras.zh: 不同制造商的工厂油漆差异很大。一旦出现碰撞修复和修补，变量就会增加。成膜、固化历史、修复过程中进行的打磨和抛光、之前的修正以及相邻工厂面板的状况都会影响饰面的处理方式。

paras.en: For a detailer, the goal is not simply to make the paint look as perfect as possible. The goal is to improve the appearance while preserving enough material for the finish to remain healthy over the long term.
paras.zh: 对于细节设计师来说，目标不仅仅是让油漆看起来尽可能完美。目标是改善外观，同时保留足够的材料，使饰面长期保持健康。

paras.en: When I inspect a vehicle that has had body or paint work, I want to know which panels have been refinished before I make decisions about correction. Sometimes the difference is obvious. Other times, a quality refinish blends so well that visual inspection alone does not tell the whole story.
paras.zh: 当我检查一辆进行过车身或喷漆工作的车辆时，我想在做出修正决定之前知道哪些面板已经过整修。有时差异是显而易见的。有时，高质量的修补漆融合得非常好，以至于仅靠目视检查并不能说明全部情况。

paras.en: That is where careful inspection, good lighting and paint-thickness measurements become useful. A paint-thickness gauge cannot tell a detailer everything about a finish, and readings must be interpreted correctly, but comparing panels can reveal significant differences in film build. It can also help identify areas where previous sanding or polishing may have occurred.
paras.zh: 这就是仔细检查、良好照明和油漆厚度测量变得有用的地方。油漆测厚仪无法告诉细节人员有关饰面的所有信息，必须正确解释读数，但比较面板可以揭示漆膜结构的显着差异。它还可以帮助识别之前可能进行过打磨或抛光的区域。

paras.en: The important point is that a detailer should not assume every panel has the same amount of material available to work with. A hood may still have its factory finish while a fender and door have been refinished. Treating all three panels identically simply because they’re on the same vehicle can be a mistake.
paras.zh: 重要的一点是，细节设计师不应假设每个面板都有相同数量的可用材料。引擎盖可能仍具有出厂时的表面处理，而挡泥板和车门已进行了整修。仅仅因为所有三个面板位于同一辆车上而对它们进行相同的处理可能是错误的。

paras.en: Refinished paint does not always respond to polishing the way surrounding factory paint does. Depending on the paint system, application, cure, prior finishing work and environmental conditions, a refinished panel may cut or finish differently from an adjacent original panel.
paras.zh: 修补漆并不总是像周围工厂油漆那样对抛光有反应。根据油漆系统、应用、固化、先前的饰面工作和环境条件，修补后的面板的切割或饰面可能与相邻的原始面板不同。

paras.en: A combination that works beautifully on one panel may be unnecessarily aggressive on another — which is why test spots matter. I would rather begin conservatively and increase correction only when the finish tells me it’s necessary than start aggressively and discover afterward that I removed more material than the job required.
paras.zh: 在一个面板上表现良好的组合可能在另一个面板上表现得过于激进——这就是测试点很重要的原因。我宁愿保守地开始，只有当完成告诉我有必要时才增加修正，而不是积极地开始，然后发现我删除了比工作所需的更多的材料。

paras.en: Detailers also need to respect the refinisher’s recommendations regarding cure time and post-refinish care. Paint systems and repair procedures differ, so a blanket rule about when a newly painted vehicle can be polished, sealed, coated or otherwise treated is not a substitute for information about the specific repair. When there is uncertainty, communication with the collision facility or paint manufacturer is the safer approach.
paras.zh: 细节设计师还需要尊重修补师关于固化时间和修补后护理的建议。喷漆系统和维修程序各不相同，因此关于新喷漆车辆何时可以抛光、密封、涂层或其他处理的一揽子规则并不能替代有关具体维修的信息。当存在不确定性时，与碰撞设施或油漆制造商沟通是更安全的方法。

paras.en: Do Not Correct a Panel Twice Without Thinking
paras.zh: 不要不假思索地两次纠正面板

paras.en: One issue that’s easy to overlook is that a refinished panel may already have undergone substantial finishing before the customer ever sees it. Depending on the repair, the surface may have been denibbed, sanded, compounded and polished to remove texture or defects.
paras.zh: 一个容易忽视的问题是，在客户看到整修好的面板之前，它可能已经经过了实质性的修整。根据修复情况，表面可能经过磨边、打磨、复合和抛光以去除纹理或缺陷。

paras.en: If a detailer later sees a few remaining imperfections and immediately performs another aggressive correction, the panel can effectively be corrected twice. The customer may see a small visual improvement, but additional clearcoat has been removed to achieve it.
paras.zh: 如果细节人员后来发现一些剩余的缺陷并立即执行另一次积极的校正，则面板可以有效地校正两次。客户可能会看到视觉上的微小改善，但为了实现这一目标，额外的清漆已被去除。

paras.en: That trade-off matters. Clearcoat is not an unlimited resource. Every sanding or polishing step that removes measurable material reduces what remains for future correction. A vehicle may need to survive years of washing, environmental exposure and additional cosmetic work. Preserving the finish should therefore be part of the decision, not an afterthought.
paras.zh: 这种权衡很重要。透明涂层不是无限的资源。每一个去除可测量材料的打磨或抛光步骤都会减少剩余的用于未来修正的材料。车辆可能需要经受多年的清洗、环境暴露和额外的装饰工作。因此，保留表面效果应该是决定的一部分，而不是事后的想法。

paras.en: Perfection Is Not Always the Safest Goal
paras.zh: 完美并不总是最安全的目标

paras.en: Customers understandably want repaired areas to look perfect. Detailers want that too. But there are situations where chasing the final isolated defect is not the best decision for the vehicle.
paras.zh: 客户希望修复后的区域看起来完美，这是可以理解的。细节设计师也希望如此。但在某些情况下，追求最终的孤立缺陷并不是车辆的最佳决策。

paras.en: If removing one deeper mark requires disproportionately aggressive sanding or polishing, I explain the trade-off. A defect that’s barely visible under normal conditions may be preferable to unnecessarily reducing the protective clearcoat around it. The same principle applies to factory paint, but it becomes particularly important when the history of a refinished panel isn’t completely known.
paras.zh: 如果去除更深的标记需要不成比例的强力打磨或抛光，我会解释权衡。在正常条件下几乎看不见的缺陷可能比不必要地减少其周围的保护性透明涂层更好。同样的原则也适用于工厂油漆，但当修补板的历史不完全了解时，这一点就变得尤为重要。

paras.en: Professional correction requires judgment. The best result isn’t always the panel with the fewest visible defects under an inspection light. Sometimes the best result is the one that looks dramatically better while retaining as much of the finish as reasonably possible.
paras.zh: 专业纠正需要判断。最好的结果并不总是在检查灯下可见缺陷最少的面板。有时，最好的结果是看起来更好，同时尽可能保留尽可能多的饰面。

paras.en: Edges, Body Lines and Blended Areas Need Respect
paras.zh: 边缘、身体线条和混合区域需要尊重

paras.en: Edges and pronounced body lines deserve additional caution because paint film can be less forgiving in those areas, and polishing pressure and pad contact are harder to control. The same is true around tight contours, adjacent trim and transitions between repaired and original areas.
paras.zh: 边缘和明显的车身线条需要额外小心，因为这些区域的漆膜可能不太宽容，而且抛光压力和抛光垫接触更难控制。紧密的轮廓、相邻的装饰以及修复区域和原始区域之间的过渡也是如此。

paras.en: A detailer also has to recognize that a repaired area may extend beyond the most obvious damaged panel. Blending can involve adjacent panels to achieve a consistent color match. Knowing the repair history helps prevent assumptions about where the refinished area begins and ends.
paras.zh: 细节设计人员还必须认识到修复区域可能会超出最明显的损坏面板。混合可以涉及相邻面板以实现一致的颜色匹配。了解修复历史有助于防止对修补区域的开始和结束位置进行假设。

paras.en: This is another reason communication between collision repairers and detailers can be valuable. A simple explanation of which panels were refinished, blended or heavily finished can give the person caring for the vehicle later information that’s difficult to obtain from appearance alone.
paras.zh: 这是碰撞修复人员和细节人员之间的沟通很有价值的另一个原因。对哪些面板进行了修补、混合或重整的简单说明可以为车辆护理人员提供仅从外观很难获得的后期信息。

paras.en: Finishing Quality Affects the Customer’s Perception
paras.zh: 整理质量影响客户的看法

paras.en: From the customer’s perspective, the paint is often the most visible part of the repair. They may not understand the structural procedures, measuring systems or refinishing process that went into restoring the vehicle, but they’ll notice haze, holograms, sanding marks, compound residue and unfinished edges.
paras.zh: 从客户的角度来看，油漆通常是维修中最明显的部分。他们可能不了解修复车辆的结构程序、测量系统或修补过程，但他们会注意到雾霾、全息图、打磨痕迹、复合残留物和未完成的边缘。

paras.en: Those details can influence how the customer perceives the entire repair. A technically excellent repair deserves an equally thoughtful final presentation.
paras.zh: 这些细节会影响客户对整个维修的看法。技术上出色的修复值得同样深思熟虑的最终展示。

paras.en: Good lighting is critical during the finishing stage. Defects that disappear under one type of shop lighting can become obvious in direct sunlight. Checking the finish under multiple lighting conditions helps identify haze or machine marks before the vehicle is delivered.
paras.zh: 良好的照明在收尾阶段至关重要。在一种商店照明下消失的缺陷在阳光直射下可能会变得明显。在多种照明条件下检查饰面有助于在车辆交付前识别雾霾或机器痕迹。

paras.en: Residue around emblems, trim, panel gaps and edges also matters. These may seem like small details compared with the repair itself, but they’re exactly the details an owner may notice when inspecting the vehicle up close.
paras.zh: 标志、装饰、面板间隙和边缘周围的残留物也很重要。与维修本身相比，这些细节似乎很小，但它们正是车主在近距离检查车辆时可能注意到的细节。

paras.en: When a repaired vehicle comes to me later, my job is not to redo the body shop’s work. It’s to evaluate the finish that exists at that moment and choose the least aggressive process capable of producing the desired improvement.
paras.zh: 当修好的车辆后来找我时，我的工作不是重做车身修理厂的工作。它是评估当时存在的表面处理，并选择能够产生所需改进的最不激进的工艺。

paras.en: That usually begins with proper washing and decontamination, followed by inspection under controlled lighting. If correction is necessary, I perform a test section before deciding on the combination for the rest of the panel. I also compare the behavior of refinished areas with original paint rather than assuming one process will work everywhere.
paras.zh: 通常从适当的清洗和去污开始，然后在受控照明下进行检查。如果需要修正，我会在决定面板其余部分的组合之前执行测试部分。我还将修补区域的行为与原漆进行比较，而不是假设一种工艺在任何地方都适用。

paras.en: If something doesn’t look right, I would rather stop and gather more information than force a result. That can mean asking the customer about the repair, recommending that the collision facility inspect an issue or simply deciding that a particular defect should remain rather than removing excessive material.
paras.zh: 如果事情看起来不对劲，我宁愿停下来收集更多信息，而不是强行得出结果。这可能意味着向客户询问维修情况，建议碰撞设施检查问题，或者简单地决定应保留特定缺陷，而不是去除多余的材料。

paras.en: Collision repairers, detailers and vehicle owners all benefit when the history of a finish is communicated clearly. The more a detailer knows about what was painted, blended, sanded or polished, the better the decisions that can be made later.
paras.zh: 当表面处理的历史得到清晰传达时，碰撞修复人员、细节设计人员和车主都会受益。细节人员对涂漆、混合、打磨或抛光的内容了解得越多，以后就能做出更好的决定。

paras.en: Customers also benefit from realistic aftercare instructions. They should understand that refinished paint needs appropriate care, that not every cosmetic imperfection should automatically be attacked aggressively and that future detailers should be told which areas have been repaired.
paras.zh: 客户还可以从实际的善后护理说明中受益。他们应该明白，修补后的油漆需要适当的护理，并不是所有的装饰缺陷都应该自动受到积极的攻击，并且应该告诉未来的细节人员哪些区域已被修复。

paras.en: For detailers, asking a few questions before correction can prevent expensive mistakes. For collision shops, providing basic information about the refinishing work can help preserve the quality of the repair long after the vehicle leaves the facility.
paras.zh: 对于细节人员来说，在纠正之前问几个问题可以防止出现代价高昂的错误。对于碰撞维修店来说，提供有关修补工作的基本信息有助于在车辆离开工厂后很长时间内保持维修质量。

paras.en: Preservation Should Be Part of the Finish
paras.zh: 保存应该是完成的一部分

paras.en: The collision repair and detailing industries approach vehicles from different perspectives, but they share an important responsibility: protecting the work that has already been done.
paras.zh: 碰撞修复和细节行业从不同的角度处理车辆，但他们都有一个重要的责任：保护已经完成的工作。

paras.en: A refinished panel should not be treated as simply another surface to compound until every visible defect disappears. Its history matters. Its remaining film build matters. The finishing work already performed matters. And the customer’s expectation for how the vehicle will look years from now matters, too.
paras.zh: 在所有可见缺陷消失之前，修补后的面板不应被简单地视为另一个复合表面。它的历史很重要。其剩余的电影制作很重要。收尾工作已经完成了。客户对车辆几年后外观的期望也很重要。

paras.en: After more than two decades of detailing, I’ve learned that restraint can be just as important as correction. Knowing how to polish paint is a skill. Knowing when to stop polishing is another one.
paras.zh: 经过二十多年的详细研究，我了解到克制与纠正同样重要。知道如何抛光油漆是一项技能。知道何时停止抛光是另一回事。

paras.en: When freshly refinished paint is approached with proper evaluation, conservative testing and long-term preservation in mind, the result can look excellent without sacrificing more of the finish than necessary. That’s better for the detailer, better for the repairer and, most importantly, better for the vehicle owner.
paras.zh: 当对新修补的油漆进行适当的评估、保守的测试和长期保存时，结果可以看起来非常出色，而无需牺牲更多的饰面。这对于细节设计人员、维修人员来说都更好，最重要的是，对于车主来说也更好。

articles.title: OEC Integrates RepairLink, PartsTech Services
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: OEConnection LLC (OEC) announced that it is integrating its PartsTech and RepairLink services.
paras.zh: OEConnection LLC (OEC) 宣布正在整合其 PartsTech 和 RepairLink 服务。

paras.en: According to OEC, PartsTech currently connects shops to 240-plus aftermarket suppliers, 60-plus tire suppliers, and distributor-sponsored promotional programs. The integration of RepairLink will enable PartsTech to add nearly 9,000 OE dealers across all 50 states and OE-sponsored promotional programs from 14-plus OE brands. Every major part type is now available in a single search, the company says.
paras.zh: 据 OEC 称，PartsTech 目前将商店与 240 多家售后市场供应商、60 多家轮胎供应商以及分销商赞助的促销计划联系起来。 RepairLink 的整合将使 PartsTech 能够在全美 50 个州增加近 9,000 个 OE 经销商，以及来自 14 多个 OE 品牌的 OE 赞助的促销计划。该公司表示，现在只需一次搜索即可找到所有主要零件类型。

paras.en: According to the company, shops can connect their RepairLink account to PartsTech, which automatically adds the shop’s preferred OE dealers, including dealer pricing, to their parts search. The upgraded PartsTech marketplace features both the newly added OE-sponsored promotional programs, from RepairLink, and the existing aftermarket distributor-sponsored promotional programs. Manufacturer-sourced OE diagrams are also now available in PartsTech.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，商店可以将他们的 RepairLink 帐户连接到 PartsTech，后者会自动将商店的首选 OE 经销商（包括经销商定价）添加到他们的零件搜索中。升级后的 PartsTech 市场既有来自 RepairLink 的新添加的 OE 赞助的促销计划，也包括现有的售后市场分销商赞助的促销计划。 PartsTech 中现在还提供制造商提供的 OE 图。

paras.en: With OE now in PartsTech through the RepairLink integration, parts from the shop’s preferred dealers appear in the same search results as aftermarket parts and tires, so shops can compare options and place orders in one workflow, OEC noted.
paras.zh: OEC 指出，现在 OE 通过 RepairLink 集成进入 PartsTech，来自商店首选经销商的零件与售后零件和轮胎出现在相同的搜索结果中，因此商店可以在一个工作流程中比较选项并下订单。

paras.en: “The PartsTech and RepairLink integration changes that. Shops can now find and order every part they need, whether it’s aftermarket, OE, or tires, in a single search and cart. This is something shops have requested for a long time, and we’re excited to deliver it,” said Greg Kirber, SVP of mechanical e-commerce at OEC.
paras.zh: OEC 机械电子商务高级副总裁 Greg Kirber 表示：“PartsTech 和 RepairLink 的集成改变了这一点。商店现在可以在一次搜索和购物车中找到并订购他们需要的每一个零件，无论是售后市场、OE 还是轮胎。这是商店长期以来的要求，我们很高兴能够交付它。”

articles.title: Understanding Mercedes-Benz TPMS
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: On different Mercedes-Benz models, you will see two types of TPMS systems. Low-line systems do not display individual tire pressures – these systems just monitor inflation and alert the driver if there is an under-inflation or over-inflation problem with one antenna. Mid-line systems display the individual pressures, and some systems have four antennas mounted near the wheel wells.
paras.zh: 在不同的梅赛德斯-奔驰车型上，您会看到两种类型的 TPMS 系统。低线系统不显示单独的轮胎压力 - 这些系统仅监控充气情况，并在一根天线出现充气不足或充气过多问题时向驾驶员发出警报。中线系统显示各个压力，有些系统在轮舱附近安装了四个天线。

paras.en: Low-line systems can’t detect a low tire pressure until the sensors in the wheels are activated by movement. Mid-line systems can “poke” the sensors with a low-frequency radio signal to get them to transmit information when the vehicle is first started or when prompted by the phone app. But, both systems use the wheel speed sensor to detect a sudden loss of pressure when the vehicle is moving.
paras.zh: 在车轮中的传感器因运动而激活之前，低线系统无法检测到低轮胎压力。中线系统可以用低频无线电信号“戳”传感器，让它们在车辆首次启动或手机应用程序提示时传输信息。但是，这两个系统都使用轮速传感器来检测车辆行驶时突然失压的情况。

paras.en: Mercedes-Benz and other German vehicle manufacturers make the assumption that people here in the U.S. adjust their tire pressure for the number of people in the vehicle and for the speed they intend to drive. They include the U.S. DOT-mandated tire pressure placard on the driver’s side door jamb, but also behind the gas filler door is the “Luftdruck” sticker, which gives the recommended tire pressure.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰和其他德国汽车制造商假设美国人会根据车内人数和驾驶速度调整轮胎压力。其中包括驾驶员侧门框上贴有美国交通部规定的轮胎压力标牌，加油门后面还有“Luftdruck”贴纸，上面给出了建议的轮胎压力。

paras.en: This sticker allows the driver set the correct tire pressure for the load and type of driving. If the driver intends to drive at 100 mph with four people in the vehicle, the sticker will advise them to add four more PSI in some cases. This mentality is also part of German tire pressure monitoring systems (TPMS) that require a reference pressure to set during a relearn.
paras.zh: 该贴纸允许驾驶员根据负载和驾驶类型设置正确的轮胎压力。如果驾驶员打算以 100 英里/小时的速度行驶，车内有 4 人，贴纸会建议他们在某些情况下再添加 4 个 PSI。这种心态也是德国轮胎压力监测系统 (TPMS) 的一部分，该系统需要在重新学习期间设置参考压力。

paras.en: Like all TPMS vehicles, the TPMS light illuminates continuously if one or more of the tires is significantly under or overinflated. If the TPMS light flashes for 60 seconds and then stays illuminated, the TPMS system itself is not operating properly and further diagnostics should be performed. If a condition causing the TPMS to malfunction develops, it may take up to 10 minutes for the system to start flashing a TPMS light.
paras.zh: 与所有 TPMS 车辆一样，如果一个或多个轮胎明显充气不足或过度充气，则 TPMS 灯会持续亮起。如果 TPMS 指示灯闪烁 60 秒然后保持亮起，则 TPMS 系统本身运行不正常，应执行进一步的诊断。如果出现导致 TPMS 故障的情况，系统可能需要长达 10 分钟的时间才会开始闪烁 TPMS 灯。

paras.en: With almost all Mercedes-Benz vehicles, you should use an auto relearn procedure that is activated by menus in the instrument cluster. The proper menu can vary by model. But, no matter the model or system, always inflate the tires to the recommended pressure before starting any relearn or reset procedure.
paras.zh: 对于几乎所有梅赛德斯-奔驰车辆，您都应该使用由组合仪表中的菜单激活的自动重新学习程序。正确的菜单可能因型号而异。但是，无论型号或系统如何，在开始任何重新学习或重置程序之前，请务必将轮胎充气至建议的压力。

paras.en: When the vehicle is in the restart mode, it is listening for the sensors. During this time, it is looking for the four or five signals that occur on the test drive to determine if a signal is coming from one of the sensors on the vehicle. The tires need to be set at the correct pressure first. This is called the “reference pressure” by Mercedes. If the inflation is not properly set, it could cause the tire pressure alert to come on.
paras.zh: 当车辆处于重启模式时，它会监听传感器。在此期间，它会寻找试驾中出现的四到五个信号，以确定信号是否来自车辆上的某个传感器。首先需要将轮胎设置为正确的压力。这被梅赛德斯称为“参考压力”。如果充气设置不正确，可能会导致轮胎压力警报响起。

paras.en: When the restart mode is activated, the display should read, “Tire Pressure Monitor Active,” or “Adopt Current Pressures as New Guidance Values.” Press OK to accept the new values. Or, the display will then issue the message “Use Current Pressures as New Reference Values.” Press OK and then it should show the message, “Tire Press Monitor Restarted.”
paras.zh: 激活重启模式后，显示屏应显示“轮胎压力监测器已激活”或“采用当前压力作为新的指导值”。按“确定”接受新值。或者，显示屏将发出消息“使用当前压力作为新参考值”。按“确定”，然后应显示消息“轮胎压力监视器已重新启动”。

paras.en: Drive the vehicle for at least 10 minutes as the system verifies that the current tire inflation pressures are within the specified range. During the drive, the current tire inflation pressures are accepted as reference values and inflation changes are based on this value.
paras.zh: 驾驶车辆至少 10 分钟，系统会验证当前轮胎充气压力是否在指定范围内。在驾驶过程中，当前轮胎充气压力被视为参考值，并且充气变化基于该值。

paras.en: Mid-line systems will typically require less time to restart or relearn a sensor’s position and start to display pressure values. Low-line systems may require at least 10 minutes of driving to complete the restart.
paras.zh: 中线系统通常需要更少的时间来重新启动或重新学习传感器的位置并开始显示压力值。低线系统可能需要至少 10 分钟的驾驶才能完成重启。

paras.en: If a relearn process can’t be completed, use a TPMS tool to activate a sensor to make sure it is active and transmitting. If not, replace the sensor.
paras.zh: 如果重新学习过程无法完成，请使用 TPMS 工具激活传感器，以确保其处于活动状态并正在传输。如果不是，请更换传感器。

articles.title: Autel Awards Five Automotive Education Scholarships
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Autel announced five recipients of its second annual Awarding Excellence Scholarships. The scholarships are part of Autel Cares, the company’s philanthropic initiative supporting automotive education and community causes.
paras.zh: Autel 宣布了第二届年度卓越奖学金的五位获奖者。这些奖学金是 Autel Cares 的一部分，这是该公司支持汽车教育和社区事业的慈善计划。

paras.en: The 2026 program awards five $5,000 scholarships, totaling $25,000. The awards support students pursuing education and training in automotive repair and service.
paras.zh: 2026 年计划颁发五项 5,000 美元的奖学金，总计 25,000 美元。该奖项支持学生接受汽车维修和服务方面的教育和培训。

paras.en: Recipients can use the scholarships for tuition, tools, books, supplies and other education-related expenses. The students are preparing for careers in the automotive repair industry.
paras.zh: 获奖者可以使用奖学金支付学费、工具、书籍、用品和其他与教育相关的费用。学生们正在为汽车维修行业的职业生涯做准备。

paras.en: This year, Autel expanded eligibility beyond recent high school graduates. Adult learners returning to school or transitioning from another career also qualified.
paras.zh: 今年，Autel 将资格范围扩大到刚毕业的高中毕业生。返回学校或从其他职业转型的成人学习者也符合资格。

paras.en: The 2026 recipients represent students at different stages of life and training. Their interests include automotive technology, collision repair, manufacturer-level service and automotive cybersecurity.
paras.zh: 2026 名获奖者代表了处于人生和培训不同阶段的学生。他们的兴趣包括汽车技术、碰撞修复、制造商级服务和汽车网络安全。

paras.en: “Last year, selecting our first scholarship recipients was difficult. This year was even more challenging because we received so many outstanding applications from students with compelling stories, clear goals, and a genuine commitment to automotive education,” said Chloe Hung, CEO of Autel U.S.
paras.zh: Autel 美国首席执行官 Chloe Hung 表示：“去年，选择第一批奖学金获得者非常困难。今年更具挑战性，因为我们收到了许多来自学生的优秀申请，这些学生拥有引人入胜的故事、明确的目标以及对汽车教育的真诚承诺。”

paras.en: “The five recipients selected this year reflect the many different paths people take into the automotive repair industry, from students beginning their training to adults continuing or returning to school. Autel is proud to support their education and invest in the skilled professionals who will help shape the future of automotive repair.”
paras.zh: “今年选出的五位获奖者反映了人们进入汽车维修行业的多种不同途径，从学生开始接受培训到成人继续或返回学校。Autel 很自豪能够支持他们的教育并投资于有助于塑造汽车维修未来的熟练专业人员。”

paras.en: The 2026 Autel Awarding Excellence Scholarship recipients are:
paras.zh: 2026 年 Autel 卓越奖学金获得者是：

paras.en: - Shawn Clark, of Deer Lodge, Montana, attends Highlands College of Montana Tech. Clark is beginning a new chapter in automotive education at age 50. He is pursuing an associate degree in automotive technology. His application reflects this year’s expanded eligibility for adult learners returning to school. Clark plans to build a new career in automotive repair.
paras.zh: - 蒙大拿州 Deer Lodge 的 Shawn Clark 就读于蒙大拿州高地理工学院。 50 岁时，克拉克开始了汽车教育的新篇章。他正在攻读汽车技术副学士学位。他的申请反映了今年成人学习者重返校园的资格扩大了。克拉克计划在汽车维修领域开创新的职业生涯。

paras.en: - Jacob Heinrichs, of Austin, Texas, attends Universal Technical Institute of Texas Inc. Heinrichs already works in the field and has three years of experience as an automotive technician. His selection reflects Autel’s support for working technicians seeking additional training. Heinrichs aims to advance his skills and career opportunities.
paras.zh: - Jacob Heinrichs 来自德克萨斯州奥斯汀，就读于德克萨斯州通用技术学院。Heinrichs 已经在该领域工作，并拥有三年的汽车技术人员经验。他的选择反映了 Autel 对寻求额外培训的工作技术人员的支持。海因里希斯的目标是提高他的技能和职业机会。

paras.en: - Marisa Rueger, of Harleysville, Pennsylvania, attends Automotive Training Center-Warminster. Rueger is pursuing collision repair and holds a 4.0 GPA. In her application, she described collision repair as her art. She also emphasized her desire to continue learning, growing and succeeding in the field.
paras.zh: - 来自宾夕法尼亚州哈利斯维尔的 Marisa Rueger 就读于沃明斯特汽车培训中心。 Rueger 致力于碰撞修复并拥有 4.0 GPA。在她的申请中，她将碰撞修复描述为她的艺术。她还强调了她在该领域继续学习、成长和取得成功的愿望。

paras.en: - Logan Mercier, of Claremont, California, attends Universal Technical Institute of California Inc. Mercier aims to complete school with a 4.0 GPA. He also plans to build advanced diagnostic skills and work toward becoming a master technician. His application focuses on academic achievement, professional growth and building a career in automotive repair.
paras.zh: - Logan Mercier，来自加利福尼亚州克莱蒙特，就读于加州环球技术学院。Mercier 的目标是以 4.0 的 GPA 完成学业。他还计划培养先进的诊断技能，并努力成为一名技术大师。他的申请重点是学术成就、专业发展和在汽车维修领域建立职业生涯。

paras.en: - Kristof Adam, of Stillwater, Minnesota, attends Century College. Adam is pursuing a career in automotive cybersecurity. He has a strong interest in hands-on vehicle work and advanced automotive technology. His application highlights the growing importance of technical education as vehicles become more connected, complex and software-driven.
paras.zh: - 明尼苏达州斯蒂尔沃特的克里斯托夫·亚当 (Kristof Adam) 就读于世纪学院。 Adam 正在从事汽车网络安全领域的职业。他对车辆实践和先进汽车技术有着浓厚的兴趣。他的申请凸显了随着车辆变得更加互联、复杂和软件驱动，技术教育变得越来越重要。

paras.en: Applicants submitted either a 500- to 600-word essay or a two- to three-minute video. They described the path that led them to pursue automotive repair education.
paras.zh: 申请人提交了一篇 500 到 600 字的论文或一段两到三分钟的视频。他们描述了引导他们追求汽车维修教育的道路。

paras.en: Applicants also explained how the scholarship would support their training. They discussed their goals, obstacles and planned careers in the automotive repair industry.
paras.zh: 申请人还解释了奖学金将如何支持他们的培训。他们讨论了自己在汽车维修行业的目标、障碍和职业规划。

articles.title: Top 5 Suspension Problems That Shops and DIYers Commonly Misdiagnose
articles.author: TrakMotive

paras.en: Struts, racks, and alignments get blamed for a lot of problems they didn’t cause. In many cases the real cause is a worn chassis part: a sway bar link, a ball joint, a tie rod end, a control arm bushing, or a strut mount. Here are five common misdiagnoses, and how to find the part that’s actually worn.
paras.zh: 支柱、机架和对准装置因许多并非由它们引起的问题而受到指责。在许多情况下，真正的原因是底盘部件磨损：稳定杆连杆、球窝接头、横拉杆端、控制臂衬套或支柱安装座。以下是五种常见的误诊，以及如何找到实际磨损的部件。

paras.en: - A clunk over bumps blamed on struts or shocks
paras.zh: - 颠簸时发出沉闷的声音，原因是支柱或减震器

paras.en: Worn struts usually make a vehicle bouncy or floaty. They rarely clunk. One of the most common sources is a sway bar end link or sway bar bushing, which is a much cheaper part. Worn strut mounts, ball joints, and control arm bushings are also common culprits. A loose exhaust hanger or heat shield can sound like any of them. To find it, grab each end link and try to twist it with the car on the ground. Then have a helper rock the car while you listen and feel at each component.
paras.zh: 磨损的支柱通常会使车辆有弹性或漂浮。他们很少发出沉闷的声音。最常见的来源之一是稳定杆端连杆或稳定杆衬套，这是一种便宜得多的零件。磨损的支柱安装座、球接头和控制臂衬套也是常见的罪魁祸首。松动的排气吊架或隔热罩听起来就像其中任何一个。要找到它，请抓住每个末端链接并尝试将汽车放在地面上扭转它。然后让一个帮手摇动汽车，同时您聆听并感觉每个部件。

paras.en: An alignment that checks out but still pulls is a common source of comebacks. Before you re-align, rule out these causes. Two of them are worn chassis parts:
paras.zh: 一个检查但仍然拉动的联盟是卷土重来的常见原因。在重新对齐之前，请排除这些原因。其中两个是磨损的底盘部件：

paras.en: - Radial tire pull: if swapping the front tires left to right reverses the pull, the tire is the cause.
paras.zh: - 子午线轮胎拉力：如果从左向右交换前轮胎使拉力反转，则轮胎是原因。

paras.en: - A sticking brake caliper: after a drive, one wheel will be noticeably hotter than the other.
paras.zh: - 制动卡钳粘滞：行驶后，一个车轮会明显比另一个车轮热。

paras.en: - A worn lower control arm bushing: it lets the wheel shift under braking or acceleration.
paras.zh: - 磨损的下控制臂衬套：它使车轮在制动或加速时发生移动。

paras.en: - A binding strut mount: it causes “memory steer,” where the car pulls in the direction of the last turn.
paras.zh: - 约束支柱安装座：它会导致“记忆转向”，即汽车沿上一转弯的方向拉动。

paras.en: 3. Loose steering or wander blamed on the steering rack
paras.zh: 3. 转向松动或跑偏归咎于转向齿条

paras.en: Play at the wheel often comes from somewhere else: a ball joint, control arm bushings, or a worn wheel bearing. How you check matters. Grab the tire at 9 and 3 o’clock and rock it. Play points to tie rods or the rack. Play when you rock it at 12 and 6 points to ball joints or a wheel bearing. Have a helper watch each joint so you can see where the movement actually is. When checking ball joints, remember that a load-carrying joint has to be unloaded before its play will show. If the coil spring sits on the lower control arm, support the lower arm near the joint. On strut designs, lift by the frame. When the spring sits on the upper arm, lift by the frame and wedge a block between the upper arm and the frame. Lifting at the wrong point can hide the wear. If the joint has a wear indicator, use it.
paras.zh: 车轮间隙通常来自其他地方：球窝接头、控制臂衬套或磨损的车轮轴承。如何检查很重要。抓住 9 点和 3 点钟位置的轮胎并摇晃它。发挥点为横拉杆或机架。当您以 12 点和 6 点摇动球接头或车轮轴承时即可进行演奏。让助手观察每个关节，以便您可以看到实际运动的位置。检查球窝接头时，请记住，必须先卸载承载接头，然后才能显示其间隙。如果螺旋弹簧位于下控制臂上，请在关节附近支撑下臂。在支柱设计中，通过框架提升。当弹簧位于上臂上时，抬起框架并在上臂和框架之间楔入一个块。在错误的位置提起可能会隐藏磨损。如果接头有磨损指示器，请使用它。

paras.en: 4. Tire wear blamed on alignment when the alignment is in spec
paras.zh: 4. 当对准符合规格时，轮胎磨损归咎于对准

paras.en: The printout is all green, but the tires keep wearing on the inside or feathering. Often the cause is a worn chassis part that the alignment rack can’t detect.
paras.zh: 打印输出全是绿色，但轮胎内部不断磨损或羽化。通常，原因是校准架无法检测到磨损的底盘部件。

paras.en: - Bushing deflection: A worn control arm, trailing arm, or subframe bushing can hold correct specs on the alignment rack but still let toe shift under braking, acceleration, or cornering. The rack measures a static car, while the tire wears dynamically. Pry gently on each arm and look for rubber that is cracked, torn, or pushed off center.
paras.zh: - 衬套偏转：磨损的控制臂、拖曳臂或副车架衬套可以在校准架上保持正确的规格，但在制动、加速或转弯时仍然会让前束发生偏移。机架测量静态汽车，而轮胎则动态磨损。轻轻撬动每条臂，寻找橡胶是否破裂、撕裂或偏离中心。

paras.en: - The rear axle gets ignored: Many shops do a front-only alignment on vehicles with adjustable or independent rear suspension. Rear toe or thrust angle that’s off makes the car “dog track,” and the front tires wear while the driver holds a slight steering correction.
paras.zh: - 后轴被忽略：许多商店对具有可调节或独立后悬架的车辆进行仅前部对准。后束角或推力角偏离会使汽车“狗跟踪”，并且当驾驶员进行轻微的转向修正时前轮胎会磨损。

paras.en: - Other factors: Running tires underinflated, carrying heavy loads (which changes camber and toe), skipping rotations, and worn shocks (which cause cupping) all produce wear patterns that look like an alignment problem.
paras.zh: - 其他因素：轮胎充气不足、承载重载（改变外倾角和前束）、跳动旋转和磨损的减震器（导致杯形）都会产生看起来像是对准问题的磨损模式。

paras.en: 5. Heavy steering or poor return-to-center blamed on the power steering pump, rack, or motor
paras.zh: 5. 转向沉重或回中心不良归咎于动力转向泵、齿条或电机

paras.en: When steering feels stiff, notchy, or doesn’t straighten itself after a turn, the pump, rack, or electric assist motor usually gets replaced first. Often the real cause is binding in the steering linkage or front suspension, which the power steering system then has to fight. A tie rod end or ball joint costs a fraction of what a new rack does.
paras.zh: 当转向感觉僵硬、有凹凸感或转弯后无法自行伸直时，通常首先更换泵、齿条或电动辅助电机。通常，真正的原因是转向连杆或前悬架中的束缚，然后动力转向系统必须与之对抗。拉杆端或球形接头的成本只是新机架的一小部分。

paras.en: - Seized or dry tie rod ends and ball joints. A joint can have no play at all, so it passes a play check, and still be stiff. A stiff joint makes the wheel feel heavy and keeps it from returning to center. Inspectors check for looseness but rarely check for binding. To check, disconnect the joint and move the stud by hand. It should move smoothly, with no notches or tight spots.
paras.zh: - 横拉杆端部和球形接头卡住或干燥。关节可能根本没有游隙，因此它通过了游隙检查，但仍然是僵硬的。僵硬的接头会使车轮感觉很重，并使其无法返回中心。检查员检查是否松动，但很少检查是否装订。要进行检查，请断开接头并用手移动螺柱。它应该移动平稳，没有凹口或紧点。

paras.en: - Binding upper strut mount bearings. These cause stiff or notchy steering, often with a creak, pop, or “boing” from the coil spring when turning at low speed. The steering also tends to stay where you leave it after a turn instead of straightening out.
paras.zh: - 绑定上支柱安装轴承。这些会导致转向僵硬或不顺畅，低速转弯时，螺旋弹簧通常会发出嘎吱声、爆裂声或“嗡嗡声”。转弯后方向盘也往往会停留在原地，而不是伸直。

paras.en: - Low or uneven caster. Caster is the main thing that makes the wheel return to center. A bent control arm or strut tower, a shifted subframe, or a worn radius rod or control arm bushing can reduce it. Uneven caster side to side also causes a pull toward the side with less caster.
paras.zh: - 主销后倾角低或不均匀。主销后倾角是使车轮回到中心的主要部件。弯曲的控制臂或支柱塔、移位的副车架、磨损的半径杆或控制臂衬套都可以减少这种情况。左右主销后倾角不均匀也会导致向主销后倾角较小的一侧产生拉力。

paras.en: Before you replace the strut, the rack, or the alignment, check the chassis. Most of the culprits on this list are worn control arms, ball joints, tie rod ends, sway bar links, bushings, or strut mounts, and Suspensia engineers every one of them to meet or exceed OE specifications.
paras.zh: 在更换支柱、机架或对齐之前，请检查底盘。此列表中的大多数罪魁祸首是磨损的控制臂、球形接头、横拉杆端部、稳定杆连杆、衬套或支柱安装座，Suspensia 设计的每一项都满足或超过原厂规格。

paras.en: This article was sponsored by Trakmotive Learn more at: https://www.suspensia.com/
paras.zh: 本文由 Trakmotive 赞助 了解更多信息：https://www.suspensia.com/

articles.title: Niterra President and CEO Mike Schwab on ‘Delivering Trusted Solutions’
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Mike Schwab, president and CEO of Niterra North America, Inc.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 Niterra North America, Inc. 的总裁兼首席执行官 Mike Schwab。

paras.en: Schwab said Niterra has evolved well beyond its roots as an ignition specialist while maintaining the quality and reliability associated with its NGK brand. Today, Niterra’s automotive portfolio extends beyond spark plugs to include ignition coils, wire sets, NTK oxygen and technical sensors and rotating electrical products such as starters and alternators.
paras.zh: Schwab 表示，Niterra 已经远远超越了其作为点火专家的根源，同时保持了 NGK 品牌相关的质量和可靠性。如今，Niterra 的汽车产品组合已不仅仅局限于火花塞，还包括点火线圈、电线组、NTK 氧气和技术传感器以及起动机和交流发电机等旋转电气产品。

paras.en: Schwab emphasized that quality, integrity, teamwork and consistent execution remain fundamental to Niterra’s business strategy, even as the industry evolves. These principles, he says, guide how the company serves customers, from delivering dependable products and maintaining transparency to strengthening partnerships and addressing customer challenges. Schwab emphasized that execution means consistently delivering on commitments involving product availability, customer service and new product introductions. While technology and product offerings will continue to change, he believes trust, reliability and strong customer relationships will remain essential to the company’s long-term success.
paras.zh: Schwab 强调，即使行业不断发展，质量、诚信、团队合作和一致执行仍然是 Niterra 业务战略的基础。他说，这些原则指导公司如何服务客户，从提供可靠的产品和保持透明度到加强合作伙伴关系和应对客户挑战。施瓦布强调，执行意味着始终如一地兑现涉及产品可用性、客户服务和新产品推出的承诺。尽管技术和产品供应将不断变化，但他相信信任、可靠性和强大的客户关系对于公司的长期成功仍然至关重要。

paras.en: Looking ahead, Schwab said the transition from NGK Spark Plug to Niterra represents a broader transformation rather than simply a name change. While continuing to strengthen its automotive business, the company is pursuing growth in new products, technologies and markets that build on its engineering capabilities. Opportunities in advanced mobility, electric vehicles and other emerging technologies are part of that strategy. Schwab said the Niterra name, derived from Latin words meaning “to shine” and “Earth,” reflects the company’s ambition to contribute to a more sustainable future.
paras.zh: 展望未来，Schwab 表示，从 NGK Spark Plug 到 Niterra 的转变代表着更广泛的转变，而不仅仅是更名。在继续加强汽车业务的同时，该公司正在以其工程能力为基础，寻求新产品、技术和市场的增长。先进移动、电动汽车和其他新兴技术的机会是该战略的一部分。施瓦布表示，Niterra 这个名字源自拉丁语，意思是“闪耀”和“地球”，反映了该公司为更加可持续的未来做出贡献的雄心。

paras.en: To hear more of Schwab’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解更多施瓦布的见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

paras.en: - How Niterra is expanding beyond spark plugs with a broader portfolio of ignition, sensor and rotating electrical products. (4:49)
paras.zh: - Niterra 如何通过更广泛的点火、传感器和旋转电气产品组合扩展到火花塞之外。 （4:49）

paras.en: - Quality, integrity, teamwork and execution remain fundamental to Niterra’s business strategy and help strengthen customer relationships and deliver value. (6:17)
paras.zh: - 质量、诚信、团队合作和执行仍然是 Niterra 业务战略的基础，有助于加强客户关系并创造价值。 （6:17）

paras.en: - Niterra emphasizes a people-first approach to serving the industry and what that commitment looks like in practice for customers, employees and partners. (9:14)

articles.title: BendPak Unveils Valor C10 Tribute Truck at SEMA
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: BendPak unveiled its first custom-built vehicle at the 2026 SEMA Show last week. The Valor C10 is a handcrafted 1970 Chevrolet C10 pickup truck honoring the service and sacrifice of U.S. military personnel.
paras.zh: BendPak 上周在 2026 年 SEMA 展上推出了其首款定制车辆。 Valor C10 是一款手工制作的 1970 款雪佛兰 C10 皮卡车，旨在纪念美国军人的服役和牺牲。

paras.en: “We call this build the Valor C10 — it was created to honor the brave men and women who have served and continue to serve in our armed forces, especially those who gave their lives in defense of our nation,” said BendPak President and CEO Jeff Kritzer. “BendPak proudly supports the military community. This serves as our way of saying thank you and reminding everyone that freedom isn’t free.”
paras.zh: BendPak 总裁兼首席执行官杰夫·克里策 (Jeff Kritzer) 表示：“我们将此建筑称为 Valor C10，它的创建是为了纪念曾经并继续在我们的武装部队中服役的勇敢男女，特别是那些为保卫我们国家而献出生命的人们。” “BendPak 自豪地支持军事界。这是我们表达感谢的方式，并提醒每个人自由不是免费的。”

paras.en: The Valor C10 tribute carries personal meaning for BendPak’s leadership and team, particularly around Veterans Day. U.S. Army veteran Don Henthorn founded BendPak in 1965. Kritzer served three years on active duty as a U.S. Air Force C-130 loadmaster.
paras.zh: Valor C10 致敬对 BendPak 的领导层和团队具有个人意义，特别是在退伍军人节前后。美国陆军退伍军人 Don Henthorn 于 1965 年创立了 BendPak。Kritzer 曾担任美国空军 C-130 装载主管三年。

paras.en: He then transitioned to the Air National Guard while beginning his full-time career at BendPak. He maintained his flight status and loadmaster duties for three more years. Kritzer’s father was a senior master sergeant and fellow loadmaster who devoted his life to military service. His son, Devin, served in the U.S. Army, including deployments to the Gulf region and Bangladesh.
paras.zh: 然后，他转入空军国民警卫队，同时在 BendPak 开始了他的全职职业生涯。他又维持了三年的飞行状态和装载管理员职责。克里策的父亲是一名高级军士长，也是一名装卸工，一生都在服兵役。他的儿子德文曾在美国陆军服役，包括部署到海湾地区和孟加拉国。

paras.en: The Valor C10 combines modern performance with the classic design of a 1970 Chevrolet pickup.
paras.zh: Valor C10 将现代性能与 1970 款雪佛兰皮卡的经典设计融为一体。

paras.en: Dustin Hacker and his team at Nostalgia Hot Rods built the Valor C10.
paras.zh: Dustin Hacker 和他在 Nostalgia Hot Rods 的团队打造了 Valor C10。

paras.en: “We’ve worked with Dustin for several years, supplying his shops with BendPak lifts and equipment, as well as showcasing many of his amazing builds in our SEMA Show booths,” said Sean Price, BendPak director of product development. “We knew he had the passion and craftsmanship to bring our vision for the Valor C10 to life.”
paras.zh: BendPak 产品开发总监 Sean Price 表示：“我们与达斯汀合作多年，为他的商店提供 BendPak 升降机和设备，并在我们的 SEMA 展位上展示了他的许多令人惊叹的作品。” “我们知道他拥有热情和精湛的技艺，能够将我们对 Valor C10 的愿景变为现实。”

paras.en: Hacker started with a vintage C10. By the project’s completion, only a heavily modified cab remained close to stock.
paras.zh: Hacker 从老式 C10 开始。到项目完成时，只剩下经过大量改装的驾驶室仍处于库存状态。

paras.en: “Most of the sheet metal is custom-fabricated, including the roof, hood, drip rails, floors, bumpers, engine bay and bed,” Hacker explained. “Under the hood, there’s a 376-cubic-inch V8 with a 2.9-liter Whipple supercharger. This thing will make 750 horsepower and drive like a dream.”
paras.zh: “大部分金属板都是定制的，包括车顶、引擎盖、滴水轨、地板、保险杠、发动机舱和床身，”哈克解释道。 “在引擎盖下，有一个 376 立方英寸的 V8 发动机和一个 2.9 升 Whipple 增压器。这辆车将产生 750 马力，驾驶起来就像梦想一样。”

paras.en: Valor C10 Features Custom Bodywork and Interior
paras.zh: Valor C10 采用定制车身和内饰

paras.en: Despite its lowered stance, the body-dropped C10 retains more than 4.5 inches of usable ground clearance. Hacker’s chassis setup allows the truck to navigate speed bumps and driveways. The truck features metallic blue paint with red accents on the body stripe, brake calipers and engine.
paras.zh: 尽管车身姿态较低，C10 仍保留了超过 4.5 英寸的可用离地间隙。黑客的底盘设置允许卡车在减速带和车道上行驶。该卡车采用金属蓝色油漆，车身条纹、制动卡钳和发动机上带有红色点缀。

paras.en: The color scheme references the U.S. flag. Blue represents vigilance, perseverance and justice, while red symbolizes hardiness, sacrifice and valor. The BendPak creative team designed custom Valor C10 badges for both doors.
paras.zh: 配色方案参考了美国国旗。蓝色代表警惕、毅力和正义，红色象征坚韧、牺牲和勇敢。 BendPak 创意团队为两扇门设计了定制 Valor C10 徽章。

paras.en: Inside, the truck features a classic bench seat with two-tone gray Alcantara upholstery and blue stitching. The interior also includes custom door panels and a headliner.
paras.zh: 车内配备经典的长座椅，配有双色灰色 Alcantara 内饰和蓝色缝线。内饰还包括定制门板和车顶内衬。

paras.en: The Valor C10 features numerous aftermarket performance components, including:
paras.zh: Valor C10 具有众多售后性能组件，包括：

paras.en: - BTR Gen V Stage 2 supercharged camshaft
paras.zh: - BTR Gen V Stage 2 增压凸轮轴

paras.en: - Holley Terminator X Max engine management system
paras.zh: - 华立终结者X Max发动机管理系统

paras.en: - Gearstar GM 6L80E six-speed automatic transmission
paras.zh: - Gearstar GM 6L80E 六速自动变速箱

paras.en: - Custom Eddie Motorsports serpentine system
paras.zh: - 定制Eddie Motorsports蛇形系统

paras.en: - QA1 four-way adjustable coilovers with cantilever rear suspension
paras.zh: - QA1 四向可调避震器，带悬臂式后悬架

paras.en: - PCS electronic gear shift module with wireless paddle shifter
paras.zh: - PCS电子换档模块，带无线换档拨片

paras.en: - Dapper Lighting custom headlights and taillights with custom billet housings
paras.zh: - Dapper Lighting 定制头灯和尾灯，带有定制钢坯外壳

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens First Store in King of Prussia
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its first store in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 125 W. Dekalb Pike with a ribbon-cutting ceremony alongside local officials and representatives from Central Montco Technical High School who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 在宾夕法尼亚州普鲁士国王开设了第一家商店，为当地驾驶员和汽车专业人士提供了更多零件、工具和专业知识。该公司为庆祝位于 125 W. Dekalb Pike 的商店开业举行了剪彩仪式，当地官员和中央 Montco 技术高中的代表在现场接受了学校汽车技术项目的捐款。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training and career opportunities through the school’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 此次捐赠将帮助学生通过学校的汽车技术项目获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员的需求量仍然很高，预计到 2034 年，每年大约有 70,000 个职位空缺。

paras.en: “We’re excited to bring Advance Auto Parts to King of Prussia and open our first store in the community,” said Eli Rosa, regional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “In addition to serving local customers, this market hub will help strengthen support for professional technicians and nearby shops across the area. We’re proud to mark the occasion by supporting Central Montco Technical High School and the programs that help students prepare for automotive technician careers.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 区域副总裁 Eli Rosa 表示：“我们很高兴将 Advance Auto Parts 带到普鲁士国王，并在社区开设我们的第一家商店。” “除了服务当地客户外，这个市场中心还将有助于加强对整个地区的专业技术人员和附近商店的支持。我们很自豪能够通过支持中央蒙特科技术高中和帮助学生为汽车技术人员职业生涯做好准备的计划来纪念这一时刻。”

paras.en: “We appreciate Advance Auto Parts’ support of career and technical education,” said Craig Robinson, administrative director at Central Montco Technical High School. “This donation helps support the hands-on learning experiences that are at the core of our automotive technology program and gives students opportunities to build skills they’ll use long after graduation.”
paras.zh: “我们感谢 Advance Auto Parts 对职业和技术教育的支持，”中央 Montco 技术高中行政总监 Craig Robinson 说道。 “这笔捐款有助于支持作为我们汽车技术项目核心的实践学习体验，并为学生提供培养毕业后长期使用的技能的机会。”

paras.en: The new store also serves as a market hub – a centralized facility designed to improve parts availability and same-day fulfillment across a network of stores, enhancing hard parts coverage for professional customers, Advance Auto Parts said.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 表示，新店还充当市场中心，这是一个集中设施，旨在提高整个商店网络的零部件可用性和当日履行率，从而提高专业客户的硬件零部件覆盖率。

articles.title: AI & the Aftermarket: MANN+HUMMEL’s Hasmeet Kaur
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: AftermarketNews asked executives from leading manufacturers/suppliers about how their companies are using artificial intelligence, what problems they hope to solve and how they see AI impacting their business in the coming years. It is our pleasure to share their insights and, today, we hear from Hasmeet Kaur, President of MANN+HUMMEL’s Global Transportation Division.
paras.zh: AftermarketNews 向领先制造商/供应商的高管询问了他们的公司如何使用人工智能、他们希望解决哪些问题以及他们如何看待人工智能在未来几年影响他们的业务。我们很高兴分享他们的见解，今天，我们听取了曼胡默尔全球运输部门总裁哈斯米特·考尔 (Hasmeet Kaur) 的发言。

paras.en: How is your company currently using artificial intelligence?
paras.zh: 贵公司目前使用人工智能的情况如何？

paras.en: At MANN+HUMMEL, we are combining our deep market and application expertise with digital and AI capabilities to better manage product and vehicle complexity across the global aftermarket. AI helps us identify gaps in product and application data, improve forecasting, support portfolio management, and accelerate decision-making across engineering and supply chain planning.
paras.zh: 在曼胡默尔，我们将深厚的市场和应用专业知识与数字和人工智能功能相结合，以更好地管理全球售后市场的产品和车辆复杂性。人工智能帮助我们识别产品和应用数据中的差距，改进预测，支持产品组合管理，并加快整个工程和供应链规划的决策。

paras.en: We also understand the power of AI in connecting expertise across our global organization and making information easier to access and use. By improving data quality, availability, and product identification, we can provide our customers with greater confidence when selecting the right filtration solutions.
paras.zh: 我们还了解人工智能在连接我们全球组织的专业知识以及使信息更容易访问和使用方面的力量。通过提高数据质量、可用性和产品识别，我们可以让客户在选择正确的过滤解决方案时更有信心。

paras.en: What specific business challenges are you hoping to solve through AI?
paras.zh: 您希望通过人工智能解决哪些具体的业务挑战？

paras.en: The aftermarket is becoming more complex every year. New vehicle technologies and a more diverse vehicle population create opportunities for growth, but they also raise the bar for product data, application coverage, and availability. Customers simply want confidence that they’re selecting the right filter and can get it when they need it.
paras.zh: 售后市场每年都变得更加复杂。新技术和更加多样化的车辆数量创造了增长机会，但也提高了产品数据、应用覆盖范围和可用性的标准。客户只是希望确信他们选择了正确的过滤器并且可以在需要时获得它。

paras.en: At MANN+HUMMEL, we have over 85 years of filtration expertise, and AI helps us make better use of that knowledge. Through AI and digital capabilities, we are working to support better decision-making and simplify complexity for both our teams and our customers. Our objective is to help ensure the right products are available for the right applications while providing practical support that enables greater confidence and efficiency across the aftermarket.
paras.zh: 在曼胡默尔，我们拥有超过 85 年的过滤专业知识，人工智能帮助我们更好地利用这些知识。通过人工智能和数字功能，我们致力于为我们的团队和客户提供更好的决策支持并简化复杂性。我们的目标是帮助确保为正确的应用提供正确的产品，同时提供实际支持，以增强整个售后市场的信心和效率。

paras.en: Looking ahead 3-5 years, where do you see AI having the greatest impact on the aftermarket?
paras.zh: 展望未来3-5年，您认为人工智能对售后市场影响最大的领域是什么？

paras.en: We see significant potential for AI to help the industry navigate increasing complexity as vehicles, technologies, and customer requirements continue to evolve. AI can help companies make better use of data, improve planning, and respond more quickly to changing market needs.
paras.zh: 随着车辆、技术和客户需求的不断发展，我们看到人工智能在帮助行业应对日益复杂的问题方面具有巨大潜力。人工智能可以帮助企业更好地利用数据、改进规划并更快地响应不断变化的市场需求。

paras.en: As vehicle technologies continue to advance, complete and connected data will become even more critical. AI will play an increasingly important role in turning large volumes of information into predictive insights that improve planning, product availability, and customer support. For distributors and customers, this means faster access to information, greater confidence in product selection, and a more seamless experience.
paras.zh: 随着车辆技术的不断进步，完整且互联的数据将变得更加重要。人工智能将在将大量信息转化为预测性见解方面发挥越来越重要的作用，从而改善规划、产品可用性和客户支持。对于分销商和客户来说，这意味着更快地获取信息、对产品选择更有信心以及更无缝的体验。
