articles.title: GSP Launches All-New, Core-Free Brake Caliper Line
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: GSP North America announced the GSP ADVANTEDGE Brake Caliper program, an all-new caliper range that frees distributors from the cost and hassle of managing cores. It’s on display at AAPEX, booth #F14611.
paras.zh: GSP North America 宣布了 GSP ADVANTEDGE 制动卡钳计划，这是一个全新的卡钳系列，可让经销商免于管理核心的成本和麻烦。它在 AAPEX 上展出，展位号：F14611。

paras.en: Every caliper is entirely new, distributors no longer need to handle, store, sort and ship cores back to the supplier, GSP said.
paras.zh: GSP 表示，每个卡钳都是全新的，经销商不再需要处理、存储、分类并将卡钳运回供应商。

paras.en: Every unit is built from the ground up with OE-matched components:
paras.zh: 每个单元均采用与原厂设备匹配的组件从头开始构建：

paras.en: - Precision-cast ductile iron or aluminum bodies and carrier brackets, with precision-machined surfaces and threads
paras.zh: - 精密铸造球墨铸铁或铝主体和托架，具有精密加工的表面和螺纹

paras.en: - OE-specified phenolic or steel pistons to match each braking system
paras.zh: - OE 指定的酚醛或钢活塞，以匹配每个制动系统

paras.en: - OE-grade EPDM seals and boots that hold piston pressure and keep contaminants out
paras.zh: - OE 级 EPDM 密封件和防尘套可保持活塞压力并防止污染物进入

paras.en: - Installation hardware included: copper washers, new banjo bolt and abutment clips
paras.zh: - 安装硬件包括：铜垫圈、新的班卓琴螺栓和基台夹

paras.en: - 100% end-of-line pressure and leak validated before leaving the factory
paras.zh: - 出厂前经过 100% 终端压力和泄漏验证

paras.en: The initial range covers more than 80% of category demand and is expected to reach 95% within 12 months of its formal launch at AAPEX.
paras.zh: 最初的产品系列覆盖了80%以上的品类需求，预计在AAPEX正式推出后12个月内将达到95%。

paras.en: The range is produced at GSP’s new manufacturing facility in Malaysia. GSP’s distribution partners can expect the same high-level quality and execution they have experienced in all GSP lines, the company said.
paras.zh: 该系列产品在 GSP 位于马来西亚的新制造工厂生产。该公司表示，GSP 的分销合作伙伴可以期待与所有 GSP 系列产品相同的高水平质量和执行力。

paras.en: “The GSP ADVANTEDGE Brake Caliper program is designed to improve distributors’ operational performance, increase bay throughput through enhanced quality and, ultimately, give customers restored and reliable braking performance,” said Tom Galla, director of new products for GSP North America.
paras.zh: GSP 北美新产品总监 Tom Galla 表示：“GSP ADVANTEDGE 制动卡钳计划旨在提高经销商的运营绩效，通过提高质量来增加海湾吞吐量，并最终为客户提供恢复且可靠的制动性能。”

articles.title: NTN Employees Volunteer at Local Food Pantry
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: NTN Bearing Corporation of America recently held a Community Spirit & Engagement Event at the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry in Elk Grove Village, Illinois. On Oct. 27, 12 NTN employees volunteered to help combat food insecurity and support local families ahead of Thanksgiving. Volunteers spent the morning assembling approximately 400 Thanksgiving food bags for distribution to families throughout the community. Team members followed a “trick-or-treat”-style shopping process, collecting and packing items at various food stations. Items included cooking oil, canned vegetables, canned pumpkin, mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, gravy, brownie mix and other household necessities.
paras.zh: 美国 NTN 轴承公司最近在伊利诺伊州埃尔克格罗夫村的埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室举办了社区精神与参与活动。 10 月 27 日，12 名 NTN 员工自愿在感恩节前帮助应对粮食不安全问题并支持当地家庭。志愿者花了一上午的时间组装了大约 400 个感恩节食品袋，分发给整个社区的家庭。团队成员遵循“不给糖就捣蛋”式的购物流程，在各个食品站收集和包装物品。商品包括食用油、罐装蔬菜、罐装南瓜、土豆泥、通心粉和奶酪、肉汁、布朗尼蛋糕粉和其他家庭必需品。

paras.en: In the afternoon, NTN employees helped pantry staff organize and store five pallets of donated food. According to the food pantry manager, the pantry’s regular staff and volunteers would have needed up to a month. The NTN team completed the same work in just a few hours.
paras.zh: 下午，NTN员工帮助食品储藏室工作人员整理并存放了五个托盘的捐赠食品。据食品储藏室经理称，储藏室的正式员工和志愿者最多需要一个月的时间。 NTN团队在短短几个小时内完成了同样的工作。

paras.en: “Helping to address food insecurity is an important part of NTN’s commitment to being a responsible corporate citizen,” said Tom Mohrdieck, president and CEO of NTN Bearing Corporation of America. “This volunteer event directly supports NTN’s global Sustainable Development Goal of Zero Hunger while allowing our employees to make a meaningful difference for families in our community. Knowing that the food bags assembled will help nearly 900 families celebrate Thanksgiving made this an especially impactful event for our team. NTN is grateful for the opportunity to support the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry and the vital services it provides throughout the year.”
paras.zh: 美国 NTN 轴承公司总裁兼首席执行官 Tom Mohrdieck 表示：“帮助解决粮食不安全问题是 NTN 致力于成为负责任的企业公民的重要组成部分。” “这次志愿者活动直接支持 NTN 的全球零饥饿可持续发展目标，同时让我们的员工为社区家庭做出有意义的改变。我们知道组装的食品袋将帮助近 900 个家庭庆祝感恩节，这对我们的团队来说是一次特别有影响力的活动。NTN 非常感谢有机会支持埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室及其全年提供的重要服务。”

paras.en: Community Engagement Program Supports Local Organizations
paras.zh: 社区参与计划支持当地组织

paras.en: NTN launched its Community Spirit & Engagement Program in January 2023. The program reflects the company’s commitment to responsible, ethical operations and supporting communities where it operates.
paras.zh: NTN 于 2023 年 1 月启动了社区精神和参与计划。该计划反映了公司对负责任、道德运营和支持其运营所在社区的承诺。

paras.en: Its goals include contributing time and resources to charitable organizations and encouraging employees to participate in their communities. The program also seeks to build partnerships with other groups and organizations.
paras.zh: 其目标包括为慈善组织贡献时间和资源，并鼓励员工参与社区活动。该计划还寻求与其他团体和组织建立伙伴关系。

paras.en: Food Pantry Serves 1,100 Families Monthly
paras.zh: 食品储藏室每月为 1,100 个家庭提供服务

paras.en: The Elk Grove Township Food Pantry provides food assistance and related support services to residents facing food insecurity. The pantry serves approximately 1,100 families monthly through a client-choice model. This approach allows households to access nutritious food and household essentials in a convenient, dignified manner.
paras.zh: 埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室为面临粮食不安全的居民提供粮食援助和相关支持服务。该食品储藏室每月通过客户选择模式为大约 1,100 个家庭提供服务。这种方法使家庭能够以方便、有尊严的方式获得营养食品和家庭必需品。

paras.en: Through partnerships with community organizations, donors and volunteers, the pantry helps local families access resources throughout the year. The pantry expects to distribute the Thanksgiving food bags from the event to nearly 900 families this holiday season.
paras.zh: 通过与社区组织、捐助者和志愿者的合作，食品储藏室全年帮助当地家庭获取资源。该食品储藏室预计将在这个假期向近 900 个家庭分发感恩节食品袋。

articles.title: This AI finds patterns in visual brain activity and turns them into pictures
articles.author: Alan Bradley

paras.en: An artificial intelligence (AI) tool can use brain scans to recreate the images people looked at with eerie accuracy.
paras.zh: 人工智能 (AI) 工具可以利用脑部扫描以令人毛骨悚然的精确度重新创建人们所看到的图像。

paras.en: The system, called Brain-IT, uses data from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) to measure activity in the visual cortex, the part of the brain that processes visual input. A computer model then predicts both the broad layout of an image and high-level information about its content. It then passes those predictions to an AI image generator, researchers explained in a study uploaded to the preprint database arXiv. The research was presented at the ICLR 2026 conference, held April 23-25, and publicized by its authors in September.
paras.zh: 该系统名为 Brain-IT，利用功能性磁共振成像 (fMRI) 的数据来测量视觉皮层（大脑中处理视觉输入的部分）的活动。然后，计算机模型会预测图像的总体布局以及有关其内容的高级信息。研究人员在上传到预印本数据库 arXiv 的一项研究中解释说，然后它将这些预测传递给人工智能图像生成器。该研究在 4 月 23 日至 25 日举行的 ICLR 2026 会议上发表，并于 9 月由作者公布。

paras.en: Brain-IT builds on an approach called the Universal Brain Encoder. That model begins with an image and then predicts the fMRI response that would be expected in individual "voxels" — small 3D units — in a brain scan.
paras.zh: Brain-IT 建立在一种称为通用大脑编码器的方法之上。该模型从图像开始，然后预测脑部扫描中单个“体素”（小型 3D 单位）中预期的功能磁共振成像响应。

paras.en: "The key idea is that every voxel, a tiny cube of brain tissue, gets its own learned vector that captures what it cares about in images," said study first author Roman Beliy, a doctoral candidate in the Department of Computer Science and Applied Mathematics at the Weizmann Institute of Science in Israel.
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者、以色列魏茨曼科学研究所计算机科学和应用数学系的博士生罗曼·贝利（Roman Beliy）说：“关键的想法是，每个体素（脑组织的一个小立方体）都有自己学习的向量，捕捉图像中它关心的内容。”

paras.en: Some voxels may be tuned to relatively simple elements of an image, such as edges, textures or locations. Others might be responding to higher-level abstract categories, like faces, bodies or scenes.
paras.zh: 一些体素可以被调整为图像的相对简单的元素，例如边缘、纹理或位置。其他人可能会对更高级别的抽象类别做出反应，例如面孔、身体或场景。

paras.en: Traditional image-to-fMRI systems have generally been custom trained for each participant and dataset. The Universal Brain Encoder is more flexible. It learns from data from multiple people and can transfer information across participants, datasets or different MRI systems with varying magnetic-field strengths, according to the study.
paras.zh: 传统的图像到功能磁共振成像系统通常针对每个参与者和数据集进行定制训练。通用大脑编码器更加灵活。研究表明，它可以从多人的数据中学习，并可以在参与者、数据集或具有不同磁场强度的不同 MRI 系统之间传输信息。

paras.en: A voxel can determine which parts of an image are relevant to it based on its learned profile, essentially saying, "I recognize edges. Which parts of this image are edges?"
paras.zh: 体素可以根据其学习的轮廓确定图像的哪些部分与其相关，本质上是说，“我识别边缘。该图像的哪些部分是边缘？”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The Universal Brain Encoder starts with an image and predicts brain activity; Brain-IT starts with measured brain activity and reconstructs the image the person saw. In other words,it asks "based on this brain activity, what was the subject looking at?". It sorts thousands of tiny brain-scan measurements from the visual cortex into 128 groups based on the kinds of visual information they tend to carry.
paras.zh: 通用大脑编码器从图像开始并预测大脑活动； Brain-IT 首先测量大脑活动并重建人们看到的图像。换句话说，它询问“根据这种大脑活动，受试者在看什么？”。它根据视觉皮层中数千个微小的大脑扫描测量结果往往携带的视觉信息类型将其分为 128 组。

paras.en: The system then lets those groups share clues with one another, allowing it to combine, for example, information about a scene's shape, color and possible objects, to build a more complete picture of the image, Beliy explained.
paras.zh: 贝利解释说，然后，系统让这些小组彼此分享线索，从而能够结合有关场景形状、颜色和可能物体的信息，以构建更完整的图像图片。

paras.en: The decoder produces two types of visual predictions. One captures semantic information — the features associated with what is likely in a scene; for an image of a dog standing in grass, for instance, this would include things like the features of a dog and an outdoor, grassy setting. The other captures structural information, like the broad visual layout or how forms are arranged.
paras.zh: 解码器产生两种类型的视觉预测。捕获语义信息——与场景中可能发生的情况相关的特征；例如，对于站在草地上的狗的图像，这将包括狗的特征和户外草地环境等内容。另一个捕获结构信息，例如广泛的视觉布局或形式的排列方式。

paras.en: In the above example, this would be aspects like the outline of the dog or where it was positioned in the frame. The structural prediction gives the generator a starting point for the image, rather than beginning from pure noise, while the semantic info guides an image generator that removes the remaining static until the image emerges.
paras.zh: 在上面的示例中，这将是狗的轮廓或它在框架中的位置等方面。结构预测为生成器提供了图像的起点，而不是从纯噪声开始，而语义信息指导图像生成器消除剩余的静态，直到图像出现。

paras.en: Although the new tool can recreate what people see, it can't reproduce memories or imagined scenes.
paras.zh: 虽然新工具可以重现人们所看到的东西，但它无法重现记忆或想象的场景。

paras.en: "We're not reading people's thoughts," study co-author Michal Irani, a computer scientist at the Weizmann Institute of Science, told Live Science. "The images we do manage to recover from fMRI require people's cooperation and full intended collaboration."
paras.zh: “我们没有读懂人们的想法，”该研究的合著者、魏茨曼科学研究所的计算机科学家米哈尔·伊拉尼 (Michal Irani) 告诉《生活科学》。 “我们设法从功能磁共振成像中恢复的图像需要人们的合作和充分的预期协作。”

paras.en: Brain-IT's synthetic images were compared with the images that participants saw. Brain-IT surpassed prior leading methods on standard objective reconstruction metrics and produced more faithful results, the study authors wrote. The system shined when limited fMRI data from a new participant was available, with just one hour of data from a new participant producing results as accurately as earlier approaches that had been trained on 40 hours of recordings.
paras.zh: Brain-IT 的合成图像与参与者看到的图像进行了比较。研究作者写道，Brain-IT 在标准客观重建指标方面超越了之前的领先方法，并产生了更忠实的结果。当来自新参与者的有限 fMRI 数据可用时，该系统会大放异彩，只需来自新参与者的一小时数据即可产生与经过 40 小时记录训练的早期方法一样准确的结果。

paras.en: A high-scoring or realistic-looking output should not be mistaken for a perfect copy of what someone saw, however.
paras.zh: 然而，高分或逼真的输出不应被误认为是某人所看到内容的完美副本。

paras.en: In the final stage of processing, the system uses an off-the-shelf diffusion generator trained on massive numbers of images. Models like this generate plausible images and can smooth textures, sharpen facial features or fill in missing details.
paras.zh: 在处理的最后阶段，系统使用经过大量图像训练的现成扩散生成器。像这样的模型可以生成可信的图像，并且可以平滑纹理、锐化面部特征或填充缺失的细节。

paras.en: Beliy said this "beautification" can make reconstructions more polished and convincing and introduce details that don't necessarily come from the brain data itself. In other words, the scan constrains the generated picture, but the AI model supplies some of its realism from learned patterns in photographs.
paras.zh: 贝利说，这种“美化”可以使重建更加精致和令人信服，并引入不一定来自大脑数据本身的细节。换句话说，扫描限制了生成的图片，但人工智能模型通过学习照片中的模式提供了一些真实感。

paras.en: While the new system produces impressive results for seen images, it can't be used to reconstruct an imagined or remembered image.
paras.zh: 虽然新系统对所看到的图像产生了令人印象深刻的结果，但它不能用于重建想象或记住的图像。

paras.en: "Brain-IT relies on how the brain processes a seen image," Irani said. "Information flows from the eyes to the primary visual cortex and onward through a series of visual areas that recognize objects and scenes."
paras.zh: “Brain-IT 依赖于大脑如何处理所看到的图像，”伊拉尼说。 “信息从眼睛流向初级视觉皮层，然后通过一系列识别物体和场景的视觉区域。”

paras.en: In a controlled experiment, researchers also know precisely which image was shown, giving the model a target during training and evaluation. In contrast, memories and imagined images do not offer the same clean reference. They can be vague and shaped by brain networks involved in memory and thought, with only partial and weaker reactivation of visual regions, Irani said. One limitation that would prevent this technology from being widely deployed is that the only way to get reliable results is from fMRI scanning, which is cumbersome and expensive. The team is currently experimenting with using easier-to-collect electroencephalogram (EEG) data, which is obtained via electrodes on the head, but that work is in the very preliminary stages, according to Irani.
paras.zh: 在受控实验中，研究人员还可以准确地知道显示的是哪张图像，从而在训练和评估期间为模型提供目标。相比之下，记忆和想象的图像不能提供同样清晰的参考。伊拉尼说，它们可能是模糊的，由涉及记忆和思维的大脑网络塑造，只有部分和较弱的视觉区域重新激活。阻碍这项技术广泛部署的一个限制是，获得可靠结果的唯一方法是功能磁共振成像扫描，这种扫描既麻烦又昂贵。伊朗尼表示，该团队目前正在尝试使用更容易收集的脑电图（EEG）数据，这些数据是通过头部电极获得的，但这项工作还处于非常初步的阶段。

paras.en: The new system could help brain researchers better understand which visual information is represented in different brain regions, how those regions interact and how individuals’ patterns differ. Such tools could eventually reveal differences in visual processing that could help clinicians spot neurological, neurodevelopmental and psychiatric conditions.
paras.zh: 新系统可以帮助大脑研究人员更好地了解不同大脑区域代表哪些视觉信息、这些区域如何相互作用以及个体的模式有何不同。这些工具最终可以揭示视觉处理的差异，从而帮助临床医生发现神经、神经发育和精神疾病。

paras.en: "There are numerous useful medical applications which we are currently striving toward," Irani said. "These include using our brain encoder/decoder to detect and analyze brain disorders such as MS, PTSD, autism and psychiatric disorders."
paras.zh: “我们目前正在努力实现许多有用的医疗应用，”伊拉尼说。 “其中包括使用我们的大脑编码器/解码器来检测和分析大脑疾病，例如多发性硬化症、创伤后应激障碍、自闭症和精神疾病。”

paras.en: Beliy, R., Zalcher, A., Kogman, J., Wasserman, N., & Irani, M. (2025, October 29). Brain-IT: Image Reconstruction from fMRI via Brain-Interaction Transformer. arXiv.org. https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.25976
paras.zh: Beliy, R.、Zalcher, A.、Kogman, J.、Wasserman, N. 和Irani, M.（2025 年，10 月 29 日）。 Brain-IT：通过 Brain-Interaction Transformer 从 fMRI 重建图像。 arXiv.org。 https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.25976

articles.title: Astronomers confirm a tiny new moon is orbiting Earth, and it'll stick around for the holidays
articles.author: Joanna Thompson

paras.en: Earth and its moon will have company this holiday season. In April, our planet picked up a passing "minimoon," pulling the space rock into a temporary orbit, astronomers have confirmed.
paras.zh: 这个假期，地球和月球将有伴。天文学家证实，四月，我们的星球发现了一颗路过的“小月亮”，将太空岩石拉入临时轨道。

paras.en: The object, dubbed 2026 QQ8, was first observed by Hungarian researcher Krisztián Sárneczky in August. It was officially reported by the International Astronomical Union's (IAU) Minor Planet Center — the body that logs and confirms new solar system objects — on Oct. 29. This extraterrestrial traveler is expected to stick around until January 2027, extending its stay through the holidays before breaking free of our planet's influence.
paras.zh: 这个被称为 2026 QQ8 的天体是匈牙利研究员 Krisztián Sárneczky 在 8 月份首次观测到的。国际天文学联合会 (IAU) 小行星中心（负责记录和确认太阳系新天体的机构）于 10 月 29 日正式报道了这一消息。这位外星旅行者预计将在地球上停留到 2027 年 1 月，在摆脱地球的影响之前，将在假期期间延长停留时间。

paras.en: 2026 QQ8 is tiny — only about 6 feet (2 meters) across, according to the IAU. If it got too close to Earth, it would likely burn up in our planet's atmosphere. However, researchers don't think there is much chance of that happening, since 2026 QQ8 is currently orbiting at around 1.5 times the average distance of the moon.
paras.zh: 据 IAU 称，2026 QQ8 很小——直径只有约 6 英尺（2 米）。如果它离地球太近，它可能会在我们星球的大气层中燃烧。然而，研究人员认为这种情况发生的可能性不大，因为 2026 QQ8 目前的轨道运行距离约为月球平均距离的 1.5 倍。

paras.en: 2026 QQ8 takes 359 days — almost a full Earth year — to orbit the sun. It comes close to our planet every 10 years or so. This minimoon is classified as an Aten asteroid; this population of space rocks occasionally cross into Earth's orbit and have semimajor axes smaller than Earth's, meaning they typically orbit closer to the sun than our planet does. Large Aten asteroids are considered the most dangerous type of asteroid, as they can easily get lost in the sun's glare before speeding toward Earth — but, again, our new mini companion is far too small to pose a threat.
paras.zh: 2026 QQ8 绕太阳运行一周需要 359 天——几乎是一个地球年。它每十年左右就会靠近我们的星球一次。这颗小卫星被归类为阿顿小行星；这些太空岩石偶尔会进入地球轨道，并且其长半轴小于地球的轨道，这意味着它们的轨道通常比我们的星球更靠近太阳。大型阿顿小行星被认为是最危险的小行星类型，因为它们在加速冲向地球之前很容易在太阳的眩光中迷失方向——但是，我们的新迷你小行星太小了，不足以构成威胁。

paras.en: - An 'invisible threat': Swarm of hidden 'city killer' asteroids around Venus could one day collide with Earth, simulations show
paras.zh: - 一种“看不见的威胁”：模拟显示，金星周围隐藏的一群“城市杀手”小行星有一天可能会与地球相撞

paras.en: - 'City killer' asteroid 2024 YR4 could shower Earth with 'bullet-like' meteors if it hits the moon in 2032
paras.zh: - “城市杀手”小行星 2024 YR4 如果在 2032 年撞击月球，可能会给地球带来“子弹状”流星雨

paras.en: - Fallout from NASA's asteroid-smashing DART mission could hit Earth — potentially triggering 1st human-caused meteor shower
paras.zh: - 美国宇航局小行星撞击任务DART的碎片可能撞击地球，有可能会引发人类有史以来第一次人为流星雨

paras.en: 2026 QQ8 is not the first minimoon discovered circling Earth. That distinction belongs to 1991 VG, which was around 30 feet (10 meters) in diameter when it was detected in November 1991. Astronomers now think Earth grabs minimoons pretty frequently; we are likely to have at least one at any given time. Most of the space rocks stay around for less than a year, although a handful may remain in Earth's gravitational pull for decades.
paras.zh: 2026 QQ8 并不是第一个被发现绕地球运行的小卫星。这一区别属于 1991 VG，当它于 1991 年 11 月被发现时，它的直径约为 30 英尺（10 米）。天文学家现在认为地球经常捕获小卫星；因此，地球经常会捕获小卫星。在任何特定时间我们都可能至少有一个。大多数太空岩石的存在时间不到一年，尽管少数可能会在地球引力的作用下保留数十年。

paras.en: New telescopes are expected to help researchers spot more minimoons as they enter and leave Earth's orbit. These include the Vera C. Rubin Observatory in Chile, which began operation earlier this year. The Rubin observatory, which takes a full scan of the entire Southern Hemisphere sky every few days, has already spotted what may be a new dwarf planet lurking in the outer solar system, as well as a new satellite galaxy of the Milky Way. Over its planned 10-year mission, the observatory is expected to detect millions of previously unknown moving objects in space.
paras.zh: 新的望远镜预计将帮助研究人员在进入和离开地球轨道时发现更多的小卫星。其中包括今年早些时候开始运行的智利维拉·C·鲁宾天文台。鲁宾天文台每隔几天对整个南半球天空进行一次全面扫描，已经发现了可能是潜伏在太阳系外的一颗新矮行星，以及银河系的一个新卫星星系。在计划的 10 年任务中，该天文台预计将探测到数百万个以前未知的太空移动物体。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Joanna Thompson is a science journalist and runner based in New York. She holds a B.S. in Zoology and a B.A. in Creative Writing from North Carolina State University, as well as a Master's in Science Journalism from NYU's Science, Health and Environmental Reporting Program. Find more of her work in Scientific American, The Daily Beast, Atlas Obscura or Audubon Magazine.
paras.zh: 乔安娜·汤普森 (Joanna Thompson) 是一位驻纽约的科学记者和跑步者。她拥有学士学位。动物学学士学位和学士学位拥有北卡罗来纳州立大学创意写作学士学位，以及纽约大学科学、健康和环境报告项目科学新闻学硕士学位。在《科学美国人》、《每日野兽报》、《Atlas Obscura》或《奥杜邦杂志》中查找她的更多作品。

articles.title: Measles is back in the United States, WHO authorities say
articles.author: Nicoletta Lanese

paras.en: Measles is officially back in the United States after the disease had been eliminated from the country for more than 25 years.
paras.zh: 麻疹在美国消灭超过 25 年之后，正式回归美国。

paras.en: The U.S. officially eliminated measles in 2000, meaning that at that time, the country had gone over a year without continuous domestic spread of the disease. Travelers would occasionally bring measles into the country, sometimes sparking significant local outbreaks, but these didn't tip enough dominoes to lead to ongoing domestic transmission.
paras.zh: 美国于2000年正式消灭了麻疹，这意味着当时该国已经有一年多时间没有出现该疾病在国内持续传播的情况。旅行者偶尔会将麻疹带入该国，有时会引发当地重大疫情，但这些并没有引发足够多的多米诺骨牌，导致国内持续传播。

paras.en: That status has now changed, the Wall Street Journal reported Friday (Nov. 13). The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO), which is the regional office of the World Health Organization for the Americas, has reevaluated the United States' measles elimination status and determined that it should be revoked. With this decision, the U.S. joins several other nations that have seen a local return of measles, including the U.K. and Canada.
paras.zh: 据《华尔街日报》周五（11 月 13 日）报道，这种状况现在已经发生了变化。世界卫生组织美洲区域办事处泛美卫生组织（PAHO）重新评估了美国的麻疹消除状况，并决定应撤销该政策。通过这一决定，美国加入了英国和加拿大等其他几个出现麻疹疫情的国家的行列。

paras.en: The decision follows a series of major measles outbreaks that kicked off in January 2025. Nearly 2,300 cases were reported nationwide in 2025, and so far in 2026, almost 5,412 confirmed cases have been confirmed, although both tallies are likely undercounts.
paras.zh: 这一决定是在 2025 年 1 月爆发的一系列重大麻疹疫情之后做出的。2025 年全国报告了近 2,300 例病例，2026 年迄今为止，已确诊近 5,412 例确诊病例，尽管这两个数字可能都被低估了。

paras.en: "When January 2025 picked up, I felt like this might be the point of no return," Maimuna Majumder, a distinguished scholar in the Computational Health Informatics Program at Boston Children's Hospital, previously told Live Science. "I do want to just stress that measles elimination has always been a tenuous prospect, and it is, by design, tenuous," she added.
paras.zh: 波士顿儿童医院计算健康信息学项目的杰出学者 Maimuna Majumder 此前告诉《Live Science》：“2025 年 1 月到来时，我觉得这可能是一个无法回头的时刻。” “我确实想强调，消除麻疹的前景一直是一个脆弱的前景，而且从设计上来说，它是脆弱的，”她补充道。

paras.en: It takes work to keep an eliminated disease from resurging. The effort rests largely on keeping vaccination rates above a critical threshold — because the measles virus spreads so easily, at least 95% of the population needs immunity via either vaccination or past infection to prevent large outbreaks from occurring and fueling uncontrolled spread. National measles vaccination rates have been falling in recent years, with just 10 states reporting rates above the immunity threshold among kindergarteners for 2025-2026.
paras.zh: 需要努力防止已消除的疾病再次出现。这项努力主要在于将疫苗接种率保持在临界阈值以上——因为麻疹病毒非常容易传播，至少 95% 的人口需要通过疫苗接种或过去感染获得免疫力，以防止大规模疫情爆发并助长不受控制的传播。近年来，全国麻疹疫苗接种率一直在下降，只有 10 个州报告 2025-2026 年幼儿园儿童的麻疹疫苗接种率高于免疫阈值。

paras.en: Experts point to several factors to explain the trend, including declining funds and staff for public health efforts and wavering public trust in vaccines and scientific expertise. The appointment of vaccine skeptic Robert F. Kennedy Jr. as health secretary and the loss of long-standing federal health leadership further fueled the trend, they say, as vaccine guidance has been changed in ways that likely sow confusion and the federal rhetoric around vaccines now frames their safety and effectiveness as open questions when they are actually well-established.
paras.zh: 专家指出了几个因素来解释这一趋势，包括用于公共卫生工作的资金和人员的减少以及公众对疫苗和科学专业知识的信任的动摇。他们表示，对疫苗持怀疑态度的小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪(Robert F. Kennedy Jr.)被任命为卫生部长，以及长期担任联邦卫生领导职务的丧失进一步加剧了这一趋势，因为疫苗指导方针的改变可能会造成混乱，而联邦围绕疫苗的言论现在将其安全性和有效性视为悬而未决的问题，而实际上疫苗的安全性和有效性已经得到了充分证实。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The nation's first measles-related deaths this year were reported in Pennsylvania in August, and five more have followed, according to state health officials. (Some of these deaths have not been confirmed by the federal government.) A death reported in Wisconsin and another in New York have brought the current total to eight, per states' counts.
paras.zh: 据州卫生官员称，宾夕法尼亚州 8 月报告了今年全国首例与麻疹相关的死亡病例，随后又发生了 5 例死亡病例。 （其中一些死亡病例尚未得到联邦政府的证实。）根据各州的统计，威斯康星州报告的一例死亡病例和纽约州的另一例死亡病例使目前的死亡总数达到八例。

paras.en: In the U.S., about 1 to 3 out of every 1,000 measles cases results in death. Pennsylvania has recorded just over 1,500 cases, so its number of reported deaths is higher than expected, hinting that the state's true case rate has not been fully captured in the data.
paras.zh: 在美国，每 1,000 例麻疹病例中约有 1 至 3 例导致死亡。宾夕法尼亚州已记录了 1,500 多例病例，因此报告的死亡人数高于预期，这表明该州的真实病例数尚未完全反映在数据中。

paras.en: In survivors, measles can cause long-term health problems, including brain damage and immune amnesia, in which the immune cells tasked with remembering past infections have their "memories" wiped.
paras.zh: 对于幸存者来说，麻疹可能会导致长期的健康问题，包括脑损伤和免疫失忆症，其中负责记住过去感染的免疫细胞的“记忆”被抹去。

paras.en: The PAHO's meeting to reevaluate the United States' status was originally scheduled for April but was pushed to November.
paras.zh: 泛美卫生组织重新评估美国地位的会议原定于 4 月举行，但被推迟到 11 月。

paras.en: To regain its measles elimination status, the U.S. must go 12 months without continuous spread of the virus.
paras.zh: 要恢复麻疹消除状态，美国必须在 12 个月内没有病毒持续传播。

paras.en: Disclaimer: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 免责声明：本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Nicoletta Lanese is the health channel editor at Live Science and was previously a news editor and staff writer at the site. She is a recipient of the 2026 AHCJ International Health Study Fellowship, with a project focused on antibiotic stewardship practices in Japan and the U.S. They hold a graduate certificate in science communication from UC Santa Cruz and degrees in neuroscience and dance from the University of Florida. Beyond Live Science, Lanese's work has appeared in The Scientist, Science News, the Mercury News, Mongabay and Stanford Medicine Magazine, among other outlets. Based in NYC, she also remains involved in dance and performs in local choreographers' work.
paras.zh: Nicoletta Lanese 是 Live Science 的健康频道编辑，此前曾担任该网站的新闻编辑和特约撰稿人。她是 2026 年 AHCJ 国际健康研究奖学金的获得者，该项目的重点是日本和美国的抗生素管理实践。他们拥有加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的科学传播研究生证书以及佛罗里达大学的神经科学和舞蹈学位。除了《Live Science》之外，Lanese 的作品还出现在《科学家》、《科学新闻》、《水星新闻》、《Mongabay》和《斯坦福医学杂志》等媒体上。她以纽约为基地，仍然参与舞蹈并在当地编舞家的工作中表演。

articles.title: More Than 3,000 Tarantulas Were Found Hidden in Socks During a Major Wildlife Trafficking Bust at an Airport in Lima, Peru

paras.en: Authorities in Peru say they have foiled a plot to smuggle more than 3,000 tarantulas—including species not yet described in scientific publications—out of the country.
paras.zh: 秘鲁当局表示，他们挫败了一起将 3000 多只狼蛛走私出境的阴谋，其中包括科学出版物中尚未描述的物种。

paras.en: After receiving an anonymous tip, officials intercepted three travelers—two German citizens and one Polish citizen—at Jorge Chávez International Airport in Lima as they were checking in at the boarding area. When they searched the travelers’ luggage, they found thousands of eggs, hatchlings and adult spiders hidden in socks, according to a November 4 statement from the National Forest and Wildlife Service of Peru (SERFOR).
paras.zh: 收到匿名举报后，官员在利马豪尔赫·查韦斯国际机场登机区拦截了三名旅客——两名德国公民和一名波兰公民。根据秘鲁国家森林和野生动物管理局 (SERFOR) 11 月 4 日的一份声明，他们在搜查旅客的行李时，发现了数千枚藏在袜子里的蜘蛛蛋、刚孵化的蜘蛛和成年蜘蛛。

paras.en: “We noticed that some of them were moving,” Cora Suárez, a SERFOR forest and wildlife control technician who works at the airport, tells the Agence France-Presse. “There were small ones and large ones.”
paras.zh: “我们注意到其中一些正在移动，”在机场工作的 SERFOR 森林和野生动物控制技术员科拉·苏亚雷斯 (Cora Suárez) 告诉法新社。 “有小的，也有大的。”

paras.en: Workers used slender wooden sticks to gently brush the spiders into clear plastic containers. Once officials are done investigating them, the tarantulas will be taken to an authorized breeding center.
paras.zh: 工人们用细长的木棍轻轻地将蜘蛛刷入透明的塑料容器中。一旦官员完成调查，狼蛛将被带到授权的繁殖中心。

paras.en: The travelers were trying to fly to Germany. Instead, they were detained by the Peruvian National Police’s environmental crimes unit and now face criminal charges.
paras.zh: 旅客正试图飞往德国。相反，他们被秘鲁国家警察的环境犯罪部门拘留，现在面临刑事指控。

paras.en: Officials have not released the names of the individuals. However, one of the travelers was a “renowned tarantula researcher,” according to the statement, per a translation by the New York Times’ Amanda Holpuch.
paras.zh: 官员尚未公布这些人的姓名。然而，根据《纽约时报》阿曼达·霍尔普奇翻译的声明，其中一名旅行者是“著名的狼蛛研究员”。

paras.en: Authorities suspect the individuals were smuggling the spiders for private collections, research and the exotic pet trade. Suárez tells the AFP that one tarantula can sell for roughly $560 in Europe, meaning the smugglers could have made around $1.68 million from the more than 3,000 tarantulas they had hidden in their suitcases.
paras.zh: 当局怀疑这些人走私蜘蛛是为了私人收藏、研究和奇异宠物贸易。苏亚雷斯告诉法新社，一只狼蛛在欧洲的售价约为 560 美元，这意味着走私者可以从他们藏在行李箱中的 3000 多只狼蛛中赚取约 168 万美元。

paras.en: The spiders originated from several different parts of Peru, including the cities of Cajamarca, Cusco and Junín, and the regions of La Libertad and Loreto. Officials are still trying to pinpoint all the species in the loot but said it included several brightly colored creatures.
paras.zh: 这些蜘蛛起源于秘鲁的几个不同地区，包括卡哈马卡、库斯科和胡宁市，以及拉利伯塔德和洛雷托地区。官员们仍在试图查明战利品中的所有物种，但表示其中包括几种颜色鲜艳的生物。

paras.en: So far, officials have identified Thrixopelma lagunas, also known as the Peruvian blue zebra or the blue birdeater. Authorities also found members of the Pamphobeteus genus, which are among the largest tarantulas in the world.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，官员们已经确认了 Thrixopelma lagunas（也称为秘鲁蓝斑马或蓝色食鸟鸟）的身份。当局还发现了 Pamphobeteus 属的成员，它们是世界上最大的狼蛛之一。

paras.en: One species was P. antinous, which is considered a vulnerable, legally protected threatened wildlife species in Peru. These arachnids are commonly known as Bolivian blue-leg birdeaters or steely blue legs.
paras.zh: 其中一个物种是 P. antinous，它被认为是秘鲁脆弱的、受法律保护的受威胁野生动物物种。这些蛛形纲动物通常被称为玻利维亚蓝腿食鸟者或钢蓝腿。

paras.en: Some of the spiders are species that scientists haven’t formally described, including members of the Antikuna and Avicularia genera.
paras.zh: 有些蜘蛛是科学家尚未正式描述的物种，包括安提库纳属和针形蜘蛛属的成员。

paras.en: “The traffickers made a meticulous selection to include different species,” Suárez says in the statement, per a translation by the Times.
paras.zh: 根据《泰晤士报》的翻译，苏亚雷斯在声明中表示：“贩运者精心挑选了不同的物种。”

paras.en: #LoÚltimo. El Serfor y Aduanas incautaron en el Aeropuerto Internacional Jorge Chávez más de 3000 tarántulas que eran transportadas de manera oculta dentro de equipajes de ciudadanos extranjeros, quienes tenían previsto viajar a Alemania. Los infractores fueron detenidos por la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP) y se les abrirá un proceso administrativo sancionador. #NoTeCompresUnDelito 🔗 Más información en: https://t.co/XhEKaixkZ1
paras.zh: #LoÚltimo。豪尔赫·查韦斯国际机场的塞尔弗和阿杜阿纳斯乘坐 3000 架狼蛛，以一种神秘的方式运输外来城市的设备，并在阿莱曼尼亚进行了预演。秘鲁国家警察 (PNP) 的违规行为和行政制裁程序中的违规行为。 #NoTeCompresUnDelito 🔗 更多信息：https://t.co/XhEKaixkZ1

paras.en: — Serfor Perú (@SerforPeru) November 5, 2026
paras.zh: - Serfor Perú (@SerforPeru) 2026 年 11 月 5 日

paras.en: According to Mongabay’s Spoorthy Raman, trafficking these spiders to the European Union is a relatively low-risk, high-reward pursuit. That’s because none of the species identified so far is protected under the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES), a global treaty intended to ensure the trade of wild plants and animals is “legal, traceable and biologically sustainable,” according to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service.
paras.zh: 根据 Mongabay 的 Spoorthy Raman 的说法，将这些蜘蛛贩运到欧盟是一种风险相对较低、回报较高的活动。据美国鱼类和野生动物管理局称，这是因为迄今为止发现的物种均未受到《濒危野生动植物种国际贸易公约》(CITES) 的保护，该公约是一项旨在确保野生动植物贸易“合法、可追溯且生物可持续”的全球条约。

paras.en: If a wild animal is legally protected by its home country but lacks an international listing like CITES or specific protection in the E.U., the E.U. does not automatically ban its import, possession or sale. Advocates are calling on the E.U. to enact legislation that closes this legal loophole.
paras.zh: 如果野生动物受到其本国的法律保护，但缺乏 CITES 等国际名录或欧盟的特定保护，则欧盟不会自动禁止其进口、拥有或销售。支持者呼吁欧盟制定立法来堵住这一法律漏洞。

paras.en: “This is a pattern that we have observed again and again: If [the tarantulas] were not seized [in Peru], they could have been legally imported to the E.U., due to a legal gap,” Sandra Altherr, the co-founder of Pro Wildlife, a wildlife conservation nonprofit based in Germany, tells Mongabay.
paras.zh: “这是我们一次又一次观察到的一种模式：如果[狼蛛]没有在[秘鲁]被查获，由于存在法律漏洞，它们可能会被合法进口到欧盟，”德国野生动物保护非营利组织 Pro Wildlife 的联合创始人桑德拉·阿尔瑟尔 (Sandra Altherr) 告诉 Mongabay。

articles.title: German Renaissance Master Albrecht Altdorfer Pioneered Landscape Painting. A Work Previously Unknown to Scholars Just Emerged After 70 Years in a Private Collection

paras.en: For nearly seven decades, a small 16th-century painting of a forest hung in a private collection in Switzerland, unbeknownst to art historians. Now, the 500-year-old work has emerged into the limelight, newly attributed to Albrecht Altdorfer, a German Renaissance artist who pioneered landscape painting.
paras.zh: 近七十年来，一幅 16 世纪的森林小画一直挂在瑞士的私人收藏中，而艺术史学家并不知道。如今，这幅拥有 500 年历史的作品已成为人们关注的焦点，新近被认为是德国文艺复兴时期风景画先驱阿尔布雷希特·阿尔特多费尔 (Albrecht Altdorfer) 的作品。

paras.en: Measuring roughly nine inches long by eight inches wide and dating from around 1520, A Thickly Wooded Landscape With a Rainbow Behind the Trees and a Distant Outcrop to the Right Beneath a Cloud-Laden Sky will head to auction at Sotheby’s in London on December 9.
paras.zh: 《树木茂密的风景，树后有彩虹，乌云密布的天空下有远处的露头》长约 9 英寸，宽约 8 英寸，可追溯至 1520 年左右，将于 12 月 9 日在伦敦苏富比拍卖行拍卖。

paras.en: “Every inch of this intimate picture is imbued with an intense mood that transcends its scale … It somehow still feels as modern and immediate as it would have appeared to those seeing it when it was first painted,” George Gordon, co-chair of Sotheby’s Old Masters department, says in a statement. “To add to the known body of work of one of the great masters of the Northern Renaissance is one of the most exciting discoveries imaginable in our field.”
paras.zh: “这幅亲密画作的每一寸都充满了一种超越其规模的强烈情绪……不知何故，它仍然给人一种现代和直接的感觉，就像第一次画它时看到的那样，”苏富比古代大师部门联席主席乔治戈登在一份声明中说。 “为北方文艺复兴时期伟大大师之一的已知作品增添色彩，是我们领域中可以想象到的最令人兴奋的发现之一。”

paras.en: The painting, which does not appear in Altdorfer’s catalogue raisonné and was only identified earlier this year, is expected to sell for up to $6.6 million. “We don’t really know what it’s worth because it’s many decades since an Altdorfer last came to the market,” Gordon tells the Art Newspaper’s Catherine Hickley. “It could fetch more than our estimate.”
paras.zh: 这幅画并未出现在 Altdorfer 的全集目录中，直到今年早些时候才被确认，预计售价高达 660 万美元。 “我们真的不知道它的价值，因为自从 Altdorfer 上次进入市场以来已经有几十年了，”戈登告诉《艺术新闻》的凯瑟琳·希克利。 “它的价格可能会超出我们的估计。”

paras.en: Until its discovery, scholars knew of just two oil landscapes by Altdorfer, both held in major European museums: Landscape With a Footbridge at London’s National Gallery and Landscape of the Danube Near Regensburg at Munich’s Alte Pinakothek. No Altdorfer painting has appeared on the market since 1980, when the National Gallery acquired Christ Taking Leave of His Mother.
paras.zh: 在它被发现之前，学者们只知道阿尔特多费尔的两幅油画风景画，两幅都收藏在欧洲主要博物馆中：伦敦国家美术馆的《人行桥风景画》和慕尼黑老绘画陈列馆的雷根斯堡附近的多瑙河风景画。自 1980 年国家美术馆收购《基督告别母亲》以来，阿尔特多弗的画作就再也没有出现在市场上。

paras.en: Painted in oil on vellum, A Thickly Wooded Landscape is the smallest and most densely forested of Altdorfer’s surviving landscapes in any medium, including engravings, etchings and drawings. In the foreground, tangled evergreens and mossy undergrowth rise without a single human figure in sight, while a distant castle perches atop a rocky outcrop on the right. Overhead, heavy clouds part just enough to reveal a faint glow from the sun, whose light catches a delicate rainbow arching behind the trees.
paras.zh: 《茂密的树林风景》以牛皮纸上的油画作成，是阿尔特多弗现存的以任何媒介（包括版画、蚀刻画和绘画）创作的风景画中面积最小、森林最茂密的一幅。在前景中，纠结的常绿植物和长满苔藓的灌木丛拔地而起，看不到任何人影，而远处的一座城堡坐落在右侧的岩石露头上。头顶上，厚重的云层散开，刚好露出太阳发出的微弱光芒，阳光在树后捕捉到一道精致的彩虹。

paras.en: Together, Altdorfer’s three known oil landscapes form a study in shifting weather and light. While Landscape With a Footbridge unfolds in blue daylight and the Landscape of the Danube canvas glows in warm evening light, the newly surfaced work captures the hushed atmosphere immediately after a rainstorm.
paras.zh: 阿尔特多弗的三个已知石油景观共同构成了对天气和光线变化的研究。 《人行桥景观》在蓝色日光下展开，《多瑙河景观》画布在温暖的夜光下闪闪发光，而新浮现的作品则捕捉到了暴雨过后的宁静气氛。

paras.en: “There is a sun, but the sun is really struggling to make its presence felt, and then you have a rainbow which has caught light from the sun,” Gordon tells the Guardian’s Miatta Mbriwa.
paras.zh: 戈登告诉《卫报》的米亚塔·姆布里瓦：“太阳是存在的，但太阳确实很难让人感觉到它的存在，然后就会出现一道吸收了太阳光的彩虹。”

paras.en: Before Altdorfer, European painters tended to treat nature as decorative scenery behind biblical or mythological narratives.
paras.zh: 在阿尔特多弗之前，欧洲画家倾向于将自然视为圣经或神话叙事背后的装饰风景。

paras.en: “The first independent landscapes in the history of European art were painted by Albrecht Altdorfer,” art historian Christopher S. Wood writes in Albrecht Altdorfer and the Origins of Landscape. “These pictures tell no stories. They are physically detached from any possible explanatory context … They are complete pictures, finished and framed, which nevertheless make a powerful impression of incompleteness and silence.”
paras.zh: “欧洲艺术史上第一幅独立风景画是由阿尔布雷希特·阿尔特多弗绘制的，”艺术史学家克里斯托弗·S·伍德在《阿尔布雷希特·阿尔特多弗与风景的起源》中写道。 “这些照片没有讲述任何故事。它们在物理上与任何可能的解释性背景无关......它们是完整的照片，完成并装框，但仍然给人留下了不完整和沉默的强烈印象。”

paras.en: As art historian Simon Schama observes in Landscape and Memory, “it was the outstanding achievement of Albrecht Altdorfer, in particular, to make the forest itself the natural protagonist.”
paras.zh: 正如艺术史学家西蒙·沙马（Simon Schama）在《风景与记忆》一书中所观察到的那样，“阿尔布雷希特·阿尔特多弗（Albrecht Altdorfer）的杰出成就尤其使森林本身成为自然的主角。”

paras.en: Altdorfer may have pioneered landscape painting, but his legacy extends beyond this world. In 1960, astronomers named 8121 Altdorfer, an asteroid orbiting the sun between Mars and Jupiter, in the painter’s honor.
paras.zh: 阿尔特多弗可能是风景画的先驱，但他的遗产超越了这个世界。 1960 年，天文学家将一颗位于火星和木星之间绕太阳运行的小行星命名为 8121 Altdorfer，以纪念这位画家。

paras.en: Born around 1480 in Regensburg, Bavaria, Altdorfer spent most of his life in the city on the Danube, balancing painting, engraving and printmaking with work as an architect and local politician before his death in 1538.
paras.zh: 阿尔特多费尔于 1480 年左右出生于巴伐利亚州雷根斯堡，在这座多瑙河畔的城市度过了一生的大部分时间，在 1538 年去世之前，他以建筑师和当地政治家的身份兼顾绘画、雕刻和版画创作。

paras.en: Around 1511, a journey south into the Alps sparked Altdorfer’s fascination with sweeping natural vistas, while the mixed deciduous and evergreen woodlands along the Danube downstream from Regensburg inspired his dense forest scenes. He later served Emperor Maximilian I in Innsbruck and painted his most famous work, The Battle of Alexander at Issus, for Duke Wilhelm IV of Bavaria in 1529.
paras.zh: 1511 年左右，向南进入阿尔卑斯山的旅程激发了阿尔特多弗对一览无余的自然景观的迷恋，而雷根斯堡下游多瑙河沿岸的落叶和常绿混合林地激发了他茂密的森林场景的灵感。后来他在因斯布鲁克侍奉马克西米利安一世皇帝，并于 1529 年为巴伐利亚公爵威廉四世绘制了他最著名的作品《伊苏斯的亚历山大之战》。

paras.en: The current owner of A Thickly Wooded Landscape inherited the painting from his father, who purchased it in 1957 from the collection of an aristocratic Austrian family, the House of Harrach. Following public previews at Sotheby’s in New York from November 7 to 19 and in London from December 4 to 9, the work will go in front of bidders. Given its rarity, Gordon tells the Art Newspaper, “I think it’s quite likely that museums will be interested.”
paras.zh: 《茂密的树林风景》的现任主人从他的父亲那里继承了这幅画，他的父亲于 1957 年从奥地利贵族家庭哈拉赫家族的收藏中购买了这幅画。继 11 月 7 日至 19 日在纽约苏富比拍卖行和 12 月 4 日至 9 日在伦敦苏富比拍卖行公开预展后，该作品将出现在竞标者面前。鉴于其稀有性，戈登告诉《艺术新闻》，“我认为博物馆很可能会感兴趣。”

articles.title: Two Centuries After This Bronze Leg Emerged From a Scottish Bog, Archaeologists Believe It May Have Belonged to a Towering Statue of a Roman Emperor on Horseback

paras.en: In 1820, a larger-than-life gilded bronze lower leg was pulled out of a bog in the Scottish Borders region. For more than two centuries, historians discredited the idea that the Roman-era artifact came from Scotland, instead assuming that it was hacked off a monument in England and hauled north by marauding tribes.
paras.zh: 1820 年，人们从苏格兰边境地区的沼泽中挖出了一条具有传奇色彩的镀金青铜小腿。两个多世纪以来，历史学家一直怀疑这件罗马时代的文物来自苏格兰，而是认为它是从英格兰的一座纪念碑上砍下来，然后被掠夺的部落运往北方的。

paras.en: But ahead of “Roman Scotland: Life on the Edge of Empire,” an exhibition at the National Museum of Scotland (NMS), researchers have determined that the so-called “Milsington leg” was not stolen from the south, nor was it violently severed. Instead, they posit that it formed part of a colossal equestrian statue of the Roman Emperor Antoninus Pius that once stood in southern Scotland in the second century C.E., before it was dismantled by retreating Roman troops.
paras.zh: 但在苏格兰国家博物馆（NMS）举办“罗马苏格兰：帝国边缘的生活”展览之前，研究人员确定，所谓的“米尔辛顿腿”并非从南方被盗，也不是被暴力切断。相反，他们认为它是罗马皇帝安东尼努斯·皮乌斯巨大骑马雕像的一部分，这座雕像曾于公元二世纪矗立在苏格兰南部，后来被撤退的罗马军队拆除。

paras.en: “This really turns on its head our understanding of Rome’s second attempt at conquering Scotland,” Fraser Hunter, principal curator of prehistoric and Roman archaeology at NMS, says in a statement.
paras.zh: NMS 史前和罗马考古学首席馆长弗雷泽·亨特 (Fraser Hunter) 在一份声明中表示：“这确实颠覆了我们对罗马第二次征服苏格兰的理解。”

paras.en: Roman campaigns into modern-day Scotland began in the 70s C.E., several decades after the conquest of Britain. Emperor Hadrian, who ruled from 117 C.E. to 138 C.E., consolidated the Romans’ northernmost limit in northern England, where Hadrian’s Wall still stands.
paras.zh: 罗马人对现代苏格兰的征战始于公元 70 年代，即征服英国数十年后。哈德良皇帝在位时间为公元 117 年至公元 138 年，巩固了罗马人在英格兰北部的最北边界，哈德良长城至今仍矗立在那里。

paras.en: Hadrian’s successor, Antoninus Pius, pushed his armies north again, and in the early 140s C.E. fortified a position about 100 miles north of Hadrian’s Wall, known as the Antonine Wall. A few years after Antoninus Pius died in 161 C.E., the Roman armies retreated south, back to Hadrian’s Wall.
paras.zh: 哈德良的继任者安东尼努斯·皮乌斯再次将军队推向北方，并于公元 140 年代初在哈德良长城以北约 100 英里处加固了一个阵地，称为安东尼长城。公元 161 年安东尼努斯·皮乌斯去世几年后，罗马军队向南撤退，回到哈德良长城。

paras.en: - The Antonine Wall ran 37 miles across Scotland, between two bodies of water: the Firth of Forth and the Firth of Clyde.
paras.zh: - 安东尼长城横跨苏格兰，绵延 37 英里，位于福斯湾和克莱德湾这两个水体之间。

paras.en: - It was around nine feet tall and unlike the stone fortifications of Hadrian’s Wall, the Antonine Wall was largely made out of turf.
paras.zh: - 安东尼长城高约九英尺，与哈德良长城的石头防御工事不同，安东尼长城主要由草皮制成。

paras.en: The timeline of the second century C.E. Roman invasion of southern Scotland—and eventual withdrawal—provides the context for the bronze limb.
paras.zh: 公元二世纪罗马入侵苏格兰南部以及最终撤退的时间线为青铜肢体提供了背景。

paras.en: Close inspection reveals that rather than bearing jagged axe or saw marks, the upper edge remains intact, just as Roman metalworkers originally cast it in the 140s C.E. An absence of gilding around the knee indicates that the leg was covered by a tunic or cloak, part of a larger statue, perhaps similar to the equestrian statue of Marcus Aurelius in Rome
paras.zh: 仔细检查发现，上边缘没有锯齿状的斧头或锯痕，而是完好无损，就像罗马金属工人最初在公元 140 年代铸造的那样。膝盖周围没有镀金，表明腿上覆盖着外衣或斗篷，是较大雕像的一部分，可能类似于罗马的马库斯·奥勒留的骑马雕像

paras.en: “When you look, you see it hasn’t been hacked off, it’s a complete leg,” Hunter explains to the Telegraph’s Ruby Cline. “So rather than loot, it looks as if the statue has been carefully decommissioned at the end of its life.”
paras.zh: “当你看时，你会发现它没有被砍掉，它是一条完整的腿，”亨特向《每日电讯报》的鲁比·克莱恩解释道。 “因此，这座雕像看起来不像是掠夺，而是在其使用寿命结束时被小心地退役了。”

paras.en: When Roman forces abandoned southern Scotland, they routinely dismantled and buried prized monuments, including stone altars and inscriptions from the Antonine Wall, rather than leave them behind, per the statement.
paras.zh: 声明称，当罗马军队放弃苏格兰南部时，他们通常会拆除并掩埋珍贵的纪念碑，包括石祭坛和安东尼墙的铭文，而不是留下它们。

paras.en: Installing a large, visually impressive statue in a border region was purposeful for Antoninus Pius, for whom victory in Scotland was “something which was worth celebrating,” Hunter explains in the statement.
paras.zh: 亨特在声明中解释说，在边境地区安装一座巨大的、视觉上令人印象深刻的雕像对安东尼努斯·皮乌斯来说是有目的的，对他来说，苏格兰的胜利是“值得庆祝的事情”。

paras.en: Politically, too, “it makes sense, the Romans producing propaganda right in those contested areas,” Hunter tells the Telegraph. To Scottish Iron Age communities with virtually no tradition of naturalistic human portraiture, a gleaming gilded emperor on horseback would have appeared “really, really alien,” Hunter tells the Guardian’s Severin Carrell.
paras.zh: 亨特告诉《每日电讯报》，从政治角度来看，“罗马人在这些有争议的地区进行宣传也是有道理的”。亨特告诉《卫报》的塞弗林·卡雷尔，对于几乎没有自然主义人类肖像传统的苏格兰铁器时代社区来说，一位骑在马背上闪闪发光的镀金皇帝会显得“非常非常外星人”。

paras.en: Following its excavation in 1820 near Hawick, Scotland, the Milsington leg spent a century tucked away in the Dalkeith Palace, near Edinburgh.
paras.zh: 米尔辛顿段于 1820 年在苏格兰霍伊克附近发掘后，在爱丁堡附近的达尔基斯宫中隐藏了一个世纪。

paras.en: Upon hearing of the discovery, Scottish writer Sir Walter Scott noted in a February 1820 letter to Lord Montagu that finding such a large Roman artifact “in so wild a place, has something very irritating to the curiosity,” adding that he hoped to examine the piece and possibly dig for the remaining fragments himself.
paras.zh: 得知这一发现后，苏格兰作家沃尔特·斯科特爵士在 1820 年 2 月致蒙塔古勋爵的一封信中指出，“在如此荒凉的地方发现如此巨大的罗马文物，非常令人好奇”，并补充说，他希望检查这件作品，并可能亲自挖掘剩余的碎片。

paras.en: In the exhibition, the Milsington leg is mounted onto a full-scale silhouette reconstruction of horse and rider. The exhibition also features a digital facial reconstruction of a decapitated man buried near the Roman fort of Inveresk, alongside an intricate, tin-coated enamel brooch from Pathhead that may have been a diplomatic gift from Roman forces to a local leader. Other artifacts on view are a unique animal-relief earthenware bowl, the skeleton of a carefully buried cavalry horse and two altars from a temple dedicated to Mithras, a deity of the sun.
paras.zh: 在展览中，米尔辛顿腿被安装在马和骑手的全尺寸轮廓重建上。展览还展出了埋葬在因弗雷斯克罗马堡垒附近的一名被斩首男子的数字面部重建，旁边还有一枚来自 Pathhead 的复杂的镀锡珐琅胸针，这可能是罗马军队送给当地领导人的外交礼物。展出的其他文物包括一个独特的动物浮雕陶碗、一匹精心埋葬的骑兵骨架以及一座供奉太阳神密特拉斯神庙的两座祭坛。

paras.en: Beyond imperial grandeur, the exhibition illuminates how Rome’s presence reshaped indigenous society in the northern reaches of the province of Britannia. Hunter estimates that roughly 10,000 Roman soldiers—including auxiliaries from North Africa and modern-day Romania—alongside another 10,000 camp followers, wives and enslaved people lived across southern and eastern Scotland during the Antonine occupation, per the Guardian.
paras.zh: 除了帝国的宏伟之外，展览还阐明了罗马的存在如何重塑了不列颠尼亚省北部的土著社会。据《卫报》报道，亨特估计，在安东尼占领期间，大约有 10,000 名罗马士兵（包括来自北非和现代罗马尼亚的辅助人员）以及另外 10,000 名营地追随者、妻子和奴隶生活在苏格兰南部和东部。

paras.en: Hunter suspects that undiscovered Roman forts once stood near where the limb was deposited and hopes that future surveys or metal detectorists might finally turn up the emperor’s torso or his bronze steed, more than 200 years after the leg emerged from the bogs.
paras.zh: 亨特怀疑，在腿被放置的地方附近曾经有未被发现的罗马堡垒，并希望未来的调查或金属探测器最终可能会在腿从沼泽中出现 200 多年后，最终发现皇帝的躯干或他的青铜骏马。

paras.en: “It offers us a tantalizing glimpse into the kind of grand monuments which once stood in southern Scotland and shows the importance Pius placed on his victories in Scotland,” Hunter says in the statement. “But it begs the question ... where is the rest of the statue?”
paras.zh: 亨特在声明中说：“它让我们对曾经矗立在苏格兰南部的宏伟纪念碑有了一个诱人的了解，并显示了庇护对他在苏格兰取得的胜利的重视。” “但这引出了一个问题……雕像的其余部分在哪里？”

paras.en: “Roman Scotland: Life on the Edge of Empire” is on view at the National Museum of Scotland in Edinburgh from November 14, 2026, through April 18, 2027.
paras.zh: “罗马苏格兰：帝国边缘的生活”将于2026年11月14日至2027年4月18日在爱丁堡苏格兰国家博物馆展出。

paras.zh: 如果您是体育迷家庭的一员，这款 Disney+ ESPN 套装是理所当然的选择。通过此 Disney Plus 优惠，您将获得 Disney+、Hulu、NFL、College Football 和 College GameDay，以及所有 ESPN 网络（包括 ESPN Unlimited）的访问权限，每月费用为 36 美元。通过迪士尼折扣套装，三项服务可节省 36%。

paras.en: Watch the Latest Disney Plus Movies This Month
paras.zh: 观看本月最新的迪士尼+电影

paras.en: Disney+ always has great new content each month, and this month is no exception. There are tons of long-awaited new releases, including Zootopia 2, the follow-up to the original hit. The newest installment of the Toy Story franchise follows the gang as they fight to compete for attention with tech and tablets—Toy Story 5 on Disney Plus is now available to stream. There's also our favorite unlikely duo, Mandalorian and Grogu, on Disney Plus, and animals fighting against deforestation in Hoppers on Disney Plus. Be sure to check out the newest Disney Plus movies streaming this month.
paras.zh: Disney+ 每个月都会推出精彩的新内容，本月也不例外。还有大量期待已久的新作品，包括《疯狂动物城 2》（Zootopia 2），它是原版热门游戏的后续作品。 《玩具总动员》系列的最新一期讲述了这帮人通过科技和平板电脑争夺注意力的故事——迪士尼+上的《玩具总动员 5》现已上线。迪士尼+ 上还有我们最喜欢的不太可能的二人组曼达洛人和格罗古，以及迪士尼+ 上的霍普斯 (Hoppers) 中与森林砍伐作斗争的动物。请务必查看本月最新的迪士尼+电影。

articles.title: Paramount+ Coupon Codes and Deals for 2026
articles.author: Molly Higgins

paras.en: Once the most talked-about TV show in the country, South Park, is on Paramount+. Don’t you want to know what got Trump in such a tizzy?
paras.zh: 曾经是全国最受关注的电视节目《南方公园》现已在派拉蒙+上播出。难道你不想知道是什么让特朗普如此兴奋吗？

paras.en: Stream the much-buzzed-about South Park, fan-favorite Yellowstone, original series MobLand, and rebooted crime drama Dexter & Dexter on Paramount+. The streaming network has bingeable TV series for almost everyone. Whether you want to revisit Lindsay Lohan’s old look in the classic Mean Girls flick or wonder how many more sequels Tom Cruise has left in him with Top Gun: Maverick, there’s a bevy of films to stream, too.
paras.zh: 在 Paramount+ 上观看热门剧集《南方公园》、深受粉丝喜爱的《黄石公园》、原创剧集 MobLand 以及重新启动的犯罪剧《嗜血法医》。该流媒体网络为几乎每个人提供了可追剧的电视剧。无论您是想重温林赛·罗韩 (Lindsay Lohan) 在经典《贱女孩》(Mean Girls) 电影中的旧造型，还是想知道汤姆·克鲁斯 (Tom Cruise) 在《壮志凌云：特立独行》(Top Gun: Maverick) 中还留下了多少续集，这里还有大量电影可供观看。

paras.en: If you’re like me and have at least half a dozen streaming services, our Paramount+ coupon codes can help you save so you can watch the content you want without having to give up one of your other beloved platforms. (I love pretending the world isn’t full of suffering around me and instead focus on Sylvester Stallone’s ever-changing Play-Doh face in Tulsa King.)
paras.zh: 如果您像我一样并且至少拥有六种流媒体服务，我们的 Paramount+ 优惠券代码可以帮助您节省费用，这样您就可以观看您想要的内容，而不必放弃您喜爱的其他平台之一。 （我喜欢假装我周围的世界没有充满苦难，而是关注西尔维斯特·史泰龙在《塔尔萨王》中不断变化的培乐多脸。）

paras.en: Try Paramount+ Free With a One-Week Trial
paras.zh: 免费试用 Paramount+ 一周

paras.en: There are tiered plans, including Essential, which allows for 3 devices, select Showtime series, and NFL games, and can be streamed on up to 3 devices at once, but has ads; and Premium, which includes all that except there are no ads, downloadable content, CBS live, and all of Showtime content.
paras.zh: 有分层计划，包括允许 3 台设备观看的 Essential、选择 Showtime 系列和 NFL 比赛，并且可以同时在最多 3 台设备上进行流式传输，但有广告；高级版，包括除无广告之外的所有内容、可下载内容、CBS 直播和所有 Showtime 内容。

paras.en: Find the Right Paramount+ Plan Pricing and Get the Latest Deals
paras.zh: 找到合适的 Paramount+ 计划定价并获取最新优惠

paras.en: It’s important to choose the right Paramount+ streaming plan so you get the best bang for your buck. Lucky for you, all plans include a 7-day free trial so you can make sure you’re choosing the right plan for you. The first is Paramount+ Essential, which is $8 per month. It includes ads, but you’ll have access to over 40,000 episodes and movies. You’ll also be able to stream on 3 devices at once, watch NFL games on CBS and the UEFA Champions League, and access select Showtime series. Paramount+ Premium is the next tier (and the most popular choice), which starts at $13 per month (after the free trial ends). You’ll get everything mentioned in the previous tier, without ads. You’ll also have the ability to watch in 4K UHD, Dolby Vision, or HDR10, download movies and shows, stream CBS live, and access all of Showtime’s content library.
paras.zh: 选择正确的 Paramount+ 流媒体套餐非常重要，这样您才能物有所值。幸运的是，所有计划都包含 7 天免费试用，因此您可以确保选择适合您的计划。第一个是 Paramount+ Essential，每月 8 美元。它包含广告，但您可以访问超过 40,000 集剧集和电影。您还可以同时在 3 台设备上进行流式传输，在 CBS 和 UEFA Champions League 上观看 NFL 比赛，并访问精选的 Showtime 系列节目。 Paramount+ Premium 是下一个级别（也是最受欢迎的选择），起价为每月 13 美元（免费试用结束后）。您将获得上一层中提到的所有内容，没有广告。您还可以观看 4K UHD、杜比视界或 HDR10、下载电影和节目、直播 CBS 直播以及访问 Showtime 的所有内容库。

paras.en: Can You Cancel Paramount Plus at any Time?
paras.zh: 您可以随时取消 Paramount Plus 吗？

paras.en: If Paramount+ isn’t suitable for you or you'd like to reduce your subscriptions, you can cancel it anytime. The cancellation process varies depending on your sign-up method. If you signed up through the website, visit your account page to cancel.
paras.zh: 如果派拉蒙+不适合您或者您想减少订阅，您可以随时取消。取消流程因您的注册方式而异。如果您通过网站注册，请访问您的帐户页面进行取消。

paras.en: Save on a Paramount+ Subscription With Student and Military Discounts
paras.zh: 订阅 Paramount+ 即可享受学生和军人折扣

paras.en: If you’re a student now (or have your student ID lying around somewhere), you can get a Paramount+ plan for just $4 a month. All you have to do is verify your student status, and you’ll get 50% off any plan of your choice for the first year. If you’re a military member, Paramount+ offers 50% off any subscription for life.
paras.zh: 如果您现在是学生（或者您的学生证在某处），则每月只需 4 美元即可获得 Paramount+ 计划。您所要做的就是验证您的学生身份，第一年您选择的任何计划都将享受 50% 的折扣。如果您是军人，Paramount+ 提供终身订阅 50% 的折扣。

paras.en: Watch Paramount+ Originals and Fan Favorites
paras.zh: 观看派拉蒙+原创作品和粉丝最爱

paras.en: There’s truly something for everyone in the family, with movies, kids’ shows, and Paramount+ originals included in every plan. If you’re feeling spooky, I’d recommend Dexter: Resurrection or Yellowjackets. If you’re looking for something more family-friendly, there are super popular cartoons like Rango or Sonic the Hedgehog to choose from.
paras.zh: 每个计划都包含电影、儿童节目和派拉蒙+原创作品，真正适合家庭中的每个人。如果你感到毛骨悚然，我会推荐《嗜血法医：复活》或《黄衫军》。如果您正在寻找更适合家庭观看的内容，可以选择《兰戈》或《刺猬索尼克》等超级流行的卡通片。

paras.en: Looking for specific recommendations? I’ve got you. There are tons of great new releases coming to Paramount+ this month, including Landman Season 2, the new Paramount+ original comedy series Crutch starring Tracy Morgan, and new episodes of (my favorite) Ink Master Season 17. There are also tons of new movies, including The Cut, a boxing drama starring Orlando Bloom; the dark comedy Shell; and the true-crime tale My Nightmare Stalker: The Eva LaRue Story. Plus, Paramount+ will be airing the important NFL holiday games.
paras.zh: 正在寻找具体建议？我有你。本月，派拉蒙+将推出大量精彩新片，包括《兰德曼》第 2 季、由特雷西·摩根主演的派拉蒙+原创喜剧剧集《拐杖》，以及（我最喜欢的）《墨水大师》第 17 季的新剧集。还有大量新电影，包括奥兰多·布鲁姆主演的拳击剧《The Cut》；黑色喜剧《贝壳》；以及真实犯罪故事《我的噩梦追踪者：伊娃·拉鲁的故事》。此外，Paramount+ 将转播重要的 NFL 假日比赛。

paras.en: Check out the wide breadth of TV and movie content on Paramount+ (and use the Paramount+ promo codes above to save on whatever plan you decide).
paras.zh: 在 Paramount+ 上查看各种电视和电影内容（并使用上面的 Paramount+ 促销代码来节省您决定的任何计划）。

paras.en: Stream All Your Favorite South Park Episodes on Paramount+
paras.zh: 在 Paramount+ 上观看所有您喜爱的《南方公园》剧集

paras.en: As mentioned earlier, South Park has rapidly become one of the most talked-about shows in TV history. Where can you watch it? Right here on Paramount+. Season 29 of South Park, along with many other seasons, is available to stream now. Whether you’re a longtime fan of Cartman and the gang or a newcomer curious about the hype, watch South Park on Paramount+ today.
paras.zh: 如前所述，《南方公园》已迅速成为电视历史上最受关注的节目之一。你可以在哪里观看？就在派拉蒙+这里。 《南方公园》第 29 季以及其他许多季现已上线。无论您是卡特曼及其帮派的长期粉丝，还是对炒作感到好奇的新人，请立即在 Paramount+ 上观看《南方公园》。

paras.en: Stream Live Sports and Events on Paramount+
paras.zh: 在 Paramount+ 上直播体育赛事和赛事

paras.en: For better or worse, I’m a Chiefs fan (cue the booing). I usually get a Paramount+ plan during the football season to keep up with my favorite beefy, TBI-ridden men. You can stream all the NFL coverage you want all season long, and 24/7 live channels are now available on Paramount+, so you’ll never need to give your brain time to process the horrors.
paras.zh: 无论好坏，我都是酋长队的球迷（提示嘘声）。我通常会在足球赛季期间制定派拉蒙+计划，以跟上我最喜欢的、肌肉发达、饱受创伤性脑损伤的男人的脚步。您可以在整个赛季中观看您想要的所有 NFL 报道，Paramount+ 现已提供 24/7 直播频道，因此您永远不需要给大脑时间来处理恐怖事件。

paras.en: Paramount+ offers all the man-on-man action you desire, from intense brawls to KO finishes. It's your go-to platform for streaming UFC live, ensuring you catch every fight. If you’ve missed any UFC events, don’t worry—there are many past fights and highlights available on Paramount+. The big UFC Fight Night event streams live on September 5, featuring UFC Fight Night: Hooker vs. Parnasse in Paris. Next up is Noche UFC: Rodriguez vs. Silva at the Desert Diamond Arena in Glendale, Arizona, on September 12. To close out the month, UFC 331: Van vs. Pantoja 2 takes place at Crypto.com Arena in LA on September 19, with Joshua Van of Myanmar facing Tatsuro Taira of Japan in the UFC flyweight championship. On September 19, Rosas Jr. versus Barcelos will be streamed from Vegas.
paras.zh: Paramount+ 提供您想要的所有人对人动作，从激烈的争吵到 KO 结局。这是您观看 UFC 直播的首选平台，确保您观看每一场比赛。如果您错过了任何 UFC 赛事，请不要担心 - Paramount+ 上有许多过去的比赛和精彩片段。 UFC 格斗之夜大型赛事将于 9 月 5 日直播，其中包括在巴黎举行的 UFC 格斗之夜：胡克 (Hooker) 对阵帕纳斯 (Parnasse)。接下来的比赛是 9 月 12 日在亚利桑那州格伦代尔沙漠钻石竞技场举行的《Noche UFC：罗德里格斯 vs. 席尔瓦》。为了结束这个月，9 月 19 日，UFC 331：范 vs. Pantoja 2 在洛杉矶 Crypto.com 竞技场举行，缅甸选手约书亚·范 (Joshua Van) 在 UFC 蝇量级锦标赛中对阵日本选手平龙 (Tatsuro Taira)。 9 月 19 日，小罗萨斯 (Rosas Jr.) 对阵巴塞洛斯 (Barcelos) 的比赛将从维加斯直播。

paras.en: These are just some of the upcoming fights, so check Paramount+ for UFC numbered events, Fight Nights, and more UFC content. Visit the Paramount+ UFC schedule page for full details, showtimes, and updates.
paras.zh: 这些只是即将举行的一些比赛，因此请查看 Paramount+ 以了解 UFC 编号赛事、格斗之夜以及更多 UFC 内容。请访问 Paramount+ UFC 日程页面，了解完整的详细信息、放映时间和更新。

paras.en: Paramount+ New Episodes of UFC Deep Waters Podcast
paras.zh: 派拉蒙+ UFC 深水播客新剧集

paras.en: What do you get when you combine podcasts and MMA? A man’s dream. Paramount+ has a brand-new UFC podcast that breaks down the biggest moments in MMA so you can relive all the bloody glory. Paramount+ also has a whole sports hub with coverage and replays of all types of sports. The Deep Waters podcast releases new episodes every Monday and features Dustin Poirier, Jorge Masvidal, Chris Weidman, and Din Thomas discussing all things UFC and MMA.
paras.zh: 当你将播客和 MMA 结合起来时，你会得到什么？一个男人的梦想。 Paramount+ 推出全新 UFC 播客，详细记录 MMA 中最重要的时刻，让您重温所有血腥荣耀。 Paramount+ 还拥有一个完整的体育中心，对所有类型的体育赛事进行报道和重播。 Deep Waters 播客每周一发布新剧集，由达斯汀·普瓦里尔 (Dustin Poirier)、豪尔赫·马斯维达尔 (Jorge Masvidal)、克里斯·韦德曼 (Chris Weidman) 和丁·托马斯 (Din Thomas) 讨论 UFC 和 MMA 的所有内容。

paras.en: Paramount+ offers a wide variety of movies and TV shows suitable for any mood and audience, including new releases, family content, action, comedy, drama, horror, fantasy, and more. Highlights include classics like The Godfather Part II, the latest Scream 7 installment, Jason Statham’s Homefront, and family favorites like Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs. Whatever your mood, Paramount+ provides countless entertainment options available at any time.
paras.zh: Paramount+ 提供适合任何心情和观众的各种电影和电视节目，包括新上映的电影和电视节目、家庭内容、动作、喜剧、戏剧、恐怖、奇幻等。亮点包括《教父第二部》、最新的《惊声尖叫 7》、杰森·斯坦森的《国土防线》等经典影片，以及《多云有肉丸》等家庭最爱影片。无论您心情如何，Paramount+ 随时提供无数娱乐选择。

paras.en: Paramount+ is constantly releasing new content, and they have some good entertainment lined up for this November. Get ready to cozy up indoors with a good movie or TV show as fall hits full swing and winter temperatures roll in. First up is the new (and final!) season of Yellowjackets on November 20. The new scripted series from British comedian Leo Reich, It Gets Worse, debuts on November 6. The true-crime documentary The Jigsaw Puzzle Murder premieres on November 12, and He Said, She Said: Till Death Do Us Part premieres on November 17. Plus, Paramount+ is airing the Thanksgiving Day NFL on CBS presentation of the Bears–Lions game on November 26, followed by The JLO Show, a CBS and Paramount+ concert film special.
paras.zh: Paramount+ 不断发布新内容，他们在今年 11 月推出了一些精彩的娱乐节目。随着秋天如火如荼地进行，冬天的气温也随之而来，准备好在室内舒适地看一场好电影或电视节目。首先是 11 月 20 日播出的新一季（也是最后一季！）黄衫军。英国喜剧演员 Leo Reich 的新剧本剧集《变得更糟》将于 11 月 6 日首播。真实犯罪纪录片《拼图谋杀案》将于 11 月 12 日首播，《他说，她说：直到死亡将我们分开》将于 11 月首播17. 此外，Paramount+ 将于 11 月 26 日在 CBS 上播出感恩节 NFL 熊狮队比赛，随后播出 CBS 和 Paramount+ 音乐会特别电影 The JLO Show。

paras.en: Don’t Miss the Champions League Soccer on Paramount+
paras.zh: 不要错过 Paramount+ 上的欧洲冠军联赛

paras.en: If football (or soccer) is more your jam, Paramount+ has you covered. You can watch Champions League Soccer on Paramount+, featuring fan favorites and heated rivalries from Real Madrid, AC Milan, Bayern Munich, Liverpool, Barcelona, and more.
paras.zh: 如果您更喜欢足球，Paramount+ 可以满足您的需求。您可以在 Paramount+ 上观看欧洲冠军联赛，其中包括皇马、AC 米兰、拜仁慕尼黑、利物浦、巴塞罗那等球队的球迷最爱以及激烈的对抗。

paras.zh: 使用此戴尔优惠券可享受 20% 折扣：Dell 14 Premium

paras.en: As mentioned, one of the best ways to save big on tech purchases is to buy a certified-refurbished Dell laptop through the Dell Outlet. The Dell Outlet has tons of like-new tech for hundreds less than buying brand new. You can get top tech like the Dell 14 Premium for $1,036 when bought refurbished—that’s $259 in savings! paras.en: The Dell 14 Plus served as Dell’s rebranding launch, and when we reviewed the laptop, we appreciated its fast performance, great battery life, solid IPS display, and comfortable keyboard and touchpad. articles.title: U.S. Air Force responds to drone activity at U.K. military base

paras.en: Nov. 13 (UPI) -- U.S. Air Force security personnel responded Friday to unauthorized drone activity at RAF Lakenheath in eastern England, officials said.
paras.zh: 11 月 13 日（UPI）——官员称，美国空军安全人员周五对英格兰东部拉肯希思皇家空军基地未经授权的无人机活动做出了反应。

paras.en: The evening incident at the air base in Suffolk comes amid heightened security concerns at American military installations in Britain following threats linked to Iran.
paras.zh: 萨福克空军基地晚间发生的事件发生在美国驻英国军事设施受到伊朗威胁后，安全担忧加剧之际。

paras.en: U.S. European Command confirmed security personnel responded to the reports but said no military personnel, aircraft or infrastructure were affected.
paras.zh: 美国欧洲司令部证实安全人员对这些报告做出了回应，但表示没有军事人员、飞机或基础设施受到影响。

paras.en: "We continue to work closely with our host nation counterparts to ensure the safety and security of our U.S. service members, U.S. and host nation civilians, contractors, and all of our families," the military said in a statement.
paras.zh: 军方在一份声明中表示：“我们将继续与东道国同行密切合作，确保我们的美国军人、美国和东道国平民、承包商以及我们所有家人的安全。”

paras.en: "Protecting our shared community is a joint responsibility, and we encourage everyone to support this effort by reporting any unusual or suspicious activity to local authorities."
paras.zh: “保护我们共同的社区是一项共同责任，我们鼓励每个人通过向地方当局报告任何异常或可疑活动来支持这一努力。”

paras.en: Britain's Defense Ministry said it was coordinating with U.S. authorities to investigate the reports.
paras.zh: 英国国防部表示正在与美国当局协调调查这些报道。

paras.en: "USAF security forces personnel responded to the reports and the situation is now resolved," a ministry spokesperson told the Guardian. "We are working closely with them to establish the facts. We will provide updates in due course."
paras.zh: “美国空军安全部队人员对报告做出了回应，目前情况已得到解决，”国防部发言人告诉《卫报》。 “我们正在与他们密切合作以查明事实。我们将在适当的时候提供最新消息。”

paras.en: Nick Timothy, a member of Parliament representing West Suffolk, said military officials assured him there was no threat to the public.
paras.zh: 代表西萨福克的议会议员尼克·蒂莫西表示，军方官员向他保证，公众不会受到威胁。

paras.en: "Given the raised threat level, I continue to encourage everyone to report anything suspicious or out of the ordinary to the authorities," Timothy told the Guardian.
paras.zh: 蒂莫西告诉《卫报》：“鉴于威胁级别提高，我继续鼓励每个人向当局报告任何可疑或异常情况。”

paras.en: RAF Lakenheath is home to the U.S. Air Force's 48th Fighter Wing, also known as the Liberty Wing, with nearly 7,000 active-duty personnel.
paras.zh: 英国皇家空军拉肯希思基地是美国空军第 48 战斗机联队（也称为自由联队）的所在地，拥有近 7,000 名现役人员。

paras.en: The installation is the largest U.S. fighter operation in Europe.
paras.zh: 此次部署是美国在欧洲最大规模的战斗机行动。

paras.en: The incident comes days after the United States moved military aircraft away from nearby RAF Mildenhall following a security threat linked to Iran.
paras.zh: 该事件发生几天前，由于与伊朗有关的安全威胁，美国将军用飞机从附近的英国皇家空军米尔登霍尔基地移走。

paras.en: At least 12 U.S. Air Force aircraft departed Mildenhall earlier this week, including two Boeing KC-135 refueling planes, with aircraft traveling to Germany and Scotland.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，至少 12 架美国空军飞机从米尔登霍尔起飞，其中包括两架波音 KC-135 加油机，飞机飞往德国和苏格兰。

paras.en: The United States also withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire in October following a suspected Iranian-linked plot targeting the installation.
paras.zh: 10月，在疑似与伊朗有关的针对该设施的阴谋之后，美国还从格洛斯特郡的皇家空军费尔福德撤出了轰炸机。

paras.en: British authorities charged two men with national security offenses following an investigation involving vans discovered near the base.
paras.zh: 英国当局在对基地附近发现的货车进行调查后，指控两名男子犯有国家安全罪。

paras.en: President Donald Trump said in October that threats against RAF Fairford prompted the withdrawal of American bombers.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统十月份表示，针对英国皇家空军费尔福德的威胁促使美国轰炸机撤出。

paras.en: RAF Lakenheath had been placed on Charlie alert in September, the second-highest threat level under the U.S. military's force protection system.
paras.zh: 英国皇家空军拉肯希思空军基地于 9 月份被置于查理警报状态，这是美军部队保护系统中第二高的威胁级别。

paras.en: Authorities have not identified who was responsible for Friday's drone activity or established any connection to the earlier threats.
paras.zh: 当局尚未确定谁对周五的无人机活动负责，也没有确定与之前的威胁有任何联系。

articles.title: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop after telecommunications outage

paras.en: Nov. 13 (UPI) -- The Federal Aviation Administration lifted its nationwide ground stop Friday evening after a telecommunications outage halted flights across the United States for more than four hours.
paras.zh: 11 月 13 日（合众国际社）——美国联邦航空管理局周五晚上取消了全国范围内的地面停靠，此前美国各地的航班因电信中断而中断了四个多小时。

paras.en: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said airspace reopened at 8:15 p.m. EST but warned that flight disruptions would continue.
paras.zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 表示，空域于晚上 8 点 15 分重新开放。 EST 但警告称，航班中断将继续。

paras.en: "But it's going to take us some time to unwind what's happened this afternoon," Duffy said during a news briefing at the White House.
paras.zh: “但我们需要一些时间来平息今天下午发生的事情，”达菲在白宫举行的新闻发布会上说。

paras.en: Duffy said the outage began when new technology overwhelmed the FAA's aging communications network, causing instability in radar data.
paras.zh: 达菲表示，当新技术淹没了联邦航空局老化的通信网络，导致雷达数据不稳定时，中断就开始了。

paras.en: The problem began at 3:36 p.m. EST, affecting all 22 air route traffic control centers.
paras.zh: 问题于下午 3:36 开始。美国东部时间，影响所有 22 个航线交通管制中心。

paras.en: Duffy said technicians had identified the problem and restored operations. He denied that the FAA's new Smart air traffic management system caused the outage.
paras.zh: 达菲表示，技术人员已经发现了问题并恢复了运行。他否认美国联邦航空管理局的新智能空中交通管理系统导致了这次中断。

paras.en: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said officials had no indication the disruption was a terrorist attack.
paras.zh: 国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林表示，官员们没有迹象表明这次破坏是恐怖袭击。

paras.en: "This isn't another 9/11," Mullin told reporters at the White House. "This is a telecommunication outage."
paras.zh: “这不是另一场 9/11，”穆林在白宫对记者说。 “这是一次电信中断。”

paras.en: Mullin said investigators had found "zero evidence that this was a cyber-attack."
paras.zh: 马林表示，调查人员发现“零证据表明这是一次网络攻击”。

paras.en: He said the disruption appeared to have been caused by older equipment becoming overwhelmed as new technology was introduced.
paras.zh: 他表示，这种中断似乎是由于新技术的引入使旧设备不堪重负而造成的。

paras.en: Duffy called on Congress to approve an additional $30 billion to modernize the nation's air traffic control system.
paras.zh: 达菲呼吁国会额外批准 300 亿美元，以实现国家空中交通管制系统的现代化。

paras.en: "I can't build things if I don't have money," he said.
paras.zh: “如果我没有钱，我就无法建造东西，”他说。

paras.en: Duffy warned that the disruptions could continue into the weekend, ahead of the Thanksgiving travel period.
paras.zh: 达菲警告说，在感恩节旅行之前，这种干扰可能会持续到周末。

paras.en: In an advisory shared by Flightradar24, the agency cited extraordinary circumstances and safety concerns amid reports of communication outages in parts of the country.
paras.zh: 在 Flightradar24 分享的一份咨询报告中，该机构在该国部分地区通信中断的报道中提到了特殊情况和安全问题。

paras.en: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the FAA "issued a nationwide ground stop for all U.S. airports following a communication issue impacting all Air Route Traffic Control Centers."
paras.zh: 美国交通部长肖恩·达菲表示，美国联邦航空局“在影响所有航线交通控制中心的通信问题后，对美国所有机场发出了全国范围内的地面停止通知”。

paras.en: "FAA technicians are investigating the issue," Duffy said in a statement on X. "We will provide immediate updates as we have them."
paras.zh: 达菲在 X 上的一份声明中表示：“美国联邦航空局的技术人员正在调查这个问题。我们将立即提供最新情况。”

paras.en: Before the nationwide order, the FAA had issued separate ground stops for flights headed to Chicago's O'Hare and Midway international airports, citing an equipment outage.
paras.zh: 在全国范围内的命令发布之前，美国联邦航空局以设备故障为由，对飞往芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场和中途国际机场的航班分别进行了地面停靠。

paras.en: The restrictions began at 2:10 p.m. CST at O'Hare and 2:17 p.m. at Midway and were initially scheduled to remain in effect until 3:30 p.m.
paras.zh: 限制措施于下午 2 点 10 分开始。奥黑尔 (CST) 下午 2:17最初计划在中途岛持续有效至下午 3:30。

paras.en: Nearly 5,000 flights were canceled by 7:45 p.m. EST, with hundreds more cancellations already scheduled for Saturday.
paras.zh: 截至晚上 7 点 45 分，近 5,000 架航班被取消。美国东部时间，周六还有数百个航班被取消。

paras.en: At least 600 flights were diverted during the shutdown, including flights redirected to airports in Washington, Chicago, Denver and Dallas-Fort Worth.
paras.zh: 关闭期间至少有 600 架航班改道，其中包括改道飞往华盛顿、芝加哥、丹佛和达拉斯沃斯堡机场的航班。

paras.en: At least 21,504 flights were delayed and 923 canceled as of Friday afternoon, according to FlightAware.
paras.zh: 据 FlightAware 称，截至周五下午，至少有 21,504 架航班延误，923 架航班取消。

paras.en: The last time there was a nationwide ground stop in the United States was in January 2023, when private contractors inadvertently deleted files pertaining to the Notice to Air Missions system.
paras.zh: 上一次美国全国范围内的地面停留是在 2023 年 1 月，当时私人承包商无意中删除了与空中任务通知系统相关的文件。

articles.title: Supreme Court to hear challenge to Trump's asylum restrictions

paras.en: Nov. 13 (UPI) -- The Supreme Court agreed Friday to hear a challenge to President Donald Trump's restrictions on asylum at the southern border, setting up a major legal test of his administration's immigration policies.
paras.zh: 11 月 13 日（合众国际社）——最高法院周五同意听取对唐纳德·特朗普总统在南部边境庇护限制的质疑，从而对其政府的移民政策进行重大法律考验。

paras.en: The justices granted the administration's appeal in Mullin v. Refugee and Immigrant, limiting their review to the first two questions presented in the government's petition.
paras.zh: 法官们批准了政府在穆林诉难民和移民一案中的上诉，将他们的审查限制在政府请愿书中提出的前两个问题。

paras.en: The case centers on a proclamation Trump signed on his first day back in office, declaring an "invasion" at the southern border and barring migrants entering illegally from applying for asylum.
paras.zh: 此案的核心是特朗普在上任第一天签署的一份公告，宣布对南部边境进行“入侵”，并禁止非法入境者申请庇护。

paras.en: Lower courts blocked the restrictions, finding that Trump exceeded his authority. The policy has remained in effect while the administration appeals.
paras.zh: 下级法院裁定特朗普越权，阻止了这些限制。在政府提出上诉期间，该政策仍然有效。

paras.en: The Supreme Court is expected to hear arguments this term and issue a decision by summer, The Hill reported.
paras.zh: 据《国会山报》报道，最高法院预计将在本学期听取辩论，并在夏季前做出裁决。

paras.en: Solicitor General D. John Sauer defended the restrictions as a central part of Trump's efforts to stop illegal border crossings.
paras.zh: 副检察长约翰·绍尔 (D. John Sauer) 辩称，这些限制是特朗普阻止非法越境努力的核心部分。

paras.en: In court filings, Sauer warned that allowing the lower court ruling to stand would undermine border security and leave the United States vulnerable to drug trafficking, weapons smuggling and cartel activity.
paras.zh: 绍尔在法庭文件中警告说，允许下级法院的裁决成立将破坏边境安全，并使美国容易受到贩毒、武器走私和卡特尔活动的影响。

paras.en: The American Civil Liberties Union and immigration advocacy groups challenged the proclamation, arguing that federal law protects the right of migrants to seek asylum regardless of how they enter the country.
paras.zh: 美国公民自由联盟和移民倡导团体对该公告提出质疑，认为联邦法律保护移民寻求庇护的权利，无论他们如何进入该国。

paras.en: "The president does not have the right to unilaterally override the protections Congress has afforded those fleeing danger," said Lee Gelernt, deputy director of the ACLU's Immigrants' Rights Project, in a statement. "The courts are right to reject this unprecedented power grab that would put countless lives in danger. We look forward to making our case before the Supreme Court."
paras.zh: 美国公民自由联盟移民权利项目副主任李·格勒恩特在一份声明中表示：“总统无权单方面推翻国会为逃离危险的人提供的保护。” “法院驳回这种史无前例的权力争夺是正确的，这将使无数人的生命处于危险之中。我们期待着向最高法院提起诉讼。”

paras.en: U.S. District Judge Randolph Moss ruled the restrictions exceeded Trump's authority and blocked them.
paras.zh: 美国地区法官伦道夫·莫斯裁定这些限制超出了特朗普的权限，并予以阻止。

paras.en: The U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit upheld the ruling in April, prompting the administration's appeal to the Supreme Court.
paras.zh: 美国哥伦比亚特区巡回上诉法院四月份维持了这一裁决，促使政府向最高法院提出上诉。

paras.en: The case is among the highest-profile legal challenges to Trump's second-term immigration crackdown.
paras.zh: 此案是特朗普第二任期移民打击行动面临的最引人注目的法律挑战之一。

articles.title: Two Celebrity Cases Put a Spotlight on British Courts’ Gag Orders
articles.author: Amanda Taub

paras.en: Two recent cases have brought new attention to the ways that British laws can allow the wealthy and powerful to silence their critics.
paras.zh: 最近的两起案件让人们重新关注英国法律允许富人和有权势的人压制批评者的方式。

paras.en: The first was the rape and sexual assault trial of the comedian Russell Brand. Before his conviction last week, Mr. Brand had obtained an injunction prohibiting another accuser from telling almost anyone — including the police, her family and most doctors — about her claims that he assaulted her. (Mr. Brand has denied her allegations.) That injunction, first revealed by Dan Neidle, a tax lawyer and free-expression activist, apparently remains in force.
paras.zh: 第一个是喜剧演员拉塞尔·布兰德的强奸和性侵犯审判。在上周被定罪之前，布兰德先生获得了一项禁令，禁止另一名原告告诉几乎任何人——包括警察、她的家人和大多数医生——她声称他袭击了她。 （布兰德先生否认了她的指控。）这项由税务律师兼言论自由活动家丹·奈德尔（Dan Neidle）首次透露的禁令显然仍然有效。

paras.en: In the second instance, two British news organizations were temporarily blocked from reporting allegations of sexual misconduct against David Walliams, a television personality and author of children’s books, before a judge declined to make the injunction permanent. The Guardian newspaper and ITV News, a British broadcaster, published investigations last week into the allegations, which Mr. Walliams denies.
paras.zh: 在第二起案件中，两家英国新闻机构被暂时禁止报道针对电视名人兼儿童读物作者大卫·威廉姆斯的性行为不端指控，随后法官拒绝将禁令永久化。 《卫报》和英国广播公司独立电视台新闻上周公布了对这些指控的调查结果，但威廉姆斯否认了这一点。

paras.en: Though both men now face public scrutiny, the revelations of how they used court injunctions — essentially gag orders — to protect their reputations have provoked no shortage of public and political outrage. Judges in other cases have issued “super injunctions,” which prohibit publishing any information even about the injunction itself.
paras.zh: 尽管两人现在都面临公众监督，但他们如何利用法院禁令（本质上是禁言令）来保护自己的声誉的曝光，引起了公众和政治上的愤怒。其他案件的法官发布了“超级禁令”，禁止发布任何信息，甚至禁止发布有关禁令本身的信息。

paras.en: “What will the government do to prevent these abuses of process, and stop the abusive injunctions and super injunctions which stop scrutiny, accountability and the work of the free press?” Nick Timothy, the shadow justice minister, asked in Parliament on Tuesday.
paras.zh: “政府将采取什么措施来防止这些滥用程序的行为，并制止滥用禁令和超级禁令来阻止审查、问责和新闻自由的工作？”影子司法部长尼克蒂莫西周二在议会提出疑问。

paras.en: The British government is now “looking at what we can do,” Alex Davies-Jones, the government minister responsible for victims of crime and violence against women and girls, said in response.
paras.zh: 负责针对妇女和女孩的犯罪和暴力行为受害者的政府部长亚历克斯·戴维斯·琼斯(Alex Davies-Jones)回应说，英国政府现在正在“考虑我们能做什么”。

articles.title: A ‘Generational Clash’ Is Fueling Europe’s Protests
articles.author: Jason Horowitz

paras.en: Sébastien Ducros, a French data analyst who supports the widespread student protests in his country, has identified an obvious culprit for the lack of government funds for dilapidated schools.
paras.zh: 法国数据分析师塞巴斯蒂安·杜克罗斯（Sébastien Ducros）支持法国广泛的学生抗议活动，他发现了政府缺乏资金建设破旧学校的明显罪魁祸首。

paras.en: “A huge portion of the money is going toward retirees, while many other things are being neglected,” said Mr. Ducros, 36. “I honestly think — even if it feels strange to say — that people like my parents are in a position where they should and could” surrender some of their pension payments, he added, saying that they were about to retire.
paras.zh: “很大一部分钱都流向了退休人员，而许多其他事情却被忽视了，”36 岁的杜克罗斯先生说。“老实说，我认为——即使这样说感觉很奇怪——像我父母这样的人应该而且可以”放弃部分养老金，他补充道，并说他们即将退休。

paras.en: But Laurent Grinwald, 72, who retired recently after decades as a postal worker, isn’t eager for his pension to be reduced, particularly to pay for other state-funded services. Especially, he said, as rents and the cost of living have shot up.
paras.zh: 但 72 岁的劳伦特·格林沃尔德 (Laurent Grinwald) 在担任了几十年的邮政工人后最近退休了，他并不急于减少自己的养老金，尤其是支付其他国家资助的服务费用。他说，尤其是随着租金和生活成本的上涨。

paras.en: “We’ve been working all this time,” Mr. Grinwald said, “and now, suddenly, the stance is, ‘Well, no, we’re going to start taking a bit more?’”
paras.zh: “我们一直在努力，”格林沃尔德先生说，“而现在，突然间，我们的立场是，‘好吧，不，我们要开始多拿一点了？’”

paras.en: This disagreement embodies a broader question for Europe, one that is at the heart of mass antigovernment demonstrations planned for Saturday in France, as well as recent protests driven by frustrated young people in countries including Belgium, Germany, Greece, Italy and Portugal. As Europeans live longer, should the needs of the young be eclipsed by their parents’ and grandparents’ pensions, routinely the largest items in Europe’s national budgets?
paras.zh: 这一分歧体现了欧洲面临的一个更广泛的问题，这个问题是法国计划于周六举行的大规模反政府示威活动以及比利时、德国、希腊、意大利和葡萄牙等国沮丧的年轻人最近发起的抗议活动的核心问题。随着欧洲人的寿命越来越长，年轻人的需求是否应该被父母和祖父母的养老金（通常是欧洲国家预算中最大的项目）所掩盖？

paras.en: “It’s a generational clash,” said Jorge Galindo, the director of EsadeEcPol, an independent think tank in Spain, which has some of the most generous pensions in Europe.
paras.zh: “这是一场代际冲突，”西班牙独立智库 EsadeEcPol 的主任豪尔赫·加林多 (Jorge Galindo) 说，该智库拥有欧洲最慷慨的养老金之一。

articles.title: Here’s the latest.
articles.author: Karoun Demirjian

paras.en: The nationwide ground stop that brought all air travel to a halt across the country and stranded thousands of passengers has been canceled, according to the Federal Aviation Administration.
paras.zh: 据美国联邦航空管理局称，导致全国所有航空旅行暂停并滞留数千名乘客的全国性地面停靠站已被取消。

paras.en: Within minutes of flight traffic being restored, Sean Duffy, the transportation secretary, took to a podium Friday night at the White House to decry Congress, accusing lawmakers of dragging their feet when it came to fully funding upgrades he warned were vital to prevent similar failures from happening again.
paras.zh: 航班交通恢复几分钟后，交通部长肖恩·达菲（Sean Duffy）周五晚上在白宫登上讲台谴责国会，指责立法者在为升级提供充分资金方面拖延，他警告说这对于防止类似故障再次发生至关重要。

paras.en: “It’s going to continue to fail,” Mr. Duffy told reporters, adding: “How many times does this have to happen for Congress to give the money to fix it?”
paras.zh: 达菲对记者说：“它会继续失败。”他补充道：“这种情况要发生多少次，国会才会拨款来解决这个问题？”

paras.en: Mr. Duffy added that the antiquated radar and telecoms systems that controllers rely on to transmit data and other information between facilities began to falter at 3:36 p.m. The aging system, which has undergone a number of upgrades, became overloaded, officials said.
paras.zh: 达菲先生补充说，控制人员赖以在设施之间传输数据和其他信息的过时雷达和电信系统在下午 3:36 开始出现故障。官员们表示，经过多次升级的老化系统已变得超载。

paras.en: Appearing alongside him, Markwayne Mullin, the secretary of homeland security, stressed that there was never any indication that the communications failures had been triggered by a cyberattack, but he added, “we are still looking, and we’re not going to rule it out.” He emphasized that lives were never in danger.
paras.zh: 与他一起出现的国土安全部长马克韦恩·穆林强调，从未有任何迹象表明通信故障是由网络攻击引发的，但他补充说，“我们仍在寻找，我们不会排除这种可能性。”他强调，生命从未面临危险。
