paras.en: But the incident appeared to inject new fuel into Mr. Duffy’s now monthslong campaign to secure at least $30 billion in extra funding for air traffic control modernization.
paras.zh: 但这一事件似乎为达菲先生目前长达数月的争取至少 300 亿美元额外资金用于空中交通管制现代化的运动注入了新的动力。

paras.en: Last year, Congress approved $12.5 billion to upgrade aging air traffic facilities and technology, funds Mr. Duffy has repeatedly referred to as a “down payment” when asking for tens of billions more. On Friday night, Mr. Duffy appeared to up the ante, telling reporters that he didn’t just want another $30 billion for the project, but another $50 billion. He argued that it should be delivered in emergency funding before the end of the year, after which control of Congress — and the budget — switches from Republicans to Democrats.
paras.zh: 去年，国会批准了 125 亿美元用于升级老化的空中交通设施和技术，达菲在要求追加数百亿美元时多次将这些资金称为“首付”。周五晚上，达菲似乎加大了赌注，他告诉记者，他不仅想要为该项目再投入 300 亿美元，还想要另外 500 亿美元。他认为，应该在年底前以紧急资金的形式提供，之后国会和预算的控制权从共和党转向民主党。

paras.en: Some Democratic lawmakers have already raised questions about how efficiently and effectively the F.A.A. has spent the money they have been given thus far. But Mr. Duffy has long argued that his department cannot be expected to complete a meaningful overhaul of the nation’s air traffic control system without a massive influx of funding.
paras.zh: 一些民主党议员已经对联邦航空管理局的效率和效力提出了质疑。已经花掉了迄今为止给他们的钱。但达菲先生长期以来一直认为，如果没有大量资金的流入，就不能指望他的部门能够完成对国家空中交通管制系统的有意义的改革。

paras.en: Friday’s nationwide ground stop was only the third that the F.A.A. has issued this century. It ranks as the second-longest, after the ground stop issued on Sept. 11, 2001, in the wake of the terrorist attacks on the World Trade Center in New York. There was a shorter one on Jan. 11, 2023, because of an outage in the F.A.A.’s system to alert pilots to safety issues.
paras.zh: 周五的全国性地面停留只是美国联邦航空管理局 (F.A.A.) 执行的第三次地面停留。本世纪已发行。继 2001 年 9 月 11 日纽约世贸中心恐怖袭击事件后，该停飞时间排在第二位。 2023 年 1 月 11 日，由于 F.A.A. 提醒飞行员安全问题的系统出现故障，该事件的时间较短。

paras.en: The order on Friday halted nearly all departures and stranded thousands of passengers at airports across the country. Hundreds of flights were diverted to other airports and more were canceled, even as some internationally bound flights managed to secure permission to take off. Amid the delays and cancellations, many passengers were taken off flights or told to go home.
paras.zh: 周五的命令几乎停止了所有航班的起飞，并使数千名乘客滞留在全国各地的机场。尽管一些飞往国际的航班设法获得起飞许可，但仍有数百架航班改道至其他机场，更多航班被取消。在航班延误和取消的情况下，许多乘客被带下飞机或被告知回家。

paras.en: More than 2 million people pass through airport security checkpoints on a typical day, according to Transportation Security Administration data. On Thursday, the agency screened nearly 2.5 million people. According to FlightRadar24, an aviation tracking site, there were more than 1,000 airborne aircraft bound for U.S. airports during the nationwide ground stop. According to the flight tracking app Flighty, there were more than 30,000 departures and arrivals scheduled for the remainder of the day.
paras.zh: 根据运输安全管理局的数据，每天有超过 200 万人通过机场安全检查站。周四，该机构对近 250 万人进行了筛查。据航空追踪网站FlightRadar24称，在全国范围内的地面停留期间，有超过1000架飞机飞往美国机场。根据航班跟踪应用程序 Flighty 的数据，当天剩余时间内预计有超过 30,000 架次出发和抵达航班。

paras.en: Passengers waiting to take off Friday afternoon were stuck in limbo.
paras.zh: 周五下午等待起飞的乘客陷入了困境。

paras.en: Before the advisory was published, the F.A.A. halted flights to Chicago’s O’Hare and Midway airports, citing equipment problems, and reported equipment-related departure delays at Newark, Las Vegas, Teterboro, Orlando, Houston and Phoenix.
paras.zh: 在该咨询发布之前，美国联邦航空局 (F.A.A.)以设备问题为由，暂停飞往芝加哥奥黑尔机场和中途岛机场的航班，并报告纽瓦克、拉斯维加斯、泰特波罗、奥兰多、休斯顿和菲尼克斯的航班因设备相关而出现延误。

paras.en: - A busy travel month: The ground stop happened about two weeks before Thanksgiving, one of the busiest times of the year for air travel. On average, U.S. airlines are expected to fly about 2.7 million passengers each day over the holiday period, according to industry trade group Airlines for America.
paras.zh: - 繁忙的旅行月：地面停留发生在感恩节前大约两周，感恩节是一年中航空旅行最繁忙的时期之一。据行业贸易组织美国航空 (Airlines for America) 称，平均而言，美国航空公司预计在假期期间每天运送约 270 万名乘客。

paras.en: Christine Chung, Niraj Chokshi, Luke Broadwater, Dustin Volz, Lisa Lerer and Robert Chiarito contributed reporting.
paras.zh: Christine Chung、Niraj Chokshi、Luke Broadwater、Dustin Volz、Lisa Lerer 和 Robert Chiarito 也参与了报道。

paras.en: The Federal Aviation Administration issued a rare nationwide ground stop Friday afternoon, after outdated air traffic communications equipment became overloaded with data and began to fail, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，在过时的空中交通通信设备数据超载并开始出现故障后，美国联邦航空管理局周五下午罕见地在全国范围内进行了地面停车。

paras.en: The outage stranded thousands of passengers and caused widespread delays from which airlines and airports are still struggling to recover. It also highlighted persistent vulnerabilities in the aging U.S. air traffic infrastructure and a funding fight, as administration officials demanded lawmakers approve tens of billions of dollars more to accelerate systemwide upgrades.
paras.zh: 这次停电导致数千名乘客滞留，并造成大面积延误，航空公司和机场仍在努力恢复。它还凸显了美国老化的空中交通基础设施中持续存在的漏洞以及资金争夺战，因为政府官员要求立法者批准额外数百亿美元以加速全系统升级。

paras.en: Sean Duffy, the transportation secretary, told reporters at the White House Friday night that the radar and other air traffic communications started to falter at 3:36 p.m. when old routers became overloaded with data. While the failures were not universal, they were pervasive enough to prompt officials to issue the unusual nationwide moratorium on takeoffs, Mr. Duffy said.
paras.zh: 周五晚上，交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 在白宫告诉记者，雷达和其他空中交通通讯在下午 3 点 36 分开始出现故障。当旧路由器数据过载时。达菲说，虽然这些失败并不普遍，但它们的普遍性足以促使官员们在全国范围内罕见地暂停起飞。

paras.en: Appearing alongside him at the White House, Markwayne Mullin, the homeland security secretary, stressed that there was no evidence that nefarious activity had triggered the technology failures.
paras.zh: 与他一起出现在白宫的国土安全部长马克韦恩·穆林强调，没有证据表明邪恶活动引发了技术故障。

paras.en: “We’ve seen zero evidence that this was a cyberattack,” Mr. Mullin said, suggesting that new equipment and new technology the Mr. Duffy’s department had added to the old infrastructure was what had overwhelmed it.
paras.zh: “我们没有看到零证据表明这是一次网络攻击，”穆林先生说，他暗示达菲先生的部门在旧基础设施中添加的新设备和新技术才是导致旧基础设施不堪重负的原因。

paras.en: Mr. Duffy insisted that the failure was caused by the antiquated, legacy communications equipment, not recent upgrades to the system.
paras.zh: 达菲先生坚称，故障是由陈旧的遗留通信设备造成的，而不是最近对系统的升级。

paras.en: “What we have is an incredibly old air traffic control system,” Mr. Duffy said, predicting that until significant upgrades are made, “it’s going to continue to fail.”
paras.zh: 达菲先生说：“我们拥有的是一个极其陈旧的空中交通管制系统。”他预测，在进行重大升级之前，“它将继续出现故障。”

paras.en: How long will it take to get things back to normal?
paras.zh: 需要多长时间才能让一切恢复正常？

paras.en: Mr. Duffy warned that it would take “some time” for air travel nationwide to recover from the ground stop, predicting flight schedules would be fully back to normal by the time the Thanksgiving travel season begins.
paras.zh: 达菲警告说，全国范围内的航空旅行需要“一段时间”才能从地面停止中恢复过来，并预计到感恩节旅行季节开始时，航班时刻表将完全恢复正常。

paras.en: “I believe that it’s going to take us some time to get back to capacity,” he said, adding: “We’re going to have some makeup to do.”
paras.zh: “我相信我们需要一些时间才能恢复产能，”他说，并补充道：“我们需要做一些调整。”

paras.en: Mr. Duffy said that the F.A.A. would prioritize larger commercial flights ahead of private and charter flights, to get previously grounded flights off the ground.
paras.zh: 达菲先生说，联邦航空管理局。将优先考虑大型商业航班，而不是私人和包机航班，以使之前停飞的航班恢复正常。

paras.en: What does the administration say needs to be done?
paras.zh: 政府说需要做什么？

paras.en: Mr. Duffy has long been pushing for a sweeping overhaul of the U.S. air traffic infrastructure, routinely complaining that controllers have been hampered by the country’s failure to upgrade outdated equipment.
paras.zh: 达菲先生长期以来一直在推动对美国空中交通基础设施进行全面检修，他经常抱怨管制员因该国未能升级过时的设备而受到阻碍。

paras.en: “We have old, old switches, old routers — we use 1980s little copper lines,” he said to reporters Friday. Only last week, the F.A.A. announced that it had begun to phase out the use of floppy disks.
paras.zh: “我们有很旧很旧的交换机、旧路由器——我们使用 20 世纪 80 年代的小铜线，”他周五对记者说。就在上周，美国联邦航空管理局 (F.A.A.)宣布已开始逐步淘汰软盘的使用。

paras.en: Last year, Congress approved $12.5 billion to fund upgrades to the country’s aging air traffic facilities and networks, some of which has been directed toward communications system upgrades. Mr. Duffy noted Friday that air traffic facilities that had been upgraded to digital systems did not experience the same overloading issues that prompted the F.A.A. to issue the ground stop order.
paras.zh: 去年，国会批准了 125 亿美元，用于资助该国老化的空中交通设施和网络的升级，其中一些资金用于通信系统升级。达菲先生周五指出，升级为数字系统的空中交通设施并没有遇到促使美国联邦航空局采取同样措施的超载问题。发出地面停止命令。

paras.en: But he stressed that having an air traffic control system dependent on a “patchwork” of upgrades and fixes was untenable, calling on Congress to spend tens of billions more to allow for more upgrades.
paras.zh: 但他强调，依靠“拼凑”的升级和修复来建立空中交通管制系统是站不住脚的，呼吁国会再花费数百亿美元以进行更多升级。

paras.en: For months, Mr. Duffy has been calling on the Republican-controlled Congress to give his department another $30 billion to accelerate efforts to upgrade air traffic control systems. On Friday night, he upped the ante, telling reporters he wanted $50 billion — and that he wanted it before the end of the year.
paras.zh: 几个月来，达菲一直呼吁共和党控制的国会再拨款 300 亿美元，以加快空中交通管制系统的升级工作。周五晚上，他提高了赌注，告诉记者他想要 500 亿美元，而且他希望在年底前拿到。

paras.en: “This is an emergency, I want Congress to give us emergency funding,” he said, adding: “How many more times does this have to happen for Congress to give the money to fix it?”
paras.zh: “这是紧急情况，我希望国会向我们提供紧急资金，”他说，并补充道：“这种情况还要发生多少次，国会才能提供资金来解决这个问题？”

paras.en: But it is unclear whether Republicans will prioritize such a sum before the end of the year, after which control of Congress shifts to the Democrats, who are expected to scrutinize how the F.A.A. has utilized air traffic funding they have received so far. Republican lawmakers have filed bills in the House and Senate to authorize $30 billion in air traffic upgrades, but neither piece of legislation has cosponsors.
paras.zh: 但目前尚不清楚共和党是否会在年底前优先考虑这笔资金，之后国会的控制权将转移到民主党，预计民主党将审查联邦航空局如何处理这一问题。已动用迄今为止收到的空中交通资金。共和党立法者已向众议院和参议院提交法案，授权 300 亿美元进行空中交通升级，但这两项法案都没有共同发起人。

paras.en: Later on Friday, Representative Hakeem Jeffries of New York, the House’s top-ranking Democrat, appeared to reject Mr. Duffy’s accusing tone and shifted the blame back to the Trump administration.
paras.zh: 周五晚些时候，众议院民主党领袖、纽约众议员哈基姆·杰弗里斯似乎拒绝了达菲的指责语气，并将责任转嫁给特朗普政府。

paras.en: “Today’s unprecedented breakdown is the latest in a series of unacceptable air travel incidents under the Trump administration’s failed leadership,” he said in a statement, adding that “American travelers deserve timely answers from the Trump administration about how and why this happened and assurances that steps are being taken to ensure that our air travel system remains safe and functional.”
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中表示：“今天前所未有的故障是特朗普政府领导失败导致的一系列不可接受的航空旅行事件中的最新一起。”他补充说，“美国旅客应该得到特朗普政府及时答复，了解这种情况是如何发生以及为何发生的，并保证正在采取措施确保我们的航空旅行系统保持安全和正常运转。”

paras.en: Nationwide, more than 8,200 flights — or over 31 percent of those scheduled in the United States for Friday — were canceled, according to Cirium, an aviation data firm. And the disruption was already spilling over into Saturday, usually a slower day for travel, with more than 5 percent of flights canceled before the day had even begun.
paras.zh: 根据航空数据公司 Cirium 的数据，全国范围内有超过 8,200 架航班（占周五美国原定航班的 31% 以上）被取消。而且这种干扰已经蔓延到周六，这通常是出行速度较慢的一天，超过 5% 的航班在当天开始之前就被取消了。

paras.en: Pete Buttigieg could not believe what he had just watched. The former transportation secretary stood at the corner of the hotel bar in Denver, where CNN had just finished broadcasting the Trump administration’s news conference about the ground stop that stopped flights nationwide on Friday.
paras.zh: 皮特·布蒂吉格简直不敢相信自己刚刚看到的一切。这位前交通部长站在丹佛酒店酒吧的一角，美国有线电视新闻网(CNN)刚刚在那里播放完特朗普政府关于周五全国航班停飞的地面站新闻发布会。

paras.en: Mr. Buttigieg was among the thousands of Democrats who had gathered in Denver this week for a conference designed to chart the party’s future and celebrate their midterm wins. The ground stop stranded some of the party’s top rising stars and their staffs.
paras.zh: 布蒂吉格是本周聚集在丹佛参加一次会议的数千名民主党人之一，该会议旨在规划该党的未来并庆祝他们的中期胜利。一些党内的新星和他们的工作人员被困在地面站。

paras.en: People accustomed to having inside information suddenly had very little.
paras.zh: 习惯于了解内幕消息的人们突然变得少之又少。

paras.en: At a table to Mr. Buttigieg’s left sat Gov. Abigail Spanberger of Virginia, Gov. Mikie Sherrill of New Jersey and Senator Elissa Slotkin of Michigan. They munched on Parmesan fries and checked their phones as they waited for news of their flights.
paras.zh: 布蒂吉格左边的一张桌子上坐着弗吉尼亚州州长阿比盖尔·斯潘伯格、新泽西州州长米基·谢里尔和密歇根州参议员埃丽莎·斯洛特金。他们一边嚼着帕尔马干酪薯条，一边检查手机，等待航班消息。

paras.en: To his right, Senator Raphael Warnock of Georgia scanned his Senate group chats to check for updates from secure channels and Senator Mark Warner of Virginia.
paras.zh: 在他的右边，佐治亚州参议员拉斐尔·沃诺克扫描了他的参议院群组聊天，以检查来自安全渠道和弗吉尼亚州参议员马克·沃纳的更新。

paras.en: But Mr. Buttigieg, glancing up at the television, struggled to comprehend the performance of his successor, Secretary Sean Duffy.
paras.zh: 但布蒂吉格抬头看了一眼电视，很难理解他的继任者肖恩·达菲国务卿的表现。

paras.en: “You can just write down the comic book asterisk swearing characters,” Mr. Buttigieg said when a New York Times reporter asked for his impressions of the news conference. “I have questions.”
paras.zh: 当《纽约时报》记者询问他对新闻发布会的印象时，布蒂吉格说道：“你可以写下漫画里的星号脏话角色。” “我有问题。”

paras.en: The downtown hotel bar resembled the famous bar scene in “Star Wars.” The stranded politicians bemoaned the lack of information from the federal government and their inability to get home.
paras.zh: 市中心的酒店酒吧酷似《星球大战》中著名的酒吧场景。被困的政客们对联邦政府缺乏信息以及无法回家表示遗憾。

paras.en: One New England-based operative booked a rental car and planned to drive back to Boston. Others looked up how many hours it would take to get to the East Coast on Amtrak. (The answer: more than 40.) Aides to one prominent Democratic governor, who had flown to Denver on a private jet, fielded questions from others in the bar about whether they could hitch a ride home.
paras.zh: 一名新英格兰特工预订了一辆租车，并计划开车返回波士顿。其他人则查了乘坐Amtrak 到达东海岸需要多少小时。 （答案：超过 40 个。）一位著名的民主党州长乘坐私人飞机飞往丹佛，他的助手回答了酒吧里其他人提出的关于他们是否可以搭便车回家的问题。

paras.en: A few people working for Gov. JB Pritzker of Illinois — who did not come to Denver — commandeered a long table where Anne Caprara, his chief of staff, worked two phones as she juggled rumors, emergencies back home and calls from the boss. She said Mr. Pritzker was furious about the lack of information coming from the Trump administration.
paras.zh: 伊利诺伊州州长 JB 普利茨克 (JB Pritzker) 的工作人员（他没有来丹佛）霸占了一张长桌，他的幕僚长安妮·卡普拉拉 (Anne Caprara) 在这张长桌上工作着两部电话，一边处理谣言、家里的紧急情况和老板打来的电话。她说普利兹克先生对特朗普政府缺乏信息感到愤怒。

paras.en: “Welcome to Denver’s hottest bar, the Mos Eisley Cantina of politics,” Ms. Caprara said, referring to the “Star Wars” bar. “With ‘Veep’ characters and a ‘Terminator 2’ vibe.”
paras.zh: “欢迎来到丹佛最热门的酒吧，莫斯艾斯利政治酒吧，”卡普拉拉女士说，指的是“星球大战”酒吧。 “有《副总统》的角色和《终结者 2》的氛围。”

paras.en: Representative Hakeem Jeffries of New York, the leader of the House Democrats, shifted the blame for Friday’s ground stop back to the Trump administration. In a statement, he called the stop “the latest in a series of unacceptable air travel incidents under the Trump Administration’s failed leadership.”
paras.zh: 众议院民主党领袖、纽约众议员哈基姆·杰弗里斯将周五的地面停留归咎于特朗普政府。他在一份声明中称此次停飞是“特朗普政府领导失败导致的一系列不可接受的航空旅行事件中的最新一起”。

paras.en: Earlier Friday night, Sean Duffy, the transportation secretary, had blamed Congress for not adequately funding his department’s plans to upgrade the nation’s air traffic infrastructure.
paras.zh: 周五晚上早些时候，交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 指责国会没有为其部门升级国家空中交通基础设施的计划提供足够的资金。

paras.en: “American travelers deserve timely answers from the Trump Administration about how and why this happened,” Mr. Jeffries added.
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯补充道：“美国游客应该得到特朗普政府及时答复，了解这种情况是如何发生以及为何发生的。”

paras.en: A communications outage on Friday led the Federal Aviation Administration to pause departing flights nationwide, but pilots were not entirely cut off from federal air traffic controllers.
paras.zh: 周五的通信中断导致美国联邦航空管理局暂停了全国范围内的出发航班，但飞行员与联邦空中交通管制员的联系并未完全切断。

paras.en: In a Friday night news conference, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the outage was intermittent, so federal controllers were still able to reach pilots.
paras.zh: 在周五晚上的新闻发布会上，交通部长肖恩·达菲表示，停电是间歇性的，因此联邦控制人员仍然能够联系到飞行员。

paras.en: “It wasn’t a complete blackout in communication or radar,” he said. “So we were able to keep some of those communications going.”
paras.zh: “这并不是通讯或雷达完全瘫痪，”他说。 “所以我们能够保持其中一些沟通。”

paras.en: But even in a complete outage, aviation authorities have multiple backups to maintain contact with pilots.
paras.zh: 但即使在完全停电的情况下，航空当局也有多个备份来与飞行员保持联系。

paras.en: Pilots and air traffic controllers primarily communicate by voice radio, using primary, backup and emergency frequencies.
paras.zh: 飞行员和空中交通管制员主要通过语音无线电进行通信，使用主要频率、备用频率和紧急频率。

paras.en: Controllers and airline dispatchers can also send text-based messages to pilots. And many commercial planes are equipped with satellite communications, which are especially useful for reaching people on the ground when the planes are flying in remote airspace like over the ocean.
paras.zh: 管制员和航空公司调度员还可以向飞行员发送基于文本的消息。许多商用飞机都配备了卫星通信功能，当飞机在遥远的空域（例如海洋上空）飞行时，卫星通信对于联系地面人员特别有用。

paras.en: If a control tower loses radio capabilities, it can also communicate with pilots with high-intensity colored lights, which pilots can acknowledge by rocking their wings or flashing lights in response.
paras.zh: 如果控制塔失去无线电功能，它还可以用高强度彩灯与飞行员进行通信，飞行员可以通过摇动机翼或闪烁灯光来确认这一点。

paras.en: Airlines began to restore some flights after the nationwide stop was lifted. United Airlines said that while many of its flights had been canceled, some were still expected to operate.
paras.zh: 全国停飞解除后，航空公司开始恢复部分航班。联合航空表示，虽然许多航班已被取消，但预计部分航班仍将运营。

paras.en: American Airlines said it was prioritizing flights to non-hub airports and international destinations in order to get planes and crews in place to recover quickly. Southwest Airlines said it was resuming a “limited number of flights” on Friday.
paras.zh: 美国航空表示，将优先安排飞往非枢纽机场和国际目的地的航班，以便让飞机和机组人员迅速就位恢复。西南航空表示，周五将恢复“有限数量的航班”。

paras.en: Some professional and college sports teams were stuck on runways, or opting to pile into buses, ahead of games this weekend that are now uncertain due to the nationwide ground stop that was lifted Friday night.
paras.zh: 在本周末的比赛之前，一些职业和大学运动队被困在跑道上，或者选择挤进公共汽车，由于周五晚上取消了全国范围的地面停车，目前情况还不确定。

paras.en: Markwayne Mullin, the secretary of homeland security, said at a news conference on Friday that the ground stop was caused by technology upgrades “overwhelming” the flight communication system. Thousands of flights have been canceled, but no high-profile games have been affected so far, ahead of what is set to be a busy weekend in sports.
paras.zh: 美国国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林 (Markwayne Mullin) 在周五的新闻发布会上表示，地面停止是由于技术升级“压倒”了飞行通信系统造成的。数千架航班已被取消，但在体育周末即将到来之前，尚未有任何备受瞩目的比赛受到影响。

paras.en: Dozens of teams had made it out of airports just ahead of the stop. But the N.B.A.’s Brooklyn Nets were not so lucky.
paras.zh: 数十支队伍已在终点站前离开机场。但 NBA 的布鲁克林篮网队就没那么幸运了。

paras.en: The Athletic reported that the Nets were stuck on a team plane on Friday. They have a game Saturday night against the Memphis Grizzles.
paras.zh: 据《The Athletic》报道，篮网队周五被困在球队飞机上。周六晚上他们将对阵孟菲斯灰熊队。

paras.en: Also stuck at an airport was the University of Texas Longhorns football team, slated to play Louisiana State University in Baton Rouge, La., on Saturday night. Minutes before the stoppage, the Longhorns posted a video of players boarding a plane with the caption “Bayou bound.”
paras.zh: 同样滞留在机场的还有德克萨斯大学长角牛橄榄球队，该队定于周六晚上在路易斯安那州巴吞鲁日对阵路易斯安那州立大学。停赛前几分钟，长角牛队发布了一段球员登上飞机的视频，并配上标题“前往河口”。

paras.en: Both teams are in the Southeastern Conference, which said in a statement that it would work “to determine whether any adjustments to scheduled competitions become necessary.”
paras.zh: 两支球队都参加了东南联盟，该联盟在一份声明中表示，将努力“确定是否有必要对预定的比赛进行任何调整”。

paras.en: On Friday night, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy told reporters that he encouraged college football teams to coordinate their flights with the Federal Aviation Administration “to make sure we have games going off tomorrow.”
paras.zh: 周五晚上，交通部长肖恩·达菲告诉记者，他鼓励大学橄榄球队与联邦航空管理局协调他们的航班，“以确保我们明天有比赛”。

paras.en: While some teams, including the Longhorns, headed home from the airport to wait out the delay, a handful of others opted to travel the old-fashioned way: By bus.
paras.zh: 虽然包括长角牛队在内的一些球队从机场回家等待延误结束，但其他一些球队选择了老式的方式：乘坐巴士。

paras.en: The Athletic reported that among the longest drives was a 330-mile ride for the Purdue University Boilermakers, who are playing the University of Iowa Hawkeyes on Saturday night.
paras.zh: 据《The Athletic》报道，普渡大学锅炉制造队 (Purdue University Boilermakers) 的骑行距离最长，其中包括 330 英里，他们周六晚上将对阵爱荷华大学鹰眼队 (University of Iowa Hawkeyes)。

paras.en: The University of Southern California women’s basketball team said they were grounded in Los Angeles ahead of a marquee game Sunday against the University of South Carolina Gamecocks, but were preparing to travel on Saturday.
paras.zh: 南加州大学女子篮球队表示，在周日对阵南卡罗来纳大学斗鸡队的一场大型比赛之前，她们在洛杉矶停飞，但准备在周六启程。

paras.en: In men’s college basketball, a Saturday game between University of North Carolina Greensboro and Cornell University in Ithaca, N.Y., was postponed because of the ground stop.
paras.zh: 在男子大学篮球方面，周六北卡罗来纳大学格林斯伯勒分校和纽约州伊萨卡康奈尔大学之间的比赛因停地而推迟。

paras.en: N.F.L. teams typically travel on Saturday for Sunday games. Five teams told The Athletic that their travel plans were not affected.
paras.zh: 国家橄榄球联盟球队通常在周六前往参加周日的比赛。五支球队告诉The Athletic，他们的旅行计划没有受到影响。

paras.en: According to The Athletic, the stakes of the ground stop may be most significant for the National Women’s Soccer League, which is scheduled to hold its semifinals this weekend. The stop affected the Kansas City Current’s flight to New York City ahead of its game against Gotham FC on Sunday. The Utah Royals, playing the Washington Spirit on Saturday, traveled before the stoppage.
paras.zh: 据《The Athletic》报道，对于全国女子足球联赛来说，停赛的风险可能最为重大，该联赛定于本周末举行半决赛。这次停靠影响了堪萨斯城潮流号在周日对阵哥谭足球俱乐部的比赛之前飞往纽约市的航班。周六对阵华盛顿精神队的犹他皇家队在停赛前进行了比赛。

paras.en: The N.B.A.’s Cleveland Cavaliers had planned to catch a flight home after their Friday night game in Miami. Kenny Atkinson, the Cavaliers head coach, told reporters before the game that he didn’t know if the team would make their flight.
paras.zh: NBA 克利夫兰骑士队原计划在周五晚上迈阿密的比赛结束后乘飞机回家。骑士队主教练肯尼·阿特金森在赛前告诉记者，他不知道球队是否会起飞。

paras.en: “I think we’re scrambling to find hotel rooms in case,” Mr. Atkinson said, adding: “If not, we’ll sleep on the bus.”
paras.zh: “我认为我们正在忙着寻找酒店房间以防万一，”阿特金森先生说，并补充说：“如果没有，我们就睡在公共汽车上。”

paras.en: Radio transmissions between active pilots and air traffic controllers at major airports offer a peek at how they navigated the Federal Aviation Administration’s nationwide ground stoppage on Friday.
paras.zh: 主要机场的现役飞行员和空中交通管制员之间的无线电传输可以让我们了解他们如何应对美国联邦航空管理局周五全国范围内的地面停飞。

paras.en: An air traffic controller at Newark Liberty International Airport can be heard sharing the news with pilots.
paras.zh: 纽瓦克自由国际机场的一名空中交通管制员与飞行员分享了这一消息。

paras.en: Minutes later, at airports in Atlanta and Chicago, controllers said they had limited information.
paras.zh: 几分钟后，亚特兰大和芝加哥机场的管制人员表示，他们掌握的信息有限。

paras.en: As planes landed over the next hour and departures were stuck at their gates, air traffic controllers can be heard talking about significant gate issues and comparing the tarmac to a “parking lot.”
paras.zh: 随着飞机在接下来的一个小时内降落，出发航班被困在登机口，可以听到空中交通管制员谈论重大的登机口问题，并将停机坪与“停车场”进行比较。

paras.en: Amid the chaos, one pilot noted the date while talking to a Newark controller: “It’s not lost on me that it’s Friday the 13th.”
paras.zh: 在一片混乱中，一名飞行员在与纽瓦克管制员交谈时注意到了这个日期：“我没有忘记今天是 13 号星期五。”

paras.en: Passengers groaned loudly as an announcement at Newark Liberty International Airport ordered them back to their gates for both domestic and international flights. “Are you kidding me? When will this end?” one woman cried out.
paras.zh: 当纽瓦克自由国际机场发布通知要求乘客返回登机口乘坐国内和国际航班时，乘客们大声抱怨。 “你在开玩笑吗？这什么时候才能结束？”一名妇女大声喊道。

paras.en: At Kennedy International Airport in New York, passengers waited to board a flight to Paris that was delayed because the pilot hadn’t been able to take his flight from Boston to J.F.K. Instead, he decided to drive, and passengers have been receiving updates about his E.T.A. over the loudspeaker. The latest update said he was expected to arrive at the airport at 9:45 p.m. When it was announced that the flight would begin boarding before his arrival, one woman raised both hands over her head with her fingers crossed.
paras.zh: 在纽约肯尼迪国际机场，乘客们等待登机飞往巴黎的航班，该航班因飞行员未能从波士顿飞往肯尼迪而延误。相反，他决定开车，乘客们一直在收到有关他预计到达时间的最新信息。通过扬声器。最新消息称，他预计将于晚上 9 点 45 分抵达机场。当宣布航班将在他抵达之前开始登机时，一名女士将双手举过头顶，交叉手指。

paras.en: More than 6,600 flights on Friday had been canceled by 9:30 p.m. Eastern, according to Flight Aware, a flight-tracking service. And that disruption had already spilled over into the weekend, with about 1,500 flights on Saturday canceled as well.
paras.zh: 截至晚上 9:30，周五已有 6,600 多个航班被取消。据航班跟踪服务公司 Flight Aware 称，东方航空。这种中断已经蔓延到周末，周六大约 1,500 架航班也被取消。

paras.en: Pete Buttigieg, who served as the transportation secretary during the Biden administration, is stranded in Denver and mingling in the bar at the Ritz-Carlton hotel. After watching the Trump administration’s press conference, Buttigieg seemed exasperated. “You can just write down the comic book asterisk swearing characters,” Buttigieg said. “I have questions.”
paras.zh: 拜登政府期间担任交通部长的皮特·布蒂吉格（Pete Buttigieg）被困在丹佛，在丽思卡尔顿酒店的酒吧里混在一起。看完特朗普政府的新闻发布会后，布蒂吉格显得很愤怒。 “你可以写下漫画书中的星号咒骂角色，”布蒂吉格说。 “我有问题。”

paras.en: It could take days for air travel to fully normalize after an event of this scale, said Vikrant Vaze, a Dartmouth professor specializing in commercial aviation logistics. “It’s going to take a lot of gymnastics” to get every airline’s aircraft, passengers and crew members back in the correct positions, he said.
paras.zh: 达特茅斯商业航空物流专业教授维克兰特·瓦兹 (Vikrant Vaze) 表示，在发生如此规模的事件后，航空旅行可能需要几天时间才能完全正常化。他说，“需要做大量的练习”才能让每家航空公司的飞机、乘客和机组人员回到正确的位置。

paras.en: Some contingency measures can be taken by airlines to get things back on track, such as flying reserve crews or “ferrying” an empty aircraft. It’s helpful that airlines have the nighttime hours, when there are typically fewer domestic flights, to push through some of the backlog, Vaze said.
paras.zh: 航空公司可以采取一些应急措施让事情重回正轨，例如派遣后备机组人员或“运送”一架空飞机。瓦兹说，航空公司利用夜间时段（国内航班通常较少）来处理一些积压的航班是有帮助的。

paras.en: Cheers and applause erupted in the Delta Sky Club at Los Angeles International Airport, where travelers just heard an announcement that the nationwide ground stop had been lifted. At least three Delta flights at the airport were already boarding, but it could take some time for other flights to get going, a Delta agent said in the announcement.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶国际机场的达美航空飞凡贵宾室爆发出欢呼声和掌声，旅客们刚刚听到全国地面停止已取消的消息。达美航空的一名代理人在公告中表示，机场至少有三架达美航空航班已经开始登机，但其他航班可能需要一些时间才能起飞。

paras.en: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy appeared to suggest that his effort to upgrade air traffic control infrastructure may have contributed to the outage, but he defended the upgrades by arguing that they had to be done.
paras.zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲似乎表示，他升级空中交通管制基础设施的努力可能是造成这次停电的原因之一，但他为升级辩护，认为升级是必须要做的。

paras.en: “By doing nothing, you inject way more risk into the system,” he said, adding, “I didn’t anticipate that we would have an outage like this.”
paras.zh: “如果不采取任何措施，就会给系统带来更多风险，”他补充道，“我没有预料到会出现这样的停电情况。”

paras.en: Duffy has criticized Congress throughout this briefing for not allocating more funding to air traffic infrastructure.
paras.zh: 达菲在整个简报中批评国会没有为空中交通基础设施分配更多资金。

paras.en: “I can’t build things if I don’t have money,” Duffy said, shaking his head. “We should talk to our senators and members of Congress to say, ‘We don’t deserve this.’”
paras.zh: “如果我没有钱，我就无法建造东西，”达菲摇着头说。 “我们应该告诉我们的参议员和国会议员，‘我们不应该遭受这样的事情。’”

paras.en: Sean Duffy has been clamoring for another $30 billion in air traffic modernization funds from Congress for several months now. On Friday night, he appeared to up the ante, saying he didn’t want just $30 billion — he wanted $50 billion. But the official ask, which he has made repeatedly and which is reflected in legislation he has endorsed, is another $30 billion.
paras.zh: 几个月来，肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 一直呼吁国会再提供 300 亿美元的空中交通现代化资金。周五晚上，他似乎加大了赌注，表示他不仅仅想要 300 亿美元，他想要 500 亿美元。但他一再提出的官方要求是另外 300 亿美元，这一要求也反映在他所支持的立法中。

paras.en: In the last few weeks, Republicans in the House and Senate filed bills to give Duffy that $30 billion. Neither has any co-sponsors.
paras.zh: 过去几周，众议院和参议院的共和党人提交了法案，要求向达菲拨款 300 亿美元。两者都没有任何共同发起人。

paras.en: Asked if travelers should expect disruptions to their Thanksgiving travel plans, Sean Duffy said he thought flights would be “back up and operational as we come into the heat of travel” ahead of the holiday.
paras.zh: 当被问及旅客是否应该预料到他们的感恩节旅行计划会受到干扰时，肖恩·达菲表示，他认为航班将在假期前“随着我们进入旅行热潮而恢复并运行”。

paras.en: In the aftermath of a frightening air-traffic control technology failure that affected Newark Liberty International Airport in April 2025, Duffy argued that the nation’s air-traffic control systems were outdated and in need of a $12.5 billion upgrade. Tonight he is using the latest technology failure as an argument for another huge increase of funding.
paras.zh: 2025 年 4 月，纽瓦克自由国际机场发生了一次可怕的空中交通管制技术故障，影响了该机场。达菲认为，美国的空中交通管制系统已经过时，需要 125 亿美元进行升级。今晚，他利用最新的技术失败作为再次大幅增加资金的论据。

paras.en: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said that new technology upgrades overloaded the existing, antiquated system, “overwhelming” the existing equipment.
paras.zh: 国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林表示，新技术升级使现有的过时系统超载，“压垮”了现有设备。

paras.en: “It’s going to continue to fail,” Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said of the antiquated technology that the F.A.A. was trying to upgrade, triggering the telecom failures that prompted the nationwide ground stop.
paras.zh: “它会继续失败，”运输部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 谈到美国联邦航空局 (F.A.A.) 所使用的过时技术时说道。试图升级，引发电信故障，导致全国范围内停飞。

paras.en: The question of older F.A.A. systems ceasing to work has been a constant throughout Duffy’s tenure as transportation secretary, going back to disputes he had with Elon Musk about what type of technology could be used for backup systems.
paras.zh: 老联邦航空局的问题在达菲担任交通部长期间，系统停止工作一直是常态，这可以追溯到他与埃隆·马斯克关于哪种类型的技术可以用于备份系统的争论。

paras.en: The Congress that Duffy has been criticizing has been entirely in Republican hands for the last two years. It’s now about to switch to Democratic control.
paras.zh: 达菲一直批评的国会在过去两年里完全掌握在共和党手中。现在即将转向民主党控制。

paras.en: “Our fix gives us a pretty good indication that it was a legacy network problem that went down,” Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said, hinting at the origins of the crisis. He said the problem was related to old equipment being overloaded.
paras.zh: “我们的解决方案给了我们一个很好的迹象，表明这是一个遗留的网络问题，”交通部长肖恩·达菲（Sean Duffy）暗示了危机的根源。他表示，问题与旧设备超载有关。

paras.en: Duffy and Mullin were asked if they could say with “100 percent certainty” that this was not the result of a cyberattack or rogue artificial intelligence. “There’s nothing certain right now,” Mullin said. “It doesn’t appear that way.”
paras.zh: 达菲和穆林被问及是否可以“100%确定”地说这不是网络攻击或流氓人工智能的结果。 “现在还没有什么确定的，”穆林说。 “看来不是这样。”

paras.en: “I want Congress to give us emergency funding,” Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said, calling on lawmakers to give the Trump administration another $30 billion, at least, to pay for further upgrades to air traffic control infrastructure. But some lawmakers have raised questions about how the F.A.A. has managed the funds it has been given thus far.
paras.zh: “我希望国会向我们提供紧急资金，”交通部长肖恩·达菲说，他呼吁议员们至少再给特朗普政府 300 亿美元，用于进一步升级空中交通管制基础设施。但一些立法者对联邦航空管理局如何处理提出了质疑。已管理迄今为止所获得的资金。

paras.en: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the Federal Aviation Administration reopened airspace at 8:15 p.m. Eastern. But he said that flight departures would be slow, and he urged passengers to check with their airlines.
paras.zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 表示，联邦航空管理局于晚上 8 点 15 分重新开放空域。东。但他表示，航班起飞速度会很慢，并敦促乘客向航空公司核实。

paras.en: Speaking at a White House briefing, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said there were limits to how quickly flights could begin moving again tonight. “Hopefully tomorrow, we are going to start to see far better movement,” he said.
paras.zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲在白宫新闻发布会上表示，今晚航班重新开始运行的速度是有限的。 “希望明天，我们将开始看到更好的走势，”他说。

articles.title: John Summit, David Guetta, Alison Wonderland & More to Play College Football Playoff National Championship Weekend
articles.author: Katie Bain

paras.en: The 2027 College Football Playoff National Championship will see two top teams competing on Jan. 25 at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas. Before that, a heavy-hitting lineup of DJs will provide pump-up music before the big game.
paras.zh: 2027 年大学橄榄球季后赛全国锦标赛将于 1 月 25 日在拉斯维加斯忠诚体育场举行，两支顶级球队将展开角逐。在此之前，强大的 DJ 阵容将在大型比赛前提供振奋人心的音乐。

paras.en: This year’s edition of AT&T Playoff Playlist Live – The CFP Music Festival will happen Jan. 23-24 at Las Vegas’ Grand Prix Plaza, located just off the Strip. The night 1 lineup will feature David Guetta, Marshmello, Alison Wonderland, Honeyluv and Girl Math, the duo made up of Nala and VNNSA. On day 2, the lineup will feature John Summit, Fisher, Sofi Tukker, Korolova and DJ Skilah. Doors open at 3 p.m. both days.
paras.zh: 今年的 AT&T Playoff Playlist Live – CFP 音乐节将于 1 月 23 日至 24 日在拉斯维加斯大道附近的大奖赛广场举行。第一晚的阵容包括 David Guetta、Marshmello、Alison Wonderland、Honeyluv 和 Girl Math，这对组合由 Nala 和 VNNSA 组成。第二天的阵容包括 John Summit、Fisher、Sofi Tukker、Korolova 和 DJ Skilah。下午 3 点开门。这两天。

paras.en: Admission to this event is free, with advance registration required. Registration details will be announced via the CFP’s official mobile app at a later date.
paras.zh: 本次活动免费入场，需提前注册。注册详情稍后将通过 CFP 的官方移动应用程序公布。

paras.en: “No city embraces the variety of music genres like Las Vegas,” Ryan Allen Hall, the CFP senior director of public events and sponsorships, says in a statement. “But it’s clear, electronic music is the pulse. From the residencies, nightclubs, dayclubs, lounges, pools and festivals, the city simply does EDM like only a select few in the entire world.
paras.zh: CFP 公共活动和赞助高级总监瑞安·艾伦·霍尔 (Ryan Allen Hall) 在一份声明中表示：“没有哪个城市像拉斯维加斯那样包容多种音乐流派。” “但很明显，电子音乐是脉搏。从驻场、夜总会、日间俱乐部、休息室、游泳池和节日，这座城市的电子舞曲风格在世界上只有少数几个。

paras.en: “But the magic for us is to bring together this stacked lineup in Las Vegas and to charge the fans absolutely nothing,” Hall continues. “It is all part of the CFP’s commitment to providing a world class championship experience to our fans and guests, especially during National Championship week. We curated a lineup specifically for the city of Miami last year and it was the largest concert ever seen on South Beach. A true spectacle. We’re here to do the same for the city of Las Vegas this January.”
paras.zh: “但对我们来说，神奇之处在于将这支阵容聚集在拉斯维加斯，并且完全不向球迷收取任何费用，”霍尔继续说道。 “这都是 CFP 致力于为我们的粉丝和客人提供世界级锦标赛体验的承诺的一部分，特别是在全国锦标赛周期间。去年我们专门为迈阿密市策划了阵容，这是南海滩有史以来规模最大的音乐会。一场真正的盛会。今年一月，我们将为拉斯维加斯市做同样的事情。”

paras.en: The 2027 edition of the event follows this year’s edition, which happened in Miami Beach with artists including Summit, Calvin Harris, Peso Pluma and Latin Mafia performing for a crowd of approximately 50,000.
paras.zh: 继今年的活动之后，2027 年的活动在迈阿密海滩举行，包括 Summit、Calvin Harris、Peso Pluma 和 Latin Mafia 在内的艺术家为大约 50,000 名观众表演。

articles.title: In Canada: Canada Music Fund to Receive $67M Boost; Women in Music Executive Award Winners Share Their Wisdom
articles.author: Chris Eggertsen

paras.en: The Canada Music Fund is getting a new boost from the federal government.
paras.zh: 加拿大音乐基金会得到了联邦政府的新支持。

paras.en: At last night’s ADISQ Gala in Montreal (Nov. 8), the Minister of Canadian Identity and Culture, Marc Miller, announced that the federal government will invest $67 million to the Canada Music Fund, as part of the government’s promised $600 million investment into the cultural sector. The sum was first announced in June to provide “immediate relief” to the country’s audio and audiovisual sector and confirmed for 2026-27 in the latest federal budget, which was tabled last week. Over the weekend, Ottawa gave a long-awaited breakdown of how the funds will be allocated.
paras.zh: 在昨晚（11 月 8 日）蒙特利尔举行的 ADISQ Gala 上，加拿大身份与文化部长 Marc Miller 宣布，联邦政府将向加拿大音乐基金投资 6700 万加元，作为政府承诺向文化部门投资 6 亿加元的一部分。这笔款项于 6 月首次宣布，旨在为该国的视听行业提供“立即救济”，并在上周提交的最新联邦预算中确认了 2026-27 年的金额。周末，渥太华公布了人们期待已久的资金分配细目。

paras.en: The music sector will receive its share of the relief investment through the Canada Music Fund, which was renewed through 2028 last year. The $67 million sum will be distributed to the five organizations that the fund supports, with FACTOR (Foundation Assisting Canadian Talent on Recordings) receiving $31.5 million, Musicaction (which funds and supports Francophone music and music companies) receiving $21 million, the Canadian Starmaker Fund receiving $5.7 million, the RadioStar fund receiving $3.8 million and the Indigenous Music Office (IMO) receiving $5 million.
paras.zh: 音乐行业将通过加拿大音乐基金获得其救助投资份额，该基金于去年续签至 2028 年。 6700万美元的资金将分配给该基金支持的五个组织，其中FACTOR（加拿大唱片人才援助基金会）获得3150万美元，Musicaction（资助和支持法语音乐和音乐公司）获得2100万美元，加拿大造星者基金获得570万美元，RadioStar基金获得380万美元，土著音乐办公室（IMO）获得500万美元。

paras.en: Last November, the IMO released a new national report outlining ways in which the federal government could help Indigenous artists and their music connect with bigger audiences, notably through increased discoverability on streaming platforms. Each of the funds will help support and foster emerging Canadian acts and help them compete on the world stage.
paras.zh: 去年 11 月，国际海事组织发布了一份新的国家报告，概述了联邦政府帮助土著艺术家及其音乐与更多受众建立联系的方式，特别是通过提高流媒体平台的可发现性。每一项基金都将帮助支持和培育新兴的加拿大行为，并帮助他们在世界舞台上竞争。

paras.en: “Canada’s cultural sovereignty depends on our willingness to invest in our own voices,” says Meg Symsyk, president and CEO of FACTOR. “We have extraordinary talent in this country. Our responsibility is to give that talent the opportunity to be heard, to build lasting careers and to reach audiences here at home and around the world. This investment in the Canada Music Fund backs Canadian artists and the independent businesses that help bring their music to life. We thank Prime Minister Carney, Minister Champagne, Minister Miller and the Government of Canada for recognizing that investing in Canadian music is an investment in who we are.”
paras.zh: FACTOR 总裁兼首席执行官 Meg Symsyk 表示：“加拿大的文化主权取决于我们是否愿意投资于自己的声音。” “我们国家拥有非凡的人才。我们的责任是为这些人才提供被倾听的机会，建立持久的职业生涯并接触国内外的观众。加拿大音乐基金的这项投资支持加拿大艺术家和帮助他们将音乐变为现实的独立企业。我们感谢卡尼总理、香槟部长、米勒部长和加拿大政府认识到投资加拿大音乐就是对我们自身的投资。”

paras.en: FACTOR, along with the Indigenous Music Office, CIMA, ADISQ, Bell Media, Spotify and more all participated in CRTC public hearings last year to discuss how to support Canadian Content.
paras.zh: FACTOR与原住民音乐办公室、CIMA、ADISQ、Bell Media、Spotify等机构一起，去年均参加了CRTC的公开听证会，讨论如何支持加拿大本土内容。

paras.en: Now, FACTOR welcomes the government’s investment and highlights how it will support the Canadian music sector.
paras.zh: 现在，FACTOR 欢迎政府的投资，并强调它将如何支持加拿大音乐行业。

paras.en: “Behind every dollar invested in Canadian music are artists taking the next step in their careers and Canadian companies helping them get there,” says Symsyk. “Sustained investment makes it possible to look beyond the next release or tour and build for the future.”
paras.zh: Symsyk 表示：“在加拿大音乐上投入的每一块钱背后都是艺术家在职业生涯中迈出的下一步，以及帮助他们实现这一目标的加拿大公司。” “持续的投资使得我们有可能超越下一个版本或巡演，并为未来而建设。”

paras.en: Several other music organizations across Canada are celebrating the news, with the Canadian Live Music Association (CLMA) saying it is “thrilled to see government recognize the value that music brings to Canada, its businesses, and its communities.” The Canadian Independent Music Association (CIMA) calls the additional funding an “important step toward strengthening the industrial ecosystem that supports the development of great Canadian artists.”
paras.zh: 加拿大各地的其他几个音乐组织都在庆祝这一消息，加拿大现场音乐协会（CLMA）表示，“很高兴看到政府认识到音乐给加拿大、其企业和社区带来的价值。”加拿大独立音乐协会（CIMA）称额外资金是“加强支持加拿大伟大艺术家发展的产业生态系统的重要一步”。

paras.en: “For years, CIMA has argued that the best way to ensure Canadians hear Canadian voices is to build a strong ecosystem of dynamic, globally competitive Canadian music companies serving excellent Canadian artists,” says Andrew Cash, president and CEO of CIMA. “These are the businesses that discover, develop and nurture artists, produce and promote Canadian music, help build audiences and create opportunities for Canadian artists to reach listeners both at home and around the world. This investment is an important commitment, and a clear indication that the government has listened to the music sector.”
paras.zh: CIMA 总裁兼首席执行官安德鲁·卡什 (Andrew Cash) 表示：“多年来，CIMA 一直认为，确保加拿大人听到加拿大声音的最佳方式是建立一个由充满活力、具有全球竞争力的加拿大音乐公司组成的强大生态系统，为优秀的加拿大艺术家提供服务。” “这些企业发现、发展和培养艺术家，制作和推广加拿大音乐，帮助建立观众并为加拿大艺术家创造接触国内外听众的机会。这项投资是一项重要的承诺，清楚地表明政府已经倾听了音乐界的声音。”

paras.en: The federal government’s new investment intends to bring stability to the cultural sector as “longer-term policy, regulatory and market conditions evolve,” such as the Online Streaming Act, whose implementation continues to be the subject of much debate between the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission (CRTC), streaming giants and the United States, which has made the CanCon fund requirements for major foreign-owned streaming services a sticking point in trade negotiations.
paras.zh: 联邦政府的新投资旨在随着“长期政策、监管和市场条件的变化”为文化部门带来稳定，例如《在线流媒体法案》，该法案的实施仍然是加拿大广播电视和电信委员会（CRTC）、流媒体巨头和美国之间争论的焦点，这使得 CanCon 对主要外资流媒体服务的资金要求成为贸易谈判的症结所在。

paras.en: Billboard Canada Women In Music Executive Award Winners Share Their Wisdom
paras.zh: 《公告牌》加拿大“音乐界女性”执行奖获奖者分享她们的智慧

paras.en: The live music sector is thriving more than ever in Canada. In her role as chief commercial officer of Live Nation Canada, Melissa Bubb-Clarke is helping it soar towards new heights.
paras.zh: 加拿大的现场音乐行业比以往任何时候都更加繁荣。作为 Live Nation Canada 的首席商务官，Melissa Bubb-Clarke 正在帮助该公司飞向新的高度。

paras.en: On Nov. 24, she will accept the Executive of the Year Award at Billboard Canada Women In Music, recognizing the important work she does behind the scenes, helping Canada’s live music giant scale its operations amid a rapidly growing industry, through collaborating and partnering with corporate brands.
paras.zh: 11 月 24 日，她将接受 Billboard Canada Women In Music 颁发的年度高管奖，以表彰她在幕后所做的重要工作，通过与企业品牌的合作和合作，帮助加拿大现场音乐巨头在快速发展的行业中扩大业务。

paras.en: The market leader in the country, Live Nation Canada has seen record success and revenue figures over the last few years, but in many ways Bubb-Clarke and the team she works with are just laying the foundation for an even bigger future.
paras.zh: 作为该国的市场领导者，Live Nation Canada 在过去几年中取得了创纪录的成功和收入数字，但在许多方面，Bubb-Clarke 和她合作的团队只是为更广阔的未来奠定了基础。

paras.en: In its second season this summer, the 50,000-capacity Rogers Stadium welcomed a new record number of 20 concerts to Toronto, drawing record-setting tours by headliners like Bruno Mars, BTS, Karol G and more. RBC Amphitheatre also kicked off its first season under its new name and partnership with RBC, which arrived alongside plans to become a year-round venue by 2030. There are more A-list artists coming to town than ever, but beyond welcoming shows, Bubb-Clarke is vying to create venues that offer an optimal experience for not just the artists playing them, but also the fans coming to see their favourite artist.
paras.zh: 在今年夏天的第二个演出季中，可容纳 50,000 人的罗杰斯体育场 (Rogers Stadium) 在多伦多举办了 20 场音乐会，创下了新纪录，吸引了布鲁诺·马尔斯 (Bruno Mars)、防弹少年团 (BTS)、卡罗尔·G (Karol G) 等顶级明星的巡演，创下了纪录。 RBC 露天剧场也以新名称和与 RBC 的合作拉开了第一季的序幕，该剧场还计划到 2030 年成为全年开放的场馆。来到小镇的一线艺术家比以往任何时候都多，但除了欢迎演出之外，Bubb-Clarke 还力争打造场馆，不仅为演出的艺术家提供最佳体验，还为前来观看他们喜爱的艺术家的粉丝提供最佳体验。

paras.en: Preparing to accept the Billboard Canada Executive of the Year Award has given Bubb-Clarke the opportunity to reflect on the major strides she and her team have been making in the live music landscape over the past several years.
paras.zh: 准备接受加拿大公告牌年度最佳执行官奖让巴布-克拉克有机会反思她和她的团队过去几年在现场音乐领域取得的重大进步。

paras.en: In an interview with Billboard Canada, Bubb-Clarke compares music to her work in sports at her previous company Maple Leafs Sports & Entertainment (MLSE), which owns the Toronto Maple Leafs and Toronto Raptors.
paras.zh: 在接受加拿大公告牌采访时，巴布-克拉克将音乐与她之前在枫叶体育娱乐公司 (MLSE) 的体育工作进行了比较，该公司拥有多伦多枫叶队和多伦多猛龙队。

paras.en: “I can give you a million reasons why I think music is as much of a compelling offering, if not more, than sports. There are more concerts at Scotiabank Arena than there are [Maple] Leafs and Raptors games combined. From a demographic standpoint, we’re serving everything to everybody with our 4,000+ shows that we do across Canada here with Live Nation. We do every demographic, every age group, all sorts of styles of music, I think we are super fan-friendly in that way.”
paras.zh: “我可以给你一百万个理由来解释为什么我认为音乐与体育一样引人注目，甚至更多。丰业银行体育场的音乐会比枫叶队和猛龙队的比赛加起来还要多。从人口统计的角度来看，我们通过 Live Nation 在加拿大各地举办的 4,000 多场演出，为每个人提供一切服务。我们为每个人群、每个年龄段、各种风格的音乐提供服务，我认为我们对粉丝非常友好方式。”

paras.en: “I think we have been able to understand what the fans have come to get, what they have been able to experience at a sports venue. They’re looking for a similar experience at a show. They want to be able to have nice food and go to a specific place post-show or pre-show and have a great overall experience.”
paras.zh: “我认为我们已经能够了解球迷来到这里想要得到什么，他们在体育场馆能够体验到什么。他们正在寻找在演出中类似的体验。他们希望能够在演出后或演出前享用美味的食物并前往特定的地方，并获得良好的整体体验。”

paras.en: In her dual role as the president of MusiCounts and the chief operating officer of CARAS, the organization behind the Juno Awards and the Canadian Music Hall of Fame, Kristy Fletcher influences every stage of a Canadian musician’s career.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂·弗莱彻 (Kristy Fletcher) 身兼 MusiCounts 总裁和 CARAS（朱诺奖和加拿大音乐名人堂背后的组织）首席运营官的双重角色，影响着加拿大音乐家职业生涯的每个阶段。

paras.en: Through music education charity MusiCounts, she’s there at the beginning, providing access to instruments and musical education to give youth a chance to make music in the first place. At CARAS, she’s able to foster and develop the industry and recognize artists at the Juno Awards. That continues all the way until the later stages of their career, when they become Hall of Famers.
paras.zh: 通过音乐教育慈善机构 MusiCounts，她从一开始就提供乐器和音乐教育的机会，让年轻人有机会创作音乐。在 CARAS，她能够培育和发展这个行业，并在朱诺奖上表彰艺术家。这种情况一直持续到他们职业生涯的后期，当他们成为名人堂成员时。

paras.en: On Nov. 24, Fletcher will accept the Impact Award at Billboard Canada Women In Music, recognizing the important work she does affecting musicians both onstage and in classrooms, from Rush’s surprise comeback performance at the 2026 Juno Awards to young students who might be Canada’s next breakthrough rock stars.
paras.zh: 11 月 24 日，弗莱彻将在加拿大公告牌音乐女性颁奖典礼上接受影响力奖，以表彰她在舞台上和课堂上所做的重要工作，从拉什在 2026 年朱诺奖上令人惊讶的复出表演到可能成为加拿大下一个突破性摇滚明星的年轻学生。

paras.en: This year, MusiCounts announced a $1.4 million donation to support music education in Canadian schools, the biggest investment in the company’s history. Through the MusiCounts School Music Funding Programs, 96 schools across the country will receive support for their music programs amid increasing budget cuts and deficits in Ontario and throughout Canada.
paras.zh: 今年，MusiCounts 宣布捐赠 140 万美元，支持加拿大学校的音乐教育，这是该公司历史上最大的一笔投资。在安大略省和整个加拿大预算削减和赤字不断增加的情况下，通过 MusiCounts 学校音乐资助计划，全国 96 所学校的音乐项目将获得支持。

paras.en: “Music is such a foundational and fundamental part of development and growth for kids,” Fletcher says. “Think of all of the incredible benefits that music has on kids. It’s a way to sort out their emotions or express their feelings and thoughts, and it can improve mental health among youth. We have seen so many studies [showing how] music supports strong and healthy mental health, and develops positive self-esteem. There are studies showing improved cognitive abilities with playing music.
paras.zh: “音乐是孩子们发展和成长的基础和根本组成部分，”弗莱彻说。 “想想音乐对孩子们带来的所有令人难以置信的好处。它是一种整理他们的情绪或表达他们的感受和想法的方式，它可以改善青少年的心理健康。我们已经看到很多研究[表明]音乐如何支持强大和健康的心理健康，并培养积极的自尊。有研究表明演奏音乐可以提高认知能力。

paras.en: “MusiCounts has to be there to help fill in some of those gaps, and the gaps do grow. We’ve been doing this work for almost 30 years and we’ve allocated over $22 million to schools and community programs across the country. You would think we would maybe be nearing the end of the work we have to do, and that’s just not the case. We’re just scratching the surface. But that has allowed us to increase our programming.”
paras.zh: “MusiCounts 必须帮助填补其中一些空白，而这些空白确实在不断扩大。我们从事这项工作已近 30 年，已为全国各地的学校和社区项目拨款超过 2200 万美元。你可能会认为我们可能即将完成我们必须做的工作，但事实并非如此。我们只是触及了表面。但这使我们能够增加我们的项目。”

paras.en: Read the full interview here. — Richard Trapunski
paras.zh: 在这里阅读完整的采访。 — 理查德·特拉彭斯基

paras.en: Sean Paul Stars in First Episode of Billboard Canada News
paras.zh: 肖恩·保罗 (Sean Paul) 主演《加拿大公告牌》第一集新闻

paras.en: “Canada has influenced my music in many ways,” says Sean Paul.
paras.zh: “加拿大在很多方面影响了我的音乐，”肖恩·保罗说。

paras.en: The Jamaican star is the subject of the first episode of Billboard Canada News, live now.
paras.zh: 这位牙买加明星是《加拿大公告牌新闻》第一集的主题，目前正在直播。

paras.en: In a revealing half-hour interview hosted by Alicia West, Paul talks about the important role that Canada played in his come-up. He guested on the Baby Blue Sound Crew song “Money Jane” with Toronto hip-hop and R&B heroes Kardinal Offishall and Jully Black.
paras.zh: 在艾丽西亚·韦斯特 (Alicia West) 主持的半小时采访中，保罗谈到了加拿大在他的演讲中所扮演的重要角色。他与多伦多嘻哈和 R&B 英雄卡迪纳尔·奥菲舍尔 (Kardinal Offishall) 和朱莉·布莱克 (Jully Black) 一起客串了 Baby Blue Sound Crew 的歌曲《Money Jane》。

paras.en: “I was just telling somebody last night. They asked me who was the first person to put you on, give you a collab? And I said Kardi. Kardi Offishall,” he says. “First person to pay me, first person to put me on a track, I always say.”
paras.zh: “我昨晚刚刚告诉别人。他们问我谁是第一个给你穿上衣服、给你合作的人？我说卡迪。卡迪奥菲舍尔，”他说。 “我总是这么说，第一个付钱给我的人，第一个让我走上正轨的人。”

paras.en: He also talks about shooting important breakthrough music videos “Gimme The Light” and “Get Busy” with Canadian director Director X (then Little X) and dancer/choreographer Tanisha Scott, both longtime collaborators. His connection goes back even further, with his grandfather living in Scarborough, Ontario when he was young.
paras.zh: 他还谈到了与加拿大导演Director X（当时的Little X）和舞蹈家/编舞Tanisha Scott（两人都是长期合作者）拍摄重要的突破性音乐视频“Gimme The Light”和“Get Busy”。他的联系可以追溯到更早的时候，他的祖父年轻时住在安大略省斯卡伯勒。

paras.en: It’s a wide-ranging conversation about his whole career, from his biggest chart hits to his collaborations with major pop stars like Rihanna and Sia. He also talks about his support of Jamaica following Hurricane Melissa.
paras.zh: 这是关于他整个职业生涯的广泛讨论，从他最热门的排行榜到他与 Rihanna 和 Sia 等主要流行歌星的合作。他还谈到了梅丽莎飓风过后对牙买加的支持。

paras.en: Watch the full interview on Billboard Canada News below. — Richard Trapunski
paras.zh: 请观看下面加拿大公告牌新闻的完整采访。 — 理查德·特拉彭斯基

articles.title: Journey Drummer Deen Castronovo Exits Mid-Tour to Focus on His Health
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Journey drummer Deen Castronovo is stepping away from the band’s farewell tour to deal with his health, the group announced Friday (Nov. 13).
paras.zh: 周五（11 月 13 日），Journey 乐队宣布，由于健康原因，Journey 鼓手 Deen Castronovo 将退出乐队的告别巡演。

paras.en: “After careful consideration and an extensive year of touring, our talented, longtime drummer Deen Castronovo has decided to step away to focus on personal health matters that require his attention,” the band said in a statement. “He has our full support during this time and extends his heartfelt thanks to the fans for the love, encouragement, and kindness he has received.”
paras.zh: 乐队在一份声明中表示：“经过仔细考虑和一年的广泛巡演，我们才华横溢的长期鼓手迪恩·卡斯特罗诺沃决定离开，专注于需要他关注的个人健康问题。” “这段时间他得到了我们的全力支持，并对粉丝们的爱、鼓励和善意表示衷心的感谢。”

paras.en: Steve Murphy will take over for the remainder of November. The New York drummer has previously worked with the Alan Parsons Project, Trans-Siberian Orchestra, Christopher Cross and Jack Bruce.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·墨菲 (Steve Murphy) 将在 11 月剩余时间里接任。这位纽约鼓手此前曾与艾伦·帕森斯计划、跨西伯利亚管弦乐团、克里斯托弗·克罗斯和杰克·布鲁斯合作过。

paras.en: The announcement follows a scare last month, when Castronovo was helped offstage and taken to hospital after two songs at Tulsa’s BOK Center on Oct. 8. He returned two nights later for a full show in San Antonio, and guitarist Neal Schon said at the time that he was “back in rare form.” Neither the band nor Castronovo has disclosed details of the illness.
paras.zh: 上个月，卡斯特罗诺沃在塔尔萨的 BOK 中心演唱了两首歌后，被搀扶下台并被送往医院。两天后，他在圣安东尼奥举行了一场完整的演出，吉他手尼尔·舍恩 (Neal Schon) 当时表示，他“以罕见的状态回归”。乐队和卡斯特罗诺沃都没有透露患病的细节。

paras.en: Castronovo, 62, first joined Journey in 1998, replacing Steve Smith, and played on five albums before leaving in 2015. He returned in 2021, initially alongside Narada Michael Walden, and became the sole drummer after Walden’s 2022 departure. He also sings, occasionally taking lead vocals, and has played with Bad English, Hardline and Ozzy Osbourne.
paras.zh: 现年 62 岁的卡斯特罗诺沃于 1998 年首次加入 Journey，接替史蒂夫·史密斯 (Steve Smith)，并在 2015 年离开之前演奏了五张专辑。他于 2021 年回归，最初与纳拉达·迈克尔·瓦尔登 (Narada Michael Walden) 并肩作战，并在瓦尔登 2022 年离开后成为唯一的鼓手。 He also sings, occasionally taking lead vocals, and has played with Bad English, Hardline and Ozzy Osbourne.

paras.en: His exit comes near the end of a long year on the road. The Final Frontier tour, promoted by AEG Presents, launched Feb. 28 in Hershey, Pa., with an initial 60 North American dates, before the band added 40 more for the fall. The current leg began Sept. 12 in Los Angeles. Keyboardist Jonathan Cain has said the run marks his own farewell chapter with the band, which also features founder Neal Schon, singer Arnel Pineda, keyboardist Jason Derlatka and bassist Todd Jensen.
paras.zh: His exit comes near the end of a long year on the road.由 AEG Presents 推广的 Final Frontier 巡演于 2 月 28 日在宾夕法尼亚州好时推出，最初在北美举行了 60 场演出，之后乐队在秋季又增加了 40 场演出。当前赛段于 9 月 12 日在洛杉矶开始。键盘手乔纳森·凯恩表示，这次演出标志着他自己与乐队的告别篇章，该乐队的其他成员还有创始人尼尔·舍恩、歌手阿内尔·皮内达、键盘手杰森·德拉特卡和贝斯手托德·詹森。

paras.en: The tour continues Saturday (Nov. 14) at Bon Secours Wellness Arena in Greenville, S.C., and wraps Nov. 28 at San Francisco’s Chase Center.
paras.zh: 巡演将于11月14日（星期六）在南卡罗来纳州格林维尔的Bon Secours Wellness Arena继续进行，并于11月28日在旧金山的Chase Center落下帷幕。

paras.en: Journey’s commercial peak came with 1981’s Escape, the band’s only No. 1 album on the Billboard 200. It produced four Hot 100 hits, including “Open Arms,” their highest-charting single at No. 2, “Who’s Crying Now” at No. 4 and “Don’t Stop Believin’” at No. 9 — a song that long outlasted its chart run to become the band’s signature.
paras.zh: Journey 的商业巅峰是 1981 年的《Escape》，这是乐队唯一一张在 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第一的专辑。它产生了四首热门 100 热门单曲，其中包括排名第二的单曲“Open Arms”、排名第四的“Who’s Crying Now”和排名第九的“Don’t Stop Believin’”——这首歌曲在排行榜上的表现很长时间，成为乐队的招牌歌曲。

articles.title: 5 Takeaways From China’s Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival
articles.author: Mathew Scott

paras.en: China celebrated its Golden Rooster Awards this past Tuesday night in a glittering ceremony hosted inside the palatial Xiamen Strait Grand Theater in Xiamen, Fujian Province, China.
paras.zh: 上周二晚，中国在中国福建省厦门市富丽堂皇的厦门海峡大剧院举行了盛大的金鸡奖颁奖典礼。

paras.en: The southern seaside city hosted generations of stars — from current hotshot Jackson Yee (Resurrection) to acclaimed auteur Zhang Yimou — for an event that is the highlight of the annual state-run Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival.
paras.zh: 这座南部海滨城市接待了一代又一代的明星——从当前炙手可热的易烊千玺（《复活》）到著名导演张艺谋——参加的活动是一年一度的国营金鸡百花电影节的重头戏。

paras.en: Hong Kong’s Tony Leung Ka Fai stole the show, winning his first Golden Rooster best actor nod for his turn as the villain in the Larry Yang-directed thriller The Shadow’s Edge — some 25 years on from sending hearts a flutter across the globe in Jean-Jacques Annaud’s steamy The Lover.
paras.zh: 香港演员梁家辉大出风头，凭借在杨致远执导的惊悚片《影锋》中饰演反派角色，首次获得金鸡奖最佳男主角奖——大约 25 年前，他在让-雅克·阿诺执导的热血沸腾的《情人》中让全球人心颤动。

paras.en: “I hope this is just the beginning of new journey,” said the veteran of more than 140 movies.
paras.zh: “我希望这只是新旅程的开始。”这位拍过140多部电影的老手说道。

paras.en: Behind the scenes the business of making movies was very much front and center, as the Chinese industry gathered for seminars and workshops it hopes will chart its future course.
paras.zh: 在幕后，电影制作业务占据了非常重要的位置，中国电影业齐聚一堂，举办研讨会和讲习班，希望能够规划未来的发展方向。

paras.en: Here’s what The Hollywood Reporter learned from the week:
paras.zh: 以下是《好莱坞报道》从本周了解到的情况：

paras.en: Yimou Urges Filmmakers to Stay Focused on the Story
paras.zh: 艺谋敦促电影制片人专注于故事

paras.en: Zhang Yimou brought a sense of gravitas to proceedings across the week. The 76-year-old was there among all the fanfare at the event’s Golden Rooster Awards, handing out the Best Feature Film award to director Shen Ao and his WW2 drama Dead to Rights while also mingling with all the stars and watching on — in awe, like everyone in the room — as a massive dragon drone cruised the air overhead.
paras.zh: 张艺谋给本周的活动带来了一种庄重感。这位 76 岁的老人出席了金鸡奖颁奖典礼，为导演沉翱和他的二战题材影片《捍卫权利》颁发了最佳故事片奖，同时也与所有明星混在一起，像房间里的每个人一样，怀着敬畏的心情观看一架巨大的龙式无人机在上空巡航。

paras.en: Yimou had also helped launch the industry side of proceedings with a “Stories That Travel: Chinese and Asian Cinema in Dialogue with the World” seminar that gathered reps from international festivals and, soon enough, saw talk turn to Artificial Intelligence and its effect on cinema.
paras.zh: 艺谋还帮助启动了“旅行的故事：与世界对话的中国和亚洲电影”研讨会，该研讨会聚集了来自国际电影节的代表，很快，话题就转向了人工智能及其对电影的影响。

paras.en: With Zhang’s adaptation of Liu Cixin sci-fi classic The Three-Body Problem in the works the director revealed he’d started to dabble in the tech, with a dedicated team set up on set to explore how AI could be adapted to the filmmaking process.
paras.zh: 随着张对刘慈欣科幻经典作品《三体》的改编，导演透露他已经开始涉足这项技术，并在片场成立了一个专门的团队来探索人工智能如何适应电影制作过程。

paras.en: In his own inimitable way, the director then set the scene for the week ahead when he urged his fellow filmmakers to do the same — but to never lose site of the main ingredient: The story.
paras.zh: 导演以他自己独特的方式为接下来的一周设定了场景，他敦促其他电影制作人也这样做——但永远不要失去主要成分的位置：故事。

paras.en: “The new technology is moving too fast,” the director said. “The moment you blink, you are behind it. So, embrace this era. But for me filmmaking is about the story that’s in my heart, and the only thing I can do is to tell it the best way I can.”
paras.zh: “新技术发展得太快了，”导演说。 “当你眨眼的那一刻，你就落后了。所以，拥抱这个时代。但对我来说，电影制作是关于我内心的故事，我唯一能做的就是用最好的方式讲述它。”

paras.en: Star-Studded Golden Roosters Celebrate a Big Year for the Locals
paras.zh: 星光熠熠的金鸡为当地人庆祝大年

paras.en: The news coming into the week was that so far this year Chinese cinemas have been dominated by Chinese movies, with eight of the year’s box office top 10 being domestic productions.
paras.zh: 本周传来的消息是，今年到目前为止，中国影院一直以中国电影为主，今年票房前十名中有八部是国产影片。

paras.en: The industry itself has been big on spreading a message of diversification of content, and to that end the two films that dominated “China’s Oscars” could not possibly be more different in either style nor in content.
paras.zh: 电影行业本身一直大力传播内容多元化的信息，为此，两部主宰“中国奥斯卡”的电影在风格和内容上都截然不同。

paras.en: Shen’s Dead to Rights — with Golden Rooster Best Actress winner Gao Ye shining — collected more than $380 million and sets itself around the infamous Nanjing massacre and the real-life story of the photo studio that documented the horror. It’s a gripping often brutal tale — and features two of China’s most bankable stars in Gao and Liu Haoran (Detective Chinatown).
paras.zh: 沈氏执导的《捍卫权利》——由金鸡奖最佳女主角得主高野领衔主演——票房收入超过 3.8 亿美元，故事围绕臭名昭著的南京大屠杀以及记录恐怖事件的照相馆的真实故事展开。这是一个扣人心弦且往往残酷的故事，主角是中国最卖座的两位明星高和刘昊然（《唐人街探案》）。

paras.en: Lan Hongchun’s Dear You — winner of both Special Jury Prize and Best Screenplay — collected around $300 million and sets itself around the story of one of the thousands of migrant Chinese families separated through economic necessity in the 1950s and ’60s. It’s a languid tear-jerker, and it stars a cast of complete unknowns.
paras.zh: 蓝鸿春的《亲爱的你》荣获评审团特别奖和最佳剧本奖，票房收入约 3 亿美元，讲述了 20 世纪 50 年代和 60 年代因经济困难而离散的数千个中国移民家庭中的一个的故事。这是一部催人泪下的影片，主演阵容完全不为人知。

paras.en: Dear You was the surprise hit of the year in China and it reached an enthusiastic global audience. Lan was beside himself on stage. “It feels like I’m dreaming,” he said. “I want to thank my grandma in heaven, because she told me so many stories when I was little.”
paras.zh: 《亲爱的你》是中国年度出人意料的热门影片，并吸引了全球热情的观众。兰在台上欣喜若狂。 “感觉就像我在做梦一样，”他说。 “我要感谢天上的奶奶，因为她给我讲了很多小时候的故事。”

paras.en: Opening night under the stars at the Bailuzhou Park Water Square in Xiamen was a treat for the young families who packed the venue for the China debut of another film that speaks to the Chinese diaspora and — the filmmakers hope — will to the domestic audience too.
paras.zh: 在厦门白鹭洲公园水广场的星空下的首映之夜，对年轻家庭来说是一场盛宴，他们挤满了场地，观看另一部面向华人侨民的电影的中国首映，电影制片人希望这部电影也能面向国内观众。

paras.en: The Singapore-Spain-Italy production The Violinist has already won best film at the 2026 Annecy International Animation Film Festival and best animated film at the 19th Asia Pacific Screen Awards. Set among the Chinese community, it follows the fortunes of two childhood friends separated by war, and it had the audience, including all those kids, transfixed.
paras.zh: 新加坡、西班牙、意大利联合制作的《小提琴家》已荣获 2026 年安纳西国际动画电影节最佳影片和第 19 届亚太电影奖最佳动画电影。该剧以华人社区为背景，讲述了两个因战争而分离的儿时好友的命运，让包括所有孩子在内的观众都惊呆了。

paras.en: “Singapore’s animation industry is very small, and the country is small too. So, with a production of this scale, one person can’t do it alone,” co-director Ervin Han explained. “We started by looking overseas for co-producers. As it happened, we had a lot of friends in the animation industry. So, all together, we’re telling a story about a part of the history of us Singaporean Chinese.”
paras.zh: “新加坡的动画产业很小，国家也很小。因此，这种规模的制作，一个人无法独自完成，”联合导演欧文·韩解释道。 “我们首先在海外寻找联合制片人。碰巧，我们在动画行业有很多朋友。所以，我们一起讲述一个关于我们新加坡华人历史的故事。”

paras.en: Producer Cristiano Bortone also took to the stage before the premiere and picked up on what was one of the central themes of this year’s festival: sharing Chinese stories with the world. Bortone The Violinist “delves deeply into Chinese and Asian culture, while also capturing a European style and sensibility.”
paras.zh: 制片人克里斯蒂亚诺·博通（Cristiano Bortone）也在首映前走上舞台，讲述了今年电影节的中心主题之一：与世界分享中国故事。小提琴家博通“深入研究中国和亚洲文化，同时也捕捉欧洲风格和情感。”

paras.en: “This is the beauty of blending our cultures,” he added.
paras.zh: “这就是我们文化融合的美妙之处，”他补充道。

paras.en: China’s next generation was out in force across the industry events, and they basically filled the room at the “Golden Rooster Film Academy II: Ark Lab AI” workshop.
paras.zh: 中国下一代在各行业盛会上纷纷出动，“金鸡电影学院II：方舟实验室AI”研讨会基本座无虚席。

paras.en: Lan Tian, the creative director behind joint-generation AI model Seedance 2.5, took the room and didn’t shy away from exploring its impact in what turned into a candid discussion about how the technology was already impacting the film industry.
paras.zh: 联合代人工智能模型 Seedance 2.5 背后的创意总监蓝天在会议室中毫不回避地探讨了其影响，并就该技术如何影响电影业进行了坦诚的讨论。

paras.en: The AI industry has been embraced in China arguably like anywhere else, and already has an estimated worth of around $176 billion, while the short-drama and digital film market is expected to top $6 billion this year. The pitch from Lan was on the savings the new tech can provide.
paras.zh: 人工智能产业在中国可以说像其他地方一样受到欢迎，估计价值已达到约 1760 亿美元，而短片戏剧和数字电影市场今年预计将突破 60 亿美元。 Lan 的演讲重点是新技术可以节省成本。

paras.en: “If you get an investment of one million, or less than one million you might be able to produce something that looks like it cost 10 million,” he said.
paras.zh: “如果你获得一百万的投资，或者少于一百万，你可能能够生产出看起来花费一千万的东西，”他说。

paras.en: But Lan’s push was also to use his technology as a tool that supports “reality.”
paras.zh: 但兰的努力还在于利用他的技术作为支持“现实”的工具。

paras.en: “My girlfriend is an actor so I know there is concern,” he said. “The creative approach I’m talking about may only require a studio and some props that interact with the actors. But I want this prop to be real, too. For instance, if I need to drink water, I want the water to be real.”
paras.zh: “我的女朋友是一名演员，所以我知道有人担心，”他说。 “我所说的创作方法可能只需要一个工作室和一些与演员互动的道具。但我也希望这个道具是真实的。比如，如果我需要喝水，我希望水是真实的。”

paras.en: Festival Spotlight Turns to Young Filmmakers
paras.zh: 电影节的焦点转向年轻电影制片人

paras.en: While AI dominated proceedings, it was encouraging to see young filmmakers committed to the traditions of cinema out and about.
paras.zh: 虽然人工智能主导了整个过程，但看到年轻的电影制作人致力于电影传统还是令人鼓舞的。

paras.en: Yan Siyu was among those featured during pitching sessions that placed emerging talent in front of international festival and studio reps. Her debut Outside The Room of My Own focusses on the journey three generation of women who take back to their ancestral village, and she echoed the words of Zhang that had opened the whole week.
paras.zh: 严思雨是在推介会上亮相的人物之一，这些推介会将新兴人才展示在国际电影节和工作室代表面前。她的处女作《在自己的房间外》聚焦于三代女性重返故乡的旅程，她呼应了整周开场的张的话。

paras.en: “I want to reach out to people to let them know there is this film in China. It’s a female director’s debut and I can say it’s a really good film,” she said. “This film is not just my work, because I have a lot of people supporting me. I can’t let them down. It’s a story that comes from my heart — and in telling it I am sharing my deepest feelings.”
paras.zh: “我想接触到人们，让他们知道中国有这部电影。这是一位女导演的处女作，我可以说这是一部非常好的电影，”她说。 “这部电影不仅仅是我的作品，因为有很多人支持我。我不能让他们失望。这是一个来自我内心的故事——在讲述它的过程中，我正在分享我最深的感受。”

articles.title: ‘Cookie Queens’ Director Says Girl Scout Cookies Were “A Delicious Way In” to a Larger Conversation (Video)
articles.author: Scott Feinberg

paras.en: In late October, Nahmias brought the film to the SCAD Savannah Film Festival, where it screened in the fest’s celebrated Docs to Watch sidebar — followed by a Q&A that you can watch below — and during which she was also one 10 directors of outstanding 2026 docs who appeared on the fest’s Doc to Watch Panel, moderated by yours truly.
paras.zh: 10 月下旬，纳米亚斯将这部电影带到了 SCAD 萨凡纳电影节，并在该电影节著名的“值得观看的文档”侧边栏放映，随后您可以在下面观看问答，在此期间，她也是 2026 年杰出纪录片的 10 名导演之一，并出现在该电影节的“值得观看的文档”面板上，由您真正主持。

paras.en: Nahmias met with Girl Scouts of the USA, but ultimately decided to make a film independent of the nation youth organization that oversees Girl Scouts (and, incidentally, was founded back in 1912 in, of all places, Savannah, Georgia). She set out to “cast” her film with girls representing a diversity of racial and ethnic demographics, economic backgrounds, and geography, ultimately finding seven whose families would consent to her filming them over the course of a six-month stretch, during which Nahmias and her team constantly traversed the country chronicling them.
paras.zh: 纳米亚斯会见了美国女童子军，但最终决定制作一部独立于负责监督女童子军的国家青年组织（顺便说一句，该组织于 1912 年在佐治亚州萨凡纳成立）的电影。她开始让代表不同种族和民族人口、经济背景和地理位置的女孩“选角”她的电影，最终找到了七个女孩，她们的家人同意她在六个月的时间里拍摄她们，在此期间，纳米亚斯和她的团队不断走遍全国，记录她们的情况。

paras.en: Stylistically, Nahmias was as inspired by scripted projects about childhood, such as The Florida Project, Moonrise Kingdom and Petit Maman, as she was by documentaries, like Salesman, Spellbound and Boys State. One big takeaway: she always shot from the kids’ POVs. In the end, Nahmias decided to cut out the stories of three girls and focus the film on four: Olive, a smooth-talking go-getter who has something of a tiger mom; Nikki, who dreams of being as cool as her older sisters; Shannon Elizabeth, the sweet child of a financially-strapped couple; and Ara, a diabetic with a bright-eyed view of the world.
paras.zh: 从风格上来说，纳米亚斯受到了《佛罗里达计划》、《月出王国》和《小妈妈》等关于童年的剧本项目的启发，也受到了《推销员》、《着迷》和《男孩州》等纪录片的启发。一大收获：她总是从孩子们的视角进行拍摄。最后，纳米亚斯决定剪掉三个女孩的故事，把电影的重点放在四个女孩身上：奥利弗，一个能言善辩、有虎妈气质的人；尼基，梦想着像她的姐姐们一样酷；香农·伊丽莎白 (Shannon Elizabeth)，一对经济拮据的夫妇的可爱孩子；阿拉是一名糖尿病患者，但她对世界有着敏锐的洞察力。

paras.en: Some might assume that the film is a competition doc in which the girls ultimately cross paths, but in fact, they never met until after the film was locked. “I was never interested in how many boxes the girls sold,” Nahmias emphasizes. “I was always interested in their inner journeys.”
paras.zh: 有些人可能会认为这部电影是一部竞赛纪录片，女孩们最终在其中相遇，但事实上，直到电影锁定后她们才相遇。 “我从来不关心女孩们卖了多少盒，”纳米亚斯强调说。 “我一直对他们的内心旅程感兴趣。”

articles.title: Modern Fairy Tale ‘Mo Amor’ Explores Identity, Transformation and Love in All Its Forms
articles.author: Georg Szalai

paras.en: Once upon a time… Princess Niina lived in her castle. She was courted by three suitors: The Mentor, The Writer and The Stonemason. This is, more or less, how the film Mo Amor, a tender, modern and very timely Estonian fairy tale about love in all its forms and identity, begins. And it is about to get its world premiere at the 30th edition of the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF).
paras.zh: 从前……尼娜公主住在她的城堡里。她受到了三位追求者的追求：导师、作家和石匠。这或多或少就是电影《Mo Amor》的开始，这是一部温柔、现代、非常及时的爱沙尼亚童话故事，讲述了各种形式和身份的爱情。该片即将在第 30 届塔林黑夜电影节 (PÖFF) 上进行全球首映。

paras.en: Writer-director Eeva Mägi (Mo Mamma, Mo Papa, The Weight of All the Beauty) and her creative collaborators present a cinematic story told by a photographer named Kaur. “Princess Niina is adored by three suitors, yet remains restless, searching for something she cannot quite name,” teases a synopsis on the PÖFF website. “Then she sheds her crown and reveals her true self. Inviting her former lovers to a secluded summer home, the stage is set for a strange reunion where memory, myth, and reality begin to intertwine, old wounds resurface, and love takes unexpected forms.”
paras.zh: 编剧兼导演 Eeva Mägi（《Mo Mamma》、《Mo Papa》、《美丽的重量》）和她的创意合作者呈现了一个由摄影师 Kaur 讲述的电影故事。 “尼娜公主受到三位追求者的崇拜，但她仍然焦躁不安，寻找着她无法说出名字的东西，”PÖFF 网站上的一个梗概说道。 “然后她摘下了王冠，展现了真实的自我。邀请她以前的恋人来到一个僻静的避暑别墅，一场奇怪的重聚舞台即将拉开，记忆、神话和现实开始交织在一起，旧伤重新浮现，爱情也以意想不到的形式出现。”

paras.en: Mo Amor gets its world premiere on Monday, Nov. 16, in the Critics’ Picks Competition of the festival. Mägi’s previous film, Mo Papa, opened Tallinn’s Critics’ Picks section last year and earned a special mention.
paras.zh: 《Mo Amor》将于 11 月 16 日星期一在电影节的评论家评选比赛中进行全球首映。 Mägi 的上一部电影《Mo Papa》去年在塔林影评人精选部分揭幕，并获得了特别提及。

paras.en: Mägi wrote and directed the film and produced it with Sten-Johan Lill, who also handled the cinematography. The editor was Jette Keedus. The cast features Mo Papa stars Ester Kuntu and Jarmo Reha, one of this year’s 10 rising stars in Tallinn’s Black Nights Stars showcase, as well as Tambet Tuisk, Andres Mähar, Sander Roosimägi and Ivor Mikker.
paras.zh: 马吉自编自导了这部电影，并与斯坦-约翰·李尔 (Sten-Johan Lill) 共同制作，后者还负责摄影。编辑是杰特·基杜斯 (Jette Keedus)。演员阵容包括《Mo Papa》主演 Ester Kuntu 和 Jarmo Reha（今年塔林 Black Nights Stars 展示会上的 10 位冉冉升起的新星之一），以及 Tambet Tuisk、Andres Mähar、Sander Roosimägi 和 Ivor Mikker。

paras.en: Ahead of the film’s Tallinn world premiere, Mägi talked to THR about the inspiration for the film, how identity is used in political rhetoric and the lyrical quality of Mo Amor.
paras.zh: 在电影塔林全球首映之前，Mägi 与 THR 谈论了电影的灵感、政治言论中如何使用身份以及《Mo Amor》的抒情品质。

paras.en: “I always have personal stories intertwined with stories that I want to tell for society or that society needs to be told,” the filmmaker shares about her inspiration for the new movie. “I had this idea about what if love actually survives the truth, since we lie so much to people we love just to pretend we’re someone else or are sometimes so afraid to reveal who we are. But then also, transgender people are facing so many obstacles, at least in Estonia, and society is still very prejudicial towards them. So I wanted to tell a universal love story, make a transgender person a hero and show a trans man’s fairy tale.”
paras.zh: “我总是将个人故事与我想为社会讲述或社会需要被讲述的故事交织在一起，”这位电影制片人分享了她对新电影的灵感。 “我有一个想法，如果爱情真的比真相更胜一筹，因为我们对我们所爱的人撒了太多谎，只是为了假装自己是别人，或者有时害怕透露自己是谁。但同时，跨性别者面临着如此多的障碍，至少在爱沙尼亚，社会对他们仍然非常偏见。所以我想讲述一个普遍的爱情故事，让一个跨性别者成为英雄，展现一个跨性别男人的童话。”

paras.en: However, Mägi also emphasizes: “Of course, there is no such thing as transgender love and ordinary love. It is all just pure love.”
paras.zh: 不过，Mägi也强调：“当然，不存在跨性别爱情和普通爱情，这只是纯粹的爱情。”

paras.en: The idea to tell the journey of self-discovery and transformation that Niina goes on came organically in the filmmaking process. “I thought it would be even more powerful if I told it as a fairy tale because fairy tales allow us to talk about very difficult topics in very beautiful and universal ways,” she tells THR. “And it also shows that everything is possible.”
paras.zh: 讲述尼娜自我发现和转变之旅的想法自然而然地出现在电影制作过程中。 “我认为如果我把它作为童话故事来讲述，效果会更强大，因为童话故事让我们能够以非常美丽和普遍的方式谈论非常困难的话题，”她告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “这也表明一切皆有可能。”

paras.en: I had the feeling that it had to be a fairy tale because this story in our society is still being seen as a fairy tale – people don’t think it’s realistic. But I think we have to tell these fairy tales until they become part of our real life.”
paras.zh: 我有一种感觉，这一定是一个童话故事，因为这个故事在我们的社会中仍然被视为童话故事——人们认为它不现实。但我认为我们必须讲述这些童话故事，直到它们成为我们现实生活的一部分。”

paras.en: Mägi loves bringing back collaborators from her past films because she shoots with a small budget and a very open process without a pre-written script that allows the creative team to explore the characters and storylines and see where the discovery process takes them. “I’ve been working with the same actors and actresses for years now,” she explains. “Both Jarmo Reha, who is Kaur, and Ester Kuntu, who’s playing Niina, were also in Mo Papa. Tambet Tuisk, who’s playing The Writer, was in two of my previous short films, and he’s also part of Mo Hunt, which is my next feature film – and Jarmo is there again, too. So, these actors and others [on the production] are already used to my method. We are all surfing on the same wave of chaos.”
paras.zh: Mägi 喜欢从她过去的电影中带回合作者，因为她的拍摄预算很少，而且拍摄过程非常开放，没有预先写好的剧本，让创意团队可以探索角色和故事情节，并了解发现过程将他们带向何方。 “多年来我一直与同一位演员合作，”她解释道。 “扮演考尔的贾莫·雷哈（Jarmo Reha）和扮演尼娜（Niina）的埃斯特·昆图（Ester Kuntu）也在《Mo Papa》中出演过。扮演作家的塔姆贝特·图伊斯克（Tambet Tuisk）出现在我之前的两部短片中，他也是我的下一部故事片《Mo Hunt》的一部分——而贾莫也再次出现了。所以，这些演员和其他（制作中的）人已经习惯了我的方法。我们都在同一波混乱中冲浪。”

paras.en: Mikker is not a professional actor, so how did he end up in Mo Amor? “I met him at a bar,” the writer-director shares. “He’s my friend. He’s studying sculpture at the Estonian Arts Academy.”
paras.zh: 米克尔不是专业演员，那么他怎么会进入Mo Amor呢？ “我在酒吧遇见了他，”这位编剧兼导演分享道。 “他是我的朋友。他正在爱沙尼亚艺术学院学习雕塑。”

paras.en: Was there an option to cast a trans actor for the film? “We couldn’t find a transgender actor to play in the film because we don’t have any [in Estonia],” the writer-director explains. “So, I talked to the trans community, and they thought that it was okay if Ester, as a woman, is playing Niina and Jarmo, as a man, is playing Kaur. And we are not so much concentrating on the transition period.”
paras.zh: 是否可以选择为这部电影选一位跨性别演员？ “我们找不到变性演员在电影中扮演，因为我们（爱沙尼亚）没有，”编剧兼导演解释道。 “所以，我和跨性别群体交谈过，他们认为如果埃斯特作为女性扮演尼娜，而贾莫作为男性扮演考尔，那也没关系。而且我们并不太关注过渡期。”

paras.en: That was also by choice. “We didn’t want to concentrate on the transitioning period and use a lot of makeup and do all these stereotypical things that a lot of films do,” Mägi tells THR.
paras.zh: 这也是选择的。 “我们不想把注意力集中在过渡时期，使用大量化妆品，并做很多电影所做的所有这些刻板的事情，”马吉告诉《好莱坞报道》。

paras.en: What Mo Amor does feature, though, is recurring photo camera sounds followed by still frames before the “action” or moving images continue. “The process itself is always guiding us,” the filmmaker emphasizes. “And when we started shooting, I realized that I wanted to have these still frames because Niina/Kaur is a photographer. I wanted to somehow make the film reflect this profession and use it as part of the cinematic storytelling.”
paras.zh: 然而，Mo Amor 的特色是，在“动作”或移动图像继续之前，重复出现相机声音，然后是静止帧。 “这个过程本身总是指导着我们，”电影制片人强调道。 “当我们开始拍摄时，我意识到我想要这些静态画面，因为尼娜/考尔是一名摄影师。我想以某种方式让电影反映这个职业，并将其作为电影叙事的一部分。”

paras.en: Mo Amor was shot over the course of 17 days at the filmmaker’s boathouse on Vilsandi Island in the Baltic Sea, Estonia’s westernmost populated island. “This place is amazing,” the creative says about the island. “It’s very cinematic. And as we didn’t have any budget, as always, I decided to basically shoot it at home.”
paras.zh: 《莫·阿莫尔》是在爱沙尼亚最西端人口稠密的波罗的海维尔桑迪岛的电影制片人船库拍摄的，历时 17 天。 “这个地方太棒了，”这位创意人士谈到这个岛屿时说道。 “这非常电影化。而且由于我们一如既往地没有任何预算，所以我决定基本上在家里拍摄。”

paras.en: What can she share about her next feature, the briefly mentioned Mo Hunt? “We are in post- production at the moment,” she says.
paras.zh: 关于她的下一部作品，即简短提到的《莫亨特》，她能分享什么？ “我们目前正在进行后期制作，”她说。

paras.en: And just like Mo Papa and Mo Amor are very different in terms of look, feel and atmosphere, Mo Hunt will also be a different kind of experience. “The visual language is different,” Mägi tells THR. “It’s a hybrid film, a staged documentary. I don’t want to repeat myself. And it’s also the outcome of the fact that we don’t have everything planned. We really go into the process and let the story guide us. And I guess every story has its unique ways of being reflected.”
paras.zh: 就像 Mo Papa 和 Mo Amor 在外观、感觉和氛围上都有很大不同一样，Mo Hunt 也将是一种不同的体验。 “视觉语言是不同的，”Mägi 告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “这是一部混合电影，一部舞台纪录片。我不想重复自己。这也是我们没有计划好一切的结果。我们真正进入这个过程，让故事引导我们。我想每个故事都有其独特的反映方式。”

paras.en: The original idea for Mo Hunt was to tell the story of a ballerina who becomes an illegal surrogate. “We started staging this ballerina, and then I had a feeling that I had to collect stories from different artists about how they have experienced the thin line between artistic creation and manipulation,” the director recalls. “Artistic creation can become exploitation or mental abuse. I was wondering how far I can push actors just for the sake of art. I understood that there are boundaries, there are limits. So, then I started to get interested in this topic and started collecting different stories from different artists.”
paras.zh: 莫亨特的最初想法是讲述一位芭蕾舞演员成为非法代理人的故事。 “我们开始表演这位芭蕾舞演员，然后我有一种感觉，我必须收集不同艺术家的故事，讲述他们如何经历艺术创作和操纵之间的微妙界限，”导演回忆道。 “艺术创作可能会成为剥削或精神虐待。我想知道我可以为了艺术而把演员推到什么程度。我明白这是有界限的，有限制的。所以，然后我开始对这个话题感兴趣，并开始收集不同艺术家的不同故事。”

paras.en: That is why Mo Hunt will be “a staged documentary.” Explains Mägi: “All the people in the film are playing actors, but they are presenting the stories of different artists. So, the film combines what’s happening in the fiction film with what’s actually happening in artists’ hearts and minds.”
paras.zh: 这就是为什么《莫亨特》将是“一部舞台纪录片”。 Mägi 解释道：“影片中的所有人都在扮演演员，但他们呈现的是不同艺术家的故事。因此，这部电影将虚构电影中发生的事情与艺术家内心中实际发生的事情结合起来。”

articles.title: Trump doesn’t plan to raise Nvidia, spy issue during China trip: U.S. officials

paras.en: President Donald Trump is not expected to raise allegations of a Chinese intelligence operation involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang during his upcoming meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping, senior U.S. officials said Friday.
paras.zh: 美国高级官员周五表示，预计唐纳德·特朗普总统在即将与中国国家主席习近平会面时不会提出涉及英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋的中国情报行动的指控。

paras.en: Officials also said that Elon Musk, the CEO of Tesla and SpaceX, will accompany Trump on the trip to Shenzhen, China, for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit on Nov. 18 and 19.
paras.zh: 官员们还表示，特斯拉和SpaceX首席执行官埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)将陪同特朗普前往中国深圳，参加11月18日至19日举行的亚太经合组织峰会。

paras.en: The White House, earlier Friday, said Trump plans to have a three-way summit there with Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 白宫周五早些时候表示，特朗普计划在那里与习近平和俄罗斯总统普京举行三方峰会。

paras.en: Jensen Huang's relationship with the suspected spy, Alice Huang, who is not related to him, has raised concerns that a Singapore-based company where she was an executive diverted restricted Nvidia chips to China.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋与涉嫌间谍的爱丽丝黄（与他没有亲属关系）的关系引发了人们的担忧，她曾担任高管的一家新加坡公司将受限制的英伟达芯片转移到中国。

paras.en: "The situation with Nvidia should not really have any bearing on the trip," an official said on the press call, speaking on the condition that they not be identified.
paras.zh: 一位官员在新闻发布会上表示，“英伟达的情况应该不会对这次旅行产生任何影响”，但要求不具名。

paras.en: "In all of our discussions and negotiations with the Chinese, we do not negotiate American export controls ... and we don't expect it to figure at all in any of our conversations with the Chinese while we're there."
paras.zh: “在我们与中国人的所有讨论和谈判中，我们不会就美国的出口管制进行谈判……而且我们也不希望它出现在我们在那里与中国人的任何对话中。”

paras.en: Asked if Trump would raise the allegations against Alice Huang to Chinese leader Xi Jinping, the official said, "The focus of a meeting with President Xi, at least on the economic side, is going to be about implementation of the trade agreement."
paras.zh: 当被问及特朗普是否会向中国领导人习近平提出对黄爱丽的指控时，该官员表示，“与习近平主席会面的重点，至少在经济方面，将是关于贸易协定的实施。”

paras.en: "When it comes to some of these national security matters and examinations and investigations that are going on in the U.S., [that is] probably not something that we're going to read the Chinese in on at this moment," the official said.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示：“当涉及到美国正在进行的一些国家安全问题以及检查和调查时，我们目前可能不会向中国人了解这些内容。”

paras.en: Another official said, "I don't expect the president to raise it — the Alice Huang issue."
paras.zh: 另一位官员表示，“我不认为总统会提出爱丽丝黄问题。”

paras.en: China has called the allegations against Alice Huang baseless.
paras.zh: 中国称针对黄爱丽的指控毫无根据。
