paras.en: Despite the suspicious circumstances, Petrie could not find convincing evidence that the individuals had died violently. Without identifiable fatal injuries, the possibility of human sacrifice remained an unresolved archaeological mystery.
paras.zh: 尽管情况可疑，皮特里无法找到令人信服的证据证明这些人是死于暴力。由于没有可识别的致命伤害，人祭的可能性仍然是一个未解的考古谜团。

paras.en: Campbell decided to revisit the original excavation evidence, hoping that modern forensic techniques could reveal clues that had escaped investigators a century earlier.
paras.zh: 坎贝尔决定重新审视最初的挖掘证据，希望现代法医技术能够揭示一个世纪前调查人员遗漏的线索。

paras.en: Modern Forensics Reveals Evidence of Violent Deaths
paras.zh: 现代法医学揭示暴力死亡的证据

paras.en: Although Petrie documented his excavations carefully, he eventually reburied most of the human remains. He did, however, preserve a selection of skulls, some of which were transferred to the United Kingdom.
paras.zh: 尽管皮特里仔细记录了他的挖掘工作，但他最终还是重新埋葬了大部分人类遗骸。然而，他确实保留了一些头骨，其中一些被转移到英国。

paras.en: Campbell located 46 of these skulls in the Duckworth Collection at Cambridge University and examined them using contemporary forensic knowledge.
paras.zh: 坎贝尔在剑桥大学达克沃斯收藏中找到了 46 个头骨，并利用当代法医学知识对它们进行了检查。

paras.en: The results revealed injuries that had previously gone unrecognized. Eighteen skulls showed substantial cranial trauma, primarily in the form of linear fractures. Petrie had apparently interpreted these cracks as damage caused by natural processes rather than injuries sustained by living people.
paras.zh: 结果揭示了之前未被识别的伤害。十八个头骨显示出严重的颅骨损伤，主要表现为线性骨折。皮特里显然将这些裂缝解释为自然过程造成的损害，而不是活人所受的伤害。

paras.en: Modern forensic methods made it possible to identify the fractures as perimortem injuries, meaning they occurred around the time of death. Their characteristics suggest that some of the individuals may have suffered deliberate, potentially fatal blows to the head.
paras.zh: 现代法医方法可以将骨折识别为临死损伤，这意味着骨折发生在死亡前后。他们的特征表明，其中一些人的头部可能遭受了故意的、可能致命的打击。

paras.en: "The injuries on the preserved crania are generally linear fractures, which would likely cause rapid unconsciousness, internal bleeding, and death," said Campbell, who also reported evidence of sharp-force trauma on some of the 18 skulls, including a chopping injury to one individual's eye.
paras.zh: 坎贝尔说：“保留下来的头骨上的损伤通常是线性骨折，这可能会导致迅速失去知觉、内出血和死亡。”他还报告了 18 个头骨中的一些头骨受到锐器外伤的证据，其中包括一个人的眼睛被砍伤。

paras.en: These findings suggest that at least 39% of the examined individuals may have been deliberately killed, providing important new evidence in support of the long-standing human sacrifice hypothesis.
paras.zh: 这些发现表明，至少 39% 的受检个体可能是被故意杀害的，为支持长期存在的活人献祭假说提供了重要的新证据。

paras.en: How Were Ancient Egypt's Royal Attendants Killed?
paras.zh: 古埃及的皇家侍从是如何被杀害的？

paras.en: Although the skull injuries offer strong evidence of violence, the precise circumstances of the deaths remain uncertain.
paras.zh: 尽管颅骨损伤提供了暴力的有力证据，但死亡的确切情况仍不确定。

paras.en: Ancient Egyptian artwork frequently portrays kings striking enemies with maces, but Campbell noted that the royal attendants buried at Abydos were not enemy combatants. The injuries also do not match the damage typically associated with these weapons.
paras.zh: 古埃及艺术品经常描绘国王用狼牙棒打击敌人，但坎贝尔指出，埋葬在阿比多斯的王室侍从并不是敌方战斗人员。这些伤害也不符合这些武器通常造成的伤害。

paras.en: A mace would generally produce depressed skull fractures, while the injuries identified in this study were predominantly linear. Such fractures are more commonly associated with impacts from broad, flat objects or severe falls.
paras.zh: 狼牙棒通常会造成颅骨凹陷性骨折，而本研究中发现的损伤主要是线性的。此类骨折更常见于宽阔、扁平物体或严重跌落的撞击。

paras.en: Accidental falls cannot be entirely excluded. However, a fall powerful enough to fracture the skull would likely have caused injuries elsewhere in the skeleton. Such damage should have appeared in Petrie's excavation records or photographs, yet no corresponding evidence was documented.
paras.zh: 不能完全排除意外跌倒的可能性。然而，如果跌倒的力量足以使头骨骨折，很可能会导致骨骼其他部位受伤。这种损坏应该出现在皮特里的挖掘记录或照片中，但没有相应的证据记录。

paras.en: The researchers also cannot determine how the remaining individuals died. Some may have died naturally, while others could have been killed using methods that left no recognizable marks on their bones, such as asphyxiation.
paras.zh: 研究人员也无法确定其余个体是如何死亡的。有些人可能是自然死亡，而另一些人可能是通过在骨头上没有留下明显痕迹的方法杀死的，例如窒息。

paras.en: Additional injuries might also have been found if the rest of their skeletons were available for examination. Unfortunately, most of those remains were reburied more than a century ago, leaving researchers with only part of the physical evidence.
paras.zh: 如果他们的其余骨骼可供检查，也可能会发现其他伤害。不幸的是，大部分遗骸在一个多世纪前被重新埋葬，研究人员只留下了部分物证。

paras.en: Ancient Skulls Reveal New Clues to Egypt's Dark Past
paras.zh: 古代头骨揭示了埃及黑暗过去的新线索

paras.en: The findings demonstrate how archaeological collections can preserve important clues long after their original excavation. Even when evidence is incomplete, advances in scientific techniques can provide new answers to questions that earlier researchers were unable to resolve.
paras.zh: 这些发现证明了考古藏品如何在最初挖掘后很长一段时间内保留重要线索。即使证据不完整，科学技术的进步也可以为早期研究人员无法解决的问题提供新的答案。

paras.en: For Campbell, the possibility of locating and examining the remaining skeletal material offers an especially intriguing opportunity to learn more about the people buried around Egypt's earliest kings.
paras.zh: 对于坎贝尔来说，定位和检查剩余骨骼材料的可能性提供了一个特别有趣的机会，可以更多地了解埃及最早国王周围埋葬的人。

paras.en: "If I had unlimited resources, I would love to figure out where the bodies of these individuals might be and analyze them!" said Campbell. "Still, this study shows how much new information about the past can be revealed when we revisit previous data armed with updated methods and knowledge, even for datasets that are incomplete and imperfect like this one."
paras.zh: “如果我有无限的资源，我很想弄清楚这些人的尸体可能在哪里并对其进行分析！”坎贝尔说。 “不过，这项研究表明，当我们用更新的方法和知识重新审视以前的数据时，即使对于像这样不完整和不完美的数据集，也可以揭示多少关于过去的新信息。”

paras.en: - Roselyn A. Campbell. New data from old bones: using bioarchaeology and forensics to reassess legacy data from ancient Abydos, Egypt. Frontiers in Environmental Archaeology, 2026; 5 DOI: 10.3389/fearc.2026.1858940
paras.zh: - 罗塞琳·A·坎贝尔。来自旧骨头的新数据：利用生物考古学和法医学重新评估来自埃及古代阿比多斯的遗留数据。环境考古学前沿，2026； 5 DOI：10.3389/fearc.2026.1858940

articles.title: Yale scientists reveal what really slows aging and what doesn't

paras.en: Yale scientists reveal what really slows aging and what doesn't
paras.zh: 耶鲁大学科学家揭示什么真正能减缓衰老，什么不能

paras.en: - Yale researchers have discovered that certain prescription drugs, healthy diets, and exercise can measurably slow biological aging, while popular anti-aging supplements appear largely ineffective. Their analysis of 51 studies could transform how scientists evaluate anti-aging treatments, although whether these biological changes actually extend life remains uncertain.
paras.zh: - 耶鲁大学的研究人员发现，某些处方药、健康饮食和运动可以显着减缓生物衰老，而流行的抗衰老补充剂似乎基本上无效。他们对 51 项研究的分析可能会改变科学家评估抗衰老治疗的方式，尽管这些生物学变化是否真的能延长寿命仍不确定。

paras.en: A growing body of research suggests that aging may be more flexible than once believed. Now, scientists at Yale have taken an important step toward identifying which treatments can actually influence biological aging and which ones show little measurable benefit.
paras.zh: 越来越多的研究表明，衰老可能比人们以前认为的更加灵活。现在，耶鲁大学的科学家们在确定哪些治疗方法实际上可以影响生物衰老以及哪些治疗方法几乎没有什么可衡量的益处方面迈出了重要的一步。

paras.en: Their findings suggest that certain prescription medications and lifestyle changes can reduce biological age as measured by DNA-based blood tests. Popular over-the-counter supplements examined in the research, however, showed little evidence of producing the same effects.
paras.zh: 他们的研究结果表明，某些处方药和生活方式的改变可以降低通过基于 DNA 的血液测试测量的生物年龄。然而，研究中检查的流行非处方补充剂几乎没有证据表明能产生相同的效果。

paras.en: The findings, published in Nature Medicine, could help scientists evaluate anti-aging treatments more effectively, although researchers emphasize that changes in biological age markers do not necessarily mean people will live longer or avoid age-related diseases.
paras.zh: 发表在《自然医学》上的研究结果可以帮助科学家更有效地评估抗衰老治疗，尽管研究人员强调，生物年龄标记的变化并不一定意味着人们会活得更长或避免与年龄相关的疾病。

paras.en: From Fighting Cancer to Understanding Aging
paras.zh: 从抗击癌症到了解衰老

paras.en: When Raghav Sehgal began graduate school at Yale several years ago, he planned to use advanced computer science techniques to investigate cancer. His background in engineering and experience launching a computational biology startup had given him a strong foundation for that work.
paras.zh: 几年前，当 Raghav Sehgal 开始在耶鲁大学读研究生时，他计划使用先进的计算机科学技术来研究癌症。他的工程背景和创办计算生物学初创公司的经验为他的这项工作奠定了坚实的基础。

paras.en: However, a question from his Ph.D. adviser at the Yale School of Medicine changed his research direction. Rather than focusing on individual diseases such as cancer or cardiovascular disease, why not investigate the aging process that contributes to their development?
paras.zh: 然而，他的博士提出了一个问题。耶鲁大学医学院的顾问改变了他的研究方向。与其关注癌症或心血管疾病等个别疾病，为什么不研究有助于其发展的衰老过程呢？

paras.en: "That put me on a different path," said Sehgal, now an associate research scientist in psychiatry who specializes in computational biology and bioinformatics. "As researchers, we have a long way to go in understanding the aging process and whether the steps we take to manage it really work."
paras.zh: “这让我走上了一条不同的道路，”塞加尔说，他现在是一名精神病学副研究科学家，专门研究计算生物学和生物信息学。 “作为研究人员，我们在了解衰老过程以及我们采取的管理措施是否真正有效方面还有很长的路要走。”

paras.en: Sehgal now studies the biological mechanisms behind human aging, how scientists can measure those changes, and why getting older increases the likelihood of conditions such as cancer, diabetes, and dementia. His work also explores whether interventions might reverse certain aspects of biological aging, even if eliminating aging itself remains beyond reach.
paras.zh: 塞加尔现在研究人类衰老背后的生物机制，科学家如何测量这些变化，以及为什么变老会增加患癌症、糖尿病和痴呆等疾病的可能性。他的工作还探讨了干预措施是否可以逆转生物衰老的某些方面，即使消除衰老本身仍然遥不可及。

paras.en: New DNA Tests Reveal Which Anti-Aging Treatments Work
paras.zh: 新的 DNA 测试揭示了哪些抗衰老治疗有效

paras.en: Sehgal is the lead author of the new study, which was conducted in the laboratory of Albert Higgins-Chen, an assistant professor of psychiatry at the Yale School of Medicine. The research team set out to determine which existing approaches to slowing aging produce changes that can be reliably measured.
paras.zh: Sehgal 是这项新研究的主要作者，该研究是在耶鲁大学医学院精神病学助理教授 Albert Higgins-Chen 的实验室进行的。研究小组着手确定哪些现有的减缓衰老的方法会产生可以可靠测量的变化。

paras.en: Their analysis found encouraging results for certain medications and lifestyle interventions. In contrast, the over-the-counter supplements included in the study generally failed to produce meaningful reductions in biological age.
paras.zh: 他们的分析发现某些药物和生活方式干预措施取得了令人鼓舞的结果。相比之下，研究中包含的非处方补充剂通常无法显着降低生物年龄。

paras.en: The project involved the entire Higgins-Chen laboratory, including Daniel Borrus, Jenel F. Armstrong, John Gonzalez, Jessica Kasamoto, and Yaroslav Markov.
paras.zh: 该项目涉及整个 Higgins-Chen 实验室，包括 Daniel Borrus、Jenel F. Armstrong、John Gonzalez、Jessica Kasamoto 和 Yaroslav Markov。

paras.en: "For the first time we've shown that certain therapies have measurable impacts," said Sehgal. "This wasn't previously possible, because we didn't have enough data to say these biomarkers are consistently responsive to these interventions."
paras.zh: “我们第一次证明某些疗法具有可测量的影响，”塞加尔说。 “这在以前是不可能的，因为我们没有足够的数据表明这些生物标志物对这些干预措施始终有反应。”

paras.en: Biomarkers provide measurable information about what is happening inside the body. In aging research, they can help estimate a person's biological or functional age, which may differ from their chronological age.
paras.zh: 生物标志物提供有关体内发生情况的可测量信息。在衰老研究中，它们可以帮助估计一个人的生物学或功能年龄，这可能与他们的实际年龄不同。

paras.en: To investigate whether treatments could influence aging, the Yale team relied primarily on blood-based measurements called epigenetic clocks.
paras.zh: 为了研究治疗是否会影响衰老，耶鲁大学研究小组主要依靠称为表观遗传时钟的血液测量。

paras.en: These tools analyze chemical patterns attached to DNA, particularly methyl groups (basic chemical structures that act like tags). Previous research has shown that these chemical markers change as people grow older. Some interventions may reverse certain age-associated patterns, and computer algorithms use those changes to estimate a person's biological age.
paras.zh: 这些工具分析附着在 DNA 上的化学模式，特别是甲基（作用类似于标签的基本化学结构）。先前的研究表明，这些化学标记物会随着人们年龄的增长而发生变化。一些干预措施可能会逆转某些与年龄相关的模式，计算机算法使用这些变化来估计一个人的生物年龄。

paras.en: The researchers brought together findings from 51 clinical studies investigating different anti-aging strategies. These ranged from dietary supplements and medications to lifestyle changes and medical procedures.
paras.zh: 研究人员汇集了 51 项临床研究的结果，调查了不同的抗衰老策略。这些范围从膳食补充剂和药物到生活方式的改变和医疗程序。

paras.en: Across those studies, the team examined more than 110 DNA methylation biomarkers (including 16 major epigenetic clocks). By comparing measurements taken before and after interventions, they could evaluate which approaches were associated with reductions in biological age.
paras.zh: 在这些研究中，该团队检查了 110 多个 DNA 甲基化生物标志物（包括 16 个主要表观遗传时钟）。通过比较干预前后的测量结果，他们可以评估哪些方法与生物年龄的降低有关。

paras.en: "What we did was pretty unique," Sehgal said. "We already know that certain things might prolong health span and lifespan. There is data from retrospective analysis as well as from animal models. We took all that knowledge along with the real-world clinical studies to identify which interventions in humans were slowing down aging across the board in these known biomarkers."
paras.zh: “我们所做的非常独特，”塞加尔说。 “我们已经知道某些事情可能会延长健康寿命和寿命。有来自回顾性分析和动物模型的数据。我们将所有这些知识与现实世界的临床研究结合起来，以确定哪些对人类的干预措施正在这些已知的生物标志物中全面减缓衰老。”

paras.en: Which Anti-Aging Treatments Showed the Best Results?
paras.zh: 哪种抗衰老治疗效果最好？

paras.en: The researchers divided the interventions into four main groups: prescription drugs, lifestyle modifications, over-the-counter supplements, and medical procedures.
paras.zh: 研究人员将干预措施分为四大类：处方药、生活方式改变、非处方补充剂和医疗程序。

paras.en: One of the clearest findings involved diet and exercise. Combining regular physical activity with a healthy eating plan consistently reduced epigenetic age. The dietary approaches examined included Mediterranean, low-fat, and low-carb diets.
paras.zh: 最明显的发现之一涉及饮食和锻炼。将定期的身体活动与健康的饮食计划相结合，可以持续降低表观遗传年龄。研究的饮食方法包括地中海饮食、低脂肪和低碳水化合物饮食。

paras.en: The strongest reductions in biological age markers were associated with certain pharmaceutical treatments. These included metformin and semaglutide, prescription medications used to manage metabolic conditions and body weight, as well as anti-TNF therapies that target a protein involved in the body's inflammatory response.
paras.zh: 生物年龄标志物的最强减少与某些药物治疗有关。其中包括二甲双胍和索马鲁肽，用于控制代谢状况和体重的处方药，以及针对参与人体炎症反应的蛋白质的抗肿瘤坏死因子疗法。

paras.en: (TNF, or tumor necrosis factor, is an immune-system protein that helps fight inflammation-related injury.)
paras.zh: （TNF，即肿瘤坏死因子，是一种免疫系统蛋白，有助于对抗炎症相关损伤。）

paras.en: The findings were less encouraging for over-the-counter supplements and some medical procedures. In the studies examined, these approaches did not produce measurable reductions in epigenetic age.
paras.zh: 对于非处方补充剂和一些医疗程序来说，研究结果不太令人鼓舞。在所检查的研究中，这些方法并未显着降低表观遗传年龄。

paras.en: The researchers also discovered that newer biological age clocks performed better than older versions. Another important finding was that people living with diseases generally experienced larger changes in their aging biomarkers than healthy participants.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现，新的生物年龄时钟比旧版本的表现更好。另一个重要的发现是，患有疾病的人的衰老生物标志物通常比健康的参与者经历更大的变化。

paras.en: Could DNA Blood Tests Transform Anti-Aging Research?
paras.zh: DNA 血液测试能否改变抗衰老研究？

paras.en: According to Sehgal, the next priority is to test these findings in larger, more diverse populations. This would help researchers determine how consistently different treatments influence biological aging across people with different health conditions and backgrounds.
paras.zh: 塞加尔表示，下一个优先事项是在更大、更多样化的人群中测试这些发现。这将有助于研究人员确定不同的治疗方法如何一致地影响不同健康状况和背景的人的生物衰老。

paras.en: The improved blood tests could also dramatically shorten the time needed to evaluate potential anti-aging therapies.
paras.zh: 改进的血液测试还可以大大缩短评估潜在抗衰老疗法所需的时间。

paras.en: "If these new biomarkers are eventually validated to predict long-term health, scientists will be able to evaluate anti-aging therapies much faster," he added. "Instead of waiting decades for evidence from clinical trials, we'll be able to see which interventions are effective and in which people in a few years or even months."
paras.zh: “如果这些新的生物标志物最终被验证可以预测长期健康，科学家将能够更快地评估抗衰老疗法，”他补充道。 “我们不必等待数十年才能获得临床试验的证据，而是可以在几年甚至几个月内看到哪些干预措施有效以及对哪些人有效。”

paras.en: That possibility could represent a major advance for aging research. Instead of relying entirely on clinical studies that follow participants for decades, scientists might eventually use validated biological age measurements to identify promising treatments much earlier.
paras.zh: 这种可能性可能代表着衰老研究的重大进步。科学家最终可能会使用经过验证的生物年龄测量来更早地识别有希望的治疗方法，而不是完全依赖跟踪参与者数十年的临床研究。

paras.en: However, senior author Higgins-Chen stressed that scientists must be careful about interpreting what changes in aging biomarkers actually mean.
paras.zh: 然而，资深作者希金斯-陈强调，科学家必须谨慎解释衰老生物标志物变化的实际含义。

paras.en: "We have developed a rigorous, systematic approach to evaluating and comparing how biomarkers change across a wide variety of interventions, and that is a critical step in the right direction," he said. "However, the true meaning of that change must be fully understood."
paras.zh: 他说：“我们开发了一种严格、系统的方法来评估和比较生物标志物在各种干预措施中的变化，这是朝着正确方向迈出的关键一步。” “但是，必须充分理解这种变化的真正含义。”

paras.en: Important Questions About Slowing Aging Remain
paras.zh: 关于延缓衰老的重要问题仍然存在

paras.en: Although the results are promising, several major questions remain unanswered.
paras.zh: 尽管结果令人鼓舞，但几个主要问题仍未得到解答。

paras.en: For example, researchers still need to establish whether changes in biological age are directly caused by a treatment or influenced by other factors that were not accounted for. They also need to understand how quickly those changes occur, whether they persist after treatment ends, and which biological processes produce them.
paras.zh: 例如，研究人员仍然需要确定生物年龄的变化是由治疗直接引起的还是受到其他未考虑因素的影响。他们还需要了解这些变化发生的速度有多快，这些变化在治疗结束后是否持续存在，以及哪些生物过程产生了这些变化。

paras.en: Most importantly, scientists have not yet established whether lowering epigenetic age leads to meaningful improvements in long-term health.
paras.zh: 最重要的是，科学家尚未确定降低表观遗传年龄是否会带来长期健康的有意义的改善。

paras.en: "And most importantly - what does the change mean for our long-term risk of age-related disease and functional decline?" Higgins-Chen said.
paras.zh: “最重要的是，这一变化对我们患年龄相关疾病和功能衰退的长期风险意味着什么？”希金斯-陈说道。

paras.en: Further investigations into these questions are underway, with additional studies led by Borrus, Armstrong, and Grace Zou.
paras.zh: 对这些问题的进一步调查正在进行中，博勒斯、阿姆斯特朗和格雷斯·邹领导的其他研究正在进行中。

paras.en: The Higgins-Chen laboratory is also affiliated with Yale's Department of Pathology, the Computational Biology and Bioinformatics Program, and the Y-Age Yale Center for Research on Aging.
paras.zh: Higgins-Chen 实验室还隶属于耶鲁大学病理学系、计算生物学和生物信息学项目以及 Y-Age 耶鲁大学衰老研究中心。

paras.en: What Appears to Work Against Biological Aging?
paras.zh: 什么似乎可以对抗生物衰老？

paras.en: Based on the improved DNA-based blood tests, the Yale researchers identified two particularly promising approaches for reducing biological age markers:
paras.zh: 基于改进的基于 DNA 的血液测试，耶鲁大学的研究人员确定了两种特别有前途的减少生物年龄标记的方法：

paras.en: - Prescription medications: Drugs used for metabolic regulation and weight management, including metformin and semaglutide, were among the treatments associated with the strongest reductions in biological age.
paras.zh: - 处方药：用于代谢调节和体重管理的药物，包括二甲双胍和索马鲁肽，是与生物年龄最明显降低相关的治疗方法之一。

paras.en: - Healthy eating combined with exercise: Regular physical activity paired with nutritious diets, including Mediterranean, low-fat, and low-carb eating plans, consistently produced favorable changes in aging biomarkers.
paras.zh: - 健康饮食与锻炼相结合：定期的体育活动与营养饮食（包括地中海饮食、低脂肪和低碳水化合物饮食计划）相结合，持续对衰老生物标志物产生有利的变化。

paras.en: The analysis also identified benefits from certain anti-TNF medications, while the tested over-the-counter supplements and some medical procedures showed little measurable effect.
paras.zh: 该分析还确定了某些抗 TNF 药物的益处，而测试的非处方补充剂和一些医疗程序几乎没有显示出可测量的效果。

paras.en: These results provide a clearer picture of which interventions may influence biological aging. However, more research is needed to confirm the findings and determine whether reductions in biological age markers ultimately translate into fewer age-related diseases, better health, or longer lives.
paras.zh: 这些结果更清楚地表明哪些干预措施可能影响生物衰老。然而，还需要更多的研究来证实这些发现，并确定生物年龄标志物的减少是否最终会转化为更少的与年龄相关的疾病、更好的健康或更长的寿命。

paras.en: Materials provided by Yale University. Original written by Karen Guzman. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由耶鲁大学提供。原创作者：凯伦·古兹曼。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

Dwaraka, Michael J. Corley, Albert Higgins-Chen. Responsiveness of epigenetic aging biomarkers to longevity interventions in humans. articles.title: 60 years ago the Leonid meteor shower produced 144,000 meteors per hour. Could it happen again?
articles.author: Joe Rao

paras.en: This year marks a rather auspicious anniversary for meteor watchers. Sixty years ago, one of the most stupendous Leonid meteor displays lit up the predawn skies over the central and western U.S. So, what will the 2026 Leonids bring us? And what might they bring in the years to come?
paras.zh: 对于流星观测者来说，今年是一个相当吉祥的周年纪念日。六十年前，最壮观的狮子座流星雨之一照亮了美国中西部黎明前的天空。那么，2026 年的狮子座流星雨会给我们带来什么？未来几年他们会带来什么？

paras.en: The Leonid meteor shower is one of the most celebrated of the year's annual displays of "shooting stars." The mere mention of the Leonids usually elicits mental images of a sky filled with shooting stars pouring down through the sky like rain. Such meteor storms have indeed occurred with the Leonids, such as in 1833 and 1966 when meteor rates of tens of thousands per hour were observed. In more recent years, most notably 1999, 2001 and 2002, lesser Leonid displays of up to "only" a few thousand meteors per hour took place.
paras.zh: 狮子座流星雨是今年最著名的年度“流星”流星雨之一。一提到狮子座流星雨，人们的脑海中通常会浮现出天空布满流星的画面，像雨一样从天空中倾泻而下。此类流星风暴确实在狮子座流星雨中发生过，例如在 1833 年和 1966 年，观测到每小时数万颗流星的速度。近年来，尤其是 1999 年、2001 年和 2002 年，狮子座流星雨的规模较小，每小时“仅”有几千颗流星。

paras.en: Unfortunately, that's not likely to be the case this year. In fact, comparatively speaking, this is going to be a lean year for the Leonids chiefly because of the expected lack of any significant activity. Although the Leonids are one of the most famous of all the annual meteor displays, this year they're not likely to be very productive. It's probable they are going to be rather weak and there probably will be long stretches when not a single Leonid will be seen. I'll explain why in a moment. First, let's find out about this shower's lineage.
paras.zh: 不幸的是，今年的情况不太可能出现。事实上，相对而言，今年对于狮子座流星雨来说将是歉收的一年，主要是因为预计将缺乏任何重大活动。尽管狮子座流星雨是所有年度流星雨中最著名的流星雨之一，但今年它们的成果不太可能很大。它们很可能会变得相当弱，并且可能会在很长一段时间内看不到一个狮子座流星雨。我稍后会解释原因。首先，让我们了解一下这款淋浴的血统。

paras.en: The Leonids are so named because the shower's radiant point, from where the meteors seem to fan out, is located within the constellation of Leo the Lion, from the backward question mark pattern of stars known as "The Sickle." The meteors are caused by the Tempel-Tuttle comet, which sweeps through the inner solar system every 33⅓ years. Each time the comet passes closest to the sun it leaves a "river of rubble" in its wake: a dense trail of dusty debris. A meteor storm becomes possible if the Earth were to score a direct hit on a fresh dust trail ejected by the comet over the past several centuries.
paras.zh: 狮子座流星雨之所以如此命名，是因为流星雨的辐射点（流星似乎从那里呈扇形散开）位于狮子座内，从被称为“镰刀”的恒星的向后问号图案而来。这些流星是由坦普尔-塔特尔彗星引起的，它每 33⅓ 年扫过太阳系内部一次。每次彗星经过最接近太阳的地方时，都会在其尾迹中留下一条“瓦砾河”：一条密集的尘埃碎片痕迹。如果地球直接撞击彗星在过去几个世纪中喷射出的新鲜尘埃轨迹，那么流星风暴就有可能发生。

paras.en: The "lion's share" (no pun intended) of comet dust can be found just ahead and trailing behind Tempel-Tuttle. That comet last swept through the inner solar system in 1998. That's why spectacular meteor showers were seen in 1999, 2001 and 2002, with declining numbers thereafter.
paras.zh: 彗星尘埃的“最大部分”（没有双关语）可以在坦普尔-塔特尔的前方和后方找到。这颗彗星最后一次掠过内太阳系是在 1998 年。这就是为什么在 1999 年、2001 年和 2002 年看到了壮观的流星雨，但此后数量逐渐减少。

paras.en: When is the best time to look for Leonids?
paras.zh: 什么时候是寻找狮子座流星雨的最佳时间？

paras.en: According to the International Meteor Organization's 2026 meteor shower calendar, the Leonids are expected to reach their regular maximum at 23:45 UTC (6:45 p.m. EST) on Nov. 17, with around 15 meteors per hour possible under ideal viewing conditions.
paras.zh: 根据国际流星组织的 2026 年流星雨日历，狮子座流星雨预计将于 11 月 17 日世界标准时间 23:45（美国东部时间下午 6:45）达到常规最大值，在理想的观测条件下，每小时可能出现约 15 颗流星。

paras.en: Other forecasts place the peak at slightly different times. Margaret Campbell-Brown and Peter Brown, meteor experts for the Royal Astronomical Society of Canada, predict that the peak of this year's Leonids will occur at 00:00 hours UTC on Nov. 18. Russian meteor expert Mikhail Maslov feels that the peak will come about a third of a day earlier, at 16:00 UTC on Nov. 17.
paras.zh: 其他预测将峰值的时间略有不同。加拿大皇家天文学会流星专家玛格丽特·坎贝尔-布朗和彼得·布朗预测，今年狮子座流星雨的峰值将出现在世界标准时间 11 月 18 日 00:00。俄罗斯流星专家米哈伊尔·马斯洛夫认为，峰值将提前大约三分之一天，即世界标准时间 11 月 17 日 16:00。

paras.en: Several weaker encounters with older debris trails are also predicted between Nov. 17 and 19, although no major meteor storm is expected.
paras.zh: 预计 11 月 17 日至 19 日期间，还会遇到几次较弱的较旧碎片轨迹，但预计不会出现重大流星风暴。

paras.en: Back in September 2014, comet Tempel-Tuttle was as far from the sun as it can get: 1.84 billion miles (2.96 billion km). The comet has since spent the last dozen years slowly approaching the inner solar system, but it's still 1.11 billion miles (1.79 billion km) from the sun, which is still well beyond the orbit of Saturn.
paras.zh: 早在 2014 年 9 月，坦普尔-塔特尔彗星距离太阳的距离已经达到了最远的距离：18.4 亿英里（29.6 亿公里）。此后，这颗彗星在过去的十几年里缓慢地接近太阳系内部，但它距离太阳仍然有11.1亿英里（17.9亿公里），仍然远远超出了土星的轨道。

paras.en: In contrast, at the point in the comet's orbit where we will be passing by on Tuesday morning, there is nothing save for a scattered few particles; bits and pieces likely loosened from the comet's nucleus a millennium or two ago.
paras.zh: 相比之下，在周二早上我们将经过的彗星轨道上，除了一些分散的粒子之外，什么也没有。碎片可能是在一两千年前从彗核中松散出来的。

paras.en: So, this year's Leonids are expected to show only low activity; "maybe" at best 10 to 15 Leonids per hour might be seen, but more likely hourly counts will be less than that. The moon will not pose a problem; it's at first quarter phase, but it will set before 11 p.m. local time Monday evening, leaving the rest of the night dark.
paras.zh: 因此，今年的狮子座流星雨预计只会表现出较低的活动性； “也许”最多每小时可以看到 10 到 15 个狮子座流星雨，但每小时的计数更有可能会少于这个数字。月亮不会造成问题；现在是第一季度阶段，但晚上 11 点之前会凝结。当地时间周一晚上，余下的夜晚一片漆黑。

paras.en: Watching a meteor shower consists of lying back, looking up at the sky... and waiting. Keep in mind that any local light pollution or obstructions like tall trees or buildings will further reduce your chances of making a meteor sighting. Leo does not start coming fully into view until the after-midnight hours, so that would be the best time to concentrate on looking for Leonids. As dawn is about to break at around 5 a.m., the Sickle will have climbed more than two-thirds of the way up from the southeast horizon to the point directly overhead (called the zenith).
paras.zh: 观看流星雨包括仰卧、仰望天空……以及等待。请记住，任何当地的光污染或障碍物（如高大的树木或建筑物）都会进一步减少您看到流星的机会。狮子座直到午夜之后才开始完全进入视野，因此这将是集中精力寻找狮子座流星雨的最佳时间。凌晨 5 点左右黎明即将破晓，镰刀将从东南地平线爬升超过三分之二，到达正上方的点（称为天顶）。

paras.en: Because the Leonids are moving along in their orbit around the sun in a direction opposite to that of Earth, they slam into our atmosphere nearly head-on, resulting in the fastest meteor velocities possible: 45 miles (72 km) per second. Such speeds tend to produce bright meteors, which leave long-lasting streaks or persistent trains in their wake. A mighty Leonid fireball can be quite spectacular, but such outstandingly bright meteors are likely to be very few and very far between this year (if any are seen at all).
paras.zh: 由于狮子座流星雨沿着与地球相反的方向绕太阳运行，因此它们几乎正面撞击我们的大气层，从而产生可能的最快流星速度：每秒 45 英里（72 公里）。这样的速度往往会产生明亮的流星，并在其尾迹中留下持久的条纹或持续的流星。强大的狮子座火球可能相当壮观，但今年如此明亮的流星可能很少而且相距很远（如果有的话）。

paras.en: It was a different story 60 years ago, in 1966, when anticipation ran high for a potentially heavy display of Leonid meteors. The previous year, comet Tempel-Tuttle swept around the sun and was accompanied later that year by an unexpected surge of Leonid activity, with brilliant meteors darting across the sky at one or two per minute as seen from Hawaii and Australia. The most sanguine prediction for 1966 came from Dr. Kenneth L. Franklin (1923-2007), chief scientist at New York's Hayden Planetarium. Dr. Franklin had carefully examined the orbit of comet Tempel-Tuttle and concluded that " . . . the position of the comet is roughly what it was in 1833. So, a dramatic shower like the one that occurred in that year may yet be in the offing for 1966."
paras.zh: 60 年前的 1966 年，情况就不同了，当时人们对狮子座流星雨可能出现的大规模展示抱有很高的期待。前一年，坦普尔-塔特尔彗星绕着太阳扫过，同年晚些时候，狮子座流星雨的活动出人意料地激增，从夏威夷和澳大利亚可以看到，明亮的流星以每分钟一到两颗的速度划过天空。对 1966 年最乐观的预测来自纽约海登天文馆首席科学家肯尼思·L·富兰克林博士（Kenneth L. Franklin，1923-2007）。富兰克林博士仔细检查了坦普尔-塔特尔彗星的轨道，并得出结论：“……这颗彗星的位置大致与 1833 年的位置相同。因此，一场像当年发生的戏剧性流星雨可能即将在 1966 年出现。”

paras.en: Based on Dr. Franklin's prediction, a "meteor party" was planned for the peak night of the Leonids in Central Park. New Yorkers of all ages were invited to gather on the Great Lawn at midnight to watch for the shooting stars. Ten thousand people turned out, but unfortunately skies were hopelessly cloudy.
paras.zh: 根据富兰克林博士的预测，中央公园计划在狮子座流星雨的高峰之夜举办一场“流星派对”。所有年龄段的纽约人都被邀请在午夜聚集在大草坪上观看流星。有一万人参加了游行，但不幸的是，天空阴云密布。

paras.en: But across the central and western US, where skies were mostly clear, Leonids were falling at a rate described by many as "too numerous to count." One observer stationed north of Mission, Texas said that meteors falling in all directions gave the impression of a "gigantic umbrella," appearing to "waterfall" out of the head of Leo. Perhaps the best views were from California and Arizona. At the Table Mountain Observatory, near Wrightwood, California, one resident astronomer commented that he and a colleague " . . . watched a rain of meteors, turn into a hail of meteors and finally a storm of meteors, too numerous to count by 3:50 a.m. Pacific Time. Instinctively we sought to shield our upturned faces from imagined celestial debris." From 6,850-foot Kitt Peak in southern Arizona, thirteen amateur astronomers saw Leonids falling at the staggering rate of 40 per second (144,000 per hour)!
paras.zh: 但在美国中部和西部地区，天空大多晴朗，狮子座流星雨的下降速度被许多人描述为“多得难以计数”。一位驻扎在得克萨斯州米申以北的观察者表示，从各个方向落下的流星给人一种“巨大的雨伞”的印象，看起来像是从狮子座的头顶“瀑布”出来的。也许最好的景色来自加利福尼亚州和亚利桑那州。在加利福尼亚州赖特伍德附近的桌山天文台，一位常驻天文学家评论说，他和一位同事“……看到了一场流星雨，变成了流星冰雹，最后变成了一场流星风暴，到太平洋时间凌晨 3 点 50 分，数量已多得难以计数。我们本能地试图保护我们仰起的脸免受想象中的天体碎片的影响。”从亚利桑那州南部 6,850 英尺高的基特峰，13 位业余天文学家看到狮子座流星雨以每秒 40 次（每小时 144,000 次）的惊人速度坠落！

paras.en: In 2005, French meteor expert Jeremie Vaubaillon published a technical paper with two colleagues in the journal Astronomy & Astrophysics that forecast Leonid activity for years up to 2100. Sadly, in the year 2029, Jupiter is expected to throw Comet Tempel-Tuttle off its current path through space, making it all but impossible — at least through the beginning of the 22nd century — to see a repeat of the Great Leonid Storm of 1966.
paras.zh: 2005 年，法国流星专家杰里米·沃拜永 (Jeremie Vaubaillon) 与两位同事在《天文学与天体物理学》杂志上发表了一篇技术论文，预测狮子座流星雨活动将持续到 2100 年。遗憾的是，到 2029 年，木星预计将使坦普尔-塔特尔彗星偏离其当前的太空路径，从而使狮子座大风暴几乎不可能重演，至少在 22 世纪初是不可能的。 1966 年。

paras.en: But Vaubaillon expects the next big Leonid outburst in the year 2034, when rates could reach up to 2,000 per hour.
paras.zh: 但 Vaubaillon 预计狮子座流星雨的下一次爆发将在 2034 年，届时流量可能会达到每小时 2,000 次。

paras.en: That's just 8 years from now. Mark your calendars.
paras.zh: 距离现在只有 8 年了。标记你的日历。

paras.en: Joe Rao serves as an instructor and guest lecturer at New York's Hayden Planetarium. He writes about astronomy for Natural History magazine, Sky and Telescope, The Old Farmer's Almanac and other publications.
paras.zh: Joe Rao 担任纽约海登天文馆的讲师和客座讲师。他为《自然历史》杂志、《天空与望远镜》、《老农年鉴》和其他出版物撰写有关天文学的文章。

paras.en: Joe Rao is Space.com's skywatching columnist, as well as a veteran meteorologist and eclipse chaser who also serves as an instructor and guest lecturer at New York's Hayden Planetarium. He writes about astronomy for Natural History magazine, Sky & Telescope and other publications. Joe is an 8-time Emmy-nominated meteorologist who served the Putnam Valley region of New York for over 21 years. You can find him on Twitter and YouTube tracking lunar and solar eclipses, meteor showers and more. To find out Joe's latest project, visit him on Twitter.
paras.zh: 乔·拉奥 (Joe Rao) 是 Space.com 的天空观察专栏作家，也是一位资深气象学家和日食追踪者，同时也是纽约海登天文馆的讲师和客座讲师。他为《自然历史》杂志、《天空与望远镜》和其他出版物撰写有关天文学的文章。 Joe 是一位曾 8 次获得艾美奖提名的气象学家，为纽约普特南谷地区服务超过 21 年。您可以在 Twitter 和 YouTube 上找到他跟踪月食、日食、流星雨等。要了解 Joe 的最新项目，请访问他的 Twitter。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 13, 1971: NASA's Mariner 9 becomes 1st spacecraft to orbit Mars, revealing close looks at the Martian surface
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 13, 1971, Mariner 9 became the first spacecraft to orbit Mars. At the time, scientists didn't know much about the Red Planet.
paras.zh: 1971 年 11 月 13 日，水手 9 号成为第一艘环绕火星运行的航天器。当时，科学家们对这颗红色星球了解不多。

paras.en: NASA had several Mars flybys before Mariner 9. Those flybys showed that Mars had a cratered surface, so some scientists thought that Mars looked just like the moon. Then Mariner 9 blew blew their minds.
paras.zh: NASA在水手9号之前曾多次飞越火星。这些飞越表明火星表面有坑坑洼洼，因此一些科学家认为火星看起来就像月球一样。然后水手9号的爆炸让他们大吃一惊。

paras.en: When Mariner 9 got to Mars, it arrived in the middle of a dust storm. It saw some tall structures sticking through the clouds. When the dust settled, images from Mariner 9 revealed that these structures were the tops of huge volcanoes.
paras.zh: 当水手九号抵达火星时，它正值沙尘暴之中。它看到一些高大的建筑物刺破云层。当尘埃落定后，水手九号的图像显示这些结构是巨大火山的顶部。

paras.en: One volcano, Olympus Mons, is the tallest in the solar system. Mariner 9 also spotted an enormous canyon called Valles Marineris. This canyon is five times longer than the Grand Canyon in Arizona.
paras.zh: 其中一座火山是奥林匹斯山，是太阳系中最高的火山。水手 9 号还发现了一个名为 Valles Marineris 的巨大峡谷。这个峡谷比亚利桑那州大峡谷长五倍。

paras.en: Mariner 9 worked for one year in orbit. When it ran out of gas, NASA shut it off. But the spacecraft remains one of the most famous Mars voyagers of all time.
paras.zh: 水手九号在轨道上工作了一年。当它耗尽气体时，美国宇航局将其关闭。但该航天器仍然是有史以来最著名的火星航行者之一。

paras.en: Mariner 9 cemented its place in space history when it entered into orbit around Mars, the first human-built spacecraft ever to do so.
paras.zh: 水手 9 号进入火星轨道，巩固了其在太空历史上的地位，这是有史以来第一艘人造航天器。

paras.en: The NASA spacecraft actually beat the Soviet Union's own Mars 2 spacecraft to the Red Planet, even though Mars 2 "had an 11-day head start," NASA said in a mission description. (Mars 2 would go on to be the first human-built craft to impact the surface of Mars when it crashed into the Red Planet.)
paras.zh: 美国宇航局在任务描述中表示，尽管火星 2 号“领先了 11 天”，但美国宇航局的航天器实际上击败了苏联自己的火星 2 号航天器到达这颗红色星球。 （火星 2 号撞上了这颗红色星球，成为第一艘撞击火星表面的人造飞船。）

paras.en: But it was the science from Mariner 9 that transformed Mars from a mysterious Red Planet into a full world for humans to explore.
paras.zh: 但水手九号的科学知识将火星从一颗神秘的红色星球变成了一个可供人类探索的完整世界。

paras.en: Mariner 9 carried four primary instruments to study Mars, including a camera system for imaging, an ultraviolet spectrometer, an infrared spectrometer and an infrared radiometer. The probe mapped 85% of Mars with those tools during its nearly one-year mission.
paras.zh: 水手9号携带了四台主要仪器来研究火星，包括用于成像的相机系统、紫外光谱仪、红外光谱仪和红外辐射计。该探测器在近一年的任务中使用这些工具绘制了火星 85% 的地图。

paras.en: The Mariner 9 spacecraft discovered 20 giant volcanoes on Mars (including Olympus Mars) and made key observations to map Valles Marineris, which runs 2,500 miles (4,000 kilometers) long acros the Tharsis region and is 120 miles (200 km) wide.
paras.zh: 水手 9 号航天器在火星（包括奥林匹斯火星）上发现了 20 座巨型火山，并进行了关键观测以绘制水手谷地图，该谷横跨塔尔西斯地区，长 2,500 英里（4,000 公里），宽 120 英里（200 公里）。

paras.en: "The canyon was named in honor of Mariner 9," NASA said in an overview.
paras.zh: NASA 在一份概述中表示：“该峡谷的命名是为了纪念水手 9 号。”

paras.en: In all, Mariner 9 took 7,329 photos of the surface of Mars, mapping the planet down to a resolution of between 1/2-1 mile (1-2 km). It also snapped at least 80 photos of Phobos and Deimos, the two small moons of Mars.
paras.zh: 水手 9 号总共拍摄了 7,329 张火星表面照片，以 1/2-1 英里（1-2 公里）的分辨率绘制了火星地图。它还拍摄了至少 80 张火星两颗小卫星火卫一和火卫二的照片。

paras.en: By February 1972, Mariner 9's supply of gaseous nitrogen, which it used to feed its attitide control thrusters, had run dry. NASA finally shut down the mission in October 1972.
paras.zh: 到 1972 年 2 月，水手 9 号用于供给姿态控制推进器的气态氮供应已经耗尽。 NASA 最终于 1972 年 10 月终止了该任务。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: SpaceX launches Starship on ambitious 22-hour Flight 15 test, but aborts booster 'chopsticks' catch (video)
articles.author: Josh Dinner

paras.en: STARBASE, Texas — SpaceX launched the 15th test flight of its massive Starship rocket today (Nov. 13) and is preparing the vehicle's upper stage for its first-ever return to the launch site in less than 24 hours.
paras.zh: 得克萨斯州 STARBASE——今天（11 月 13 日）SpaceX 对其大型 Starship 火箭进行了第 15 次试飞，并正在准备火箭的上级，以便在不到 24 小时内首次返回发射场。

paras.en: Flight 15 lifted off from SpaceX's Starbase facility here in South Texas at 5:47 p.m. ET (2247 GMT; 4:47 p.m. local Texas time). The towering Super Heavy booster and Ship upper stage cleared the tower without incident and climbed into the skies under more than 18 million pounds of thrust from the booster's 33 Raptor 3 engines.
paras.zh: 15 号航班于下午 5 点 47 分从 SpaceX 位于德克萨斯州南部的 Starbase 设施起飞。东部时间（2247 GMT；德克萨斯州当地时间下午 4:47）。高耸的超重型助推器和飞船上级顺利地越过塔楼，并在助推器 33 台 Raptor 3 发动机提供的超过 1800 万磅的推力下爬上天空。

paras.en: The flight continued nominally through its initial ascent, with the successful execution of Super Heavy's main engine cutoff and Ship's subsequent hot-staging — firing its own Raptors during separation from the booster — about 2.5 minutes after launch. Following stage separation, Super Heavy reoriented for a planned return to Starbase as Ship powered its way toward low Earth orbit (LEO).
paras.zh: 飞行名义上继续进行最初的上升，发射后约 2.5 分钟，成功执行了“超重型”主发动机的切断，以及飞船随后的热升级（在与助推器分离期间发射自己的猛禽）。级分离后，超重型飞船重新调整方向，计划返回星际基地，同时飞船向低地球轨道（LEO）行驶。

paras.en: SpaceX originally planned to catch Super Heavy with the Starbase launch tower's giant mechanical "chopstick" arms. But it wasn't to be: The company called off the catch attempt and brought the booster down for a controlled splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico about 6.5 minutes after launch, for reasons that were not immediately clear.
paras.zh: SpaceX 最初计划用 Starbase 发射塔的巨型机械“筷子”臂来捕获“超重”。但事实并非如此：该公司取消了捕获尝试，并在发射后约 6.5 分钟将助推器降落在墨西哥湾，以进行受控溅落，原因尚不清楚。

paras.en: A successful catch would have been a significant milestone for SpaceX and its efforts to design Starship as a fully and rapidly reusable launch vehicle. It would have been the first successful recovery of a Version 3 (V3) Super Heavy, which SpaceX began flying earlier this year. The company previously recovered three of its V1 Super Heavy vehicles and reused two of those in later flights.
paras.zh: 对于 SpaceX 及其将 Starship 设计为完全且快速可重复使用的运载火箭的努力来说，成功捕获将是一个重要的里程碑。这将是 SpaceX 今年早些时候开始飞行的第 3 版 (V3) 超重型飞机的首次成功回收。该公司此前回收了三辆 V1 超重型车辆，并在以后的航班中重复使用了其中两辆。

paras.en: Ship's Raptors continued to fire following stage separation, completing their first burn just after eight minutes into flight. All went according to plan after that for Ship as well: A second engine burn lasting about 20 seconds parked Ship in LEO at an altitude of around 170 miles (275 kilometers) at T+26 minutes and 10 seconds.
paras.zh: 船上的猛禽在级分离后继续开火，在飞行八分钟后完成了第一次燃烧。此后，船舶的一切都按计划进行：在 T+26 分 10 秒，第二次发动机燃烧持续约 20 秒，停泊在 LEO 高度约 170 英里（275 公里）的船舶。

paras.en: "We’ve got a nominal orbit insertion, so Starship now in orbit around Earth for the second time ever," SpaceX's Dan Huot said during today's Flight 15 launch webcast. "That’s a really great moment."
paras.zh: SpaceX 的 Dan Huot 在今天的 Flight 15 发射网络广播中表示：“我们已经完成了名义上的轨道插入，因此 Starship 现在第二次进入绕地球轨道。” “那真是一个伟大的时刻。”

paras.en: Ship first reached orbit on Flight 14, which launched on Sept. 28.
paras.zh: 飞船于 9 月 28 日发射，于 14 号航班首次进入轨道。

paras.en: Ship carried 26 of SpaceX's Starlink V3 spacecraft, which were deployed into LEO on schedule today over a 42-minute span starting 35 minutes after launch.
paras.zh: 这艘船搭载了 26 艘 SpaceX 的 Starlink V3 航天器，这些航天器今天在发射后 35 分钟开始，在 42 分钟内按计划部署到近地轨道。

paras.en: The upgraded wireless internet satellites are the second V3 batch to reach orbit, after a set of 26 that were delivered on Flight 14 . V3s are significantly more powerful than SpaceX's V2 Starlinks, which currently number more than 11,000 in LEO. The addition of this new set of V3s will add a terabit of data capacity to the constellation, according to SpaceX's Flight 15 mission outline. That's equivalent to the amount contributed by 10 Starlink V2 launches, which are carried out by SpaceX's Falcon 9 rocket.
paras.zh: 升级后的无线互联网卫星是继 14 号航班交付的 26 颗卫星之后第二批进入轨道的 V3 卫星。 V3 比 SpaceX 的 V2 星链更强大，后者目前在近地轨道上的数量超过 11,000 个。根据 SpaceX 的 Flight 15 任务大纲，这组新 V3 的添加将为该星座增加 1 太比特的数据容量。这相当于 SpaceX 的猎鹰 9 号火箭进行 10 次星链 V2 发射所贡献的金额。

paras.en: Three of the V3 Starlinks flying today were equipped with cameras to point back at Ship after deployment in order to analyze its heatshield tiles and other hardware following its ascent to orbit. Their data will help SpaceX determine if Ship can indeed come home to Starbase on Saturday.
paras.zh: 今天飞行的三架 V3 Starlinks 配备了摄像机，在部署后可以指向飞船，以便在飞船升入轨道后分析其隔热板和其他硬件。他们的数据将帮助 SpaceX 确定 Ship 是否确实能够在周六返回 Starbase。

paras.en: "Starship will only execute a return to launch site if the flight control team has ensured that the vehicle systems critical for reentry maneuvers and final landing burn and tower approach are healthy," SpaceX wrote in its Flight 15 mission description.
paras.zh: SpaceX 在其 Flight 15 任务描述中写道：“只有飞行控制团队确保对再入机动、最终着陆燃烧和塔台进场至关重要的飞行器系统都处于健康状态，星舰才会执行返回发射场的任务。”

paras.en: SpaceX engineers will have ample time to go over Ship's systems before making a final landing decision. Ship is scheduled to circle Earth 14 times, spending more than 21 hours in space before coming home.
paras.zh: 在做出最终着陆决定之前，SpaceX 工程师将有充足的时间检查飞船的系统。飞船计划绕地球飞行 14 圈，在太空中停留超过 21 小时后返回。

paras.en: You can follow all of the action on here at Space.com via our Flight 15 live updates page.
paras.zh: 您可以通过我们的 Flight 15 实时更新页面关注 Space.com 上的所有活动。

paras.en: SpaceX has reserved three contingency checkpoints during Flight 15's mission timeline to allow for an early Pacific Ocean return, should engineers determine a catch attempt to be unfeasible or unwise. The first comes just 10 minutes after the completion of Starlink satellite deployment, the second at T+7 hours and 15 minutes, and a final one at T+20 hours and 41 minutes.
paras.zh: SpaceX 在 15 号航班的任务时间内预留了三个应急检查点，以便在工程师确定捕获尝试不可行或不明智的情况下提前返回太平洋。第一个是在星链卫星部署完成后仅 10 分钟发生的，第二个是在 T+7 小时 15 分钟时发生的，最后一个是在 T+20 小时 41 分钟时发生的。

paras.en: Should Ship continue to look good through each of these milestones, SpaceX will proceed with a 10-second deorbit burn at approximately T+21 hours and 36 minutes, setting the spacecraft on a trajectory back toward South Texas. Its plunge through Earth's atmosphere will begin about 35 minutes later. SpaceX has also designated a contingency splashdown zone in the Gulf of Mexico, should conditions prevent a safe catch during Ship's final approach.
paras.zh: 如果 Ship 在每个里程碑中都表现良好，SpaceX 将在大约 T+21 小时 36 分钟进行 10 秒的脱轨燃烧，使航天器沿着返回德克萨斯州南部的轨道运行。大约 35 分钟后，它将开始冲入地球大气层。 SpaceX 还在墨西哥湾指定了一个应急溅落区，以防在飞船最后进近期间出现无法安全捕获的情况。

paras.en: If all goes according to plan, Ship will return to Starbase on Saturday at approximately 4:17 p.m. EST (2117 GMT; 3:17 p.m. Texas time), about 22.5 hours after liftoff. A successful catch would be a major milestone for SpaceX — the first-ever recovery of a Starship upper stage.
paras.zh: 如果一切按计划进行，飞船将于周六下午 4:17 左右返回 Starbase。美国东部时间（2117 GMT；德克萨斯时间下午 3:17），起飞后约 22.5 小时。成功捕获将成为 SpaceX 的一个重要里程碑——这是有史以来第一次回收星际飞船的上级。

paras.en: Full reusability is central to the company's ambitions for launching its V3 Starlink satellites, as well as a proposed constellation of orbital data centers envisioned by company founder and CEO Elon Musk. The next-gen Starlink constellation will consist of about 100,000 satellites, while the AI network will be 10 times that size, Musk has said. Building and maintaining those constellations will require a mind-boggling number of launches. Indeed, SpaceX is targeting 10,000 Starship liftoffs per year by 2030, according to Musk.
paras.zh: 完全可重复使用性是该公司发射 V3 Starlink 卫星以及公司创始人兼首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 设想的轨道数据中心星座的雄心壮志的核心。马斯克表示，下一代星链星座将由约 10 万颗卫星组成，而人工智能网络的规模将是这个规模的 10 倍。建设和维护这些星座将需要数量惊人的发射。事实上，据马斯克称，SpaceX 的目标是到 2030 年每年实现 10,000 次星际飞船升空。

paras.en: Some of Starship's other planned missions won't necessarily require full reusability, but the spacecraft's reliability will be critical to NASA's Artemis program and its efforts to return astronauts to the moon. The space agency selected Starship as one of the program's crewed lunar landers, and it's slated to fly a demonstration mission with NASA's Orion spacecraft and Artemis III astronauts to Earth orbit in the summer of 2027.
paras.zh: 星舰计划中的一些其他任务不一定需要完全可重复使用，但航天器的可靠性对于美国宇航局的阿尔忒弥斯计划及其将宇航员送回月球的努力至关重要。美国宇航局选择 Starship 作为该计划的载人月球着陆器之一，并计划于 2027 年夏天与 NASA 的猎户座飞船和 Artemis III 宇航员一起执行飞往地球轨道的演示任务。

paras.en: Editor's note: This story was updated at 7:10 p.m. ET on Nov. 13 with news of successful payload deployment.
paras.zh: 编者注：本文更新于晚上 7 点 10 分。美国东部时间 11 月 13 日发布有效负载成功部署的消息。

paras.en: Josh Dinner is Space.com's Spaceflight Staff Writer and a photographer with a passion for science and exploration. He has worked the space beat since 2016, covering the evolution of NASA's commercial spaceflight partnerships and crewed missions, planetary science missions, the Artemis program and humanity's return to the moon. He also enjoys building 1:144-scale model rockets and spacecraft. Find some of Josh's launch photography on Instagram, and follow him on X, where he mostly posts in haiku.
paras.zh: 乔什·丁纳 (Joshdinner) 是 Space.com 的 Spaceflight 特约撰稿人，也是一位热衷于科学和探索的摄影师。自 2016 年以来，他一直致力于太空领域的研究，报道了 NASA 商业航天合作伙伴关系和载人任务、行星科学任务、阿尔忒弥斯计划和人类重返月球的演变。他还喜欢建造 1:144 比例的火箭和航天器模型。在 Instagram 上查找 Josh 的一些首发照片，并在 X 上关注他，他主要在 X 上发布俳句。

articles.title: Horizon Microtechnologies Targets Constellation-Scale Production As Esa Phi-Lab Selection Strengthens Industrialisation Push
articles.author: Horizon Microtechnologies

paras.en: (Karlsruhe, Germany, September 29th 2026) Horizon Microtechnologies is accelerating industrialisation of its metallised polymer micro-additive manufacturing platform through IP-MASS, a two-year scale-up project supported by €500,000 and reinforced by selection for ESA Phi-Lab Austria.
paras.zh: （德国卡尔斯鲁厄，2026 年 9 月 29 日）Horizo​​n Microtechnologies 正在通过 IP-MASS 加速其金属化聚合物微增材制造平台的工业化，这是一个为期两年的扩大项目，由 500,000 欧元支持，并得到 ESA Phi-Lab Austria 的选择加强。

paras.en: The programme is expanding Horizon’s printing, coating and process-verification capabilities for shielding housings and other passive RF hardware, targeting up to 50,000 precision-coated satellite components and a repeatable manufacturing framework suited to constellation-class demand rather than one-off prototype production.
paras.zh: 该计划正在扩展 Horizo​​n 的屏蔽外壳和其他无源射频硬件的印刷、涂层和工艺验证能力，目标是多达 50,000 个精密涂层卫星组件和适合星座级需求而不是一次性原型生产的可重复制造框架。

paras.en: Horizon combines precision polymer 3D printing with conformal metallisation and protective coatings. Polymer provides the precision bulk geometry, while metal is applied only to the thickness required. Replacing even lightweight metals such as aluminium with metallised polymer can reduce weight by 40%, while 3D printing can deliver further size, weight and design advantages alongside attractive economics compared with conventionally machined metal parts.
paras.zh: Horizo​​n 将精密聚合物 3D 打印与保形金属化和保护涂层相结合。聚合物提供了精确的整体几何形状，而金属仅应用到所需的厚度。即使用金属化聚合物取代铝等轻质金属，也可以减轻 40% 的重量，而与传统加工的金属零件相比，3D 打印可以提供更大的尺寸、重量和设计优势，同时具有有吸引力的经济性。

paras.en: ESA Phi-Lab Austria’s “Industrialization by Design” focus supports upstream space technologies with commercial potential, reflecting the move towards scalable, reliable and cost-effective industrial products.
paras.zh: ESA Phi-Lab Austria 的“设计工业化”重点支持具有商业潜力的上游空间技术，反映了向可扩展、可靠和具有成本效益的工业产品迈进。

paras.en: Importantly, IP-MASS is not limited to shielding housings. Horizon is also seeking spacecraft and space-related terrestrial applications where polymer 3D printing and metallisation could address product requirements, manufacturing constraints or future volume demand.
paras.zh: 重要的是，IP-MASS 不仅限于屏蔽外壳。 Horizo​​n 还在寻求航天器和与太空相关的地面应用，其中聚合物 3D 打印和金属化可以满足产品要求、制造限制或未来的批量需求。

paras.en: “Horizon has proved that metallised polymer micro-AM can deliver far more than lightweight prototypes,” said Andreas Frölich, CEO of Horizon Microtechnologies. “The next challenge is industrial: achieving the prices, lead times, repeatability and throughput needed when a component is required not once or ten times, but thousands or tens of thousands of times.”
paras.zh: Horizo​​n Microtechnologies 首席执行官 Andreas Frölich 表示：“Horizo​​n 已经证明，金属化聚合物微型增材制造的性能远超轻型原型。” “下一个挑战是工业领域：当某个组件的需求不是一次或十次，而是数千或数万次时，实现所需的价格、交货时间、可重复性和吞吐量。”

paras.en: Frölich adds, “Shielding housings give us a strong first industrialisation case, but they are not the limit. We also want to address components where lightweight printed geometry and functional metallic surfaces could create a meaningful technical or manufacturing advantage.”
paras.zh: Frölich 补充道：“屏蔽外壳为我们提供了强大的第一个工业化案例，但它们并不是限制。我们还希望解决轻质印刷几何形状和功能性金属表面可以创造有意义的技术或制造优势的组件。”

paras.en: The move builds on Horizon’s space-readiness work, which subjected representative metallised polymer demonstrators to established LEO tests including outgassing, temperature shock, radiation, mechanical shock, material fatigue and atomic-oxygen exposure.
paras.zh: 此举建立在地平线太空准备工作的基础上，该工作对代表性金属化聚合物演示器进行了既定的低地球轨道测试，包括排气、温度冲击、辐射、机械冲击、材料疲劳和原子氧暴露。

paras.en: For high-volume satellite architectures such as phased-array payloads, components may be used hundreds of times per spacecraft and across hundreds of satellites, turning component-level mass and cost savings into significant programme-level gains.
paras.zh: 对于相控阵有效载荷等大容量卫星架构，每个航天器和数百颗卫星上的组件可能会使用数百次，从而将组件级质量和成本节省转化为显着的项目级收益。

paras.en: IP-MASS also provides scope to cooperate on applications with anticipated demand of 100 units per year or more. Partners do not need a fully developed component: early-stage concepts are welcome while design-for-manufacturability decisions can still be made.
paras.zh: IP-MASS 还提供了针对每年预计需求 100 台或更多的应用的合作范围。合作伙伴不需要完全开发的组件：欢迎早期概念，同时仍然可以做出可制造性设计决策。

paras.en: “We do not want to assume that we already know every application where this technology can create value,” Frölich says. “The organisations designing next-generation spacecraft know where their product and manufacturing constraints are. We want them to bring those challenges to us so we can explore whether the technology is relevant and, where it is, potentially shape the manufacturing route together.”
paras.zh: “我们不想假设我们已经知道这项技术可以创造价值的每一个应用，”Frölich 说。 “设计下一代航天器的组织知道他们的产品和制造限制在哪里。我们希望他们将这些挑战带给我们，这样我们就可以探索该技术是否相关，以及它在哪里，有可能共同塑造制造路线。”

paras.en: Horizon is moving beyond validation towards an industrial manufacturing platform for next-generation satellite hardware, while inviting the space community to help identify which applications it should industrialise next.
paras.zh: Horizo​​n 正在超越验证，转向下一代卫星硬件的工业制造平台，同时邀请航天界帮助确定下一步应该工业化哪些应用。

paras.en: Horizon is a member of the Green Space Center, an initiative supported by the State of Baden-Württemberg and based at the Chamber of Commerce and Industry Reutlingen (IHK Reutlingen) that promotes innovation in water management, New Space, and intelligent systems.
paras.zh: Horizo​​n 是绿色空间中心的成员，该中心由巴登-符腾堡州支持，总部设在罗伊特林根工商会 (IHK Reutlingen)，旨在促进水管理、新空间和智能系统方面的创新。

paras.en: “We help SMEs in Baden-Württemberg internationalize space-related business models and products and support their entry into international markets,” said Marcin Bielecki, Head of Technology at the Green Space Center.
paras.zh: 绿色空间中心技术主管 Marcin Bielecki 表示：“我们帮助巴登-符腾堡州的中小企业实现与太空相关的商业模式和产品的国际化，并支持他们进入国际市场。”

paras.en: The initiative aims to position Baden-Württemberg as a sustainability-driven hub for space technology by fostering cross-sector collaboration and applying space technologies to create ecological impact.
paras.zh: 该倡议旨在通过促进跨部门合作和应用空间技术创造生态影响，将巴登符腾堡州定位为可持续发展驱动的空间技术中心。

paras.en: Baden-Württemberg hosts a dynamic and rapidly growing New Space ecosystem, including leading European companies such as ATMOS Space Cargo, HyImpulse, ConstellR and CELERES while supporting emerging innovators such as InSpacePropulsion Technologies (ISPTech) and Yugen Space.
paras.zh: 巴登符腾堡州拥有一个充满活力且快速发展的新太空生态系统，包括 ATMOS Space Cargo、HyImpulse、ConstellR 和 CELERES 等欧洲领先公司，同时支持 InSpacePropulsion Technologies (ISPTech) 和 Yugen Space 等新兴创新者。

articles.title: Moog Marks 25 Years Since ESPA Design Milestone: Innovating Space Rideshare
articles.author: Moog Inc.

paras.en: East Aurora, N.Y. — Moog Inc. (NYSE: MOG.A and MOG.B) marks 25 years since the Evolved Secondary Payload Adapter (ESPA) ring completed its Critical Design Review in 2001. The pioneering technology helped advance space rideshare by enabling multiple payloads to share a launch and broadening access to orbit for commercial, government, and defense missions.
paras.zh: 纽约州东奥罗拉 — 穆格公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：MOG.A 和 MOG.B）纪念演进型辅助有效载荷适配器 (ESPA) 环于 2001 年完成关键设计审查以来 25 周年。这项开创性技术通过支持多个有效载荷共享发射并拓宽商业、政府和国防任务的轨道通道，帮助推进了太空共享出行。

paras.en: Development of ESPA began in 1999 through a collaborative government-industry initiative, culminating in the successful completion of its Critical Design Review on January 18, 2001. The ESPA ring enabled launch vehicles to carry multiple secondary payloads by efficiently using previously unused volume beneath primary satellites. This approach lowered costs and increased mission flexibility, supporting commercial satellite constellations, technology demonstrations, and critical defense operations.
paras.zh: ESPA 的开发始于 1999 年，通过政府与行业的合作倡议，最终于 2001 年 1 月 18 日成功完成了关键设计审查。ESPA 环使运载火箭能够通过有效利用主卫星下方以前未使用的空间来携带多个辅助有效载荷。这种方法降低了成本并提高了任务灵活性，支持商业卫星星座、技术演示和关键防御行动。

paras.en: “ESPA helped redefine access to space by enabling additional payloads to share a launch with primary missions. Its impact continues across commercial, government, and military space—and its story reflects the value of enduring collaboration between Air Force Research Lab (AFRL) and industry partners such as Moog,” said Dr. Darren Raspa, chief historian, AFRL Space and Directed Energy Systems.
paras.zh: AFRL 空间和定向能源系统首席历史学家达伦·拉斯帕 (Darren Raspa) 博士表示：“ESPA 通过启用额外的有效载荷与主要任务共享发射，帮助重新定义了太空访问。它的影响持续遍及商业、政府和军事太空，它的故事反映了空军研究实验室 (AFRL) 与穆格等行业合作伙伴之间持久合作的价值。”

paras.en: Over the past 25 years, the ESPA family has evolved into a versatile, modular platform supporting varied payload sizes and interface configurations. ESPA-derived designs have also served as the structural foundation for spacecraft buses. Today, the platform continues to support mission planning for NASA, the U.S. government, and commercial space ventures worldwide.
paras.zh: 在过去的 25 年里，ESPA 系列已发展成为一个多功能的模块化平台，支持各种有效负载大小和接口配置。 ESPA 衍生设计也成为航天器总线的结构基础。如今，该平台继续支持 NASA、美国政府和全球商业航天企业的任务规划。

paras.en: Moog continues to offer a family of ESPA configurations, including Standard ESPA, ESPA Heavy, and ESPA Grande, designed to accommodate evolving payload and mission requirements. The platform’s modular architecture and adaptable interfaces support rideshare missions, payload integration, and spacecraft applications across the growing space market.
paras.zh: 穆格继续提供一系列 ESPA 配置，包括标准 ESPA、ESPA Heavy 和 ESPA Grande，旨在适应不断变化的有效载荷和任务要求。该平台的模块化架构和适应性强的接口支持不断增长的太空市场中的乘车共享任务、有效载荷集成和航天器应用。

paras.en: “The ESPA ring began as a technical solution to a practical challenge: maximizing every launch opportunity,” said Timothy Pargett, general manager, Moog Payload Adapters and Isolation business. “Today, it stands as a cornerstone of how missions, large and small, gain cost-effective, reliable access to orbit through rideshare. Its enduring legacy reflects visionary innovation and trusted partnerships across the aerospace community.”
paras.zh: “ESPA 环最初是作为应对实际挑战的技术解决方案：最大化每个发射机会，”穆格有效负载适配器和隔离业务总经理 Timothy Pargett 说道。 “如今，它已成为大大小小的任务如何通过拼车获得具有成本效益且可靠的轨道访问的基石。它的持久遗产反映了整个航空航天界的富有远见的创新和值得信赖的合作伙伴关系。”

paras.en: In conjunction with the anniversary, a Moog flight-qualified ESPA ring will be on display at the National Museum of Nuclear Science & History in Albuquerque, N.M., from November 7, 2026, through January 10, 2027.
paras.zh: 为庆祝周年纪念日，一枚符合穆格飞行资格的 ESPA 环将于 2026 年 11 月 7 日至 2027 年 1 月 10 日在新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基的国家核科学与历史博物馆展出。

paras.en: Museum visitors will have the opportunity to see firsthand the hardware that helped advance rideshare and enable diverse space missions.
paras.zh: 博物馆参观者将有机会亲眼目睹有助于推进乘车共享和实现多样化太空任务的硬件。

paras.en: As ESPA enters its next chapter, Moog continues to advance spacecraft payload integration and develop adaptable solutions that expand flexible, cost-effective access to orbit for future space exploration and defense missions.
paras.zh: 随着 ESPA 进入新篇章，穆格将继续推进航天器有效载荷集成，并开发适应性强的解决方案，为未来的太空探索和防御任务扩展灵活、经济高效的轨道访问。

paras.en: Moog is a worldwide designer, manufacturer, and systems integrator of high-performance precision motion and fluid controls and control systems. Moog’s high-performance systems control military and commercial aircraft, satellites, and space vehicles, launch vehicles, defense systems, missiles, automated industrial machinery, marine, and medical equipment. Additional information about the Company can be found at www.moog.com or www.moog.com/space.
paras.zh: 穆格是全球高性能精密运动和流体控制及控制系统的设计者、制造商和系统集成商。穆格的高性能系统控制军用和商用飞机、卫星和航天器、运载火箭、防御系统、导弹、自动化工业机械、船舶和医疗设备。有关公司的更多信息，请访问 www.moog.com 或 www.moog.com/space。

articles.title: Senate committee takes up nominees for NASA chief financial officer and inspector general
articles.author: Jeff Foust

paras.en: WASHINGTON — A Senate committee is set to advance nominations for NASA’s chief financial officer and inspector general.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——参议院委员会将推进对 NASA 首席财务官和监察长的提名。

paras.en: The Senate Commerce Committee held a hearing Nov. 10 to consider nominations for several posts, including that of Joshua Shoemaker to be NASA’s chief financial officer and Robert Steinau to be inspector general. Those are two of the four positions at the agency that require Senate confirmation; the others are administrator and deputy administrator.
paras.zh: 参议院商务委员会于 11 月 10 日举行听证会，审议多个职位的提名，包括提名约书亚·舒梅克 (Joshua Shoemaker) 担任 NASA 首席财务官，以及罗伯特·斯坦瑙 (Robert Steinau) 担任监察长。这是该机构需要参议院批准的四个职位中的两个。其他人为行政长官和副行政长官。

paras.en: Neither nominee received many questions during the hearing, which lasted a little more than an hour. Senators largely focused their attention on the nomination of Danielle Thumann to be a member of the Federal Communications Commission.
paras.zh: 在持续一个多小时的听证会上，两位提名人都没有收到很多问题。参议员们的注意力主要集中在丹妮尔·图曼 (Danielle T humann) 担任联邦通信委员会成员的提名上。

paras.en: Shoemaker is an accountant who has worked for more than 20 years in the private sector and in the Mississippi state government. Since August, he has been a senior adviser in NASA’s Mission Support Directorate, and before that was controller for the Republican National Committee.
paras.zh: Shoemaker 是一名会计师，在私营部门和密西西比州政府工作了 20 多年。自八月以来，他一直担任美国宇航局任务支持理事会的高级顾问，在此之前，他曾担任共和党全国委员会的财务总监。

paras.en: Steinau has worked since 2009 at NASA’s Office of Inspector General, and since December 2024 has served as the office’s senior official in the absence of a Senate-confirmed inspector general. He previously worked for the Department of Energy’s Office of Inspector General and for the U.S. Secret Service.
paras.zh: 斯坦瑙自 2009 年以来一直在 NASA 监察长办公室工作，并自 2024 年 12 月起在参议院确认监察长缺席的情况下担任该办公室的高级官员。他此前曾在能源部监察长办公室和美国特勤局工作。

paras.en: Shoemaker, in his opening statement at the nomination hearing, said he would focus on financial accountability, improved visibility into financial performance of NASA programs, transparency with Congress on that performance and modernization of NASA financial systems.
paras.zh: 舒梅克在提名听证会上的开场发言中表示，他将重点关注财务责任、提高 NASA 项目财务绩效的可见性、国会对该绩效的透明度以及 NASA 财务系统的现代化。

paras.en: “I believe the CFO has an important responsibility to give the administrator, NASA leadership and Congress an honest and timely picture of the agency’s financial position,” he said. He added that means how programs are performing against their planned budgets and schedules as well as ensuring effective management of resources.
paras.zh: 他说：“我认为首席财务官负有重要责任，要向行政长官、美国宇航局领导层和国会诚实、及时地介绍该机构的财务状况。”他补充说，这意味着项目如何根据计划预算和时间表执行，以及确保资源的有效管理。

paras.en: He deferred questions on specific programs as well as on the proposed U.S. Space Academy that a presidential commission, led by NASA, is studying. Shoemaker said that decisions on locating the academy will ultimately be made by the president.
paras.zh: 他推迟了有关具体计划以及由美国宇航局领导的总统委员会正在研究的拟议美国太空学院的问题。舒梅克表示，学院选址的决定最终将由总统做出。

paras.en: Steinau said that, as inspector general, he would focus on three critical challenges for NASA: returning humans to the moon, transitioning from the International Space Station to commercial stations and cybersecurity.
paras.zh: 斯坦瑙表示，作为监察长，他将重点关注美国宇航局面临的三个关键挑战：将人类送上月球、从国际空间站过渡到商业空间站以及网络安全。

paras.en: “NASA is moving with urgency, and it is imperative that accountability keep pace with ambition,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“美国宇航局正在紧急行动，责任必须与雄心同步。”

paras.en: The Senate Commerce Committee announced Nov. 11 that it will meet Nov. 18 to vote on the nominees at the Nov. 10 hearing, sending them, if approved, to the full Senate for a confirmation vote.
paras.zh: 参议院商务委员会11月11日宣布，将于11月18日举行会议，在11月10日的听证会上对提名人进行投票，如果获得批准，将送交参议院全体会议进行确认投票。

paras.en: NASA has been without a Senate-confirmed chief financial officer since the start of the Trump administration in January 2025. The White House nominated Greg Autry for that position in the spring of 2025, but the nomination was returned by the Senate without acting on it at the end of the year. NASA has lacked a Senate-confirmed inspector general since the departure of Paul Martin in late 2023.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年 1 月特朗普政府上台以来，NASA 一直没有经过参议院确认的首席财务官。白宫于 2025 年春季提名格雷格·奥特里担任该职位，但参议院在年底未对提名采取行动，而是退回了该提名。自 2023 年底保罗·马丁离职以来，NASA 一直缺乏经参议院确认的监察长。

articles.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak: Unrest fuelled by armed groups holds back response

paras.en: DR Congo Ebola outbreak: Unrest fuelled by armed groups holds back response
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国埃博拉疫情：武装团体引发的骚乱阻碍了应对工作

paras.en: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread amid repeated and ongoing deadly attacks on civilians and frontline health workers by armed groups that are obstructing efforts to stop transmission, UN responders said on Friday.
paras.zh: 联合国应急人员周五表示，刚果民主共和国的埃博拉疫情继续蔓延，武装团体不断对平民和前线卫生工作者进行致命袭击，阻碍阻止传播的努力。

paras.en: In an update, the UN Senior Ebola Response Coordinator, Julien Harneis, stressed that more people are being killed by Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) fighters than by Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus in recent days.
paras.zh: 联合国高级埃博拉应对协调员朱利安·哈尼斯 (Julien Harneis) 在最新消息中强调，最近几天，被民主同盟军 (ADF) 战士杀害的人数比被本迪布焦病毒引起的埃博拉疾病杀害的人数还要多。

paras.en: And yet attacks on “tens of villages" across the south of Ituri and North Kivu provinces go "unnoticed", Mr. Harneis maintained. “People are scared, people are furious at the lack of action on this...following up contact tracing in areas where ADF operating is a very hazardous idea.”
paras.zh: 然而，哈内斯坚称，伊图里省南部和北基伍省“数十个村庄”遭受的袭击“未被注意到”。 “人们感到害怕，人们对缺乏对此采取行动感到愤怒……在 ADF 开展行动的地区进行追踪接触者是一个非常危险的想法。”

paras.en: Echoing that message, the UN World Health Organization (WHO)’s Dr Chikwe Ihekweazu, Executive Director of WHO’s Health Emergencies Programme, said that despite much progress in containing transmission within eastern DRC, about 400 to 500 cases of infection are still being identified every week.
paras.zh: 联合国世界卫生组织 (WHO) 卫生紧急项目执行主任 Chikwe Ihekweazu 博士回应了这一信息，他表示，尽管在遏制刚果民主共和国东部传播方面取得了很大进展，但每周仍发现约 400 至 500 例感染病例。

paras.en: This trend is linked to the emergence of cases in rural and hard-to-reach areas.
paras.zh: 这一趋势与农村和偏远地区病例的出现有关。

paras.en: In more positive developments, the WHO official noted that prevention efforts have led to “a significant reduction” in transmission in previous hotspots, in particular Bunia, Mongbwalu, Rampara and Nizi, all in Ituri province in eastern DRC.
paras.zh: 世卫组织官员指出，更积极的进展是，预防工作已导致先前热点地区的传播“显着减少”，特别是位于刚果民主共和国东部伊图里省的布尼亚、蒙布瓦卢、兰帕拉和尼济。

paras.en: Nonetheless, the violent unrest across the vast area impacted by Ebola creates huge challenges for responders.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，受埃博拉影响的广大地区发生的暴力骚乱给应对人员带来了巨大的挑战。

paras.en: “We’ve seen so many attacks on healthcare, attacks on communities as well, attacks on people providing care, and people losing their lives, nurses in burials,” Dr Ihekweazu explained. “So, we need to keep working with the community, and this is very important. And working with the specific groups instigating these attacks.”
paras.zh: Ihekweazu 博士解释说：“我们看到了很多针对医疗保健的袭击、针对社区的袭击、针对提供护理的人员的袭击，以及人们失去生命、护士被埋葬的情况。” “因此，我们需要继续与社区合作，这一点非常重要。并与煽动这些攻击的特定团体合作。”

paras.en: Communities are already facing outbreaks of diseases, malnutrition and displacement driven by decades of violent unrest fuelled by dozens of armed groups that remain active in the resource-rich region.
paras.zh: 由于数十个仍在资源丰富地区活跃的武装团体助长了数十年的暴力骚乱，社区已经面临疾病爆发、营养不良和流离失所的问题。

paras.en: Earlier this week, WHO condemned attacks against frontline healthcare workers and community awareness officers, including in Cantine-Aloya in North Kivu that killed 66 civilians including three health workers. Three health facilities were also looted.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，世卫组织谴责针对前线医护人员和社区意识官员的袭击，其中包括在北基伍省 Cantine-Aloya 发生的袭击，造成 66 名平民死亡，其中包括 3 名卫生工作者。三个卫生设施也被抢劫。

paras.en: Two weeks ago, a nurse was also killed and another health worker badly injured when they were attacked while responding to an Ebola alert in Tshopo province.
paras.zh: 两周前，乔波省的一名护士在应对埃博拉警报时遭到袭击，一名护士身亡，另一名卫生工作者受重伤。

paras.en: Other attacks have included an arson attempt on a treatment centre and stones thrown at a vehicle used for conducting safe and dignified burials, an indication of the need to continue to build trust with extremely vulnerable communities.
paras.zh: 其他袭击包括企图纵火治疗中心以及向用于进行安全和有尊严的埋葬的车辆投掷石块，这表明需要继续与极其脆弱的社区建立信任。

paras.en: “We cannot focus only on Ebola. Some people in the affected communities have said told me personally that Ebola is a lesser evil compared to some of the other threats they face,” WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed earlier this week.
paras.zh: “我们不能只关注埃博拉病毒。受影响社区的一些人私下告诉我，与他们面临的其他一些威胁相比，埃博拉病毒危害较小，”世卫组织总干事谭德塞本周早些时候强调。

paras.en: The DRC Ebola outbreak was declared in May and has since become the country's largest yet as it continues to spread faster than any previous outbreak across the vast east and northeast provinces.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国于五月宣布爆发埃博拉疫情，此后成为该国迄今为止规模最大的一次埃博拉疫情，疫情在东部和东北部广大省份的传播速度比以往任何一次疫情都要快。

paras.en: To date, more than 11,000 cases have been confirmed and more than 5,000 people have died.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，已确诊病例超过11,000例，死亡人数超过5,000人。

paras.en: In a related development, the UN World Food Programme (WFP) warned that nearly 29 million people in the DRC face acute food insecurity, with most in the conflict and Ebola-affected eastern and northeastern provinces. That number is likely to continue to increase, said Jean-Martin Bauer, WFP Director of Food Security and Nutrition Analysis.
paras.zh: 与此相关的是，联合国世界粮食计划署 ​​(WFP) 警告称，刚果民主共和国近 2900 万人面临严重的粮食不安全，其中大多数生活在冲突和受埃博拉病毒影响的东部和东北部省份。世界粮食计划署粮食安全和营养分析主任让·马丁·鲍尔表示，这一数字可能会继续增加。

paras.en: Briefing journalists via video in Geneva, Mr. Bauer stressed that conflict is driving the hunger crisis, in addition to the Ebola outbreak.
paras.zh: 鲍尔先生在日内瓦通过视频向记者通报情况时强调，除了埃博拉疫情外，冲突也正在加剧饥饿危机。

paras.en: “What we need right now is access, and we need resources to avoid the situation becoming more difficult in the DRC,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们现在需要的是准入，我们需要资源来避免刚果民主共和国的局势变得更加困难，”他说。

paras.en: Latest UN-backed food insecurity expert assessments indicate that between January and June 2027, 30.3 million people will be in crisis levels of acute food insecurity or worse, with 4.2 million of this number experiencing “emergency levels” of hunger and the most acute needs in North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri provinces “driven by persistent conflict and large-scale displacement”.
paras.zh: 联合国支持的最新粮食不安全专家评估表明，2027年1月至6月期间，3030万人将处于严重粮食不安全甚至更严重的危机，其中420万人在北基伍省、南基伍省和伊图里省“因持续冲突和大规模流离失所”而面临“紧急程度”的饥饿和最迫切的需求。

paras.en: Mr. Bauer noted that Ebola is just one of many disease outbreaks in DRC, but that it is compounding the hunger crisis for communities already struggling to eat.
paras.zh: 鲍尔先生指出，埃博拉病毒只是刚果民主共和国爆发的众多疾病之一，但它正在加剧已经难以吃饭的社区的饥饿危机。

paras.en: “Families are being displaced, they’re being cut off from their farms, from their livelihoods,” he explained. “Food prices are rising, making affording a meal quite complicated for too many households.”
paras.zh: “许多家庭正在流离失所，他们与农场、生计的联系被切断，”他解释道。 “食品价格不断上涨，让太多家庭的吃饭变得相当困难。”

articles.title: COP31: New initiative targets AI and reliable climate change information

paras.en: COP31: New initiative targets AI and reliable climate change information
paras.zh: COP31：新举措针对人工智能和可靠的气候变化信息

paras.en: New guidance has been issued to ensure that people everywhere can obtain credible climate change information from artificial intelligence (AI) and understand how the technology impacts the environment.
paras.zh: 新的指导方针已经发布，以确保世界各地的人们都能从人工智能（AI）获得可靠的气候变化信息，并了解该技术如何影响环境。

paras.en: The Priorities for Action on AI and Climate Information Integrity were launched at the COP31 climate conference in Antalya, Türkiye, on Friday by the Global Initiative for Information Integrity on Climate Change, which is co-chaired by the United Nations, its scientific agency UNESCO and Brazil.
paras.zh: 周五，全球气候变化信息完整性倡议在土耳其安塔利亚举行的 COP31 气候会议上启动了人工智能和气候信息完整性行动优先事项，该倡议由联合国、其科学机构教科文组织和巴西共同主持。

paras.en: “The question isn't simply whether AI is good or bad for the climate. It’s whether people can rely on what they’re told by AI and about it,” said Charlotte Scaddan, Information Integrity Senior Advisor with the UN Department of Global Communications.
paras.zh: 联合国全球通信部信息完整性高级顾问夏洛特·斯卡丹 (Charlotte Scaddan) 表示：“问题不仅仅是人工智能对气候有利还是有害。问题在于人们是否可以依赖人工智能告诉他们的信息以及有关人工智能的信息。”

paras.en: Although more people are turning to AI for climate information, the co-chairs note that the Independent International Scientific Panel on AI – established last year by the UN General Assembly – has warned that “producing fluent text is easier than producing factual text” for the revolutionary tech.
paras.zh: 尽管越来越多的人开始利用人工智能来获取气候信息，但联合主席指出，联合国大会去年成立的人工智能国际独立科学小组警告说，对于这项革命性技术，“生成流畅的文本比生成事实文本更容易”。

paras.en: Moreover, risks can increase during climate disasters, when AI-generated images and videos can spread faster than official warnings. Meanwhile, the general public is asked to accept claims about AI’s own climate impact while lacking the necessary data to evaluate its effect on the environment.
paras.zh: 此外，在气候灾难期间，当人工智能生成的图像和视频的传播速度超过官方警告时，风险可能会增加。与此同时，公众被要求接受有关人工智能自身对气候影响的说法，但缺乏必要的数据来评估其对环境的影响。

paras.en: The global priorities seek to uphold accountability and transparency.
paras.zh: 全球优先事项旨在维护问责制和透明度。

paras.en: They call for AI companies to assess how their systems affect climate information integrity, to publish their findings and disclose their energy use and carbon, water and land footprints.
paras.zh: 他们呼吁人工智能公司评估其系统如何影响气候信息完整性，公布其研究结果并披露其能源使用以及碳、水和土地足迹。

paras.en: At the same time, States are urged to integrate information integrity into national AI strategies and climate plans.
paras.zh: 与此同时，敦促各国将信息完整性纳入国家人工智能战略和气候计划。

paras.en: The action points are grounded in human rights and build on the Belém Declaration on Information Integrity on Climate Change, launched during COP30 last year in Brazil, and the UN Global Principles for Information Integrity.
paras.zh: 这些行动要点以人权为基础，并以去年在巴西举行的 COP30 期间发布的《关于气候变化信息完整性的贝伦宣言》和《联合国信息完整性全球原则》为基础。

paras.en: The partners in the initiative called for greater investment in the information people use to understand and act on climate change. So far, Germany has committed more than $2.2 million to support research, develop communication strategies and undertake public awareness campaigns.
paras.zh: 该倡议的合作伙伴呼吁加大对人们用来了解气候变化并采取行动的信息的投资。到目前为止，德国已承诺投入超过 220 万美元来支持研究、制定传播策略和开展公众宣传活动。

paras.en: Friday also marked the launch of the Charter for Climate Information Integrity in Advertising which seeks to address problems such as “monetization of disinformation and denial”, said Jake Dubbins, co-founder of the Conscious Advertising Network.
paras.zh: 意识广告网络联合创始人杰克·杜宾斯表示，周五还标志着《广告气候信息完整性宪章》的启动，该宪章旨在解决“虚假信息和否认的货币化”等问题。

paras.en: The charter calls for transparency across the advertising supply chain to ensure that advertisers have visibility of ad placements while respecting user privacy.
paras.zh: 该章程呼吁整个广告供应链保持透明度，以确保广告商能够了解广告投放情况，同时尊重用户隐私。

paras.en: COP31 is focused around 10 priority themes, including clean energy transition and electrification, zero waste and climate-resilient cities. The conference concludes on 20 November.
paras.zh: COP31 围绕 10 个优先主题，包括清洁能源转型和电气化、零废物和气候适应型城市。会议于 11 月 20 日结束。

articles.title: ‘Here, you can eat until you’re full’: Oleshky evacuees savour first proper meals in years

paras.en: ‘Here, you can eat until you’re full’: Oleshky evacuees savour first proper meals in years
paras.zh: “在这里，你可以吃到饱”：奥列什基撤离人员多年来第一次品尝到正餐

paras.en: In a quiet hospital corridor in Kyiv, staff and volunteers push carts carrying steaming pots of chicken soup, bread and buckwheat porridge to patients recently evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky, in Ukraine’s southern Kherson region.
paras.zh: 在基辅一个安静的医院走廊里，工作人员和志愿者推着推车，给最近从乌克兰南部赫尔松地区俄罗斯占领的奥列什基撤离的病人送去热气腾腾的鸡汤、面包和荞麦粥。

paras.en: For most people, a bowl of soup is unremarkable. But for evacuees like Olha, who spent the last four-and-a-half years trapped in a war zone, the World Food Programme (WFP) meals are a feast.
paras.zh: 对于大多数人来说，一碗汤并不算什么。但对于像奥尔哈这样过去四年半被困在战区的撤离者来说，世界粮食计划署 ​​(WFP) 提供的餐点简直就是一场盛宴。

paras.en: “Our neighbours had eaten all the pigeons in the area, every last one,” the 50-year-old recalls. “I simply couldn’t understand how there could be hunger in the 21st century.”
paras.zh: “我们的邻居已经把这个地区所有的鸽子都吃光了，”这位 50 岁的老人回忆道。 “我简直无法理解二十一世纪怎么会出现饥饿。”

paras.en: Olha is one of hundreds of people evacuated from Oleshky in late October under a brief ceasefire who are now receiving medical check-ups and treatment in Kyiv hospitals. WFP and its Ukrainian partner, Iskra Dobra, were the first humanitarian responders to provide hot meals the moment they arrived.
paras.zh: 奥尔哈是十月下旬根据短暂停火从奥列什基撤离的数百人之一，他们目前正在基辅医院接受体检和治疗。粮食计划署及其乌克兰合作伙伴 Iskra Dobra 是第一批在抵达后立即提供热餐的人道主义救援人员。

paras.en: “This is the first proper meal they have had in years,” said Richard Ragan, WFP Country Director in Ukraine.
paras.zh: “这是他们多年来第一次吃到像样的饭菜，”世界粮食计划署驻乌克兰国家主任理查德·拉根 (Richard Ragan) 说。

paras.en: When the war erupted in 2022, Oleshky was occupied – sitting on the frontline – and eventually cut off from humanitarian assistance. Olha and her husband, Serhii, were searched, interrogated and threatened. “By noon at the latest, everyone was indoors,” Serhii says.
paras.zh: 2022 年战争爆发时，奥列什基被占领——坐在前线——并最终切断了人道主义援助。奥尔哈和她的丈夫谢尔希遭到搜查、审讯和威胁。 “最晚到中午，每个人都在室内，”瑟希说。

paras.en: Food grew scarce and prices soared, and a kilo of flour could cost as much as $12, evacuees say. In May, food deliveries ended altogether.
paras.zh: 撤离人员表示，食物变得稀缺，价格飙升，一公斤面粉的价格可能高达 12 美元。五月份，食品配送完全结束。

paras.en: With no heating in their shell-damaged home, the family slept in three layers of clothes. Olha planted cucumbers, tomatoes and zucchini, rushing outside during brief lulls between attacks to tend them.
paras.zh: 由于被炮弹损坏的家中没有暖气，一家人只能穿着三层衣服睡觉。奥尔哈种了黄瓜、西红柿和西葫芦，在两次袭击之间的短暂间歇期间，他冲到外面照料它们。

paras.en: “It was terribly frightening. But what could we do? We had to eat,” she says.
paras.zh: “这太可怕了。但我们能做什么？我们必须吃饭，”她说。

paras.en: Further down the corridor, 78-year-old Valentyna describes how she and her elderly neighbours made soup from wild plants. “There was no bread, no flour, nothing at all,” she says.
paras.zh: 走廊尽头，78 岁的瓦伦蒂娜 (Valentyna) 讲述了她和年长的邻居如何用野生植物制作汤。 “没有面包，没有面粉，什么都没有，”她说。

paras.en: “Until we reached the border, we were afraid anything could still happen,” Olha recalls. Then, suddenly, they were through. Along the road to Kyiv, people stood holding signs and Ukrainian flags to welcome them.
paras.zh: “在我们到达边境之前，我们担心仍然会发生任何事情，”奥尔哈回忆道。然后，突然之间，他们就结束了。沿着通往基辅的道路，人们举着标语和乌克兰国旗欢迎他们。

paras.en: “We saw our people,” she says. “There was something so wonderful about their energy. A sense of peace.”
paras.zh: “我们看到了我们的人民，”她说。 “他们的能量是如此美妙。一种平静的感觉。”

paras.en: For Valentyna, the meals have been a revelation. “Here, you can eat until you’re full! I hadn’t seen so much food in years,” she says. “The borscht is absolutely delicious.”
paras.zh: 对于瓦伦蒂娜来说，这些饭菜是一个启示。 “在这里，你可以吃到饱！我已经好几年没见过这么多食物了，”她说。 “罗宋汤绝对美味。”

paras.en: Since Russia’s full-scale invasion in February 2022, WFP has provided the equivalent of 4.1 billion meals to Ukraine’s most vulnerable people. Every month, it reaches 357,000 people in frontline communities with emergency food and cash assistance, and some 200,000 students receive its daily school meals.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年 2 月俄罗斯全面入侵以来，粮食计划署已向乌克兰最弱势群体提供了相当于 41 亿份餐食。每个月，该组织都会为前线社区的 357,000 人提供紧急食品和现金援助，并为约 200,000 名学生提供每日学校膳食。

paras.en: For the evacuees, the future remains uncertain, with homes they cannot return to and years of fear that will not simply disappear. But there is also the relief of being safe and, in a hospital room in Kyiv, having a hot meal waiting.
paras.zh: 对于撤离者来说，未来仍然不确定，他们无法返回家园，多年的恐惧也不会消失。但在基辅的一家医院病房里，有一顿热饭等待着，这也让人松了口气。
