articles.title: Choi pushing for first LPGA win at The Annika as Korda drops back

paras.en: The Annika: Hye-Jin Choi shares lead as she seeks first LPGA win while Nelly Korda drops four shots back
paras.zh: Annika：崔惠珍并列领先，寻求首个 LPGA 胜利，而内莉·科达 (Nelly Korda) 则落后四杆

paras.en: Hye-Jin Choi shares the lead with Carlota Ciganda and Lindy Duncan as she chases a first LPGA victory; Nelly Korda was four shots back at the end of the second day; Watch round three of The Annika on LPGA Tour from 7pm on Saturday, live on Sky Sports Mix
paras.zh: 崔惠珍 (Hye-Jin Choi) 与卡洛塔·西甘达 (Carlota Ciganda) 和林迪·邓肯 (Lindy Duncan) 并列领先，她正在追逐首个 LPGA 胜利；第二天结束时，内莉·科达 (Nelly Korda) 落后四杆；周六晚上 7 点开始观看 Sky Sports Mix 直播的 Annika on LPGA 巡回赛第三轮比赛

paras.en: Hye-Jin Choi opened with two bogeys, made up ground with a 15-foot eagle putt late and finished with a three-under 67 on Friday that gave her part of a three-way share of the lead at The Annika.
paras.zh: 崔惠珍(Hye-Jin Choi)开局吞下两个柏忌，最后以一记15英尺老鹰推杆弥补了失地，并在周五以67杆，低于标准杆三杆的成绩结束了比赛，这让她在安妮卡(The Annika)比赛中获得了部分领先优势。

paras.en: It was far more effective than the bogey-free round of Nelly Korda, the No. 1 player who could only laugh at her clean card because it was cleaner than she would have preferred - 15 straight pars, one birdie, two closing pars for a 69.
paras.zh: 这比排名第一的内莉·科达（Nelly Korda）的无柏忌回合要有效得多，内莉·科达（Nelly Korda）只能嘲笑她干净的牌，因为这比她希望的要干净——15个直标准杆，一只小鸟，两个最后标准杆，打出69杆。

paras.en: That left Korda four shots behind going into the weekend at Pelican Golf Club, where a victory would make the 28-year-old American eligible for the LPGA Hall of Fame.
paras.zh: 这使得科达在鹈鹕高尔夫俱乐部的周末比赛中落后四杆，这场胜利将使这位 28 岁的美国人有资格进入 LPGA 名人堂。

paras.en: "I had a lot of chances," said Korda, competing for the first time in two months. "But you can just tell that from yesterday morning to today afternoon with the wind, that's what the defence of this golf course is. It's as fast as Bermuda as I've putted on throughout my career."
paras.zh: “我有很多机会，”两个月来第一次参加比赛的科达说道。 “但是你可以看出，从昨天早上到今天下午都有风，这就是这个高尔夫球场的防守。它的速度和我整个职业生涯中的百慕大一样快。”

paras.en: It wasn't a problem for Solheim Cup star Carlota Ciganda, who birdied her last four holes for a 63 to join Choi and Lindy Duncan (66) atop the leaderboard at 12-under 128.
paras.zh: 对于索尔海姆杯明星卡洛塔·西甘达来说，这不是问题，她在最后四个洞抓到小鸟，打出 63 杆，与崔顺实和林迪·邓肯（66 杆）一起以 128 杆，低于标准杆 12 杆位居领先榜首位。

paras.en: The Japanese duo of Mao Saigo (65) and Minami Katsu (69) were two shots behind.
paras.zh: 日本组合西乡真央（65杆）和南胜（69杆）落后两杆。

paras.en: Choi has been an LPGA member for five years and it has been a curious chase for that first LPGA victory, particularly since she was 17 when she had a late lead in the 2017 US Women's Open and wound up as a runner-up.
paras.zh: 崔女士成为 LPGA 会员已经五年了，对首个 LPGA 胜利的追逐一直令人好奇，特别是自她 17 岁时，她在 2017 年美国女子公开赛中处于领先地位并最终获得亚军之后。

paras.en: She also had two good chances at winning during the recent Asia swing, where she was runner-up in Shanghai and South Korea.
paras.zh: 她在最近的亚洲巡回赛中也有两次很好的获胜机会，在上海和韩国获得亚军。

paras.en: Choi was playing in the group with Korda for the opening two rounds, which she believes has tested her enough to calm her nerves on the weekend. She wasn't rattled by the bogey-bogey start, or the bogey on the par-five 14th, her fifth hole of the round.
paras.zh: 崔在前两轮比赛中与科达同组，她相信这对她来说已经足够考验，足以让她在周末平静下来。她并没有因为开局时的柏忌-柏忌，或者第 14 洞五杆洞（她本轮的第五洞）的柏忌而感到不安。

paras.en: She pieced together enough birdies to regain some momentum, then hit an approach that got a nice kick around the green and rolled out to just under 15 feet for eagle on the par-five seventh.
paras.zh: 她拼凑了足够多的小鸟来重新获得一些动力，然后击球，在果岭上打出漂亮的一脚，并在第七个五杆洞中将球滚到略低于15英尺的老鹰。

paras.en: "I have two rounds left, but I have recently played in a champion group on the tournament before, so I have that experience and I'm going just try my best and concentrate on my game," Choi said.
paras.zh: “我还剩两轮比赛，但我最近参加过锦标赛的冠军组比赛，所以我有这样的经验，我会尽力而为，专注于我的比赛，”崔说。

paras.en: Scoring was low enough in the opening round that one-under 139 made the cut. This is the final regular-season event of the year, and the top 60 in the Race to CME Globe advance to the finale next week in Naples, where the winner gets $2 million.
paras.zh: 首轮比赛的得分很低，以低于标准杆 139 杆的成绩晋级。这是今年最后一场常规赛，CME Globe 赛中的前 60 名选手将晋级下周在那不勒斯举行的决赛，获胜者将获得 200 万美元奖金。

paras.en: Julia Lopez Ramirez of Spain, who defeated Yealimi Noh in a crucial singles match in her Solheim Cup debut, was among those at nine-under 131. That was important for the Spaniard, who came into the week at No. 66 in the Race to the CME Globe.
paras.zh: 西班牙选手朱莉娅·洛佩兹·拉米雷斯 (Julia Lopez Ramirez) 在索尔海姆杯首秀中的一场关键单打比赛中击败了耶阿利米·诺 (Yealimi Noh)，她的成绩为低于标准杆 9 杆 131 杆。这对西班牙人来说很重要，她在本周的 CME 环球大赛中排名第 66 名。

paras.en: Duncan, the 35-year-old Floridian, has yet to win on the LPGA Tour and this was the first time she had at least a share of the lead through 36 holes. She went 2-1 in her Solheim Cup debut.
paras.zh: 35 岁的佛罗里达人邓肯尚未在 LPGA 巡回赛上获胜，这是她第一次在 36 洞中取得至少并列领先。她在索尔海姆杯首秀中以2-1获胜。

paras.en: "The week has gone by really fast, which is sometimes a good thing," Duncan said. "Because if you're playing a lot and you get some momentum going, that's kind of a nice way to play. So it's just been kind of rolling with it."
paras.zh: “这一周过得很快，有时这是一件好事，”邓肯说。 “因为如果你打得很多并且有动力，这就是一种很好的打球方式。所以它就一直在滚动。”

paras.en: Charley Hull was five shots off the leaders on seven-under after shooting 67 on Friday. England's Lottie Woad finished the second round level with Hull on seven-under.
paras.zh: 查利·赫尔 (Charley Hull) 周五打出 67 杆后，以低于标准杆 7 杆的成绩落后领先者 5 杆。英格兰选手洛蒂·沃德在第二轮比赛中以低于标准杆七杆的成绩与赫尔城队打平。

articles.title: WTA Finals: Svitolina defeats Sabalenka to reach semi-finals

paras.en: WTA Finals: Elina Svitolina defeats Aryna Sabalenka to reach semi-finals as Mirra Andreeva overwhelms Diana Shnaider
paras.zh: WTA决赛：埃琳娜·斯维托丽娜击败阿莉娜·萨巴伦卡进入半决赛，米拉·安德烈娃击败戴安娜·施奈德

paras.en: Elina Svitolina has eliminated Aryna Sabalenka from the WTA Finals, winning in three sets, 6-3 3-6 6-1 after momentum swung from one to the other and back; Svitolina will face Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova in the semi-finals at Indian Wells Tennis Garden
paras.zh: 埃琳娜·斯维托丽娜 (Elina Svitolina) 在 WTA 总决赛中淘汰了阿琳娜·萨巴伦卡 (Aryna Sabalenka)，在三盘比赛中以 6-3 3-6 6-1 的比分逆转获胜。斯维托丽娜将在印第安维尔斯网球花园的半决赛中迎战温网冠军琳达·诺斯科娃

paras.en: Elina Svitolina defeated Aryna Sabalenka over three compelling sets to reach the semi-finals of the WTA Finals in Indian Wells.
paras.zh: 埃琳娜·斯维托丽娜 (Elina Svitolina) 在印第安维尔斯 (Indian Wells) 举行的 WTA 年终总决赛中，通过三盘比赛击败阿琳娜·萨巴伦卡 (Aryna Sabalenka)，进入半决赛。

paras.en: The Ukrainian won 6-3 3-6 6-1, standing up to Sabalenka's powerful serve as she won the first set.
paras.zh: 乌克兰选手顶住萨巴伦卡强大的发球局，以6-3 3-6 6-1拿下第一盘。

paras.en: Sabalenka stormed back to take control of the second set. But momentum shifted yet again in the deciding set.
paras.zh: 萨巴伦卡强势反击，控制了第二盘。但在决胜盘中，势头再次转变。

paras.en: The opening games of the third were tight, but Svitolina landed a hammer blow when she broke Sabalenka's service game to go 3-1 up and pressed on from there to run away with the final set.
paras.zh: 第三局开局双方胶着，但斯维托丽娜一击破发，以3-1领先，最终拿下决胜盘。

paras.en: "Very happy with the performance. It was not an easy match. It was a little bit of a roller coaster," Svitolina told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: “对表现非常满意。这不是一场轻松的比赛。有点像过山车，”斯维托丽娜告诉天空体育。

paras.en: "I played well in the first set, she stepped up the game and the third I tried to put an 'extra' ball over the net."
paras.zh: “第一盘我打得很好，她加快了比赛节奏，第三盘我试图将一个‘额外’的球打过网。”

paras.en: Svitolina will face Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova in the semi-final at Indian Wells Tennis Garden.
paras.zh: 斯维托丽娜将在印第安维尔斯网球花园的半决赛中迎战温网冠军琳达·诺斯科娃。

paras.en: "I knew from the start of the tournament this would be a possibility but I have no regrets or complaints. I'm in the semi-final and that's amazing for me," she said.
paras.zh: “我从比赛一开始就知道这是有可能的，但我没有遗憾或抱怨。我进入了半决赛，这对我来说太棒了，”她说。

paras.en: Mirra Andreeva won 12 of the final 13 games to cruise past Diana Shnaider 6-2 6-1 and complete her round-robin play at the WTA Finals on Friday.
paras.zh: 米拉·安德烈娃 (Mirra Andreeva) 赢得了最后 13 场比赛中的 12 场，以 6-2 6-1 击败戴安娜·施奈德 (Diana Shnaider)，并在周五的 WTA 总决赛中完成了循环赛。

paras.en: Andreeva dropped just 11 games total while winning Group 2 with a 3-0 record and will play Jessica Pegula in Saturday's semifinals.
paras.zh: 安德烈耶娃总共只输了 11 场比赛，但以 3-0 的战绩赢得了第 2 组的胜利，并将在周六的半决赛中对阵杰西卡·佩古拉。

paras.en: Shnaider, the second alternate, was a late replacement for Karolina Muchova, who withdrew with a gastrointestinal illness. Shnaider was making her WTA Finals debut in singles after qualifying in doubles last year with fellow Russian Andreeva.
paras.zh: 施奈德是第二替补球员，她是卡罗琳娜·穆乔娃的替补，后者因肠胃疾病退出。施奈德在去年与俄罗斯同胞安德烈耶娃一起获得双打资格后，首次在 WTA 总决赛单打比赛中亮相。

paras.en: Shnaider led 2-0 in the first set before Andreeva took control and wrapped up the win in 55 minutes. Andreeva won 71 per cent of her first-serve points and converted six of seven break points. Shnaider committed 32 errors in her only match after spending the week practising and not knowing whether she would be needed.
paras.zh: 首盘施奈德以2-0领先，随后安德烈耶娃控制局面，并在55分钟内锁定胜局。安德烈耶娃一发得分率高达 71%，并成功完成 7 个破发点中的 6 个。施奈德在她唯一一场比赛中犯下了 32 个错误，此前她花了一周的时间进行训练，而且不知道自己是否需要自己。

paras.en: "I don't know how much fun that was," Andreeva said. "It's nice to share a court with your friend. It's more nerve-wracking for me personally because I know her well."
paras.zh: “我不知道那有多有趣，”安德烈耶娃说。 “和你的朋友共用一个球场真是太好了。对我个人来说这更让人伤脑筋，因为我很了解她。”

paras.en: Muchova, a Wimbledon finalist this year, already lost her first two matches and could not have advanced to the semifinals even if she had played Friday. Muchova was the second withdrawal from the eight-day, $10 million event. Top-ranked Elena Rybakina dropped out before the tournament began last Sunday, citing a viral illness and exhaustion.
paras.zh: 今年进入温网决赛的穆乔娃已经输掉了前两场比赛，即使周五参加比赛也无法晋级半决赛。 Muchova 是这项为期八天、耗资 1000 万美元的赛事中的第二位退赛者。排名第一的埃琳娜·雷巴基娜（Elena Rybakina）在上周日比赛开始前退出，理由是病毒性疾病和疲惫。

articles.title: Trump, Xi and Putin plan an unprecedented  meeting on the sidelines of APEC, officials say
articles.author: Caroline Kenny

paras.en: President Donald Trump will meet with the leaders of China and Russia on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzen, China’s tech hub, next week, an unprecedented gathering of the heads of the world’s biggest nuclear powers.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统将于下周在中国科技中心深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会期间会见中国和俄罗斯领导人，这是世界最大核大国领导人前所未有的聚会。

paras.en: “President Trump will conclude his visit to China with a trilateral meeting between the president of the United States, the president of the People’s Republic of China and the president of the Russian Federation,” Olivia Wales, a White House spokesperson, said in a call with reporters Friday night. “The president has made it clear that, among other topics, he will discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world, whose proliferation President Trump believes is very dangerous.”
paras.zh: 白宫发言人奥利维亚·威尔士周五晚上在接受记者采访时表示，“特朗普总统将通过美国总统、中华人民共和国总统和俄罗斯联邦总统之间的三方会晤来结束对中国的访问。” “总统已明确表示，除其他议题外，他将讨论世界范围内核武器的削减，特朗普总统认为核武器的扩散非常危险。”

paras.en: It is not anticipated that any sort of agreement will come from the trilateral meeting, according to a senior U.S. official, who described the session as an “entry point” and “the first conversation,” pointing to the reduction of nuclear arsenals as a key topic.
paras.zh: 一位美国高级官员表示，预计三边会议不会达成任何形式的协议，他将此次会议描述为“切入点”和“第一次对话”，并指出削减核武库是一个关键议题。

paras.en: “We do think it’s time for China to sort of step up, you know, to the adults’ table, if you will, and have adult conversations about adult things,” the senior U.S. official said about the issue of nuclear weapons.
paras.zh: 这位美国高级官员在谈到核武器问题时表示：“我们确实认为，如果你愿意的话，中国现在应该站到成年人的桌子上，就成年人的事情进行成年人的对话。”

paras.en: Beijing’s arsenal of more than 600 warheads, according to Pentagon estimates, is far smaller than inventories held by the U.S. and Russia, each estimated to have more than 5,000 warheads. With U.S. and Russian arsenals dwarfing its stockpile, China has shown little interest in developing a nuclear pact.
paras.zh: 据五角大楼估计，北京拥有 600 多枚弹头，远小于美国和俄罗斯的库存，两国的弹头估计均超过 5,000 枚。由于美国和俄罗斯的核武库数量相形见绌，中国对制定核协议兴趣不大。

paras.en: The last nuclear arms pact between Russia and the United States expired in February, removing caps on the two largest atomic arsenals for the first time in more than a half-century. When that treaty — known as New START — expired, Trump rejected a call by Russia to extend the two-country deal for another year and called for “a new, improved and modernized” deal that includes China.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和美国之间的最后一项核武器条约于二月到期，半个多世纪以来首次取消了两个最大原子武库的上限。当这项名为《新削减战略武器条约》的条约到期时，特朗普拒绝了俄罗斯将两国协议再延长一年的呼吁，并呼吁达成一项包括中国在内的“新的、改进的和现代化的”协议。

paras.en: The three-way summit with Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin comes at a complicated moment in relations for the three countries.
paras.zh: 与特朗普、习近平和弗拉基米尔·普京的三方峰会正值这三个国家关系的复杂时刻。

paras.en: Trump intends to discuss the Iran war with the two leaders, but not the war in Ukraine, according to a senior U.S. official, who noted that discussions about the war in Ukraine are a separate “track” that China is not part of so it would not be “appropriate.”
paras.zh: 一位美国高级官员表示，特朗普打算与两位领导人讨论伊朗战争，但不会讨论乌克兰战争，他指出，有关乌克兰战争的讨论是一个单独的“轨道”，中国不参与其中，因此“不合适”。

paras.en: Trump has warmly embraced Xi after coming to a truce in their short-lived trade war last year and in spite of differences over the U.S. war with Iran and other tensions between the world’s foremost economic powers.
paras.zh: 尽管两国在美国与伊朗的战争以及世界主要经济大国之间的其他紧张局势上存在分歧，但在去年短暂的贸易战休战后，特朗普热情拥抱了习近平。

paras.en: Similarly, Trump has sought to build his relationship with Putin, even as the Russian leader has persisted in his nearly 5-year-old war with Ukraine and as Moscow has deepened its military, intelligence and diplomatic partnership with Iran.
paras.zh: 同样，特朗普一直在寻求与普京建立关系，尽管这位俄罗斯领导人坚持与乌克兰进行了近五年的战争，而且莫斯科加深了与伊朗的军事、情报和外交伙伴关系。

paras.en: There is no bilateral with Putin scheduled, but the two leaders will appear at events and the trilateral meeting together, according to a senior U.S. official.
paras.zh: 一位美国高级官员表示，没有安排与普京举行双边会谈，但两位领导人将一起出席活动和三边会议。

paras.en: There are no plans for Trump to engage with North Korea during the trip, according to a senior U.S. official.
paras.zh: 一位美国高级官员表示，特朗普没有计划在访问期间与朝鲜接触。

paras.en: Separately, Elon Musk will be the only business leader who is part of the president’s delegation, according to a senior U.S. official, who noted that other U.S. business leaders will attend the summit in their own capacity but there is no official U.S. business delegation.
paras.zh: 另外，据一位美国高级官员称，埃隆·马斯克将是总统代表团中唯一的商界领袖，他指出其他美国商界领袖将以自己的身份参加峰会，但没有官方的美国商界代表团。

paras.en: Musk will not be part of any official meetings, according to a senior U.S. official.
paras.zh: 一位美国高级官员表示，马斯克不会参加任何正式会议。

paras.en: Two senior U.S. officials said that they don’t think Trump will raise the espionage investigation focused on Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese intelligence agent who allegedly had a romantic relationship with Nvidia chief Jensen Huang, with China.
paras.zh: 两名美国高级官员表示，他们认为特朗普不会针对中国情报特工黄爱丽 (Alice Huang) 展开间谍调查，据称她与英伟达 (Nvidia) 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 存在恋情。

paras.en: “The situation with Nvidia should not really have any bearing on the trip. In all of our discussions and negotiations with the Chinese, we do not negotiate American export controls,” a senior U.S. official said. “These are national security matters that we develop in the administration and interagency process, and we don’t expect it to figure at all in any of our conversations with the Chinese while we’re there.”
paras.zh: “与英伟达的情况实际上应该不会对这次访问产生任何影响。在我们与中国人的所有讨论和谈判中，我们不会就美国的出口管制进行谈判，”一位美国高级官员表示。 “这些是我们在行政和机构间程序中制定的国家安全问题，我们不希望它出现在我们在那里与中国人的任何对话中。”

paras.en: Beijing was least certain about the value of the summit
paras.zh: 北京对峰会的价值最不确定

paras.en: By agreeing to host the meeting, Xi may be calculating that the moment offers him an opportunity to flex China’s growing clout and prestige.
paras.zh: 通过同意主办这次会议，习近平可能是在盘算，这次会议为他提供了一个展示中国日益增长的影响力和威望的机会。

paras.en: For the Kremlin, the planned trilateral meeting is a coveted chance to posture as a superpower on par with Washington and Beijing.
paras.zh: 对于克里姆林宫来说，计划中的三边会议是一个令人垂涎的机会，可以展现出与华盛顿和北京同等的超级大国的姿态。

paras.en: “I think the key for Putin was that this was very much about signaling a desire to talk to the president and talk to Chairman Xi in a way that suggests that they’re making decisions on Ukraine, which obviously the Ukrainians and the Europeans don’t like,” said Edgard Kagan, a former U.S. ambassador to Malaysia who is now at the Center for Strategic and International Studies.
paras.zh: “我认为对普京来说，关键在于，这在很大程度上表明了与总统和习主席对话的愿望，以一种表明他们正在就乌克兰问题做出决定的方式，这显然是乌克兰人和欧洲人不喜欢的，”前美国驻马来西亚大使、现供职于战略与国际研究中心的埃德加德·卡根(Edgard Kagan)说。

paras.en: The trilateral could very well overshadow the APEC summit. The summit, which is bringing 21 economies to Shenzhen, marks a big moment for China to show off its fast-growing, ultramodern coastal metropolis that transformed from a small fishing village into a global technology and economic hub in just a few decades.
paras.zh: 三边会谈很可能给亚太经合组织峰会蒙上阴影。此次峰会将有 21 个经济体齐聚深圳，这标志着中国展示其快速发展的超现代化沿海大都市的重要时刻，该大都市在短短几十年内从一个小渔村转变为全球科技和经济中心。

paras.en: More substantively, such a gathering could also muddy China’s argument that a Cold War mentality in the West was a contributing factor that led to Russia’s war on Ukraine and its pointed criticism that the U.S. has undermined international institutions and treaties with how it has executed its war against Iran.
paras.zh: 更实质性的是，这样的聚会还可能混淆中国的论点，即西方的冷战思维是导致俄罗斯对乌克兰发动战争的一个因素，以及中国对美国对伊朗战争破坏了国际机构和条约的尖锐批评。

paras.en: The trilateral meeting could undercut China’s push to portray itself as a defender of free trade at APEC, said Hoo Tiang Boon, a professor of Chinese foreign policy at Nanyang Technological University.
paras.zh: 南洋理工大学中国外交政策教授胡添文表示，三边会议可能会削弱中国在亚太经合组织中将自己描绘成自由贸易捍卫者的努力。

paras.en: “You sort of run counter to Chinese support of multilateralism,” he said.
paras.zh: “你有点违背中国对多边主义的支持，”他说。

paras.en: The leaders have met in pairs plenty of times over the years
paras.zh: 多年来，两国领导人多次成对会面

paras.en: Putin and Xi are no strangers. They’ve fostered a close personal relationship, meeting more than 40 times since Xi became president in 2013 and addressing each other as “dear friend.”
paras.zh: 普京和习近平并不陌生。他们建立了密切的私人关系，自习近平2013年就任国家主席以来会面了40多次，并互相称呼对方为“亲爱的朋友”。

paras.en: Trump and Putin have met face-to-face on seven different occasions, most recently in Alaska in August 2025. Xi and Trump have held face-to-face talks on eight occasions, including a September state visit to Washington by Xi.
paras.zh: 特朗普和普京已在不同场合进行过七次面对面会晤，最近一次是 2025 年 8 月在阿拉斯加。习近平和特朗普已举行过八次面对面会谈，其中包括习近平 9 月对华盛顿进行国事访问。

paras.en: Beijing is the No. 1 trading partner for Moscow, a relationship that has strengthened since Putin sent troops into Ukraine in 2022.
paras.zh: 北京是莫斯科的第一大贸易伙伴，自普京 2022 年出兵乌克兰以来，两国关系得到加强。

paras.en: As the EU and the West sought to economically isolate Russia, China increased its purchases of Russia’s energy resources and became Moscow’s principal supplier of key technologies, including high-tech components for Russian weapons industries. Beijing has ignored Western demands to cut those supplies.
paras.zh: 随着欧盟和西方试图在经济上孤立俄罗斯，中国增加了对俄罗斯能源的购买，并成为莫斯科关键技术的主要供应商，包括俄罗斯武器工业的高科技零部件。北京无视西方削减供应的要求。

paras.en: In the lead-up to Russia’s war on Ukraine, Xi and Putin declared their countries had a “no-limits friendship.” China officially has said it is neutral on the conflict, while charging that Kyiv’s Western allies played a part in provoking Russia’s military action in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯对乌克兰发动战争之前，习近平和普京宣称两国拥有“无限的友谊”。中国正式表示对这场冲突保持中立，同时指责基辅的西方盟友参与挑衅俄罗斯在乌克兰的军事行动。

paras.en: Moscow, in turn, has repeatedly declared its support for Beijing’s policy on issues related to Taiwan.
paras.zh: 莫斯科则一再宣称支持北京在台湾问题上的政策。

paras.en: Trump recently struck a diesel deal with Russia, waiving sanctions against Moscow and allowing for the sale of millions of tons of the fuel. The U.S. leader has blamed surging energy prices on Ukraine’s attacks on Russian oil refineries. Analysts, however, say the rise in global crude prices is due mostly to the Iran war.
paras.zh: 特朗普最近与俄罗斯达成了一项柴油协议，免除了对莫斯科的制裁，并允许出售数百万吨燃料。美国领导人将乌克兰袭击俄罗斯炼油厂归咎于能源价格飙升。然而分析师表示，全球原油价格上涨主要是由于伊朗战争。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has expressed concern that the trilateral meeting could serve as a platform for discussing a possible Ukraine deal behind Kyiv’s back.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示担心三边会议可能成为背着基辅讨论可能的乌克兰协议的平台。

paras.en: Planning for the summit has drawn comparisons to the Yalta Conference, the 1945 gathering at which the leaders of the U.S., Britain and the Soviet Union agreed to divide Germany and Berlin into four military occupation zones and finalized plans for establishing the United Nations.
paras.zh: 这次峰会的规划与 1945 年的雅尔塔会议相比较，在这次会议上，美国、英国和苏联领导人同意将德国和柏林划分为四个军事占领区，并最终确定了建立联合国的计划。

paras.en: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov has dismissed the Yalta comparisons, noting that any potential agreements reached in Shenzhen can’t be enforced on others.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫(Dmitry Peskov)驳斥了与雅尔塔的比较，指出在深圳达成的任何潜在协议都不能强加于其他国家。

paras.en: “It’s clear that a meeting between the leaders of countries such as Russia, China and the United States is extremely significant,” Peskov said. “However, let’s not forget that the vision for a global order is that no one tries to impose any particular view of global order, and it should be based entirely on mutual benefit and mutual respect.”
paras.zh: 佩斯科夫表示：“显然，俄罗斯、中国和美国等国领导人之间的会晤极其重要。” “但是，我们不要忘记，全球秩序的愿景是没有人试图强加任何特定的全球秩序观点，它应该完全建立在互利和相互尊重的基础上。”
