articles.title: Newcastle climate protest goes ahead, no arrests made
articles.author: Bridget Murphy

paras.en: More than 600 kayakers took to Newcastle Harbour as part of "Paddle for the Planet", protesting coal exports.
paras.zh: 作为“为地球划桨”活动的一部分，600 多名皮划艇运动员来到纽卡斯尔港，抗议煤炭出口。

paras.en: No arrests were made after NSW Police had tried to block the event.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州警方试图阻止该活动后，没有逮捕任何人。

paras.en: A larger protest is being planned for February 2027.
paras.zh: 计划于 2027 年 2 月举行更大规模的抗议活动。

paras.en: Protest organisers and NSW Police say no arrests were made as hundreds of kayakers took to Newcastle Harbour in New South Wales, to protest against coal exports and fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 抗议组织者和新南威尔士州警方表示，数百名皮划艇运动员前往新南威尔士州纽卡斯尔港抗议煤炭出口和化石燃料，但没有逮捕任何人。

paras.en: Climate activism group Rising Tide began promoting its "Paddle for the Planet" event in August, but Newcastle Council this week moved to ban the group from holding any of its events on council land.
paras.zh: 气候活动组织“涨潮”于八月开始宣传其“为地球划桨”活动，但纽卡斯尔议会本周采取行动，禁止该组织在议会土地上举办任何活动。

paras.en: NSW Police attempted to block the protest, citing safety concerns and potential resourcing pressures.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州警方以安全问题和潜在的资源压力为由，试图阻止抗议活动。

paras.en: However, the court dismissed the application on Friday, deciding the event was in the public interest.
paras.zh: 然而，法院周五驳回了该申请，认为该活动符合公共利益。

paras.en: Speaking after the paddle-out, Rising Tide spokesperson Joe Hallenstein labelled Anthony Albanese "hypocritical", as the prime minister and climate change minister engage in the COP31 summit.
paras.zh: 起航后，Rising Tide 发言人乔·哈伦斯坦 (Joe Hallenstein) 称安东尼·阿尔巴内塞 (Anthony Albanese) “虚伪”，因为这位总理和气候变化部长正在参加 COP31 峰会。

paras.en: "[Albanese] is over in Türkiye telling the world that Australia is a leader in climate action, when the opposite is true," Mr Hallenstein said.
paras.zh: “[Albanese] 在土耳其告诉世界，澳大利亚是气候行动的领导者，而事实恰恰相反，”哈伦斯坦先生说。

paras.en: "Both Albanese's federal Labor government, and Chris Minns's state Labor government continue to approve new coal and gas projects, which is the opposite of action on climate change."
paras.zh: “阿尔巴尼斯的联邦工党政府和克里斯明斯的州工党政府都继续批准新的煤炭和天然气项目，这与应对气候变化的行动背道而驰。”

paras.en: The event was held off Horseshoe Beach, which is managed by Transport for NSW.
paras.zh: 该活动在马蹄海滩附近举行，该海滩由新南威尔士州交通局管理。

paras.en: A NSW Police spokesperson confirmed, by the completion of the event, officers had not made any arrests.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州警方发言人证实，截至活动结束，警方尚未逮捕任何人。

paras.en: Organisers say more than 900 people registered for the event, with more than 600 taking to the water.
paras.zh: 组织者称，有 900 多人报名参加了此次活动，其中 600 多人参加了水中活动。

paras.en: Hundreds more lined the shore of Horseshoe Beach for the hour-long demonstration.
paras.zh: 还有数百人在马蹄海滩沿岸排队参加长达一小时的示威活动。

paras.en: "I'm tired of governments, from the federal government down to the local government, not doing enough about reducing [climate impact]," attendee Scott Alcorn said.
paras.zh: “我厌倦了政府，从联邦政府到地方政府，在减少[气候影响]方面做得不够，”与会者斯科特·奥尔康说。

paras.en: "I can see there's plenty of enthusiastic people who feel just the same way as I do."
paras.zh: “我看到有很多热情的人和我有同样的感受。”

paras.en: A limited police presence, mostly on foot, attended the protest.
paras.zh: 少数警察参加了抗议活动，大部分是步行。

paras.en: In the Supreme Court hearing, Assistant Commissioner David Waddell and NSW Police's legal representative argued there were serious safety concerns for large amounts of people on the water.
paras.zh: 在最高法院的听证会上，助理局长 David Waddell 和新南威尔士州警察局的法律代表辩称，大量人员在水上存在严重的安全问题。

paras.en: A cap of 785 vessels was placed on the event.
paras.zh: 此次活动的船只数量上限为 785 艘。

paras.en: The Port of Newcastle did not run any shipping movements between 10am and 2pm.
paras.zh: 纽卡斯尔港上午 10 点至下午 2 点之间没有任何航运活动。

paras.en: NSW Greens spokesperson for climate change and justice Sue Higginson said climate change and fossil fuel projects must be a key concern in the NSW election, scheduled for March 13, 2027.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州绿党气候变化和司法发言人 Sue Higginson 表示，气候变化和化石燃料项目必须成为定于 2027 年 3 月 13 日举行的新南威尔士州选举的主要关注点。

paras.en: She argued while the cost of living is the biggest issue for voters coming into the campaign period, it "does not mean people are not also concerned about the health of their local environment".
paras.zh: 她认为，虽然生活成本是选民进入竞选期间的最大问题，但这“并不意味着人们不关心当地环境的健康”。

paras.en: "Labor and the Coalition, all they want to do is talk about One Nation … what we are doing is providing the people with a real alternative and a real vision for their future."
paras.zh: “工党和联盟党想做的就是谈论一国......我们正在做的是为人们提供真正的选择和对未来的真正愿景。”

paras.en: Ms Higginson also referred to a recent decision by the Minns government to make legislative changes allowing the Mount Pleasant coalmine in the Upper Hunter to increase its life and output.
paras.zh: 希金森女士还提到明斯州政府最近决定进行立法修改，允许上亨特的芒特普莱森特煤矿延长其寿命和产量。

paras.en: The premier announced the move despite a High Court ruling relating to the mine that concluded global climate emissions must be considered in approvals.
paras.zh: 尽管高等法院就该矿做出了一项裁决，认为批准时必须考虑全球气候排放，但总理还是宣布了这一举措。

paras.en: "[The government] is literally carving laws that defy the High Court's ruling because a coal company is threatening to lay off workers before Christmas," she said.
paras.zh: “（政府）实际上正在制定藐视高等法院裁决的法律，因为一家煤炭公司威胁要在圣诞节前解雇工人，”她说。

paras.en: Ms Higginson said the matter is set to be debated in NSW parliament next week.
paras.zh: 希金森女士表示，此事将于下周在新南威尔士州议会进行辩论。

paras.en: A Rising Tide spokesperson confirmed the group plans to hold a larger on-water protest at the end of February on Newcastle Harbour, a fortnight before the election.
paras.zh: Rising Tide 发言人证实，该组织计划于二月底，即大选前两周，在纽卡斯尔港举行更大规模的水上抗议活动。

articles.title: Australia's newest fast-bowling sensation tipped for big things from a young age
articles.author: Yousuf Shameel and Jacqueline Lynch

paras.en: Mon, 14 Sept, 11:00 pm, Final score, ZIM 235, AUS 8/294
paras.zh: 9 月 14 日星期一，晚上 11:00，最终得分，ZIM 235，AUS 8/294

paras.en: Mahli Beardman's six-wicket haul on debut a cause for celebration across regional WA
paras.zh: 马赫利·比尔德曼 (Mahli Beardman) 首次亮相就取得了六个小门的成绩，成为整个西澳地区值得庆祝的理由

paras.en: Fast bowler Mahli Beardman's 6/24 against England was the best ODI debut performance of all time by an Australian bowler.
paras.zh: 快速投球手 Mahli Beardman 在对阵英格兰的 6/24 比赛中创下了澳大利亚投球手有史以来在 ODI 首秀中的最佳表现。

paras.en: Beardman, 21, played his initial and representative junior cricket in Dampier in WA's Pilbara.
paras.zh: 21 岁的 Beardman 在西澳皮尔巴拉的丹皮尔 (Dampier) 参加了他的首场青少年板球比赛，也是他的代表作。

paras.en: Cricket figures hope his performance encourages the next generation of country cricketers.
paras.zh: 板球界人士希望他的表现能够鼓励下一代乡村板球运动员。

articles.title: Father Christmas greeted by estimated 335,000 at Adelaide pageant
articles.author: Madina Jaffari

paras.en: Thousands have lined the streets for the Adelaide Christmas Pageant, marking the start of the festive season in the city.
paras.zh: 数千人聚集在阿德莱德的街道上参加圣诞盛会，标志着该市节日季的开始。

paras.en: Pageant-goers flocked to the city early to secure good spots, ahead of the arrival of Father Christmas.
paras.zh: 在圣诞老人到来之前，参加选美活动的人们早早就涌入这座城市，以抢占好位置。

paras.en: While the David Jones collapse has left a cloud over the Magic Cave, the popular Christmas attraction remains open.
paras.zh: 虽然大卫·琼斯倒塌事件给魔幻洞穴蒙上了一层阴影，但这个受欢迎的圣诞景点仍然开放。

paras.en: More than 300,000 people are estimated to have lined the streets for this year's Adelaide Christmas Pageant, the 94th edition of the annual yuletide parade.
paras.zh: 据估计，今年阿德莱德圣诞游行是第 94 届年度圣诞游行，预计有超过 30 万人走上街头参加。

paras.en: Pageant-goers arrived in the city early, along with hundreds of performers who gathered near South Terrace and King William Road, ahead of the much-loved parade.
paras.zh: 选美观众提前抵达这座城市，数百名表演者聚集在南台和威廉王路附近，准备迎接备受喜爱的游行。

paras.en: Five new floats were added to this year's line-up, including The Magic Hat and A Bumper Christmas.
paras.zh: 今年的阵容中增加了五个新花车，包括“魔法帽”和“丰收圣诞”。

paras.en: "Seeing all the floats go past, they love it," one parent said while sitting with his family.
paras.zh: “看到所有的花车经过，他们很喜欢，”一位家长和家人坐在一起说。

paras.en: "It makes it all kind of worth it, getting up super early."
paras.zh: “起得很早，一切都值得了。”

paras.en: Organisers believe about 335,000 people turned out for the event, which culminated with the much-anticipated arrival of Father Christmas.
paras.zh: 组织者相信约有 335,000 人参加了此次活动，并以万众期待的圣诞老人到来而达到了高潮。

paras.en: Beneath grey skies, a slight shadow was cast on proceedings by the collapse of David Jones, whose Adelaide store has hosted the children's Christmas attraction, the Magic Cave, for almost three decades, although it will continue operating for the time being.
paras.zh: 灰色的天空下，大卫·琼斯的倒闭给整个活动蒙上了一层阴影。大卫·琼斯的阿德莱德商店近三十年来一直举办儿童圣诞景点“魔法洞”，不过目前仍将继续营业。

paras.en: But, overwhelmingly, there were beaming smiles along the event's route.
paras.zh: 但绝大多数情况下，活动沿途充满了灿烂的笑容。

paras.en: Renowned children's entertainer Emma Watkins, better known by her stage name Emma Memma, said she was thrilled to be back after making her debut last year.
paras.zh: 著名儿童艺人艾玛·沃特金斯（Emma Watkins）以她的艺名艾玛·梅玛（Emma Memma）而闻名，她表示，去年首次亮相后，她很高兴能回归。

paras.en: "The buzz is real, the festive spirit is out,"
paras.zh: “热闹是真实的，节日气氛已经消失了，”

paras.en: This year Watkins was part of the float The Sounds and Signs of Christmas, a reference to her push to help make entertainment more accessible for deaf and and hearing children alike.
paras.zh: 今年，沃特金斯参加了“圣诞节的声音和迹象”花车活动，意指她致力于帮助聋哑和听力正常的儿童更容易获得娱乐。

paras.en: "Today is the first time that my co-performer Elvin Lam is actually joining me in the pageant," she said.
paras.zh: “今天是我的搭档林子豪第一次真正和我一起参加选美比赛，”她说。

paras.en: "It's his first Christmas pageant ever, and Elvin is profoundly deaf, and he will be signing throughout the whole parade."
paras.zh: “这是他第一次参加圣诞节游行，埃尔文是个严重的聋子，他将在整个游行过程中手语。”

paras.en: Kunal Dhingra and his family were among those who rose early to secure good spots.
paras.zh: 库纳尔·丁格拉 (Kunal Dhingra) 和他的家人是早起抢占好位置的人之一。

paras.en: "I can see a lot of people are here from different backgrounds. All the kids are really happy," he said while holding his slightly tired infant daughter.
paras.zh: “我看到这里有很多来自不同背景的人。所有的孩子都非常高兴，”他抱着略显疲惫的小女儿说道。

paras.en: "We're here from 6am, she woke up pretty early."
paras.zh: “我们早上六点就到了，她起得很早。”

paras.en: A cross-section of the community was present at the time-honoured parade, with young pageant-goer Miabelle saying she relished "spending time with my cousins" and seeing the floats.
paras.zh: 社区的各个阶层都参加了这场历史悠久的游行，年轻的选美观众米亚贝尔表示，她很享受“与我的表兄弟姐妹共度时光”并观看花车。

paras.en: "There's one big teddy bear I'm looking forward to," she said.
paras.zh: “我很期待一只大泰迪熊，”她说。

paras.en: Another attendee, a local grandmother, said her connection to the event went back decades.
paras.zh: 另一位参加者是当地的一位祖母，她说她与这次活动的联系可以追溯到几十年前。

paras.en: "My dad used to drive trucks, and I remember when we were kids we used to get on the back of his truck and watching the pageant on King William Street,"
paras.zh: “我父亲曾经开卡车，我记得当我们还是孩子的时候，我们经常坐在他的卡车后面，观看威廉王街的选美比赛，”

paras.en: "Now I get to enjoy it with my grandchildren.
paras.zh: “现在我可以和我的孙子们一起享受它了。

paras.en: "I just love it. I think I'd come without the kids, if I had to."
paras.zh: “我就是喜欢它。如果必须的话，我想我会不带孩子来。”

paras.en: The Magic Cave, held in David Jones at the Adelaide Central Plaza, has been part of the city's Christmas landscape since 1998 when its original host John Martin's closed down.
paras.zh: 魔术洞 (Magic Cave) 在阿德莱德中央广场 (Adelaide Central Plaza) 的大卫琼斯 (David Jones) 举办，自 1998 年原主办方约翰·马丁 (John Martin) 关闭以来，一直是该市圣诞景观的一部分。

paras.en: While the Magic Cave welcomed Father Christmas this year, questions have emerged about what lies ahead for the attraction.
paras.zh: 虽然魔法洞穴今年迎来了圣诞老人，但人们对这个景点的前景提出了疑问。

paras.en: Last week, David Jones went into voluntary administration, with 19 of its 38 stores slated for closure across Australia and New Zealand.
paras.zh: 上周，David Jones 进入自愿托管状态，其在澳大利亚和新西兰的 38 家门店中有 19 家计划关闭。

paras.en: In SA, stores in Westfield Marion and Westfield West Lakes will shut down by the end of the year.
paras.zh: 在南澳，Westfield Marion 和 Westfield West Lakes 的商店将于今年年底关闭。

paras.en: But the store in Rundle Mall will remain open, and locals are keen to keep the Magic Cave as part of Adelaide's Christmas festivities.
paras.zh: 但蓝道购物中心 (Rundle Mall) 的商店将继续营业，当地人热衷于保留魔洞作为阿德莱德圣诞节庆祝活动的一部分。

paras.en: "It's an Adelaide icon, bringing my now baby like when I was a kid, and now letting her do it," local woman Erin said.
paras.zh: “这是阿德莱德的标志，像我小时候一样带着我现在的孩子，现在让她来做，”当地妇女艾琳说。

paras.en: "We need David Jones … we need the Magic Cave, the kids love it, it's one thing they look forward to."
paras.zh: “我们需要大卫·琼斯……我们需要魔法洞穴，孩子们喜欢它，这是他们期待的一件事。”

articles.title: U.S. flights cleared to take off again after ground stop order caused thousands of delays and cancellations

paras.en: U.S. flights cleared to take off again after ground stop order caused thousands of delays and cancellations
paras.zh: 在地面停止命令导致数千次延误和取消后，美国航班获准再次起飞

paras.en: - Flights across the U.S. were grounded for more than four hours on Friday, causing travel chaos across the country and beyond.
paras.zh: - 周五，美国各地的航班停飞四个多小时，导致美国各地及其他地区的旅行混乱。

paras.en: - Thousands of flights were cancelled or delayed, including in Canada, after aging air traffic control systems in the U.S. were overloaded, triggering a ground stop order by the Federal Aviation Administration.
paras.zh: - 美国老化的空中交通管制系统超载，引发美国联邦航空管理局下达地面停止令后，包括加拿大在内的数千架航班被取消或延误。

paras.en: - The ripple effect of the FAA's order, which was in effect for more than four hours, will likely last many days as airlines work through the backlog of delays.
paras.zh: - 美国联邦航空局的命令已生效四个多小时，其连锁反应可能会持续很多天，因为航空公司正在努力解决积压的延误问题。

paras.en: - November 14 What to know about flights in U.S. airspace Rhianna Schmunk The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration grounded all flights across the country for nearly four hours on Friday after a critical communications failure for air traffic control centres, ordering a complete ground stoppage for only the second time since 9/11. The shutdown upended travel plans for hundreds of thousands of passengers in the United States, but also for thousands more in Canada whose flights would've flown through American airspace. The White House said new upgrades overwhelmed "an incredibly old air traffic control system," setting off the outage that forced the FAA to keep planes on the ground. "It's going to continue to fail," U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy warned late Friday. He repeated there was no evidence to indicate a cyberattack, but said investigators hadn't ruled one out. It will likely take days for airport operations to return to normal. Airlines will have to push through diverted aircraft, staffing complications and a backlog of weary passengers, many of whom were stranded at airports with little in the way of answers. Those who were stranded are still advised to check with their airline for scheduling updates or rebooking opportunities. The FAA has only grounded flights nationwide twice before in the last 25 years. After the terrorist attacks on Sept. 11, 2001, the agency closed air traffic for two days. Decades later, on Jan. 11, 2023, domestic departures stopped for about 90 minutes due to another communications issue.
paras.zh: - 11 月 14 日 关于美国领空航班的须知 Rhianna Schmunk 美国联邦航空管理局周五因空中交通管制中心发生严重通信故障而将全国所有航班停飞近四个小时，这是自 9/11 以来第二次下令全面停飞。这次停飞打乱了美国数十万乘客的旅行计划，也打乱了加拿大数千名乘客的旅行计划，他们的航班将飞越美国领空。白宫表示，新的升级压垮了“极其陈旧的空中交通管制系统”，引发了停电，迫使美国联邦航空局将飞机留在地面上。美国交通部长肖恩·达菲周五晚间警告说：“它将会继续失败。”他重申，没有证据表明存在网络攻击，但表示调查人员并未排除这种可能性。机场运营可能需要几天时间才能恢复正常。航空公司将不得不应对飞机改道、人员配置复杂化以及疲惫不堪的乘客积压等问题，其中许多人被困在机场，几乎没有任何答案。仍建议滞留人员检查 与他们的航空公司联系以安排更新或重新预订机会。过去 25 年来，美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 仅在全国范围内停飞过两次航班。 2001 年 9 月 11 日恐怖袭击事件发生后，该机构关闭了空中交通两天。几十年后的 2023 年 1 月 11 日，由于另一个通讯问题，国内航班暂停了约 90 分钟。

paras.en: - A timeline of what happened Mike Crawley According to Duffy, the FAA experienced telecommunications issues at 3:36 p.m. ET. He said there was intermittent loss of radar at its regional centres that control high-altitude air traffic between takeoffs and landings, as well as intermittent loss of communication with some aircraft. The ground stop order was issued at 3:53 p.m. ET. More than 3,500 planes were in the air en route to U.S. airports at the time, and that number gradually whittled down to about 400 as planes either landed at their destination airports or were diverted. The FAA lifted the ground stop order at 8:15 p.m. ET. By then, about 6,700 flights had been cancelled and 8,600 had been delayed, according to the FlightAware tracking website. At 8:30 p.m. ET, Duffy told a news briefing at the White House that the outage was caused by old technology that was overloaded.
paras.zh: - 发生事件的时间表 Mike Crawley 根据 Duffy 的说法，FAA 在下午 3:36 遇到了电信问题。等。他表示，控制起飞和降落之间高空空中交通的区域中心的雷达间歇性丢失，与一些飞机的通信也间歇性丢失。地面停止命令于下午 3 点 53 分发出。等。当时有超过 3,500 架飞机在飞往美国机场的途中，随着飞机降落在目的地机场或改道，这一数字逐渐减少到约 400 架。美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 于晚上 8 点 15 分解除了地面停止命令。等。据 FlightAware 追踪网站称，截至目前，约有 6,700 架次航班被取消，8,600 架次航班延误。晚上 8:30美国东部时间，达菲在白宫举行的新闻发布会上表示，停电是由旧技术超载造成的。

paras.en: - Duffy's hard sell for billions from Congress Mike Crawley The White House briefing in large part became a sales pitch by Duffy, who urged Congress to approve billions of dollars in funding to rebuild aging computer infrastructure within the country's air traffic control system. He told reporters that the Trump administration has been asking for the past two years for $30 billion to build a brand new air traffic control system. "Congress, let's make this system more safe," Duffy said. "I can't snap my fingers and build a network overnight, but do you want us to build this for America? And I think every member of Congress should say yes." What Duffy didn't mention is that the Congress that didn't greenlight the administration's funding request has been controlled by the Republican Party — his party — for the past two years.
paras.zh: - 达菲向国会迈克·克劳利（Mike Crawley）强行推销数十亿美元 白宫简报在很大程度上变成了达菲的推销，他敦促国会批准数十亿美元的资金，以重建该国空中交通管制系统内老化的计算机基础设施。他告诉记者，特朗普政府过去两年一直要求拨款300亿美元，用于建设全新的空中交通管制系统。 “国会，让我们让这个系统更加安全，”达菲说。 “我不可能一夜之间打响指就建立起一个网络，但你希望我们为美国建立这个网络吗？我认为每一位国会议员都应该说‘是’。”达菲没有提到的是，过去两年来，没有批准政府拨款请求的国会一直由共和党（他的政党）控制。

paras.en: - Duffy blames 'incredibly old air traffic control system' Mike Crawley Duffy is blaming old hardware for the air traffic control communications outage that triggered the nationwide grounding of flights. "What we have is an incredibly old air traffic control system," he told a White House briefing. "The president for the last year has been asking Congress to fully fund a full build of a brand new air traffic control system." Congress has been asked for $30 billion US for the project, but Duffy says now, in the wake of today's outage, he wants $50 billion. Duffy said the specific issue was instability in communications with planes and radar data at its 22 regional air traffic control centres that handle flights at higher altitudes. "It's an old system that went down and went down everywhere. It got overloaded," Duffy said.
paras.zh: - 达菲指责“令人难以置信的旧空中交通管制系统” 迈克·克劳利·达菲将空中交通管制通信中断归咎于旧硬件，导致全国范围内的航班停飞。 “我们拥有的是一个极其古老的空中交通管制系统，”他在白宫简报会上说。 “去年总统一直要求国会全额资助全面建设全新的空中交通管制系统。”国会已被要求为该项目提供 300 亿美元，但达菲现在表示，在今天的停电之后，他需要 500 亿美元。达菲表示，具体问题是处理高空航班的 22 个地区空中交通管制中心的飞机通信和雷达数据不稳定。 “这是一个旧系统，到处都在崩溃。它已经超载了，”达菲说。

paras.en: - BREAKING: Ground stop order lifted nationwide Mike Crawley The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration has lifted a nationwide ground stop order that brought flights across the United States to a standstill. The ripple effect of the FAA's order, which was in effect for more than four hours, will likely last many days as airlines work through the backlog of delays. The FAA has lifted its extraordinary order that grounded thousands of flights across the U.S. "At 8:15 p.m. tonight we've opened up the airspace," U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy told the White House briefing. Duffy said it will take some time before air travel returns to normal schedules.
paras.zh: - 突发新闻：全国范围内取消地面停止命令 Mike Crawley 美国联邦航空管理局取消了全国范围内的地面停止命令，该命令导致美国各地的航班陷入停顿。美国联邦航空管理局的命令已生效四个多小时，其连锁反应可能会持续很多天，因为航空公司正在努力解决积压的延误问题。美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 取消了停飞全美数千架航班的特别命令。美国交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 在白宫简报会上表示，“今晚 8 点 15 分，我们开放了领空”。达菲表示，航空旅行恢复正常还需要一段时间。

paras.en: - Mullin says no connection with Microsoft outage Mike Crawley Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin has kicked off a briefing at the White House by denying the air traffic shutdown had anything to do with the Microsoft outage of the past two days. "I know a lot of people are making that jump," Mullin said. "What we've seen, there is actually no cyberattack."
paras.zh: - Mullin 表示与 Microsoft 宕机事件无关 Mike Crawley 国土安全部部长 Markwayne Mullin 在白宫举行的简报会上否认空中交通关闭与过去两天的 Microsoft 宕机事件有任何关系。 “我知道很多人都在迈出这一步，”穆林说。 “据我们所见，实际上没有网络攻击。”

paras.en: - Why some U.S. planes are taking off Mike Crawley Video feeds from a few U.S. airports are showing the occasional plane taking off despite the FAA's nationwide ground-stop order. You might be wondering why. These are planes departing coastal airports with flight routes taking them over the Atlantic and Pacific oceans. Such flights don't fall under the scope of the 22 regional air traffic control centres that have been hit by the communications outage that triggered the ground stop. These centres manage flights at higher altitudes as they cross the continental U.S. Flights have been allowed to take off for European destinations from such airports as Washington's Dulles International, and for Pacific Rim destinations from San Francisco and other West Coast airports.
paras.zh: - 为什么一些美国飞机要起飞 迈克·克劳利 从美国一些机场传来的视频显示，尽管美国联邦航空管理局在全国范围内下达了地面停飞令，但飞机还是偶尔起飞。您可能想知道为什么。这些飞机从沿海机场起飞，航线飞越大西洋和太平洋。此类航班不属于22个地区空中交通管制中心的管辖范围，这些中心因通信中断而导致地面停止。这些中心管理飞越美国大陆的更高海拔航班。航班被允许从华盛顿杜勒斯国际机场等机场起飞前往欧洲目的地，以及从旧金山和其他西海岸机场飞往环太平洋地区目的地。

paras.en: - Air Canada cancels Friday flights to and from U.S. Geoff Nixon Air Canada, citing the ongoing FAA ground stop, says it's cancelling flights both to and from the United States for "the remainder of the evening." In a Friday evening post on X, the airline is also advising that "flights between Canada, the Caribbean and South America that transit U.S. airspace may also be impacted."
paras.zh: - 加拿大航空取消周五往返美国的航班 杰夫·尼克松加拿大航空 (Geoff Nixon) 以美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 地面停留为由，表示将取消“当晚剩余时间”往返美国的航班。在 X 周五晚间的一篇文章中，该航空公司还建议“加拿大、加勒比海和南美洲之间途经美国领空的航班也可能受到影响。”

paras.en: - Disappointment at U.S. departures in Vancouver Troy Charles I'm here at Vancouver International Airport as passengers in the U.S. departures wing struggle to sort out travel plans. The big board here shows 22 flights bound for the United States, as of 5:45 p.m. PT, eight of those flights are cancelled and seven are delayed. I spoke with a U-15 B.C. Lacrosse team that had an afternoon flight set for California to play in a Lacrosse tournament. Right before boarding the call came down that their flight was cancelled. The coach of the team says they are out of options and have had to pull out of the tournament. Another Vancouver resident had boarded a plane bound for Las Vegas for his birthday weekend when the captain came over the intercom informing passengers of the nationwide ground stop in the United States. Plenty of long faces and frustrated passengers here as they wait to find out if and when they may reach their destination.
paras.zh: - 对温哥华美国出发航班感到失望 Troy Charles 我在温哥华国际机场，美国出发航班的乘客正在努力制定旅行计划。截至下午 5 点 45 分，这里的大屏幕显示有 22 趟飞往美国的航班。太平洋时间，其中八个航班被取消，七个航班延误。我与一名 U-15 BC 进行了交谈长曲棍球队下午飞往加利福尼亚州参加长曲棍球锦标赛。就在登机前，接到电话说他们的航班被取消了。球队教练表示他们别无选择，不得不退出比赛。另一名温哥华居民在登上飞往拉斯维加斯过生日周末的飞机时，机长通过对讲机告知乘客美国全国地面站的情况。这里有很多板着脸、沮丧的乘客，他们等待着知道是否以及何时可以到达目的地。

paras.en: - Update coming from the White House Mike Crawley Two members of U.S. President Donald Trump's cabinet are expected in the White House press room at any moment. The media have been told to gather for a briefing from Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin.
paras.zh: - 来自白宫迈克·克劳利的最新消息预计美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的两名内阁成员随时都会出现在白宫新闻发布室。媒体被告知聚集在一起，听取交通部长肖恩·达菲和国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林的简报。

articles.title: Spanish goalkeeper barred 12 games for collision leading to death of Tenerife striker

paras.en: Spanish goalkeeper barred 12 games for collision leading to death of Tenerife striker
paras.zh: 西班牙门将因碰撞导致特内里费前锋死亡被禁赛12场

paras.en: Jesús de Miguel was chasing high ball in midfield when he was struck in the chest by Jesus Owono
paras.zh: 赫苏斯·德米格尔在中场追逐高球时，被赫苏斯·奥沃诺击中胸部

paras.en: Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been suspended 12 games after he received a red card for a reckless on-field collision with Jesus de Miguel that resulted in the death of the Tenerife striker.
paras.zh: 安道尔门将赫苏斯·奥沃诺因在场上与赫苏斯·德米格尔发生鲁莽碰撞并导致特内里费前锋赫苏斯·德·米格尔死亡而被红牌罚下，被禁赛12场。

paras.en: The Spanish soccer federation's disciplinary committee issued the suspension for Owono on Friday, 10 days after De Miguel died a day after his clash with Owono.
paras.zh: 周五，西班牙足协纪律委员会对奥沃诺进行了停赛，十天前，德米格尔在与奥沃诺发生冲突的第二天就去世了。

paras.en: The disciplinary committee said Owono used "excessive force" in the collision.
paras.zh: 纪律委员会表示，奥沃诺在碰撞中使用了“过度武力”。

paras.en: De Miguel was chasing a high ball in midfield when he was struck in the chest by Owono, who rushed far outside his area, near the end of the Nov. 2 match in Tenerife. The 30-year-old De Miguel suffered cardiac arrest following the collision. He died the next day.
paras.zh: 11月2日在特内里费岛的比赛临近尾声时，德米格尔在中场追高球时被奥沃诺击中胸部，奥沃诺冲出德米格尔的禁区很远。 30 岁的德米格尔在碰撞后心脏骤停。第二天他就死了。

paras.en: Owono issued a statement through his club expressing his remorse and offering his condolences to De Miguel's family.
paras.zh: 奥沃诺通过俱乐部发表声明，表达悔恨并向德米格尔的家人表示哀悼。

paras.en: Spanish police opened an investigation into possible involuntary manslaughter. Under Spanish law, deaths from non-natural causes, including accidents, are subject to judicial investigation, though prosecutors have said that criminal proceedings are unlikely.
paras.zh: 西班牙警方对可能的过失杀人事件展开调查。根据西班牙法律，包括事故在内的非自然原因死亡将受到司法调查，但检察官表示不太可能提起刑事诉讼。

paras.en: On Thursday, Andorra coach Carles Manso said it will be up to Owono to decide when he feels ready to play again.
paras.zh: 周四，安道尔教练卡莱斯·曼索表示，奥沃诺将决定何时准备好再次参加比赛。

paras.en: "He is deeply affected by the situation," Manso said. "We will give him the space to feel completely free to decide whether, and when, he might want to return."
paras.zh: “他深受这种情况的影响，”曼索说。 “我们会给他空间，让他可以完全自由地决定是否以及何时回归。”

articles.title: UN hails progress in Ebola response, cites insecurity as biggest challenge

paras.en: UN hails progress in Ebola response, cites insecurity as biggest challenge
paras.zh: 联合国赞扬埃博拉应对工作取得进展，称不安全是最大挑战

paras.en: Six months since the outbreak was declared in Congo, response teams are struggling to get ahead
paras.zh: 自刚果宣布疫情爆发六个月以来，应对小组正在努力取得进展

paras.en: United Nations health officials on Friday hailed progress in the Ebola response six months after the outbreak first prompted global concerns, but cautioned that the disease continues to spread to more remote and dangerous parts of Congo.
paras.zh: 埃博拉疫情首次引发全球担忧六个月后，联合国卫生官员周五对埃博拉应对工作取得的进展表示欢迎，但警告称，该疾病继续蔓延到刚果更偏远和危险的地区。

paras.en: With the number of confirmed cases now surpassing 11,100, the outbreak is the second-worst for Ebola on record and has spread to parts of east, central and west Africa. More than 5,400 people have died so far, according to the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC).
paras.zh: 目前确诊病例数已超过11,100例，这是有记录以来第二严重的埃博拉疫情，并已蔓延至东非、中非和西非部分地区。据非洲疾病控制和预防中心 (Africa CDC) 称，迄今为止已有 5,400 多人死亡。

paras.en: Flagged by health authorities in mid-May, the outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo species of the virus, for which there are no approved treatments or vaccines.
paras.zh: 卫生当局于 5 月中旬指出，此次疫情是由罕见的 Bundibugyo 病毒引起的，目前尚无批准的治疗方法或疫苗。

paras.en: "We do see encouraging signs," said Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of the World Health Organization's Health Emergencies Programme, citing falling cases in former hotspots like Bunia in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织突发卫生事件项目负责人奇奎​​·伊赫克韦祖表示：“我们确实看到了令人鼓舞的迹象。”他列举了刚果民主共和国东部布尼亚等前热点地区病例数下降的情况。

paras.en: "But what we have seen now is the emergence of cases in more rural and more difficult-to-reach areas."
paras.zh: “但我们现在看到的是，更多农村和更难以到达的地区出现了病例。”

paras.en: - Congo's Ebola outbreak tops 11,000 cases as disease keeps spreading
paras.zh: - 刚果埃博拉疫情持续蔓延，病例数已突破 11,000 例

paras.en: - 1 in 4 Ebola deaths are children in Democratic Republic of Congo's worst outbreak
paras.zh: - 在刚果民主共和国疫情最严重的地区，四分之一的埃博拉死亡病例是儿童

paras.en: - Exclusive 'No one is safe' as Ebola outbreak surges to more than 10,000 cases, Africa's top doctor warns Canada
paras.zh: - 非洲顶级医生警告加拿大，随着埃博拉疫情激增至一万多例，“没有人是安全的”

paras.en: He added that children account for more than one third of deaths while transmission continues with up to 500 cases reported every week.
paras.zh: 他补充说，儿童占死亡人数的三分之一以上，而传播仍在继续，每周报告的病例多达 500 例。

paras.en: "The biggest challenge the response faces right now is the rising insecurity," he said, citing WHO data showing 80 attacks on health sites and workers so far.
paras.zh: 他说：“目前应对工作面临的最大挑战是日益加剧的不安全感。”他援引世卫组织的数据称，迄今为止已发生 80 起针对卫生场所和工作人员的袭击。

paras.en: "Violence restricts our access to people in need of help. It disrupts surveillance, it disrupts treatment and forces people to move, disrupting their access to care," said Ihekweazu.
paras.zh: “暴力限制了我们接触需要帮助的人。它扰乱了监视，扰乱了治疗并迫使人们搬家，扰乱了他们获得护理的机会，”伊赫克韦祖说。

paras.en: An attack last week by a rebel armed group in North Kivu killed 66 civilians including three health workers. Three health facilities were also looted and burned and more than 1,000 contacts that were being monitored were lost to followup after the violence. Three patients confirmed to have Ebola are also unaccounted for.
paras.zh: 上周，北基伍省反叛武装组织发动袭击，造成 66 名平民死亡，其中包括 3 名卫生工作者。三个卫生设施也遭到抢劫和烧毁，1000 多名正在接受监控的接触者在暴力事件后失去了踪迹。三名确诊感染埃博拉病毒的患者也下落不明。

paras.en: Congolese civilians carry their belongings as they flee following an attack by Islamic State-linked militants, who burned homes, a health post and other buildings, in Cantine-Aloya, Democratic Republic of Congo, on Nov. 6. (Gradel Muyisa Mumbere/Reuters)
paras.zh: 11 月 6 日，在刚果民主共和国 Cantine-Aloya，与伊斯兰国有联系的武装分子发动袭击，烧毁了房屋、卫生站和其他建筑物，刚果平民携带财物逃离。（Gradel Muyisa Mumbere/路透社）

paras.en: "We need an urgent halt in hostilities and violence," said Dr. Marie Belizaire, an emergency director with the WHO during a briefing.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织紧急事务主任玛丽·贝利泽尔博士在新闻发布会上说：“我们需要紧急停止敌对行动和暴力。”

paras.en: Belizaire says the ongoing violence puts any progress made over the past six months at risk.
paras.zh: 贝利泽尔表示，持续的暴力事件使过去六个月取得的任何进展都面临风险。

paras.en: "Health workers and humanitarian teams need to be able to reach affected communities safely and patients will be able to seek care without fear," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“卫生工作者和人道主义团队需要能够安全到达受影响的社区，患者也能够毫无恐惧地寻求护理。”

paras.en: Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, Ebola has spread across eight provinces.
paras.zh: 自5月15日宣布疫情爆发以来，埃博拉病毒已蔓延至八个省份。

paras.en: Africa CDC says there has been some progress. Laboratory testing capacity and patient beds have significantly scaled up. Initially there were only two labs available and now 30 testing labs are up and running across the affected health zones.
paras.zh: 非洲疾病预防控制中心表示已经取得了一些进展。实验室检测能力和病床数量显着扩大。最初只有两个实验室可用，现在受影响的卫生区已建立并运行 30 个测试实验室。

paras.en: "At the beginning of this response, we were only able to do testing for dozens of cases — with the capacity now for more than 4,300 samples per day," said Dr. Wessam Mankoula, a medical epidemiologist with the Africa CDC.
paras.zh: 非洲疾病预防控制中心的医学流行病学家 Wessam Mankoula 博士说：“在应对措施之初，我们只能对数十个病例进行检测，而现在每天的检测能力超过 4,300 个样本。”

paras.en: There are also 2,000 beds for patient admission and more than 3,000 people have recovered from Ebola.
paras.zh: 还有2000张床位供病人收治，已有3000多人从埃博拉病毒中康复。

paras.en: However, in a briefing, Mankoula said having more beds and testing will not control the outbreak.
paras.zh: 然而，曼库拉在新闻发布会上表示，增加床位和检测并不能控制疫情。

paras.en: Dr. Toussaint Selemani, head of medical activities at the Ebola Treatment Center of the Kitatumba Reference Hospital, talks to his medical colleagues in Butembo in October. (Gradel Muyisa Mumbere/Reuters)
paras.zh: 10 月份，Kitatumba 参考医院埃博拉治疗中心医疗活动负责人 Toussaint Selemani 博士在布滕博与他的医务同事交谈。 （格拉德尔·穆伊萨·蒙贝尔/路透社）

paras.en: "Surveillance is a big challenge — identifying all possible contacts," he said. "This is very critical to the success of this response."
paras.zh: “监视是一项巨大的挑战——识别所有可能的接触者，”他说。 “这对于这次应对措施的成功非常关键。”

paras.en: Only 11 per cent of new cases are coming from contact lists and nearly two thirds of deaths are still occurring outside of health centres.
paras.zh: 只有 11% 的新病例来自接触者名单，近三分之二的死亡仍然发生在卫生中心之外。

paras.en: Low access to funds contributing to 'dysfunctions'
paras.zh: 难以获得资金导致“功能障碍”

paras.en: In a briefing, Africa CDC says according to its tracking, $3 billion US has been pledged to help with the crisis but only 45 per cent has been disbursed.
paras.zh: 非洲疾病预防控制中心在一份简报中表示，根据其追踪，已承诺提供 30 亿美元来帮助应对危机，但仅支付了 45%。

paras.en: Help is not reaching those who need it most, according to French medical charity Doctors Without Borders, pointing to untrained and unpaid staff, ambulances without fuel and a lack of surveillance teams and supplies to safely manage suspected cases.
paras.zh: 法国医疗慈善机构无国界医生组织表示，最需要帮助的人并未获得帮助，他们指出，工作人员未经培训且无薪，救护车没有燃料，缺乏监控团队和安全管理疑似病例的物资。

paras.en: "Despite the vast amounts of money provided for the response, many front-line responders are left trying to contain the outbreak with empty hands and empty pockets," Dr. Javid Abdelmoneim, international president for Doctors Without Borders, said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 无国界医生组织国际主席贾维德·阿卜杜勒莫奈姆博士周四表示：“尽管为应对工作提供了大量资金，但许多前线救援人员仍然两手空空、口袋空空，试图控制疫情。”

paras.en: "Our teams are often left speechless by the dysfunctions they witness in many areas. Six months into the response, this situation is simply unacceptable."
paras.zh: “我们的团队经常因在许多领域看到的功能失调而无言以对。响应已经六个月了，这种情况简直令人无法接受。”

paras.en: Doctors Without Borders called on the Congolese government and UN agencies, which include the World Health Organization, to ensure the resources that have been mobilized translate into support on the ground.
paras.zh: 无国界医生组织呼吁刚果政府和包括世界卫生组织在内的联合国机构，确保已调动的资源转化为实地支持。

articles.title: Tanker collides with cruise ship on Mississippi in New Orleans

paras.en: More than 30 people were hospitalized but no deaths were reported after a freighter collided with a cruise ship on the Mississippi River in the US on Friday.
paras.zh: 周五，一艘货轮在美国密西西比河与一艘游轮相撞，造成 30 多人住院，但无人死亡。

paras.en: Authorities said at least 180 passengers and crew were rescued. New Orleans Mayor Helena Moreno described it as "a miracle on the Mississippi," adding that none of those hospitalized had critical injuries.
paras.zh: 当局表示，至少 180 名乘客和机组人员获救。新奥尔良市市长海伦娜·莫雷诺形容这是“密西西比河上的一个奇迹”，并补充说住院的人都没有重伤。

paras.en: Footage showed the paddlewheel cruise boat, called The American Heritage, capsizing after the impact with the much larger cargo vessel and rescue teams rushing to get people in life jackets out of the water.
paras.zh: 视频显示，这艘名为“美国遗产号”的明轮游轮在撞击后倾覆，更大的货船和救援队正赶忙将穿着救生衣的人从水中救出。

paras.en: The accident happened near the port of New Orleans when the freighter Atlantic Asphalt hit the cruise ship while it was docked.
paras.zh: 事故发生在新奥尔良港附近，货轮“大西洋沥青”号在停靠时撞上了游轮。

paras.en: "It was just chaos," local witness Devon Flanagan was quoted by news agency AP.
paras.zh: 美联社援引当地目击者德文·弗拉纳根的话说：“这只是一片混乱。”

paras.en: "You had all types of ships, like other barges and other companies down there trying to help out, which also was a little convoluted because you had people still in the water," he described the scene.
paras.zh: “有各种类型的船只，就像其他驳船和其他公司一样，试图提供帮助，这也有点复杂，因为有人仍在水中，”他描述了现场。

paras.en: The company operating The American Heritage , American Cruise Lines, said in a statement that "guests and crew were evacuated, and we are deeply concerned for everyone involved."
paras.zh: 运营美国传统游轮的公司美国游轮公司在一份声明中表示，“客人和船员已被疏散，我们对所有相关人员深感担忧。”

paras.en: According to AP, the cruise ship was built in 2015, is five stories tall and can hold up to 150 passengers. It was finishing an eight-day cruise to several Mississippi River destinations in Louisiana and Mississippi.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，这艘游轮建于2015年，高五层，最多可容纳150名乘客。它即将结束为期八天的航行，前往路易斯安那州和密西西比州的几个密西西比河目的地。

paras.en: When news of the collision broke, it was initially unclear whether there were any fatalities and how many people were injured or missing.
paras.zh: 当碰撞消息传出时，最初尚不清楚是否有人死亡以及有多少人受伤或失踪。

paras.en: Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry said he was on his way to New Orleans.
paras.zh: 路易斯安那州州长杰夫·兰德里表示，他正在前往新奥尔良的途中。

paras.en: "We are aware of the incident on the Mississippi and we are in close contact with local officials and law enforcement," he wrote on X.
paras.zh: “我们知道密西西比河上发生的事件，我们正在与当地官员和执法部门保持密切联系，”他在 X 上写道。

paras.en: US Department of Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin wrote on social media that "we are throwing every asset we have to helping rescue missing passengers" and that his department was coordinating closely with state officials.
paras.zh: 美国国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林在社交媒体上写道，“我们正在投入一切资源来帮助营救失踪乘客”，并且他的部门正在与州官员密切协调。

articles.title: SpaceX launches Starship rocket, fails to recover booster

paras.en: US company SpaceX has successfully launched the latest flight of its Starship spacecraft into orbit but did not recover the booster rocket as planned.
paras.zh: 美国SpaceX公司已成功将其最新一次的Starship飞船送入轨道，但并未按计划回收助推火箭。

paras.en: The company, owned by tech billionaire Elon Musk, is hoping to develop a fully reusable rocket system. It had planned to recover both the booster and the upper stage, which is the spacecraft itself.
paras.zh: 该公司由科技亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克拥有，希望开发一种完全可重复使用的火箭系统。它原计划回收助推器和上级，即航天器本身。

paras.en: Instead of landing back at the launch site, the booster exploded above the Gulf of Mexico. The upper stage is currently in orbitand the plan is to recover it on Saturday when it returns to Earth.
paras.zh: 助推器没有返回发射场，而是在墨西哥湾上空爆炸。上面级目前在轨道上，计划于周六返回地球时将其回收。

paras.en: It is to be caught by mechanical arms upon landing back at the launch pad, marking the first time the spacecraft would be caught after returning to Earth. It could then potentially be reused in the future.
paras.zh: 它在返回发射台时将被机械臂抓住，这标志着航天器返回地球后首次被抓住。将来它可能会被重复使用。

paras.en: In addition to testing the reusable rocket system, the mission also delivered 26 of SpaceX’s satellitesfor its Starlink network.
paras.zh: 除了测试可重复使用的火箭系统外，此次任务还为其星链网络​​交付了 26 颗 SpaceX 卫星。

paras.en: SpaceX's Starship is the world's largest and most powerful rocket system. At 124 meters (407 feet) tall, it consists of a spacecraft mounted on a booster rocket. Both stages were designed from the outset to be fully reusable.
paras.zh: SpaceX 的 Starship 是世界上最大、最强大的火箭系统。它高 124 米（407 英尺），由安装在助推火箭上的航天器组成。这两个阶段从一开始就被设计为完全可重复使用。

paras.en: At the launch, both the spacecraft and booster successfully lifted off from the SpaceX South Texas Starbase site. While the Friday launch was an uncrewed mission, Starship is designed to carry both crew and cargo.
paras.zh: 发射时，航天器和助推器均成功从 SpaceX 南德克萨斯星际基地升空。虽然周五的发射是一项无人任务，但“星舰”的设计目的是同时运载船员和货物。

paras.en: On its return path, the booster diverted from its flight path to the launch site and steered to a designated area over the Gulf of Mexico where it exploded over the sea surface. The reasons for the failure of the controlled landing were not immediately clear.
paras.zh: 在返回途中，助推器从飞行路径转向发射场，转向墨西哥湾上空的指定区域，并在海面爆炸。受控着陆失败的原因尚不清楚。

paras.en: "Not sure right now why we weren't able to bring it back," SpaceX's Dan Huot said.
paras.zh: SpaceX 的丹·霍特 (Dan Huot) 表示：“现在不确定为什么我们无法将其带回来。”

paras.en: The upper stage continued into orbit and soon after began releasing the 26 satellites it was carrying.
paras.zh: 上级继续进入轨道，不久后开始释放其携带的 26 颗卫星。

paras.en: It is scheduled to return to Earth on Saturday.
paras.zh: 它计划于周六返回地球。

paras.en: Developing a fully reusable rocket system is key to SpaceX’s goal to drive down the cost of spaceflight.
paras.zh: 开发完全可重复使用的火箭系统是 SpaceX 降低航天成本目标的关键。

paras.en: In previous launches, the Starship booster was successfully recovered. The upper stages of the 14 previous Starship missions have all ended up in the ocean though, either by design or because of failures.
paras.zh: 在之前的发射中，星舰助推器已成功回收。不过，之前 14 次星舰任务的上层阶段都最终落入了海洋，要么是设计原因，要么是因为失败。

paras.en: The new objective of Friday’s launch was to recover both stages of the Starship launch system.
paras.zh: 周五发射的新目标是恢复星舰发射系统的两个阶段。

paras.en: Currently, SpaceX is mostly using smaller Falcon rockets, which are not fully reusable because the second stage cannot be recovered.
paras.zh: 目前，SpaceX 主要使用较小的猎鹰火箭，由于第二级无法回收，这些火箭不能完全重复使用。

paras.en: Musk said he expected SpaceX to conduct Starship launches once a week by early 2027.
paras.zh: 马斯克表示，他预计 SpaceX 将在 2027 年初之前每周进行一次星际飞船发射。

paras.en: The project has received billions of dollars in NASA funding, with SpaceX also investing at least $15 billion.
paras.zh: 该项目已获得 NASA 数十亿美元的资助，SpaceX 也投资了至少 150 亿美元。

paras.en: The main goal of the program is to put astronauts on the Moon by 2028 although outstanding technical challenges could delay that schedule.
paras.zh: 该计划的主要目标是在 2028 年之前将宇航员送上月球，尽管突出的技术挑战可能会推迟这一时间表。

articles.title: Gen Z protests: Do Baby Boomers really have it better than young people?

paras.en: Young people across Germany and Europe are taking to the streets, voicing fears of a bleak future.
paras.zh: 德国和欧洲各地的年轻人走上街头，表达对黯淡未来的恐惧。

paras.en: But is that really the case? Does Gen Z face greater challenges than Baby Boomers did in the 1990s? What do the two generations have in common, and where do their experiences differ?
paras.zh: 但事实真的是这样吗？ Z 世代面临的挑战是否比 20 世纪 90 年代婴儿潮一代面临的挑战更大？两代人有什么共同点，他们的经历又有何不同？

paras.en: "Of course, it's fair to ask, 'Were things just as tough for you back then?'" youth researcher Simon Schnetzer tells DW. "But young people see that things are difficult for them now, and say that's why they need support today."
paras.zh: “当然，我们可以公平地问，‘当时的情况对你来说也同样艰难吗？’”青年研究员西蒙·施奈策（Simon Schnetzer）告诉德国之声。 “但年轻人看到现在的事情对他们来说很困难，并说这就是他们今天需要支持的原因。”

paras.en: Schnetzer, who wrote the annual Youth in Germany study, highlights one key question raised by the recent demonstrations across Europe as: "Have we given young people the conditions they need to live and work here with confidence, and to keep this system funded?"
paras.zh: 施奈策撰写了年度德国青年研究报告，他强调了最近欧洲各地示威活动提出的一个关键问题：“我们是否为年轻人提供了他们自信地在这里生活和工作所需的条件，并为这个系统提供了资金支持？”

paras.en: His straightforward answer is no. A survey of the statistics shows that both Gen Z and the Baby Boomers are affected by major societal changes, but in different ways. DW surveyed data on pensions, education, housing and climate change to find out more.
paras.zh: 他直接的回答是否定的。一项统计调查显示，Z 世代和婴儿潮一代都受到重大社会变革的影响，但影响方式不同。德国之声调查了养老金、教育、住房和气候变化方面的数据，以了解更多信息。

paras.en: The facts point to a clear trend: Fewer and fewer young people are having to support an ever-growing number of retirees. According to the Germany's public pension insurance system, there were 3.73 contributors for every retiree in 1957. By 2025, that figure had fallen to just 2.1.
paras.zh: 事实表明了一个明显的趋势：越来越少的年轻人需要赡养越来越多的退休人员。根据德国公共养老保险制度，1957年，每名退休人员有3.73人缴费。到2025年，这一数字已降至仅2.1人。

paras.en: By 2045, this number is projected to drop to just 1.73 contributors per retiree. In absolute terms, this means 35.35 million contributors will be financing pensions for 16.82 million retirees.
paras.zh: 到 2045 年，这一数字预计将下降至每名退休人员仅 1.73 名缴款人。从绝对数量来看，这意味着 3535 万缴款人将为 1682 万退休人员提供养老金。

paras.en: To cushion this trend and keep contribution rates stable, the pension system already receives around €118 billion [$131 billion] in annual government subsidies. This amounts to roughly 25% of the federal budget. That means an increasing share of the population will be called upon to help fund pensions.
paras.zh: 为了缓解这一趋势并保持缴费率稳定，养老金体系已获得约 1,180 亿欧元（1,310 亿美元）的年度政府补贴。这大约相当于联邦预算的 25%。这意味着越来越多的人口将被要求为养老金提供资金。

paras.en: There are also signs that many people's pensions are already falling short of covering their living expenses. The number of retirees relying on federal basic income support has risen from 257,000 in 2003 to 738,000 in 2024.
paras.zh: 还有迹象表明，许多人的养老金已经不足以支付他们的生活费用。依赖联邦基本收入支持的退休人员人数已从2003年的257,000人增加到2024年的738,000人。

paras.en: Rising rents hit low-income households particularly hard. According to a report by the German Institute for Economic Research (DIW), the share of income spent on rent by low-income households rose from around 24% in 1990 to nearly 36% in 2021.
paras.zh: 租金上涨对低收入家庭的打击尤其严重。德国经济研究所（DIW）的一份报告显示，低收入家庭用于租金的收入比例从1990年的24%左右上升到2021年的近36%。

paras.en: This means that in 2021, the lowest-income households spent an average of 14 percentage points more of their income on rent than high-income households.
paras.zh: 这意味着，2021年，最低收入家庭用于租金的支出占其收入的平均比高收入家庭多14个百分点。

paras.en: According to Germany's Federal Statistical Office (Destatis), in 2025, an average of 11% of the population spent more than 40% of their disposable income on housing costs. Among people at risk of poverty, the figure was as high as 35%.
paras.zh: 根据德国联邦统计局（Destatis）的数据，2025年，平均有11%的人口将可支配收入的40%以上用于住房费用。在面临贫困风险的人群中，这一数字高达35%。

paras.en: However, according to calculations by real estate platform Jacasa, Boomers could actually help ease pressure on the housing market in the coming years. They currently own around 4.8 million owner-occupied houses and apartments.
paras.zh: 然而，根据房地产平台 Jacasa 的计算，婴儿潮一代实际上可以帮助缓解未来几年房地产市场的压力。他们目前拥有约 480 万套自住房屋和公寓。

paras.en: Over the coming decades, these properties are expected to change hands as former occupants sell them, move into assisted living, or hand them down through inheritance. In some regions, this could lead to an oversupply of properties and, consequently, lower prices, according to Jacasa's projections.
paras.zh: 在未来的几十年里，随着前居住者出售它们、进入辅助生活区或通过继承将它们传下来，这些房产预计将易手。根据 Jacasa 的预测，在某些地区，这可能会导致房地产供应过剩，从而导致价格下降。

paras.en: According to the federal government's Education Finance Report, public spending on education for people under 30 has doubled since 2011, rising from around €4,000 to approximately €8,000 per person annually.
paras.zh: 根据联邦政府的教育财政报告，自 2011 年以来，30 岁以下人群的公共教育支出翻了一番，从每人每年约 4,000 欧元增加到约 8,000 欧元。

paras.en: Despite this increase, Germany ranks only in the middle of the pack internationally. According to the Federal Statistical Office (Destatis), public education spending accounted for 4.6% of Germany's gross domestic product (GDP) in 2022, compared with an OECD average of 4.7%.
paras.zh: 尽管有这样的增长，德国在国际上的排名仅处于中游。根据联邦统计局(Destatis)的数据，2022年公共教育支出占德国国内生产总值(GDP)的4.6%，而经合组织的平均水平为4.7%。

paras.en: However, the additional funding cannot solve the problem of teacher shortages. According to estimates by the Standing Conference of the Ministers of Education and Cultural Affairs, Germany will be short of around 27,000 teachers by 2035. The main reasons are the wave of Baby Boomer retirements and declining birth rates, which have contributed to a shortage of young teachers.
paras.zh: 然而，追加经费并不能解决师资短缺的问题。据教育和文化部长常务会议估计，到2035年，德国将短缺约2.7万名教师。主要原因是婴儿潮一代退休潮和出生率下降导致年轻教师短缺。

paras.en: Back in 1972, the Club of Rome warned of the consequences of global warming in its landmark publication The Limits to Growth. According to the United Nations, the planet is on track for 2.6°C of warming by the end of the century compared with pre-industrial levels.
paras.zh: 早在 1972 年，罗马俱乐部就在其具有里程碑意义的出版物《增长的极限》中警告了全球变暖的后果。据联合国称，到本世纪末，与工业化前水平相比，地球气温将上升 2.6°C。

paras.en: If the world maintains its current climate policies, children who are six years old today could experience heat waves two to seven times as often as Boomers did over their lifetimes. That was the finding of a 2025 study by Vrije University in Brussels.
paras.zh: 如果世界维持目前的气候政策，今天六岁的儿童一生中经历热浪的次数可能是婴儿潮一代的两到七倍。这是布鲁塞尔自由大学 2025 年一项研究的结果。

paras.en: The deadly impact of extreme weather is already evident in rising death tolls during recent heatwaves. According to Germany's Robert Koch Institute (RKI), an estimated 16,000 people died from heat-related causes across Germany by mid-September 2026. The vast majority — more than 14,000 — were over the age of 65.
paras.zh: 最近热浪造成的死亡人数不断上升，极端天气的致命影响已经显而易见。根据德国罗伯特·科赫研究所 (RKI) 的数据，截至 2026 年 9 月中旬，德国各地估计有 16,000 人死于高温相关原因。其中绝大多数（超过 14,000 人）年龄在 65 岁以上。

paras.en: "Gen Z and Baby Boomers are in the same boat. We need to bring them together, because otherwise younger people have no prospects for prosperity, and neither do older generations," youth researcher Schnetzer concludes.
paras.zh: “Z 世代和婴儿潮一代处于同一条船上。我们需要将他们聚集在一起，因为否则年轻人就没有繁荣的前景，老一辈也没有，”青年研究员施奈泽总结道。

paras.en: He suggests that both generations take to the streets and protest together, adding that would just be the beginning. "What needs to follow is a constructive process to define goals and measures that everyone can support," he said. "Even if it means making sacrifices."
paras.zh: 他建议两代人一起走上街头抗议，并补充说这只是开始。 “需要遵循的是一个建设性的过程，以确定每个人都可以支持的目标和措施，”他说。 “即使这意味着做出牺牲。”

paras.en: This article was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。

articles.title: Siege fuels disease fears in Yemen’s Taiz

paras.en: Taiz, Yemen – The woman held the body of a young baby girl wrapped in a white shroud.
paras.zh: 也门塔伊兹——一名妇女抱着一名裹着白色裹尸布的小女婴的尸体。

paras.en: “Our children are dying because of the siege. We have no open road, no medics and no medicines,” the woman said.
paras.zh: “我们的孩子因为围困而死去。我们没有畅通的道路，没有医务人员，也没有药品，”这名妇女说。

paras.en: Wearing the traditional clothing of women from Jabal Sabir, the mountain that overlooks the city of Taiz and is one of its most famous symbols, she appeared in a short video widely circulated on social media on November 10.
paras.zh: 11 月 10 日，她穿着 Jabal Sabir 妇女的传统服装出现在社交媒体上广为流传的一段短视频中。Jabal Sabir 山俯瞰着塔伊兹市，也是塔伊兹最著名的标志之一。

paras.en: In her arms was the body of an infant from her family, identified as Gaza Ali Abdulmughni al-Shaqab, who had fallen ill and died after her family was unable to get her emergency medical care. The Yemeni Network for Rights and Freedoms said the vehicle carrying the baby to the hospital was attacked by Houthi forces as it travelled through mountain roads.
paras.zh: 她怀里抱着她家人的一具婴儿的尸体，她的名字是加沙·阿里·阿卜杜勒穆尼·沙卡卜 (Gaza Ali Abdulmughni al-Shaqab)，她因家人无法获得紧急医疗护理而生病并死亡。也门权利与自由网络表示，载着婴儿前往医院的车辆在穿越山路时遭到胡塞武装袭击。

paras.en: “She died, and we couldn’t get her emergency treatment because of the siege,” the woman said, referring to the ongoing Houthi siege of al-Shaqab, which lies on a front line between the rebel group and Yemeni government forces.
paras.zh: “她死了，由于围困，我们无法为她提供紧急治疗，”这位女士说，她指的是胡塞武装对青年党的围攻，该青年党位于叛乱组织和也门政府军之间的前线。

paras.en: The siege of Taiz and the surrounding areas such as al-Shaqab intensified in early October, when the Houthis advanced around the city and cut off the last major supply route into government-held areas.
paras.zh: 10月初，对塔伊兹及沙卡布等周边地区的围困加剧，胡塞武装向该市推进，切断了进入政府控制区的最后一条主要补给路线。

paras.en: Fighting between the Iran-backed group and the Saudi-backed Yemeni government intensified over the summer, before the Houthis captured substantial territory along Yemen’s Red Sea coast in September and then made further advances in Taiz governorate.
paras.zh: 今年夏天，伊朗支持的组织与沙特支持的也门政府之间的战斗愈演愈烈，胡塞武装于 9 月占领了也门红海沿岸的大片领土，然后在塔伊兹省进一步推进。

paras.en: Government counteroffensives have only had limited success so far, and the siege of the city of Taiz continues.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，政府的反攻只取得了有限的成功，对塔伊兹市的围困仍在继续。

paras.en: The Yemeni government has accused the Houthis of tightening their siege on nearly two million people living in Taiz for more than a month, preventing the entry of food, safe drinking water, medicines and fuel.
paras.zh: 也门政府指责胡塞武装在一个多月的时间里加强了对塔伊兹近200万人的围困，阻止食品、安全饮用水、药品和燃料进入。

paras.en: Human Rights Watch (HRW) said in a statement on October 29 that the siege imposed by the Houthis on civilians in Taiz “may amount to the war crime of using starvation as a method of warfare”.
paras.zh: 人权观察组织10月29日发表声明称，胡塞武装对塔伊兹平民的围困“可能构成以饥饿作为战争手段的战争罪”。

paras.en: The Houthis have denied responsibility for the road closures, instead blaming Yemeni government forces.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装否认对封路负责，而是指责也门政府军。

paras.en: But HRW said that residents, aid workers and United Nations officials had all reported that the Houthis were to blame.
paras.zh: 但人权观察表示，居民、援助人员和联合国官员都报告说，胡塞武装应对此事负责。

paras.en: International bodies have repeatedly warned of the crisis now facing Taiz.
paras.zh: 国际机构多次警告塔伊兹目前面临的危机。

paras.en: On October 14, the World Food Programme (WFP) said that it had been unable to reach more than 600,000 people in Taiz dependent on humanitarian assistance.
paras.zh: 10 月 14 日，世界粮食计划署 ​​(WFP) 表示，无法为塔伊兹超过 60 万依赖人道主义援助的民众提供援助。

paras.en: The WFP described the situation as “especially alarming”, noting that most districts in Taiz were classified as facing emergency levels of hunger.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署将这种情况描述为“特别令人震惊”，并指出塔伊兹的大多数地区都被列为面临紧急饥饿水平。

paras.en: For its part, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) warned that health services in Taiz were failing because of a shortage of supplies.
paras.zh: 联合国人道主义事务协调办公室（OCHA）警告说，塔伊兹的卫生服务由于供应短缺而失败。

paras.en: Nearly 250,000 people had lost access to essential healthcare, including more than 186,000 children younger than five years old, the agency said.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，近 25 万人无法获得基本医疗保健，其中包括超过 186,000 名五岁以下儿童。

paras.en: It added that more than 1,400 cases of acute diarrhoea and suspected cholera were reported in just one week.
paras.zh: 报告补充说，仅一周内就报告了1,400多例急性腹泻和疑似霍乱病例。

paras.en: “Twelve hospitals are at risk of closing or have had to reduce services due to a lack of fuel and critical supplies,” OCHA added.
paras.zh: 人道协调厅补充说：“由于缺乏燃料和关键物资，十二家医院面临关闭的风险或不得不减少服务。”

paras.en: According to figures obtained by Al Jazeera from the Epidemiological Surveillance Department at Taiz’s Public Health and Population Office, 5,642 cases across three disease categories were recorded during the latest four-week reporting period.
paras.zh: 根据半岛电视台从塔伊兹公共卫生和人口办公室流行病学监测部门获得的数据，在最近四个星期的报告期内，三种疾病类别共记录了 5,642 例病例。

paras.en: The vast majority – 5,228 cases – were of acute watery diarrhoea. There were also 232 suspected dengue fever cases and 182 suspected cholera cases.
paras.zh: 其中绝大多数（5,228 例）为急性水样腹泻。还有232例登革热疑似病例和182例霍乱疑似病例。

paras.en: The number of watery diarrhoea cases decreased compared with the previous reporting period, but Dr Yasin Abdulmalik, the director of the department, said that was likely the result of residents finding it increasingly difficult to reach health facilities because of road closures between the city and surrounding rural areas.
paras.zh: 与上一个报告期相比，水样腹泻病例数量有所减少，但该部门主任亚辛·阿卜杜勒马利克博士表示，这可能是由于城市与周边农村地区之间的道路封闭，居民越来越难以前往医疗机构。

paras.en: “The siege has led to a shortage of petroleum products, including fuel, whose prices have risen on the black market,” Abdulmalik said. “This has created an additional difficulty in travelling to hospitals and health centres for treatment because of higher transport fares.”
paras.zh: 阿卜杜勒马利克说：“围困导致包括燃料在内的石油产品短缺，黑市上的价格上涨。” “由于交通费用较高，这给前往医院和医疗中心接受治疗带来了额外的困难。”

paras.en: “In reality, more than twice this number of cases were unable to reach [health facilities] because of the siege and its various consequences,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“事实上，由于围困及其造成的各种后果，有两倍多的病例无法到达[医疗机构]。”

paras.en: Taysir al-Samiei, a health communications official at Taiz’s Public Health and Population Office, told Al Jazeera that patients’ ability to reach hospitals had fallen by between 60 and 70 percent by the end of the second week of the siege.
paras.zh: 塔伊兹公共卫生和人口办公室的卫生通讯官员泰西尔·萨米埃 (Taysir al-Samiei) 告诉半岛电视台，到围困第二周结束时，患者前往医院的能力已下降了 60% 至 70%。

paras.en: Dr Fares al-Absi, a consultant in diabetes, endocrinology and obesity, said the reported high number of acute watery diarrhoea and cholera cases was down to the use of unsafe water sources.
paras.zh: 糖尿病、内分泌学和肥胖症顾问 Fares al-Absi 博士表示，报告的大量急性水样腹泻和霍乱病例是由于使用了不安全的水源。

paras.en: Al-Absi said the situation had worsened “after the Houthis prevented safe drinking water from entering the city, except for limited quantities sold at high prices, which have risen dramatically because of the shortage of diesel”.
paras.zh: 阿卜西表示，“在胡塞武装阻止安全饮用水进入该市之后，除了以高价出售的有限数量的饮用水外，情况变得更加恶化，而这些饮用水由于柴油短缺而大幅上涨”。

paras.en: “Recently, access to the al-Dhabab water basin, a major source of water transported by trucks, has been restricted,” al-Absi added. “Only about 8 percent of Taiz’s water needs are currently being met, while most local wells are unfit for consumption.”
paras.zh: 阿卜西补充说：“最近，进入达巴布水盆地（卡车运输水的主要来源）的通道受到了限制。” “塔伊兹目前仅约 8% 的用水需求得到满足，而当地大多数水井都无法饮用。”

paras.en: Al-Absi also explained that dengue fever was spreading because of the conditions in the city.
paras.zh: 阿卜西还解释说，由于该市的条件，登革热正在蔓延。

paras.en: The disease is transmitted by mosquitoes that breed in stagnant water, while accumulated rubbish can also create conditions that favour mosquito breeding.
paras.zh: 这种疾病是通过在死水中繁殖的蚊子传播的，而堆积的垃圾也会创造有利于蚊子繁殖的条件。

paras.en: Al-Absi said that tonnes of waste had accumulated in Taiz’s streets because of insufficient diesel to transport the rubbish. He also accused the Houthis of preventing sanitation trucks from reaching the landfill in the west of the city.
paras.zh: 阿卜西说，由于没有足够的柴油来运输垃圾，塔伊兹的街道上堆积了数吨垃圾。他还指责胡塞武装阻止环卫车到达该市西部的垃圾填埋场。

paras.en: “Both stagnant water and rubbish have increased significantly as a result of the siege, as streets and residential neighbourhoods have turned into open rubbish dumps,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“由于围困，积水和垃圾都大幅增加，街道和居民区变成了露天垃圾场。”

articles.title: Philippine court orders arrest of jailed, US-wanted celebrity preacher

paras.en: A Philippine court has ordered the arrest of jailed celebrity preacher Apollo Quiboloy, who is wanted in the US on child sex trafficking charges, in a step towards his possible extradition, according to the country’s Justice Department.
paras.zh: 据菲律宾司法部称，菲律宾一家法院已下令逮捕被监禁的名人传教士阿波罗·奎博洛伊（Apollo Quiboloy），他因儿童性交易指控而在美国被通缉，这是可能引渡他的一步。

paras.en: The department’s spokesman Polo Martinez told the AFP news agency on Saturday that the Makati Regional Trial Court issued the warrant of arrest and a hold-departure on Thursday after finding probable cause that he committed the offences charged.
paras.zh: 该部门发言人波罗·马丁内斯周六告诉法新社，马卡蒂地区审判法院在找到他犯下指控的罪行的合理理由后，于周四发出了逮捕令并暂缓离境。

paras.en: The Philippine government filed its petition with a lower court on Monday, three months after Washington formally requested his extradition in August. Under Philippine law, the court must now hold hearings before deciding whether or not to hand him over.
paras.zh: 菲律宾政府于周一向下级法院提交了请愿书，距华盛顿于八月正式请求引渡他三个月后。根据菲律宾法律，法院现在必须举行听证会才能决定是否移交他。

paras.en: The court issued the same orders against two co-accused, Teresita Dandan and Helen Panilag, both officers of Quiboloy’s Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) sect. The two women are still at large, according to local media reports.
paras.zh: 法院对两名同案被告特雷西塔·丹丹 (Teresita Dandan) 和海伦·帕尼拉格 (Helen Panilag) 发出了同样的命令，她们都是基波洛伊耶稣基督王国 (KOJC) 教派的官员。据当地媒体报道，这两名女子仍然在逃。

paras.en: Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, speaking on behalf of the Office of the President, denied that the warrant was timed to coincide with US President Donald Trump’s visit to Manila on November 17 for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations summit.
paras.zh: 宫殿新闻官克莱尔·卡斯特罗代表总统办公室发言，否认逮捕令的时间恰逢美国总统唐纳德·特朗普 11 月 17 日访问马尼拉参加东南亚国家联盟峰会。

paras.en: “No, it was probably just a coincidence,” she said, according to the Philippines News Agency.
paras.zh: 据菲律宾通讯社报道，她说：“不，这可能只是巧合。”

paras.en: Quiboloy, who calls himself the “appointed son of God”, is being held without bail while on trial for human trafficking in Pasig, which carries life in prison if convicted, AFP reported.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，自称为“上帝任命的儿子”的奎博洛伊因贩卖人口罪在巴石接受审判，不得保释，如果罪名成立，他将被判处终身监禁。

paras.en: He also faces a child abuse trial in Quezon City, according to local media. He has denied the allegations and pleaded not guilty to the Philippine charges.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，他还在奎松市面临虐待儿童审判。他否认了这些指控，并对菲律宾的指控表示无罪。

paras.en: A US grand jury indicted Quiboloy in 2021 for conspiracy to engage in sex trafficking by force, fraud and coercion, sex trafficking of children and bulk cash smuggling, AFP reported.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，美国大陪审团于 2021 年对 Quiboloy 提出起诉，罪名是密谋以武力进行性交易、欺诈和胁迫、儿童性交易以及大宗现金走私。

paras.en: The FBI identified Dandan as the “international administrator” of a fake charity operation, and Panilag as a former top church administrator in the US, according to local media reports.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，联邦调查局认定丹丹是一家虚假慈善机构的“国际管理员”，帕尼拉格是美国前教会高级管理员。

paras.en: Police said after his 2024 arrest that alleged victims were told they were having sex with the “spirit of God” and were threatened that “angels of death” would hunt them down if they told anyone, AFP reported.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，警方表示，在他 2024 年被捕后，据称受害者被告知他们正在与“上帝的灵”发生性关系，并受到威胁，如果他们告诉任何人，“死亡天使”就会追捕他们。

paras.en: The church said at the time that members had “freedom of choice”.
paras.zh: 教会当时表示，成员有“选择的自由”。

paras.en: Quiboloy’s sect claims to have millions of followers and owns a television network.
paras.zh: 奎博洛伊教派声称拥有数百万追随者并拥有一个电视网络。

paras.en: He is a close ally of former President Rodrigo Duterte. He ran for Senate last year from prison and received 5.6 million votes, but lost, AFP reported.
paras.zh: 他是前总统罗德里戈·杜特尔特的亲密盟友。据法新社报道，他去年出狱竞选参议员，获得 560 万张选票，但落选。

articles.title: Salah breaks Egypt scoring record, Tunisia lose to Libya in AFCON qualifier

paras.en: Mohamed Salah scored twice in Egypt’s 5-0 thrashing of Malawi in the Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers on Friday, becoming the country’s leading all-time scorer with 70 goals.
paras.zh: 周五，在非洲国家杯预选赛埃及5-0大胜马拉维的比赛中，穆罕默德·萨拉赫梅开二度，以70粒进球成为该国历史最佳射手。

paras.en: The 34-year-old former Liverpool star left it late in Cairo to overtake Hossam Hassan, scoring with a far-post header in the 84th minute and from a penalty five minutes into added time.
paras.zh: 这位34岁的前利物浦球星在开罗比赛最后时刻超越了霍萨姆·哈桑，他在第84分钟远门柱头球破门，并在补时五分钟后通过点球破门。

paras.en: Hassan was fired as Egypt coach last week, and replacement Ali Maher made a perfect start with goals from Nasser Maher, Omar Marmoush and Mohamed Hany building a 3-0 lead by half-time.
paras.zh: 哈桑上周被解雇，埃及队主帅阿里·马赫接替他，纳赛尔·马赫、奥马尔·马尔穆什和穆罕默德·哈尼的进球帮助球队在半场结束时取得了3-0的领先优势，取得了完美的开局。

paras.en: Egypt have seven points in Group B after three matches, three more than Angola, who host South Sudan on Saturday.
paras.zh: 经过三场比赛，埃及在 B 组中积 7 分，比周六主场迎战南苏丹的安哥拉多 3 分。

paras.en: Achraf Hakimi, favourite to win a second successive African Footballer of the Year award next month, also bagged a brace as Group A pacesetters Morocco crushed Niger 5-1 in Casablanca.
paras.zh: 阿什拉夫·哈基米（Achraf Hakimi）是下个月连续第二次获得非洲足球先生奖的热门人选，他也梅开二度，帮助 A 组领头羊摩洛哥在卡萨布兰卡以 5-1 击败尼日尔。

paras.en: Substitute Tolu Arokodaro scored twice within eight minutes as Nigeria beat Tanzania 3-1 in Uyo to get their campaign back on track.
paras.zh: 替补上场的托卢·阿科达罗在八分钟内梅开二度，帮助尼日利亚在乌约以 3-1 击败坦桑尼亚，球队重回正轨。

paras.en: Tunisia suffered a shock home 2-0 loss to Libya, and Kenya scored in the final minute to snatch a surprise 2-2 draw away to South Africa.
paras.zh: 突尼斯主场0-2惨败给利比亚，肯尼亚在最后时刻进球，客场2-2意外战平南非。

paras.en: Alhassan Yusuf put Nigeria ahead after just 103 seconds and Alphonce Msanga equalised on 32 minutes following a rare Tanzanian attack.
paras.zh: 阿尔哈桑·优素福 (Alhassan Yusuf) 仅在 103 秒后就帮助尼日利亚队取得领先，阿尔方斯·姆桑加 (Alphonce Msanga) 在坦桑尼亚队罕见的进攻后，于第 32 分钟扳平了比分。

paras.en: Arokodaro, scorer of six goals in his last five matches for Ajax Amsterdam, came off the bench for the second half and quickly made an impact.
paras.zh: 阿罗科达罗在阿贾克斯阿姆斯特丹的过去五场比赛中打进了六球，他在下半场替补出场并很快产生了影响。

paras.en: His near-post back heel off a low cross put Nigeria ahead for the second time after 52 minutes, and as the match reached the hour mark, he struck again from close range.
paras.zh: 他的近门柱后脚后跟低平传中，帮助尼日利亚队在第 52 分钟后第二次领先，当比赛进入一小时时，他再次近距离射门。

paras.en: An ultimately comfortable victory lifted the Super Eagles to six points after three rounds in Group L, one point behind Guinea-Bissau, who drew 1-1 with Madagascar on Thursday.
paras.zh: 最终轻松获胜，超级鹰队在L组三轮比赛后积6分，落后周四1-1战平马达加斯加的几内亚比绍队一分。

paras.en: Nigeria back on track, Tunisia in trouble
paras.zh: 尼日利亚重回正轨，突尼斯陷入困境

paras.en: Although bottom of the table with just one point, Tanzania are guaranteed a place at the 2027 AFCON as cohosts with Kenya and Uganda.
paras.zh: 尽管仅积一分排名垫底，但坦桑尼亚将与肯尼亚和乌干达共同主办 2027 年非洲杯。

paras.en: That means Guinea-Bissau, Nigeria and Madagascar must fight for one place at the 24-nation tournament, the first to be staged in East Africa since Ethiopia were the 1976 hosts.
paras.zh: 这意味着几内亚比绍、尼日利亚和马达加斯加必须在 24 国锦标赛中争夺一个席位，这是自埃塞俄比亚 1976 年主办以来首次在东非举行。

paras.en: Nigeria were in trouble after a 3-0 hammering in Guinea-Bissau two months ago, but now have a clear path to a tournament they have won three times.
paras.zh: 两个月前，尼日利亚队在几内亚比绍队以 3-0 惨败后陷入困境，但现在他们已经在三连冠的比赛中找到了一条清晰的道路。

paras.en: Away wins over Tanzania on Tuesday and Madagascar in March, and a home win over Guinea-Bissau, also in March, will assure qualification.
paras.zh: 周二客场战胜坦桑尼亚，三月客场战胜马达加斯加，三月主场战胜几内亚比绍，将确保晋级。

paras.en: Tunisia are in Group H, which includes cohosts and automatic qualifiers Uganda, and their record of reaching every AFCON tournament since 1994 is in peril.
paras.zh: 突尼斯分在 H 组，其中包括共同主办国和自动预选赛的乌干达，他们自 1994 年以来参加每届非洲杯的记录都岌岌可危。

paras.en: A 2-0 defeat at home to neighbours Libya leaves them bottom of the table with just two points, and a venue switch two months ago means their remaining three fixtures are all away.
paras.zh: 主场0-2输给邻国利比亚，使他们仅积两分排名垫底，而两个月前的比赛场地更换意味着他们剩下的三场比赛都将在客场进行。

paras.en: Ali Youssef converted a 44th-minute penalty for Libya, and Hamdou Elhouni, who once played for leading Tunisian club Esperance, doubled the lead in the 62nd minute.
paras.zh: 阿里·优素福（Ali Youssef）在第44分钟为利比亚主罚点球，曾效力于突尼斯顶级俱乐部埃斯佩兰斯（Esperance）的哈姆杜·埃尔霍尼（Hamdou Elhouni）在第62分钟将领先优势扩大一倍。

paras.en: Victory lifted Libya from last place to a share of the lead on four points with Uganda. Botswana and Tunisia have two each. Uganda host Botswana in Kampala on Saturday.
paras.zh: 胜利使利比亚从垫底位置上升到与乌干达并列领先 4 分。博茨瓦纳和突尼斯各有两个。乌干达周六在坎帕拉主场迎战博茨瓦纳。

paras.en: The Group D clash between South Africa and Kenya pitted two South African coaches against each other. Pitso Mosimane handles Bafana Bafana and Benni McCarthy guides the Harambee Stars.
paras.zh: D组南非队与肯尼亚队的交锋，是两位南非教练的对决。皮索·莫西曼 (Pitso Mosimane) 负责指挥巴法纳·巴法纳 (Bafana Bafana)，本尼·麦卡锡 (Benni McCarthy) 负责指导哈兰比之星 (Harambee Stars)。

paras.en: Former Manchester United coaching staffer McCarthy was the happier at full-time after Ryan Ogam equalised in the final minute of regular time.
paras.zh: 在瑞安·奥加姆在常规时间最后一分钟扳平比分后，前曼联教练麦卡锡在全场比赛中感到更加高兴。

paras.en: From a South African perspective, this was two points lost, although they remain on top with seven. Guinea have six, automatic qualifiers; Kenya, two; and Eritrea, one.
paras.zh: 从南非队的角度来看，尽管他们仍以 7 分位居榜首，但还是丢了两分。几内亚有六场，自动预选赛；肯尼亚，两个；厄立特里亚就是其中之一。

articles.title: Drought threatens Iraq's marshes, risking one of the oldest ways of life
articles.author: Jane Arraf

paras.en: Drought threatens Iraq's marshes, risking one of the oldest ways of life
paras.zh: 干旱威胁着伊拉克的沼泽，危及最古老的生活方式之一

paras.en: The unique marshes of southern Iraq are beginning to revive after five years of devastating drought. But challenges remain for one of the world's oldest ways of life.
paras.zh: 经历了五年的毁灭性干旱后，伊拉克南部独特的沼泽地开始复苏。但世界上最古老的生活方式之一仍然面临挑战。

paras.en: In the marshes of southern Iraq, one of the world's oldest ways of life is under threat. Years of drought decimated the buffalo herds that people have depended on since the dawn of history. Over the last year, rain has revived some marshlands, but there's just not enough to ward off other threats. NPR's Jane Arraf and Fatima Al-Kassab bring us this report from Iraq.
paras.zh: 在伊拉克南部的沼泽地里，世界上最古老的生活方式之一正受到威胁。多年的干旱导致了人类自有历史以来赖以生存的水牛群的大量死亡。去年，降雨使一些沼泽地恢复了生机，但还不足以抵御其他威胁。 NPR 的 Jane Arraf 和 Fatima Al-Kassab 为我们带来了这份来自伊拉克的报道。

paras.en: JANE ARRAF, BYLINE: It's just after sunrise in Iraq's marshes, about 50 miles from the ancient site of Ur. There are water buffalo wading in the shallow water. We're in a long, narrow boat called a mashuf, the same design used for thousands of years.
paras.zh: 简·阿拉夫连线：日出后，伊拉克的沼泽地距离乌尔古遗址约 50 英里。浅水区有水牛在涉水。我们乘坐的是一条又长又窄的船，称为“mashuf”，这种设计已经使用了数千年。

paras.en: ARRAF: Birds here include a few migratory species still passing through. Even after years of drought, there's incredible biodiversity here.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：这里的鸟类包括一些仍在途经的候鸟。即使经历了多年的干旱，这里的生物多样性仍然令人难以置信。

paras.en: FATIMA AL-KASSAB, BYLINE: Wow. Oh, my God.
paras.zh: 法蒂玛·卡萨布连线：哇。我的天啊。

paras.en: ARRAF: There are just, like, five or six of them, little ones. But wild boars just swam across and darted into the reeds.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：大概只有​​五六个，都是小孩子。但野猪只是游过去，冲进芦苇丛里。

paras.en: It was a mother and her piglets, gone in a flash. Our guide, Jassim Al-Asadi, the co-founder of the environmental organization Nature Iraq, points out a white egret.
paras.zh: 那是一位母亲和她的小猪，转眼间就消失了。我们的导游贾西姆·阿萨迪（Jassim Al-Asadi）是伊拉克自然环境组织的联合创始人，他指着一只白鹭。

paras.en: JASSIM AL-ASADI: You see the buffalo? With a bird - and there is a bird on the buffalo. You see?
paras.zh: JASSIM AL-ASADI： 你看到水牛了吗？有一只鸟——水牛身上有一只鸟。你看？

paras.en: ARRAF: Saddam Hussein drained the marshes in the 1990s after an uprising in southern Iraq. Asadi was born in the marshes, literally in a boat. When the U.S. toppled Saddam in 2003, Asadi - an engineer - played a key role in restoring them. His work almost cost him his life. Three years ago, he was kidnapped and tortured by an Iran-backed militia in Iraq. It accused him of being an Israeli spy because he met with foreign journalists. When he was freed, he insisted on returning to his work there.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：20 世纪 90 年代伊拉克南部发生起义后，萨达姆·侯赛因排干了沼泽地。阿萨迪出生在沼泽地里，实际上是在船上。 2003年美国推翻萨达姆政权时，工程师阿萨迪在恢复政权的过程中发挥了关键作用。他的工作几乎要了他的命。三年前，他在伊拉克被伊朗支持的民兵绑架并遭受酷刑。它指责他是以色列间谍，因为他会见了外国记者。获释后，他坚持回到那里工作。

paras.en: ARRAF: "How's the water?" Asadi asks a herder milking one of the water buffalo.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：“水怎么样？”阿萨迪询问一名正在给一头水牛挤奶的牧民。

paras.en: ARRAF: Muammel Raad Waheed (ph) says he's getting twice as much milk from each one as he was during the drought, when there were dead water buffalo floating in the canals. Families then deserted the marshes, taking their remaining animals to places with more water. Now some of those families are starting to come back. But the future of the marshlands depends partly on the Iraqi government's water policies and those of Turkey and Syria, which share the rivers.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：穆阿梅尔·拉德·瓦希德（博士）说，他从每头牛身上得到的牛奶是干旱期间的两倍，当时运河里漂浮着死去的水牛。随后，人们抛弃了沼泽地，将剩下的动物带到了水源较多的地方。现在，其中一些家庭开始返回。但沼泽地的未来部分取决于伊拉克政府以及共享河流的土耳其和叙利亚的水政策。

paras.en: ARRAF: Fishermen tell Asadi they're still suffering.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：渔民告诉阿萨迪，他们仍然在受苦。

paras.en: AL-ASADI: There is only a kind, not - a bad kind of the fish. And no one eat it here. It is not tasty and smaller and...
paras.zh: AL-ASADI：只有一种鱼，而不是一种不好的鱼。而且这里没人吃。不好吃而且比较小...

paras.en: ARRAF: Those are sea fish that can live in more saline and polluted water. Without water treatment plants, towns here dump sewage directly into the marshes. On land, Asadi shows us Nature Iraq's solution.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：这些是可以生活在含盐量更高和污染的水中的海鱼。这里的城镇没有水处理厂，污水直接排入沼泽地。在陆地上，阿萨迪向我们展示了自然伊拉克的解决方案。

paras.en: AL-ASADI: This is the pumping station - floating pumping station. And the waters come here from Tigris to this pool.
paras.zh: AL-ASADI：这是泵站——浮动泵站。水从底格里斯河流到这个水池。

paras.en: ARRAF: A pond where reeds and other plants remove toxins from dirty water.
paras.zh: ARRAF：一个池塘，芦苇和其他植物可以去除脏水中的毒素。

paras.en: ARRAF: A few miles away, Asadi takes us to a village where workers are erecting a reed guesthouse, turning long stalks of the tied reeds into the distinctive arches. It's the same design found in ancient Sumerian stone carvings. After straining to lift the reed foundations, the workers erupt in celebration.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：几英里外，阿萨迪带我们来到一个村庄，那里的工人们正在建造一座芦苇宾馆，将长长的芦苇秆变成独特的拱门。这与古代苏美尔石雕中的设计相同。在用力抬起芦苇地基后，工人们爆发出庆祝活动。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED WORKERS: (Singing in Arabic).
paras.zh: 身份不明的工人：（用阿拉伯语唱歌）。

paras.en: ARRAF: Life is much harder these days. But people here are keeping alive traditions that have survived thousands of years while they wait for the marshes to recover.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：现在的生活更加艰难了。但这里的人们在等待沼泽恢复的同时，仍然保留着数千年来延续下来的传统。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED WORKERS: (Singing in Arabic).
paras.zh: 身份不明的工人：（用阿拉伯语唱歌）。

paras.en: ARRAF: Jane Arraf, NPR News, in the central marshes of southern Iraq.
paras.zh: ARRAF：简·阿拉夫，NPR 新闻，在伊拉克南部的中央沼泽地。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of transcripts for NPR programming may vary. Transcript text may also be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。
