articles.title: Kentucky needs buzzer-beating three to survive Northern Arizona's upset bid at Rupp Arena

paras.en: The Kentucky Wildcats have one of the most expensive rosters in college basketball. It didn't look like money well spent for 39 minutes and 58 seconds on Friday night.
paras.zh: 肯塔基野猫队拥有大学篮球界最昂贵的球员名单之一。周五晚上的 39 分 58 秒，看起来钱花得不值。

paras.en: Kentucky needed a last-second three-pointer from Alex Wilkins to beat winless Northern Arizona 78-77 at Rupp Arena. NAU, which entered the game as a 30.5-point underdog, had every opportunity to pull off a massive upset in the closing minute. The Lumberjacks had a 77-73 lead with just 22 seconds remaining.
paras.zh: 肯塔基队需要亚历克斯·威尔金斯在最后一秒投进三分球，在鲁普竞技场以 78-77 击败未尝胜绩的北亚利桑那队。 NAU 在比赛中以 30.5 分的劣势进入比赛，在最后一刻完全有机会制造出巨大的冷门。比赛还剩22秒时，伐木工队以77-73领先。

paras.en: Kentucky cut the deficit to two on a basket by Mason Williams, then had to intentionally foul Northern Arizona. Max Majerle, son of former Phoenix Suns All-Star Dan Majerle, missed the front end of the one-and-one, but a Kentucky player knocked the ball out of bounds in the scramble for the rebound.
paras.zh: 肯塔基队依靠梅森·威廉姆斯的投篮将比分差距缩小到两分，然后不得不故意对北亚利桑那州犯规。马克斯·马耶尔（Max Majerle）是前菲尼克斯太阳队全明星球员丹·马耶尔（Dan Majerle）的儿子，他错过了一对一的前端，但一名肯塔基州球员在抢篮板时将球撞出界外。

paras.en: Once again, Kentucky had to foul. Northern Arizona got the ball in the hands of Chris Komin, an 82% free throw shooter last season. But like Majerle, Komin missed the front end of the one-and-one. The Wildcats grabbed the board with 7 seconds left, moved the ball into the frontcourt on a pass from Mason Williams to to Wilkins, and Wilkins hit the game-winner.
paras.zh: 肯塔基队再次犯规。北亚利桑那州将球交给了上赛季罚球命中率 82% 的克里斯·科明 (Chris Komin)。但和马耶尔一样，科明错过了一对一的前端。还剩7秒时，野猫队抢下篮板，接到梅森·威廉姆斯的传球，将球移至前场，传给威尔金斯，威尔金斯命中制胜球。

paras.en: CBS Sports puts Kentucky’s roster in its $20 million-plus spending tier. The team it barely beat Friday had lost its first three games by an average of 24 points.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司体育频道 (CBS Sports) 将肯塔基州的阵容列入了 2000 万美元以上的支出级别。周五勉强击败的球队在前三场比赛中平均输掉了 24 分。

paras.en: When Northern Arizona went to the line with a chance to go up four, I wondered how far back I’d have to go to find a Kentucky loss as a 30-point favorite. I couldn’t find one. The Wildcats were favored by 25 when Evansville won at Rupp Arena in 2019 and by 26 when Gardner-Webb won there in 2007.
paras.zh: 当北亚利桑那队有机会上升 4 分时，我想知道要多久才能看到肯塔基队成为 30 分的热门球队。我找不到。 2019 年埃文斯维尔在鲁普竞技场获胜时，野猫队获得了 25 票的青睐；2007 年加德纳-韦伯在拉普竞技场获胜时，野猫队获得了 26 票的青睐。

paras.en: So how did Kentucky get that close to losing? The same problem I brought up before the Kansas game. The Wildcats had given up 80 points to James Madison, and I wondered whether they could get enough stops against the Jayhawks. Kansas scored 89 and won by 20.
paras.zh: 那么肯塔基州为何如此接近失败呢？我在堪萨斯队比赛前也提出了同样的问题。野猫队已经把 80 分让给了詹姆斯·麦迪逊，我想知道他们是否能在对阵松鸦鹰队时获得足够的得分。堪萨斯队拿下 89 分，以 20 分获胜。

paras.en: Then Northern Arizona came into Rupp, having scored an average of 62 points in their two losses to New Mexico and No. 12 Arizona, and shot 13-for-26 from 3 en route to 77 points.
paras.zh: 随后，北亚利桑那队迎来了鲁普，在输给新墨西哥队和排名第12的亚利桑那队的两场比赛中，鲁普场均得到62分，并且三分球26投13中，得到77分。

paras.en: Kentucky shot 56.4% and turned the ball over just four times Friday. If you’d told me that before tipoff, I would’ve figured the walk-ons were getting a few minutes.
paras.zh: 周五，肯塔基队投篮命中率为 56.4%，失误仅四次。如果你在比赛开始前告诉我，我会认为跑龙套的时间只有几分钟。

paras.en: Grambling State comes to Rupp on Monday before Kentucky plays Indiana on Friday.
paras.zh: 格兰布林州立大学将于周一对阵鲁普，周五肯塔基州将对阵印第安纳州。

paras.en: If the Tigers are still in it with 22 seconds left, at least I know where to find the Evansville and Gardner-Webb box scores.
paras.zh: 如果老虎队在还剩 22 秒时仍处于领先状态，至少我知道在哪里可以找到埃文斯维尔和加德纳-韦伯的统计数据。

articles.title: Mike Evans ruled out, Trent Williams questionable as NFC-leading 49ers' injury concerns persist

paras.en: The San Francisco 49ers will be without wide receiver Mike Evans for a third straight game Sunday after ruling him out against the Dallas Cowboys as he continues to deal with Achilles tendinitis.
paras.zh: 旧金山 49 人队将在周日连续第三场比赛中缺席外接手迈克·埃文斯 (Mike Evans)，此前他因跟腱炎而无法参加对阵达拉斯牛仔队的比赛。

paras.en: Meanwhile, it remains unclear whether standout left tackle Trent Williams will suit up after injuring his shoulder in practice this week.
paras.zh: 与此同时，目前还不清楚出色的左截锋特伦特·威廉姆斯在本周的训练中肩膀受伤后是否会穿上比赛服。

paras.en: Injuries are an unavoidable part of the NFL, but few teams have dealt with them as consistently as the San Francisco 49ers have in recent seasons. Their injury report has become a weekly storyline.
paras.zh: 伤病是 NFL 中不可避免的一部分，但很少有球队能像旧金山 49 人队最近几个赛季那样始终如一地应对伤病问题。他们的伤病报告已成为每周的故事情节。

paras.en: Evans and Williams were not the only concerns for San Francisco this week. Coach Kyle Shanahan said cornerbacks Deommodore Lenoir and Renardo Green were also on the injury report. Both missed practice Wednesday and Thursday after suffering injuries in last week’s game against Las Vegas, but they were limited participants Friday.
paras.zh: 埃文斯和威廉姆斯并不是本周旧金山唯一的担忧。教练凯尔·沙纳汉表示，角卫德奥莫多尔·勒努瓦和雷纳多·格林也在伤病报告中。两人在上周对阵拉斯维加斯的比赛中受伤后缺席了周三和周四的训练，但周五他们的参加人数有限。

paras.en: Linebacker Dre Greenlaw was also listed as questionable after hurting his knee at practice Thursday, while cornerback Nate Hobbs (adductor), defensive back Upton Stout (shoulder, neck) and defensive tackle C.J. West (knee) were also questionable.
paras.zh: 线卫德雷·格林劳在周四训练中膝盖受伤后也被列为出战成疑的名单，而角卫内特·霍布斯（内收肌）、防守后卫厄普顿·斯托特（肩膀、颈部）和防守截锋C.J.韦斯特（膝盖）也出战成疑。

paras.en: At 38, Williams remains a 12-time Pro Bowler playing at a high level, making his availability significant for San Francisco. He left practice early Thursday and did not participate Friday, but Shanahan remained hopeful the veteran tackle would feel well enough to play Sunday.
paras.zh: 38 岁的威廉姆斯仍然是 12 次入选职业保龄球手的高水平球员，这使得他对旧金山队来说意义重大。他周四早些时候离开了训练，并没有参加周五的比赛，但沙纳汉仍然希望这位经验丰富的截锋能够感觉良好，能够参加周日的比赛。

paras.en: Vederian Lowe would likely start if Williams is unable to go, but replacing the longtime standout would be a major challenge for the 49ers.
paras.zh: 如果威廉姆斯无法上场，维德里安·洛很可能会首发，但替换这位长期表现出色的球员对 49 人队来说将是一个重大挑战。

paras.en: "The left tackle in general is always huge. Then a guy of Trent’s caliber is huge," Shanahan said. "Just the way he plays out there, down in and down out, what he means to the team, just his presence, the type of person he is, and just what he brings on game day. He’s a captain for a reason, and everyone knows Trent Williams is one of the best players in this league."
paras.zh: “一般来说，左截锋总是很强大。那么像特伦特这样的球员就是巨大的，”沙纳汉说。 “就像他在场上的表现一样，无论进进出出，他对球队意味着什么，他的存在，他的为人，以及他在比赛日带来的东西。他成为队长是有原因的，每个人都知道特伦特·威廉姆斯是这个联盟中最好的球员之一。”

paras.en: San Francisco will have more help at receiver this week with Deebo Samuel set to return after missing the past three games with a hamstring injury and Keenan Allen set to make his debut for the 49ers after being acquired earlier this week in a trade from Indianapolis.
paras.zh: 旧金山队本周将在接球手方面得到更多帮助，迪博·塞缪尔(Deebo Samuel)因腿筋受伤缺席过去三场比赛后将回归，基南·艾伦(Keenan Allen)将于本周早些时候从印第安纳波利斯交易中获得49人队首秀。

paras.en: But they will be missing Evans again after he left a Week 6 game against Washington early with the injury. He missed the next two games and has been unable to practice since then but is making progress. Shanahan said there’s a chance Evans could play next week in Mexico against Minnesota.
paras.zh: 但在埃文斯因伤提前缺席第六周对阵华盛顿的比赛后，他们将再次错过埃文斯。他错过了接下来的两场比赛，此后一直无法训练，但正在取得进步。沙纳汉表示埃文斯下周有机会在墨西哥对阵明尼苏达队。

paras.en: The 49ers enter Sunday’s game with an NFC-best 7-1 record.
paras.zh: 49 人队以 NFC 最佳战绩 7 胜 1 负的战绩进入周日的比赛。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Democrat flips Alaska governor's mansion after Trump-backed GOP infighting

paras.en: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins has won Alaska's gubernatorial election, defeating Trump-endorsed Republican Bernadette Wilson and flipping the governor's mansion.
paras.zh: 民主党人乔纳森·克莱斯·汤姆金斯赢得了阿拉斯加州长选举，击败了特朗普支持的共和党人伯纳黛特·威尔逊，并推翻了州长官邸。

paras.en: The Associated Press called the race for Kreiss-Tomkins, a former state lawmaker, Friday evening local time. He is the first Democratic governor in Alaska since 1998.
paras.zh: 美联社于当地时间周五晚上宣布了前州议员克雷斯-汤姆金斯的竞选。他是自 1998 年以来第一位民主党阿拉斯加州州长。

paras.en: Alaska's gubernatorial election became an unusual contest as Republicans battled among themselves over who should succeed Gov. Mike Dunleavy, who was barred from seeking a third consecutive term.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加州的州长选举成为一场不同寻常的竞争，因为共和党人在谁应该接替被禁止寻求连续第三个任期的州长迈克·邓利维(Mike Dunleavy)的问题上展开了激烈的斗争。

paras.en: Wilson, a conservative activist and former political operative, received President Donald Trump's endorsement during a campaign in which multiple Republicans competed for the governor's office.
paras.zh: 威尔逊是一名保守派活动家和前政治人物，在多名共和党人竞争州长职位的竞选活动中获得了唐纳德·特朗普总统的支持。

paras.en: Trump publicly criticized fellow Republicans Dave Bronson and Treg Taylor, accusing them of dividing conservative voters and potentially jeopardizing the party's hold on the governorship.
paras.zh: 特朗普公开批评共和党同僚戴夫·布朗森和特雷格·泰勒，指责他们分裂保守派选民，并可能危及该党对州长职位的控制。

paras.en: Bronson, a former Anchorage mayor, and Taylor, a former Alaska attorney general, remained part of the Republican field, creating a complicated general-election contest.
paras.zh: 前安克雷奇市长布朗森和前阿拉斯加州总检察长泰勒仍然留在共和党阵营，造成了一场复杂的大选竞争。

paras.en: Kreiss-Tomkins, a former state representative from Sitka, emerged as the Democratic contender, seeking to return his party to the governor's mansion after Dunleavy's two terms.
paras.zh: 来自锡特卡的前州代表克莱斯-汤姆金斯成为民主党竞争者，寻求在邓利维连任两届后让他的政党重返州长官邸。

paras.en: The election unfolded under Alaska's ranked-choice voting system, which allows voters to rank candidates in order of preference.
paras.zh: 这次选举是在阿拉斯加的排名选择投票系统下进行的，该系统允许选民按照偏好顺序对候选人进行排名。

paras.en: If no candidate receives a majority of first-choice votes, the lowest-performing candidate is eliminated and those ballots are redistributed according to voters' next preferences. The process continues until a candidate secures a majority among continuing ballots.
paras.zh: 如果没有候选人获得多数第一选择选票，则表现最差的候选人将被淘汰，这些选票将根据选民的下一个偏好重新分配。该过程将持续进行，直到候选人在持续投票中获得多数席位。

paras.en: The system has added an unusual dynamic to Alaska politics, allowing multiple candidates from the same party to compete in the general election without a traditional partisan runoff.
paras.zh: 该制度为阿拉斯加政治增添了一种不同寻常的活力，允许来自同一党派的多名候选人在大选中竞争，而无需传统的党派决选。

paras.en: The contest also came as Alaska remained a reliably Republican state in presidential elections, despite occasionally electing Democrats and independents to statewide office.
paras.zh: 这场竞选也是在阿拉斯加在总统选举中仍然是一个可靠的共和党州之际进行的，尽管偶尔会选举民主党人和独立人士担任全州公职。

articles.title: US-bound flights out of Australia delayed after telecommunications outage grounded American planes
articles.author: Henry Belot

paras.en: Some US-bound flights from Sydney airport were grounded or delayed on Saturday after American authorities halted departures and delayed landings at all US airports.
paras.zh: 在美国当局停止在美国所有机场起飞并推迟降落后，周六从悉尼机场飞往美国的一些航班停飞或延误。

paras.en: Flights from Melbourne airport were also affected, with travel for passengers expected to depart for Los Angeles shortly after 10am being delayed by almost three hours.
paras.zh: 从墨尔本机场出发的航班也受到影响，预计上午 10 点后不久飞往洛杉矶的乘客的航班延误了近三个小时。

paras.en: Sydney airport confirmed the US ban on flight arrivals was lifted shortly before 1pm, although it was not known how this would impact delays.
paras.zh: 悉尼机场证实，美国对航班抵达的禁令在下午 1 点前不久被取消，但尚不清楚这将如何影响航班延误。

paras.en: Earlier, the airport confirmed some US-bound flights had been grounded.
paras.zh: 早些时候，机场证实部分飞往美国的航班已停飞。

paras.en: “We are aware of the nationwide ground stop issued by the US Federal Aviation Administration and are monitoring the situation closely,” the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 发言人表示：“我们了解美国联邦航空管理局在全国范围内发出的停飞令，并正在密切关注事态发展。”

paras.en: “Passengers travelling to or via the United States should check with their airline for the latest information regarding their flight.”
paras.zh: “前往或途经美国的乘客应向航空公司查询有关航班的最新信息。”

paras.en: Passengers on US bound flights from Sydney Airport reported being stuck on the tarmac for three hours before eventually departing. One plane required extra fuel after running air-conditioning for several hours while waiting.
paras.zh: 从悉尼机场飞往美国的航班上的乘客报告称，在最终起飞前被困在停机坪上三个小时。一架飞机在等待期间打开空调几个小时后需要额外的燃油。

paras.en: The FAA announced the nationwide pause in response to “a temporary telecommunications outage”. It has since lifted the grounding order, as it continued to investigate the cause of the outage.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空局宣布在全国范围内暂停运营，以应对“暂时的电信中断”。此后，该公司解除了停飞令，并继续调查停电原因。

paras.en: Passengers on two US-bound flights from Melbourne airport, which were due to depart at 12pm and 12.45pm, were also delayed due to the situation in the US.
paras.zh: 受美国疫情影响，原定于中午12点和12点45分起飞的两架从墨尔本机场飞往美国的航班的乘客也出现延误。

paras.en: A flight to Dallas, scheduled for 10am, departed at around 1pm, shortly after the US ban was lifted.
paras.zh: 美国禁令解除后不久，原定上午 10 点飞往达拉斯的航班于下午 1 点左右起飞。

paras.en: By 3pm Saturday, all delayed flights from Melbourne had departed.
paras.zh: 截至周六下午 3 点，所有从墨尔本出发的延误航班均已起飞。

paras.en: Qantas thanked passengers for their patience and recommended people with upcoming flights to the US to check its website for more information.
paras.zh: 澳洲航空感谢乘客的耐心等待，并建议乘坐即将飞往美国的航班的乘客查看其网站以获取更多信息。

paras.en: Four flights from Brisbane were also delayed.. Two had departed by 3pm on Saturday.
paras.zh: 从布里斯班起飞的四架航班也被延误。其中两架航班于周六下午 3 点起飞。

paras.en: “Passengers travelling to North America are advised to contact their airline for the latest information about their flight,” a Brisbane Airport spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 布里斯班机场发言人表示：“建议前往北美的乘客联系航空公司，了解有关航班的最新信息。”

articles.title: University hounded out of Hungary by Orbán reaches out to new government
articles.author: Jennifer Rankin in Brussels

paras.en: A university that Viktor Orbán tried to chase out of Hungary is open to expanding its presence in Budapest, in a mark of confidence in the country’s democratic future.
paras.zh: 维克托·欧尔班试图将其赶出匈牙利的一所大学对扩大其在布达佩斯的存在持开放态度，这标志着对该国民主未来的信心。

paras.en: Carsten Q Schneider, the interim president and rector of Central European University (CEU), said it was interested in increasing its programmes in Budapest, as long as this did not damage the student experience.
paras.zh: 中欧大学（CEU）临时校长兼校长卡斯滕·Q·施奈德（Carsten Q Schneider）表示，该校有兴趣增加在布达佩斯的项目，只要这不损害学生的体验。

paras.en: So far the CEU has not held formal talks with Hungary’s new government, which has promised to restore academic freedom, “but our hand is reaching out, their hand is reaching out – it is just that they have many things to do”, the academic told the Guardian.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，中欧大学尚未与承诺恢复学术自由的匈牙利新政府进行正式会谈，这位学者告诉《卫报》，“但我们的手正在伸出，他们的手也在伸出——只是他们有很多事情要做”。

paras.en: The CEU relocated its main activities to Vienna from Budapest in 2019, after pressure from the previous government led by Orbán. But the outlook changed when Péter Magyar won a landslide victory in April pledging to root out corruption and reform the state.
paras.zh: 在欧尔班领导的上届政府的压力下，CEU 于 2019 年将其主要活动从布达佩斯迁至维也纳。但当彼得·马扎尔 (Péter Magyar) 在四月份赢得压倒性胜利并承诺根除腐败并改革国家时，前景发生了变化。

paras.en: The CEU, founded by Hungarian-American financier and philanthropist George Soros in 1991 to entrench democratic change in the region, was forced to cease awarding degrees in Budapest in response to a law widely seen as targeting the institution.
paras.zh: CEU 由匈牙利裔美国金融家和慈善家乔治·索罗斯 (George Soros) 于 1991 年创立，旨在巩固该地区的民主变革，但由于一项广泛认为针对该机构的法律，该大学被迫停止在​​布达佩斯授予学位。

paras.en: The EU’s highest court struck down Hungary’s “Lex CEU” in 2020, finding that it violated the EU charter of fundamental rights, but the verdict came too late for the university. The CEU retains 312 staff in Budapest, mostly administrative, but the majority, 476, and all its teaching, are in Vienna.
paras.zh: 欧盟最高法院于2020年驳回了匈牙利的“Lex CEU”，认为它违反了欧盟基本权利宪章，但该判决对于该大学来说为时已晚。 CEU 在布达佩斯保留了 312 名工作人员，其中大部分是行政人员，但大多数（476 名）及其所有教学工作人员都在维也纳。

paras.en: Schneider said upgrading the status of the CEU, which is privately funded, in Budapest would be “a symbol for academic freedom [and] of resilience” but depended on goodwill and funding independent of the Hungarian government. He said a decision on its future in Hungary would be taken by the CEU’s 13-member board, whose members include Soros and his son, Alexander Soros.
paras.zh: 施奈德表示，布达佩斯由私人资助的 CEU 的地位升级将是“学术自由[和]韧性的象征”，但取决于独立于匈牙利政府的善意和资金。他表示，关于其在匈牙利的未来的决定将由 CEU 的 13 名成员组成的董事会做出，其中包括索罗斯和他的儿子亚历山大·索罗斯。

paras.en: “We don’t want special treatment,” Schneider said. ‘“We are a great asset, so let’s work out something.”
paras.zh: “我们不想要特殊待遇，”施奈德说。 “我们是一笔巨大的财富，所以让我们想办法吧。”

paras.en: But the CEU, which he said was “thriving tremendously” in Vienna, does not plan a wholesale return to Budapest. Any change would have to ensure the quality of the student experience, for instance, assuring that students would be able to combine courses, say in economics and history, without having to travel the 200km-plus distance between the two cities.
paras.zh: 但他表示，CEU 在维也纳“蓬勃发展”，并不打算大规模返回布达佩斯。任何改变都必须确保学生体验的质量，例如，确保学生能够将经济学和历史等课程结合起来，而不必在两个城市之间行驶 200 多公里的距离。

paras.en: Focused on social sciences, law and humanities, the CEU has more than 1,400 students from 103 countries, mostly doing master’s and PhD programmes.
paras.zh: CEU 专注于社会科学、法律和人文学科，拥有来自 103 个国家的 1,400 多名学生，大部分攻读硕士和博士课程。

paras.en: According to Schneider, for the first time in the CEU’s 25-year history, students from the US now make up the largest cohort of master’s students (10%). The CEU has seen an increase in US applicants since Donald Trump returned to the White House and launched a sweeping campaign against elite universities, including slashing federal funding and seeking to exert control over internal policies.
paras.zh: 施耐德表示，在 CEU 25 年的历史上，来自美国的学生首次成为硕士生中最大的群体（10%）。自唐纳德·特朗普重返白宫并发起针对精英大学的全面运动（包括削减联邦资金和寻求对内部政策的控制）以来，CEU 的美国申请人数有所增加。

paras.en: The CEU rector has had informal talks with US academics on how to maintain academic freedom under pressure from rightwing populists. He described his message as: “Don’t be naive for a second. These people have a plan, so it’s not by accident that they attack universities. They want to have cultural hegemony.” He added, however, that Trump and allied movements, such as Germany’s Alternative für Deutschland, have identified “real problems”, such as in the US how universities have entrenched “a reproduction of elites”
paras.zh: CEU校长与美国学者就如何在右翼民粹主义者的压力下维护学术自由进行了非正式会谈。他将自己的信息描述为：“一秒钟都不要天真。这些人有一个计划，所以他们攻击大学并不是偶然的。他们想要拥有文化霸权。”不过，他补充说，特朗普和德国另类选择党等联盟运动已经发现了“真正的问题”，例如在美国，大学如何巩固“精英再生产”

paras.en: When coming under political pressure, he said universities needed “to look for allies”, among other academic institutions, students, alumni and parents. Institutions also had to stand up for disciplines under attack, such as gender studies, Schneider added.
paras.zh: 他表示，在面临政治压力时，大学需要在其他学术机构、学生、校友和家长中“寻找盟友”。施奈德补充说，各机构还必须捍卫受到攻击的学科，例如性别研究。

paras.en: He recalled the outpouring of support for CEU – when tens of thousands of people protested in Budapest in defence of the university – as “one of the most humbling experiences I have had”.
paras.zh: 他回忆起对 CEU 的大力支持——当时数万人在布达佩斯举行抗议活动，捍卫大学——是“我经历过的最令人羞愧的经历之一”。

paras.en: Schneider, a German political scientist who specialises in the study of democracies and regime transition, said Magyar had successfully used Orbán’s political machine against him.
paras.zh: 专门研究民主和政权过渡的德国政治学家施奈德表示，马扎尔成功地利用了欧尔班的政治机器来对付他。

paras.en: “Nobody has a better idea than [Magyar] how to defeat the most potent and the most skilled illiberal populist [Orbán]. So he knows something.” He added: “The people and skills that you need to bring a non-democratic regime down are not the same and sometimes the opposite of what it takes to establish a democracy. So the question now is whether he [Magyar] has the skills to basically reinvent liberal democracy for the 21st century.”
paras.zh: “没有人比[马扎尔]更清楚如何击败最强大、最熟练的非自由民粹主义者[欧尔班]。所以他知道一些事情。”他补充道：“推翻非民主政权所需的人员和技能与建立民主所需的人员和技能并不相同，有时甚至相反。因此，现在的问题是，他（马扎尔）是否有能力从根本上重塑 21 世纪的自由民主。”

paras.en: Schneider said Hungary could be the world’s first “post-illiberal democracy” – a model for democratic restoration, just as Orbán inspired rightwing populists around the world. But he also raised doubts about this thesis, saying there were questions about how Magyar and his Tisza party might develop in the context of Hungary’s “very difficult economic situation”.
paras.zh: 施奈德表示，匈牙利可能成为世界上第一个“后非自由民主国家”——民主复兴的典范，就像欧尔班激励了世界各地的右翼民粹主义者一样。但他也对这一论点提出了质疑，称在匈牙利“非常困难的经济形势”的背景下，马扎尔和他的蒂萨政党如何发展存在疑问。

paras.en: The test would be, he suggested, when Magyar faces losing support and, eventually, defeat at the ballot box. “So what happens when he loses support and then cracks in his movement appear? Will he be the visionary leader who manages … to establish a three, four, five-party system, where people compete? That is to be seen.”
paras.zh: 他建议，考验将是当马扎尔面临失去支持并最终在投票箱中失败时。 “那么，当他失去支持，然后他的运动出现裂缝时，会发生什么？他会成为一位有远见的领导人，设法……建立一个三、四、五党制，让人们相互竞争吗？这还有待观察。”

articles.title: Microsoft ‘deeply sorry’ for global outage that could have billion-dollar impact on Australia
articles.author: Henry Belot and Guardian staff

paras.en: The Microsoft outage could be a disaster for the Australian economy that forces some small businesses to close, with costs expected to run into the billions of dollars, experts have warned.
paras.zh: 专家警告说，微软的宕机可能对澳大利亚经济造成一场灾难，迫使一些小企业关闭，损失预计将达到数十亿澳元。

paras.en: The US software company has said it is “deeply sorry” for a widespread outage that caused disruption to millions of users, organisations and businesses across the globe – and that it has “addressed the underlying issue”.
paras.zh: 这家美国软件公司表示，对于这次大范围的服务中断给全球数以百万计的用户、组织和企业带来了干扰，公司表示“深感抱歉”，并表示已经“解决了根本问题”。

paras.en: The company said the outage was a “technical issue” not related to cyber-attacks or AI agents, and that it continued to gradually restore services.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，此次中断是一个“技术问题”，与网络攻击或人工智能代理无关，并将继续逐步恢复服务。

paras.en: Experts have said the outage exposes “Australia’s reliance on foreign technology” and that people unable to be paid, send an invoice, or access government services “are entitled to be worried”.
paras.zh: 专家表示，这次停电暴露了“澳大利亚对外国技术的依赖”，无法获得付款、无法开具发票或无法获得政府服务的人们“有理由担心”。

paras.en: The outage of Microsoft’s services, which began on Friday morning, lasted roughly 18 hours before services started to recover. Microsoft said it was bringing back services gradually to ensure a stable restoration.
paras.zh: 微软服务的中断从周五早上开始，持续了大约 18 个小时，然后服务才开始恢复。微软表示，正在逐步恢复服务，以确保稳定恢复。

paras.en: Ashwin Pal, a partner at the risk advisory firm RSM Australia, said his clients had activated business continuity and disaster recovery plans, but many businesses didn’t have a fallback.
paras.zh: 风险咨询公司RSM Australia的合伙人阿什温·帕尔(Ashwin Pal)表示，他的客户已经启动了业务连续性和灾难恢复计划，但许多企业没有后备措施。

paras.en: “A protracted event like this can easily be the straw that breaks the camel’s back for smaller entities,” Pal said.
paras.zh: 帕尔说：“像这样的旷日持久的事件很容易成为压垮小型实体的最后一根稻草。”

paras.en: Pal said Microsoft had obviously struggled to recover, which raised bigger questions.
paras.zh: 帕尔表示，微软显然一直在努力恢复，这引发了更大的问题。

paras.en: “I’m a technologist and I’m actually flabbergasted as to how something like this could have happened … they pushed out a change which should have been tested,” Pal said.
paras.zh: “我是一名技术专家，我真的很惊讶这样的事情怎么会发生……他们推出了一项本应经过测试的更改，”帕尔说。

paras.en: The Australian Computer Society has renewed calls for the federal government to urgently review which critical IT systems rely on a single provider, and where backup options could keep the economy running.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚计算机协会再次呼吁联邦政府紧急审查哪些关键 IT 系统依赖于单一提供商，以及哪些备份选项可以保持经济运行。

paras.en: The society’s chief executive, Prins Ralston, said the outage had “exposed Australia’s reliance on foreign technology”, particularly on small businesses.
paras.zh: 该协会首席执行官 Prins Ralston 表示，这次停电“暴露了澳大利亚对外国技术的依赖”，特别是对小企业的依赖。

paras.en: “Australians who couldn’t get paid, couldn’t send an invoice, or couldn’t reach a government service this morning are entitled to be worried,” Ralston said.
paras.zh: 拉尔斯顿说：“今天早上拿不到工资、无法寄出发票或无法联系政府服务的澳大利亚人有理由担心。”

paras.en: Australian hospitals and health clinics were affected by the outage, although the Australian Medical Association (AMA) on Friday said had been no impacts for patient care.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚医院和诊所受到停电影响，但澳大利亚医学协会（AMA）周五表示，对患者护理没有影响。

paras.en: “We’ve had some facilities return to using paper for scripts because authentication to get into lots of prescribing software requires multifactor verification, which requires you to be able to access your Microsoft-supported email,” said the AMA’s president, Dr Michael Bonning.
paras.zh: “我们已经让一些机构恢复使用纸质脚本，因为进入许多处方软件的身份验证需要多因素验证，这要求您能够访问 Microsoft 支持的电子邮件，”AMA 主席 Michael Bonning 博士说。

paras.en: Courts in South Australia and Victoria reported that the outage had affeced its email system. Many schools across the country were also affected.
paras.zh: 南澳大利亚州和维多利亚州的法院报告称，停电影响了其电子邮件系统。全国许多学校也受到影响。

paras.en: Service NSW, the one-stop shop agency for residents, drivers, and business owners to access government services, encouraged customers to delay their visits to its service centres.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州服务局是为居民、司机和企业主提供政府服务的一站式服务机构，鼓励客户推迟前往其服务中心的时间。

paras.en: Federal government departments have also been maffectedy the outage, including national security agencies.
paras.zh: 联邦政府部门也受到了停电的影响，其中包括国家安全机构。

paras.en: The head the domestic spy agency Asio, Mike Burgess, on Friday said the organisation’s systems “operate on multiple levels”, adding that they had been affected “on one level, yes, but not completely”.
paras.zh: 国内间谍机构 Asio 负责人迈克·伯吉斯 (Mike Burgess) 周五表示，该组织的系统“在多个层面上运行”，并补充说，它们“在一个层面上受到了影响，是的，但并不完全”。

paras.en: The outage has affected businesses and organisations across the world that use Microsoft products.
paras.zh: 这次中断影响了世界各地使用微软产品的企业和组织。

paras.en: In the UK, healthcare systems were disrupted and several British police forces urged people not to try to report crimes online and to phone them in instead.
paras.zh: 在英国，医疗保健系统受到干扰，几名英国警察敦促人们不要尝试在网上举报犯罪行为，而是打电话给他们。

paras.en: US government offices across the country have been affected by the outage, including congressional offices that heavily rely on Outlook email. The US House’s chief administrative officer that handles IT for the chamber sent out a “campus-wide alert” to staffers on Thursday about the outage, Politico reported.
paras.zh: 全国各地的美国政府办公室都受到了此次中断的影响，其中包括严重依赖 Outlook 电子邮件的国会办公室。据 Politico 报道，负责众议院 IT 事务的美国众议院首席行政官周四向工作人员发出了关于此次停电的“全院警报”。

paras.en: In Japan, the shipping company Sagawa Express said it was unable to accept online reservations for some of its services at airports and train stations while Taisho, a leading pharmaceutical company, said it was having to handle orders by phone.
paras.zh: 在日本，航运公司佐川急便表示，无法接受机场和火车站部分服务的在线预订，而领先的制药公司大正则表示，必须通过电话处理订单。

paras.en: When stock market trading opened on Wall Street, shares in Microsoft dipped slightly, down 1.1% at $516.86.
paras.zh: 当华尔街股市开盘时，微软股价小幅下跌，下跌 1.1%，至 516.86 美元。

paras.en: Microsoft has suggested the outage may have been caused by problems with the settings applied to servers responsible for keeping Microsoft 365 up and running.
paras.zh: 微软表示，此次中断可能是由于负责保持 Microsoft 365 正常运行的服务器所应用的设置问题造成的。

paras.en: Microsoft’s executive vice-president of Copilot, Charles Lamanna, said: “We regret that today’s outages caused disruptions for our customers, and we are working to address the issue.”
paras.zh: 微软副总裁查尔斯·拉曼纳 (Charles Lamanna) 表示：“我们很遗憾今天的服务中断给我们的客户造成了干扰，我们正在努力解决这个问题。”

articles.title: What we know about the longest ground stop since 9/11

paras.en: The US Federal Aviation Administration has lifted the longest nationwide ground stop of flights since the 11 September 2001 terrorist attacks.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局取消了自 2001 年 9 月 11 日恐怖袭击以来最长的全国航班地面停留。

paras.en: The FAA said Friday's stoppage, which lasted more than four hours, was "due to extraordinary circumstances" from a communication issue affecting all air traffic control centres.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空局表示，周五持续了四个多小时的停飞是“由于特殊情况”造成的，影响了所有空中交通管制中心的通信问题。

paras.en: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there was no indication of an attack and that everybody was safe.
paras.zh: 国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林表示，没有迹象表明发生了袭击，每个人都很安全。

paras.en: The ground stop led to more than 8,500 delayed and nearly 8,000 cancelled flights on Friday, according to FlightAware.
paras.zh: 据 FlightAware 称，周五的地面停飞导致超过 8,500 架航班延误，近 8,000 架航班取消。

paras.en: The FAA's initial announcement at 15:54 EST (20:54 GMT) said all flights departing within the US would be grounded until further notice.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 于美国东部时间 15:54（格林尼治标准时间 20:54）首次宣布称，所有从美国境内起飞的航班都将停飞，直至另行通知。

paras.en: More than 3,500 airplanes were in the air at the time. Some were diverted to other airports and others flew on to their destinations.
paras.zh: 当时有超过 3,500 架飞机在空中飞行。一些飞机被转移到其他机场，另一些则飞往目的地。

paras.en: Hours later, some flights were allowed to take off from San Francisco International airport.
paras.zh: 几小时后，部分航班获准从旧金山国际机场起飞。

paras.en: The Federal Aviation Administration opened skies again at until 20:15 EST.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (Federal Aviation Administration) 于美国东部时间 20:15 重新开放天空。

paras.en: All US-bound air traffic from Eurocontrol member states was suspended "on request of the FAA due to technical issues", according to Eurocontrol's website.
paras.zh: 据欧洲空中安全组织网站称，“由于技术问题，应美国联邦航空局的要求”，所有从欧洲空中安全组织成员国飞往美国的空中交通都被暂停。

paras.en: There are 42 Eurocontrol member states, including dozens of EU nations, the UK, Ukraine, and Turkey, as well as Israel and Morocco.
paras.zh: 欧洲安全组织有 42 个成员国，包括数十个欧盟国家、英国、乌克兰、土耳其，以及以色列和摩洛哥。

paras.en: Australia's largest international airport, Sydney, grounded all US-bound flights until further notice.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚最大的国际机场悉尼机场停飞了所有飞往美国的航班，直至另行通知。

paras.en: Air Canada cancelled flights between the US and Canada.
paras.zh: 加拿大航空取消了美国和加拿大之间的航班。

paras.en: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said in a news conference on Friday night that the outage would cause a ripple effect for a few days.
paras.zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲在周五晚上的新闻发布会上表示，停电将造成几天的连锁反应。

paras.en: "It's going to take us some time to unwind what's happened this afternoon," Duffy said.
paras.zh: “我们需要一些时间来平息今天下午发生的事情，”达菲说。

paras.en: Tens of thousands of people were stranded in airports around the country, many of them "without any knowledge of where they're going to sleep tonight", Duffy said.
paras.zh: 达菲说，全国各地有数万人滞留在机场，其中许多人“不知道今晚要睡在哪里”。

paras.en: Delta Air Lines and United Airlines said they were resuming operations.
paras.zh: 达美航空和联合航空表示正在恢复运营。

paras.en: American Airlines said it was "focused on operating as many remaining flights as possible this evening". JetBlue said it would resume flights on Saturday morning.
paras.zh: 美国航空表示，“今晚的重点是运营尽可能多的剩余航班”。捷蓝航空表示将于周六早上恢复航班。

paras.en: Duffy said a legacy air traffic control communications system became overloaded.
paras.zh: 达菲说，传统的空中交通管制通信系统变得超载。

paras.en: "So this is analogue telecom. Our switches, our routers actually got overloaded with data and they went down," Duffy said.
paras.zh: “这就是模拟电信。我们的交换机、路由器实际上因数据过载而瘫痪了，”达菲说。

paras.en: He said this had affected communications and radar. The system needs a complete overhaul, he said, estimating a $50 billion price tag.
paras.zh: 他说这影响了通信和雷达。他说，该系统需要彻底检修，估计耗资 500 亿美元。

paras.en: "It's going to continue to fail," he said.
paras.zh: “它会继续失败，”他说。

paras.en: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin told the news conference said they had seen "zero evidence" it was a cyber-attack.
paras.zh: 国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林在新闻发布会上表示，他们发现“零证据”这是一次网络攻击。

paras.en: He also ruled out any link to the global Microsoft outage that began on Thursday.
paras.zh: 他还排除了与周四开始的微软全球服务中断有任何联系。

paras.en: Mullin said the introduction of some new technology into an old air traffic control system had overwhelmed it.
paras.zh: 马林表示，在旧的空中交通管制系统中引入一些新技术已经使其不堪重负。

paras.en: Both cabinet secretaries insisted the public was never in danger during the stoppage.
paras.zh: 两位内阁大臣都坚称，停工期间公众从未面临危险。

paras.en: It was only the second such nationwide stoppage since the immediate aftermath of the al-Qaeda plane hijackings of 11 September 2001.
paras.zh: 这是自 2001 年 9 月 11 日基地组织飞机劫持事件发生后第二次全国范围内的停飞。

paras.en: "This looks like the worst since 9/11, but clearly not on that scale," Dr Guy Gratton, an associate professor of aviation at Cranfield University, told BBC Verify.
paras.zh: 克兰菲尔德大学航空学副教授盖伊·格拉顿 (Guy Gratton) 博士告诉 BBC verify：“这看起来是自 9/11 以来最严重的一次，但显然没有那么严重。”

paras.en: Dr Gratton pointed to a US grounding in 2023 due to a failure in the Notice to Air Missions (Notam) system.
paras.zh: 格拉顿博士指出，由于空中任务通知 (Notam) 系统故障，美国将于 2023 年停飞。

paras.en: "That lasted 1 hour and 52 minutes, delayed about 9,500 flights and cancelled about 1,300," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“整个事件持续了 1 小时 52 分钟，导致约 9,500 架次航班延误，约 1,300 架次航班取消。”

paras.en: The 2023 outage meant air traffic safety notices could no longer be published, and flights were grounded until that system was restored.
paras.zh: 2023 年的停电意味着无法再发布空中交通安全通知，航班也将停飞，直至系统恢复。

paras.en: But Friday's incident lasted longer than the 2023 event.
paras.zh: 但周五的事件持续时间比 2023 年的事件还要长。

articles.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says

paras.en: Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping are planning to meet on the sidelines of a summit in China next week, the White House has said.
paras.zh: 白宫表示，唐纳德·特朗普、弗拉基米尔·普京和习近平计划在下周中国峰会期间会面。

paras.en: The historic meeting between the leaders of the US, Russia and China will take place as Trump attends the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit in the southern city of Shenzhen, spokeswoman Olivia Wales told reporters.
paras.zh: 发言人奥利维亚·威尔士对记者表示，美国、俄罗斯和中国领导人之间的历史性会晤将在特朗普出席在南部城市深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会期间举行。

paras.en: "The president has made it clear that, among other topics, he will discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world, whose proliferation President Trump believes is very dangerous," she said.
paras.zh: “总统已明确表示，除其他议题外，他将讨论世界范围内核武器的削减，特朗普总统认为核武器的扩散非常危险，”她说。

paras.en: It is understood Iran may also be discussed during the meeting of the world's biggest nuclear powers, but not Ukraine. Moscow and Beijing are yet to comment.
paras.zh: 据了解，世界最大核大国会议期间也可能讨论伊朗问题，但不会讨论乌克兰问题。莫斯科和北京尚未发表评论。

paras.en: No agreement was expected to follow the talks, an unnamed, senior American official said, according to news agencies AP and Reuters.
paras.zh: 据美联社和路透社报道，一位不愿透露姓名的美国高级官员表示，预计会谈后不会达成协议。

paras.en: Trump will arrive in Shenzhen late on Wednesday for the two-day summit between the 21 member states. He will also take part in bilateral talks with Xi on Thursday - their fourth meeting since the US president returned to office in 2025.
paras.zh: 特朗普将于周三晚些时候抵达深圳，参加为期两天的21个成员国峰会。他还将参加周四与习近平的双边会谈，这是自美国总统 2025 年重新就职以来他们的第四次会面。

paras.en: "President Trump will conclude his visit to China with a trilateral meeting between the president of the United States, the president of the People's Republic of China, and the president of the Russian Federation," Wales said.
paras.zh: 威尔士说：“特朗普总统将通过美国总统、中华人民共和国主席和俄罗斯联邦总统之间的三方会晤来结束对中国的访问。”

paras.en: She said Trump's trip, which will also include attending an Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) summit in the Philippines on Tuesday, would "secure historic wins to the American people and advance America's interests in the Indo Pacific".
paras.zh: 她表示，特朗普此行还包括出席周二在菲律宾举行的东南亚国家联盟（东盟）峰会，这将“确保美国人民取得历史性胜利，并促进美国在印度太平洋地区的利益”。

paras.en: A nuclear weapons control treaty between the US and Russia expired in February, leaving the world's biggest nuclear arsenals without major guardrails and effectively marking an end to the arms control co-operation which helped to resolve the Cold War.
paras.zh: 美国和俄罗斯之间的核武器控制条约于二月到期，使世界上最大的核武库失去了重要的护栏，并有效地标志着有助于解决冷战的军控合作的结束。

paras.en: The UN has urged both sides to agree a new framework without delay. Trump however said he could replace the deal with a better agreement which included China, which has been building up its arsenal.
paras.zh: 联合国敦促双方立即商定新框架。不过，特朗普表示，他可以用一项更好的协议来取代该协议，其中包括一直在增强核武库的中国。

paras.en: Former senior US officials and analysts told the BBC at the time that seeking Beijing and Moscow's co-operation could turn up major hurdles and take years.
paras.zh: 美国前高级官员和分析人士当时告诉英国广播公司，寻求北京和莫斯科的合作可能会遇到重大障碍，并且需要数年时间。

paras.en: Xi separately hosted both Putin and Trump in Beijing just days apart earlier this year, while the US president welcomed his Chinese counterpart to Washington in September.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，习近平在北京分别接待了普京和特朗普，时间相隔几天，而美国总统则于九月在华盛顿欢迎了中国总统。

paras.en: Beijing has become a crucial trading partner for Moscow since it launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, which has isolated Russia and left it subject to Western sanctions.
paras.zh: 自2022年全面入侵乌克兰以来，北京已成为莫斯科的重要贸易伙伴，这导致俄罗斯孤立并受到西方制裁。

paras.en: But a controversial US deal to import Russian diesel and the suspension of sanctions targeting the biggest buyers of Moscow's oil and gas - including China - heightened European concern about the Trump administration's softening towards the Kremlin last month.
paras.zh: 但美国进口俄罗斯柴油的一项有争议的协议以及针对包括中国在内的莫斯科石油和天然气最大买家的制裁暂停，加剧了欧洲对特朗普政府上个月对克里姆林宫态度软化的担忧。

paras.en: Trump and Xi have meanwhile sought to project warmer ties at summits in Beijing and Washington this year - though little significant progress appeared to have been made on key issues such as trade, their race for AI dominance, and Taiwan. The war in Iran has also been a sticking point, with Beijing the largest buyer of Tehran's oil and its biggest trade partner.
paras.zh: 与此同时，特朗普和习近平试图在今年的北京和华盛顿峰会上展现更温暖的关系，尽管在贸易、人工智能主导地位之争和台湾等关键问题上似乎没有取得重大进展。伊朗战争也是一个症结所在，北京是德黑兰石油的最大买家及其最大的贸易伙伴。

paras.en: Chinese state media reported on Friday that Xi would take part in "bilateral" talks on the sidelines of the Apec summit, citing a foreign ministry spokesman, but has not reported on the trilateral meeting.
paras.zh: 中国官方媒体周五援引外交部发言人的话说，习近平将在亚太经合组织峰会期间参加“双边”会谈，但尚未报道三边会议。

paras.en: Earlier this month, Russian state news agency Tass reported that Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov had said there were "signals confirming readiness" for such talks at the summit.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，俄罗斯国家通讯社塔斯社报道称，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，有“信号证实”峰会已准备好进行此类会谈。

articles.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after for day-long global outage

paras.en: Microsoft has said its services have been fully restored after a worldwide outage affected several of its tools, causing disruption.
paras.zh: 微软表示，在全球范围内的停电影响了其多个工具并造成中断后，其服务已完全恢复。

paras.en: The tech firm said early on Saturday morning that efforts to address the underlying problem had been completed and customers using Outlook, Teams and Copilot should no longer be affected.
paras.zh: 该科技公司周六凌晨表示，解决根本问题的工作已经完成，使用 Outlook、Teams 和 Copilot 的客户不应再受到影响。

paras.en: The outage hit more than 70 countries, disrupting everything from business operations to government services and personal users. More than 430 million people use the affected products worldwide.
paras.zh: 这次停电袭击了 70 多个国家，影响了从商业运营到政府服务和个人用户的一切。全球有超过 4.3 亿人使用受影响的产品。

paras.en: Microsoft apologised for the technical issue, which it said was introduced during a "network capacity upgrade" and was not caused by a cyber-attack or an artificial intelligence agent.
paras.zh: 微软对这一技术问题表示歉意，称该问题是在“网络容量升级”期间引入的，并非由网络攻击或人工智能代理引起。

paras.en: Experts said the event was a "stark reminder" of how heavily businesses and vital services rely on a small group of big tech providers.
paras.zh: 专家表示，这一事件“鲜明地提醒”人们企业和重要服务对一小群大型科技提供商的依赖程度。

paras.en: Users began reporting they were having trouble accessing Microsoft 365 products on Thursday.
paras.zh: 周四，用户开始报告他们在访问 Microsoft 365 产品时遇到问题。

paras.en: By Friday, the far-reaching issue was affecting institutions from the Japanese government and the Philippines Supreme Court to the Australian spy agency, and trains, hospitals and courts in North America.
paras.zh: 到周五，这个影响深远的问题已经影响到从日本政府、菲律宾最高法院到澳大利亚间谍机构，以及北美的火车、医院和法院等机构。

paras.en: Services were beginning to recover by Friday afternoon UK time, nearly 24 hours after the issues first began to emerge.
paras.zh: 英国时间周五下午，距离问题首次出现近 24 小时，服务开始恢复。

paras.en: In the UK, some parts of the NHS were affected, as were some schools and police forces.
paras.zh: 在英国，NHS 的某些部门、一些学校和警察部队都受到了影响。

paras.en: UK cyber minister Liz Lloyd said the incident had "limited" impact on critical frontline services such as 999 calls and that there had been no disruption to the transport network.
paras.zh: 英国网络部长利兹·劳埃德表示，该事件对 999 电话等关键前线服务的影响“有限”，并且运输网络没有受到干扰。

paras.en: In Canada, however, the national rail network said passengers may not be able to receive email updates about their trips, and hospitals across the country also had issues with emails.
paras.zh: 然而，在加拿大，国家铁路网络表示，乘客可能无法收到有关其行程的电子邮件更新，全国各地的医院也存在电子邮件问题。

paras.en: In the US, staff members from the House of Representatives told Politico it had set back an entire day of legislative work as everything was on Microsoft's Outlook.
paras.zh: 在美国，众议院工作人员告诉 Politico，立法工作已经推迟了一整天，因为一切都在微软的 Outlook 上。

paras.en: Singapore's government acknowledged some of its systems had been impacted, and in India, the outage disrupted work for many on Friday.
paras.zh: 新加坡政府承认其部分系统受到了影响，而在印度，周五的停电中断了许多人的工作。

paras.en: In Turkey, advisers and officials attending the COP31 climate summit in Antalya were left frustrated by being unable to access Outlook.
paras.zh: 在土耳其，参加安塔利亚 COP31 气候峰会的顾问和官员因无法访问 Outlook 而感到沮丧。

paras.en: The issues also affected smaller businesses and individuals.
paras.zh: 这些问题还影响到小型企业和个人。

paras.en: Peter Pentz, a winemaker in South Africa, said his entire business had been effectively brought to a "standstill".
paras.zh: 南非酿酒师彼得·彭茨(Peter Pentz)表示，他的整个业务实际上已陷入“停滞”。

paras.en: His winery's communication with exports was also brought to a standstill, he said, and "critical production work" had been halted as the Cape West Coast winery "relies on these systems for parts of our day-to-day operations".
paras.zh: 他说，他的酒厂与出口的沟通也陷入停滞，并且“关键生产工作”已停止，因为西海岸角酒厂“部分日常运营依赖这些系统”。

paras.en: Georgia from Staffordshire in England said she had been due to complete her first house purchase after waiting eight months to get to this point - but the outage has delayed that.
paras.zh: 来自英格兰斯塔福德郡的乔治亚州表示，她原本应该在等待八个月后完成她的第一套房子购买，但停电推迟了这一计划。

paras.en: "The solicitor mentioned there may be a delay due to not being able to contact other agencies," she said.
paras.zh: “律师提到，由于无法联系其他机构，可能会出现延误，”她说。

paras.en: "We're not the only one completing today - there are hundreds of houses and for them to ring everyone in time is unfeasible."
paras.zh: “我们并不是今天唯一完工的——有数百所房屋，他们不可能及时给每个人打电话是不可行的。”

paras.en: Microsoft first acknowledged users in the Americas were unable to access Exchange Online mailboxes at 17:54 GMT on Thursday, and shortly after warned the disruption was possibly affecting Microsoft 365 globally.
paras.zh: 周四格林尼治标准时间 17:54，微软首次承认美洲用户无法访问 Exchange Online 邮箱，不久后警告称，此次中断可能会影响全球的 Microsoft 365。

paras.en: It launched an investigation and engineers began working to restore services, but by 04:36 on Friday Microsoft was reporting only a "partial recovery" in some parts of the world.
paras.zh: 它发起了一项调查，工程师开始努力恢复服务，但到周五 04:36，微软报告称世界某些地区仅“部分恢复”。

paras.en: By 13:32, the tech giant said there had been "broader improvements" in North America, "sustained improvements" across much of Europe and "encouraging recovery signals" in the Asia Pacific region.
paras.zh: 截至 13 点 32 分，这家科技巨头表示，北美地区出现了“更广泛的改善”，欧洲大部分地区出现了“持续改善”，亚太地区出现了“令人鼓舞的复苏信号”。

paras.en: Microsoft said it restored services gradually due to the scale of the problem and to help ensure services remained stable once they were up and running again.
paras.zh: 微软表示，由于问题的严重性，它正在逐步恢复服务，并帮助确保服务在重新启动和运行后保持稳定。

paras.en: "We are deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our customers and partners," a Microsoft spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 微软发言人表示：“我们对这一事件给我们的客户和合作伙伴造成的干扰深表歉意。”

paras.en: "We know the trust they place in our services and take that responsibility extremely seriously."
paras.zh: “我们知道他们对我们服务的信任，并非常认真地对待这一责任。”

paras.en: A full post-incident report will be released once Microsoft has completed a review.
paras.zh: Microsoft 完成审核后将发布完整的事件后报告。

paras.en: Experts said that while workers may have been happy to not have email access for a working day, the incident showed the dependence many organisations have on these cloud-based services.
paras.zh: 专家表示，虽然员工可能很高兴在工作日无法访问电子邮件，但该事件表明许多组织对这些基于云的服务的依赖。

paras.en: "The global Microsoft outage is a stark reminder of how heavily we rely on a handful of big tech providers," said Rob Demain, chief executive of cybersecurity firm e2e-assure.
paras.zh: 网络安全公司 e2e-assure 首席执行官 Rob Demain 表示：“微软的全球宕机事件清楚地提醒我们，我们对少数几家大型技术提供商的依赖程度。”

paras.en: Matt Saunders, field chief technology officer at tech consultancy Adaptavist, said it would be challenging to mitigate against a similar problem.
paras.zh: 技术咨询公司 Adaptavist 的现场首席技术官马特·桑德斯 (Matt Saunders) 表示，缓解类似问题将具有挑战性。

paras.en: "Classic IT disaster planning strategies suggest using a second service for resilience, but in practice, it's almost impossible for a business to function without tools such as Microsoft," he said.
paras.zh: “经典的 IT 灾难规划策略建议使用第二个服务来实现弹性，但实际上，如果没有 Microsoft 等工具，企业几乎不可能正常运转，”他说。

paras.en: "In the wake of this outage, organisations must have a plan in place for how to work without such tools, for when incidents like this occur."
paras.zh: “在这次中断之后，组织必须制定一个计划，以便在发生此类事件时，在没有此类工具的情况下如何工作。”

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

(MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.

Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).

“We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.

EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.

Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

paras.en: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

Carlisle Brake & Friction launches a new product solutions video: Carlisle Solutions for Tractor Applications, to showcase all of the latest motion control technologies available for agriculture equipment, specifically tractor applications.
From power valves, to disc brakes, to PTO and shuttle clutch friction options, this video breaks down all of the features and benefits of Carlisle’s newest brake system and powertrain solutions.
For improved visualization, the video features 3D animation and demonstrations of the product fitments within a standard tractor model.

articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

(MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.

articles.title: SEMA Crowns Champion of Bike Builder Shootout
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The inaugural SEMA Battle of the Builders: Bike Builder Shootout presented by Mothers named Steven Iacona as its first champion. Iacona won with a custom Harley-Davidson Knucklehead, rising to the top of a competitive field of builders from across the country.

“It’s amazing. I’ve never been to the SEMA Show before, but it’s always been something I’ve wanted to experience,” said Iacona, owner of Iacona Custom Cycles in Brooklyn, N.Y. “To be next to these great builders on stage, it’s just incredible. It’s a great thing for the motorcycle industry, and it’s great to bring new life into the industry.”

The competition was evaluated by a panel of motorcycle industry experts, including Zach Ness of Arlen Ness Motorcycles, Jeff Holt of V-Twin Visionary and Pat Patterson of Led Sled Customs. Judges reviewed entries based on craftsmanship, design innovation and overall execution before selecting finalists and naming Iacona the overall champion.

“I began with a 1945 Knucklehead engine that we had, and I just needed to find the right customer that would let me do what I wanted with it,” said Iacona. “I built a bike similar to what I had heard the stock Knucklehead was and just enhanced it. I didn’t want to disrespect the Knucklehead, and this is what I came up with. The customer is going to ride it and enjoy it, and that’s all that matters.”
- Winner: Steven Iacona — Harley-Davidson Knucklehead
- 2nd place: Robert Zeolla — Indian In-Line 4
- 3rd place: James Crosby — Harley-Davidson Pan Head

The addition of the motorcycle category reflects SEMA’s commitment to expanding opportunities across the specialty-equipment industry and strengthening the powersports presence at the SEMA Show. The competition recognizes builders who push innovation, craftsmanship and creativity within motorcycle customization.

“The Bike Builder Shootout reflects SEMA’s support for every segment of the customization industry and creating new opportunities for builders to showcase their work,” said RJ de Vera, vice president of marketing for SEMA. “The creativity and craftsmanship displayed throughout this competition exceeded our expectations. We’re excited to build on this momentum and further expand the powersports presence at the SEMA Show in the years ahead.”

The Bike Builder Shootout was introduced in 2026 as an expansion of the SEMA Battle of the Builders competition, creating a dedicated platform for motorcycle builders to showcase their work on a major industry stage. The category celebrates the artistry, engineering, and passion driving motorcycle customization.
For more information about SEMA Battle of the Builders, visit semabotb.com.

articles.title: Mitchell 1’s ProDemand+ Connects Mechanical and Collision Repair Data
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Mitchell 1 introduces ProDemand+, integrating OEM collision repair information within its ProDemand platform. By connecting collision and mechanical repair resources, ProDemand+ helps auto body shops streamline research, identify related repair requirements and tackle more complex repairs involving interconnected vehicle systems.

“Collision repairs today involve much more than fixing visible damage. Even a seemingly straightforward bumper or mirror replacement can involve electrical systems, sensors and critical calibration procedures,” said Chris Bonneau, product marketing manager for collision products for Mitchell 1. “ProDemand+ gives technicians access to the OEM information they need to identify related mechanical repair requirements upfront, reduce costly rework and get vehicles safely back on the road faster.”

For example, replacing a damaged bumper may require technicians to research electrical connections, mounting specifications and ADAS sensor locations and calibration procedures. With ProDemand+, collision professionals can access this information alongside OEM body repair procedures without switching between separate repair information platforms.

ProDemand+ combines OEM body and structural repair procedures, sectioning information, materials, adhesives, and paint and refinishing resources with ProDemand’s mechanical repair information. To help technicians research related vehicle systems, the platform also provides vehicle-specific ADAS procedures, interactive wiring diagrams for electrical troubleshooting, SureTrack Real Fixes and community forums featuring proven repair solutions and insights from professional technicians.
For more information, visit mitchell1.com, call (888) 724-6742 or locate an independent sales consultant at mitchell1.com/my-rep.

articles.title: BendPak Debuts Valor C10 Custom 1970 Chevy Pickup at SEMA
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: BendPak Inc. unveiled its inaugural custom-built vehicle at the 2026 SEMA Show last week. The Valor C10 is a handcrafted 1970 Chevrolet C10 pickup truck built as a tribute to the sacrifice, courage and commitment of the U.S. Armed Forces.

“We call this build the Valor C10 — it was created to honor the brave men and women who have served and continue to serve in our armed forces, especially those who gave their lives in defense of our nation,” said Jeff Kritzer, president and CEO of BendPak. “BendPak proudly supports the military community. This serves as our way of saying thank you and reminding everyone that freedom isn’t free.”

As the nation observes Veterans Day, the Valor C10 carries personal meaning for BendPak’s leadership and team. U.S. Army veteran Don Henthorn founded BendPak in 1965. After three years of active-duty service as a U.S. Air Force C-130 loadmaster, Kritzer transitioned to the Air National Guard, retaining his flight status and loadmaster duties while launching his full-time career at BendPak, a dual commitment he maintained for three years. He is the son of a senior master sergeant and fellow loadmaster whose life was devoted to military service. Kritzer’s son, Devin, served in the U.S. Army, including deployments to the Gulf region and Bangladesh.

paras.en: With its fusion of modern performance and timeless design, the Valor C10 emphasizes American strength, ingenuity and resilience.
The team at Nostalgia Hot Rods, led by Dustin Hacker, was tapped to build the Valor C10.

“We’ve worked with Dustin for several years, supplying his shops with BendPak lifts and equipment, as well as showcasing many of his amazing builds in our SEMA Show booths,” said Sean Price, director of product development for BendPak. “We knew he had the passion and craftsmanship to bring our vision for the Valor C10 to life.”
Hacker started with a vintage C10, and by the time the build was complete, the closest part left to stock was a heavily modified cab.

“Most of the sheet metal is custom-fabricated, including the roof, hood, drip rails, floors, bumpers, engine bay and bed,” said Hacker. “Under the hood, there’s a 376-cubic-inch V8 with a 2.9-liter Whipple supercharger. This thing will make 750 horsepower and drive like a dream.”

Despite its slammed stance, the body-dropped C10 retains more than 4.5 inches of usable ground clearance due to the chassis setup, making it easier to navigate speed bumps and driveways. It’s finished in metallic blue with red accents, including a body stripe, brake calipers and engine. The color scheme nods to the U.S. flag. Custom Valor C10 badges designed by the BendPak creative team highlight both doors.
The interior features a classic bench seat upholstered in two-tone gray Alcantara with blue stitching. The door panels and headliner are also bespoke.

- Gearstar GM 6L80E 6-speed automatic transmission
- Custom Eddie Motorsports serpentine system

- Dapper Lighting custom headlights and taillights with custom billet housings

articles.title: NHTSA estimates decline in traffic fatalities in first half of 2026
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Newly released data from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) estimates a 2.5% drop in traffic fatalities for the first half of 2026, projecting the second-lowest half-year fatality rate in U.S. history.
Crash fatalities fell to an estimated 16,750 from January through June, down from 17,175 during the first half of 2025.

“We’ve made progress on road safety, but the Trump Administration isn’t letting up,” said NHTSA Administrator Jonathan Morrison in a NHTSA press release. “Even with near-record low fatality rates, we will continue to work with a sense of urgency to make sure more Americans get home safely. Through our Pathways to Safer Streets initiative, we are tackling the leading causes of traffic deaths— from reckless driving to impaired driving—while funding critical lifesaving measures like prehospital blood programs.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Vehicle miles traveled (VMT) increased about 12.9 billion miles, or 0.8%, in the first half of the year, while the fatality rate fell to a near-record low of 1.02 per 100 million VMT. If realized, the fatality rate would be the second-lowest first-half rate, slightly above the lowest reached in the first half of 2014 at 1.01.
In the first half of 2025, NHTSA estimated the fatality rate was 1.05 per 100 million VMT.
Fatalities in Q2 2026 decreased by 0.2%.
Thirty-five states and Puerto Rico are projected to have had fatality decreases during the first half of 2026.

NHTSA notes in its report that the fatality counts and percentage change for 2025 and 2026 will be slightly revised when the Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS) Annual Reporting File (ARF) for 2025 is available later this year, and when the final file for 2025 and the ARF for 2026 are available next year. Estimates will be further refined when projections for January through September of 2026 are released in late December.
Historically, the report points out that fatalities increased for seven consecutive quarters beginning in Q3 2020 until a 5.9% decline in Q2 2022.
The percentage increase in the second quarter of 2021 is the highest quarterly percentage increase in FARS data recorded history, which was in the COVID-19 pandemic period, according to the report.
Eight out of 10 regions broken out in NHTSA’s data saw fewer fatalities during the first half of this year compared to the first half of 2025.
In 2026, Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy directed NHTSA to launch the Pathways to Safer Streets (P2SS) action plan.

Under the P2SS framework, NHTSA says it is partnering with law enforcement agencies nationwide “to support vigorous, high-visibility traffic enforcement aimed at identifying and stopping dangerous drivers.”

“NHTSA has also increased support for prehospital blood transfusion programs for safety partners, enabling emergency medical services units to administer blood before crash victims reach the hospital,” the NHTSA press release states. “Research shows this innovation decreases mortality for trauma patients with severe bleeding by 37%.”

articles.title: Boyd to investors on Q3 total losses, TCOR, and repairable claims volumes
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Boyd Group President and CEO Brian Kaner said Wednesday that there is positive momentum in the industry to push total losses down.

Kaner made the comment during the company’s Q3 earnings call with investors. When asked how raising total loss thresholds impacts total loss rates, Kaner said he thinks rates could decrease with more regulation.
“If you see people raising thresholds to 85%, those borderline total losses will end up becoming repairable vehicles again and ultimately help our business,” he said.

“Total losses are getting a tremendous amount of attention in the industry right now. We know that it’s not a great customer experience. There’s more people that are upside down in loans right now, so if their car gets totaled, they end up not only not being able to get a car, but they end up writing a check to get out of the car that they’re actually in. We know that it’s not a great experience. I think many people are picking up on that, inclusive of the insurance carriers.”
He added that attrition after total losses is higher than after repairable claims, which has gotten the attention of insurance carriers and OEMs.

“If you trust the data that’s out there, the data that CCC would reflect or that JD Power reflects, is 40% of people after a total loss event switch insurance carriers, so the attrition after a total loss event versus a repair event that’s 7% is super high,” Kaner said.
He said Q3 claims data continues to point to a more stable operating environment, with repairable claims volumes estimated to be down 1–3% year over year.
Kaner also shared that Boyd saw a sequential improvement in total cost of repair (TCOR) in Q3.

“We said for quite some time that the underlying metrics behind TCOR were still moving as they normally move,” he said. “We still saw normal pricing increases on the labor side. We still saw normal price movement on parts through the inflationary environment that we’re in. And what had been muting that was just the year-over-year impact of more total losses, so bigger tickets coming out of the repair set driving down or mixing down the overall TCOR. We saw that level out in Q3, and we continue to see it now stable as we get into the fourth quarter. That’s allowing the underlying movement and price to actually illuminate.”

paras.en: Part of what’s driving TCOR up, Kaner said, is an increase in calibration services.

“We continue to see a higher penetration rate of calibration services on the average ticket that we’re seeing, and all of those things are starting to move the ticket back in a more positive direction,” he said. “I would say still muted from the, call it 4%, that we expect, but certainly moving its way back towards then.”

A press release on Q3 earnings results adds that “volume gains driven by the strength of the company’s performance and insurer relationships contributed to positive same-store sales growth during the quarter of 2.2%, complemented by a modest increase in total cost of repair.”
Kaner told investors that self-pay jobs are growing at a greater pace than insurance volume, though it’s growing off a much smaller base. He said the average self-pay ticket is much lower.
“Our focus today still remains on providing great service for the insurance partners that we do business with,” he said.
Regarding general Q3 earnings, Boyd reported a 28% revenue increase supported by the addition of Joe Hudson’s.
Kaner said the focus with integrating Joe Hudson’s is now on improving client scores to drive incremental volume and ensuring stores have adequate staffing.
Kaner also told investors that Boyd has 34 new startup locations planned for the next 12 months.

articles.title: NHTSA’s White to collision repairers: ‘You are the final checkpoint’
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: The collision repair industry has a bigger role in the national vehicle conversation than the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has historically recognized, Lee White, NHTSA’s deputy administrator, said during the Society of Collision Repair Specialists’ (SCRS) OEM Summit held during the 2026 SEMA Show.

“I’m excited to be here speaking with skilled craftsmen and women who bring vehicles back to life after they’ve had an accident,” White said. “When done right, your work is often underappreciated, even though it is the product of hard-won expertise.”
NHTSA exists because there is risk every time someone drives on U.S. roadways, White said.
In the 1970s, about 70,000 Americans died a year on U.S. roadways, he said. That number was reduced to about 39,000 in 2024, and the estimate is below 37,000 in 2025.

“That is a lot of progress, particularly when you consider how many more cars and trucks are on the road, as well as the miles that we drive,” he said. “NHTSA cannot take all the credit for this improvement. Many players have contributed, from local governments to the major vehicle manufacturers. There is a lot of work still to be done.”
NHTSA Administrator Jonathon Morrison frequently tells his staff that the agency cannot operate in a vacuum, White said.

“We are opening up our doors to all our stakeholders and the experts like those in the room,” White said. “We want to team with you, and we want to work with your team, and we want to hear from you. The collaborative spirit is exactly why I am here today. By working together, we can save lives.”
The Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) conversation typically revolves around how a vehicle is designed, White said.

“But reality tells us a different story,” White said. “A vehicle may be on the road for 15 to 20 years, experiencing multiple collisions and undergoing numerous repairs over its useful life. From NHTSA’s perspective, we must think deeply about how to preserve the safety performance engineered into a vehicle throughout its entire lifespan, and certify that there’s no degradation.”
NHTSA research on automatic emergency braking, for example, shows the technology prevents crashes, he said.

“We accept that these systems create a measurable safety benefit,” White said. “Preserving that capability after a collision must become a core part of how we think about vehicle safety. If a system was producing a measurable reduction in crash risk before a crash, our expectation must be that it will continue to do so after the vehicle leaves your repair facility.”

White added that looking for a warning light on the dashboard is not enough to safely evaluate vehicle damage. He said shops must verify that safety systems are performing before returning the vehicle to customers.
The complexity will grow as the vehicle fleet transitions to autonomous vehicles, he said.
White pointed to a recent partnership between NHTSA and SAE to expedite the development of data-driven AV performance standards.

“As we move toward vehicles assuming more of the driving task, the integrity of a collision repair becomes even more consequential,” White said. “The collision repair industry must start preparing for this right now. If we are ultimately going to trust a vehicle to make safety-critical decisions, it is absolutely essential to know that its sensing and decision-making capabilities have been properly restored following a collision.”
NHTSA needs data to better navigate the future, he said. He added this provides an opportunity for the collision repair industry and NHTSA to collaborate.

“Your facilities see damaged vehicles every day,” White said. “You are sitting on a potentially valuable source of safety information that historically hasn’t been part of the research ecosystem. The information coming out of a repair process could help NHTSA and manufacturers significantly better understand how safety systems perform in the real world.”
NHTSA wants comments from the collision industry, White said.

This includes during a 90-day comment period that will follow an ADAS Workshop on Aftermarket Modifications and ADAS Performance event Dec. 10. The event will bring together OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, engineering firms, academics, and SEMA to talk about the issues, White said.

“We believe that this event will be an important step toward solutions,” White said. “Reconciling the different interests of all those involved may be challenging, but all involved can certainly agree that keeping safety is paramount.”
Aaron Schulenburg, SCRS executive director, sat down with White during the OEM Summit. He noted that NHTSA organically found individuals on SCRS’ ADAS Governing Council to join the event.
White said NHTSA will read every comment submitted following the event.
“Submit your comments,” White added. “We want to hear from you.”
Schulenburg asked what repair information might help NHTSA in the future.

“How can we learn more about certain repair issues that this room is having in terms of what needs to get back to the OEMs and what we can do to improve the safety profile,” White said. “It’s a matter of turning data into real-world steps we can take to make our roads safer, to make the vehicles perform at a safer rate, and to make our drivers’ behavior better. That’s our goal.”
The collision industry faces pressure that can lead to repairs that don’t necessarily restore the systems, Schulenburg responded.

“I think that’s where the data question comes in: how do we use that to connect the dots to incentivize proper repairs to restore the safety rather than allowing that pressure, the cost mitigation to influence the industry to move in different directions?, he asked.
White said he hopes that conversation becomes a part of the Dec. 10 event.

“The people in this room, you care about doing repairs the right way,” White said. “We want our rules and regulations to encourage that. We can’t make choices because of financial pressure. Financial pressure, wherever it’s coming from — internal to your company or from industry, if it’s coming from insurance, wherever that pressure point’s coming, it can’t be at the expense of safety. We can never let a vehicle go out of our shops and be at risk safety-wise because we chose cost.”
The event should identify what research is missing and what steps should be taken in the next 12 months, he said.
“We’ve got to make sure that we’ve got the voice, we’ve got the comments, we’ve got the gaps identified, so that we know what we’ve got to do,” he said.
A question from the audience asked White how NHTSA tracks alternative parts.

“If you see something, say something,” White said. “Go to the NHTSA website. You can fill out a form and let us know that you have an issue with a part that you’re concerned about. Whether it’s a comment that we issue from a conference or a notice of proposed rulemaking, there’s people in NHTSA that look at that and take that seriously.”

NHTSA has been raising the performance bar in other ways recently, White said. This includes incorporating new ADAS evaluations, such as automatic emergency braking, into its New Car Assessment Program (NCAP).
Automakers and vehicle safety groups told Congress last year that NCAP had fallen behind other countries and wasn’t rating new safety technologies fast enough.

White said under Morrison, NHTSA is evaluating not only whether it has the equipment but if it also performs. He pointed to an AEB final rule that specifies vehicle and pedestrian avoidance performance benchmarks on vehicles by 2029.

“Administrator Morrison has made it clear that many of our past regulations were designed when no one envisioned modern safety technologies, meaning that the technology of the future is often tethered to the regulations of the past,” White said. “To address this, under the leadership of President Trump and Transportation Secretary Duffy, NHTSA is diligently working to update the FMVSS to account for these new designs, prioritizing safety requirements and the performance of those requirements over design specifications.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The repair industry must also evolve as performance expectations become more sophisticated, White said.

“The critical question must shift from ‘did we calibrate it?’ to ‘have we restored its performance?’ Manufacturers, regulators, and repairers all have a shared role in establishing confidence that these systems continue to deliver their intended safety benefit after a crash,” White said.
Schulenburg asked whether NHTSA had any guidance on how the collision industry can navigate pressure it faces in the claims environment. For example, pressure to use alternative parts.
“Our worry as an industry is that oftentimes that may produce an outcome that doesn’t preserve the safety that you’ve worked so hard to create in the standards,” Schulenburg said.
White responded, “You are under tremendous pressure to cut costs. That can’t come at the expense of safety. Safety always has to be foundational.”
Affordability is also part of that equation, he added. Technology advancement must consider the cost of repair, he said.
Recently, an OEM announced six new model types that will sell below $40,000, he said.

“The message of affordability is a loud one,” White said. “How do we do that? What we don’t want is a safety system that only performs like it’s on the showroom floor. We can’t do that at the repair shops. That’s not an acceptable business model. How do we strike that balance? There are still a lot of details to work out, but we don’t want to put in any safety risk in that process.”

Schulenburg responded, “I think when consumers have to assume parts of the cost of the repair that they otherwise expected to be covered by a claim, those are pieces of affordability that don’t always get addressed. You’re obviously engaging with the repair community and the manufacturer community. Do you also engage with the insurance community around these topics?”
White said NHTSA has ongoing communications with the insurance industry as well. It also tries to stay up to date on trends.
Deadly counterfeit airbags are an example of how a decision made during a repair can determine whether a safety system protects someone or actually injures them, White said.

“That’s the lesson that NHTSA has learned and what collision repairers need to hear is that the traceability, the authenticity, and the suitability of the safety-critical replacement components are paramount,” he said. “We understand the pressure from the insurance companies on repairs to seek out alternative parts, lower their costs. But there’s an equal reason of concern when dealing with alternative safety sensors, cameras, and radar units.”

NHTSA identified an 11th death caused by a counterfeit airbag part from China in September. The agency urges owners of used vehicles that have previously been in a crash with an airbag deployment since 2020 to have their vehicle inspected.
The agency banned the importation and sale of these DTN60DB inflators earlier this year; the first ban NHTSA issued in more than two decades.
White said the sellers of counterfeit parts have short-term business models.
“They pop up, they disappear,” he said. “They go out of business, and then six months later they surface. We shut that one down, and then two days later they open up another marketplace.”
These are trends buyers can look for when looking for a reputable parts seller, he said.
Schulenburg responded that authorized supply channels play an important role in protecting against counterfeit parts.
He asked whether there is a risk for other counterfeit parts such as cameras, sensors, and radars.

“That’s a global threat as far as knockoffs and noncompliant equipment,” White responded. “We’re going to have to constantly be sure that we’ve got the right standards, sure that their performance levels are validated.”
Every OEM has different technology developments, he said. He added that each has a different level of performance.

“A lidar advancement means maybe it’s six months ahead of the radar and it’s a little bit ahead of the camera,” White said. “How do we make sure that that system performs like it was designed, at that same year model with similar equipment and similar mileage?”
There have to be some procedures and processes in place to keep technology performing after a collision, he said.
He noted that the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has published some guidelines.
“NHTSA hasn’t done that in terms of the technology,” White said. “We are going to go after the performance of the system.”
Federal law prohibits any motor vehicle repair business from knowingly making a device or design element of a vehicle inoperative, he said.

“While the concept of not rendering inoperative a federally required safety system is not new, a lot of the technology found in modern vehicles is,” White said. “When a vehicle safety system performance depends on cameras, radar, software, precise mounting tolerances, calibration, and interconnected systems, the responsibility of the repairer is more complex than ever before.”
“Rendering inoperative” is a term used by NHTSA that defines the degradation of a safety system to where it doesn’t perform as it should.

Schulenburg pointed out that the rendering inoperative discussion historically has been focused on safety systems such as airbags and seatbelts. He asked how this could change with the advancement of technical safety systems.
“What’s happening is we’re moving toward a situation where the vehicle is going to be able to operate itself,” White said.
He added that the discussion of rendering inoperable grows in the scenario.
Schulenburg asked whether the recent elections will change the way that NHTSA operates.

“I’ll go back to the 100 people that are going to be killed in crashes today,” White said. “They’re not worried about elections. They want the safety equipment to work. The NHTSA mission transcends the politics in Washington, D.C. I’ve never met a team of more committed people working every day on safety.”
Looking forward, White said training technicians for future technology is one of the most important pieces for the collision repair industry.
“That’s where the energy needs to be, so that we’re prepared, so that as the technology comes out in 2027, 2028, 2029, and these model years start rolling out, we’re ready,” White said.
Collision repairers touch vehicles at a unique, critical moment after something goes wrong and before vehicles go back on the road, White said.

“There are profound opportunities for the collision repair community to become a more meaningful partner in NHTSA’s safety mission,” he added. “If there’s one thing I want everyone in the collision repair business in this room to understand about your role in vehicle safety, it is this: you are the final checkpoint. The safety standards we write and the system automakers engineer rely entirely on your expertise to ensure endurance throughout that vehicle’s life.”

Aaron Schulenburg, SCRS executive director, and Lee White, NHTSA’s deputy administrator, discuss the collision repair industry during SCRS’ OEM Summit at the 2026 SEMA Show (Lurah Lowery/Repairer Driven News).
