paras.en: The human heel bone is the largest and “most remarkable bone in the foot,” says biomechanist Ali Yawar, who was not involved in the work. “We should look at our heel and think of it as what makes us, among many other things, uniquely human.”
paras.zh: 生物力学家Ali Yawar表示，人类的跟骨是最大的骨头，也是“足部最非凡的骨头”。他并未参与这项研究。“我们应该看看我们的脚跟，并认为它是在众多因素中使我们具有独特人类特征的因素之一。”

articles.title: Record-breaking simulation sheds light on cosmic ‘dark ages’

paras.en: People sometimes fret that we might be living inside a computer simulation and that we’re all products of some gigantic godlike program created for reasons unknown. (This suspicion is so prevalent that it’s spawned its own joke among Star Trek fans: when things get really bad, just look up and firmly say, “Computer, end program,” in case we all happen to be in a holodeck.)
paras.zh: 人们有时会担心我们可能生活在计算机模拟中，并且我们都是出于未知原因而创建的某个巨大的神一样的程序的产物。 （这种怀疑如此普遍，以至于在《星际迷航》粉丝中引发了自己的笑话：当事情变得非常糟糕时，只需抬头并坚定地说：“计算机，结束程序”，以防我们都碰巧在全息甲板中。）

paras.en: I certainly can’t say whether this is true or not (or what difference it would make), but I do know that we humans are getting pretty good at simulating the universe ourselves—or at least the physics of it.
paras.zh: 我当然不能说这是否属实（或者它会产生什么影响），但我确实知道我们人类已经非常擅长模拟宇宙本身——或者至少是它的物理学。

paras.en: For proof, look no further than Lumina, a new record-breaking simulation from a large international team of scientists. Lumina is the best-yet attempt to model the physics underpinning one of the most important events in cosmic history: reionization, which is the key to understanding critical energy sources in the early universe. The researchers published their initial results on October 26 in the Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society.
paras.zh: 为了证明这一点，Lumina 就是一个很好的例子，这是一个由大型国际科学家团队开发的新的破纪录模拟。 Lumina 是对支持宇宙历史上最重要事件之一的物理学进行建模的最佳尝试：再电离，这是理解早期宇宙关键能源的关键。研究人员于 10 月 26 日在《皇家天文学会月刊》上发表了他们的初步结果。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: To say the simulation is ambitious seriously undersells it. Lumina calculates the physical conditions in a volume of space more than 1.5 billion light-years wide—an immense distance—yet can also simulate what’s going on at scales of around only 1,400 light-years. It does this by dividing that volume over a staggering 432 billion individual sectors of space and keeping track of multiple physical parameters inside each as conditions change over time. This produces the most detailed simulation over the largest chunk of the universe ever created, revealing what happened over a two-billion-year stretch of time that reaches back to just 50 million years or so after the big bang.
paras.zh: 说模拟是雄心勃勃的，其实是严重低估了它。 Lumina 计算超过 15 亿光年宽的空间体积中的物理条件（这是一个巨大的距离），但也可以模拟仅约 1,400 光年尺度上发生的情况。它通过将体积划分为惊人的 4320 亿个单独的空间扇区，并随着条件随时间的变化而跟踪每个扇区内的多个物理参数来实现这一点。这对有史以来最大的宇宙部分进行了最详细的模拟，揭示了从大爆炸后 5000 万年左右的 20 亿年时间里发生的事情。

paras.en: It was during this era that the first stars and galaxies themselves formed, yet we know very little about the physical conditions of the universe at that time—which is why simulations like Lumina can be so enlightening.
paras.zh: 正是在这个时代，第一批恒星和星系本身形成，但我们对当时宇宙的物理条件知之甚少，这就是为什么像 Lumina 这样的模拟如此具有启发性。

paras.en: In the beginning, the cosmos was very hot and very dense. It expanded, and it cooled as it did so. For the first 380,000 years or so, it was opaque because it was filled with ionized gas—charged particles such as electrons and protons. At those extremely high densities, you couldn’t swing a photon without it hitting an ion and bouncing off in a random direction, so light couldn’t travel freely as it does today.
paras.zh: 起初，宇宙非常炽热，密度极高。它在膨胀的过程中逐渐冷却。在前38万年左右的时间里，宇宙是不透明的，因为它充满了电离气体——带电粒子，如电子和质子。在如此极高的密度下，光子一出现就会撞击离子，然后向随机方向反弹，因此光无法像今天这样自由传播。

paras.en: Eventually the universe cooled enough that atomic nuclei and electrons could combine, and when they did, all that gas that was suffusing space very quickly became electrically neutral. Such material isn’t very good at absorbing light, so this made the universe transparent. Photons could fly freely, traveling long distances.
paras.zh: 最终，宇宙冷却到足以使原子核和电子能够结合，当它们结合时，弥漫在太空中的所有气体很快就会变成电中性。这种材料不太善于吸收光线，因此这使得宇宙变得透明。光子可以自由飞行，传播很长的距离。

paras.en: As this was happening, gravity was starting to draw together vast expanses of cooling matter. Huge structures began forming—such as galaxies, clusters of galaxies and superclusters of galaxies. On a smaller scale, stars were starting to coalesce from the miasma as well—and supermassive black holes in the centers of galaxies were, too.
paras.zh: 与此同时，引力开始将大片正在冷却的物质聚集在一起。巨大的结构开始形成，例如星系、星系团和星系超团。在更小的尺度上，恒星也开始从瘴气中凝聚起来，星系中心的超大质量黑洞也是如此。

paras.en: Both stars and these monstrous black holes were sources of intense high-energy photons, including ultraviolet light. All that radiation zapped electrons off atoms once again, and over the course of time, this reionized the universe. By then, however, the universe had expanded so much that the density of all that gas had plummeted, so the cosmos stayed transparent. That’s pretty much the state of things today, some 13-billion-plus years later.
paras.zh: 恒星和这些庞大的黑洞都是强烈的、高能量光子的来源，包括紫外线。所有这些辐射再次将电子从原子中剥离，随着时间的推移，宇宙再次被电离。然而，到那时，宇宙已经膨胀到所有气体的密度都急剧下降的程度，因此宇宙仍然保持透明。大约130多亿年后，这就是今天的情况。

paras.en: But there are details we still don’t know that are difficult to deduce just from observations. When (and how suddenly) did reionization occur? What role did dark matter play, or the different elements churned out by stars? When exactly did large-scale structures form?
paras.zh: 但仍有一些细节我们还不知道，仅凭观测很难推断出来。再电离何时（以及以多突然的方式）发生？暗物质发挥了什么作用？恒星产生的各种元素又发挥了什么作用？大规模结构究竟是在什么时候形成的？

paras.en: This is where simulations come in. We understand, for example, gravity, the flow of photons through matter and the amount of radiation stars and galaxies emit. A computer model can take a small region of virtual space, add in hydrogen, helium, dark matter and radiation and then apply the laws of physics and see how it all changes over time. By doing this across thousands, millions or billions of these regions and letting them affect each other, you can try to reproduce how the universe works.
paras.zh: 这就是模拟发挥作用的地方。例如，我们了解重力、光子在物质中的流动以及恒星和星系发出的辐射量。计算机模型可以取虚拟空间的一个小区域，加入氢、氦、暗物质和辐射，然后应用物理定律，观察所有这些物质随时间的变化。通过在成千上万、数百万或数十亿个这样的区域中进行此操作，并让它们相互影响，就可以尝试重现宇宙的运作方式。

paras.en: But simulating the universe isn’t easy. You need to look at small scales to ensure you’re getting the physics of star formation right, but you also need to look at huge scales to allow things such as galaxies and galaxy clusters to form. And to see how all this structure changes, you have to do this over and over again as simulated time passes.
paras.zh: 但模拟宇宙并非易事。你需要观察小尺度，以确保正确掌握恒星形成的物理学原理，但你也需要观察大尺度，以便让星系和星系团等天体得以形成。为了观察所有这些结构是如何变化的，随着模拟时间的推移，你必须一遍又一遍地进行这项工作。

paras.en: Still, computers are pretty good these days, and scientists can code their sims to optimize for speed without (hopefully) sacrificing too much realism. So as our computers and code have improved, simulations have evolved over time to become more complex, much like the cosmos itself.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，如今的计算机性能相当出色，科学家们可以编写模拟代码来优化速度，同时（希望）不会牺牲太多真实性。因此，随着我们的计算机和代码的改进，模拟也随着时间的推移而演变，变得更加复杂，就像宇宙本身一样。

paras.en: Lumina is the latest step in this evolution. It looks at small regions of space but has so many of them—hundreds of billions—that it actually covers volumes big enough to see structures such as clusters. Also, importantly, the volume of space is so huge that relatively rare (but extremely influential) objects such as super-powerful, ionizing-radiation-spewing quasars can form as well, allowing their outsized effects to be included.
paras.zh: Lumina是这一演进过程中的最新一步。它观察的是宇宙中的小区域，但这样的区域有数千亿个，因此它实际上覆盖的体积大到足以看到星系团等结构。同样重要的是，空间体积如此之大，以至于像超强、喷射电离辐射的类星体等相对罕见（但影响极大）的天体也能形成，从而可以将它们巨大的影响也包括在内。

paras.en: Lumina also uses the most sophisticated physics ever done on this scale. The simulation keeps track of hydrogen, helium and dark matter, as well as ionizing radiation from various sources. (I’ll note it does not include the effects of magnetism, which are ridiculously complex and difficult to calculate.)
paras.zh: Lumina还采用了有史以来在这个尺度上最先进的物理学。该模拟跟踪氢、氦和暗物质，以及来自各种来源的电离辐射。（我在此说明，模拟不包括磁性的影响，因为磁性极其复杂，难以计算。）

paras.en: The sim’s initial results are pretty interesting. Astronomers have argued for years over whether supermassive black holes or stars were primarily responsible for reionization. And Lumina indicates the answer is both! Stars were responsible for the ionization of hydrogen and for removing one electron off helium atoms, but it took the higher energy output from huge black holes in the centers of galaxies to completely ionize helium (which clutches its electrons more tightly than hydrogen does). This doesn’t really surprise me—in general, if there are two possible explanations for some effect, the real answer may be a mix of both—but it’s still helpful to clarify the roles these individual sources play.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Among other results, the Lumina team finds that the reionization of hydrogen completed about 12.5 billion years ago. Total helium reionization (meaning both electrons are stripped) started around 12.8 billion years ago and finished about 1.2 billion years later. Other, more subtle, results will keep astronomers busy matching theory and observations for some time. In a sense, the Lumina results are much like the survey from, say, the Vera C. Rubin Observatory, which is taking observations of the actual universe with extraordinary resolution and depth; both present exquisite datasets that can be plumbed for treasures for years to come.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: A simulated universe can tell us a lot about the real one—assuming it is real. Either way, the ultimate goal is understanding it a little better, and that’s real enough for me.
paras.zh: 假设真实宇宙是真实的，那么模拟宇宙可以告诉我们很多关于真实宇宙的信息。无论如何，最终目标都是要多了解它一点，对我来说，这就足够真实了。

articles.title: Can SpaceX catch its Starship?

paras.en: SpaceX’s Starship, the largest and most ambitious rocket ever built, is embarking on its most consequential test yet.
paras.zh: SpaceX 的 Starship 是有史以来最大、最雄心勃勃的火箭，目前正在开始其最重要的测试。

paras.en: Elon Musk says the enormous two-stage vehicle will someday carry humans to the moon and Mars, but more immediately, Starship is central to the company’s plan to build out its Starlink satellite Internet constellation (not to mention its aim to pack a million data center satellites into orbit around Earth). But first SpaceX must show Starship can deliver on its most transformative and critical promise: full reusability.
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，这种巨大的两级飞行器有一天将载人前往月球和火星，但更直接的是，Starship 是该公司建设 Starlink 卫星互联网星座计划的核心（更不用说其目标是将 100 万颗数据中心卫星送入地球轨道）。但首先 SpaceX 必须证明 Starship 能够兑现其最具变革性和最关键的承诺：完全可重复使用。

paras.en: That’s why today’s Flight 15 is so consequential. Set to launch no earlier than 5:45 P.M. EST from the company’s Starbase site in South Texas, this test flight has a deceptively simple goal: getting the rocket into space and then returning both the Super Heavy booster and the Starship orbiter back to Earth intact and essentially ready to fly again.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么今天的 15 号航班如此重要。定于下午 5 点 45 分之前启动美国东部时间从该公司位于德克萨斯州南部的 Starbase 基地出发，这次试飞的目标看似简单：将火箭送入太空，然后将超重型助推器和星舰轨道器完好无损地送回地球，基本上准备好再次飞行。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: What that will involve is the booster and orbiter separately reentering Earth’s atmosphere and flying back to Starbase, where the launch tower, fitted with enormous mechanical arms, will be waiting to catch them. SpaceX has previously shown it can snatch the Super Heavy from midair in previous tests. But Flight 15 will be the first attempt to catch the orbiter itself, after it has spent nearly a full day in space and circled Earth some 14 times.
paras.zh: 这将涉及助推器和轨道飞行器分别重新进入地球大气层并飞回星际基地，那里装有巨大机械臂的发射塔将等待着捕捉它们。 SpaceX 此前曾在之前的测试中展示过它可以从半空中捕获超重型火箭。但 15 号航班将是轨道飞行器本身的首次尝试，此前它已经在太空中度过了近一整天并绕地球飞行了约 14 圈。

paras.en: If both recoveries succeed, SpaceX will have achieved a major milestone toward its goal of a fully reusable orbital rocket. On Friday afternoon, just hours ahead of the flight, the Federal Aviation Administration issued the necessary launch license.
paras.zh: 如果两次回收都成功，SpaceX 将在实现完全可重复使用的轨道火箭目标方面实现一个重要里程碑。周五下午，就在起飞前几个小时，美国联邦航空管理局颁发了必要的发射许可证。

paras.en: The mission begins with the ignition of the 33 engines on Starship’s Super Heavy booster, which will propel the spacecraft toward orbit before the two vehicles separate. Six and a half minutes after liftoff, the booster will attempt to return to Starbase and the launch tower’s awaiting mechanical “chopstick” arms.
paras.zh: 该任务首先点燃 Starship 超重型助推器上的 33 个发动机，这将在两艘飞行器分离之前将航天器推向轨道。升空六分半钟后，助推器将尝试返回星际基地和发射塔等待的机械“筷子”臂。

paras.en: Meanwhile Starship itself will continue into orbit to deploy 26 next-generation satellites for Starlink, SpaceX’s fast-growing Internet business. Once it’s fully operational, Starship will be able to loft Starlink satellites in far larger and more frequent batches than the firm’s retiring workhorse rocket, the Falcon 9. That will pave the way for the company’s plans to supplement Starlink with the launch of huge numbers of orbital data centers for artificial intelligence. If all goes to plan, then, about 22 hours later, Starship will attempt its own homecoming back to Starbase, returning to Earth around 4:15 P.M. EST on November 14.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Starship 本身将继续进入轨道，为 SpaceX 快速增长的互联网业务 Starlink 部署 26 颗下一代卫星。一旦全面投入运营，Starship 将能够以比该公司即将退役的主力火箭猎鹰 9 号更大、更频繁的批量发射 Starlink 卫星。这将为该公司通过发射大量人工智能轨道数据中心来补充 Starlink 的计划铺平道路。如果一切按计划进行，那么大约 22 小时后，Starship 将尝试自行返回 Starbase，并于下午 4:15 左右返回地球。美国东部时间 11 月 14 日。

paras.en: Even with a flawless recovery of both stages, the real prize remains untested: SpaceX must still show that it can rapidly turn around both the booster and orbiter for a fast return to flight. That would put the company well on its way to fulfilling Musk’s projection of roughly one Starship launch per week in the first half of 2027.
paras.zh: 即使两个阶段都完美恢复，真正的奖励仍然未经考验：SpaceX 仍然必须证明它可以快速转动助推器和轨道器以快速返回飞行。这将使该公司顺利实现马斯克关于 2027 年上半年每周发射大约一艘星际飞船的计划。

paras.en: Flight 15 follows Flight 14, which saw Starship successfully reach orbit and deploy a batch of operational Starlink satellites. But that previous mission ended early because of an engine issue on Starship, leading SpaceX to bring the vehicle down in the Pacific Ocean. (The Super Heavy booster splashed down as planned in the Gulf of Mexico.) Besides demonstrating a much more audacious recovery, Flight 15 should also be Starship’s longest-yet sojourn in orbit.
paras.zh: 15 号航班紧随 14 号航班之后，星舰成功进入轨道并部署了一批运行的星链卫星。但由于 Starship 的发动机问题，之前的任务提前结束，导致 SpaceX 将飞船坠入太平洋。 （超重型助推器按计划在墨西哥湾溅落。）除了展示更大胆的回收之外，15 号航班也应该是星舰在轨道上逗留时间最长的一次。

paras.en: The test is essential prep for Starship to meet its obligations to NASA’s Artemis program, which seeks to return U.S. astronauts to the moon before the end of 2028. SpaceX is developing a modified Human Landing System (HLS) version of Starship to potentially serve as a lunar lander, transporting crews between lunar orbit and the moon’s surface.
paras.zh: 这次测试是 Starship 履行其对 NASA 阿尔忒弥斯计划义务的重要准备，该计划旨在于 2028 年底之前让美国宇航员重返月球。SpaceX 正在开发改进版的 Starship 人类着陆系统 (HLS)，有可能充当月球着陆器，在月球轨道和月球表面之间运送宇航员。

paras.en: Before it can ferry humans on those far-flung voyages, though, Starship has to demonstrate key capabilities closer to home. During NASA’s Artemis III mission, targeted for next summer, Starship is set to launch to rendezvous and dock in low-Earth orbit with a NASA Orion spacecraft carrying four astronauts; SpaceX’s rival Blue Origin is also part of that mission, and a test version of that company’s Blue Moon Mark 2 lander will also link up with Orion.
paras.zh: 不过，在能够运送人类进行遥远的航行之前，星舰必须在离家较近的地方展示关键能力。在美国宇航局计划于明年夏天执行的阿耳忒弥斯 III 任务中，星际飞船将发射升空，与载有四名宇航员的美国宇航局猎户座飞船在近地轨道交会对接； SpaceX 的竞争对手 Blue Origin 也是该任务的一部分，该公司 Blue Moon Mark 2 着陆器的测试版本也将与猎户座连接。

paras.en: Future Starship test flights will also need to solve the challenge of in-space refueling because, for the heavy HLS, a round trip to the moon requires more fuel than a single Starship can carry into orbit.
paras.zh: 未来的星舰试飞还需要解决太空加油的挑战，因为对于重型 HLS 来说，往返月球需要的燃料比单艘星舰带入轨道的燃料还要多。

paras.en: SpaceX’s ambitions are unfolding against a changing political landscape as well, particularly in Texas, where the company’s Starbase facility is based. The state’s governor-elect Gina Hinojosa campaigned against energy-intensive data centers and has pledged to pause new approvals until stronger protections are in place.
paras.zh: SpaceX 的雄心壮志也在不断变化的政治格局中展开，尤其是在该公司 Starbase 设施所在地的德克萨斯州。该州当选州长吉娜·伊诺霍萨 (Gina Hinojosa) 发起反对能源密集型数据中心的活动，并承诺暂停新的审批，直到采取更强有力的保护措施。

paras.en: The timing is awkward for SpaceX: the company has just disclosed plans for a proposed $24-billion gas-fired power plant and supercomputing complex at Starbase and is seeking local tax incentives for the project.
paras.zh: 对于 SpaceX 来说，时机很尴尬：该公司刚刚披露了在 Starbase 建设耗资 240 亿美元的燃气发电厂和超级计算中心的计划，并正在为该项目寻求当地税收优惠。

paras.en: For now the immediate question is whether Starship can do something no orbital-class rocket has done before: come home in one piece, with both stages recovered and ready, in principle, to fly again.
paras.zh: 目前迫在眉睫的问题是，“星舰”是否能做到以前轨道级火箭从未做过的事情：完整地回家，两级都已恢复并准备好，原则上可以再次飞行。

articles.title: Stone Age children left fingerprints on ancient art projects
articles.author: Freda Kreier

paras.en: Children have been making art with help from grown-ups for millennia.
paras.zh: 几千年来，孩子们一直在成年人的帮助下进行艺术创作。

paras.en: Fragmented clay figurines dating as far back as 15,000 years ago, discovered in what is now Israel, preserve the fingerprints of both adults and young children. The finding suggests the grown-ups taught the kids how to shape and decorate clay, researchers report November 11 in PLOS One.
paras.zh: 在现在的以色列发现的泥人碎片可以追溯到 15,000 年前，保留了成人和幼儿的指纹。研究人员 11 月 11 日在 PLOS One 上报道称，这一发现表明大人教孩子们如何塑造和装饰粘土。

paras.en: Children’s contributions to prehistoric art and culture aren’t well understood. Concrete evidence of their involvement has been hard to find, says archaeologist Laurent Davin of the Hebrew University of Jerusalem.
paras.zh: 儿童对史前艺术和文化的贡献尚不清楚。耶路撒冷希伯来大学的考古学家劳伦特·达文说，很难找到他们参与其中的具体证据。

paras.en: In recent decades, researchers have found a handful of objects made by children — including 200,000-year-old rock art bearing child-sized handprints in Tibet and 30,000-year-old clay sculptures pockmarked with child-sized fingerprints in Czech Republic.
paras.zh: 近几十年来，研究人员发现了一些由儿童制作的物品，其中包括西藏有 20 万年历史、带有儿童大小手印的岩画，以及捷克共和国有 3 万年历史、有儿童大小手印的泥塑。

paras.en: Davin and colleagues hadn’t set out to find Stone Age children’s artwork. They were investigating whether the Natufian culture — a group of hunter-gatherers who formed some of the first permanent settlements in the Levant about 14,000 years ago — made clay art before the advent of agriculture in the region.
paras.zh: 达文和同事并没有打算寻找石器时代儿童的艺术品。他们正在调查纳图夫文化（大约 14,000 年前，一群狩猎采集者在黎凡特形成了第一个永久定居点）是否在该地区出现农业之前就制作了粘土艺术。

paras.en: The archaeologists came across the first set of fingerprints while sorting through 40 kilograms of clay collected at three Natufian sites, which range in age from 15,000 to 11,600 years old. Among tens of thousands of clay lumps, the team found some 150 fragments of sculptures, including 15 recognizable bird, gazelle and human figures. Around 60 of these pieces preserved fingerprints from where people had pinched or prodded the clay.
paras.zh: 考古学家在对三个纳图夫遗址收集的 40 公斤粘土进行分类时发现了第一组指纹，这些粘土的年龄从 15,000 岁到 11,600 岁不等。在数万块粘土块中，研究小组发现了约 150 件雕塑碎片，其中包括 15 件可辨认的鸟类、瞪羚和人物雕像。其中大约 60 件作品保存了人们捏或戳粘土时留下的指纹。

paras.en: The distances between the fingerprints’ ridges, which are influenced by age and sex, suggest that most of the figurines were made by women and children — some younger than 10. Only a few sets of fingerprints belonged to men. And the torso of one tiny human statue had both adult and child fingerprints, hinting that an elder and child had passed it back and forth. Davin suspects that the adult actively taught a child how to work the clay.
paras.zh: 指纹脊线之间的距离受年龄和性别的影响，表明大多数雕像是由妇女和儿童制作的——有些还不到 10 岁。只有几组指纹属于男性。一座微型人体雕像的躯干上有成人和儿童的指纹，这表明有一位老人和一个孩子来回经过。达文怀疑成年人主动教孩子如何制作粘土。

paras.en: This evidence of intergenerational learning so far back in time is fascinating, says archaeologist Steven Dorland of Grand Valley State University in Allendale, Mich. It demonstrates how much researchers can learn from broadening their focus beyond adult males, he says. Dorland has used pottery to understand social learning in Indigenous societies of the Great Lakes region. He has even studied children’s fingerprints on some of those artifacts.
paras.zh: 密歇根州艾伦代尔市大谷州立大学的考古学家史蒂文·多兰说，这种迄今为止代际学习的证据令人着迷。他说，这表明研究人员可以通过将关注点扩大到成年男性之外来学到很多东西。多兰利用陶器来了解五大湖地区土著社会的社会学习。他甚至研究了其中一些文物上的儿童指纹。

paras.en: The purpose of the Natufian figurines is unclear. Most of the statues are less than 2 centimeters long and don’t display signs of intense use, the team found, suggesting they weren’t treated as precious heirlooms.
paras.zh: 纳图夫人雕像的用途尚不清楚。研究小组发现，大多数雕像长度不到 2 厘米，并且没有显示出频繁使用的迹象，这表明它们没有被视为珍贵的传家宝。

paras.en: Davin suspects the figurines may have represented stories, like how kids draw Disney characters today, he says. “Maybe the idea is that the role of children here is not necessarily to learn to make figurines, but more to learn the story behind them.”
paras.zh: 达文怀疑这些雕像可能代表了故事，就像今天孩子们如何画迪士尼人物一样，他说。 “也许这个想法是，孩子们在这里的角色不一定是学习制作雕像，更多的是了解它们背​​后的故事。”

articles.title: The ‘hell chicken’ dinosaur was a real terror — to fruit
articles.author: Jake Buehler

paras.en: More than 65 million years ago, a small, beaked dinosaur dubbed the “hell chicken” was a real terror – to fruit. Reconstruction of its beak and jaw suggest it mashed up fruit much like modern parrots.
paras.zh: 超过 6500 万年前，一种被称为“地狱鸡”的小型喙恐龙确实令人恐惧。它的喙和下巴的重建表明它可以像现代鹦鹉一样捣碎水果。

paras.en: It’s the first evidence of non-avian dinosaurs evolving specialized adaptations for eating fruit, and comes at a time when flowering plants were coming into their own, researchers report October 10 in Nature Communications.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 10 月 10 日在《自然通讯》杂志上报道，这是非鸟类恐龙进化出专门适应吃水果的第一个证据，并且出现在开花植物成熟的时期。

paras.en: In 2011, a fossil collector found much of the fossilized skeleton of an odd theropod dinosaur in eastern Montana and brought to the attention of David Evans, a paleontologist at the Royal Ontario Museum in Canada. Over the next several years, fossil collectors and paleontologists working in Montana and North and South Dakota unearthed four more partial skeletons.
paras.zh: 2011年，一位化石收藏家在蒙大拿州东部发现了一种奇怪的兽脚类恐龙的大部分化石骨架，并引起了加拿大皇家安大略博物馆古生物学家戴维·埃文斯的注意。在接下来的几年里，在蒙大拿州、北达科他州和南达科他州工作的化石收藏家和古生物学家又出土了四具部分骨骼。

paras.en: The dinosaur belonged to a particularly birdlike subgroup of beaked theropods called oviraptorosaurs that lived during the Cretaceous Period. This species probably weighed around 12 kilograms — about the size of a turkey.
paras.zh: 这种恐龙属于一种特别像鸟类的喙兽脚亚目亚群，称为偷蛋龙，生活在白垩纪时期。该物种的重量可能约为 12 公斤，相当于火鸡的大小。

paras.en: Evans and Greg Funston — a paleontologist at Stony Brook University in New York — and their colleagues named it Infernogallus jamesi, or ‘hell chicken,’ after its discovery in the Hell Creek geological formation and its overall poultrylike appearance.
paras.zh: 埃文斯和纽约石溪大学的古生物学家格雷格·芬斯顿以及他们的同事将其命名为 Infernogallus jamesi，即“地狱鸡”，因为它是在地狱溪地质构造中发现的，而且其整体外观像家禽。

paras.en: When the researchers studied Infernogallus’s skull and reconstructed the musculature, they discovered that it was no ordinary theropod. The construction of its jaw joints, muscles and palate suggest that it moved its jaw forward and back when eating rather than up and down like its chomping relatives.
paras.zh: 当研究人员研究火鸡的头骨并重建肌肉组织时，他们发现它不是普通的兽脚亚目恐龙。它的下颌关节、肌肉和上颚的结构表明，它在进食时前后移动下巴，而不是像它咀嚼的近亲那样上下移动。

paras.en: This chewing style is unique among non-avian dinosaurs but is strikingly similar to that of fruit-eating parrots. Funston and his colleagues think Infernogallus had adapted to a fruit-rich diet, deftly stripping the flesh from large seeds using its tongue and sliding jaw motions.
paras.zh: 这种咀嚼方式在非鸟类恐龙中是独一无二的，但与食果鹦鹉的咀嚼方式惊人相似。芬斯顿和他的同事认为火鸡已经适应了富含水果的饮食，能够利用舌头和滑动下巴的动作巧妙地从大种子上剥离果肉。

paras.en: These fruit-munching adaptations were surprising, Funston says. “But the more we delved into it, the more sense it made,” he says. “All the different lines of evidence seemed to converge on this one answer.”
paras.zh: 芬斯顿说，这些咀嚼水果的适应令人惊讶。 “但我们越深入研究它，它就越有意义，”他说。 “所有不同的证据似乎都集中在这个答案上。”

paras.en: Angiosperms — plants that produce flowers and fruits — were rapidly diversifying throughout the Cretaceous. Mounting evidence suggests that angiosperms were coevolving with Cretaceous animals, and that dinosaurs may have been eating their fruits. Infernogallus adds to that emerging picture. It’s possible that other ‘hell chicken’ relatives or other dinosaur groups were habitual fruit eaters too, Funston says.
paras.zh: 被子植物——产生花朵和果实的植物——在整个白垩纪迅速多样化。越来越多的证据表明，被子植物与白垩纪动物共同进化，恐龙可能一直在吃它们的果实​​。 Infernogallus 进一步丰富了这一新景象。芬斯顿说，其他“地狱鸡”亲戚或其他恐龙群体也可能习惯吃水果。

paras.en: “[The discovery] suggests that our picture of dinosaur ecology right before the Cretaceous extinction has been missing major puzzle pieces, and that dinosaurs were more diverse than we thought.”
paras.zh: “[这一发现]表明，我们对白垩纪灭绝之前的恐龙生态的了解一直缺少主要的拼图，而且恐龙比我们想象的更加多样化。”

articles.title: In National Geographic’s “Expedition: Saving Our Seas,” it’s all hands on deck
articles.author: Carolyn Gramling

paras.en: As documentaries about Earth’s accelerating climate crisis go, Expedition: Saving Our Seas is surprisingly buoyant.
paras.zh: 正如有关地球日益加剧的气候危机的纪录片所言，《远征：拯救我们的海洋》出人意料地活跃。

paras.en: The ocean covers more than two-thirds of Earth’s surface. And “as the climate heats up, our seas are under pressure like never before,” narrator Auli’i Cravalho, the voice of the title character in Disney’s Moana, says at the opening of The National Geographic Society’s new documentary. The film documents how oceanographers are racing to document and mitigate climate change’s impacts on ocean and coastal habitats.
paras.zh: 海洋覆盖了地球表面三分之二以上的面积。 “随着气候变暖，我们的海洋面临着前所未有的压力，”迪士尼影片《莫阿娜》中主角的配音奥丽伊·克拉瓦略 (Auli'i Cravalho) 在国家地理学会新纪录片的开头说道。该影片记录了海洋学家如何竞相记录和减轻气候变化对海洋和沿海栖息地的影响。

paras.en: Expedition: Saving Our Seas premieres November 13 on the National Geographic Channel at 9pm EST and streams the next day on Disney+ and Hulu.
paras.zh: 《远征：拯救我们的海洋》于美国东部时间 11 月 13 日晚上 9 点在国家地理频道首播，并于次日在 Disney+ 和 Hulu 上播出。

paras.en: Despite that solemn mission, Expedition: Saving Our Seas is full of hope — and stunning visuals. The documentary offers a window into the scientists’ wonder and joy in their work as they discover new life forms in the depths of the Southern Ocean, or successfully nurture young corals threatened by warming in the Indian Ocean.
paras.zh: 尽管肩负着庄严的使命，《远征：拯救我们的海洋》仍然充满希望——以及令人惊叹的视觉效果。这部纪录片为我们展示了科学家们在工作中的惊奇和喜悦，因为他们在南大洋深处发现了新的生命形式，或者成功地培育了受到印度洋变暖威胁的年轻珊瑚。

paras.en: The film opens with a twist on the usual world map: At the center is one great ocean, surrounded by land. Trivia buffs know Earth has five oceans: the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic. But geographic names aside, these five oceans are just one, linked by a global system of currents known as the Great Ocean Conveyor Belt.
paras.zh: 影片一开始就改变了通常的世界地图：中心是一片巨大的海洋，周围是陆地。冷知识爱好者都知道地球有五大洋：太平洋、大西洋、印度洋、南方和北极。但撇开地理名称不谈，这五个大洋只是一个大洋，由称为大洋传送带的全球洋流系统连接起来。

paras.en: “It’s this giant connected ocean that ignores all of the political boundaries, ignores all of the names we call them,” says Andrew Thurber, a biological oceanographer at the University of California, Santa Barbara, whose research is among those featured in the film.
paras.zh: 加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校的生物海洋学家安德鲁·瑟伯（Andrew Thurber）说：“这是一个巨大的相连海洋，它无视所有的政治界限，无视我们对它们的所有名称。”他的研究也在影片中得到了体现。

paras.en: The documentary loosely follows the current’s path as it zips around the world from project to project.
paras.zh: 这部纪录片大致遵循了当今世界的潮流，从一个项目到另一个项目。

paras.en: The first project in the documentary is Thurber’s. He’s on board a research vessel in the frigid Southern Ocean, which rings Antarctica. Using a remotely-operated vehicle dubbed SuBastian, Thurber and his colleagues are scanning the seafloor, hunting for the world’s southernmost hydrothermal vent.
paras.zh: 纪录片中的第一个项目是瑟伯的。他在环绕南极洲的寒冷南大洋上的一艘科考船上。瑟伯和他的同事使用名为“苏巴斯蒂安”的远程操作车辆扫描海底，寻找世界最南端的热液喷口。

paras.en: Hydrothermal vents spew superhot, chemically-enriched seawater. In the generally nutrient-poor Southern Ocean, that makes these vents a potential food oasis to support deep sea life.
paras.zh: 热液喷口喷出超热、富含化学物质的海水。在普遍营养贫乏的南大洋，这使得这些喷口成为支持深海生物的潜在食物绿洲。

paras.en: Throughout the night, as the ROV scans the seafloor, Thurber and his colleagues stay glued to the video it sends back, oohing and aahing as never-before-seen life-forms come into view. “It was a marathon of excitement,” he says now.
paras.zh: 整个晚上，当遥控潜水器扫描海底时，瑟伯和他的同事们一直盯着它发回的视频，当前所未见的生命形式出现在视野中时，他们发出惊叹声和啊啊声。 “这是一场令人兴奋的马拉松，”他现在说道。

paras.en: Then they see it: A large black smoker, the southernmost hydrothermal vent ever found. And all around it: swarms of pregnant female krill.
paras.zh: 然后他们看到了：一个巨大的黑色烟雾，这是迄今为止发现的最南端的热液喷口。在它的周围：成群结队的怀孕雌性磷虾。

paras.en: “That blew all of our minds,” Thurber says. Krill are the keystone species of the entire Southern Ocean food web, a crucial food source for baleen whales, seals, penguins and fish. But krill are threatened by both industrial fishing and climate change. This discovery, Thurber says, helps make the case for a marine protected area, a region where fishing and other human activities should be restricted.
paras.zh: “这让我们所有人大吃一惊，”瑟伯说。磷虾是整个南大洋食物网的关键物种，是须鲸、海豹、企鹅和鱼类的重要食物来源。但磷虾同时受到工业捕捞和气候变化的威胁。瑟伯说，这一发现有助于建立海洋保护区，即应限制捕鱼和其他人类活动的区域。

paras.en: From the Southern Ocean, the Great Ocean Conveyor Belt flows thousands of kilometers to the north, where marine ecologist Maiyai Taal Hocheimy is tracking how the rising waters of the Atlantic Ocean are encroaching on Banjul, the capital of The Gambia in West Africa. Her hope is that salt-tolerant mangrove trees along the coast, with their dense network of soil-retaining roots, might help hold back the sea in the coming decades — provided that the community can be enlisted to help maintain the mangroves.
paras.zh: 大洋输送带从南大洋向北流动数千公里，海洋生态学家迈亚伊·塔尔·霍切米正在追踪大西洋上升的海水如何侵蚀西非冈比亚首都班珠尔。她希望，沿海的耐盐红树林及其密集的固土根系网络可能有助于在未来几十年内抑制海水的侵蚀——前提是社区可以参与帮助维护红树林。

paras.en: I found Hocheimy’s work especially inspiring because she is working to shape the future of oceanography. In 2017, she founded the GREAT (Gaining Research Experience in Africa for Tomorrow) Institute, the first aquatic and coastal science research institute in The Gambia. The mangrove project recruited young local scientists to help conduct the research.
paras.zh: 我发现 Hocheimy 的工作特别鼓舞人心，因为她正在努力塑造海洋学的未来。 2017年，她创立了GREAT（为明天在非洲获得研究经验）研究所，这是冈比亚第一个水生和沿海科学研究机构。红树林项目招募了当地年轻的科学家来帮助进行研究。

paras.en: “The goal is to train the next generation of environmental stewards,” Hocheimy says. “We have to show that mangroves have value, so they’ll understand and want to protect them. It is their future at stake.”
paras.zh: “我们的目标是培训下一代环境管理者，”霍切米说。 “我们必须证明红树林具有价值，这样他们就会理解并想要保护红树林。这关系到他们的未来。”

paras.en: That sentiment is echoed many times in the film — the importance not only of enlisting young scientists but also centering local scientists who pose new questions that oceanographers who parachute in from other places may not think to ask, says marine biogeochemist Kristina Brown.
paras.zh: 海洋生物地球化学家克里斯蒂娜·布朗（Kristina Brown）表示，这种观点在影片中多次得到呼应——不仅要招募年轻科学家，还要集中当地科学家提出新问题，而从其他地方跳伞而来的海洋学家可能不会想问这些问题。

paras.en: In the documentary, Brown, of the University of Manitoba in Canada, co-leads an expedition to explore the waters of Sherman Basin, a large bay north of the Arctic Circle in Nunavut, Canada. This region has been hunted and fished by Inuit people for centuries.
paras.zh: 在纪录片中，加拿大曼尼托巴大学的布朗与他人共同领导了一支探险队，探索谢尔曼盆地的水域，谢尔曼盆地是加拿大努纳武特地区北极圈以北的一个大海湾。几个世纪以来，这个地区一直被因纽特人狩猎和捕鱼。

paras.en: But it might change beyond all recognition in the next few decades, Brown says. So, the local Inuit community invited her to help create the first catalog of what species are present in the waters and on the seafloor. “[It’s] the first project I’ve been involved in where the local community both defined the research questions and have brought their own unique expertise to the research project.”
paras.zh: 但布朗表示，在接下来的几十年里，情况可能会发生翻天覆地的变化。因此，当地因纽特人社区邀请她帮助创建第一个水域和海底物种目录。 “[这是]我参与的第一个项目，当地社区既定义了研究问题，又为研究项目带来了自己独特的专业知识。”

paras.en: Watching how communities around the world are increasingly taking ownership of studies in their own waters was, for me, the most exciting takeaway of this documentary.
paras.zh: 对我来说，观看世界各地的社区如何越来越多地在自己的水域进行研究是这部纪录片最令人兴奋的收获。

paras.en: “We want to democratize access to the deep sea, to enable people who haven’t had access to these kinds of tools to ask more and new questions,” says Katy Croft Bell, the founder and president of the Ocean Discovery League, a nonprofit ocean exploration group based in Saunderstown, Rhode Island.
paras.zh: 海洋探索联盟（位于罗德岛州桑德斯敦的非营利性海洋探索组织）的创始人兼总裁凯蒂·克罗夫特·贝尔 (Katy Croft Bell) 表示：“我们希望使进入深海的途径民主化，让那些无法使用这些工具的人们能够提出更多新问题。”

paras.en: As a result of inaccessibility, little of Earth’s vast ocean has been mapped, particularly the deep sea. Bell’s organization is developing inexpensive technologies such as a hardy little camera and sensor system dubbed DORIS, for Deep Ocean Research and Imaging System. It can descend to 6,000 meters and costs less than $10,000.
paras.zh: 由于交通不便，地球上广阔的海洋，特别是深海，几乎没有被绘制出来。贝尔的组织正在开发廉价技术，例如用于深海研究和成像系统的耐用小型相机和传感器系统 DORIS。它可以下降到 6,000 米，成本不到 10,000 美元。

paras.en: Expedition: Saving Our Seas offers just a few scant minutes to each project before moving on around the globe to the next, so there’s no time to learn about each project in depth. But the overall takeaway of watching these vignettes, back to back, is that there is a young, energetic community of scientists taking on the challenge.
paras.zh: 探险：拯救我们的海洋在前往全球各地进行下一个项目之前，每个项目只提供了几分钟的时间，因此没有时间深入了解每个项目。但连续观看这些小插曲的总体收获是，有一个年轻、充满活力的科学家群体正在接受挑战。

paras.en: Mitigating climate change’s impacts on the oceans is, after all, a race against time. So it’s nice to think we might have all hands on deck.
paras.zh: 毕竟，减轻气候变化对海洋的影响是一场与时间的赛跑。因此，很高兴我们能够齐心协力。

articles.title: Huge Review of 361 Studies Suggests Eating Less Protein May Slow Down The Aging Process
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: Researchers often undertake reviews, which are studies of previous studies.
paras.zh: 研究人员经常进行回顾，即对先前研究的研究。

paras.en: By bringing together findings across different experiments, populations, and time periods, broader trends can often be identified.
paras.zh: 通过汇集不同实验、人群和时间段的发现，通常可以确定更广泛的趋势。

paras.en: Now, a comprehensive new review drawing on 361 scientific studies has found growing evidence that having less protein in a diet could slow down biological aging.
paras.zh: 现在，一项基于 361 项科学研究的综合性新综述发现，越来越多的证据表明，饮食中较少的蛋白质可以延缓生物衰老。

paras.en: The research, by molecular biologist Bailey Knopf and biomedical researcher Dudley Lamming from the University of Wisconsin-Madison, is published in Cell Press Blue.
paras.zh: 这项研究由威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的分子生物学家 Bailey Knopf 和生物医学研究员 Dudley Lamming 完成，发表在 Cell Press Blue 上。

paras.en: The review looks at protein's impact on metabolism and lifespan, as well as assessing some of the biological processes that might explain the links.
paras.zh: 该综述着眼于蛋白质对新陈代谢和寿命的影响，并评估了一些可能解释这些联系的生物过程。

paras.en: There is nuance to the story though, because a lot of previous research has shown that protein can be good for us.
paras.zh: 不过，这个故事有细微差别，因为之前的大量研究表明蛋白质对我们有好处。

paras.en: It's used to build and repair muscle, can help in weight management, and is also associated with healthy aging – particularly when it comes to maintaining muscle mass in later years.
paras.zh: 它用于构建和修复肌肉，有助于体重管理，并且还与健康衰老有关，尤其是在晚年维持肌肉质量方面。

paras.en: The researchers suggest that protein intake needs to be tailored to individuals, rather than reduced in every case.
paras.zh: 研究人员建议，蛋白质摄入量需要因人而异，而不是在每种情况下都减少。

paras.en: "Despite widespread recommendations for higher protein intake during aging, increasing evidence suggests that dietary protein restriction (PR) promotes metabolic health, healthspan, and lifespan across diverse organisms," write the researchers in their published paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在发表的论文中写道：“尽管人们普遍建议在衰老过程中增加蛋白质摄入量，但越来越多的证据表明，饮食蛋白质限制（PR）可以促进不同生物体的代谢健康、健康寿命和寿命。”

paras.en: "This review provides a comprehensive overview of current knowledge regarding the benefits of PR and amino acid restriction for healthy aging and highlights the therapeutic potential of interventions based on these diets to promote healthspan and longevity."
paras.zh: “这篇综述全面概述了有关 PR 和氨基酸限制对健康老龄化的益处的当前知识，并强调了基于这些饮食的干预措施在促进健康寿命和长寿方面的治疗潜力。”

paras.en: There's a lot to take in from the review – as you might expect from a review drawing on 361 references – but some of the findings highlighted by the authors include the signs of slower aging that have turned up in animals put on low-protein diets.
paras.zh: 这篇综述有很多值得借鉴的地方——正如你可能从一篇引用了 361 篇参考文献的综述中所期望的那样——但作者强调的一些发现包括在低蛋白饮食的动物中出现的衰老速度减慢的迹象。

paras.en: In human studies, there's been evidence that cutting down on protein in a diet can reduce some of the inflammation that speeds up biological aging, as well as helping to boost overall metabolic health.
paras.zh: 在人类研究中，有证据表明，减少饮食中的蛋白质摄入可以减少一些加速生物衰老的炎症，并有助于促进整体代谢健康。

paras.en: On the other hand, the researchers also point out the relationship between exercise and protein consumption, suggesting that more protein can be beneficial – for those who are regularly active and working their muscles.
paras.zh: 另一方面，研究人员还指出了运动和蛋白质消耗之间的关系，表明更多的蛋白质对于那些经常活动和锻炼肌肉的人来说是有益的。

paras.en: "It's absolutely crystal clear that there are benefits of protein to muscle growth and exercise response of active individuals," says Lamming.
paras.zh: “很明显，蛋白质对活跃个体的肌肉生长和运动反应有好处，”拉明说。

paras.en: "But because most people are relatively sedentary, many people are likely consuming more protein than they actually need, which probably has negative health consequences."
paras.zh: “但由于大多数人相对久坐，许多人摄入的蛋白质可能比他们实际需要的多，这可能会对健康产生负面影响。”

paras.en: The review also considers some of the potential explanations for the benefits of restricting dietary protein. They include shifting cell signaling to focus more on maintenance rather than growth, reducing the accumulation of senescent cells (waste cells that need to be removed), and boosting cellular energy production.
paras.zh: 该综述还考虑了限制膳食蛋白质益处的一些潜在解释。它们包括改变细胞信号转导更多地关注维持而不是生长、减少衰老细胞（需要清除的废细胞）的积累以及促进细胞能量产生。

paras.en: Some of the chemical changes that come from eating less protein include a greater abundance of the hormone fibroblast growth factor 21 (FGF21), the researchers note, while the review also highlights certain amino acids that may be connecting dietary protein to aging processes.
paras.zh: 研究人员指出，减少蛋白质摄入会产生一些化学变化，包括激素成纤维细胞生长因子 21 (FGF21) 的含量增加，同时该评论还强调了某些可能将膳食蛋白质与衰老过程联系起来的氨基酸。

paras.en: Ultimately, it may be that the types of protein we eat, and the combination of amino acids in it, matter as much as total intake.
paras.zh: 最终，我们吃的蛋白质类型以及其中氨基酸的组合可能与总摄入量一样重要。

paras.en: "These studies show that the amount of protein sedentary people are eating today may have negative health consequences, at least at the population level," says Lamming.
paras.zh: “这些研究表明，如今久坐不动的人摄入的蛋白质量可能对健康产生负面影响，至少在人群层面是如此。”Lamming说。

paras.en: Looking ahead, the researchers don't recommend a reduction in dietary protein across the board, but they do want to see a reassessment of how much protein we all need, especially in relation to age and exercise.
paras.zh: 展望未来，研究人员并不建议全面减少膳食蛋白质，但他们确实希望重新评估我们所有人需要多少蛋白质，特别是与年龄和锻炼有关的蛋白质。

paras.en: Studies of groups of people that analyze protein's effects on biological aging and metabolism could follow, and from there inform our understanding of how to best ensure we age as healthily as possible.
paras.zh: 随后可以对人群进行研究，分析蛋白质对生物衰老和新陈代谢的影响，并由此帮助我们了解如何最好地确保我们尽可能健康地衰老。

paras.en: "Recent recommendations have encouraged people to eat more protein, but they've also encouraged people to exercise more," says Lamming.
paras.zh: “最近的建议鼓励人们多吃蛋白质，但也鼓励人们多锻炼，”拉明说。

paras.en: "We probably need to personalize protein recommendations based not just on age, but also on how physically active people are."
paras.zh: “我们可能不仅需要根据年龄，还要根据人们的身体活动程度来个性化蛋白质推荐。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Cell Press Blue.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《Cell Press Blue》杂志上。

articles.title: A Wild Puma Was Caught on Camera Hunting in an Unexpected Place
articles.author: Michael Irving

paras.en: It's a familiar sight for cat owners: You come into the room only to find your furry friend has climbed up onto the dining table in search of food.
paras.zh: 对于猫主人来说，这是一个熟悉的景象：你走进房间却发现你毛茸茸的朋友已经爬上餐桌寻找食物。

paras.en: A similar thing has now been caught on camera traps in South America: A wild puma (Puma concolor) has been spotted way higher up in the rainforest canopy than they're usually thought to climb.
paras.zh: 南美洲的相机陷阱现在也捕捉到了类似的情况：在雨林树冠上发现了一只野生美洲狮（Puma concolor），其高度比人们通常认为的要高。

paras.en: The account is reported in a new preprint paper from a team led by the National Museum of Natural History in France.
paras.zh: 法国国家自然历史博物馆领导的团队在一份新的预印本论文中报道了这一说法。

paras.en: Most cat species can climb trees, but the bigger the cat, the more likely it is to prefer a ground-dwelling life.
paras.zh: 大多数猫科动物都可以爬树，但猫越大，它就越可能喜欢地面生活。

paras.en: Lions and tigers are stockily built, which is great for overpowering large prey animals on the ground, but it's not particularly conducive to climbing.
paras.zh: 狮子和老虎体格粗壮，非常适合在地面上制服大型猎物，但不太利于攀爬。

paras.en: That's not to say that they never do, but on the rare occasion that you might see a lion or tiger up a tree, they'll usually stick to the thick, lower branches that can support their weight.
paras.zh: 这并不是说它们从来不这样做，但在极少数情况下，你可能会看到狮子或老虎爬上树，它们通常会粘在可以支撑其重量的粗壮的较低树枝上。

paras.en: Leopards are the most prolific tree-climbers of the cat family, often stashing their kills up in the treetops to hide them from scavengers. Some evidence suggests they might sometimes hunt tree-dwelling prey while they're up there, but it's rarely documented.
paras.zh: 豹子是猫科动物中最擅长爬树的动物，它们经常将猎物藏在树顶，以躲避食腐动物。一些证据表明，它们有时可能会在树上捕食栖息在树上的猎物，但这很少有记录。

paras.en: "Questions thus arise about interactions between ground-dwelling top predators and their [canopy-dwelling] prey," the researchers write.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“因此，关于地面顶级捕食者和它们的[树冠]猎物之间相互作用的问题就出现了。”

paras.en: "Are the latter really safe from climbing large cats in the forest canopy? How high can top predators climb into the treetops?"
paras.zh: “后者在森林树冠上攀爬大型猫科动物真的安全吗？顶级掠食者能爬到树顶多高？”

paras.en: The researchers have now captured direct evidence of a puma taking hunting to new heights. The unsuspecting targets were kinkajous (Potos flavus) – nocturnal, arboreal mammals that are related to raccoons.
paras.zh: 研究人员现在已经捕获了美洲狮将狩猎提升到新高度的直接证据。毫无戒心的目标是金卡朱斯（Potos flavus）——与浣熊有亲缘关系的夜间活动的树栖哺乳动物。

paras.en: The intriguing scene was caught on a camera trap placed high in the crown of a nutmeg tree in the Saut Pararé forest in French Guiana. At a height of 33 meters (108 feet) above the ground, the camera was much higher than most wild cat species are usually seen.
paras.zh: 这一有趣的场景被法属圭亚那索帕拉雷森林中一棵肉豆蔻树树冠高处的相机陷阱捕捉到。相机距离地面 33 米（108 英尺）高，比通常看到的大多数野猫物种要高得多。

paras.en: Just before 8:30 pm on 24 September 2023, an adult female kinkajou wandered into view of the camera, with a juvenile by her side. The pair were only visible for around 10 seconds, before leaping above the camera and out of sight.
paras.zh: 2023 年 9 月 24 日晚上 8:30 之前，一只成年雌性金卡朱漫步进入镜头视野，旁边还有一名幼年金卡朱。这对情侣只出现了大约 10 秒，然后就跳到了摄像机上方，消失了。

paras.en: Around 20 minutes later, at 8:49 pm, a puma appears out of the darkness, stalking along the same branch. It stops to sniff a few spots where the kinkajous had been, and seems to be trying to pick up the trail – the predator spends the next 15 minutes prowling back and forth along the branch, and investigating the area.
paras.zh: 大约 20 分钟后，晚上 8 点 49 分，一只美洲狮从黑暗中出现，沿着同一条树枝跟踪。它停下来嗅了金卡雀曾经去过的几个地方，似乎是在试图寻找踪迹——捕食者在接下来的 15 分钟里沿着树枝来回徘徊，调查该地区。

paras.en: Finally, at 9:06 pm, the puma slinks back the way it came, and vanishes into the night.
paras.zh: 最后，晚上 9 点 06 分，美洲狮悄悄溜回原路，消失在夜色中。

paras.en: There's no way to know what happened next, since the ending of the story unfolded offscreen. But either way, a kinkajou watching this video back would surely feel the way we might if we saw security camera footage of an unknown intruder moving through our home in the middle of the night.
paras.zh: 没有办法知道接下来发生了什么，因为故事的结局是在银幕外展开的。但无论哪种方式，金卡朱人在观看这段视频时肯定会有与我们看到安全摄像头拍摄的未知入侵者在半夜穿过我们家的感觉一样的感觉。

paras.en: After all, it's thought that life in the treetops helps animals like this avoid the dangerous predators that hunt below.
paras.zh: 毕竟，人们认为树顶上的生活可以帮助这样的动物避开在下面捕猎的危险掠食者。

paras.en: If there is some relief to be found for the kinkajou population, it's that this was the only interaction between a cat and its potential prey captured on camera among almost 40,000 individual 'events' seen over a decade of observations.
paras.zh: 如果要为金卡朱种群找到一些缓解的话，那就是在十多年的观察中，近 40,000 个单独的“事件”中，这是相机捕捉到的猫与其潜在猎物之间唯一的互动。

paras.en: The goal of the camera trap project wasn't to see how high pumas and other cats can go – according to the researchers on the new paper, it was "to identify and quantify fruit-eating mammals and birds visiting fruiting nutmeg trees".
paras.zh: 相机陷阱项目的目标不是看看美洲狮和其他猫科动物能飞多高——根据新论文中的研究人员的说法，它是“识别和量化以水果为食的哺乳动物和鸟类访问肉豆蔻树的结果”。

paras.en: But no self-respecting scientist would turn down a bonus finding – especially an interaction as rare as this.
paras.zh: 但没有一个有自尊心的科学家会拒绝额外的发现——尤其是像这样罕见的相互作用。

paras.en: The research has not yet been peer-reviewed or published, but is currently available as a preprint on the bioRxiv server.
paras.zh: 该研究尚未经过同行评审或发表，但目前可在 bioRxiv 服务器上作为预印本。

articles.title: Some Ketogenic Diets May Increase Inflammation And Mitochondrial Stress
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: Not all ketogenic diets have the same effects. The kind of fats you eat could make a difference, according to new research in Science Advances.
paras.zh: 并非所有生酮饮食都有相同的效果。 The kind of fats you eat could make a difference, according to new research in Science Advances.

paras.en: The point of a ketogenic diet is to induce a state called ketosis, in which the body uses fat as its main fuel source.
paras.zh: 生酮饮食的目的是诱导一种称为酮症的状态，在这种状态下，身体使用脂肪作为主要燃料来源。

paras.en: That's why keto diets involve restricting carbohydrates. Ketosis happens when the body is short on glucose.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么生酮饮食需要限制碳水化合物。当身体缺乏葡萄糖时就会发生酮症。

paras.en: While keto diets are probably best-known as a strategy for weight loss, they were originally designed to treat epilepsy.
paras.zh: 虽然生酮饮食可能是最著名的减肥策略，但它们最初是为了治疗癫痫而设计的。

paras.en: Scientists are interested in what other therapeutic applications there might be for keto diets, but that requires a much more detailed understanding of how they work.
paras.zh: 科学家们对生酮饮食可能有哪些其他治疗应用感兴趣，但这需要更详细地了解它们的工作原理。

paras.en: "Our previous studies have found that all ketogenic diets are not the same, with different fats causing different metabolic changes," says physician-scientist David Gius, director of the University of Cincinnati Cancer Center.
paras.zh: “我们之前的研究发现，所有生酮饮食都不相同，不同的脂肪会导致不同的代谢变化，”辛辛那提大学癌症中心主任、医师科学家大卫·吉乌斯说。

paras.en: "We followed the research data while studying a different aspect of ketogenic diets and found something unexpected."
paras.zh: “我们在研究生酮饮食的不同方面时跟踪了研究数据，发现了一些意想不到的东西。”

paras.en: Their results, which are based on mouse experiments, suggest that diets with higher levels of long-chain saturated fatty acids trigger mitochondrial stress, leading to increased inflammation.
paras.zh: 他们基于小鼠实验的结果表明，长链饱和脂肪酸含量较高的饮食会引发线粒体应激，导致炎症加剧。

paras.en: Mice were fed either a keto diet featuring Crisco (a palm oil-based shortening with about 26 percent long-chain saturated fatty acids), a keto diet featuring coconut oil (similar to Crisco in fat content, but with only 12 percent long-chain saturated fatty acids), or a regular diet, for comparison.
paras.zh: 小鼠被喂食以 Crisco（一种以棕榈油为基础的起酥油，含有约 26% 长链饱和脂肪酸）的酮类饮食、以椰子油（与 Crisco 脂肪含量相似，但仅含有 12% 长链饱和脂肪酸）为特色的酮类饮食，或常规饮食，以进行比较。

paras.en: After 21 days on these diets, the Crisco mice accumulated much higher levels of proinflammatory macrophages (specialized white blood cells that fight pathogens) in their hearts, kidneys, livers, brains, and white fat.
paras.zh: 采用这些饮食 21 天后，Crisco 小鼠的心脏、肾脏、肝脏、大脑和白色脂肪中积累了更高水平的促炎巨噬细胞（对抗病原体的特殊白细胞）。

paras.en: The coconut oil keto diet, on the other hand, didn't have that effect: those mice had levels of proinflammatory markers more similar to those fed a normal diet.
paras.zh: 另一方面，椰子油酮饮食没有这种效果：这些小鼠的促炎标记物水平与正常饮食的小鼠更相似。

paras.en: "Our findings suggest that the proinflammatory effects of long-chain saturated fatty acids may emerge only beyond a critical threshold of exposure," the authors write.
paras.zh: 作者写道：“我们的研究结果表明，长链饱和脂肪酸的促炎作用可能只有在超过临界暴露阈值时才会出现。”

paras.en: "Although the keto diet used in this study is relatively low in long-chain saturated fatty acids compared with commonly used lard- or cocoa butter-based formulations, it nonetheless induces macrophage accumulation and
paras.zh: “尽管与常用的基于猪油或可可脂的配方相比，本研究中使用的酮饮食的长链饱和脂肪酸含量相对较低，但它仍然会诱导巨噬细胞积累和

paras.en: These small differences could explain why ketogenic diets can produce both pro- and anti-inflammatory effects.
paras.zh: 这些微小的差异可以解释为什么生酮饮食可以产生促炎和抗炎作用。

paras.en: The inflammatory effects seem to be triggered by signals of mitochondrial stress and immune cell activation.
paras.zh: 炎症反应似乎是由线粒体应激和免疫细胞激活信号引发的。

paras.en: "Our data suggest that the proinflammatory consequences of ketogenic diets are not intrinsic to ketone metabolism, which has been shown to have anti-inflammatory effects, but are instead shaped by diet composition, fatty acid availability, and potentially cell type-specific responses," the authors add.
paras.zh: 作者补充道：“我们的数据表明，生酮饮食的促炎后果并不是酮代谢所固有的，酮代谢已被证明具有抗炎作用，而是由饮食成分、脂肪酸可用性和潜在的细胞类型特异性反应决定的。”

paras.en: They're curious about whether ketogenic diets could be tailored to alter the microenvironments of tumors, and potentially improve the outcomes of cancer immunotherapy.
paras.zh: 他们很好奇生酮饮食是否可以改变肿瘤的微环境，并有可能改善癌症免疫治疗的结果。

paras.en: But it's a controversial area of research, still in the exploratory phase.
paras.zh: 但这是一个有争议的研究领域，仍处于探索阶段。

paras.en: At present, the limited evidence comes mainly from animal studies like this one, which means it's unclear if the effects of keto diets could actually help humans undergoing cancer treatment.
paras.zh: 目前，有限的证据主要来自像这样的动物研究，这意味着尚不清楚生酮饮食的效果是否真的可以帮助人类接受癌症治疗。

paras.en: Just because things work a certain way in mice doesn't necessarily mean the same goes for humans.
paras.zh: 仅仅因为老鼠身上的事情以某种方式运作，并不一定意味着人类也同样如此。

paras.en: A large systematic review conducted in 2021 found no evidence that a ketogenic diet made a difference for cancer patients, in terms of either anti-tumor effects or overall survival.
paras.zh: 2021 年进行的一项大型系统回顾发现，没有证据表明生酮饮食对癌症患者的抗肿瘤作用或总体生存率有影响。

paras.en: Scientists have begun a clinical trial at the University of Texas Health Science Center to investigate further, which will also open at the University of Cincinnati soon.
paras.zh: 科学家们已在德克萨斯大学健康科学中心开始进行进一步研究的临床试验，该试验也将很快在辛辛那提大学开放。

paras.en: The research has been published in Science Advances.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《科学进展》上。

articles.title: Stopping statins after 70 may be safer than expected, but there's a catch

paras.en: Stopping statins after 70 may be safer than expected, but there's a catch
paras.zh: 70 岁后停止服用他汀类药物可能比预期更安全，但有一个问题

paras.en: - A major study of nearly 1,900 older adults suggests that stopping statins after age 70 may be relatively safe in the short term for people who have never experienced a heart attack or stroke. However, a higher rate of serious cardiovascular events or death during longer follow-up raises questions about the risks of discontinuing these widely prescribed medications.
paras.zh: - 一项针对近 1,900 名老年人的大型研究表明，对于从未经历过心脏病发作或中风的人来说，70 岁后停止服用他汀类药物在短期内可能相对安全。然而，在较长的随访期间，严重心血管事件或死亡的发生率较高，引发了人们对停止使用这些广泛处方药物的风险的疑问。

paras.en: A major new study suggests that many adults age 70 and older who have never experienced a heart attack or stroke may be able to stop taking statins without substantially increasing their short-term cardiovascular risks. However, the findings also point to a possible increase in risk over a longer period, making the decision more complicated than it initially appears.
paras.zh: 一项重要的新研究表明，许多从未经历过心脏病或中风的 70 岁及以上成年人可以停止服用他汀类药物，而不会显着增加短期心血管风险。然而，研究结果还表明，随着时间的推移，风险可能会增加，从而使决策比最初看起来更加复杂。

paras.en: The independent, preliminary research was presented at the American Heart Association's Scientific Sessions 2026, held November 6 through 9 in Chicago. The annual conference brings together cardiovascular researchers and healthcare professionals from around the world to share scientific discoveries, emerging evidence, and advances in clinical care.
paras.zh: 这项独立的初步研究已在 11 月 6 日至 9 日在芝加哥举行的美国心脏协会 2026 年科学会议上发表。该年度会议汇集了来自世界各地的心血管研究人员和医疗保健专业人员，分享科学发现、新证据和临床护理方面的进展。

paras.en: An estimated 25% of American adults have elevated levels of low-density lipoprotein-cholesterol (LDL-C), commonly called "bad cholesterol." When too much LDL cholesterol accumulates in the arteries, it can restrict blood flow and contribute to heart attacks and strokes. Statins are widely prescribed to lower cholesterol and reduce these risks, including in people who have never experienced a cardiovascular event. This preventive approach remains a central part of the American Heart Association's 2026 joint guideline on dyslipidemia.
paras.zh: 据估计，25% 的美国成年人的低密度脂蛋白胆固醇 (LDL-C) 水平升高，通常称为“坏胆固醇”。当过多的低密度脂蛋白胆固醇在动脉中积聚时，它会限制血液流动并导致心脏病和中风。他汀类药物被广泛用于降低胆固醇和降低这些风险，包括从未经历过心血管事件的人。这种预防方法仍然是美国心脏协会 2026 年血脂异常联合指南的核心部分。

paras.en: Do Older Adults Need to Keep Taking Statins?
paras.zh: 老年人需要继续服用他汀类药物吗？

paras.en: Although statins are an established treatment for reducing cardiovascular risk, questions remain about how much benefit they provide when people reach their 70s and beyond, particularly if they have never had a heart attack or stroke.
paras.zh: 尽管他汀类药物是一种降低心血管风险的既定治疗方法，但当人们到了 70 岁及以上时，尤其是如果他们从未患过心脏病或中风，他汀类药物能带来多少益处仍然存在疑问。

paras.en: "While the Association's recent joint guideline recommends lifestyle and potentially medication for people with high LDL-C at younger ages to reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke, recent studies question the health benefits of continuing statins in the later decades of life," said study author Rita F. Redberg, M.D., M.Sc., FAHA, professor of cardiology and the Araxe Vilensky Endowed Chair in Cardiology at the University of California, San Francisco School of Medicine. "A few previous studies assessed the safety of discontinuing statins for primary prevention at age 70 and later, and they found no difference in mortality. One study suggested quality of life improvements after stopping statins. Whether it is safe to discontinue statins to prevent a first CVD event in the elderly remained unclear and the question we explored in our study."
paras.zh: 研究作者、加州大学旧金山分校医学院心脏病学教授、心脏病学教授、Araxe Vilensky 心脏病学主席 Rita F. Redberg（医学博士、理学硕士、FAHA）表示：“虽然该协会最近的联合指南建议年轻时高 LDL-C 患者的生活方式和可能的药物治疗，以降低心脏病发作和中风的风险，但最近的研究质疑在生命的后几十年继续服用他汀类药物对健康的益处。” “之前的一些研究评估了 70 岁及以后停用他汀类药物进行一级预防的安全性，他们发现死亡率没有差异。一项研究表明，停用他汀类药物后生活质量会有所改善。停用他汀类药物以预防老年人首次 CVD 事件是否安全仍不清楚，这也是我们在研究中探讨的问题。”

paras.en: To investigate, researchers enrolled nearly 1,900 adults aged 70 and older who were taking statins specifically to prevent a first cardiovascular event. Every participant also had at least two chronic medical conditions, such as a history of cancer or lung disease.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，研究人员招募了近 1,900 名 70 岁及以上的成年人，他们专门服用他汀类药物来预防首次心血管事件。每个参与者还至少患有两种慢性疾病，例如癌症或肺部疾病史。

paras.en: Participants were divided into two groups. One group stopped taking statins, while the other continued their prescribed treatment. Researchers tracked their health for approximately two years, with additional follow-up extending as long as four years. They examined rates of heart attack, stroke, and death, along with changes in quality of life, muscle pain, falls, and muscle wasting (known as sarcopenia).
paras.zh: 参与者被分为两组。一组停止服用他汀类药物，而另一组继续接受处方治疗。研究人员对他们的健康状况进行了大约两年的跟踪，并进行了长达四年的额外随访。他们检查了心脏病发作、中风和死亡的发生率，以及生活质量的变化、肌肉疼痛、跌倒和肌肉萎缩（称为肌肉减少症）。

paras.en: What Happened When Older Adults Stopped Statins?
paras.zh: 当老年人停止服用他汀类药物时会发生什么？

paras.en: The initial findings were largely reassuring. After approximately two years, participants who stopped taking statins did not experience a statistically significant increase in heart attacks, strokes, or deaths compared with those who remained on the medications.
paras.zh: 初步调查结果在很大程度上令人放心。大约两年后，与继续服用他汀类药物的参与者相比，停止服用他汀类药物的参与者心脏病发作、中风或死亡并未出现统计上显着的增加。

paras.en: Stopping treatment also did not produce measurable improvements in the other outcomes researchers examined. Quality of life, muscle discomfort, falls, and muscle wasting were similar in both groups.
paras.zh: 停止治疗也没有对研究人员检查的其他结果产生可测量的改善。两组的生活质量、肌肉不适、跌倒和肌肉萎缩相似。

paras.en: There was, however, a small difference in cardiovascular outcomes. Over the first two years, the results indicated approximately one additional cardiovascular event for every 40 people who discontinued statins compared with those who continued treatment.
paras.zh: 然而，心血管结局存在微小差异。结果表明，在头两年中，与继续治疗的患者相比，停用他汀类药物的患者中大约每 40 人会增加 1 例心血管事件。

paras.en: The longer follow-up revealed a more concerning pattern. Over a period of up to four years, 12.7% of participants who stopped statins experienced a heart attack, stroke, or death, compared with 9.2% of those who kept taking the medications.
paras.zh: 更长的随访揭示了更令人担忧的模式。在长达四年的时间里，停止服用他汀类药物的参与者中有 12.7% 经历了心脏病、中风或死亡，而继续服用药物的参与者中这一比例为 9.2%。

paras.en: Longer Follow-Up Reveals a Potential Risk
paras.zh: 更长时间的随访揭示了潜在的风险

paras.en: Redberg explained that the higher rate of serious outcomes during the four-year follow-up represents a new finding in research on statin discontinuation among older adults. She suggested that the difference may have emerged because this trial included more participants and tracked them for a longer period than earlier studies.
paras.zh: 雷德伯格解释说，四年随访期间严重后果的发生率较高，代表了老年人停用他汀类药物的研究的新发现。她认为，这种差异的出现可能是因为这项试验比早期的研究纳入了更多的参与者，并且跟踪他们的时间更长。

paras.en: These results complicate the question of whether older adults should continue cholesterol treatment indefinitely. While the findings suggest that stopping statins may be a reasonable option for many people in this age group, they also indicate that remaining on treatment could offer some protection over time.
paras.zh: 这些结果使老年人是否应该无限期地继续胆固醇治疗的问题变得更加复杂。虽然研究结果表明，对于这个年龄段的许多人来说，停止服用他汀类药物可能是一个合理的选择，但他们也表明，随着时间的推移，继续治疗可以提供一些保护。

paras.en: "This small, increased risk of cardiovascular events means that one cannot make a general recommendation about stopping statins in this patient population," she said. "There should be shared decision-making between the patient and the healthcare professional to know if it is appropriate for an individual to discontinue the medication. In general, however, discontinuation is safe for most people who are in this age group and without a previous CVD event."
paras.zh: 她说：“心血管事件的这种小而增加的风险意味着我们无法就这一患者群体停止服用他汀类药物提出一般性建议。” “患者和医疗保健专业人士应该共同做出决定，以了解个人是否适合停止用药。不过，一般来说，对于这个年龄段且以前没有心血管疾病事件的大多数人来说，停药是安全的。”

paras.en: The trial involved 1,880 participants aged 70 and older (average age of 77; 53% men, and 47% women), all of whom had at least two chronic health conditions. Individuals with established cardiovascular disease or a previous cardiovascular event were not eligible to participate.
paras.zh: 该试验涉及 1,880 名 70 岁及以上的参与者（平均年龄 77 岁；53% 为男性，47% 为女性），他们都患有至少两种慢性疾病。患有已确诊的心血管疾病或既往发生过心血管事件的个人没有资格参加。

paras.en: Researchers conducted the study between November 2021 and April 2026 across 24 medical centers in Switzerland, France, and the Netherlands. Of the participants, 938 were assigned to discontinue statins, while 942 were assigned to continue taking their medications.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 2021 年 11 月至 2026 年 4 月期间在瑞士、法国和荷兰的 24 个医疗中心进行了这项研究。在参与者中，938 名被分配停止服用他汀类药物，而 942 名被分配继续服用药物。

paras.en: Throughout the trial and subsequent follow-up, researchers recorded heart attacks, acute ischemic strokes, and deaths from any cause. Participants also completed surveys assessing their overall quality of life, muscle pain, falls, and sarcopenia.
paras.zh: 在整个试验和随后的随访过程中，研究人员记录了心脏病发作、急性缺血性中风和任何原因造成的死亡。参与者还完成了评估他们的整体生活质量、肌肉疼痛、跌倒和肌肉减少症的调查。

paras.en: One limitation was that some participants did not remain in their originally assigned groups. Some people instructed to stop statins eventually resumed treatment, while others assigned to continue taking statins stopped using them. Altogether, approximately 14% of participants switched from their assigned treatment approach during the study.
paras.zh: 一个限制是一些参与者没有留在最初分配的组中。一些被指示停止服用他汀类药物的人最终恢复了治疗，而其他被指定继续服用他汀类药物的人则停止了使用。总共约有 14% 的参与者在研究期间改变了指定的治疗方法。

paras.en: To determine whether these changes affected the findings, the researchers performed several additional statistical analyses. The results remained unchanged.
paras.zh: 为了确定这些变化是否影响了研究结果，研究人员进行了几项额外的统计分析。结果保持不变。

paras.en: Taken together, the findings suggest that discontinuing statins may be an option for many adults over 70 who have not previously experienced cardiovascular disease, especially when considering outcomes over the first two years. However, the higher rate of heart attacks, strokes, and deaths during longer follow-up underscores why stopping treatment should be an individualized decision made with a healthcare professional rather than a general recommendation for all older adults.
paras.zh: 总而言之，研究结果表明，对于许多 70 岁以上、以前没有患过心血管疾病的成年人来说，停用他汀类药物可能是一种选择，特别是考虑到前两年的结果时。然而，在较长的随访期间心脏病发作、中风和死亡的发生率较高，这凸显了为什么停止治疗应该是与医疗保健专业人员一起做出的个体化决定，而不是对所有老年人的普遍建议。

paras.en: Materials provided by American Heart Association. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由美国心脏协会提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Study of 750,000 pregnancies reveals a surprising twist about Ozempic and Wegovy

paras.en: Study of 750,000 pregnancies reveals a surprising twist about Ozempic and Wegovy
paras.zh: 对 750,000 例怀孕的研究揭示了 Ozempic 和 Wegovy 的惊人变化

paras.en: - European Society of Human Reproduction and Embryology
paras.zh: - 欧洲人类生殖和胚胎学学会

paras.en: - A study of more than 750,000 pregnancies found that early exposure to Ozempic, Wegovy, and similar drugs was not linked to increased pregnancy complications when used for weight loss, but was associated with a higher risk of premature birth when prescribed for diabetes. The surprising difference suggests that diabetes itself may be driving the risk, although researchers caution that the drugs' safety during pregnancy remains uncertain.
paras.zh: - 一项针对超过 750,000 名孕妇的研究发现，早期接触 Ozempic、Wegovy 和类似药物用于减肥时不会增加妊娠并发症，但用于治疗糖尿病时会增加早产风险。这种令人惊讶的差异表明，糖尿病本身可能会导致这种风险，尽管研究人员警告说，这些药物在怀孕期间的安全性仍不确定。

paras.en: A major study involving more than 750,000 pregnancies has uncovered an important difference in the potential pregnancy risks of popular weight loss medications such as Ozempic and Wegovy. Women who unintentionally used these drugs shortly before or during early pregnancy were more likely to give birth prematurely, but only when the medications had been prescribed to treat existing diabetes.
paras.zh: 一项涉及超过 750,000 名孕妇的大型研究发现，Ozempic 和 Wegovy 等流行减肥药物的潜在怀孕风险存在重要差异。在怀孕前不久或怀孕早期无意中使用这些药物的女性更有可能早产，但前提是这些药物是用来治疗现有糖尿病的。

paras.en: Among women taking the same medications for weight management, researchers found no significant association with premature birth or other pregnancy complications examined in the study.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，在服用相同体重管理药物的女性中，与早产或其他妊娠并发症没有显着关联。

paras.en: The findings suggest that diabetes itself, rather than the medications, may be responsible for the increased risk of early delivery. The research was published in Human Reproduction Open, a leading journal in reproductive medicine.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，糖尿病本身，而不是药物，可能是导致早产风险增加的原因。该研究发表在生殖医学领先期刊《Human Reduction Open》上。

paras.en: The medications examined included semaglutide (brand names: Ozempic, Wegovy) and liraglutide (Saxenda). Both belong to a widely used group of drugs known as GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs). Originally developed to manage type 2 diabetes, these medications also suppress appetite, making them effective treatments for weight loss. However, their safety during pregnancy has not been established.
paras.zh: 检查的药物包括索马鲁肽（商品名：Ozempic、Wegovy）和利拉鲁肽（Saxenda）。两者都属于广泛使用的一组药物，称为 GLP-1 受体激动剂 (GLP-1 RA)。这些药物最初是为了治疗 2 型糖尿病而开发的，它们还能抑制食欲，从而成为减肥的有效疗法。然而，它们在怀孕期间的安全性尚未确定。

paras.en: Why Ozempic and Similar Drugs Raise Pregnancy Concerns
paras.zh: 为什么 Ozempic 和类似药物会引起怀孕问题

paras.en: Professor Henriette Svarre Nielsen, who led the research at the Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics at Copenhagen University Hospital Hvidovre in Hvidovre, Denmark, explained that the rapid rise in GLP-1 prescriptions has created an urgent need for better information about pregnancy exposure.
paras.zh: 丹麦 Hvidovre 哥本哈根大学医院 Hvidovre 妇产科领导这项研究的 Henriette Svarre Nielsen 教授解释说，GLP-1 处方的迅速增加迫切需要更好的有关妊娠暴露的信息。

paras.en: "GLP-1 RA treatment has, within the last few years, become the medication with the sharpest increase in prescriptions worldwide. Current guidance suggests the treatment should be stopped eight weeks prior to planning a pregnancy. However, this is based on early-phase model organism studies, and not real-world evidence. Nonetheless, because of its widespread adoption, inadvertent exposure in early pregnancy is inevitable, and there is hardly any evidence to guide clinical counseling when it happens."
paras.zh: “在过去的几年里，GLP-1 RA 治疗已成为全球处方量增长最快的药物。目前的指南建议，应在计划怀孕前八周停止治疗。然而，这是基于早期模型生物研究，而不是现实世界的证据。尽管如此，由于其广泛采用，妊娠早期的无意接触是不可避免的，而且几乎没有任何证据可以在发生这种情况时指导临床咨询。”

paras.en: To investigate these concerns, researchers examined whether accidental exposure to GLP-1 medications around conception was associated with complications during pregnancy. They focused on preterm birth (birth before 37 weeks), pre-eclampsia, gestational diabetes, delivering a baby that was unusually large for its gestational age, stillbirth, and placental problems.
paras.zh: 为了调查这些问题，研究人员检查了受孕前后意外接触 GLP-1 药物是否与怀孕期间的并发症有关。他们重点关注早产（37周前出生）、先兆子痫、妊娠糖尿病、所产婴儿相对于胎龄来说异常大、死产和胎盘问题。

paras.en: Study Examines More Than 750,000 Pregnancies
paras.zh: 研究检查了超过 750,000 例怀孕情况

paras.en: The research team used Denmark's nationwide health registries to examine 756,636 pregnancies involving a single baby among 480,231 women. All pregnancies resulted in deliveries between October 1, 2009, and December 31, 2023.
paras.zh: 研究小组利用丹麦全国健康登记处对 480,231 名女性中的 756,636 次怀孕进行了检查，其中涉及单胎。所有怀孕均在2009年10月1日至2023年12月31日期间分娩。

paras.en: The researchers classified a pregnancy as having possible accidental exposure to GLP-1 medications if the woman filled a prescription for semaglutide or liraglutide during the eight weeks before or after the first day of her last menstrual period.
paras.zh: 如果妇女在末次月经第一天之前或之后的八周内服用索马鲁肽或利拉鲁肽处方，研究人员将怀孕归类为可能意外接触 GLP-1 药物。

paras.en: This 16-week period included the time when a woman might not yet realize she was pregnant, as well as the early stages of fetal development when major organs begin to form.
paras.zh: 这 16 周的时期包括女性可能尚未意识到自己怀孕的时期，以及主要器官开始形成的胎儿发育早期阶段。

paras.en: Of the pregnancies included in the study, 529 involved prescription records indicating exposure to GLP-1 medications during this period.
paras.zh: 在该研究纳入的怀孕中，有 529 例涉及处方记录，表明在此期间接触过 GLP-1 药物。

paras.en: To make the comparisons more reliable, the researchers accounted for several characteristics that could influence pregnancy outcomes. These included maternal age, body mass index (BMI), smoking habits, location, education, and whether the woman already had diabetes. They also considered the month and year of pregnancy to account for possible seasonal patterns and changes over time.
paras.zh: 为了使比较更加可靠，研究人员考虑了几个可能影响妊娠结局的特征。这些因素包括母亲年龄、体重指数（BMI）、吸烟习惯、地点、教育程度以及女性是否患有糖尿病。他们还考虑了怀孕的月份和年份，以解释可能的季节性模式和随时间的变化。

paras.en: Diabetes May Be the Key to Premature Birth Risk
paras.zh: 糖尿病可能是早产风险的关键

paras.en: The results revealed a striking distinction between women prescribed GLP-1 drugs for diabetes and those using them for weight loss.
paras.zh: 结果显示，服用 GLP-1 药物治疗糖尿病的女性与使用这些药物减肥的女性之间存在显着差异。

paras.en: Dr. Kathrine Hviid, the study's first author and a PhD student in the same department, said the findings could help shape future research and improve medical guidance for women who unknowingly use these drugs during early pregnancy.
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者、同一系的博士生 Kathrine Hviid 博士表示，这些发现可能有助于塑造未来的研究，并改善对怀孕早期不知不觉地使用这些药物的女性的医疗指导。

paras.en: "We made some extremely important findings that have implications for future studies, such as randomized controlled trials of GLP-1 RA usage in pregnancy, and for clinical counseling.
paras.zh: “我们取得了一些极其重要的发现，这些发现对未来的研究具有影响，例如 GLP-1 RA 在妊娠中使用的随机对照试验以及临床咨询。

paras.en: "We found that these medications were associated with an increased risk of preterm birth, but the risk was only present when the medication was used for diabetes treatment, and not for weight management. This suggests that the underlying condition of diabetes, rather than the medication, may be driving this association."
paras.zh: “我们发现这些药物与早产风险增加有关，但只有当药物用于糖尿病治疗而不是用于体重管理时，才会存在这种风险。这表明糖尿病的潜在状况，而不是药物，可能推动了这种关联。”

paras.en: At first, women with GLP-1 prescriptions appeared to experience several pregnancy complications more frequently than those without exposure. However, most of these associations were no longer statistically significant once the researchers accounted for other factors that could affect pregnancy outcomes.
paras.zh: 起初，服用 GLP-1 处方的女性似乎比未服用 GLP-1 的女性更容易出现多种妊娠并发症。然而，一旦研究人员考虑到可能影响妊娠结局的其他因素，大多数这些关联就不再具有统计学意义。

paras.en: The remaining significant association involved premature birth among women who had been prescribed liraglutide or semaglutide to manage diabetes.
paras.zh: 其余的显着关联涉及服用利拉鲁肽或索马鲁肽来控制糖尿病的女性的早产。

paras.en: Compared with women who had not been exposed to these medications, the adjusted odds of premature delivery were 70% higher among women taking liraglutide for diabetes and 84% higher among those taking semaglutide for diabetes.
paras.zh: 与未接触过这些药物的女性相比，服用利拉鲁肽治疗糖尿病的女性早产调整后的几率高出 70%，而服用索马鲁肽治疗糖尿病的女性则高出 84%。

paras.en: The researchers' accompanying announcement also reported estimated increases of approximately 11% for semaglutide and 9% for liraglutide among women with pre-existing diabetes.
paras.zh: 研究人员在随附的公告中还报告称，在患有糖尿病的女性中，索马鲁肽和利拉鲁肽的估计增加了约 11% 和 9%。

paras.en: Crucially, the same elevated risk of premature birth was not observed when the medications were prescribed specifically for weight management.
paras.zh: 至关重要的是，当专门为体重管理开处方药物时，没有观察到相同的早产风险升高。

paras.en: This difference suggests that the underlying medical condition may play a larger role in pregnancy outcomes than exposure to the medications themselves.
paras.zh: 这种差异表明，潜在的医疗状况对妊娠结局的影响可能比药物本身的影响更大。

paras.en: What the Findings Mean for Women Taking GLP-1 Drugs
paras.zh: 研究结果对服用 GLP-1 药物的女性意味着什么

paras.en: According to Professor Nielsen, future investigations must distinguish between women taking GLP-1 medications for diabetes and those using them for weight control. Combining these groups could obscure important differences in their underlying health and pregnancy risks.
paras.zh: Nielsen 教授表示，未来的研究必须区分服用 GLP-1 药物治疗糖尿病的女性和使用这些药物控制体重的女性。将这些群体结合起来可能会掩盖其潜在健康和怀孕风险的重要差异。

paras.en: "Future studies must take account of the reason a woman has been prescribed these medications, as the risks differ between women using GLP-1 RAs for diabetes versus weight management. This is one of the first studies to examine GLP-1 RA exposure in early pregnancy according to the reason for prescription. As more evidence accumulates, these findings will guide clinical counseling for women inadvertently exposed to GLP-1 RAs in early pregnancy. In Denmark, about 70% of people who use weight loss medications are women and so it is inevitable that some may take it without realizing they are pregnant."
paras.zh: “未来的研究必须考虑到女性服用这些药物的原因，因为使用 GLP-1 RA 治疗糖尿病的女性与体重管理的女性之间的风险不同。这是根据处方原因检查妊娠早期 GLP-1 RA 暴露的首批研究之一。随着更多证据的积累，这些发现将指导针对妊娠早期无意中接触 GLP-1 RA 的女性的临床咨询。在丹麦，大约 70% 使用减肥药物的人是女性，因此不可避免的是，有些人可能会在没有意识到自己怀孕的情况下服用它。”

paras.en: Although the results provide useful new information, Nielsen emphasized that additional research is necessary before changing existing medical recommendations.
paras.zh: 尽管结果提供了有用的新信息，但尼尔森强调，在改变现有的医疗建议之前，还需要进行更多的研究。

paras.en: In particular, the findings do not justify abandoning current guidance to discontinue GLP-1 medications before a planned pregnancy. They also do not provide enough evidence to establish new clinical counseling recommendations based on why the drugs were prescribed.
paras.zh: 特别是，研究结果并不能证明放弃当前在计划怀孕前停止使用 GLP-1 药物的指导是合理的。他们也没有提供足够的证据来根据开药原因建立新的临床咨询建议。

paras.en: Important Limitations of the Pregnancy Study
paras.zh: 妊娠研究的重要局限性

paras.en: One of the investigation's greatest strengths was its size, with health records covering more than three-quarters of a million pregnancies.
paras.zh: 该调查的最大优势之一是其规模，健康记录涵盖了百万怀孕中的四分之三以上。

paras.en: However, the study was observational, meaning it could identify associations but could not determine whether GLP-1 medications directly caused premature births. Other factors, including the effects of diabetes itself, may help explain the results.
paras.zh: 然而，该研究是观察性的，这意味着它可以识别关联，但无法确定 GLP-1 药物是否直接导致早产。其他因素，包括糖尿病本身的影响，可能有助于解释这些结果。

paras.en: Another limitation was that the researchers relied on prescription records. Although they could determine whether a woman had filled a prescription, they could not confirm whether she had actually taken the medication.
paras.zh: 另一个限制是研究人员依赖处方记录。虽然他们可以确定一名妇女是否按处方配药，但无法确认她是否确实服用了药物。

paras.en: The researchers nevertheless believe that most women who purchased the drugs were likely to have used them because of their substantial cost.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，研究人员认为，由于价格昂贵，大多数购买这些药物的女性可能会使用它们。

paras.en: In Denmark, patients generally contribute toward the cost of GLP-1 injections, although government subsidies are available for diabetes treatment. For example, a 1mg injection of Wegovy or Ozempic (semaglutide) costs approximately €180 and €114, respectively, with the diabetes subsidy reflected in the lower price.
paras.zh: 在丹麦，尽管政府为糖尿病治疗提供补贴，但患者通常需要支付 GLP-1 注射费用。例如，注射 1 毫克 Wegovy 或 Ozempic（索马鲁肽）的费用分别约为 180 欧元和 114 欧元，糖尿病补贴反映在较低的价格中。

paras.en: Dr. Hviid said: "Because of the high cost, we assume that compliance is very high among the women prescribed GLP-1 RAs."
paras.zh: Hviid 博士说：“由于成本高昂，我们认为女性服用 GLP-1 RA 的依从性非常高。”

paras.en: Experts Call for More Individualized Pregnancy Guidance
paras.zh: 专家呼吁更加个性化的怀孕指导

paras.en: The findings also attracted attention from researchers outside Denmark.
paras.zh: 该发现也引起了丹麦以外研究人员的关注。

paras.en: In an invited commentary published alongside the study, Drs. Yeyi Zhu and Monique Hedderson of Kaiser Permanente Northern California and the Center for Upstream Prevention of Adiposity and Diabetes Mellitus in Pleasanton, California, described the results as important additions to the growing research on GLP-1 medications and reproductive health.
paras.zh: 在与该研究一起发表的受邀评论中，博士。北加州 Kaiser Permanente 和加州普莱森顿肥胖和糖尿病上游预防中心的 Yeyi Zhu 和 Monique Hedderson 将这些结果描述为对 GLP-1 药物和生殖健康不断发展的研究的重要补充。

paras.en: They wrote that the findings "complement and extend an emerging evidence base on the reproductive safety of GLP-1 RAs."
paras.zh: 他们写道，这些发现“补充并扩展了关于 GLP-1 RA 生殖安全性的新兴证据基础”。

paras.en: The researchers also emphasized that the distinction between diabetes treatment and weight management could help doctors provide more personalized advice to women who accidentally used these medications around conception.
paras.zh: 研究人员还强调，糖尿病治疗和体重管理之间的区别可以帮助医生为在怀孕期间意外使用这些药物的女性提供更个性化的建议。

paras.en: "For clinicians, the study by Hviid et al. (2026) may inform preconception and early pregnancy counseling. The observation that elevated preterm birth risk was confined to women treated for diabetes, and not to those using GLP-1 receptor agonists for weight management, supports more balanced, individualized discussions with patients who may have experienced inadvertent periconceptional exposure. For patients with diabetes, the study reinforces the importance of recognizing diabetes as an important risk factor for obstetric complications and prioritizing metabolic health and glycemic management before and during pregnancy."
paras.zh: “对于临床医生来说，Hviid 等人 (2026) 的研究可能为孕前和早期妊娠咨询提供信息。观察结果表明，早产风险升高仅限于接受糖尿病治疗的女性，而不是那些使用 GLP-1 受体激动剂进行体重管理的女性，这支持与可能经历过无意的围孕期暴露的患者进行更平衡、个性化的讨论。对于糖尿病患者来说，该研究强调了认识到糖尿病是产科并发症的重要危险因素并优先考虑代谢的重要性。怀孕前和怀孕期间的健康和血糖管理。”

paras.en: Ultimately, the study highlights why a woman's underlying health conditions matter when evaluating the potential pregnancy risks of GLP-1 medications. While the findings offer some reassurance regarding accidental exposure among women using these drugs for weight loss, they do not establish that the medications are safe during pregnancy.
paras.zh: 最终，该研究强调了为什么在评估 GLP-1 药物的潜在怀孕风险时，女性的基本健康状况很重要。虽然研究结果为使用这些药物减肥的女性意外暴露提供了一些保证，但它们并不能证明这些药物在怀孕期间是安全的。

paras.en: Further research will be needed to clarify the risks and determine how best to counsel women who become pregnant while using these increasingly popular treatments.
paras.zh: 需要进一步的研究来澄清风险，并确定如何最好地为那些在使用这些日益流行的治疗方法时怀孕的女性提供建议。
