articles.title: Scientists discover a hidden danger of viral infections that vaccines may prevent

paras.en: Scientists discover a hidden danger of viral infections that vaccines may prevent
paras.zh: 科学家发现疫苗可以预防病毒感染的隐患

paras.en: - A new study reveals that viral infections may leave behind hidden damage to the immune system long after symptoms disappear. Researchers found that mice recovering from an acute infection experienced lasting changes to their spleens and weakened immune responses, potentially leaving them more vulnerable to future threats. Surprisingly, prior vaccination completely prevented these harmful changes in the mouse model.
paras.zh: - 一项新的研究表明，病毒感染可能会在症状消失很久之后对免疫系统留下隐藏的损害。研究人员发现，从急性感染中恢复的小鼠的脾脏发生了持久的变化，免疫反应减弱，可能使它们更容易受到未来的威胁。令人惊讶的是，先前的疫苗接种完全阻止了小鼠模型中的这些有害变化。

paras.en: Vaccines may do more than protect people from the immediate effects of a viral infection. New research suggests they could also help prevent lasting damage to the immune system that remains even after the virus has disappeared.
paras.zh: 疫苗的作用不仅仅是保护人们免受病毒感染的直接影响。新的研究表明，它们还可以帮助防止对免疫系统的持久损害，即使在病毒消失后这种损害仍然存在。

paras.en: Scientists at Pompeu Fabra University discovered that mice recovering from an acute viral infection experienced prolonged problems with their immune defenses. Although the animals had successfully fought off the virus, their immune systems remained impaired, making it harder to respond to new threats. Remarkably, mice vaccinated before infection did not develop these problems, suggesting that vaccination may provide an additional layer of protection beyond preventing illness.
paras.zh: 庞培法布拉大学的科学家发现，从急性病毒感染中恢复的小鼠的免疫防御会出现长期问题。尽管这些动物成功地抵抗了病毒，但它们的免疫系统仍然受损，使得它们更难应对新的威胁。值得注意的是，在感染前接种疫苗的小鼠没有出现这些问题，这表明疫苗接种可能在预防疾病之外提供额外的保护。

paras.en: Most people think of common viral infections, such as colds or stomach viruses, as temporary illnesses. A virus enters the body, multiplies, causes symptoms, and is eventually brought under control by the immune system. Once symptoms disappear, recovery is generally considered complete. The immune response also creates protection against future encounters with the same virus.
paras.zh: 大多数人认为常见的病毒感染（例如感冒或胃病毒）是暂时的疾病。病毒进入体内，繁殖，引起症状，并最终受到免疫系统的控制。一旦症状消失，通常就被认为已经完全康复。免疫反应还可以防止未来遇到相同的病毒。

paras.en: But what if the immune system continues to experience harmful effects long after the infection appears to be over?
paras.zh: 但是，如果在感染似乎结束后很长一段时间内免疫系统仍继续受到有害影响怎么办？

paras.en: Viral Infections Can Leave Lasting Immune Damage
paras.zh: 病毒感染会造成持久的免疫损伤

paras.en: Researchers from Pompeu Fabra University's Infection Biology Laboratory investigated this possibility in a study published in Cell Death & Disease.
paras.zh: 庞培法布拉大学感染生物学实验室的研究人员在《细胞死亡与疾病》上发表的一项研究中调查了这种可能性。

paras.en: Using mice with acute viral infections, the team examined what happened to their immune systems after the animals had recovered. They found that eliminating the virus did not necessarily restore normal immune function. Instead, the infection left behind changes that persisted well beyond the initial illness.
paras.zh: 研究小组使用患有急性病毒感染的小鼠，检查了它们康复后免疫系统的变化。他们发现消除病毒并不一定能恢复正常的免疫功能。相反，感染留下的变化远远超出了最初的疾病。

paras.en: According to Andreas Meyerhans, an ICREA research professor at UPF, who led the research, "there is a general perception that an acute viral infection is a relatively minor and transient event: once the virus is controlled and the symptoms have resolved, the body has fully recovered and is back to normal. But this view may underestimate consequences that are not immediately visible and can persist long after the infection itself has resolved."
paras.zh: 领导这项研究的 UPF ICREA 研究教授安德烈亚斯·迈耶汉斯 (Andreas Meyerhans) 表示，“人们普遍认为，急性病毒感染是一种相对较小和短暂的事件：一旦病毒得到控制，症状消失，身体就完全康复并恢复正常。但这种观点可能低估了不会立即显现的后果，并且在感染本身解决后可能会持续很长时间。”

paras.en: The researchers traced these lingering effects to significant changes in the spleen, an organ that plays an important role in coordinating immune defenses. As the immune system fought to eliminate the virus, the spleen developed fibrosis, a condition involving the buildup of scar-like tissue. The arrangement and positioning of immune cells within the organ also became disrupted.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这些挥之不去的影响追溯到脾脏的显着变化，脾脏是协调免疫防御发挥重要作用的器官。当免疫系统努力消灭病毒时，脾脏出现纤维化，这是一种涉及疤痕样组织堆积的疾病。器官内免疫细胞的排列和定位也被破坏。

paras.en: These structural changes interfered with the interactions between immune cells that are necessary to activate T cells. These specialized cells are essential to adaptive immunity because they help recognize and destroy infected cells.
paras.zh: 这些结构变化干扰了激活 T 细胞所必需的免疫细胞之间的相互作用。这些特殊细胞对于适应性免疫至关重要，因为它们有助于识别和破坏受感染的细胞。

paras.en: As a result, the mice remained less capable of launching effective immune responses when exposed to new challenges. Even though the original infection had been brought under control, their immune defenses continued to function poorly.
paras.zh: 结果，当小鼠面临新的挑战时，启动有效免疫反应的能力仍然较差。尽管最初的感染已经得到控制，但他们的免疫防御功能仍然很差。

paras.en: "The infection can be controlled, but that does not necessarily mean that the host has fully recovered," says Dr. Paula Cebollada Rica, first author of the study. "Our findings show that the immune-related consequences of an acute viral infection can persist beyond the period in which the virus is detectable, leaving the animals in an immunocompromised state."
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者保拉·塞博拉达·里卡博士说：“感染可以得到控制，但这并不一定意味着宿主已经完全康复。” “我们的研究结果表明，急性病毒感染的免疫相关后果可能会持续超过病毒可检测到的时期，使动物处于免疫功能低下的状态。”

paras.en: Vaccination Prevented Lasting Immune System Damage
paras.zh: 疫苗接种可预防持久的免疫系统损伤

paras.en: After identifying these long-term effects, the scientists investigated whether they could be avoided. They focused on vaccination, which prepares the immune system to recognize and fight a pathogen before an infection occurs.
paras.zh: 在确定了这些长期影响后，科学家们研究了是否可以避免这些影响。他们专注于疫苗接种，让免疫系统做好准备，在感染发生之前识别并对抗病原体。

paras.en: The results revealed a striking difference between vaccinated and unvaccinated animals. Mice that received vaccination before infection did not develop the spleen damage or immune dysfunction seen in the other group.
paras.zh: 结果显示，接种疫苗和未接种疫苗的动物之间存在显着差异。在感染前接受疫苗接种的小鼠没有出现另一组中所见的脾脏损伤或免疫功能障碍。

paras.en: Their spleens maintained their normal structure, and their T cells continued to function at levels comparable to those of mice that had never been infected.
paras.zh: 它们的脾脏保持了正常结构，它们的 T 细胞继续以与从未被感染的小鼠相当的水平发挥功能。

paras.en: This finding suggests that vaccination can protect the immune system itself from some of the harmful consequences of fighting a viral infection. In the mouse model, vaccination not only protected against the disease caused by the virus but also preserved the animals' ability to respond to future immune challenges.
paras.zh: 这一发现表明，疫苗接种可以保护免疫系统本身免受对抗病毒感染的一些有害后果的影响。在小鼠模型中，疫苗接种不仅可以预防病毒引起的疾病，还可以保留动物应对未来免疫挑战的能力。

paras.en: "Vaccinated animals did not experience T-cell dysfunction or splenic alterations after recovering from an acute viral infection. This means that vaccination not only prevented the disease resulting from the acute infection but also preserved the immune system's ability to cope with new challenges," Cebollada Rica explains.
paras.zh: “接种疫苗的动物在从急性病毒感染中恢复后没有出现 T 细胞功能障碍或脾脏改变。这意味着疫苗接种不仅可以预防急性感染引起的疾病，还可以保留免疫系统应对新挑战的能力，”Cebollada Rica 解释道。

paras.en: A Hidden Benefit of Vaccines With Public Health Implications
paras.zh: 疫苗的隐藏好处对公共卫生的影响

paras.en: The findings broaden the potential benefits of vaccination by highlighting a form of protection that may not be immediately apparent. Beyond reducing the immediate effects of an infection, vaccines may also help prevent persistent changes that weaken immune defenses.
paras.zh: 研究结果强调了一种可能不会立即显现的保护形式，从而扩大了疫苗接种的潜在益处。除了减少感染的直接影响外，疫苗还可能有助于防止削弱免疫防御的持续变化。

paras.en: Although these results were obtained in mice and do not establish that the same effects occur in humans, they raise important questions about how viral infections influence long-term immune health and how vaccination might help protect it.
paras.zh: 尽管这些结果是在小鼠身上获得的，并且并不能证明相同的效果也会发生在人类身上，但它们提出了关于病毒感染如何影响长期免疫健康以及疫苗接种如何帮助保护它的重要问题。

paras.en: The research also comes at a time when vaccination policies and infectious disease prevention efforts are increasingly influenced by political decisions. The researchers emphasize the importance of scientific evidence in understanding the full consequences of infections, particularly when policy choices can undermine coordinated efforts to prevent infectious diseases.
paras.zh: 这项研究也是在疫苗接种政策和传染病预防工作越来越受到政治决策影响的时期进行的。研究人员强调科学证据对于理解感染的全部后果的重要性，特别是当政策选择可能破坏预防传染病的协调努力时。

paras.en: Understanding the broader benefits of vaccination could therefore influence not only medical care but also how public health officials explain the value of vaccines to the public.
paras.zh: 因此，了解疫苗接种的更广泛益处不仅会影响医疗保健，还会影响公共卫生官员向公众解释疫苗价值的方式。

paras.en: "The benefits of vaccination highlighted by this research are important not only for healthcare, but also for how we communicate the value of vaccination to the population at large," Meyerhans states. "It is important that people are aware of the broader protection that vaccination can provide and continue to trust in vaccines as one of the most effective tools to prevent diseases. Put simply, vaccines provide strong health benefits at a relatively low cost to society."
paras.zh: “这项研究强调的疫苗接种的好处不仅对医疗保健很重要，而且对于我们如何向广大人群传达疫苗接种的价值也很重要，”迈尔汉斯说道。 “重要的是，人们要意识到疫苗接种可以提供更广泛的保护，并继续相信疫苗是预防疾病的最有效工具之一。简而言之，疫苗以相对较低的社会成本提供强大的健康益处。”

articles.title: California's brand-new Air & Space Center, home of the space shuttle Endeavour, opens today
articles.author: Chelsea Gohd

paras.en: LOS ANGELES — The California Science Center officially opened its brand-new Samuel Oschin Air & Space Center to the public today (Nov. 13).
paras.zh: 洛杉矶——今天（11 月 13 日），加州科学中心全新的塞缪尔·奥钦航空航天中心正式向公众开放。

paras.en: After more than three decades in development, folks can finally visit the Los Angeles science museum's massive new wing. For most of us, the biggest draw is its centerpiece: the retired space shuttle Endeavour, sitting upright in launch position, towering at nearly 200 feet (61 meters) tall.
paras.zh: 经过三十多年的发展，人们终于可以参观洛杉矶科学博物馆巨大的新翼。对于我们大多数人来说，最大的吸引力是它的核心：退役的奋进号航天飞机，直立在发射位置，高近 200 英尺（61 米）。

paras.en: "It just takes your breath away when you see that reveal and the doors open and you get to look at it for the first time. It's just — it's overwhelming," former NASA astronaut Garrett Reisman told Space.com during a visit to the museum. Reisman flew on two space shuttle missions during his astronaut career, the first of which was on Endeavour.
paras.zh: “当你看到这个揭秘，大门打开，你第一次看到它时，你会惊叹不已。这真是令人难以抗拒，”前美国宇航局宇航员加勒特·赖斯曼在参观博物馆时告诉 Space.com。赖斯曼在其宇航员生涯中执行了两次航天飞机任务，其中第一次是在奋进号上。

paras.en: "There are people that come from all over the world, and when they come to Los Angeles, they're going to have the opportunity to see it, too," Reisman added. "The exposure it's going to have is just a force multiplier. There are so many people that can have that opportunity to bring their kids here and show them [the shuttle] and have that experience."
paras.zh: “有些人来自世界各地，当他们来到洛杉矶时，他们也将有机会看到它，”雷斯曼补充道。 “它将获得的曝光只是一个力量倍增器。有很多人可以有机会带他们的孩子来这里，向他们展示[航天飞机]并获得这种体验。”

paras.en: Entering into this exhibit is an experience in and of itself, as I can personally attest; I was among of group of reporters who got a sneak peek at the new wing on Oct. 28. A video presentation ends in a dramatic reveal: Visitors walk into a space where the enormous shuttle, which flew 25 missions to Earth orbit from 1992 to 2011, feels truly larger than life.
paras.zh: 正如我个人可以证明的那样，进入这个展览本身就是一种体验。我是 10 月 28 日抢先一睹新机翼的记者之一。视频演示以戏剧性的揭示结束：参观者走进一个空间，在这架巨大的航天飞机中，这架从 1992 年到 2011 年执行了 25 次地球轨道任务的航天飞机，感觉真的比生活更宏大。

paras.en: There are a number of interactive exhibits around the base of Endeavour, which you can slide down to (though, of course, you can also take the elevator or stairs). From a shuttle landing simulator to a replica of a shuttle cockpit that you can sit in, to shuttle tires and space tech from across decades of spaceflight history, there's an incredible variety of space artifacts to both observe and interact with.
paras.zh: 奋进号基地周围有许多互动展览，您可以滑下来（当然，您也可以乘坐电梯或楼梯）。从航天飞机着陆模拟器到您可以坐在里面的航天飞机驾驶舱的复制品，再到数十年航天历史中的航天飞机轮胎和太空技术，有各种各样的太空文物可供观察和互动。

paras.en: As for Endeavour itself: It is open, so you can peer inside to see the robotic arm tucked away among a myriad of handles, straps and electronic gear inside. And you can see the shuttle from underneath all the way to the top.
paras.zh: 至于奋进号本身：它是开放式的，所以你可以向里面看去，看到机械臂隐藏在里面无数的手柄、带子和电子设备中。你可以从下面一直到顶部看到航天飞机。

paras.en: You can lie on the floor underneath the shuttle's engines, for example, and then take an elevator up the launch tower to come face-to-face with Endeavour's nose. There's even a transparent floor at the top that allows you to stand above the shuttle (though if you have a fear of heights, this might not be for you).
paras.zh: 例如，你可以躺在航天飞机发动机下方的地板上，然后乘坐电梯登上发射塔，与奋进号的机头面对面。顶部甚至还有一个透明的地板，可以让您站在航天飞机上方（尽管如果您有恐高症，这可能不适合您）。

paras.en: This is the abbreviated description, but know that if you are visiting the California Science Center, you will want to budget a serious amount of time to explore all that this new center has to offer.
paras.zh: 这是简短的描述，但请注意，如果您要参观加州科学中心，您将需要花费大量时间来探索这个新中心所提供的一切。

paras.en: The new air and space center is designed for all ages, and for civilians and astronauts alike. For instance, looking at Endeavour spurred some memories for Reisman: He reflected on his time aboard the shuttle and his time as an astronaut and pinpointed specific places on the shuttle that played important roles in his mission.
paras.zh: 新的航空航天中心专为所有年龄段、平民和宇航员而设计。例如，看着奋进号激发了赖斯曼的一些回忆：他回顾了自己在航天飞机上的时光以及作为宇航员的时光，并指出了航天飞机上在他的任务中发挥重要作用的特定位置。

paras.en: "I'm looking at handrails that I held onto during a spacewalk," he said. "They're the same handrails. My hand was in the glove, but it was wrapped around those handrails. And I practiced for a long time exactly how I was going to do that, how I was going to root my tether, and all that kind of stuff. And I get to stand [here] now. When you go up the elevator there, you can actually have a direct view of those handrails, and every time I see that, I'm thinking about that spacewalk."
paras.zh: “我正在看着我在太空行走时抓住的扶手，”他说。 “它们是相同的扶手。我的手戴着手套，但它包裹着那些扶手。我花了很长时间练习如何做到这一点，如何扎根绳索，以及所有类似的东西。现在我站在这里。当你登上那里的电梯时，你实际上可以直接看到那些扶手，每次我看到它，我都会想到太空行走。”

paras.en: But you don't need to have completed a spacewalk to get that view. And, as of today, the general public is welcome to visit the museum, which is free to the public — as is the new aerospace center with its Endeavour exhibit.
paras.zh: 但你并不需要完成太空行走才能看到这样的景象。而且，从今天开始，欢迎公众参观博物馆，该博物馆免费向公众开放，新的航空航天中心及其奋进号展览也是如此。

paras.en: However, due to the excitement over this new center opening, you will need to make a reservation online to attend. And, while the museum is free to the public, there is a cost associated with reserving slots during these busy first few days.
paras.zh: 然而，由于新中心的开业令人兴奋，您需要在线预订才能参加。而且，虽然博物馆免费向公众开放，但在繁忙的最初几天，预订席位会产生一定的费用。

paras.en: Chelsea Gohd served as a Senior Writer for Space.com from 2018 to 2022 before returning in 2026, covering everything from climate change to planetary science and human spaceflight in both articles and on-camera in videos. With a M.S. in Biology, Chelsea has written and worked for institutions including NASA JPL, the American Museum of Natural History, Scientific American, Discover Magazine Blog, Astronomy Magazine, and Live Science. When not writing, editing or filming something space-y, Gohd is writing music and performing as Foxanne, even launching a song to space in 2021 with Inspiration4. You can follow her online @chelsea.gohd and @foxanne.music
paras.zh: Chelsea Gohd 于 2018 年至 2022 年担任 Space.com 的高级作家，并于 2026 年回归，在文章和视频中报道了从气候变化到行星科学和载人航天的所有内容。拥有硕士学位在生物学领域，Chelsea 曾为 NASA JPL、美国自然历史博物馆、《科学美国人》、Discover 杂志博客、天文学杂志和 Live Science 等机构撰写文章和工作。在创作、编辑或拍摄太空作品之余，Gohd 会创作音乐并以 Foxanne 的身份进行表演，甚至于 2021 年与 Inspiration4 一起向太空推出了一首歌曲。您可以在线关注她@chelsea.gohd 和@foxanne.music

articles.title: Rocket Lab launching 100th space mission early on Nov. 14: Watch it live
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: Rocket Lab will launch its 100th space mission early Saturday morning (Nov. 14), and you can watch the milestone liftoff live.
paras.zh: 火箭实验室将于周六清晨（11 月 14 日）发射其第 100 次太空任务，您可以现场观看这一里程碑式的升空。

paras.en: An Electron rocket topped with a private Japanese Earth-observing satellite is scheduled to launch from Rocket Lab's New Zealand site on Saturday, during a window that opens at 12:30 a.m. EST (0530 GMT; 6:30 p.m. local time).
paras.zh: 搭载日本私人地球观测卫星的 Electron 火箭定于周六从火箭实验室新西兰基地发射，发射窗口时间为美国东部时间上午 12:30（格林尼治标准时间 0530；当地时间下午 6:30）。

paras.en: The mission, which Rocket Lab calls "The Mountain God Rises," will be the 100th to date for the California-based company. You can watch it live via Rocket Lab here, and Space.com will carry the feed if, as expected, it's made available. Coverage will begin about 30 minutes before launch.
paras.zh: 火箭实验室将此次任务称为“山神崛起”，这将是这家总部位于加州的公司迄今为止执行的第 100 次任务。您可以通过此处的 Rocket Lab 观看直播，如果按预期提供，Space.com 将提供该动态。报道将于发射前约 30 分钟开始。

paras.en: Rocket Lab launched for the first time in May 2017, sending the brand-new Electron up on a test flight from New Zealand. That effort failed, but Electron bounced back on its second-ever liftoff, delivering several cubesats to low Earth orbit (LEO) in January 2018.
paras.zh: Rocket Lab 于 2017 年 5 月首次发射，将全新的 Electron 从新西兰进行了试飞。这一努力失败了，但 Electron 在第二次升空中东山再起，于 2018 年 1 月向近地轨道 (LEO) 发射了几颗立方体卫星。

paras.en: In the years since, the 59-foot-tall (18 meters) Electron has become one of the most prolific and reliable rockets in the world, carrying small payloads to the final frontier for a variety of customers.
paras.zh: 此后的几年里，59 英尺高（18 米）的 Electron 已成为世界上最多产、最可靠的火箭之一，为各种客户将小型有效载荷运送到最后的前沿。

paras.en: And it's hitting the century mark in record-breaking fashion: No commercially developed rocket has gotten there faster, not even SpaceX's workhorse Falcon 9, according to Rocket Lab founder and CEO Peter Beck.
paras.zh: 火箭实验室创始人兼首席执行官彼得·贝克 (Peter Beck) 表示，它正以破纪录的方式达到百年目标：没有任何商业开发的火箭能比它更快地到达那里，甚至 SpaceX 的主力猎鹰 9 号也没有。

paras.en: "It's an unprecedented milestone for a commercial small-lift orbital rocket, and a threshold rarely crossed in modern spaceflight," Beck said on Monday (Nov. 9), during Rocket Lab's third-quarter earnings call with investors. "But what matters most to us and our customers is that we have achieved a 96% reliability rate across 99 launches."
paras.zh: 贝克周一（11 月 9 日）在 Rocket Lab 与投资者举行的第三季度财报电话会议上表示：“对于商业小型运力轨道火箭来说，这是一个前所未有的里程碑，也是现代航天领域很少跨越的门槛。” “但对我们和我们的客户来说最重要的是，我们在 99 次发射中实现了 96% 的可靠性。”

paras.en: Electron will meet the moment in style on Saturday morning, thanks to some fancy livery.
paras.zh: 由于一些精美的制服，Electron 将在周六早上以时尚的方式迎接这一时刻。

paras.en: "Black rocket 🤝 Golden milestone. Electron is all dressed up for launch 100," Rocket Lab said via X on Tuesday (Nov. 10), in a post that shared a photo of the specially painted first stage.
paras.zh: 周二（11 月 10 日），Rocket Lab 通过 X 发布了一张专门绘制的第一阶段的照片，并在帖子中表示：“黑色火箭🤝金色里程碑。Electron 已经为第 100 次发射做好了准备。”

paras.en: Not all of Rocket Lab's missions have gone orbital, it should be noted: A suborbital variant of Electron known as HASTE, which customers use to test technologies in a hypersonic flight environment, has nine missions under its belt to date.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，并非所有 Rocket Lab 的任务都进入了轨道：Electron 的亚轨道变体 HASTE 可供客户用来在高超音速飞行环境中测试技术，迄今为止已完成九次任务。

paras.en: "The Mountain God Rises" will be Rocket Lab's 11th launch to date for the Tokyo-based company iQPS, which is building a constellation of three dozen synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites in LEO. If all goes to plan, Electron's upper "kick stage" will deploy a single iQPS spacecraft 357 miles (575 kilometers) above Earth.
paras.zh: “山神崛起”将是 Rocket Lab 迄今为止为总部位于东京的 iQPS 公司进行的第 11 次发射，该公司正在近地轨道建造一个由三打合成孔径雷达 (SAR) 卫星组成的星座。如果一切按计划进行，Electron 的上部“启动级”将在地球上方 357 英里（575 公里）处部署一个 iQPS 航天器。

paras.en: SAR satellites can see through cloud cover and image our planet at night as well as during the day, offering key advantages over spacecraft that are optimized to view in optical wavelengths.
paras.zh: SAR 卫星可以穿透云层，在夜间和白天对地球进行成像，与经过优化以在光波长下观察的航天器相比，它具有关键优势。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: 'Arrival' at 10: Denis Villeneuve's alien visitation classic that reminded us it's good to talk
articles.author: Richard Edwards

paras.en: In many of the biggest science fiction franchises, conversing with alien races is an absolute doddle. In "Star Trek", universal translators come as standard, while C-3PO has spent the last 49 years reminding everyone in "Star Wars" that he's fluent in over six million forms of communication.
paras.zh: 在许多最大的科幻小说系列中，与外星种族对话绝对是轻而易举的事。在《星际迷航》中，通用翻译器成为标准配置，而 C-3PO 在过去的 49 年里一直在提醒《星球大战》中的每个人，他能流利地使用超过 600 万种交流方式。

paras.en: But in "Arrival" — which was released 10 years ago in November 2016 — making first contact proves to be rather more challenging than maintaining your Duolingo streak. In fact, working out how to establish a dialogue with extraterrestrial visitors becomes the whole point of this powerful and heartbreaking story, as the fate of planet Earth hinges on the interpretation of a single noun.
paras.zh: 但在 10 年前的 2016 年 11 月发行的《降临》中，事实证明，首次接触比保持 Duolingo 连胜更具挑战性。事实上，解决如何与外星访客建立对话成为这个强大而令人心碎的故事的重点，因为地球的命运取决于对一个名词的解释。

paras.en: The film's journey to the big screen began when a screenwriter best known for his work on horror franchises such as "Final Destination", "A Nightmare on Elm Street" and "The Thing" read a short story in an online magazine. Eric Heisserer was so impressed by Ted Chiang's "Understand" that he bought himself a collection of the author's short stories. One in particular, the Nebula Award-winning "Story of Your Life", piqued his interest.
paras.zh: 这部电影的大银幕之旅始于一位以《死神来了》、《榆树街噩梦》和《怪形》等恐怖系列作品而闻名的编剧在一本在线杂志上读到了一个短篇故事。埃里克·海瑟尔（Eric Heisserer）对特德·姜（Ted Jiang）的《理解》印象深刻，以至于给自己买了一本该作者的短篇小说集。尤其是获得星云奖的《你一生的故事》，引起了他的兴趣。

paras.en: "It had a very profound emotional effect on me," he reminisced to Deadline. "I was in tears, and I was both heartbroken and uplifted. My head was just full of big ideas. I had to walk around the block a couple of times afterward and just hug my friends. The next day, I was like, 'Oh god, I want to give this to other people.'"
paras.zh: “这对我产生了非常深远的情感影响，”他向 Deadline 回忆道。 “我泪流满面，既心碎又振奋。我的脑子里充满了伟大的想法。之后我不得不绕着街区走了几次，拥抱我的朋友。第二天，我想，‘天啊，我想把这个送给其他人。’”

paras.en: So when 21 Laps (the production company that later went on to make "Stranger Things") invited Heisserer to discuss possible future projects, the writer mentioned "Story of Your Life". The producers were also smitten.
paras.zh: 因此，当21 Laps（后来制作《怪奇物语》的制作公司）邀请海瑟尔讨论未来可能的项目时，作者提到了《你一生的故事》。制片人也被迷住了。

paras.en: "I was so excited, but I had that dread that a lot of producers get, which is, 'Are the rights available?'" 21 Laps' Dan Levine told the Hollywood Gold podcast. "You read something that blows you away, and then you find there aren't the rights, and there's no chance, you have to move on. So we were trying to track down this Ted Chiang, and he had no agent. He had a day job. He was impossible to find, so we started the hunt for Ted Chiang."
paras.zh: “我很兴奋，但我也有很多制片人都会有的恐惧，那就是‘有版权吗？’”《21 Laps》的丹·莱文 (Dan Levine) 告诉好莱坞黄金播客。 “你读到一些让你震惊的东西，然后你发现没有权利，也没有机会，你必须继续前进。所以我们试图找到这个特德·蒋，但他没有经纪人。他有一份日常工作。他不可能找到，所以我们开始寻找特德·蒋。”

paras.en: An up-and-coming Canadian director named Denis Villeneuve had also found his way on to 21 Laps' radar after his 2010 French-language drama "Incendies" earned rave reviews and an Academy Award nomination. He told the producers that he'd always wanted to direct a science fiction film — a hint of things to come? — and they showed him "Story of Your Life".
paras.zh: 加拿大新锐导演丹尼斯·维伦纽夫 (Denis Villeneuve) 2010 年的法语剧情片《焦灼之地》(Incendies) 赢得好评如潮并获得奥斯卡奖提名，随后也引起了 21 Laps 的关注。他告诉制片人，他一直想执导一部科幻电影——这是未来的暗示吗？ ——他们给他看了《你一生的故事》。

paras.en: He was also drawn to the story, while the now-located Chiang was suitably impressed by the director's work on "Incendies" to make a deal for the rights. And with Amy Adams also interested in playing the lead role of linguist Dr Louise Banks, the film that would eventually become "Arrival" was ready to proceed — or, at least, it would be once Villeneuve had completed his first three Hollywood movies, "Prisoners" (2013), "Enemy" (2013) and "Sicario" (2015).
paras.zh: 他也被这个故事所吸引，而现在身在其中的蒋对导演在《焦灼》中的作品印象深刻，从而达成了版权协议。由于艾米·亚当斯也有兴趣扮演语言学家路易丝·班克斯博士的主角，这部最终成为《降临》的电影已经准备好继续拍摄——或者，至少在维伦纽夫完成他的前三部好莱坞电影《囚徒》(2013年)、《敌人》(2013年)和《边境杀手》(2015年)之后。

paras.en: With 12 alien spaceships arriving simultaneously around the globe, "Arrival"'s poster-friendly elevator pitch could almost have been borrowed from "Independence Day". Indeed, the question of whether these whisper-quiet, chocolate button-shaped craft belong to the "Day the Earth Stood Still" / "Close Encounters" friendly extraterrestrial camp, or have the invasion of planet Earth on their minds is a mystery the world's governments are desperate to solve.
paras.zh: 12 艘外星飞船同时抵达全球，《降临》的海报式电梯宣传几乎可以借鉴《独立日》。事实上，这些悄无声息的巧克力纽扣形状的飞船是否属于“地球静止之日”/“亲密接触”友好的外星阵营，或者他们脑子里有入侵地球的想法，这是世界各国政府迫切想要解决的一个谜团。

paras.en: "Denis didn't really see this as an alien invasion movie — more an alien arrival movie," producer Aaron Ryder told SFX magazine. "What would be the protocols that were in place? How would they be implemented? How would people react? What would the government be doing? What would the news organisations be saying? That was the tone and the texture, which is established right up front."
paras.zh: “丹尼斯并不真正认为这是一部外星人入侵电影——更多的是一部外星人到来的电影，”制片人亚伦·赖德告诉 SFX 杂志。 “制定的协议是什么？它们将如何实施？人们会如何反应？政府会做什么？新闻机构会说什么？这就是预先确定的基调和结构。”

paras.en: These Hollywood blockbuster components were not part of "Story of Your Life". But even though Heisserer's script was not a direct translation of Chiang's tale, he retained the most important bits — namely Dr Banks' efforts to establish a means of communication with seven-legged extraterrestrial heptapods, and the profound effect their language has on her perception of time.
paras.zh: 这些好莱坞大片的成分并不是“你一生的故事”的一部分。不过，尽管海瑟尔的剧本不是蒋故事的直接翻译，但他保留了最重要的部分——即班克斯博士为建立与七足外星七足动物沟通方式所做的努力，以及它们的语言对她对时间的感知的深远影响。

paras.en: Designed by Carlos Huante, the heptapods themselves are like giant elongated hands, alien visitors light years away from the "Star Trek" tradition of actors with a few ridges glued to their foreheads. Like the evil 456 in "Torchwood: Children of Earth", they're enclosed in gaseous chambers and make sounds imperceptible to the human ear.
paras.zh: 由卡洛斯·万特设计的七肢桶本身就像巨大的拉长的手，是外星访客，与《星际迷航》演员额头上粘有一些脊的传统相距数光年。就像《火炬木：地球之子》中邪恶的 456 一样，它们被封闭在气室中，发出人耳无法察觉的声音。

paras.en: This, however, is where "Arrival" gets really interesting. Working alongside physicist colleague Dr Ian Donnelly (Jeremy Renner), Banks gradually exchanges foundational vocabulary with two heptapods they name Abbott and Costello. They discover that the alien visitors use a sophisticated written language of circular "logograms", squirted into their atmosphere as if it were sentient squid ink.
paras.zh: 然而，这正是“到来”真正有趣的地方。班克斯与物理学家同事伊恩·唐纳利博士（杰里米·雷纳饰）一起工作，逐渐与他们命名为阿伯特和科斯特洛的两个七肢桶交换基础词汇。他们发现外星访客使用一种复杂的圆形“语标”书面语言，喷射到他们的大气中，就像有知觉的乌贼墨水一样。

paras.en: "The idea in the short story is of circular language that has no beginning and no end," Villeneuve explained in an interview with IndieWire. "We were looking for no relation to any human language. I had to figure out how to produce logograms from my aliens while avoiding being long and boring. The sounds were an expression of their emotions, with more intellect coming from the signs. This beautiful species uses written language as their first means of expression instead of movement or gesture. They produce words out of their bodies."
paras.zh: “短篇小说的想法是循环语言，没有开始也没有结束，”维伦纽夫在接受 IndieWire 采访时解释道。 “我们正在寻找与任何人类语言都没有关系的东西。我必须弄清楚如何从我的外星人那里产生语标，同时避免又长又无聊。声音是他们情感的表达，更多的智慧来自符号。这个美丽的物种使用书面语言作为他们的第一个表达方式，而不是运动或手势。他们从身体中产生单词。”

paras.en: But Banks and Donnelly's research project has a purpose. With the world's military on high alert — and, ironically, struggling to communicate — they need to work out how to ask the aliens a fundamental question: Why are you here?
paras.zh: 但班克斯和唐纳利的研究项目有一个目的。由于世界军队处于高度戒备状态，而且讽刺的是，他们很难沟通，他们需要弄清楚如何向外星人提出一个基本问题：你为什么在这里？

paras.en: The heptapods' answer — "offer weapon" — is tantalizingly ambiguous. Are they planning to attack? Or is, as Banks suggests, 'weapon' simply being used as a synonym for 'tool'?
paras.zh: 七肢桶的回答——“提供武器”——含糊得令人着迷。他们打算进攻吗？或者，正如班克斯所说，“武器”只是被用作“工具”的同义词？

paras.en: Aside from a bomb planted on the heptapod ship by a rogue US soldier, "Arrival" is mostly free from the big-budget explosions that are part-and-parcel of most alien visitation movies. Instead, the film's denouement delivers a twist — the crux of Chiang's story — that rivals "The Sixth Sense", "Fight Club" and "The Prestige" in its audacious sleight of hand.
paras.zh: 除了一名流氓美国士兵在七肢桶船上安放的炸弹外，《降临》基本上没有出现大多数外星人造访电影中必不可少的大成本爆炸。相反，影片的结局呈现了一个转折——蒋故事的核心——其大胆的手法可与《第六感》、《搏击俱乐部》和《威望》相媲美。

paras.en: It turns out the "weapon" in question is actually the heptapod language, which, thanks to their non-linear perception of time, gives speakers a unique perspective on the past, present, and future. Therefore, those scenes we assumed to be flashbacks to the life and tragic death of Louise's daughter, Hannah, are actually flashforwards, as her increased understanding of heptapod-speak gives her memories of a life she hasn't yet lived.
paras.zh: 事实证明，所讨论的“武器”实际上是七肢桶语言，由于其对时间的非线性感知，使说话者对过去、现在和未来有了独特的视角。因此，那些我们认为是路易丝女儿汉娜的生活和悲惨死亡的闪回的场景，实际上是闪回，因为她对七肢桶语言的理解不断加深，让她回忆起了她尚未经历过的生活。

paras.en: Villeneuve put on multiple test screenings to ensure the big reveals hit properly.
paras.zh: 维伦纽夫进行了多次试映，以确保大片的上映顺利进行。

paras.en: "I wanted to screen it with people who knew nothing about the project," he said. "What we discovered is when someone in the audience felt too lost — if intellectually they were not engaged — the ending was less powerful from an emotional point of view. So we tried to give as few clues as possible, but enough clues to be able to stay engaged and follow the story."
paras.zh: “我想和对这个项目一无所知的人一起筛选，”他说。 “我们发现，当观众中的某个人感到太失落时——如果他们在理智上没有投入——从情感的角度来看，结局就不那么有力了。所以我们试图提供尽可能少的线索，但要有足够的线索，以便能够保持参与并跟踪故事。”

paras.en: Those subtle hints become obvious on second and third viewings, whether it's a lingering shot of a wedding ring absent in the movie's "present" or a conversation about the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis (the notion that the structure of a language can influence the way its speakers think). The absence of young Hannah's father also takes on tragic new meaning when we realize it's Ian, who'll leave after Louise tells him about their daughter's sad fate.
paras.zh: 这些微妙的暗示在第二次和第三次观看时变得明显，无论是电影“礼物”中缺席的结婚戒指的挥之不去的镜头，还是关于萨皮尔-沃尔夫假说（一种语言的结构可以影响其说话者的思维方式的概念）的对话。当我们意识到是伊恩时，年轻汉娜父亲的缺席也呈现出悲剧性的新含义，在路易丝告诉他他们女儿的悲惨命运后，伊恩将离开。

paras.en: "We were walking on this tightrope of trying to play things so it could play both ways, because of the reveal at the end," Adams recalled in a Vanity Fair conversation with Villeneuve. "I had to do so much work to understand how I play a character so that the first time you watch it you think that it's one thing, and the second time you watch it you can see it from a totally different perspective."
paras.zh: 亚当斯在《名利场》杂志与维伦纽夫的对话中回忆道：“我们正走在走钢丝上，试图玩一些东西，这样它就可以双向发挥作用，因为最后的揭露。” “我必须做很多工作来理解我如何扮演一个角色，这样当你第一次看它时，你会认为这是一回事，而当你第二次观看它时，你会从完全不同的角度看到它。”

paras.en: While Adams didn't get the Oscar nomination her performance deserved, everything else paid off, with the film making over $200 million worldwide from its reported $47 million budget. (The film did win an Academy Award for sound editing, while receiving further nods for best picture, director, and adapted screenplay.)
paras.zh: 虽然亚当斯的表演没有获得应有的奥斯卡提名，但其他一切都得到了回报，该片据报道的 4700 万美元预算在全球赚得超过 2 亿美元。 （这部电影确实赢得了奥斯卡最佳声音剪辑奖，同时还获得了最佳影片、最佳导演和最佳改编剧本奖。）

paras.en: Villeneuve has famously gone on to become Hollywood's go-to guy for intelligent sci-fi, thanks to "Blade Runner 2049" and the smash-hit "Dune" saga, and will next be given the opportunity to resurrect James Bond.
paras.zh: 凭借《银翼杀手 2049》和风靡一时的《沙丘》传奇，维伦纽夫后来成为好莱坞智能科幻片的首选人物，接下来他将有机会复活詹姆斯·邦德。

paras.en: Normally we'd take this opportunity to say no one could have foreseen Villeneuve's subsequent ascendancy but — in a story involving heptapods and some clever people at 21 Laps — who can be so sure?
paras.zh: 通常情况下，我们会借此机会说没有人能够预见到维伦纽夫随后的崛起，但是——在一个涉及七肢桶和 21 圈的一些聪明人的故事中——谁能这么肯定呢？

paras.en: "Arrival" is available to stream on Paramount+ in the US, and Netflix in the UK.. It's also available on Blu-ray via Amazon.
paras.zh: 《降临》可以在美国的 Paramount+ 和英国的 Netflix 上观看。还可以通过亚马逊购买蓝光光盘。

paras.en: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team — led by expert codebreaker Louise Banks (Amy Adams) — is brought together to investigate.
paras.zh: 当神秘的宇宙飞船在全球着陆时，由密码破译专家路易斯·班克斯（艾米·亚当斯饰）领导的精英团队聚集在一起进行调查。

paras.en: Richard's love affair with outer space started when he saw the original "Star Wars" on TV aged four, and he spent much of the ’90s watching "Star Trek”, "Babylon 5” and “The X-Files" with his mum. After studying physics at university, he became a journalist, swapped science fact for science fiction, and hit the jackpot when he joined the team at SFX, the UK's biggest sci-fi and fantasy magazine. He liked it so much he stayed there for 12 years, four of them as editor.
paras.zh: 理查德对外太空的热爱始于四岁时在电视上看到原版《星球大战》，他在 90 年代的大部分时间都和妈妈一起观看《星际迷航》、《巴比伦 5》和《X 档案》。大学物理专业毕业后，他成为一名记者，将科学事实换成了科幻小说，并在加入英国最大的科幻奇幻杂志 SFX 的团队时中了大奖。他非常喜欢它，因此在那里呆了 12 年，其中四年担任编辑。

paras.en: He's since gone freelance and passes his time writing about "Star Wars", "Star Trek" and superheroes for the likes of SFX, Total Film, TechRadar and GamesRadar+. He has met five Doctors, two Starfleet captains and one Luke Skywalker, and once sat in the cockpit of "Red Dwarf"'s Starbug.
paras.zh: 此后，他成为自由职业者，并为 SFX、Total Film、TechRadar 和 GamesRadar+ 等公司撰写有关《星球大战》、《星际迷航》和超级英雄的文章来打发时间。他见过五位博士、两位星际舰队舰长和一位卢克·天行者，还曾经坐过“红矮星”星虫号的驾驶舱。

articles.title: Cork Takes the Heat So DRACO’s Data Can Survive
articles.author: Amorim Cork Solutions

paras.en: Mozelos, Portugal, September 2, 2026 – Amorim Cork Solutions is contributing its P50 cork-based thermal protection material to DRACO, a European Space Agency (ESA) mission designed to capture rare in-flight data on how satellites break apart during atmospheric reentry.
paras.zh: 葡萄牙莫泽洛斯，2026 年 9 月 2 日 – Amorim Cork Solutions 正在向 DRACO 贡献其 P50 软木热防护材料，DRACO 是欧洲航天局 (ESA) 的一项任务，旨在捕获有关卫星在重返大气层期间如何分解的罕见飞行数据。

paras.en: Scheduled for launch in 2027, DRACO, short for Destructive Reentry Assessment Container Object, will deliberately reenter Earth’s atmosphere and break apart. Around 200 sensors and four cameras will record what happens to the spacecraft throughout the process, generating data that could help improve reentry models and support the development of safer, more sustainable spacecraft.
paras.zh: DRACO（破坏性再入评估容器物体的缩写）计划于 2027 年发射，将故意重新进入地球大气层并解体。大约 200 个传感器和四个摄像头将记录航天器在整个过程中发生的情况，生成有助于改进再入模型并支持开发更安全、更可持续的航天器的数据。

paras.en: At the heart of this unusual engineering challenge is a 40 cm survival capsule. While the spacecraft around it is designed to break apart, the capsule must survive long enough to preserve and transmit the mission’s critical scientific data. Its heat shield will use Amorim P50, a cork-based ablative thermal protection material developed for demanding aerospace environments.
paras.zh: 这项不同寻常的工程挑战的核心是一个 40 厘米的救生舱。虽然它周围的航天器被设计为会分解，但太空舱必须存活足够长的时间才能保存和传输任务的关键科学数据。其隔热罩将使用 Amorim P50，这是一种基于软木的烧蚀热防护材料，专为要求苛刻的航空航天环境而开发。

paras.en: During reentry, DRACO will encounter intense thermal and mechanical conditions as the spacecraft progressively breaks apart. Data collected by its sensors and cameras will be processed onboard, with the most valuable information transferred to the survival capsule.
paras.zh: 在重返大气层期间，随着航天器逐渐解体，DRACO 将遇到强烈的热和机械条件。其传感器和摄像头收集的数据将在船上进行处理，最有价值的信息将传输到救生舱中。

paras.en: Protecting that capsule is therefore essential to the mission.
paras.zh: 因此，保护​​该太空舱对于此次任务至关重要。

paras.en: The von Karman Institute for Fluid Dynamics (VKI), which is responsible for key aspects of the capsule’s design, aerothermodynamics, and thermal protection development and validation, selected Amorim P50 for its heat shield.
paras.zh: 冯卡门流体动力学研究所 (VKI) 负责胶囊设计、空气热力学以及热防护开发和验证的关键方面，选择 Amorim P50 作为其隔热罩。

paras.en: P50 is a lightweight, cork-based ablative material designed to provide thermal protection in demanding aerospace applications. Its selection for DRACO builds on approximately 15 years of collaboration between Amorim and VKI in the field of aerothermodynamics and thermal protection.
paras.zh: P50 是一种轻质软木烧蚀材料，旨在为要求苛刻的航空航天应用提供热保护。 DRACO 的选择建立在 Amorim 和 VKI 在空气热力学和热防护领域约 15 年的合作基础上。

paras.en: “DRACO represents a remarkable engineering challenge: designing a spacecraft to break apart while ensuring that the knowledge generated during that process survives,” said Sofia Paixão, Global Technical & Product Manager at Amorim Cork Solutions. “We are proud to see Amorim P50 contributing to that challenge and to a mission that could deepen our understanding of atmospheric reentry and help inform the design of future spacecraft.”
paras.zh: Amorim Cork Solutions 全球技术和产品经理 Sofia Paixão 表示：“DRACO 代表了一项非凡的工程挑战：设计一艘能够分解的航天器，同时确保该过程中产生的知识得以保存。” “我们很自豪看到 Amorim P50 为这一挑战和任务做出贡献，该任务可以加深我们对大气层再入的理解，并有助于为未来航天器的设计提供信息。”

paras.en: Ahead of the mission, the capsule’s thermal protection system has undergone experimental validation at VKI.
paras.zh: 在执行任务之前，太空舱的热保护系统已在 VKI 进行了实验验证。

paras.en: A half-scale version of the capsule was exposed to plasma flows in VKI’s facilities to reproduce key aspects of the aerothermal environment expected during atmospheric reentry. The tests allowed the team to evaluate the heat shield and overall thermal protection design under reentry-like conditions before progressing toward the full-scale capsule.
paras.zh: 半比例版本的太空舱在 VKI 设施中暴露于等离子流中，以重现大气再入期间预期的气热环境的关键方面。这些测试使团队能够在类似重返大气层的条件下评估隔热罩和整体热防护设计，然后再进入全尺寸太空舱。

paras.en: “We have extensively tested P50 within the DRACO programme. It is a highly insulating, robust, and predictable ablative material that is readily available on the commercial market,” said Dr. Bernd Helber, Research Expert in Aerothermochemistry at the von Karman Institute for Fluid Dynamics (VKI).
paras.zh: “我们在 DRACO 计划中对 P50 进行了广泛的测试。它是一种高度绝缘、坚固且可预测的烧蚀材料，在商业市场上很容易买到，”冯卡门流体动力学研究所 (VKI) 空气热化学研究专家 Bernd Helber 博士说。

paras.en: The DRACO mission is not the first time Amorim P50 has been used by VKI for an experimental reentry spacecraft. The material was previously selected for QARMAN, the QubeSat for Aerothermodynamic Research and Measurements on AblatioN, developed by VKI to collect data during atmospheric reentry.
paras.zh: DRACO 任务并不是 VKI 第一次将 Amorim P50 用于实验性再入航天器。该材料之前曾被用于QARMAN（用于空气热力学研究和烧蚀测量的QubeSat）选择，该卫星由VKI 开发，用于收集大气再入过程中的数据。

paras.en: DRACO marks the next chapter in this long-standing collaboration, bringing cork-based thermal protection technology to a new European mission with an ambitious scientific objective.
paras.zh: DRACO 标志着这一长期合作的新篇章，将基于软木塞的热防护技术带入新的欧洲使命，实现雄心勃勃的科学目标。

paras.en: Once DRACO begins its final descent, its sensors and cameras will document the spacecraft’s breakup and transfer the most important information to the protected capsule.
paras.zh: 一旦 DRACO 开始最后的下降，它的传感器和摄像机将记录航天器的解体并将最重要的信息传输到受保护的太空舱。

paras.en: The data collected by DRACO is expected to provide valuable insight into how spacecraft structures and materials behave during atmospheric reentry. The findings will help improve reentry models and support ESA’s work on Design for Demise, an approach aimed at designing spacecraft so that they break up more completely during reentry, reducing the risk posed by surviving debris.
paras.zh: DRACO 收集的数据预计将为航天器结构和材料在重返大气层期间的行为提供有价值的见解。这些发现将有助于改进再入模型，并支持欧空局的“死亡设计”工作，该方法旨在设计航天器，使其在再入过程中更彻底地解体，从而降低残存碎片带来的风险。

paras.en: The mission contributes to ESA’s broader Zero Debris approach, which aims to significantly reduce the creation of debris in Earth and lunar orbits by 2030.
paras.zh: 该任务为欧空局更广泛的零碎片方法做出了贡献，该方法的目标是到 2030 年大幅减少地球和月球轨道上碎片的产生。

paras.en: For Amorim Cork Solutions, DRACO further demonstrates the role cork-based thermal protection materials can play in demanding space applications, combining the natural thermal properties of cork with engineered solutions developed to perform under extreme conditions.
paras.zh: 对于阿莫林软木解决方案，DRACO 进一步展示了基于软木的热防护材料在要求苛刻的空间应用中可以发挥的作用，将软木的自然热性能与为在极端条件下运行而开发的工程解决方案相结合。

articles.title: CesiumAstro Secures $730 Million in Janus Henderson-Led Series D at a Valuation Above $4.5 Billion; Unveils Synchronicity Satellite Constellation Following Fully Successful Element-1 Mission
articles.author: CesiumAstro

paras.en: CesiumAstro Inc., a global leader in space and defense communications systems and satellites, today announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion. The financing brings CesiumAstro’s total capital announced in 2026 to more than $1.2 billion and supports its expansion into developing and operating its own satellite infrastructure.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro Inc. 是太空和国防通信系统及卫星领域的全球领导者，今天宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元。此次融资使 CesiumAstro 宣布的 2026 年总资本超过 12 亿美元，并支持其扩张至开发和运营自己的卫星基础设施。

paras.en: The company also announced Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation for commercial, sovereign, and defense missions. The announcement follows the launch of CesiumAstro’s first satellite Element-1, and the start of its on-orbit operations.
paras.zh: 该公司还宣布了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划由 737 颗卫星组成、支持人工智能的星座，用于商业、主权和国防任务。该公告是在 CesiumAstro 的第一颗卫星 Element-1 发射并开始在轨运行之后发布的。

paras.en: This expansion builds on three strategic acquisitions that have strengthened CesiumAstro’s vertical integration from semiconductors to mission operations, helping accelerate the development and deployment of Synchronicity. The company is also expanding its engineering and manufacturing operations worldwide. As part of that effort, CesiumAstro has announced a $500 million investment over five years to expand its Austin-area headquarters, including the purchase of 270,000 square feet of advanced manufacturing space.
paras.zh: 此次扩张建立在三项战略收购的基础上，这些收购加强了 CesiumAstro 从半导体到任务运营的垂直整合，有助于加速 Synchronicity 的开发和部署。该公司还在全球范围内扩展其工程和制造业务。作为这一努力的一部分，CesiumAstro 宣布在五年内投资 5 亿美元来扩建其奥斯汀地区总部，包括购买 270,000 平方英尺的先进制造空间。

paras.en: The equity round was led by Janus Henderson, with participation from Insight Partners, Sands Capital, Sumitomo Corporation of Americas, Woven Capital – Toyota’s Growth Fund, Incharge Capital, Magnetar, AV, and NewSpace Capital, alongside $100 million in debt financing provided through the Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM) and JPMorgan.
paras.zh: 此轮股权融资由 Janus Henderson 领投，Insight Partners、Sands Capital、Sumitomo Corporation of Americas、Woven Capital – 丰田成长基金、Incharge Capital、Magnetar、AV 和 NewSpace Capital 参与，此外还通过美国进出口银行 (EXIM) 和摩根大通提供了 1 亿美元的债务融资。

paras.en: The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: 新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: “For nearly a decade, we have invested in the engineering, intellectual property, manufacturing infrastructure, and the talented people required to build an enduring space technology company,” said Shey Sabripour, Founder and CEO of CesiumAstro. “With our technology proven on orbit, on the ground and in the air, a significantly expanded set of capabilities, and more than $1.2 billion in new capital raised this year, we are positioned to take the next major step in our growth.”
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 创始人兼首席执行官 Shey Saripour 表示：“近十年来，我们在工程、知识产权、制造基础设施和人才方面进行了投资，以建立一家持久的太空技术公司。” “凭借我们在轨道、地面和空中验证的技术、显着扩展的能力以及今年筹集的超过 12 亿美元的新资本，我们已准备好在增长方面迈出下一个重大步骤。”

paras.en: “Shey Sabripour is an extraordinary entrepreneur, and CesiumAstro is poised to revolutionize the space communications industry. This industry is at an inflection point; legacy solutions are not equipped for the demands of today’s customers,” said Aaron Schaechterle, Portfolio Manager, Janus Henderson. “When we met Shey and his team, it became clear that CesiumAstro provides transformative technology that is critical to the industry’s future. This investment was originated through the Janus Henderson Ascent platform, which was created to provide private market capital to visionary companies that redefine their industries and to support these companies on the journey from private to public markets.”
paras.zh: Janus Henderson 产品组合经理 Aaron Schaechterle 表示：“Shey Sabripour 是一位杰出的企业家，CesiumAstro 有望彻底改变太空通信行业。这个行业正处于拐点；传统解决方案无法满足当今客户的需求。” “当我们见到 Shey 和他的团队时，我们发现 CesiumAstro 提供的变革性技术对行业的未来至关重要。这项投资源自 Janus Henderson Ascent 平台，该平台的创建是为了向有远见的公司提供私募市场资本，重新定义其行业，并支持这些公司从私募市场走向公开市场。”

paras.en: Introducing Synchronicity: A 737-Satellite, AI-Enabled Constellation
paras.zh: 引入同步性：由 737 颗卫星组成、支持人工智能的星座

paras.en: Synchronicity takes CesiumAstro beyond supplying advanced space technologies and complete spacecraft to developing and operating its own integrated space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 同步性使 CesiumAstro 不仅提供先进的空间技术和完整的航天器，还开发和运营自己的综合空间基础设施。

paras.en: The constellation is designed around a dynamically managed, multi-beam, multi-frequency architecture supporting Ku-, Ka-, and V-band communications, advanced edge compute, and multi-orbit operations. This unified system aims to deliver more flexible, resilient, and adaptable connectivity across a broad range of commercial and national security missions.
paras.zh: 该星座围绕动态管理、多波束、多频率架构设计，支持 Ku、Ka 和 V 频段通信、高级边缘计算和多轨道操作。这个统一的系统旨在为广泛的商业和国家安全任务提供更灵活、有弹性和适应性强的连接。

paras.en: AI is integrated throughout the architecture, enabling network optimization, dynamic allocation of communications resources, and autonomous adaptation to changing mission requirements and operating conditions. Edge processing capabilities are intended to bring compute closer to where data is generated, reducing dependence on terrestrial infrastructure and supporting increasingly time-sensitive applications.
paras.zh: 人工智能集成在整个架构中，可实现网络优化、通信资源的动态分配以及自主适应不断变化的任务要求和操作条件。边缘处理功能旨在使计算更接近数据生成的地方，减少对地面基础设施的依赖并支持对时间日益敏感的应用程序。

paras.en: Unlike architectures assembled from independently sourced components, Synchronicity will leverage CesiumAstro’s vertically integrated technology portfolio, including custom silicon, best-in-class active phased arrays, software-defined payloads, advanced processors, spacecraft, mission software, and terminals for air, ground, mobility, and maritime platforms. This approach enables system-wide performance optimization.
paras.zh: 与由独立采购的组件组装而成的架构不同，Synchronicity 将利用 CesiumAstro 的垂直集成技术组合，包括定制芯片、一流的有源相控阵、软件定义的有效载荷、先进处理器、航天器、任务软件以及空中、地面、移动和海上平台的终端。这种方法可以实现系统范围的性能优化。

paras.en: “Synchronicity is the culmination of the technology stack we have methodically built since CesiumAstro was founded,” said Sabripour. “We designed the silicon, the active phased array, the payload, processors, the spacecraft, ground terminals, and the network as one system. That vertical integration gives us the ability to build capabilities in space that evolve as mission requirements, technology, and operating conditions change.”
paras.zh: “同步性是我们自 CesiumAstro 成立以来有条不紊地构建的技术堆栈的顶峰，”Saripour 说。 “我们将芯片、有源相控阵、有效载荷、处理器、航天器、地面终端和网络设计为一个系统。这种垂直整合使我们能够在太空中构建随着任务要求、技术和操作条件的变化而发展的能力。”

paras.en: Three Strategic Acquisitions Expand CesiumAstro’s Capabilities
paras.zh: 三项战略收购扩大了 CesiumAstro 的能力

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has brought critical semiconductor, mission software, and artificial intelligence capabilities together through three acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr.
paras.zh: 在过去 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项收购将关键的半导体、任务软件和人工智能能力整合在一起：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr。

paras.en: Jariet Technologies — A leading millimeter-wave RF System-on-Chip (RF-SoC) semiconductor company specializing in advanced solutions for satellite communications, electronic warfare, and radar systems. The acquisition strengthens CesiumAstro’s technology portfolio with advanced mixed-signal semiconductors, digital signal processing, and digital beamforming capabilities, enabling greater performance and control across its communications payloads, active phased arrays, and spacecraft.
paras.zh: Jariet Technologies — 一家领先的毫米波射频片上系统 (RF-SoC) 半导体公司，专注于卫星通信、电子战和雷达系统的先进解决方案。此次收购增强了 CesiumAstro 的技术组合，包括先进的混合信号半导体、数字信号处理和数字波束形成功能，从而实现其通信有效载荷、有源相控阵和航天器的更高性能和控制。

paras.en: 1Aardvark — A company specializing in mission software, algorithms, and systems engineering for national defense programs. The acquisition expands CesiumAstro’s autonomous mission capabilities, enabling spacecraft to dynamically respond to changing conditions, operate with greater resilience, and maintain mission effectiveness in contested or connectivity-constrained environments.
paras.zh: 1Aardvark — 一家专门从事国防项目任务软件、算法和系统工程的公司。此次收购扩大了CesiumAstro的自主任务能力，使航天器能够动态响应不断变化的条件，以更大的弹性运行，并在有争议或连接受限的环境中保持任务有效性。

paras.en: Vidrovr — An AI company specializing in real-time multimodal signal analysis. The acquisition accelerates CesiumAstro’s integration of AI into space communications and sensing systems, enabling intelligent RF optimization, autonomous satellite operations, and reconfigurable edge compute across its space and defense platforms.
paras.zh: Vidrovr — 一家专门从事实时多模态信号分析的人工智能公司。此次收购加速了 CesiumAstro 将人工智能集成到空间通信和传感系统中，从而在其空间和国防平台上实现智能射频优化、自主卫星操作以及可重新配置的边缘计算。

paras.en: Element: A Decade of Engineering Proven on Orbit
paras.zh: 元素：在轨道上经过十年验证的工程

paras.en: CesiumAstro successfully launched and began on-orbit operation of Element-1 in October 2026.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 于 2026 年 10 月成功发射 Element-1 并开始在轨运行。

paras.en: Element-1 integrates CesiumAstro’s proprietary communications payloads, active phased array technology, compute systems, and spacecraft engineering in an operational satellite. The mission validates nearly a decade of investment in proprietary intellectual property, specialized engineering expertise, and in-house manufacturing capabilities.
paras.zh: Element-1 在一颗运行卫星中集成了 CesiumAstro 专有的通信有效载荷、有源相控阵技术、计算系统和航天器工程。该任务验证了近十年来在专有知识产权、专业工程专业知识和内部制造能力方面的投资。

paras.en: Element-1 is the first of eight planned spacecraft, with seven more launches secured for the next deployment phase. The Element program also advances CesiumAstro’s space-based edge processing and compute capabilities, enabling data to be processed closer to its source and supporting more intelligent, responsive, and autonomous missions.
paras.zh: Element-1 是计划中的八艘航天器中的第一艘，下一部署阶段还有七次发射。 Element 计划还提升了 CesiumAstro 的天基边缘处理和计算能力，使数据能够在更接近其来源的地方进行处理，并支持更智能、响应更快和自主的任务。

paras.en: Expanding Global Operations and Manufacturing Capacity
paras.zh: 扩大全球运营和制造能力

paras.en: In Texas, CesiumAstro announced a $500 million investment over five years to expand its global headquarters in Austin, including the purchase of 270,000 square feet of advanced manufacturing space. The expansion will support precision electronics and spacecraft manufacturing, engineering, integration, and test, with plans to add 550 jobs and grow the Austin-area workforce to more than 1,000 employees by 2030.
paras.zh: 在德克萨斯州，CesiumAstro 宣布在五年内投资 5 亿美元，以扩建其位于奥斯汀的全球总部，包括购买 270,000 平方英尺的先进制造空间。此次扩建将支持精密电子和航天器制造、工程、集成和测试，计划到 2030 年增加 550 个就业岗位，并将奥斯汀地区的员工人数增加到 1,000 多人。

paras.en: Across the United States, the company is investing hundreds of millions of dollars to expand its engineering, manufacturing, and operational capabilities, with additional facilities in Colorado, California, Alabama, Florida, and the Washington, D.C. area.
paras.zh: 在美国各地，该公司正在投资数亿美元来扩大其工程、制造和运营能力，并在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、阿拉巴马州、佛罗里达州和华盛顿特区设立了额外的工厂。

paras.en: In Europe and Asia, the company is expanding its presence, with operations in the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, Taiwan, Singapore, and Japan.
paras.zh: 在欧洲和亚洲，该公司正在扩大其业务，在英国、德国、瑞士、台湾、新加坡和日本开展业务。

paras.en: These expansions will support scaled production of its communications and sensing systems, advanced compute technologies, and spacecraft, as well as development and deployment of its next-generation space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 这些扩建将支持其通信和传感系统、先进计算技术和航天器的规模生产，以及下一代空间基础设施的开发和部署。

articles.title: Commercial Space Federation Welcomes CesiumAstro as a New Associate Member
articles.author: Commercial Space Federation

paras.en: November 13, 2026— Washington, D.C.—The Commercial Space Federation (CSF) is pleased to welcome CesiumAstro as its newest Associate Member. A global leader in advanced connectivity solutions for the space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. CesiumAstro’s addition further strengthens CSF’s diverse membership and the Federation’s work to advance a competitive, innovative, and sustainable U.S. commercial space economy.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月 13 日——华盛顿特区——商业航天联合会 (CSF) 很高兴欢迎 CesiumAstro 成为其最新准会员。 CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。 CesiumAstro 的加入进一步加强了 CSF 的多元化成员资格以及联合会推动竞争性、创新性和可持续的美国商业太空经济的工作。

paras.en: CesiumAstro is a lobal leader in advanced connectivity solutions for space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. Its full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads and advanced computing systems. CesiumAstro maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards. Headquartered near Austin, Texas, the company operates additional facilities in Colorado, California, Washington, D.C., Florida, the United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore, Taiwan, and Japan.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，CesiumAstro 提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。其全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。 CesiumAstro 保持与内部设计、制造和测试能力的完全垂直整合，并通过了 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证。该公司总部位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀附近，在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、华盛顿特区、佛罗里达州、英国、德国、新加坡、台湾和日本设有其他工厂。

paras.en: CesiumAstro recently announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion, and unveiled Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation. The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 最近宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元，并推出了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划中的 737 颗卫星、支持人工智能的星座。新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has expanded its capabilities through three strategic acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr, strengthening the company’s capabilities across semiconductor technology, mission software, and artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 在过去的 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项战略收购扩大了其能力：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr，增强了公司在半导体技术、任务软件和人工智能方面的能力。

paras.en: CesiumAstro’s full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads, and advanced compute systems. The company maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 的全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。该公司与通过 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证的内部设计、制造和测试能力保持完整的垂直整合。

paras.en: “A thriving commercial economy in low Earth orbit needs reliable communications and a clear path from development to operations. CesiumAstro is joining CSF’s Commercial LEO Council to bring our communications expertise to that effort. We look forward to advancing policies that encourage investment, expand government use of commercial services, and support companies building the next generation of space infrastructure.”
paras.zh: “近地轨道蓬勃发展的商业经济需要可靠的通信以及从开发到运营的清晰路径。CesiumAstro 正在加入 CSF 的商业 LEO 委员会，将我们的通信专业知识用于这一努力。我们期待推进鼓励投资、扩大政府对商业服务的使用以及支持企业建设下一代空间基础设施的政策。”

paras.en: – Josh Ingersoll, Director of Spectrum and Regulatory Affairs at CesiumAstro
paras.zh: – Josh Ingersoll，CesiumAstro 频谱和监管事务总监

paras.en: Founded in 2006, the Commercial Space Federation (CSF) and its members are laying the foundation for democratizing access to outer space for scientists, students, civilians, and businesses. All while working towards the goal of expanding the U.S. Commercial Space Economy. Through the promotion of technological innovation, CSF and its diverse membership are guiding the bolstering of U.S. leadership in aerospace and inspiring America’s next generation of engineers and explorers. CSF also serves as the commercial space industry’s primary advocate with the U.S. Congress and the Administration, helping inform the development and implementation of policy priorities. By engaging with congressional players, CSF is able to provide recommendations on commercial space issues that will impact the commercial space industry in the short and long term.
paras.zh: 商业太空联盟 (CSF) 及其成员成立于 2006 年，正在为科学家、学生、平民和企业进入外太空的民主化奠定基础。同时努力实现扩大美国商业太空经济的目标。通过促进技术创新，CSF 及其多元化成员正在指导巩固美国在航空航天领域的领导地位，并激励美国下一代工程师和探险家。 CSF 还担任美国国会和政府商业航天业的主要倡导者，帮助为政策优先事项的制定和实施提供信息。通过与国会参与者合作，CSF 能够就商业航天问题提供建议，这些问题将在短期和长期影响商业航天行业。

articles.title: Gemini Astronaut Photos Inspired Early Earth Observation Program
articles.author: Michele Ostovar

paras.en: Astronauts James A. Lovell Jr. and Edwin E. “Buzz” Aldrin Jr. orbited Earth from November 11 to 15, 1966, on Gemini XII, the final mission of NASA’s Gemini program.
paras.zh: 1966 年 11 月 11 日至 15 日，宇航员小詹姆斯·A·洛弗尔 (James A. Lovell Jr.) 和埃德温·E·“巴兹”·奥尔德林 (Edwin E. “Buzz” Aldrin Jr.) 乘坐双子座 XII 绕地球飞行，这是美国宇航局双子座计划的最后一次任务。

paras.en: In addition to successfully completing rendezvous maneuvers and spacewalks, procedures vital to sending American astronauts to the Moon, the crew was also spurring the development of a different field of exploration, observing Earth from space.
paras.zh: 除了成功完成交会机动和太空行走（对于将美国宇航员送上月球至关重要的程序）外，机组人员还推动了不同探索领域的发展，即从太空观察地球。

paras.en: The photos taken by Lovell, Aldrin, and other Gemini astronauts demonstrated the value of orbital imagery for studying Earth’s surface. Their images helped scientists make the case for a dedicated Earth observation satellite program. One of strongest advocates for accelerating the use of Earth-observing satellites was William T. Pecora, the director of the United States Geological Survey from 1965 to 1971. In a 1969 statement, Pecora noted that the Earth Resources Observation Satellite (EROS) program he championed, and which later paved the way for Landsat, was “conceived in 1966 largely as a direct result of the demonstrated utility of Mercury and Gemini orbital photography to Earth resource studies.”
paras.zh: 洛弗尔、奥尔德林和其他双子座宇航员拍摄的照片证明了轨道图像对于研究地球表面的价值。他们的图像帮助科学家论证了专门的地球观测卫星计划。加速使用地球观测卫星的最有力倡导者之一是 1965 年至 1971 年间担任美国地质调查局局长的威廉·T·佩科拉 (William T. Pecora)。佩科拉在 1969 年的一份声明中指出，他所倡导的地球资源观测卫星 (EROS) 计划（后来为陆地卫星铺平了道路）“于 1966 年构思，很大程度上是水星和双子座的实用性得到证实的直接结果”轨道摄影到地球资源研究。”

paras.en: For more than five decades, Landsat and other Earth-observing satellites have provided invaluable data used around the world to monitor crops, wildfires, flooding, vegetation health, land use, and countless other changes to our planet.
paras.zh: 五十多年来，陆地卫星和其他地球观测卫星提供了宝贵的数据，在世界各地用于监测农作物、野火、洪水、植被健康、土地利用以及地球无数其他变化。

articles.title: Outbursts from a Massive Star
articles.author: HQ Web Team

paras.en: Using NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory, astronomers have discovered what is triggering repeated outbursts from a giant, unstable star located in the galaxy shown in this image released on Nov. 9, 2026.
paras.zh: 利用 NASA 的钱德拉 X 射线天文台，天文学家发现了触发银河系中一颗巨大且不稳定恒星反复爆发的原因，如 2026 年 11 月 9 日发布的这张图像所示。

paras.en: The volatile star, known as AT 2016blu, is in the spiral galaxy NGC 4559, located about 30 million light-years from Earth. Astronomers estimate the mass of this star is at least 33 times that of the Sun.
paras.zh: 这颗名为 AT 2016blu 的不稳定恒星位于螺旋星系 NGC 4559 中，距离地球约 3000 万光年。天文学家估计这颗恒星的质量至少是太阳的33倍。

paras.en: Image credit: X-ray: NASA/CXC/Univ. of Virginia/M. Aghakhanloo et al.; Optical: SDSS; Image Processing: NASA/CXC/SAO/P. Edmonds
paras.zh: 图片来源：X 射线：NASA/CXC/Univ。弗吉尼亚/M。阿加坎卢等人；光学：SDSS；图像处理：NASA/CXC/SAO/P。埃德蒙兹

articles.title: ‘Lives are at stake’: Humanitarians call for swift entry of winter supplies in Gaza

paras.en: ‘Lives are at stake’: Humanitarians call for swift entry of winter supplies in Gaza
paras.zh: “生命危在旦夕”：人道主义者呼吁迅速向加沙运送冬季物资

paras.en: “The devastating impact of the latest rainstorm in Gaza was preventable,” the Humanitarian Country Team (HCT) in the Occupied Palestinian Territory said in a statement.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦被占领土人道主义国家工作队（HCT）在一份声明中表示：“加沙最近的暴雨造成的破坏性影响是可以避免的。”

paras.en: “Children and adults were killed, critical services suspended, and thousands of family shelters flooded, swept away, or torn apart – not by the storm alone, but by policy decisions.”
paras.zh: “儿童和成人被杀，关键服务暂停，数以千计的家庭避难所被洪水、冲走或撕裂——这不仅仅是风暴造成的，也是政策决定造成的。”

paras.en: The HCT brings together heads of UN agencies and international and local non-governmental organizations who recalled that several months ago they had presented a plan to help Palestinians prepare for the current winter season.
paras.zh: HCT 汇集了联合国机构以及国际和地方非政府组织的负责人，他们回顾说，几个月前他们提出了一项计划，帮助巴勒斯坦人为当前的冬季做好准备。

paras.en: It outlined what they would deliver, such as shelter, improved health and protection services, drainage and sandbag reinforcement, and identified various supplies that need to enter Gaza.
paras.zh: 它概述了他们将提供的服务，例如住所、改善的健康和保护服务、排水系统和沙袋加固，并确定了需要进入加沙的各种物资。

paras.en: These include tents, warm clothes and blankets as well as equipment for pumping water, removing debris and clearing explosive ordnance.
paras.zh: 其中包括帐篷、保暖衣服和毯子以及抽水、清除碎片和清除爆炸物的设备。

paras.en: The plan also spelled out the need for sufficient funding, expedited entry of critical supplies and access to higher ground.
paras.zh: 该计划还明确指出需要充足的资金、加快关键物资的进入以及进入地势较高的地区。

paras.en: Their statement underlined Israel’s obligation as the Occupying Power to ensure the basic needs of Gaza’s population, including supplies essential for survival.
paras.zh: 他们的声明强调以色列作为占领国有义务确保加沙人民的基本需求，包括生存必需的供应。

paras.en: “Yet Israeli policies continue to obstruct the entry of critical items as well as access to most of Gaza’s land, including areas away from the shoreline that are less prone to flooding,” they said.
paras.zh: 他们表示：“然而，以色列的政策继续阻碍关键物品进入以及进入加沙大部分土地，包括远离海岸线、不易发生洪水的地区。”

paras.en: “Incoming supplies face multiple approval requirements, limited crossing capacity and unpredictable or narrow delivery windows that delay their entry.”
paras.zh: “传入的物资面临多重审批要求、有限的过境能力以及不可预测或狭窄的交货窗口，从而延迟了其进入。”

paras.en: They noted that “although funding has fallen far short of what is needed”, more than 150,000 tents are currently outside Gaza waiting to be dispatched. Meanwhile, needs inside the enclave are growing as every rainstorm destroys more tents, requiring more replacements.
paras.zh: 他们指出，“尽管资金远远低于所需”，但目前有超过 15 万顶帐篷在加沙境外等待派遣。与此同时，飞地内的需求正在增长，因为每次暴雨都会摧毁更多的帐篷，需要更多的更换。

paras.en: “Winter will last for months. Access to longer-lasting shelter must not be made conditional on political progress when people’s needs are so urgent,” they said.
paras.zh: “冬天将持续数月。当人们的需求如此迫切时，获得更持久的住所决不能以政治进展为条件，”他们说。

paras.en: “Winter supplies must reach families immediately to prevent further loss of life and protect their dignity. People cannot wait.”
paras.zh: “冬季物资必须立即送达各家各户，以防止进一步的生命损失并保护他们的尊严。人们不能等待。”

paras.en: They called on the Israeli authorities to expedite the entry of life-saving supplies in Gaza, lift restrictions and enable the repair of water and wastewater networks
paras.zh: 他们呼吁以色列当局加快救生用品进入加沙、取消限制并修复供水和废水处理网络

paras.en: “Let all humanitarian partners operate – UN agencies, international organizations, and Palestinian NGOs alike. Allow meaningful commercial activity,” they said.
paras.zh: “让所有人道主义合作伙伴开展行动——联合国机构、国际组织和巴勒斯坦非政府组织等。允许有意义的商业活动，”他们说。

paras.en: The partners also urged Member States “to use their influence to ensure these steps are taken swiftly and to provide the necessary humanitarian funding without delay”, stressing that “lives are at stake.”
paras.zh: 合作伙伴还敦促会员国“利用其影响力，确保迅速采取这些步骤，并立即提供必要的人道主义资金”，并强调“生命处于危险之中”。

articles.title: COP31: Climate finance falls short as calls grow for polluters to pay

paras.en: COP31: Climate finance falls short as calls grow for polluters to pay
paras.zh: COP31：随着要求污染者付费的呼声越来越高，气候融资不足

paras.en: From emotional appeals for climate justice to high-stakes negotiations over billions of dollars, finance dominated discussions at COP31 on Friday. UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned that even tripling adaptation funding for vulnerable countries would meet less than a third of their needs, as pressure mounted on wealthy nations and major polluters to pay their fair share.
paras.zh: 从对气候正义的情感诉求到数十亿美元的高风险谈判，金融问题主导了周五 COP31 的讨论。联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯警告说，即使向脆弱国家提供三倍的适应资金也只能满足不到三分之一的需求，因为富裕国家和主要污染者支付公平份额的压力越来越大。

paras.en: - Climate finance: Guterres calls for reforms to an international financial system he says is failing vulnerable countries.
paras.zh: - 气候金融：古特雷斯呼吁对国际金融体系进行改革，他认为该体系正在让脆弱国家失望。

paras.en: - New investments: A $10 billion initiative aims to finance climate projects in emerging markets.
paras.zh: - 新投资：一项 100 亿美元的计划旨在为新兴市场的气候项目提供资金。

paras.en: - On the ground: UN experts highlight support for disaster-hit communities, farmers and innovative insurance schemes.
paras.zh: - 实地：联合国专家强调对受灾社区、农民和创新保险计划的支持。

paras.en: - Negotiations: COP31 Presidency circulates first outline of a possible political declaration, with climate finance and fossil fuels remaining among the key unresolved issues.
paras.zh: - 谈判：COP31主席团分发了可能的政治宣言的第一份大纲，其中气候融资和化石燃料仍然是未解决的关键问题。

paras.en: Some demonstrators held signs demanding that “polluters pay”. Others, dressed as chefs, offered a recipe for climate action: debt cancellation as the secret ingredient.
paras.zh: 一些示威者举着标语，要求“污染者付费”。其他人则打扮成厨师，提出了气候行动的秘诀：取消债务作为秘方。

paras.en: Along the corridors and waterways of the COP31 venue in Antalya, protesters from across the globe gathered to demand climate justice. Some fought back tears, while others wept openly, recounting the lives and livelihoods already lost to climate change.
paras.zh: 沿着安塔利亚 COP31 会场的走廊和水道，来自世界各地的抗议者聚集在一起，要求气候正义。一些人忍住泪水，另一些人则公开哭泣，讲述因气候变化而失去的生命和生计。

paras.en: Speaking of Lake Chad, where drought and fluctuating water levels have devastated communities and displaced families, a Nigerian activist questioned why his country, which has contributed little to global emissions, faces far higher borrowing costs than wealthier nations to cope with climate impacts.
paras.zh: 谈到乍得湖，那里的干旱和水位波动给社区和流离失所的家庭造成了严重破坏，一位尼日利亚活动人士质疑，为什么他的国家对全球排放贡献甚少，却面临比富裕国家高得多的借贷成本来应对气候影响。

paras.en: Similar concerns echoed through Friday's finance discussions, as the Secretary-General warned that climate disasters were erasing decades of development gains and pushing vulnerable countries deeper into debt.
paras.zh: 周五的金融讨论中也出现了类似的担忧，秘书长警告说，气候灾难正在抹去数十年的发展成果，并使脆弱国家陷入更深的债务。

paras.en: “Even tripling adaptation finance would meet less than 30 per cent of what is needed,” he told journalists at his final COP press conference as Secretary-General before leaving office at the end of the year.
paras.zh: “即使将适应资金增加两倍，也只能满足不到所需资金的 30%，”他在年底离任前作为秘书长的最后一次 COP 新闻发布会上对记者表示。

paras.en: The consequences, he argued, extend far beyond the environment.
paras.zh: 他认为，其后果远远超出了环境范围。

paras.en: “You cannot build peace on a burning planet,” he said. “You cannot eradicate poverty when climate disasters keep throwing people back into it.”
paras.zh: “你无法在一个燃烧的星球上建立和平，”他说。 “当气候灾难不断让人们重新陷入贫困时，你就无法消除贫困。”

paras.en: Climate action, he insisted, must remain central to the UN's work, requiring a faster transition away from fossil fuels and a challenge to the “powerful interests” standing in the way.
paras.zh: 他坚持认为，气候行动必须仍然是联合国工作的核心，需要更快地摆脱化石燃料，并对阻碍的“强大利益”提出挑战。

paras.en: “The future of our planet cannot be negotiated on the terms of those profiting from its destruction.”
paras.zh: “我们星球的未来不能根据那些从其破坏中获利的人的条件进行谈判。”

paras.en: But finding the money to protect vulnerable countries is another battle. The UN chief revealed that he had met with the heads of international climate funds earlier on Friday, urging them to cut through the bureaucracy that makes financial assistance so difficult to access, particularly for countries with limited resources.
paras.zh: 但寻找资金来保护脆弱国家则是另一场战斗。联合国秘书长透露，他于周五早些时候会见了国际气候基金负责人，敦促他们消除官僚主义，因为官僚主义使财政援助难以获得，特别是对于资源有限的国家而言。

paras.en: He also questioned the fairness of a global financial system designed after the Second World War, when many developing countries had little say in shaping it.
paras.zh: 他还质疑二战后设计的全球金融体系的公平性，当时许多发展中国家在塑造这一体系方面几乎没有发言权。

paras.en: Changing that system, he argued, could also help unlock more funding. A dollar invested in the capital of a development bank, for example, could generate eight to ten dollars in financing, while greater use of guarantees could attract private investment.
paras.zh: 他认为，改变这一制度也有助于释放更多资金。例如，投资于开发银行资本的一美元可以产生八到十美元的融资，而更多地使用担保可以吸引私人投资。

paras.en: At a ministerial meeting, UN climate chief Simon Stiell described the consequences of leaving things as they are.
paras.zh: 在一次部长级会议上，联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔描述了保持现状的后果。

paras.en: “Many developing countries are trapped in a downward loop of debt, disaster, and devastating capital costs,” he said. “Climate finance must help countries break free.”
paras.zh: “许多发展中国家陷入了债务、灾难和毁灭性资本成本的恶性循环，”他说。 “气候融资必须帮助各国摆脱困境。”

paras.en: Under existing agreements, developed countries are expected to lead efforts to mobilize at least $300 billion a year for developing nations by 2035, as part of a broader $1.3 trillion goal.
paras.zh: 根据现有协议，预计发达国家将带头努力，到 2035 年每年为发展中国家筹集至少 3000 亿美元，作为更广泛的 1.3 万亿美元目标的一部分。

paras.en: But an assessment highlighted at COP31 suggests that, on current trends, annual climate finance could fall $840 billion short of that larger target.
paras.zh: 但 COP31 强调的一项评估表明，按照目前的趋势，年度气候融资可能比这一更大目标少 8,400 亿美元。

paras.en: Fresh efforts to close the gap emerged on Friday. Development finance institutions from Britain, Norway and Canada announced plans to mobilize $10 billion for climate projects in emerging markets by 2030.
paras.zh: 周五出现了缩小差距的新举措。英国、挪威和加拿大的发展金融机构宣布，计划到 2030 年为新兴市场的气候项目筹集 100 亿美元。

paras.en: Protecting livelihoods before and after disaster
paras.zh: 保护灾前和灾后的生计

paras.en: For millions of farmers, climate finance can mean the difference between adapting to a changing climate and losing everything when disaster strikes.
paras.zh: 对于数百万农民来说，气候融资可能意味着适应气候变化和在灾难发生时失去一切之间的区别。

paras.en: Kaveh Zahedi, from the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), told UN News that only around five per cent of climate-related development finance goes to agriculture, and that share is declining.
paras.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织 (FAO) 的卡维·扎赫迪 (Kaveh Zahedi) 告诉《联合国新闻》，与气候相关的发展资金中只有约 5% 用于农业，而且这一比例正在下降。

paras.en: Yet investing in adaptation can help farmers restore degraded land, use water more efficiently and grow crops better able to withstand droughts and floods, as increasingly unpredictable weather and El Niño are threatening food production.
paras.zh: 然而，随着越来越难以预测的天气和厄尔尼诺现象正在威胁粮食生产，对适应措施的投资可以帮助农民恢复退化的土地，更有效地利用水资源，种植能够更好地抵御干旱和洪水的作物。

paras.en: “The biggest risk is not investing in agriculture,” he warned. "Because then you’re risking food insecurity. You're risking an increase in hunger."”
paras.zh: “最大的风险不是投资农业，”他警告说。 “因为那样你就会面临粮食不安全的风险。你就会面临饥饿加剧的风险。”

paras.en: But even with better preparation, some disasters cannot be avoided. And when they strike, how quickly money arrives can make all the difference.
paras.zh: 但即使准备得更好，一些灾难也无法避免。当他们罢工时，资金到达的速度会产生重大影响。

paras.en: Imagine a farmer in Fiji whose fields have just been battered by a cyclone. The crops are gone; bills remain. And the next harvest may be months away.
paras.zh: 想象一下斐济的一位农民，他的田地刚刚被飓风袭击。庄稼没了；账单仍然存在。下一次收获可能还需要几个月的时间。

paras.en: An innovative insurance scheme is helping farmers recover without waiting for lengthy damage assessments.
paras.zh: 一项创新的保险计划正在帮助农民恢复健康，而无需等待漫长的损失评估。

paras.en: Known as parametric insurance, it provides payouts when predefined conditions, such as wind speed or rainfall, are reached.
paras.zh: 它被称为参数保险，当达到预定义条件（例如风速或降雨量）时提供赔付。

paras.en: Sinja Buri, from the United Nations University Institute for Environment and Human Security, explained why speed matters.
paras.zh: 联合国大学环境与人类安全研究所的 Sinja Buri 解释了速度为何如此重要。

paras.en: “The longer it takes for him to receive support, the longer it will take to recover. And the costs will even be higher,” she said.
paras.zh: “他获得支持的时间越长，恢复的时间就越长。而且成本也会更高，”她说。

paras.en: The programme operates across eight Pacific countries, with tens of thousands of people benefiting so far.
paras.zh: 该计划在八个太平洋国家开展，迄今为止已有数万人受益。

paras.en: But tackling climate change is not just about spending money.
paras.zh: 但应对气候变化不仅仅是花钱。

paras.en: “Climate action is a good investment and it is profitable,” Hunter Lovins, founder of the NGO Natural Capitalism Solutions, told UN News.
paras.zh: “气候行动是一项很好的投资，而且是有利可图的，”非政府组织自然资本主义解决方案创始人亨特·洛文斯告诉联合国新闻。

paras.en: With fuel prices soaring in the United States, Ms. Lovins pointed to her own electric car, charged by solar panels at home, as an example of how renewable energy can cut costs and reduce dependence on volatile oil prices.
paras.zh: 随着美国燃油价格的飙升，洛文斯女士以她自己的电动汽车为例，该汽车由家里的太阳能电池板充电，作为可再生能源如何降低成本并减少对波动油价的依赖的例子。

paras.en: She has also seen its benefits during a disaster. When floods cut off her community in Colorado and left neighbours without electricity for more than a week, her home solar-powered home remained. Neighbours even brought their frozen food to her freezer.
paras.zh: 她还在灾难期间看到了它的好处。当洪水切断了她在科罗拉多州的社区并导致邻居断电一个多星期时，她家的太阳能房屋仍然存在。邻居甚至把冷冻食品送到她的冰箱里。

paras.en: “This is real security in your community,” she said.
paras.zh: “这才是社区真正的安全，”她说。

paras.en: Ms. Lovins now helps organize community-led climate initiatives with more than 1,000 organizers across 57 countries, encouraging people to adopt solutions without waiting for governments.
paras.zh: Lovins 女士现在帮助 57 个国家的 1,000 多名组织者组织社区主导的气候倡议，鼓励人们采取解决方案，而无需等待政府。

paras.en: “You don't have to wait on a government. Let’s do it.”
paras.zh: “你不必等待政府。让我们去做吧。”

paras.en: An emotional farewell with a rallying cry
paras.zh: 带着战斗口号的情感告别

paras.en: Elsewhere at COP31, the spirit of the protests found its way into a plenary hall, where civil society representatives had gathered to bid farewell to Mr. Guterres at his last climate summit as UN Secretary-General.
paras.zh: 在 COP31 的其他地方，抗议精神进入了全体会议厅，民间社会代表聚集在一起，向古特雷斯先生作为联合国秘书长的最后一次气候峰会告别。

paras.en: For nearly a decade, they said, he had been their “champion”, “the best spokesperson they could have wished for”. And they wanted him to know it.
paras.zh: 他们说，近十年来，他一直是他们的“冠军”、“他们所希望的最好的代言人”。他们希望他知道这一点。

paras.en: There was a “Make Polluters Pay” award, an emotional standing ovation and even an invitation to return to a future COP wearing an NGO badge, this time as one of them.
paras.zh: 有一个“让污染者付出代价”奖，全场起立鼓掌，甚至还邀请佩戴非政府组织徽章的未来缔约方会议再次出席，这次是作为其中之一。

paras.en: The gathering soon took on the familiar sounds of a climate demonstration. Cries of “Make polluters pay!” echoed around the room, joined by another chant: “SG! SG! SG!”
paras.zh: 集会很快就出现了熟悉的气候示威声音。 “让污染者付出代价！”的呼喊房间里回响着，伴随着另一声呼喊：“SG！SG！SG！”

paras.en: Mr. Guterres, visibly moved by the reception, returned to the issue that had dominated the day. Fossil fuel companies, he argued, should be taxed on their extraordinary profits to help those suffering from a crisis they did little to cause.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生显然被这次招待会所感动，他又回到了当天主导的问题。他认为，化石燃料公司应该对其超额利润征税，以帮助那些遭受他们未曾造成的危机的人们。

paras.en: “We face lobbies. We face powers that are putting pressure on governments,” he warned, urging activists to keep up the pressure of their own.
paras.zh: “我们面临着游说团体。我们面临着向政府施加压力的权力，”他警告说，并敦促活动人士继续施加自己的压力。

paras.en: As the UN chief prepared to leave his final COP, the message ringing through the hall was clear. The battle for climate justice will go on, and Mr. Guterres “will not stop fighting”.
paras.zh: 当联合国秘书长准备离开他的最后一次缔约方会议时，大厅里响起的信息是明确的。气候正义之战将继续下去，古特雷斯先生“不会停止战斗”。

paras.en: - Adaptation finance: Countries disagree over how to measure progress towards tripling funding by 2035, including which baseline to use.
paras.zh: - 适应融资：各国对于如何衡量到 2035 年资金增加两倍的进展情况存在分歧，包括使用哪个基准。

paras.en: - Who pays?: Developing countries want stronger commitments from wealthy nations, while others favour mobilizing private investment.
paras.zh: - 谁付钱？：发展中国家希望富裕国家做出更强有力的承诺，而其他国家则倾向于动员私人投资。

paras.en: - Loss and Damage: Negotiators remain divided over predictable funding and assistance for vulnerable communities.
paras.zh: - 损失和损害：谈判者对于为弱势社区提供可预测的资金和援助仍存在分歧。

paras.en: - Political Outcome: The COP31 Presidency has circulated proposals for a possible final agreement, with finance and fossil fuels among the unresolved issues.
paras.zh: - 政治结果：COP31 主席团已分发了可能达成最终协议的提案，其中未解决的问题包括金融和化石燃料问题。

articles.title: Security Council LIVE: Fragile Gulf calm tested as threats to Hormuz shipping mount

paras.en: Security Council LIVE: Fragile Gulf calm tested as threats to Hormuz shipping mount
paras.zh: 安理会直播：随着霍尔木兹航运面临的威胁加剧，脆弱的海湾平静受到考验

paras.en: Nearly nine months after Israeli and US strikes on Iran set off a regional war, the Gulf remains on a knife edge. Iran has all but closed the Strait of Hormuz, which carried a fifth of the world’s oil before the conflict. Attacks on shipping are rising, and efforts to stop a return to full-scale fighting have yet to produce a deal. The Security Council meets shortly at Bahrain’s request to discuss the threat to regional and maritime security. Follow live below – and for full meetings coverage year round, go here.
paras.zh: 以色列和美国对伊朗的袭击引发地区战争近九个月后，海湾地区仍处于危险边缘。伊朗几乎关闭了霍尔木兹海峡，该海峡在冲突前运载着世界五分之一的石油。对航运的袭击不断增加，阻止全面战斗重新爆发的努力尚未达成协议。应巴林的要求，安理会不久将召开会议，讨论对地区和海上安全的威胁。关注下面的实时直播 - 要了解全年的完整会议报道，请访问此处。

paras.en: - The war began on 28 February. Iran then struck US military assets and other targets in six Gulf States and Jordan
paras.zh: - 战争于 2 月 28 日开始。伊朗随后袭击了美国在六个海湾国家和约旦的军事资产和其他目标

paras.en: - In March, the council adopted resolution 2817, which condemned Iran’s attacks and its threats to navigation. China and Russia abstained

paras.en: - A 60-day US–Iran ceasefire, mediated by Pakistan in June, lapsed in August without a peace deal
