articles.title: Ravens quarterback Jackson to miss up to 10 weeks with thumb injury

paras.en: NFL: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson to miss up to 10 weeks with broken and dislocated thumb
paras.zh: NFL：巴尔的摩乌鸦队四分卫拉马尔·杰克逊因拇指骨折脱臼将缺席长达 10 周

paras.en: Lamar Jackson will miss between six and 10 weeks with a broken and dislocated thumb; Jackson suffered the injury on his first play from scrimmage in Baltimore's 36-10 loss to Buffalo Bills; quarterback could still return this season should Baltimore make playoffs
paras.zh: 拉马尔·杰克逊因拇指骨折脱臼将缺席六到十周；杰克逊在巴尔的摩以 36-10 输给布法罗比尔队的比赛中的混战中受伤，这是他第一次上场比赛时受伤的。如果巴尔的摩进入季后赛，四分卫本赛季仍可能回归

paras.en: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson will miss between six and 10 weeks as he recovers from a broken and dislocated thumb.
paras.zh: 巴尔的摩乌鸦队四分卫拉马尔·杰克逊因拇指骨折脱臼康复，将缺席六到十周的时间。

paras.en: Jackson suffered the injury on his first play from scrimmage in Baltimore's 36-10 loss to Buffalo Bills when his throwing hand was hit by pass rusher Greg Rousseau, but could still return this season if the struggling Ravens can get back into the postseason picture.
paras.zh: 巴尔的摩队以 36-10 输给布法罗比尔队的比赛中，杰克逊在他的第一次比赛中受伤，当时他的投球手被冲传手格雷格·卢梭击中，但如果苦苦挣扎的乌鸦队能够重返季后赛，他仍然可能在本赛季回归。

paras.en: "Recovery timelines are challenging to predict, but injuries like this that require surgery typically take about 6-10 weeks to heal," said Baltimore head coach Jesse Minter.
paras.zh: 巴尔的摩主教练杰西·明特表示：“恢复时间很难预测，但像这样需要手术的伤病通常需要大约 6 到 10 周才能愈合。”

articles.title: Riley determined to prove himself a world champion in waiting

paras.en: Viddal Riley determined to prove himself a world champion in waiting in European title fight against Seydi Coupe
paras.zh: 维达尔·莱利 (Viddal Riley) 决心在与 Seydi Coupe 的欧洲冠军争夺战中证明自己是世界冠军

paras.en: Viddal Riley puts the European title on the line against Seydi Coupe on Saturday; "I won't be disappointed if I don't stop him. I'll be disappointed if I don't batter him," Riley said; Victory should see Riley closing in on a world title shot
paras.zh: 周六，维达尔·莱利 (Viddal Riley) 对阵塞迪·库佩 (Seydi Coupe)，将争夺欧洲冠军。 “如果我不阻止他，我不会失望。如果我不殴打他，我会感到失望，”莱利说。胜利应该让莱利接近世界冠军

paras.en: Viddal Riley will put himself on a path to a cruiserweight world title shot, if he can defend the European championship against Seydi Coupe on Saturday.
paras.zh: 如果维达尔·莱利能够在周六对阵塞迪·库佩的比赛中卫冕欧洲冠军，他将踏上通往轻量级世界冠军的道路。

paras.en: Only 14 fights into his pro career, Riley is already rated as the IBF's No. 2 contender for their world championship.
paras.zh: 莱利的职业生涯仅打了 14 场比赛，就已被评为 IBF 世界冠军的第二号竞争者。

paras.en: The Londoner wants to showcase himself as a world champion in waiting against Coupe.
paras.zh: 这位伦敦人希望在与 Coupe 的比赛中展示自己作为世界冠军的实力。

paras.en: "I think I'm the most well-rounded cruiserweight in the world," Riley told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: “我认为我是世界上最全面的轻量级选手，”莱利告诉天空体育。

paras.en: "I think we've trained for that because we want to cover every aspect of the game. We don't want to be lacking any area when it comes to movement, speed, IQ. All these things, I have them."
paras.zh: “我认为我们已经为此进行了训练，因为我们想要涵盖比赛的各个方面。我们不想在移动、速度、智商方面缺少任何方面。所有这些东西，我都有。”

paras.en: The IBF belt is currently vacant with Riley and New Zealand's David Nyika ranked one and two. Sooner or later a world title fight would surely lie ahead of Riley, if he's victorious.
paras.zh: IBF金腰带目前空缺，莱利和新西兰选手大卫·尼卡排名第一和第二。如果莱利获胜的话，世界冠军争夺战迟早会摆在他面前。

paras.en: "He's in the way. We can't worry about the other side of the door until we get past the doorman," Riley said of Coupe.
paras.zh: “他挡住了路。在经过门卫之前，我们不能担心门的另一边，”莱利谈到库普时说道。

paras.en: "I'm trying to get in the club, Seydi's asking for my ID at the door, I have to show him my ID or pull him out the way and get into the club."
paras.zh: “我正试图进入俱乐部，塞迪在门口索要我的身份证，我必须向他出示我的身份证，或者把他拉出来并进入俱乐部。”

paras.en: It's a fight Riley is determined to dominate.
paras.zh: 莱利决心在这场战斗中占据主导地位。

paras.en: "I believe this will be a stoppage victory," the Londoner said. "You can't stop everybody, I'm aware of that as well. I won't be disappointed per se if I don't stop him. I'll be disappointed if I don't batter him.
paras.zh: “我相信这将是一场补时胜利，”伦敦人说。 “你无法阻止所有人，我也知道这一点。如果我不阻止他，我本身不会失望。如果我不殴打他，我会感到失望。

paras.en: "I just want to show for 12 rounds at least, it's not the level. We're completely different levels and I do, contrary to belief, possess good punch power."
paras.zh: “我只是想至少展示12回合，这不是水平。我们完全不同的水平，与我的信念相反，我确实拥有良好的拳击力量。”

articles.title: U.S. moves military aircraft from British base amid Iran threats
articles.author: Chantal Da Silva

paras.en: LONDON — The United States has moved military aircraft from an air base in the United Kingdom amid threats from Iran.
paras.zh: 伦敦——在伊朗的威胁下，美国已将军用飞机从英国的一个空军基地撤出。

paras.en: A U.S. official confirmed to NBC News that several military aircraft had left RAF Mildenhall as the security posture there had increased.
paras.zh: 一名美国官员向 NBC 新闻证实，随着英国皇家空军米尔登霍尔机场的安全态势加强，几架军用飞机已离开该机场。

paras.en: They were operating under “enhanced force protection measures,” the official said. The official would not speculate on the exact nature of the threat that appears to have led to ramped-up security.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示，他们是在“强化的部队保护措施”下行动的。这位官员不愿猜测似乎导致安全升级的威胁的确切性质。

paras.en: At least eight air refueling tankers and three Osprey tilt-rotor aircraft left the base in Suffolk, eastern England, on Monday, flight tracking data showed.
paras.zh: 飞行跟踪数据显示，至少八架空中加油机和三架鱼鹰倾转旋翼机周一离开英格兰东部萨福克的基地。

paras.en: Some of the tankers, Boeing KC-135 Stratotankers, were relocated to air bases in Germany and Spain, with one moved to the area of Glasgow Prestwick Airport in Scotland. The Ospreys were moved to nearby RAF Lakenheath in Suffolk.
paras.zh: 部分波音 KC-135 Stratotankers 加油机被转移到德国和西班牙的空军基地，其中一架转移到苏格兰格拉斯哥普雷斯蒂克机场地区。鱼鹰被转移到萨福克郡附近的英国皇家空军拉肯希思基地。

paras.en: It comes weeks after the U.S. withdrew bombers from another base in Britain, RAF Fairford, after police foiled a suspected terrorist plot linked to Iran. The U.S. has used bases in the U.K. to strike Iran.
paras.zh: 几周前，美国警方挫败了与伊朗有关的可疑恐怖分子阴谋，并从英国皇家空军费尔福德基地撤出了轰炸机。美国利用英国基地打击伊朗。

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal, which was first to report on this week’s movements, said the evacuation came following a threat from Iran, citing people familiar with the matter. It said that the exact nature of the threat was not yet known and that it remained under discussion by U.S. officials.
paras.zh: 最先报道本周动向的《华尔街日报》援引知情人士的话称，此次撤离是在伊朗发出威胁后进行的。声明称，威胁的确切性质尚不清楚，美国官员仍在讨论中。

paras.en: “We take proactive measures to ensure our aircraft, our people and our installations remain safe and secure,” a U.S. official told NBC News.
paras.zh: 一名美国官员告诉 NBC 新闻：“我们采取积极措施，确保我们的飞机、人员和设施保持安全。”

paras.en: A U.S. European Command official said: “U.S. Air Force aircraft rotate between installations and operating locations for a variety of reasons including training and real world requirement. U.S. military aircraft are hosted in accordance with access, basing, and overflight agreements with our Allies and partners. Due to operations security, we will not provide further information on movement of assets.”
paras.zh: 美国欧洲司令部一名官员表示：“美国空军飞机出于各种原因在设施和作战地点之间轮换，包括训练和现实世界的要求。美国军用飞机的驻留是根据与我们的盟友和合作伙伴签订的准入、基地和飞越协议进行的。出于运营安全考虑，我们不会提供有关资产移动的进一步信息。”

paras.en: A spokesperson for the U.K. Defense Ministry said it does “not routinely comment on the activity of other nations.”
paras.zh: 英国国防部发言人表示，英国国防部“不会经常对其他国家的活动发表评论”。

paras.en: “Aircraft and other assets move regularly according to operational requirements,” the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: “飞机和其他资产根据运营要求定期移动，”发言人说。

paras.en: The U.S. pulled aircraft from RAF Fairford last month following reports of a possible Iranian drone attack, two U.S. officials have told NBC News. That move came in the wake of an investigation into a possible planned terrorist attack at the base, which is in Gloucestershire.
paras.zh: 两名美国官员告诉 NBC 新闻，在有报道称伊朗可能发动无人机袭击后，美国上个月从英国皇家空军费尔福德撤走了飞机。此举是在对位于格洛斯特郡的基地可能策划的恐怖袭击进行调查之后做出的。

paras.en: Five men were detained on Sept. 27 after three suspicious vans were spotted traveling toward RAF Fairford. Other arrests followed, and two men were charged under the National Security Act.
paras.zh: 9 月 27 日，三辆可疑货车被发现驶向英国皇家空军费尔福德机场，五名男子被拘留。随后又逮捕了其他人，并根据《国家安全法》对两名男子提出指控。

paras.en: The incident, which attracted huge international attention, remains largely unexplained, although British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said the activity was likely to have been coordinated in Iran.
paras.zh: 尽管英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示，这一事件很可能是在伊朗协调的，但这一事件引起了国际社会的广泛关注，但很大程度上仍无法解释。

paras.en: Though Tehran has denied involvement in any plot against RAF Fairford, its powerful Revolutionary Guard warned in July that any base used to launch attacks against Iranian territory was a legitimate target.
paras.zh: 尽管德黑兰否认参与了任何针对皇家空军费尔福德的阴谋，但其强大的革命卫队在 7 月警告称，任何用于对伊朗领土发动袭击的基地都是合法目标。

paras.en: Iran has vowed to retaliate for any renewal of the American-Israeli war against it and has threatened to expand its response beyond the Middle East.
paras.zh: 伊朗发誓将对美国和以色列再次发动战争进行报复，并威胁要将其反应范围扩大到中东以外的地区。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Monday that Washington had addressed concerns about reported threats from Tehran against American diplomats overseas by “moving people away from the threat.”
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周一表示，华盛顿已经通过“让人们远离威胁”来解决有关德黑兰针对美国海外外交官的威胁的担忧。

paras.en: “Obviously, we’re always worried about the safety and security of our personnel and their families overseas,” Rubio said. “And so, when we see anything that could pose a potential threat beyond a certain threshold, we’re going to address it.”
paras.zh: 卢比奥说：“显然，我们一直担心海外人员及其家人的安全。” “因此，当我们看到任何可能构成超过一定阈值的潜在威胁时，我们将予以解决。”

paras.en: Citing new “momentum” in negotiations to end the war, President Donald Trump downplayed the prospect of new U.S. attacks Monday.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周一以结束战争谈判的新“势头”为由，淡化了美国发动新袭击的可能性。

paras.en: “Iran militarily is effectively over,” Trump said after a meeting with Qatar’s prime minister, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani.
paras.zh: 特朗普在与卡塔尔首相谢赫·穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜拉赫曼·阿勒萨尼会面后表示，“伊朗的军事行动实际上已经结束”。

paras.en: Further U.S. attacks “won’t be necessary” at this point, but Washington remains “locked and loaded” should circumstances change, Trump told reporters at the White House.
paras.zh: 特朗普在白宫对记者表示，美国目前“没有必要”发动进一步的袭击，但如果情况发生变化，华盛顿仍将“锁定并上膛”。

articles.title: Microsoft services hit by major outage across the world
articles.author: Steve Kopack

paras.en: A massive global outage impacting more than a dozen Microsoft cloud services, including Outlook email and Teams messaging stretched into Friday as the tech giant struggled to restore the service, which is critical to the day-to-day functions of governments, schools and businesses around the world.
paras.zh: 全球范围内的大规模宕机影响了包括 Outlook 电子邮件和 Teams 消息传递在内的十多项微软云服务，该服务一直持续到周五，这家科技巨头正在努力恢复该服务，而该服务对于世界各地政府、学校和企业的日常运作至关重要。

paras.en: Starting around 12:50 p.m. ET Thursday, Microsoft began warning users of its products on social media that it was “investigating reports of users experiencing issues accessing Exchange Online,” its cloud email service.
paras.zh: 中午 12:50 左右开始美国东部时间周四，微软开始在社交媒体上警告其产品的用户，称其正在“调查用户在访问其云电子邮件服务 Exchange Online 时遇到问题的报告”。

paras.en: By the time workers were arriving at the office on Friday morning, Microsoft said it was still working on the problem.
paras.zh: 当周五早上工作人员到达办公室时，微软表示仍在解决该问题。

paras.en: Microsoft said in its latest update about 7 a.m. ET that it was seeing “encouraging recovery progress in Europe, with service availability and email delivery performance improving across a growing portion of affected Microsoft 365 infrastructure. “
paras.zh: 微软在美国东部时间上午 7 点左右的最新更新中表示，“欧洲的恢复进展令人鼓舞，受影响的 Microsoft 365 基础设施中越来越多的部分的服务可用性和电子邮件传送性能都得到了改善。”

paras.en: It added that “North America is also improving; however, some users may still experience intermittent issues as recovery actions continue.”
paras.zh: 它补充说，“北美地区也在改善；但是，随着恢复行动的继续，一些用户可能仍然会遇到间歇性问题。”

paras.en: Hours earlier the tech giant had warned that attempts “to improve serviceability” were “not taking as expected,” it said in an update on X overnight.
paras.zh: 几小时前，这家科技巨头在 X 隔夜更新中警告称，“提高可维护性”的尝试“没有达到预期”。

paras.en: Some on the social media platform derided the technical responses, or hoped email would be down Friday for a possible day off.
paras.zh: 社交媒体平台上的一些人嘲笑了技术回应，或者希望周五能关闭电子邮件，以便可能休息一天。

paras.en: There are few products as pervasive inside global companies as Outlook email.
paras.zh: 很少有产品像 Outlook 电子邮件一样在跨国公司中如此普及。

paras.en: Email traffic to many of the tech giant’s 450 million users came to a halt around midday, with email programs freezing and crashing, and mobile devices unable to refresh inboxes or send messages.
paras.zh: 这家科技巨头 4.5 亿用户中的许多用户的电子邮件流量在中午左右停止，电子邮件程序冻结和崩溃，移动设备无法刷新收件箱或发送消息。

paras.en: The problems also affected Microsoft’s non-commercial consumer products, according to a notice on its website. “This issue impacts Outlook.com, OneDrive, OneNote To Do, Teams, and Microsoft 365 for the web.”
paras.zh: 根据微软网站上的通知，这些问题还影响了微软的非商业消费产品。 “此问题影响 Outlook.com、OneDrive、OneNote To Do、Teams 和 Microsoft 365 网页版。”

paras.en: Throughout the day the problems spread. As of 11 p.m. ET on Thursday, Microsoft’s online status pages said its corporate services Exchange Online, Copilot, Microsoft Planner, Sharepoint, Microsoft To Do, Windows 365, cloud printing services, and mobile device management programs were all experiencing issues.
paras.zh: 一整天，问题都在蔓延。截至晚上 11 点美国东部时间周四，微软的在线状态页面表示，其企业服务 Exchange Online、Copilot、Microsoft Planner、Sharepoint、Microsoft To Do、Windows 365、云打印服务和移动设备管理程序都遇到了问题。

paras.en: The problem caused chaos in workplaces around the world. At one, truck manufacturer Workhouse Group, it forced the company to delay its earnings report which was set to be released on Thursday afternoon.
paras.zh: 这个问题在世界各地的工作场所造成了混乱。其中之一是卡车制造商 Workhouse Group，它迫使该公司推迟原定于周四下午发布的收益报告。

paras.en: In a statement, Workhorse said: “The rescheduling is due to business disruptions caused by the global Microsoft outages taking place today.”
paras.zh: Workhorse 在一份声明中表示：“此次重新安排是由于微软今天发生的全球服务中断导致业务中断。”

paras.en: The Los Angeles County Medical Examiner’s Office, the L.A. County Sheriff’s Department and other government agencies in California said their communications were impacted by the outage, NBC Los Angeles reported. In Washington, email services at federal agencies and on Capitol Hill were impacted.
paras.zh: 据 NBC Los Angeles 报道，洛杉矶县法医办公室、洛杉矶县治安部门和加州其他政府机构表示，他们的通信受到了此次故障的影响。在华盛顿，联邦机构和国会山的电子邮件服务受到影响。

paras.en: In Colorado, the Arapahoe County Sheriff’s Office said the outage was affecting online bond payments for people being held in its detention facility. “Until Outlook email is restored, anyone needing to post bond for immediate release must do so in person at the jail,” it said on social media.
paras.zh: 在科罗拉多州，阿拉帕霍县治安官办公室表示，停电影响了拘留设施中被关押人员的在线押金支付。它在社交媒体上表示：“在 Outlook 电子邮件恢复之前，任何需要交纳保证金以立即获释的人都必须亲自到监狱办理。”

paras.en: Throughout most of the day, Microsoft has said it has been working on the issue. By 2:50 p.m. ET, the company wrote on social media that it was “testing a configuration change” to its cloud servers in order to try to restore services.
paras.zh: 微软在一天的大部分时间里都表示，它一直在研究这个问题。下午 2:50 之前东部时间，该公司在社交媒体上写道，它正在对其云服务器“测试配置更改”，以尝试恢复服务。

paras.en: By 4:40 p.m. ET, the company said it was restarting “affected servers to return them to service.”
paras.zh: 下午 4:40 之前东部时间，该公司表示正在重新启动“受影响的服务器以使其恢复服务”。

paras.en: Microsoft explained a few minutes later in another post on X that a “core process on affected servers is becoming overwhelmed, causing capacity loss.”
paras.zh: 几分钟后，微软在 X 上的另一篇文章中解释说，“受影响服务器上的核心进程正在变得不堪重负，导致容量损失。”

paras.en: The company also said it was “shifting traffic” around in order to relieve overwhelmed servers that remained online.
paras.zh: 该公司还表示，正在“转移流量”，以缓解仍处于在线状态的不堪重负的服务器。

paras.en: But then not long after, the company again said, “The servers we returned to service can become unresponsive again once they receive traffic; we’re analyzing diagnostic data to determine what’s triggering the behavior.”
paras.zh: 但不久之后，该公司再次表示，“我们恢复服务的服务器一旦收到流量，可能会再次变得无响应；我们正在分析诊断数据，以确定是什么触发了该行为。”

paras.en: The updates continued into the night. At 11:36 p.m., Microsoft said it its efforts to improve server stability were ongoing, but that while it was “observing partial recovery across regions in which we’ve applied these adjustments” that didn’t result in “sustained recovery.”
paras.zh: 更新一直持续到晚上。晚上 11 点 36 分，微软表示，其提高服务器稳定性的努力仍在继续，但虽然它“观察到我们应用这些调整的地区的部分恢复情况”，但并没有带来“持续恢复”。

paras.en: NBC News attempted to reach Microsoft representatives through multiple phone numbers listed on the company’s press releases and through a phone number to its investor relations department, however the company has not commented in response.
paras.zh: NBC 新闻试图通过该公司新闻稿中列出的多个电话号码以及投资者关系部门的电话号码联系微软代表，但该公司尚未做出回应。

paras.en: An email sent to a public relations firm that represents Microsoft from a personal non-Outlook or Microsoft based email address quickly bounced back, with an error message reading that the server was “unavailable or unable to receive mail.”
paras.zh: 从个人非 Outlook 或基于 Microsoft 的电子邮件地址发送到代表 Microsoft 的公关公司的电子邮件很快被退回，并显示一条错误消息，指出服务器“不可用或无法接收邮件”。

paras.en: In a statement to Bloomberg News, a Microsoft spokesperson said: “We appreciate our customers’ patience while we work to restore services as soon as possible.”
paras.zh: 微软发言人在给彭博新闻社的一份声明中表示：“我们感谢客户的耐心等待，我们将努力尽快恢复服务。”

paras.en: Major outages, such as Microsoft’s, are not unprecedented but have become increasingly rare. In 2024, a glitch with a security program led to Windows devices around the world freezing, causing them displaying Microsoft’s well-known “blue screen of death” error. That issue brought airlines, companies, and critical systems to a halt.
paras.zh: 像微软这样的重大中断并非史无前例，但已经变得越来越罕见。 2024 年，安全程序的故障导致世界各地的 Windows 设备死机，导致它们显示微软著名的“蓝屏死机”错误。该问题导致航空公司、公司和关键系统陷入瘫痪。

paras.en: Some of Microsoft’s other critical cloud services, such as its Azure cloud computing platform, that powers many websites and apps, remained online and did not have any additional issues.
paras.zh: 微软的一些其他关键云服务，例如为许多网站和应用程序提供支持的 Azure 云计算平台，仍然保持在线状态，没有出现任何其他问题。

articles.title: Pope Leo makes emotional return to his ‘beloved diocese of Chiclayo’
articles.author: Corky Siemaszko

paras.en: LIMA, Peru — Pope Leo XIV made a triumphant return Friday to the Peruvian city of Chiclayo, where he served as bishop for eight years and was affectionately nicknamed “Padre Roberto.”
paras.zh: 秘鲁利马——周五，教皇利奥十四世凯旋返回秘鲁城市奇克拉约，他在那里担任主教八年，被亲切地称为“罗伯托神父”。

paras.en: Leo arrived in a plane decorated with “#LeoXFliesHome” stickers and he was greeted with a sign at the airport bearing the same message. A small dance troupe performed before him as he stepped off the plane.
paras.zh: Leo 乘坐的飞机上装饰着“#LeoXFliesHome”贴纸，在机场迎接他的是带有相同信息的标牌。当他走下飞机时，一个小型舞蹈团在他面前表演。

paras.en: He will stay in the area until Sunday to lead eight events, including a private dinner with the priests who once reported to him as bishop.
paras.zh: 他将留在该地区直到周日，领导八项活动，包括与曾经向他报告主教的神父们举行私人晚宴。

paras.en: The crowds greeting Leo in Peru’s fourth-largest city will likely be smaller than the estimated 3 million or so who welcomed the pope when he arrived Wednesday in Lima, the country’s capital.
paras.zh: 在秘鲁第四大城市迎接利奥的人群可能比周三教皇抵达该国首都利马时预计的 300 万人左右要少。

paras.en: But their enthusiasm more than made up for their smaller numbers as the former Bishop Robert Prevost of Chiclayo returned to this coastal city of nearly 700,000 as the leader of the Catholic Church.
paras.zh: 但随着奇克拉约前主教罗伯特·普雷沃斯特作为天主教会领袖回到这座拥有近 70 万人口的沿海城市，他们的热情足以弥补人数较少的问题。

paras.en: As he toured in an open-air popemobile at the Pampas de Pimentel, a vast desert plain just outside Chiclayo, the crowd erupted in cheers, many waving white-and-yellow Vatican flags.
paras.zh: 当他乘坐露天教皇专车在奇克拉约郊外的潘帕斯皮门特尔沙漠平原巡演时，人群爆发出欢呼声，许多人挥舞着白色和黄色的梵蒂冈旗帜。

paras.en: Some had been waiting since last night to catch a glimpse of the pontiff, many of them forced to walk as lines of cars had blocked the roads where vendors sold hats, mini pope dolls and sweet Peruvian bread.
paras.zh: 有些人从昨晚起就一直在等待一睹教皇的风采，其中许多人被迫步行，因为道路被汽车堵塞，小贩们在那里出售帽子、迷你教皇玩偶和秘鲁甜面包。

paras.en: Maria Esther Chozo Reyes, 76, said she had taken a 12-hour bus ride from Lima and arrived Thursday afternoon before she camped overnight. “He knows the people of Chiclayo and he’s lived here, he’s made his mission here,” she told The Associated Press. “We really need his blessing.”
paras.zh: 76 岁的玛丽亚·埃丝特·乔佐·雷耶斯 (Maria Esther Chozo Reyes) 说，她从利马乘坐 12 小时的巴士抵达周四下午，然后露营过夜。 “他了解奇克拉约的人民，他住在这里，他在这里完成了他的使命，”她告诉美联社。 “我们真的需要他的祝福。”

paras.en: Thanking the people for their love and support, in his sermon Leo said it was a blessing to be in his former home.
paras.zh: 利奥在布道中感谢人们的爱和支持，他说能够回到他以前的家是一件幸事。

paras.en: “As I look at your faces, a prayer of thanksgiving to the Lord arises in my heart for the blessing you have been and continue to be in my life,” he said, adding that his lung cancer diagnosis and surgery to remove part of one lung exactly a month ago had been a time of trial.
paras.zh: 他说：“当我看着你们的脸时，我心里升起了对上帝的感恩祈祷，感谢你们一直并继续在我的生命中赐福。”他补充说，一个月前他被诊断出患有肺癌，并接受了部分肺切除手术，这对他来说是一段考验的时期。

paras.en: Leo’s sojourn to Chiclayo is midway through the final leg of his 12-day visit to South America, a historic trip that included stops in Argentina and Uruguay. And it’s the most sentimental part of his journey.
paras.zh: Leo 对奇克拉约的逗留正处于他为期 12 天的南美洲之行的最后一站，这次历史性的旅行包括在阿根廷和乌拉圭停留。这是他旅程中最感伤的部分。

paras.en: For while Leo was born in Chicago and English is his mother tongue, the first words he uttered from the balcony of St. Peter’s Basilica were a shoutout in Spanish to his “beloved Diocese of Chiclayo.”
paras.zh: 虽然利奥出生在芝加哥，英语是他的母语，但他在圣彼得大教堂的阳台上说的第一句话是用西班牙语向他“心爱的奇克拉约教区”喊叫。

paras.en: During his time in that city, Leo often repeated a joke: “Chicago, Chiclayo, what difference is there? Only one letter.”
paras.zh: 在这座城市期间，利奥经常重复一个笑话：“芝加哥，奇克拉约，有什么区别？只有一个字母。”

paras.en: Setting aside the fact that it’s actually two letters, Leo quickly became a beloved figure in Chiclayo by championing social justice issues, embracing the poor and venturing into the local prison to say Mass.
paras.zh: 抛开这实际上是两个字母的事实不谈，利奥很快就成为奇克拉约受人爱戴的人物，他倡导社会正义问题，拥抱穷人，并冒险进入当地监狱做弥撒。

paras.en: During the pandemic, Leo endeared himself to many by launching a fundraising drive to raise money for a badly-needed oxygen production plant.
paras.zh: 在大流行期间，利奥发起了一项筹款活动，为急需的制氧厂筹集资金，赢得了许多人的喜爱。

paras.en: When Cyclone Maku hit the area in March 2023, Leo was photographed wading through the floodwaters to get supplies to the destitute and distributing food at soup kitchens.
paras.zh: 2023 年 3 月，当飓风“马库”袭击该地区时，Leo 被拍到趟过洪水，为穷人获取物资，并在施粥处分发食物。

paras.en: At Christmastime, Leo would drive a pickup truck laden with gifts into remote villages around Chiclayo and join family celebrations.
paras.zh: 圣诞节期间，利奥会驾驶一辆满载礼物的皮卡车前往奇克拉约周围的偏远村庄，参加家庭庆祝活动。

paras.en: Leo spent two decades as a missionary, priest and finally as a bishop in Peru and became a citizen in 2015. During his two decades in the country, he was also a strident critic of then- Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori’s authoritarian regime.
paras.zh: 利奥在秘鲁担任传教士、神父，最后成为主教，并于 2015 年成为公民。在秘鲁的 20 年间，他也是当时秘鲁总统阿尔贝托·藤森独裁政权的尖锐批评者。

paras.en: The return to his former adoptive home after adjusting to life at the Vatican appeared to lead to an amusing moment of confusion for the multilingual pontiff in Lima earlier on Friday, as he mistakenly began to deliver remarks in Italian, before correcting himself and switching to Spanish.
paras.zh: 周五早些时候，在适应了梵蒂冈的生活后，回到了他以前的收养家庭，这似乎给利马的多语言教宗带来了一个有趣的困惑时刻，因为他错误地开始用意大利语发表讲话，然后纠正自己并改用西班牙语。

paras.en: “Oh, sorry, I’m speaking Italian,” he told the crowd. “Here, at home, and I’m speaking Italian.”
paras.zh: “哦，抱歉，我说的是意大利语，”他对人群说道。 “在这里，在家里，我说的是意大利语。”

paras.en: On Thursday, Leo delivered a speech while sitting beside Fujimori’s daughter, recently-elected Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori, at Lima’s Gran Teatro Nacional performing arts center.
paras.zh: 周四，里奥在利马国家大剧院表演艺术中心发表讲话，坐在藤森的女儿、最近当选的秘鲁总统藤森惠子旁边。

paras.en: Leo urged the country’s leaders to cultivate honesty and integrity to strengthen public trust --- and called on officeholders to listen to their constituents.
paras.zh: 利奥敦促国家领导人培养诚实和正直，以增强公众信任，并呼吁官员倾听选民的声音。

paras.en: “Today I understand how much of this land remains with me and how much of my own story also belongs to you,” Leo said.
paras.zh: “今天我明白了这片土地有多少属于我，我自己的故事也有多少属于你，”利奥说。

paras.en: There was thunderous applause when Leo referred to Peru as “my homeland.”
paras.zh: 当利奥称秘鲁为“我的祖国”时，全场响起雷鸣般的掌声。

paras.en: And Leo appeared to have tears in his eyes as he sang the Peruvian national anthem along with a children’s choir.
paras.zh: 里奥与儿童合唱团一起唱秘鲁国歌时，眼里似乎含着泪水。

paras.en: Claudio Lavanga reported from Lima and Corky Siemaszko from New York.
paras.zh: Claudio Lavanga 从利马报道，Corky Siemaszko 从纽约报道。

articles.title: Are you team car door or car bonnet? This town's history depends on your answer
articles.author: Max Tillman and Genevieve Blandin de Chalain

paras.en: Blow the layer of dust off Lightning Ridge and you will find a town as rich in colour as the precious black opal mined here.
paras.zh: 吹掉闪电山脊上的一层灰尘，您会发现一座色彩丰富的小镇，就像这里开采的珍贵黑蛋白石一样色彩丰富。

paras.en: The stone’s dark undertone is the marriage of carbon and iron oxide, brought together over millennia beneath the earth’s surface.
paras.zh: 石头的深色底色是碳和氧化铁的结合，它们在地表下数千年的时间里聚集在一起。

paras.en: It brings colour to life in a way that no other precious stone can.
paras.zh: 它以其他宝石无法比拟的方式为生活带来色彩。

paras.en: It is an exceptionally rare find, with more than 90 per cent of the world’s supply located beneath this outback moonscape.
paras.zh: 这是一个极其罕见的发现，世界上 90% 以上的供应都位于这片内陆月球景观之下。

paras.en: Great fortunes have been made and lost here on Yuwaalaraay Country in Northern NSW, where stories have become facts and truth can be just as elusive as the black opal itself.
paras.zh: 在新南威尔士州北部的尤瓦拉拉伊 (Yuwaalaraay) 乡村，人们创造了巨大的财富，也失去了巨大的财富，这里的故事已成为事实，而真相可能就像黑蛋白石本身一样难以捉摸。

paras.en: Among the corrugated iron shacks and the long-abandoned mine shafts that pockmark this land, the past is everywhere.
paras.zh: 在这片土地上遍布的波纹铁皮棚屋和废弃已久的矿井中，到处都是过去的痕迹。

paras.en: Exactly what that history is, however, depends on who's telling it.
paras.zh: 然而，这段历史到底是什么，取决于谁在讲述它。

paras.en: Barb Moritz is waiting for us in front of an old miner's cottage on the main street.
paras.zh: 巴布·莫里茨（Barb Moritz）正在主街道上一座古老的矿工小屋前等我们。

paras.en: Built in 1932, its warped pinewood beams and lopsided tin roof resemble an abstract painting.
paras.zh: 建于 1932 年，其扭曲的松木梁和倾斜的铁皮屋顶就像一幅抽象画。

paras.en: It's the headquarters of the Lightning Ridge Historical Society, and the seat from which Barb holds court.
paras.zh: 它是闪电岭历史协会的总部，也是巴布的法庭所在地。

paras.en: She emerges from the shadow of the verandah awning whirring with facts and directions, her dark eyes glowing.
paras.zh: 她从阳台遮阳篷的阴影中出现，不停地讲述着事实和方向，她的黑眼睛闪闪发光。

paras.en: Barb cuts a strikingly vibrant figure amid a palette of rusted metal and aging wood.
paras.zh: 倒钩在生锈的金属和老化的木材的调色板中塑造出引人注目的充满活力的形象。

paras.en: When she smiles, the afternoon sun catches her opal dental filling and it flashes with brilliant greens and blues.
paras.zh: 当她微笑时，午后的阳光照射到她的蛋白石牙齿填充物上，牙齿上闪烁着明亮的绿色和蓝色。

paras.en: Introductions are swift before Barb leaps into her opening stanza, fine tuned over decades of leading tour groups.
paras.zh: 介绍很快，然后巴布跳入她的开场诗节，经过数十年领先旅游团的精心调整。

paras.en: She points towards the local pool, opened by Dawn Fraser in 1990.
paras.zh: 她指着当地的游泳池，该游泳池由 Dawn Fraser 于 1990 年开设。

paras.en: The Opal Miners Hall of Fame is further out, just a few minutes' drive from the cottage.
paras.zh: 蛋白石矿工名人堂 (Opal Miners Hall of Fame) 距离小屋更远，仅几分钟车程。

paras.en: Then there's the Lightning Ridge Cemetery, or as Barb refers to it, the "dead end of town".
paras.zh: 然后是闪电岭公墓，或者正如巴布所说，“城镇的死胡同”。

paras.en: She casts us a deadpan glance and pauses for effect.
paras.zh: 她面无表情地看了我们一眼，然后停了下来以达到效果。

paras.en: Barb is a long way from the cornfields of Iowa in the American mid-west, where she grew up.
paras.zh: 巴布距离她长大的美国中西部爱荷华州的玉米地很远。

paras.en: She still isn't quite sure if she chose to move to Lightning Ridge, or if the black opal lured her.
paras.zh: 她仍然不太确定自己是否选择搬到闪电山脊，或者黑蛋白石是否诱惑了她。

paras.en: "From the very beginning, I feel I was directed to opal," she says, her accent still thick.
paras.zh: “从一开始，我就觉得我是被导向蛋白石的，”她说道，口音仍然很浓。

paras.en: Barb arrived in Lightning Ridge in the summer of 1990.
paras.zh: 1990 年夏天，Barb 抵达 Lightning Ridge。

paras.en: Three years later, she was working for the historical society.
paras.zh: 三年后，她在历史学会工作。

paras.en: "I met the people who lived here, the old-timers who built this community," she says.
paras.zh: “我遇到了住在这里的人们，以及建造这个社区的老前辈，”她说。

paras.en: "There was a time when I was communicating with a dozen octogenarians in the 1990s."
paras.zh: “在 20 世纪 90 年代，我曾与十几位八十多岁的老人交流。”

paras.en: It wasn't long before Barb was the society's secretary.
paras.zh: 不久之后，巴布就成为了协会的秘书。

paras.en: Tucked away behind the old miner's cottage is an aging demountable filled to the brim with miners' ledgers and newspaper clippings dating back more than a century.
paras.zh: 老矿工小屋后面藏着一间陈旧的可拆卸式房屋，里面装满了一个多世纪前的矿工账簿和剪报。

paras.en: It is the engine room of the historical society.
paras.zh: 它是历史社会的发动机室。

paras.en: And it's here, among the records, that Barb pieces together a version of Lightning Ridge's opal-mining evolution.
paras.zh: 正是在这里，在记录中，巴布拼凑出了闪电岭蛋白石开采演变的一个版本。

paras.en: In the late 1990s, this history was translated onto a conspicuous canvas unique to the town's identity, the "car door tours".
paras.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代末，这段历史被转化为该镇独特的显眼画布，即“车门之旅”。

paras.en: Across the featureless landscape, car doors mark out four colour-coded routes (green, red, yellow and blue) to sites the society deems significant to the town's history.
paras.zh: 在毫无特色的景观中，车门标出了四种颜色编码的路线（绿色、红色、黄色和蓝色），通往社会认为对该镇历史具有重要意义的地点。

paras.en: "People lock their car doors because they're afraid maybe one will go missing," Barb says with a glimmer in her eye.
paras.zh: “人们锁上车门，因为他们担心有人会失踪，”巴布眼中闪烁着光芒说道。

paras.en: "We're always on the scrounge for car doors."
paras.zh: “我们总是在寻找车门。”

paras.en: The doors have become much more than a tourist attraction for the droves of travellers and grey nomads who pass through.
paras.zh: 对于成群结队的旅行者和经过的灰色游牧民族来说，这些大门已经不仅仅是一个旅游景点。

paras.en: They're also used by locals and emergency services to help locate people living on claims that are well and truly off the beaten track.
paras.zh: 当地人和紧急服务部门还使用它们来帮助寻找那些真正远离人迹罕至的地方的人们。

paras.en: The population of Lightning Ridge is a bit of a mystery. Officially, it has about 2,000 residents. Unofficially, it's more like 5,000 because many people move to this outback town to disappear.
paras.zh: 闪电岭的人口有点神秘。据官方统计，这里约有 2,000 名居民。据非官方统计，这个数字更像是 5,000 人，因为许多人搬到这个内陆小镇是为了消失。

paras.en: We follow Barb's car as she navigates the dirt roads, tracing the green car door tour as it winds its way up to McDonald's Six-Mile opal field.
paras.zh: 我们跟随巴布的车在土路上行驶，沿着绿色车门蜿蜒前往麦当劳六英里蛋白石田。

paras.en: Perched on an ironstone ridge above the town, facing the western horizon, it's a moonscape of colourless rock, sheet metal and dozens of deserted mine shafts.
paras.zh: 它坐落在城镇上方的铁矿石山脊上，面朝西方地平线，无色的岩石、金属板和数十个废弃的矿井组成了月球般的景观。

paras.en: You can't miss the monument to Charles Nettleton.
paras.zh: 您不能错过查尔斯·内特尔顿的纪念碑。

paras.en: Protected by a wire fence, the jagged rectangular stone slab and its plaque look lovingly maintained, but resemble a tombstone.
paras.zh: 在铁丝网的保护下，锯齿状的矩形石板及其匾额看起来维护得很好，但就像一块墓碑。

paras.en: There is pride in Barb's eyes as she takes stock of the monument, pale yellow under the midday sun.
paras.zh: 当巴布打量这座在正午阳光下呈淡黄色的纪念碑时，她的眼中充满了自豪。

paras.en: It would not be here without her ability to move heaven and earth for her adopted home.
paras.zh: 如果没有她为她的第二故乡翻天覆地的能力，这里就不会存在。

paras.en: "[Charles Nettleton] was the first professional opal miner who came to this country" Barb explains.
paras.zh: “[Charles Nettleton] 是第一位来到这个国家的专业蛋白石矿工”Barb 解释道。

paras.en: "And we decided … we needed to have a monument — a historical reserve — to where he had sunk his first shafts for the syndicate of businessmen who hired him."
paras.zh: “我们决定……我们需要建立一座纪念碑——一个历史保护区——在他为雇佣他的商人集团打下第一根竖井的地方。”

paras.en: A seasoned miner from Victoria, Nettleton first made his way to Lightning Ridge in 1902, sinking a shaft to try his luck finding the fabled black opal.
paras.zh: 内特尔顿 (Nettleton) 是一位来自维多利亚州的经验丰富的矿工，他于 1902 年首次前往闪电山脊，凿井以碰碰运气，寻找传说中的黑蛋白石。

paras.en: His first attempt failed, but he's celebrated as the founder of the industry that gave Lightning Ridge its reputation and lifeblood.
paras.zh: 他的第一次尝试失败了，但他被誉为给 Lightning Ridge 带来声誉和命脉的行业创始人。

paras.en: Among the dozens of shafts on the ironstone ridge, the exact location of Nettleton's first shaft has been lost to time.
paras.zh: 在铁石山脊上的数十个竖井中，内特尔顿的第一个竖井的确切位置已经随着时间的流逝而消失。

paras.en: "We don't know which one he dug … he maybe dug them all," she says.
paras.zh: “我们不知道他挖了哪一个……他可能把它们都挖了，”她说。

paras.en: "We've chosen the one that's more accessible to us. One that we can see, we can put up our marker, and people can appreciate the beginnings."
paras.zh: “我们选择了更容易接近的一个。我们可以看到的一个，我们可以放置我们的标记，人们可以欣赏它的开始。”

paras.en: "There are people in the town who don't like what they read about history, and they think they can change it," Barb says, with a dismissive glance over her shoulder.
paras.zh: “镇上有些人不喜欢他们所读到的历史，他们认为自己可以改变它，”巴布说道，回头轻蔑地看了一眼。

paras.en: As tourists take a moment in front of Nettleton's shaft to read the plaque, something else catches their eye.
paras.zh: 当游客们在内特尔顿竖井前停留片刻阅读牌匾时，其他东西吸引了他们的目光。

paras.en: Barb watches on with visible frustration as the carload of travellers take the time to inspect it.
paras.zh: 当一车旅客花时间检查它时，巴布明显感到沮丧。

paras.en: It has been crudely fastened to a large tree with thick metal wire.
paras.zh: 它被粗暴地用粗金属线固定在一棵大树上。

paras.en: Large black letters have been scrawled onto a stark white background.
paras.zh: 大的黑色字母被潦草地写在纯白色的背景上。

paras.en: At a distance, it could be mistaken for a signature calling card of the historical society's car door tours.
paras.zh: 从远处看，它可能会被误认为是历史协会车门旅游的签名名片。

paras.en: Peter Glogauer doesn't see eye to eye with Barb Moritz.
paras.zh: 彼得·格洛高尔与巴布·莫里茨的看法不一致。

paras.en: A Lightning Ridge "true local", he's the son of German immigrants who scoured the world for somewhere to start afresh after the Second World War.
paras.zh: 他是闪电岭“真正的本地人”，是德国移民的儿子，二战后他们在世界各地寻找新的开始。

paras.en: His parents never spoke of their past, and Pete came to feel ashamed of his German ancestry.
paras.zh: 他的父母从未谈论过他们的过去，皮特开始为自己的德国血统感到羞耻。

paras.en: A restless student, he was fascinated by the stories of Ancient Rome and Classical Greece as much as he was by the stories he'd hear from the old miners he grew up alongside.
paras.zh: 作为一个好动的学生，他对古罗马和古典希腊的故事着迷，就像他从一起长大的老矿工那里听到的故事一样。

paras.en: Lightning Ridge offered his family a new beginning, and a young boy an identity to carry with pride.
paras.zh: 闪电岭为他的家人提供了一个新的开始，也为一个小男孩提供了一个值得自豪的身份。

paras.en: Pete makes it clear — opal runs in his blood.
paras.zh: 皮特明确表示——蛋白石流淌在他的血液中。

paras.en: "We're a breed unto ourselves," he says of his Lightning Ridge kin.
paras.zh: “我们是我们自己的一个品种，”他谈到他的闪电岭亲戚时说道。

paras.en: Pete greets us with a firm, sandpaper-rough handshake and soft, warm eyes.
paras.zh: 皮特用坚定、粗糙的握手和柔软、温暖的眼睛向我们打招呼。

paras.en: Better known across the opal fields as "Gloey", he is the man responsible for the breakaway bonnets.
paras.zh: 他在蛋白石领域更为人熟知的名字是“Gloey”，他是负责分离式发动机盖的人。

paras.en: The origins of Pete's rebellion tellingly read like a Greek tragedy, aching with torn loyalties and a profound sense of duty to his home.
paras.zh: 皮特叛逆的起源读起来就像一场希腊悲剧，伴随着忠诚的撕裂和对家庭的深刻责任感而痛苦。

paras.en: He too was once a member of the Lightning Ridge Historical Society, but the longer he sat among the official records, the more restless he became.
paras.zh: 他也曾是闪电岭历史学会的会员，但在官方记录中坐得越久，他就越焦躁不安。

paras.en: "I started to study, and look at maps and I realised that some of our history just isn't quite what's being presented," he says.
paras.zh: “我开始研究，查看地图，我意识到我们的一些历史并不完全是所呈现的内容，”他说。

paras.en: The relationship between Pete and the society never recovered, and he took it upon himself to stake an alternative claim to the tourists keen to learn the stories of Lightning Ridge.
paras.zh: 皮特和社会之间的关系再也没有恢复，他主动向热衷于了解闪电岭故事的游客提出了另一种主张。

paras.en: "I didn't mean to go into competition with them," Pete says. "It was just pretty much to get some facts right."
paras.zh: “我无意与他们竞争，”皮特说。 “这只是为了弄清一些事实。”

paras.en: Since the first car bonnet appeared two years ago, several have sprouted along the town's historical fault lines.
paras.zh: 自从两年前出现第一个汽车引擎盖以来，沿着该镇的历史断层线已经出现了几个汽车引擎盖。

paras.en: They read like handwritten notes in the margins of an old book, scrawled in a frantic rush to get thoughts onto the page.
paras.zh: 它们读起来就像一本旧书页边的手写笔记，疯狂地把想法写在纸上。

paras.en: "I thought I'd try and inform visitors to Lightning Ridge where the very early discoveries of opal were made," Pete says.
paras.zh: “我想我应该尝试告诉参观闪电岭的游客，那里是早期发现蛋白石的地方，”皮特说。

paras.en: "So I started putting white bonnets up, who discovered them, the date they were discovered, who worked there, that sort of thing."
paras.zh: “所以我开始戴上白色帽子，谁发现了它们，它们被发现的日期，谁在那里工作，诸如此类的事情。”

paras.en: Pete says he has "good communal support" and recounts the day that two boys leant a hand when they saw him trying to erect a sign.
paras.zh: 皮特说，他得到了“良好的社区支持”，并回忆了那天两个男孩看到他试图竖起一块牌子时向他伸出了手。

paras.en: While Barb has the weight of the historical society at her back, Pete's undertaking feels close to the bone.
paras.zh: 虽然巴布有历史学会的支持，但皮特的事业却让人感觉很艰难。

paras.en: "Nearly 60 years I've been in the Ridge. I love the place, and to me, its early history is so important," he says.
paras.zh: “我在山脊待了近 60 年。我喜欢这个地方，对我来说，它的早期历史非常重要，”他说。

paras.en: We meet Pete at his home as he prepares to secure a new bonnet with iron stakes.
paras.zh: 我们在皮特家里见到了他，当时他正准备用铁桩固定一顶新帽子。

paras.en: It's sitting in the back of his ute, the black paint still wet.
paras.zh: 它坐在他的皮卡车后座上，黑色油漆还没有干。

paras.en: He's the first to acknowledge his handiwork is no Sistine Chapel.
paras.zh: 他是第一个承认自己的作品不是西斯廷教堂的人。

paras.en: "You might notice some of my writing's pretty ordinary," he says with a grin.
paras.zh: “你可能会注意到我的一些写作非常普通，”他笑着说。

paras.en: Such is the reputation of the historical society, Pete's rebellion seems almost criminal.
paras.zh: 这就是历史社会的声誉，皮特的叛乱似乎几乎是犯罪。

paras.en: But to him, the greater crime would be to do nothing to counter what he believes is the inaccurate portrayal of one of the most famous opal-mining sites in the world.
paras.zh: 但对他来说，更大的罪行是不采取任何行动来反驳他认为对世界上最著名的蛋白石矿场之一的不准确描述。

paras.en: While Charles Nettleton may have a statue built in his honour at the entrance of town, Pete refuses to place him on a pedestal.
paras.zh: 虽然查尔斯·内特尔顿可能会在城镇入口处为他建造一座雕像，但皮特拒绝将他放在基座上。

paras.en: He refers to Nettleton's monument as 'The Rock', and sees it as nothing more than a testament to the historical society's stranglehold on the history of his hometown.
paras.zh: 他将内特尔顿的纪念碑称为“岩石”，并认为它只不过是历史学会对其家乡历史的束缚的证明。

paras.en: "It's always been common knowledge to the locals that Jack Murray was the first miner here," Pete says, drawing upon half a century of being, as he refers to himself, a 'son of silica'.
paras.zh: “当地人都知道杰克·默里是这里的第一个矿工，”皮特说，半个世纪以来他一直是“二氧化硅之子”。

paras.en: John 'Jack' Murray, a boundary-rider employed by a nearby cattle station, was the first to find black opal in 1901, he says emphatically.
paras.zh: 约翰·“杰克”·默里 (John 'Jack' Murray) 是附近一家养牛场的一名边界骑手，他强调说，他于 1901 年第一个发现了黑蛋白石。

paras.en: As the story has always gone, Murray was setting rabbit traps on the ironstone ridges when he came across a glistening gem exposed by erosion.
paras.zh: 正如故事一直流传的那样，默里在铁矿石山脊上设置兔子陷阱时，发现了一颗因侵蚀而暴露出来的闪闪发光的宝石。

paras.en: After Nettleton failed to find opal at Six-Mile, in 1903 he joined Murray at Nobby's Opal field one of first in Lightning Ridge.
paras.zh: 内特尔顿 (Nettleton) 在六英里 (Six-Mile) 未能找到蛋白石后，于 1903 年与穆雷 (Murray) 一起前往诺比 (Nobby) 蛋白石矿区，这是闪电山脊 (Lightning Ridge) 的第一个蛋白石矿区。

paras.en: "There were seven or eight other miners here before Nettleton turned up, but for some reason the historical society have fixated on [him]," Pete says.
paras.zh: “在内特尔顿出现之前，这里还有其他七八个矿工，但出于某种原因，历史学会已经关注了[他]，”皮特说。

paras.en: It was enough to spur the old miner into action.
paras.zh: 这足以激励老矿工行动起来。

paras.en: "I'd like to see the story tell that Jack Murray sank the first holes and discovered the first opal," he says.
paras.zh: “我希望看到杰克·默里 (Jack Murray) 打入第一个洞并发现第一块蛋白石的故事，”他说。

paras.en: It bothers him that countless tourists have left Lightning Ridge believing Nettleton dug the first mine shaft near the site of his monument.
paras.zh: 让他困扰的是，无数游客离开闪电山脊，相信内特尔顿在他的纪念碑附近挖了第一个矿井。

paras.en: Pete says Nettleton sunk his first shaft about 95 metres south of "the rock" in 1902.
paras.zh: 皮特说，内特尔顿于 1902 年在“岩石”以南约 95 米处打下了他的第一根竖井。

paras.en: "I put that white bonnet up saying that although Nettleton sank his first shafts here, they were not the first to be dug," he says.
paras.zh: “我把那顶白色帽子戴起来，说虽然内特尔顿在这里打下了他的第一根竖井，但它们并不是第一个被挖的，”他说。

paras.en: "There's no false information in that. There are no misconceptions. It's just fact."
paras.zh: “其中没有虚假信息。没有误解。这只是事实。”

paras.en: Barb doesn't dispute the fact that Murray may have been "out setting rabbit traps when he picked up pretty rocks".
paras.zh: 巴伯并不否认穆雷可能“在捡到漂亮的石头时出去设置兔子陷阱”这一事实。

paras.en: But as to whether or not he took the initiative to dig for opal, she is less sure.
paras.zh: 但至于他是否主动去挖掘蛋白石，她就不太确定了。

paras.en: "He may not even have sunk a shaft," she says.
paras.zh: “他甚至可能没有击沉一根轴，”她说。

paras.en: "Charlie Nettleton, as a professional miner, knew what to do with it."
paras.zh: “查理·内特尔顿（Charlie Nettleton）作为一名职业矿工，知道如何处理它。”

paras.en: Barb bristles when asked to address Pete's alternative car bonnet tours.
paras.zh: 当被问及皮特的另类汽车引擎盖之旅时，倒钩勃然大怒。

paras.en: "There are so many of them around the field and they are confusing and they're not part of the tourist association," Barb says with disdain.
paras.zh: “球场周围有很多这样的人，令人困惑，而且他们不属于旅游协会，”巴布轻蔑地说。

paras.en: "They're confusing because it's not significant history.
paras.zh: “他们令人困惑，因为这不是重要的历史。

paras.en: "We don't want anybody to even notice or know about them … they're just creating havoc, they'll be gone soon."
paras.zh: “我们不希望任何人注意到或了解他们……他们只是在制造破坏，他们很快就会消失。”

paras.en: The conflict between Pete and the historical society reaches into almost every aspect of the town's colourful history.
paras.zh: 皮特与历史社会之间的冲突几乎触及该镇丰富多彩的历史的各个方面。

paras.en: However, both Pete and the historical society agree that the town's name was inspired by a macabre natural phenomenon that occurred sometime before 1880.
paras.zh: 然而，皮特和历史协会都一致认为，该镇的名字是受到 1880 年之前某个时间发生的可怕自然现象的启发。

paras.en: A young drover and his flock of 600 sheep were all struck dead in an instant by a lightning bolt hitting an ironstone ridge above the town during a powerful storm.
paras.zh: 在一场强烈的暴风雨中，一道闪电击中了小镇上空的铁石山脊，一名年轻的牧羊人和他的羊群 600 只羊瞬间全部死亡。

paras.en: The exact location of this fatal bolt has been lost over the generations of retelling.
paras.zh: 经过几代人的重述，这个致命螺栓的确切位置已经消失。

paras.en: Ten kilometres out of town, at a rest stop on the Castlereagh Highway, the historical society has erected a plaque to commemorate the tragic event.
paras.zh: 距城镇十公里处，在卡斯尔雷高速公路的一个休息站，历史协会竖起了一块牌匾来纪念这一悲惨事件。

paras.en: Placed there in 1999, it provides a convenient place for travellers to stop and reflect on the poor drover's fate.
paras.zh: 它于 1999 年设立，为旅行者提供了一个方便的地方，可以停下来反思可怜的牲口贩的命运。

paras.en: And this is where Pete's frustration bubbles to the top again.
paras.zh: 这就是皮特的挫败感再次达到顶峰的地方。

paras.en: "[The historical society] got a plaque out there that says this is the spot that marks the area where the young man was killed by lightning, him and his flock," Pete says, with an exasperated sigh.
paras.zh: “[历史协会]在那里立了一块牌匾，上面写着这个地方标志着那个年轻人、他和他的羊群被闪电杀死的地方，”皮特愤怒地叹了口气说道。

paras.en: "It happened nearly three kilometres up the road."
paras.zh: “事情发生在路上近三公里处。”

paras.en: The historical society's attempts to strike a delicate balance between the truth and the tourism industry that provides so much to the town, has never sat right with Pete.
paras.zh: 历史学会试图在真相和为小镇带来如此多贡献的旅游业之间取得微妙的平衡，但皮特从来没有同意过。

paras.en: To him, history does not concern itself with whether it fits into an itinerary or provides shade for a picnic lunch.
paras.zh: 对他来说，历史并不关心它是否适合行程或为野餐午餐提供遮荫。

paras.en: Gamilaraay Yuwaalaraay woman Aunty Rhonda Ashby travels the same dirt track to get to McDonald's Six-Mile Opal field, but sees the land she traverses altogether differently from both Barb and Pete.
paras.zh: 加米拉拉伊·尤瓦拉拉伊 (Gamilaraay Yuwaalaraay) 的阿姨朗达·阿什比 (Rhonda Ashby) 沿着同样的土路前往麦当劳的六英里蛋白石田，但她对所经过的土地的看法与巴布和皮特完全不同。

paras.en: The past that Pete and Barb dispute is but a fraction of the history Rhonda can feel and hear in the ironstone.
paras.zh: 皮特和巴伯争论的过去只是朗达在铁矿石中感受到和听到的历史的一小部分。

paras.en: "There's layers of stories we have with this country," she explains, while surveying the arid landscape.
paras.zh: “我们与这个国家有很多故事，”她一边勘察干旱的土地一边解释道。

paras.en: Nettleton's monument may have been built to honour the beginning of one version of history, but from atop the lookout, an ancient past stretches to the horizon.
paras.zh: 内特尔顿的纪念碑可能是为了纪念某个历史版本的开始而建造的，但从瞭望台的顶端，一段古老的过去一直延伸到地平线。

paras.en: "For local Aboriginal people this ridge was one of the creations of Baayami," Aunty Rhonda says.
paras.zh: “对于当地原住民来说，这条山脊是巴亚米的创造之一，”朗达阿姨说。

paras.en: "He [Baayami] built the ridges up so he could look out over country," she says tracing the Yuwaalaraay creation story into the earth beneath her feet.
paras.zh: “他（巴亚米）建造了山脊，这样他就可以俯瞰乡村，”她说，将尤瓦拉拉伊的创造故事追溯到她脚下的土地上。

paras.en: It's a story her ancestors have told for tens of thousands of years.
paras.zh: 这是她的祖先讲述了数万年的故事。

paras.en: Aunty Rhonda marks the cardinal directions the creator looked out upon.
paras.zh: 朗达阿姨标记了创作者​​所关注的主要方向。

paras.en: "We believe his power is in the lightning," she says.
paras.zh: “我们相信他的力量在于闪电，”她说。

paras.en: For Rhonda, Lightning Ridge is hallowed land, where the iron in the soil has been attracting fierce lightning storms for millennia.
paras.zh: 对于朗达来说，闪电岭是神圣的土地，数千年来，那里土壤中的铁一直吸引着猛烈的闪电风暴。

paras.en: "Lightning Ridge, was Law country, a bit like a courthouse … but for Aboriginal people Law is a bit different to the law we have in court today," Aunty Rhonda says.
paras.zh: “闪电岭是法律国家，有点像法院……但对于原住民来说，法律与我们今天法庭上的法律有点不同，”朗达阿姨说。

paras.en: "Special people came onto this country and discussed Law … that may have been because of the electricity with the lightning being struck here and that connection to the higher creator.
paras.zh: “特殊的人来到这个国家并讨论法律……这可能是因为这里闪电击中的电力以及与更高创造者的联系。

paras.en: "So maybe that's why this place is pretty special to our mob."
paras.zh: “所以也许这就是为什么这个地方对我们的暴徒来说非常特别。”

paras.en: Gamileroi Yuwaalaraay Elder Brenda Mcbride's ancestors walked the ancient ridge lines long before Charles Nettleton and Jack Murray split the earth to chase their fortunes.
paras.zh: 加米莱罗伊·尤瓦拉拉伊 (Gamileroi Yuwaalaraay) 布伦达·麦克布莱德 (Brenda Mcbride) 长老的祖先早在查尔斯·内特尔顿 (Charles Nettleton) 和杰克·默里 (Jack Murray) 劈开大地追逐财富之前就已在古老的山脊线上行走。

paras.en: There are few people on Yuwaalaraay Country who hold the knowledge she does.
paras.zh: 尤瓦拉拉伊国家很少有人拥有她所掌握的知识。

paras.en: To Aunty Brenda, not enough has been done to understand the stories that cannot be found in miners' ledgers, old newspaper clippings or painted onto a car door.
paras.zh: 对于布伦达阿姨来说，理解那些在矿工账簿、旧剪报或画在车门上的故事还不够。

paras.en: She believes the oral history that she holds true should be shared with visitors long before they take to the winding tracks that lead to the lookout.
paras.zh: 她认为，早在游客踏上通往瞭望台的蜿蜒小道之前，就应该与他们分享她所掌握的真实的口述历史。

paras.en: "[The historical society has] done all this other work, and they should go back to the people who live there," she says.
paras.zh: “[历史学会]已经完成了所有其他工作，他们应该回到生活在那里的人们，”她说。

paras.en: "A local person who's got history of Lightning Ridge should be put up first before those car doors."
paras.zh: “一个熟悉闪电岭历史的当地人应该首先站在那些车门前。”

paras.en: "I really do believe that there's a voice there for our mob," Aunty Rhonda says.
paras.zh: “我真的相信我们的暴民有声音，”朗达阿姨说。

paras.en: "It's a much deeper meaning to country, because we always had that special connection with country, whether it was spiritually [or] physically."
paras.zh: “这对国家来说具有更深刻的意义，因为我们始终与国家有着特殊的联系，无论是精神上还是身体上。”

paras.en: Aunty Rhonda acknowledges the car doors are a useful tool to help tourists navigate the Ridge's maze of dirt roads, but says more can be done to include the missing chapters of the town's story.
paras.zh: 朗达阿姨承认车门是一个有用的工具，可以帮助游客在山脊迷宫般的土路中穿行，但她表示，还可以做更多的工作来包括小镇故事中缺失的章节。

paras.en: "There's place names still in language, and so all along these tours there's narratives that could be spoken about from a First Nation [perspective]," she says.
paras.zh: “有些地名仍然以语言形式存在，因此在这些旅行中，都有可以从原住民[角度]讲述的故事，”她说。

paras.en: As the caravans and four-wheel drives rattle down the Castlereagh Highway laden with accounts of long-dead miners, there are three stories they can take with them about this outback land and its precious black opal.
paras.zh: 当大篷车和四轮驱动车在卡斯尔雷高速公路上行驶时，满载着死去已久的矿工的故事，他们可以随身携带三个关于这片内陆土地及其珍贵黑蛋白石的故事。

paras.en: Aunty Rhonda dreams of those convoys departing with a richer history.
paras.zh: 朗达阿姨梦想着那些带着更丰富历史出发的车队。

paras.en: "I'd like to see a tourism industry where our mob are leading so they've got an opportunity to share that history and the knowledge of some of these beautiful ecosystems that we have around the country," she says.
paras.zh: “我希望看到我们的暴民引领旅游业，这样他们就有机会分享我们在全国各地拥有的一些美丽生态系统的历史和知识，”她说。

paras.en: "History is important to be learnt. I don't think it's too late."
paras.zh: “学习历史很重要。我认为现在还不算太晚。”

paras.en: - Reporting: Genevieve Blandin de Chalain and Max Tillman
paras.zh: - 报道：Genevieve Blandin de Chalain 和 Max Tillman

paras.zh: - 摄影和视频：Genevieve Blandin de Chalain、Max Tillman 和 Peter Glogauer

articles.title: Australia, Philippines to ink defence deal amid South China Sea tensions
articles.author: Tim Swanston and Stephen Dziedzic

paras.en: Major defence deal for Australia, Philippines amid clashes with China
paras.zh: 在与中国发生冲突之际，澳大利亚和菲律宾达成了重大防务协议

paras.en: Australia is set to sign a defence deal with the Philippines to bolster its navy and coastguard.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚将与菲律宾签署一项防务协议，以加强其海军和海岸警卫队。

paras.en: The Philippines has been at the frontline of efforts by US allies to counter China's "aggression" in the South China Sea.
paras.zh: 菲律宾一直处于美国盟友反击中国在南海“侵略”的前线。

paras.en: The agreement is set to be signed on Sunday.
paras.zh: 该协议定于周日签署。

paras.en: Australia and the Philippines are on the cusp of signing a major defence cooperation agreement, as tensions continue to flare between the Philippines and China over control of the highly strategic South China Sea.
paras.zh: 随着菲律宾和中国之间围绕高度战略性的南海控制权的紧张局势继续加剧，澳大利亚和菲律宾即将签署一项重大防务合作协议。

paras.en: The agreement, which is set to be signed on Sunday as Prime Minister Anthony Albanese meets with senior Philippines officials on the sidelines of the ASEAN summit in Manila, is expected to expand reciprocal military access and information sharing, as well as bolster the Philippine Navy and coastguard.
paras.zh: 该协议定于周日在马尼拉东盟峰会期间与菲律宾高级官员会面时签署，预计将扩大相互军事准入和信息共享，并加强菲律宾海军和海岸警卫队。

paras.en: It comes as an informal defence bloc of four nations — Australia, the United States, the Philippines and Japan — nicknamed "the Squad", looks to bolster the Philippines' defensive capability and carry out more military exercises, in an attempt to counter China's maritime influence in the South and East China seas.
paras.zh: 这是一个由澳大利亚、美国、菲律宾和日本四个国家组成的非正式防务集团，绰号为“小队”，旨在增强菲律宾的防御能力并开展更多军事演习，以对抗中国在南海和东海的海上影响力。

paras.en: Top defence officials met in Cebu last month, and on Tuesday revealed the Squad would set up a Combined Coordination Centre that would likely serve as a joint hub to build the capacity of the country's navy and coastguard.
paras.zh: 高级国防官员上个月在宿务会面，周二透露，该小队将设立一个联合协调中心，该中心可能会作为建设该国海军和海岸警卫队能力的联合中心。

paras.en: The Philippines has been at the frontline of combined efforts by US allies to counter China in the South China Sea, a highly strategic waterway through which a significant portion of global trade passes.
paras.zh: 菲律宾一直处于美国盟友在南海共同对抗中国的前线，南海是一条高度战略性的水道，全球贸易的很大一部分都要经过该水道。

paras.en: The atolls and reefs are also rich with marine life.
paras.zh: 环礁和珊瑚礁也拥有丰富的海洋生物。

paras.en: Several South East Asian nations have overlapping claims in the South China Sea, but China claims almost all of this waterway through its "nine-dash line", a claim it argues is based on historic rights.
paras.zh: 几个东南亚国家对南海有重叠的主权声索，但中国声称对通过其“九段线”的几乎整个水道拥有主权，并认为这一主张是基于历史权利。

paras.en: A decade ago that claim was ruled as having no legal basis under international maritime law by a tribunal at The Hague. China has rejected the ruling.
paras.zh: 十年前，海牙法庭裁定这一主张根据国际海事法没有法律依据。中国拒绝了这一裁决。

paras.en: China has been creating artificial islands that host military bases in the South China Sea, including in the Philippines' exclusive economic zone and in the heavily contested Spratly Islands.
paras.zh: 中国一直在南海建造人工岛屿，设立军事基地，包括菲律宾的专属经济区和争议激烈的南沙群岛。

paras.en: Clashes frequently occur between both countries' coast guards, particularly in the Spratly Islands and at Scarborough Shoal, off the northern Philippines island of Luzon.
paras.zh: 两国海岸警卫队之间经常发生冲突，特别是在南沙群岛和菲律宾北部吕宋岛附近的黄岩岛。

paras.en: China is accused of "grey zone" tactics, including water cannoning and maritime harassment, that are designed to apply pressure on the Philippines but deliberately fall short of triggering war.
paras.zh: 中国被指责采取“灰色地带”策略，包括高压水枪和海上骚扰，其目的是向菲律宾施加压力，但故意不引发战争。

paras.en: Philippines Defence Secretary Gilberto Teodoro said China's actions in the South China Sea were his country's greatest traditional security challenge.
paras.zh: 菲律宾国防部长吉尔伯托·特奥多罗表示，中国在南海的行动是菲律宾面临的最大的传统安全挑战。

paras.en: "[China's behaviour] is irresponsible, escalatory and provocative," he told the ABC earlier this year.
paras.zh: “（中国的行为）是不负责任的、升级性的和挑衅性的，”他今年早些时候告诉澳大利亚广播公司。

paras.en: "Its nine-dash line is the biggest threat to regional stability and peace."
paras.zh: “它的九段线是对地区稳定与和平的最大威胁。”

paras.en: Australia's increasing defence ties with the Philippines
paras.zh: 澳大利亚与菲律宾加强防务关系

paras.en: The new defence agreement comes as Australia ramps up support for the Philippines' maritime defence and security.
paras.zh: 新的防务协议出台之际，澳大利亚加大了对菲律宾海上防御和安全的支持。

paras.en: Since April last year, Australia has provided more than $13 million in support to the Philippine Coast Guard, mostly in the form of drones and drone operator training, helping the Philippines monitor Chinese naval and coastguard vessels, as well as protect subsea cables, keep a close eye on illegal fishing and track drones deployed by the Chinese military.
paras.zh: 自去年4月以来，澳大利亚已向菲律宾海岸警卫队提供了超过1300万美元的支持，主要以无人机和无人机操作员培训的形式，帮助菲律宾监控中国海军和海岸警卫队船只，以及保护海底电缆、密切关注非法捕鱼和跟踪中国军队部署的无人机。

paras.en: Australia has also helped build up defence infrastructure across five Philippine military bases on Luzon.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚还帮助菲律宾吕宋岛的五个军事基地建设国防基础设施。

paras.en: In a report released earlier this week, David Dutton from the Australian Strategic Policy Institute said the Philippines had "become pivotal for Canberra's regional balancing and deterrence objectives", with the country emerging as "the state under greatest coercive pressure from China".
paras.zh: 澳大利亚战略政策研究所的戴维·达顿在本周早些时候发布的一份报告中表示，菲律宾“已成为堪培拉地区平衡和威慑目标的关键”，该国正在成为“受到中国胁迫压力最大的国家”。

paras.en: Mr Dutton said the agreement would be a "milestone in the transformation of the relationship into a genuinely strategic partnership".
paras.zh: 达顿表示，该协议将是“两国关系转变为真正战略伙伴关系的里程碑”。

paras.en: Maritime security expert Jennifer Parker said the agreement would "bundle up the package of things [Australia] has already been doing … focusing on interoperability with the Philippines, the ability of our defence forces, particularly our navy, to work with the Philippines".
paras.zh: 海事安全专家詹妮弗·帕克表示，该协议将“捆绑[澳大利亚]已经在做的一揽子事情……重点关注与菲律宾的互操作性，以及我们的国防军，特别是我们的海军与菲律宾合作的能力”。

paras.en: Ms Parker also hoped there would be enhanced information sharing.
paras.zh: 帕克女士还希望加强信息共享。

paras.en: Australia's increasing defence cooperation with the Philippines comes as China and the Philippines have been escalating verbal barbs.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚与菲律宾加强防务合作之际，中国和菲律宾的口角不断升级。

paras.en: Philippines President Ferdinand Marcos Jr accused China's ambassador to Manila Jing Quan of making a threat after Mr Quan said Beijing could "easily win" in a conflict with the Philippines.
paras.zh: 菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯 (Ferdinand Marcos Jr) 指责中国驻马尼拉大使全精表示北京可以在与菲律宾的冲突中“轻松获胜”，此后他发出了威胁。

paras.en: The ambassador was summoned by Philippines Foreign Secretary Theresa Lazaro and denied he was being threatening.
paras.zh: 该大使被菲律宾外交部长特蕾莎·拉扎罗传唤，并否认自己存在威胁。

paras.en: China's foreign ministry said Foreign Minister Wang Yi told Ms Lazaro during a phone call last week that "a handful of Philippine politicians, driven by political bias and selfish gains, have repeatedly attacked and smeared China", and said the country should strengthen restraint over those individuals.
paras.zh: 中国外交部表示，外交部长王毅上周在与拉扎罗通话时告诉拉扎罗，“菲律宾少数政客出于政治偏见和私利，屡次攻击抹黑中国”，并表示中国应加强对这些人的克制。

paras.en: Australia has also drawn rebukes from China, including in July after the Philippines and China blamed one another for a physical confrontation in the Spratly Islands between China Coast Guard and Philippine Navy personnel.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚也遭到了中国的谴责，包括7月份菲律宾和中国就中国海警和菲律宾海军人员在南沙群岛发生肢体冲突相互指责之后。

paras.en: Foreign Minister Penny Wong said Australia was concerned about "aggression" and "destabilising conduct".
paras.zh: 外交部长黄英贤表示，澳大利亚对“侵略”和“破坏稳定的行为”感到担忧。

paras.en: It prompted a Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson to urge "the relevant countries to stop exaggerating tensions and inciting confrontation".
paras.zh: 这促使中国外交部发言人敦促“有关国家停止渲染紧张局势、煽动对抗”。

paras.en: South-East Asian countries will hold high-level leaders' talks from Sunday as part of this year's ASEAN summit, with the South China Sea set to be a key issue.
paras.zh: 作为今年东盟峰会的一部分，东南亚国家将于周日举行高层领导人会谈，南海问题将成为关键问题。

paras.en: ASEAN nations and China have been negotiating a code of conduct for more than eight years, in a bid to provide a way to resolve disputes.
paras.zh: 东盟国家和中国就行为准则进行了八年多的谈判，旨在提供解决争端的途径。

paras.en: Philippine officials have said they cannot confirm whether the code would be finalised by the end of this year's summit.
paras.zh: 菲律宾官员表示，他们无法确认该准则是否会在今年峰会结束前最终确定。

paras.en: The verbal and physical tensions over the South China Sea come as analysts have observed greater Chinese navy activity in waters near Taiwan.
paras.zh: 分析人士观察到中国海军在台湾附近海域的活动有所增加，南海问题上的言语和肢体冲突随之而来。

paras.en: The Institute for the Study of War has analysed what it describes as a "rare" coordination of China's geographical naval commands, in a deployment that "suggests the People's Liberation Army is conducting a major exercise that simulates isolating Taiwan".
paras.zh: 战争研究所分析了中国海军地理司令部的“罕见”协调，此次部署“表明中国人民解放军正在进行一场模拟孤立台湾的大型演习”。

paras.en: These have taken place in the context of US naval resources being moved to the Middle East for the war on Iran and operations in the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 这些都是在美国海军资源被转移到中东以应对伊朗战争和霍尔木兹海峡行动的背景下发生的。

paras.en: "I think people are right to be concerned about the distraction of the Middle East conflict for US assets in the region,"
paras.zh: “我认为人们对中东冲突分散美国在该地区资产的担忧是正确的，”

paras.en: "The US Navy is under significant pressure … you have seen a significant drawdown in naval forces in this region.
paras.zh: “美国海军面临着巨大的压力......你已经看到该地区海军力量的大幅缩减。

paras.en: "In the last six months we have seen China both intensify their operations in the South China Sea around the Philippines and also expand them to the east of Taiwan into the Pacific.
paras.zh: “在过去六个月中，我们看到中国不仅加强了在菲律宾周围南海的行动，还将其行动扩展到台湾以东的太平洋地区。

paras.en: "You are seeing China seek to take advantage, I would say, of the lack of US assets in the region."
paras.zh: “我想说，你看到中国试图利用美国在该地区缺乏资产的优势。”

articles.title: NSW growers reveal the tough calls made before this year's harvest
articles.author: Amelia Bernasconi and Cara Jeffery

paras.en: Winter crop growers across NSW are reporting mixed results after a challenging season.
paras.zh: 在经历了一个充满挑战的季节之后，新南威尔士州的冬季作物种植者报告的结果好坏参半。

paras.en: Some crops exceeded expectations but others were never planted.
paras.zh: 一些作物的产量超出了预期，但另一些作物却从未种植。

paras.en: Farmers across the state are hoping for summer rain to set them up for next season.
paras.zh: 全州的农民都希望夏季降雨能够为下个季节做好准备。

paras.en: From taking a gamble on planting to sitting out the season entirely, New South Wales farmers are navigating a harvest shaped by drought, rising fuel and fertiliser costs and difficult decisions.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州的农民正面临着干旱、燃料和化肥成本上涨以及艰难决策所带来的收获，从押注播种到完全休耕。

paras.en: Australia's overall winter crop production is forecast to be down by about a third this year, but the state is still on track to be the second highest-producing state, behind WA.
paras.zh: 预计澳大利亚今年冬季作物总产量将下降约三分之一，但该州仍有望成为仅次于西澳的第二高产州。

paras.en: But it has been a tale of two seasons for grain growers in north and south NSW.
paras.zh: 但对于新南威尔士州北部和南部的谷物种植者来说，这只是两个季节的故事。

paras.en: Burren Junction farmer Rodney Slack-Smith took a risk many other were unprepared to take when he planted a crop after one of the driest starts to a season in recent memory.
paras.zh: 伯伦章克申 (Burren Junction) 的农民罗德尼·斯莱克·史密斯 (Rodney Slack-Smith) 在经历了最近记忆中最干旱的季节开局后播种作物时，冒了许多其他人没有准备好冒的风险。

paras.en: "We got a bit of a break mid-May and we took a punt," he said.
paras.zh: “我们在五月中旬得到了一些休息，然后我们进行了赌注，”他说。

paras.en: The family planted about half of the property to crops, despite limited stored moisture and little follow-up rain.
paras.zh: 尽管储存的水分有限且后续降雨很少，但该家庭仍将大约一半的财产种植为农作物。

paras.en: Yields were below average but the harvest is providing some return.
paras.zh: 产量低于平均水平，但收获正在带来一些回报。

paras.en: Mr Slack-Smith said farming in western NSW was about accepting the cycles.
paras.zh: Slack-Smith 先生表示，新南威尔士州西部的农业就是要接受循环。

paras.en: "If you farm for long enough around here you expect you get really good seasons, average seasons, you get a failure," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果你在这里耕种足够长的时间，你会期望获得真正好的季节，但如果季节平庸，你就会失败。”

paras.en: Two years ago the family planted 1,200 hectares and "didn't get any of it up", but last year was a bumper crop for much of the region.
paras.zh: 两年前，这个家庭种植了 1,200 公顷土地，但“一无所获”，但去年该地区大部分地区都获得了丰收。

paras.en: Rising input costs, however, posed major challenges throughout 2026.
paras.zh: 然而，投入成本的上升给 2026 年带来了重大挑战。

paras.en: Mr Slack-Smith estimated diesel accounted for as much as a quarter of the mixed-farming operation's input costs.
paras.zh: 斯莱克-史密斯先生估计柴油占混合农业经营投入成本的四分之一。

paras.en: "With the wet weather, the headers are using more fuel than they normally would — I think it's $3 a litre," he said.
paras.zh: “由于天气潮湿，割台使用的燃料比平时更多——我认为是每升 3 美元，”他说。

paras.en: "But what can you do? You need fuel to run your machinery."
paras.zh: “但是你能做什么呢？你需要燃料来运行你的机器。”

paras.en: Mr Slack-Smith's neighbour, Toby Moore, made the tough decision to sit the season out.
paras.zh: 斯莱克·史密斯先生的邻居托比·摩尔做出了艰难的决定，缺席本赛季的比赛。

paras.en: "The rain came a little bit late for us and the moisture profile wasn't quite there for us, so we chose not to plant," he said.
paras.zh: “雨来得有点晚，而且湿度不太适合我们，所以我们选择不种植，”他说。

paras.en: The call effectively meant sacrificing a year's grain income, but Mr Moore, who also runs cattle, believes it will position the business more strongly for next season.
paras.zh: 这一呼吁实际上意味着牺牲一年的粮食收入，但同时也养牛的摩尔先生相信，这将使该业务在下一季中处于更有利的地位。

paras.en: He hopes summer storms will recharge soil moisture reserves ahead of next year's cropping season.
paras.zh: 他希望夏季风暴能够在明年的耕作季节之前补充土壤水分储备。

paras.en: At Cryon, Enid Coupé and Hunter Hopcroft said their harvest had been "madness" thanks to some late storms.
paras.zh: 在克莱昂，伊妮德·库佩 (Enid Coupé) 和亨特·霍普克罗夫特 (Hunter Hopcroft) 表示，由于最近发生了一些风暴，他们的收成“疯狂”。

paras.en: The couple count themselves among the minority of Walgett district growers who managed to get a decent crop in this year.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇认为自己是沃尔格特地区少数今年获得不错收成的种植者之一。

paras.en: With drought conditions gripping much of north-west NSW, Dr Coupé estimated less than 10 per cent of the district was able to plant.
paras.zh: 由于新南威尔士州西北部大部分地区遭遇干旱，Coupé 博士估计该地区只有不到 10% 的地区能够播种。

paras.en: "We were lucky enough to get a good hit of rain at the end of May and it was on," she said.
paras.zh: “我们很幸运，五月底下了一场大雨，而且雨一直持续着，”她说。

paras.en: Yields are lower than in recent bumper years but strong grain protein levels are helping to compensate.
paras.zh: 产量低于最近的丰收年份，但强劲的谷物蛋白质水平有助于弥补这一损失。

paras.en: Wheat prices remain steady but chickpeas prices have spiked to about $1,000 a tonne.
paras.zh: 小麦价格保持稳定，但鹰嘴豆价格已飙升至每吨 1,000 美元左右。

paras.en: "We've only got 600 hectares of chickpeas in. I wish we had more," Mr Hopcroft said.
paras.zh: “我们只有 600 公顷鹰嘴豆。我希望我们有更多，”霍普克罗夫特先生说。

paras.en: "It's not often your commodity doubles on last year's prices."
paras.zh: “你的商品价格比去年翻倍的情况并不常见。”

paras.en: After battling through the most expensive cropping season of his farming career, southern NSW grower Trent Lindbeck was relieved to see yields exceeding expectations on his farm.
paras.zh: 在经历了农业生涯中最昂贵的种植季节后，新南威尔士州南部的种植者 Trent Lindbeck 看到自己农场的产量超出了预期，松了口气。

paras.en: Mr Lindbeck began harvesting canola about 10 days earlier than usual, after what he described as a favourable growing season.
paras.zh: 在经历了他所说的有利的生长季节后，Lindbeck 先生比平常提前了大约 10 天开始收获油菜籽。

paras.en: "I reckon we've got double the canola from last year to this year and expecting the wheat and barley to be a hell of a lot better than 12 months ago as well," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我认为今年的油菜籽产量是去年的两倍，预计小麦和大麦的产量也会比 12 个月前好得多。”

paras.en: Mr Lindbeck planted more than 1,200 hectares of canola, wheat, barley and field peas on his property at Junee Reefs, north of Wagga Wagga.
paras.zh: Lindbeck 先生在沃加沃加北部朱尼礁 (Junee Reefs) 的土地上种植了超过 1,200 公顷的油菜籽、小麦、大麦和豌豆。

paras.en: "Probably the dearest [crop] I've ever grown with fuel and fertiliser where it is,"
paras.zh: “这可能是我用燃料和化肥种植过的最珍贵的[作物]，”

paras.en: After a lighter crop last year, he said a solid 2026 harvest was critical.
paras.zh: 他表示，继去年收成较少之后，2026 年丰收至关重要。

paras.en: "Very important to get that back and having a bit more to go again next year."
paras.zh: “非常重要的是要找回这一点，并且明年还有更多的事情要做。”

articles.title: NHL indicates Finland's block on Russian athletes could affect future games there

paras.en: NHL indicates Finland's block on Russian athletes could affect future games there
paras.zh: NHL表示芬兰对俄罗斯运动员的封锁可能会影响那里未来的比赛

paras.en: League has held regular-season games in country in 2022, 2024, 2026
paras.zh: 联盟已于2022年、2024年、2026年在该国举办过常规赛

paras.en: The NHL will consider Finland's plans to prevent Russian athletes entering the country when deciding whether to stage more regular-season games there in future, the league told The Associated Press.
paras.zh: NHL 告诉美联社，在决定未来是否在芬兰举办更多常规赛时，该联盟将考虑芬兰阻止俄罗斯运动员进入该国的计划。

paras.en: Finland and Norway both announced plans to refuse entry to Russian athletes Thursday, the same day as the Carolina Hurricanes and Seattle Kraken played the first of two NHL regular-season games in the Finnish capital, Helsinki.
paras.zh: 周四，芬兰和挪威都宣布计划拒绝俄罗斯运动员入境，同一天，卡罗莱纳飓风队和西雅图海妖队在芬兰首都赫尔辛基进行了两场 NHL 常规赛的第一场比赛。

paras.en: The Finnish restrictions take effect from Monday, after the NHL games, and follow a backlash to Russia being reinstated in the hockey world championships, which is not an NHL event.
paras.zh: 芬兰的限制措施从周一 NHL 比赛结束后生效，此前俄罗斯恢复参加曲棍球世界锦标赛（这不是 NHL 赛事）遭到强烈反对。

paras.en: “We are aware of the government’s position, and we’ll have to take that into account," the league said on Friday when asked if the new restrictions would be an obstacle to future games in Finland.
paras.zh: 当被问及新的限制是否会成为芬兰未来比赛的障碍时，联盟周五表示：“我们了解政府的立场，我们必须考虑到这一点。”

paras.en: The Finnish foreign ministry's statement outlining the restrictions didn't distinguish between Russian athletes on national teams, those competing as neutral athletes, or those on club teams in sports like hockey or soccer.
paras.zh: 芬兰外交部的声明概述了这些限制，并没有区分国家队的俄罗斯运动员、作为中立运动员参加比赛的运动员，以及参加曲棍球或足球等运动的俱乐部队的运动员。

paras.en: The ministry said Thursday that Russians would only be allowed to work in Finland on “tasks that are essential to Finland’s national interests." It added that Russia “uses sports as a propaganda tool.”
paras.zh: 该部周四表示，俄罗斯人只能在芬兰从事“对芬兰国家利益至关重要的任务”。它补充说，俄罗斯“利用体育作为宣传工具”。

paras.en: The NHL has played regular-season games in Finland as part of its Global Series in 2022 and 2024 and hasn't confirmed any future games there yet.
paras.zh: NHL 已在芬兰进行了 2022 年和 2024 年全球系列赛的常规赛，但尚未确认未来在那里举行的任何比赛。

paras.en: - Finland says its national teams won't play against Russia in hockey tournaments
paras.zh: - 芬兰表示其国家队不会在冰球锦标赛中对阵俄罗斯

paras.en: - Russian federation head Tretiak says it will seek compensation if barred from world juniors in Alberta
paras.zh: - 俄罗斯联邦主席特雷蒂亚克表示，如果被禁止参加阿尔伯塔省的世界青少年比赛，俄罗斯联邦主席特雷蒂亚克将寻求赔偿

paras.en: As of the opening day of the 2026-27 season in September, there were 53 Russians on NHL rosters, making up 7.3 per cent of the league. That was the fourth-largest contingent of players from any country.
paras.zh: 截至 9 月 2026-27 赛季开幕日，NHL 名单上有 53 名俄罗斯球员，占联盟的 7.3%。这是来自所有国家的第四大球员队伍。

paras.en: Russian winger Andrei Svechnikov had an assist for the Hurricanes in Thursday's 4-1 win over the Kraken in Helsinki. Pyotr Kochetkov was Carolina's backup goaltender. The Hurricanes and Kraken play again in Finland on Saturday.
paras.zh: 周四，飓风队在赫尔辛基 4-1 战胜海妖队的比赛中，俄罗斯边锋安德烈·斯维奇尼科夫 (Andrei Svechnikov) 送出助攻。彼得·科切特科夫（Pyotr Kochetkov）是卡罗莱纳州的替补守门员。周六，飓风队和克拉肯队将在芬兰再次比赛。

paras.en: The government decisions Thursday followed a backlash in Finland to Russia being reinstated for the ice hockey world championships, but its effects could mostly be felt in other sports. The International Skating Union warned of a “possible consequential impact” on its figure skating world championships in Finland in March.
paras.zh: 周四政府的决定是在芬兰对俄罗斯恢复参加冰球世界锦标赛的强烈反对之后作出的，但其影响主要在其他体育项目中感受到。国际滑冰联盟警告称，三月份在芬兰举行的花样滑冰世锦赛可能会受到“间接影响”。

paras.en: Public broadcaster ERR reported Friday that Estonia had written to the International Ski and Snowboard Federation that athletes from Russia and its ally Belarus would not be allowed to enter the country. Estonia hosts the world junior championships in Nordic skiing in January.
paras.zh: 公共广播公司 ERR 周五报道称，爱沙尼亚已致函国际滑雪和单板滑雪联合会，称俄罗斯及其盟友白俄罗斯的运动员将不被允许进入该国。爱沙尼亚一月份主办世界青少年北欧滑雪锦标赛。

articles.title: U.K. police launch sex offence investigation into children’s author and comedian David Walliams
articles.author: Associated Press

paras.en: U.K. police launch sex offence investigation into children’s author and comedian David Walliams
paras.zh: 英国警方对儿童作家兼喜剧演员大卫·威廉姆斯展开性犯罪调查

paras.en: Walliams was subject of investigation by the Guardian and ITV News alleging he preyed on young women
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯受到《卫报》和独立电视台新闻的调查，指控他性侵年轻女性

paras.en: London police said on Friday they are investigating children’s author and TV personality David Walliams for serious sexual offences, after news outlets reported that he used his fame to groom girls and young women for sex.
paras.zh: 伦敦警方周五表示，他们正在调查儿童作家兼电视名人大卫·威廉姆斯的严重性犯罪行为，此前有新闻媒体报道称，他利用自己的名气引诱女孩和年轻女性进行性行为。

paras.en: The Metropolitan Police said it had received a number of allegations of past abuse following a joint investigation by ITV News and the Guardian newspaper.
paras.zh: 大都会警察局表示，在独立电视台新闻和《卫报》联合调查后，他们收到了一些过去虐待行为的指控。

paras.en: One woman said in the reports that she was sexually assaulted by Walliams at his London home when she was 15, while others accused him of grooming them when they were teens.
paras.zh: 一名女性在报告中称，她 15 岁时在威廉姆斯位于伦敦的家中遭到了他的性侵犯，而其他人则指责他在她们十几岁的时候为她们提供美容服务。

paras.en: Police are investigating different allegations than those reported by the news outlets, but said they will look into the news stories for any evidence of other crimes.
paras.zh: 警方正在调查与新闻媒体报道不同的指控，但表示他们将调查新闻报道以寻找其他犯罪的证据。

paras.en: Walliams, 55, has denied the allegations, saying he had not broken any laws and was not a sexual predator.
paras.zh: 55 岁的威廉姆斯否认了这些指控，称他没有违反任何法律，也不是性掠夺者。

paras.en: "I am devastated that some of the women I met 10 to 20 years ago have now expressed hurt or anger towards me," Walliams said in writing to ITV and the Guardian.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯在写给英国独立电视台和卫报的信中表示：“我很伤心，我 10 到 20 年前遇到的一些女性现在对我表达了伤害或愤怒。”

paras.en: "Whilst a power imbalance is inevitable when one party is famous, abusing that power is something else entirely and it is something that I never did."
paras.zh: “虽然当一个政党出名时，权力失衡是不可避免的，但滥用权力则完全是另一回事，而且我从未这样做过。”

paras.en: Walliams attends a performance of Awful Auntie at the Richmond Theatre in Richmond, England, on May 9, 2024. A number of Walliams's books now have screen adaptations. (Shane Anthony Sinclair/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 2024 年 5 月 9 日，威廉姆斯在英国里士满的里士满剧院观看了《可怕的阿姨》的演出。威廉姆斯的许多书籍现已被改编成电影。 （肖恩·安东尼·辛克莱/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Walliams is best known as the co-creator and co-star of Little Britain, a hugely popular TV comedy sketch show in the 2000s. But he’s also a children’s book author with some 40 published titles that have sold more than 60 million copies worldwide, according to his website.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯最为人所知的身份是《小不列颠》的联合创始人和联合主演，这是 2000 年代非常受欢迎的电视喜剧小品节目。但他也是一位儿童读物作家，据他的网站称，已出版约 40 本书，全球销量超过 6000 万册。

paras.en: Several books, including Gangsta Granny, have been adapted into BBC comedy dramas and stage productions. Producers of Fing! — an upcoming film based on Walliams’s book — said in a statement on Tuesday that they had removed his cameo appearance and that Walliams "will have no involvement in the film’s release or promotion." He is credited as a co-writer.
paras.zh: 包括 Gangsta Granny 在内的多本书已被改编成 BBC 喜剧和舞台剧。 《Fing!》的制作人一部根据威廉姆斯的书改编的即将上映的电影在周二的一份声明中表示，他们已经取消了他的客串表演，并且威廉姆斯“将不会参与电影的发行或宣传”。他被认为是合著者。

paras.en: U.K. distributor Sky told Variety it was dropping the movie. Angel Studios, the U.S. distributor, did not answer The Associated Press’s emailed query about its plans for the film.
paras.zh: 英国发行商天空电视台告诉《综艺》杂志，他们将放弃这部电影。美国发行商天使工作室没有回复美联社通过电子邮件询问其电影计划的问题。

paras.en: Walliams was dropped last year by publisher HarperCollins after allegations of inappropriate behaviour. Few details were published at the time, but the Guardian reported that there were concerns about his behaviour for years, including an allegation he had an inappropriate sexual relationship with a junior female employee.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯去年因被指控不当行为而被出版商哈珀柯林斯公司解雇。当时公布的细节很少，但《卫报》报道称，多年来人们对他的行为感到担忧，包括指控他与一名初级女员工有不正当的性关系。

paras.en: He was also a judge for a decade on Britain’s Got Talent, though he stepped down in 2022 after apologizing for making "disrespectful comments" about auditioning contestants.
paras.zh: 他还担任了英国达人秀的评委长达十年之久，不过他因对试镜选手做出“不尊重的评论”而道歉后于 2022 年辞职。

paras.en: The reports into Walliams’s alleged misconduct were published a day after British actor-comedian Russell Brand was sentenced to 10 ½ years in prison for rape and sexual assault. The two stories together drew comparisons and caused wider soul-searching over celebrities getting away with sexual misconduct in the U.K.
paras.zh: 关于威廉姆斯涉嫌不当行为的报告是在英国演员兼喜剧演员拉塞尔·布兰德因强奸和性侵犯被判处 10.5 年监禁的第二天发布的。这两个故事一起进行了比较，并引发了人们对英国名人性行为不端行为的更广泛的反思。

paras.en: Brand’s accusers in court had come forward after a joint investigation by The Times and Channel 4. Since his sentencing, more women have come forward to make claims against him, The Times reported. Police are also investigating two other cases against him.
paras.zh: 布兰德在法庭上的原告是在《泰晤士报》和第四频道联合调查后挺身而出的。据《泰晤士报》报道，自他宣判以来，越来越多的女性站出来对他提出索赔。警方还在调查另外两起针对他的案件。

paras.en: The Guardian and ITV said they spoke to more than 100 people during a three-year investigation into Walliams.
paras.zh: 《卫报》和英国独立电视台表示，他们在对威廉姆斯进行为期三年的调查期间采访了 100 多人。

paras.en: He had sought a court injunction to prevent the news outlets from identifying him, but a judge rejected the application, saying such a legal measure would be "an exceptionally serious interference" with the media’s rights.
paras.zh: 他曾寻求法院禁令，阻止新闻媒体透露他的身份，但法官拒绝了他的申请，称这样的法律措施将是对媒体权利的“极其严重的干涉”。

paras.en: Walliams is seen during a reception for winners of The Queen's Commonwealth Essay Competition at Buckingham Palace on Nov. 22, 2018. Walliams hasn't spoken publicly since the Guardian and ITV News published their investigation. (Jeff Spicer/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 2018 年 11 月 22 日，威廉姆斯出现在白金汉宫举行的女王英联邦征文比赛获奖者招待会上。自《卫报》和英国独立电视台新闻发表调查以来，威廉姆斯一直没有公开发表过言论。 （杰夫·斯派塞/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Walliams had claimed that publication of sexual misconduct allegations would lead him to take his own life, but Justice Matthew Nicklin said it was the responsibility of mental health services to look after his safety.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯声称，公开不当性行为指控将导致他自杀，但法官马修·尼克林表示，心理健康服务机构有责任照顾他的安全。

paras.en: Walliams has not spoken publicly since the story was first reported Tuesday afternoon.
paras.zh: 自周二下午首次报道此事以来，威廉姆斯尚未公开发表讲话。

paras.en: Police, meanwhile, encouraged any sex offence victim to come forward.
paras.zh: 与此同时，警方鼓励所有性犯罪受害者挺身而出。

paras.en: "We know reporting allegations of this nature can be daunting, but specialist officers are on hand to provide support, answer questions and guide you through the process," Det. Supt. Mike Cagney said.
paras.zh: “我们知道报告这种性质的指控可能令人望而生畏，但专家官员会随时为您提供支持、回答问题并指导您完成整个过程，”侦探说。警官。迈克·卡格尼说道。

articles.title: Russell Brand accused by 6 women of sexual misconduct, assault following rape conviction
articles.author: Alexandra Mae Jones

paras.en: Russell Brand accused by 6 women of sexual misconduct, assault following rape conviction
paras.zh: 拉塞尔·布兰德 (Russell Brand) 在强奸定罪后被 6 名女性指控性行为不端和袭击

paras.en: An investigation by The Times details further allegations against ex-comedian
paras.zh: 《泰晤士报》的一项调查详细介绍了针对前喜剧演员的进一步指控

paras.en: WARNING: This article may affect those who have experienced sexual violence or know someone affected by it.
paras.zh: 警告：本文可能会影响那些经历过性暴力或认识受其影响的人。

paras.en: Six more women have come forward alleging sexual misconduct and predatory behaviour by Russell Brand, according to an investigation by the U.K.-based newspaper The Times, following his conviction for rape and sexual assault earlier this week.
paras.zh: 据英国《泰晤士报》本周早些时候因强奸和性侵犯被定罪后，英国《泰晤士报》进行的一项调查显示，又有六名女性站出来指控拉塞尔·布兰德的不当性行为和掠夺性行为。

paras.en: The 51-year-old former comedian and actor was sentenced to more than 10 years in prison on Monday after being found guilty of raping a woman and committing three sexual assaults between 2004 and 2009.
paras.zh: 这位 51 岁的前喜剧演员兼演员因在 2004 年至 2009 年期间强奸一名妇女并犯下三起性侵犯罪，于周一被判处 10 多年监禁。

paras.en: In a joint investigation by The Times and Sunday Times published Friday, six more women described non-consensual encounters with Brand, including rape and sexual harassment.
paras.zh: 在《泰晤士报》和《星期日泰晤士报》周五发表的一项联合调查中，另外六名女性描述了与布兰德的非自愿接触，包括强奸和性骚扰。

paras.en: The publication also coincided with the release of a Netflix documentary on Brand called Open Secret, which examines how rumours of his unsettling behaviour persisted throughout his career.
paras.zh: 该出版物还恰逢 Netflix 一部关于布兰德的纪录片《公开的秘密》上映，这部纪录片探讨了关于他令人不安的行为的谣言是如何在他的整个职业生涯中持续存在的。

paras.en: One woman told The Times that Brand had continued having sex with her after she noticed he wasn't wearing a condom and told him to stop. She said the assault occurred during an on-off relationship she had with the actor in the late 2000s, and that Brand texted her to apologize afterwards.
paras.zh: 一名女子告诉《泰晤士报》，布兰德在发现他没有戴安全套并告诉他停止后，继续与她发生性关系。她说，这次袭击发生在2000年代末她与这位演员时断时续的关系期间，布兰德事后给她发短信道歉。

paras.en: "I justified it in my head by saying to myself: at least he admitted it," she told The Times.
paras.zh: “我在心里对自己说：至少他承认了，”她告诉《泰晤士报》。

paras.en: Another woman, who said she met Brand while lining up at one of his gigs in 2007 when she was 19, said she told him during a sexual encounter she was in pain but that he continued anyway.
paras.zh: 另一位女士说，她在 2007 年 19 岁的时候在布兰德的一场演出中认识了她，她说她在一次性接触中告诉他，她很痛苦，但他还是继续了。

paras.en: "And then it gets worse and it's really painful. And I say 'stop' and he doesn't stop," she said.
paras.zh: “然后情况变得更糟，真的很痛苦。我说‘停止’，但他没有停止，”她说。

paras.en: She alleged that Brand told her afterwards: "Tonight was consensual. Nobody did anything they didn’t want to do."
paras.zh: 她声称布兰德事后告诉她：“今晚是双方同意的。没有人做了他们不想做的事情。”

paras.en: "And that's the moment I just thought ... I know that you know what you've done is wrong," she said.
paras.zh: “那一刻我只是想......我知道你知道你所做的事情是错误的，”她说。

paras.en: Many of the women described meeting Brand at his comedy gigs or in situations where they felt he used his celebrity to manipulate them into hotel rooms, where his demeanour then changed.
paras.zh: 许多女性描述了在布兰德的喜剧演出中或在她们觉得布兰德利用自己的名气将她们操纵到酒店房间的情况下遇见他的情况，然后他的举止发生了变化。
