articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：月票是 CNN 旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派别试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在使用高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。城墙以椭圆形城墙为身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 建议住在景泰县中心。古城距离您的住处仅 30 分钟出租车车程，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候随时前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes.景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然充满活力的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended.由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history;钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答任何有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通会比私家车多花一两个小时。

articles.title: Android TV box malware found in 1.3M devices

paras.en: You buy a streaming box, plug it into your television and connect it to Wi-Fi. A few minutes later, you're watching your favorite show. Everything seems perfectly normal. But what if that little box has been secretly working for criminals since the day you brought it home?
paras.zh: 您购买一个流媒体盒，将其插入电视并连接到 Wi-Fi。几分钟后，您就可以观看您最喜欢的节目了。一切看起来都很正常。但如果这个小盒子从你带回家那天起就一直在秘密为犯罪分子服务怎么办？

paras.en: That's the alarming discovery behind a massive Android TV box malware operation involving more than 1.3 million devices worldwide. According to a Nov. 2 report from Google's Threat Intelligence Group, investigators concluded with high confidence that a device manufacturer deliberately installed hidden software inside streaming hardware. That backdoor gave outsiders remote access without the owners knowing.
paras.zh: 这是一次涉及全球超过 130 万台设备的大规模 Android TV 盒子恶意软件操作背后的惊人发现。根据谷歌威胁情报小组 11 月 2 日的一份报告，调查人员高度确信，一家设备制造商故意在流媒体硬件中安装了隐藏软件。该后门允许外部人员在所有者不知情的情况下进行远程访问。

paras.en: And here's what makes this particularly concerning. The malware was built directly into the devices, and some affected products made it through Google's own security certification process. In other words, buyers could do everything right and still end up with compromised hardware.
paras.zh: 这就是让这一点特别令人担忧的原因。该恶意软件直接内置于设备中，一些受影响的产品通过了谷歌自己的安全认证流程。换句话说，买家可能会做对所有事情，但最终仍然会得到受损的硬件。

paras.en: Missed CyberGuy LIVE? Watch the replay and discover 5 ways to travel smarter and save money.
paras.zh: 错过了 Cyber​​Guy LIVE？观看重播，了解 5 种更智能、更省钱的旅行方式。

paras.en: Our free CyberGuy LIVE class, 5 Ways to Travel Smarter and Save Money, has ended, but you can still watch the full replay. Kurt "CyberGuy" Knutsson walks you through five practical ways to protect your phone and personal information, avoid common travel scams, find better deals, save money on bookings and use technology to make your travels easier and less stressful. No technical experience is needed.
paras.zh: 我们的免费 Cyber​​Guy 现场课程“智慧旅行和省钱的 5 种方式”已经结束，但您仍然可以观看完整重播。 Kurt“Cyber​​Guy”Knutsson 将引导您了解五种实用方法来保护您的手机和个人信息、避免常见的旅行诈骗、找到更好的优惠、节省预订费用以及使用技术让您的旅行更轻松、更轻松。无需技术经验。

paras.en: Watch the free replay + downloadable checklist now at CyberGuyLive.com.
paras.zh: 立即在 Cyber​​GuyLive.com 观看免费重播 + 可下载清单。

paras.en: Google uncovers malware hiding inside Android TV boxes
paras.zh: 谷歌发现隐藏在 Android 电视盒内的恶意软件

paras.en: Google says the operation involved Videostrong Technology, a China-based company that manufactures Android-powered devices for different brands. According to investigators, Videostrong developed and installed malicious software called XCPE. Google assesses with high confidence that the company deliberately operated the backdoor for financial gain. The software allowed remote operators to maintain access to devices long after customers purchased them.
paras.zh: 谷歌表示，此次行动涉及Videostrong Technology，这是一家中国公司，为不同品牌生产Android设备。据调查人员称，Videostrong 开发并安装了名为 XCPE 的恶意软件。谷歌高度确信该公司故意操作后门以获取经济利益。该软件允许远程操作员在客户购买设备后很长时间内仍能保持对设备的访问。

paras.en: According to Google, Videostrong sold access to compromised devices to criminal affiliates, who installed additional malware and turned those products into part of a botnet. That's a network of infected devices controlled remotely without their owners' permission. Researchers identified more than 1.3 million affected devices across the globe. Most were Android TV streaming boxes, although the operation also reached other types of connected hardware. And many people using these products had no idea anything was wrong.
paras.zh: 据谷歌称，Videostrong 向犯罪附属机构出售了受感染设备的访问权限，这些附属机构安装了额外的恶意软件，并将这些产品变成了僵尸网络的一部分。这是一个由受感染设备组成的网络，未经所有者许可就被远程控制。研究人员在全球范围内发现了超过 130 万台受影响的设备。大多数是 Android TV 流媒体盒，不过该操作也适用于其他类型的连接硬件。许多使用这些产品的人并不知道有什么问题。

paras.en: What criminals were doing with infected streaming boxes
paras.zh: 犯罪分子用受感染的流媒体盒做了什么

paras.en: While people were watching television, hidden software could be working behind the scenes for someone else. One of the biggest operations involved residential proxy networks. These services allow someone to route their internet activity through another person's home connection. That means a criminal could use your internet address to make suspicious online activity appear to originate from your household.
paras.zh: 当人们看电视时，隐藏的软件可能在幕后为其他人工作。最大的业务之一涉及住宅代理网络。这些服务允许某人通过另一个人的家庭连接路由他们的互联网活动。这意味着犯罪分子可能会使用您的互联网地址使可疑的在线活动看起来像是来自您的家庭。

paras.en: Think about that for a moment. Someone you've never encountered could be using your internet connection without your permission, while your streaming box continues playing Netflix or YouTube. Google also found malware capable of generating fake advertising activity. Some modules secretly loaded ads or simulated interactions to generate revenue for the operators.
paras.zh: 想一想。您从未遇到过的人可能会在未经您许可的情况下使用您的互联网连接，而您的流媒体盒仍在继续播放 Netflix 或 YouTube。谷歌还发现恶意软件能够产生虚假广告活动。有些模块秘密加载广告或模拟交互，为运营商创造收入。

paras.en: Other capabilities were more invasive. Researchers observed operators capturing screenshots, injecting keystrokes and collecting sensitive account information from compromised devices. They could also install additional software remotely. And because much of this activity happened in the background, users might never see an obvious warning.
paras.zh: 其他功能更具侵入性。研究人员观察到操作员捕获屏幕截图、注入击键并从受感染的设备收集敏感帐户信息。他们还可以远程安装其他软件。由于大部分活动发生在后台，用户可能永远不会看到明显的警告。

paras.en: How the Android TV malware bypassed Google's security
paras.zh: Android TV 恶意软件如何绕过 Google 的安全措施

paras.en: Normally, manufacturers must pass Google's compatibility and security checks before shipping certified Android devices with Google's services. However, Google says Videostrong found a way around those protections. The company allegedly concealed malicious software during testing. The backdoor then loaded additional malicious code after the device's first startup, exploiting a gap in Google's review process.
paras.zh: 通常情况下，制造商必须通过 Google 的兼容性和安全检查，然后才能使用 Google 的服务交付经过认证的 Android 设备。然而，谷歌表示 Videostrong 找到了绕过这些保护的方法。据称该公司在测试过程中隐藏了恶意软件。然后，后门会在设备首次启动后加载额外的恶意代码，利用谷歌审查过程中的漏洞。

paras.en: Even more concerning, the malware could disable Google Play Protect app verification. That's one of Android's built-in defenses against harmful applications. The backdoor also had staying power. Researchers discovered that XCPE was embedded in the device's firmware, the software responsible for basic hardware operations. If someone removed the visible malware package, the system could reinstall it after a reboot. So even a factory reset might leave the underlying infection intact.
paras.zh: 更令人担忧的是，该恶意软件可能会禁用 Google Play Protect 应用程序验证。这是 Android 针对有害应用程序的内置防御措施之一。后门也具有持久力。研究人员发现 XCPE 嵌入在设备的固件中，该软件负责基本的硬件操作。如果有人删除了可见的恶意软件包，系统可能会在重新启动后重新安装它。因此，即使恢复出厂设置也可能使潜在的感染完好无损。

paras.en: This is probably the first question people will ask after hearing about this investigation. Unfortunately, Google has not released a complete consumer-friendly list of every infected retail product. However, cybersecurity company Synthient published its own investigation identifying specific hardware and model names connected to the operation.
paras.zh: 这可能是人们听到这项调查后会问的第一个问题。不幸的是，谷歌尚未发布每种受感染零售产品的完整消费者友好列表。然而，网络安全公司 Synthient 发布了自己的调查，确定了与该操作相关的特定硬件和型号名称。

paras.en: Researchers purchased and examined a MECOOL KM9PRO Max Android TV streaming box in late 2025. They found the XCPE backdoor preinstalled under the package name com.oemservice. The tested device used firmware version C1.0.8_20250325, according to Synthient's technical documentation. This identifies the specific research sample, although it does not establish that every unit running that version is infected.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 2025 年末购买并检查了一台 MECOOL KM9PRO Max Android TV 流媒体盒。他们发现 XCPE 后门预装在软件包名称 com.oemservice 下。根据Synthient的技术文档，测试设备使用的固件版本为C1.0.8_20250325。这标识了特定的研究样本，尽管它并不能确定运行该版本的每个单元都被感染。

paras.en: Other device models identified by researchers
paras.zh: 研究人员确定的其他设备型号

paras.en: Synthient also published model identifiers observed in the wider botnet. These include KM9PRO_MAX, KM9PRO, KM2PLUSDELUXE, KM2PLUS, KM7PLUS, KT1, IPx1, IPx3, Q96MAX and TX3MINI. These identifiers appeared in data associated with the malicious operation. However, researchers explicitly warn that a matching model name alone cannot confirm that an individual device is compromised. You can review Synthient's published device model list at github.com/synthient/public-research/blob/main/2026/11/Videostrong/README.md to compare it with your own hardware.
paras.zh: Synthient 还发布了在更广泛的僵尸网络中观察到的模型标识符。其中包括 KM9PRO_MAX、KM9PRO、KM2PLUSDELUXE、KM2PLUS、KM7PLUS、KT1、IPx1、IPx3、Q96MAX 和 TX3MINI。这些标识符出现在与恶意操作相关的数据中。然而，研究人员明确警告称，仅靠匹配的型号名称并不能确认单个设备已受到损害。您可以在 github.com/synthient/public-research/blob/main/2026/11/Videostrong/README.md 查看 Synthient 发布的设备型号列表，将其与您自己的硬件进行比较。

paras.en: The investigation also identified infections in Android-powered karaoke machines, digital signage equipment and some telehealth devices. Google says the malware appeared across many models and brands over several years. And that's why checking the exact product you own is so important. The retail brand on the box may differ from the company responsible for manufacturing its hardware or firmware.
paras.zh: 调查还发现了 Android 卡拉 OK 机、数字标牌设备和一些远程医疗设备中的感染。谷歌表示，该恶意软件多年来出现在许多型号和品牌中。这就是为什么检查您拥有的确切产品如此重要。盒子上的零售品牌可能与负责制造其硬件或固件的公司不同。

paras.en: Google shuts down the XCPE botnet and bans manufacturer
paras.zh: 谷歌关闭XCPE僵尸网络并禁止制造商

paras.en: Google worked with Japan's National Police Agency and several cybersecurity companies to dismantle the XCPE operation. Google took legal action to shut down the domains and servers Videostrong used to control infected devices and install malware. The company also pursued legal action against command-and-control domains associated with more than a dozen additional malware families. According to Google, those additional actions were expected to sever criminal access to at least 10 million other compromised devices. That estimate involves malware networks beyond the 1.3 million devices identified in the XCPE operation.
paras.zh: 谷歌与日本国家警察厅和几家网络安全公司合作拆除了 XCPE 行动。谷歌采取了法律行动，关闭了 Videostrong 用于控制受感染设备和安装恶意软件的域和服务器。该公司还针对与十多个其他恶意软件家族相关的命令和控制域采取了法律行动。据谷歌称，这些额外的行动预计将阻止犯罪分子对至少 1000 万台其他受感染设备的访问。据估计，XCPE 操作中发现的恶意软件网络超过 130 万台设备。

paras.en: Google also cut ties with Videostrong and banned the company, along with future subsidiaries and affiliates, from building or selling certified Android devices or supplying software to other certified vendors. The company says it has also strengthened its security review process to better detect similar threats, including improvements to how it verifies the integrity of firmware on certified Android TV devices. That's encouraging news, but there's an important catch. Disrupting the servers used to control malware doesn't automatically remove malicious firmware from devices already sitting in people's homes. For owners of affected hardware, that leaves an important question about whether their devices can ever be trusted again.
paras.zh: 谷歌还切断了与 Videostrong 的联系，并禁止该公司以及未来的子公司和附属公司制造或销售经过认证的 Android 设备或向其他经过认证的供应商提供软件。该公司表示，它还加强了安全审查流程，以更好地检测类似威胁，包括改进验证经过认证的 Android TV 设备上固件完整性的方式。这是一个令人鼓舞的消息，但有一个重要的问题。破坏用于控制恶意软件的服务器并不会自动从人们家中已有的设备中删除恶意固件。对于受影响硬件的所有者来说，这留下了一个重要问题：他们的设备是否可以再次受到信任。

paras.en: How to protect yourself from Android TV box malware
paras.zh: 如何保护自己免受 Android 电视盒恶意软件的侵害

paras.en: Now, before you start unplugging every streaming device in your house, understand that Google has not suggested every Android TV or Google TV product is compromised. However, this investigation offers a good reason to take a closer look at the equipment connected to your home network.
paras.zh: 现在，在您开始拔掉家里所有流媒体设备的电源之前，请了解 Google 并未建议所有 Android TV 或 Google TV 产品都受到损害。然而，这项调查提供了一个充分的理由来仔细研究连接到家庭网络的设备。

paras.en: 1) Check your streaming box's brand and model
paras.zh: 1) 检查您的流媒体盒的品牌和型号

paras.en: Start by identifying the exact make and model of your streaming device. Look on the underside of the box, its original packaging or the device information screen in Settings. Compare that information with Synthient's list of observed models. If your device matches a listed model, investigate further. Remember, a model match alone does not confirm an infection. If you own the MECOOL KM9PRO Max examined by researchers, take the warning seriously and consider replacing it.
paras.zh: 首先确定您的流媒体设备的确切品牌和型号。查看盒子的底部、原始包装或“设置”中的设备信息屏幕。将该信息与 Synthient 观察到的模型列表进行比较。如果您的设备与列出的型号匹配，请进一步调查。请记住，仅模型匹配并不能确认感染。如果您拥有经过研究人员检查的 MECOOL KM9PRO Max，请认真对待该警告并考虑更换它。

paras.en: 2) Disconnect a device you believe is infected
paras.zh: 2) 断开您认为已感染的设备的连接

paras.en: If you have strong reason to suspect your streaming box contains malicious firmware, disconnect it from Wi-Fi or unplug it entirely. Contact the manufacturer or retailer about a verified clean firmware update, replacement or refund. Synthient recommends permanently removing affected devices from use because they may contain additional malware. Don't assume a factory reset will solve the problem. The XCPE backdoor was designed to reinstall itself.
paras.zh: 如果您有充分的理由怀疑您的流媒体盒包含恶意固件，请将其与 Wi-Fi 断开或完全拔掉。请联系制造商或零售商了解经过验证的干净固件更新、更换或退款。 Synthient 建议永久停止使用受影响的设备，因为它们可能包含其他恶意软件。不要以为恢复出厂设置就能解决问题。 XCPE 后门旨在自行重新安装。

paras.en: 3) Check Google Play Protect certification
paras.zh: 3) 检查 Google Play Protect 认证

paras.en: On devices with the Google Play Store, open the Play Store, tap your profile icon and select Settings > About to check the Play Protect certification status. You can also open Play Protect from your profile menu to review security scanning. However, certification alone cannot guarantee a device is free of malware. Some devices associated with this investigation passed Google's certification checks. A certified label offers an additional layer of reassurance, but it cannot guarantee that a device is free of malware.
paras.zh: 在具有 Google Play 商店的设备上，打开 Play 商店，点击您的个人资料图标，然后选择“设置”>“关于”以检查 Play Protect 认证状态。您还可以从个人资料菜单中打开 Play Protect 以查看安全扫描。然而，仅认证并不能保证设备没有恶意软件。与此调查相关的一些设备通过了 Google 的认证检查。经过认证的标签可以提供额外的保证，但它不能保证设备没有恶意软件。

paras.en: 4) Avoid suspicious streaming apps and cheap TV boxes
paras.zh: 4）避免可疑的流媒体应用程序和廉价的电视盒

paras.en: Be cautious about streaming products promising unlimited premium channels or paid entertainment for a suspiciously low one-time price. The FBI has previously warned about questionable streaming hardware that arrives with malware or installs it during setup. Stick with reputable manufacturers that provide regular security updates. Also, avoid installing streaming applications from unofficial websites or unknown app marketplaces.
paras.zh: 对于承诺无限量付费频道或一次性价格低得可疑的付费娱乐的流媒体产品要保持谨慎。美国联邦调查局 (FBI) 此前曾警告称，存在问题的流媒体硬件可能会附带恶意软件或在安装过程中安装。坚持使用定期提供安全更新的信誉良好的制造商。此外，避免从非官方网站或未知的应用程序市场安装流媒体应用程序。

paras.en: 5) Keep your home router updated and secure
paras.zh: 5) 保持您的家庭路由器更新和安全

paras.en: Your router connects your streaming equipment to the rest of your home network. Make sure its firmware is current and review the list of connected devices for unfamiliar equipment. If your router supports a separate guest or smart-home network, consider placing streaming boxes and other connected gadgets there. That can help limit their access to your personal computers and other sensitive devices. If you discover an infected device, disconnect it before changing your Wi-Fi password. A password change alone will not remove malware already embedded in the box.
paras.zh: 您的路由器将您的流媒体设备连接到家庭网络的其余部分。确保其固件是最新的，并查看已连接设备列表中是否有不熟悉的设备。如果您的路由器支持单独的访客或智能家居网络，请考虑在那里放置流媒体盒和其他连接的小工具。这可以帮助限制他们对您的个人计算机和其他敏感设备的访问。如果您发现受感染的设备，请在更改 Wi-Fi 密码之前将其断开连接。仅更改密码并不能删除已嵌入盒子中的恶意软件。

paras.en: Check your router's activity logs or connected-device information if those features are available. Unexplained bandwidth consumption or unfamiliar network connections can be warning signs, although they do not prove a device has malware. Keep in mind that an infected streaming box may show no obvious symptoms. Normal performance doesn't guarantee that the hardware is secure.
paras.zh: 检查路由器的活动日志或连接设备信息（如果这些功能可用）。无法解释的带宽消耗或不熟悉的网络连接可能是警告信号，尽管它们并不能证明设备存在恶意软件。请记住，受感染的流媒体盒可能不会表现出明显的症状。正常性能并不能保证硬件安全。

paras.en: 7) Protect accounts connected to your streaming device
paras.zh: 7) 保护连接到您的流媒体设备的帐户

paras.en: If you've signed into streaming services or a Google account on a device you believe was compromised, change those passwords using a trusted computer or phone. Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) where available. Also, review your account activity for unfamiliar sign-ins. Google observed operators collecting sensitive information from compromised devices, so protecting those accounts is a sensible precaution.
paras.zh: 如果您在您认为受到威胁的设备上登录了流媒体服务或 Google 帐户，请使用受信任的计算机或手机更改这些密码。在可用的情况下启用双因素身份验证 (2FA)。另外，请检查您的帐户活动是否有不熟悉的登录。谷歌观察到运营商从受感染的设备收集敏感信息，因此保护这些帐户是一项明智的预防措施。

paras.en: 8) Use strong antivirus protection on compatible devices
paras.zh: 8) 在兼容设备上使用强大的防病毒保护

paras.en: Strong antivirus software can help protect your computers and smartphones from malicious downloads and other threats. Keep those protections enabled, especially when dealing with unfamiliar applications. However, traditional antivirus software on your computer won't remove a backdoor embedded in a streaming box's firmware. If the box itself is compromised, disconnecting and replacing it may be the safest solution. Get my picks for the best 2026 antivirus protection winners for your Windows, Mac, Android & iOS devices at Cyberguy.com
paras.zh: 强大的防病毒软件可以帮助保护您的计算机和智能手机免受恶意下载和其他威胁。保持这些保护处于启用状态，尤其是在处理不熟悉的应用程序时。但是，计算机上的传统防病毒软件不会删除嵌入在流媒体盒固件中的后门。如果盒子本身受到损害，断开连接并更换它可能是最安全的解决方案。在 Cyber​​guy.com 上获取我为您的 Windows、Mac、Android 和 iOS 设备挑选的 2026 年最佳防病毒保护获奖者

paras.en: 9) Be careful with apps that pay you to share internet bandwidth
paras.zh: 9) 小心付费分享互联网带宽的应用程序

paras.en: Some services offer compensation in exchange for allowing others to use your unused internet connection. Google specifically warns that these arrangements can expose devices and home networks to additional security risks. Before installing any bandwidth-sharing or proxy application, understand exactly who can access your connection and what activity they may conduct through it.
paras.zh: 有些服务会提供补偿，以换取允许其他人使用您未使用的互联网连接。谷歌特别警告说，这些安排可能会使设备和家庭网络面临额外的安全风险。在安装任何带宽共享或代理应用程序之前，请准确了解谁可以访问您的连接以及他们可以通过该连接进行哪些活动。

paras.en: What really gets my attention about this investigation is how little someone would have needed to do to become a victim. You could buy a streaming box from an online retailer, connect it to your television and end up with malware that was already installed before you opened the package. And there's another part of this story I find particularly frustrating. Some affected devices made it through Google's certification process. People rely on those certifications because they assume someone has checked the hardware for security problems. In this case, that trust was exploited. Google deserves credit for working with investigators to disrupt the operation. But I think the bigger responsibility starts with manufacturers and the companies selling these products. If a company puts compromised hardware into someone's home, it should be held accountable for fixing the problem. For me, the takeaway is pretty simple. Know what you're connecting to your home network. Stick with brands that have a solid record of security updates. And if researchers confirm that a streaming box contains malicious firmware, I wouldn't keep using it simply because the picture on the television still looks fine.
paras.zh: 这项调查真正引起我注意的是，一个人只需做很少的事情就可以成为受害者。您可以从在线零售商处购买流媒体盒，将其连接到电视，最终会在打开包装之前安装已经安装的恶意软件。这个故事的另一部分我觉得特别令人沮丧。一些受影响的设备通过了 Google 的认证流程。人们依赖这些认证，因为他们认为有人已经检查过硬件是否存在安全问题。在这种情况下，这种信任被利用了。谷歌与调查人员合作破坏了这一行动，值得赞扬。但我认为更大的责任始于制造商和销售这些产品的公司。如果一家公司将受损的硬件放入某人的家中，则该公司应该负责解决问题。对我来说，外卖非常简单。了解您连接到家庭网络的内容。坚持选择拥有可靠安全更新记录的品牌。如果研究人员确认流媒体盒包含恶意固件，我不会仅仅因为电视上的图像看起来仍然不错而继续使用它。

paras.en: If a streaming box can pass Google's security checks and still arrive with hidden malware, should manufacturers be required to recall compromised devices and compensate customers? Let us know by writing to us at Cyberguy.com
paras.zh: 如果流媒体盒可以通过谷歌的安全检查，但仍然带有隐藏的恶意软件，那么制造商是否应该被要求召回受损设备并对客户进行赔偿？请通过 Cyber​​guy.com 写信告知我们
