articles.title: Animal rights activist attacks NYC horse carriage driver with skateboard during tirade, union says

paras.en: An angry animal rights activist armed with a skateboard allegedly assaulted two horse-drawn carriage drivers in Central Park on Tuesday after launching an expletive-laden tirade in front of visiting families, union representatives said.
paras.zh: 工会代表称，周二，一名愤怒的动物权利活动人士手持滑板，在来访的家庭面前发表了充满咒骂的长篇大论后，据称在中央公园袭击了两名马车司机。

paras.en: Abigail Holbrook, 27, of Philadelphia, was arrested after screaming at drivers and accusing them of "animal abuse" near a carriage stand, according to police and video of the incident.
paras.zh: 据警方和该事件的视频显示，来自费城的27岁女子Abigail Holbrook在马车停靠点附近对驾车者大喊大叫，指责他们“虐待动物”，随后被逮捕。

paras.en: "You’re animal abusers! Horses do not do well in New York City. They are very sensitive to light and noise," Holbrook shouted, according to video of the confrontation. "The people that are f------ using these horses are animal abusers. I’m Squid the Kid, bro. Y’all will know my f------ name."
paras.zh: 根据冲突视频，霍尔布鲁克喊道：“你们是虐待动物的人！马在纽约市过得不好。它们对光和噪音非常敏感。” “使用这些马的人都是动物虐待者。我是乌贼小子，兄弟。你们都会知道我的名字。”

paras.en: During the altercation, Holbrook punched two 45-year-old drivers and struck one of them in the head with her skateboard, the Transport Workers Union of America (TWU) told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 美国运输工人联盟 (TWU) 告诉福克斯数字新闻，在争吵期间，霍尔布鲁克殴打了两名 45 岁的司机，并用滑板击中其中一名司机的头部。

paras.en: Both victims suffered minor injuries and declined medical treatment at the scene. Holbrook was taken into custody by the New York City Police Department and is charged with two counts of assault.
paras.zh: 两名受害者均受轻伤，并拒绝在现场接受治疗。霍尔布鲁克被纽约市警察局拘留，并被指控犯有两项袭击罪。

paras.en: "This is outrageous and unacceptable," TWU Local 100 Administrative Vice President Alexander Kemp said in a statement. "We need a more visible police presence for our members at horse-carriage stands in the park to protect against these wackos. This is their place of work and people are coming just to harass and attack them. All workers deserve to be safe at work."
paras.zh: TWU Local 100 行政副总裁 Alexander Kemp 在一份声明中表示：“这是令人愤慨且不可接受的。” “我们需要在公园的马车站为我们的成员提供更明显的警察存在，以防止这些疯子。这是他们的工作场所，人们来这里只是为了骚扰和攻击他们。所有工人都应该在工作中保持安全。”

paras.en: Christina Hansen, a union shop steward who witnessed the assault and alerted police, placed the blame on rhetoric from city leadership and advocacy groups.
paras.zh: 目击袭击事件并向警方报警的工会商店代表克里斯蒂娜·汉森(Christina Hansen)将责任归咎于市领导层和倡导团体的言论。

paras.en: "The problem is that a lot of people, you know, don't know anything about horses, and they get misled by these animal rights groups who liken it to slavery, and say that the horses are being tortured by being forced to drag heavy carriages around as if carriages don't have wheels," Hansen told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 汉森告诉福克斯新闻数字频道：“问题是，很多人对马一无所知，他们被这些动物权利组织误导，这些动物权利组织将马比作奴隶制，并说马被迫拖着沉重的马车四处走动，就好像马车没有轮子一样，正在遭受折磨。”

paras.en: Hansen noted that the financial livelihoods of carriage drivers depend on whether their horses are well taken care of.
paras.zh: 汉森指出，马车司机的经济生计取决于他们的马是否得到很好的照顾。

paras.en: "Let's face it, these organizations ... make money by getting donations and there's no money to be made by telling people that our horses are well taken care of," she said. "I only make money if my horse is well taken care of because I can't go to work if he can't pull the carriage, if he doesn't enjoy his job ... so my monetary interest is that my horse is taken care of. Their monetary interest is that the horses are being abused or exploited or whatever."
paras.zh: “让我们面对现实吧，这些组织……通过获得捐款来赚钱，而告诉人们我们的马匹得到很好的照顾是赚不到钱的。”她说。“只有我的马得到妥善照料，我才能赚钱，因为如果它不能拉马车，如果不喜欢这份工作，我就无法去工作……所以我的经济利益在于我的马得到妥善照料。他们的经济利益在于马匹受到虐待、剥削或类似情况。”

paras.en: The violence erupted amid ongoing legal and political battles surrounding the city's historic carriage industry.
paras.zh: 这场暴力事件是在围绕该市历史悠久的运输业持续不断的法律和政治斗争中爆发的。

paras.en: Last month, the city council voted 40 to 7 to pass Romanch's Law, named in memory of 18-year-old Romanch Mahajan, who died in June after being thrown from a runaway carriage in Central Park.
paras.zh: 上个月，市议会以 40 比 7 的投票结果通过了罗曼奇法案，该法案是为了纪念 18 岁的罗曼奇·马哈詹 (Romanch Mahajan)，他于 6 月在中央公园从一辆失控的马车上被抛出后死亡。

paras.en: The legislation would phase out horse-drawn carriages entirely by June 1, 2028, while directing the city to establish a transition program for more than 150 drivers and industry workers.
paras.zh: 该立法将在 2028 年 6 月 1 日之前完全淘汰马车，同时指示该市为 150 多名司机和行业工人制定过渡计划。

paras.en: In a statement to Fox News Digital, People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA) pushed back against the union's accusations.
paras.zh: 在向福克斯新闻数字频道发表的一份声明中，善待动物组织 (PETA) 反驳了该工会的指控。

paras.en: "If the horse-drawn carriage trade is suddenly concerned about hostility and violence, it might start by looking in the mirror," the group said.
paras.zh: 该组织表示：“如果马车贸易突然担心敌意和暴力，可能要先反思一下。”

paras.en: Horse-drawn carriages have been a staple of Central Park and Fifth Avenue for generations, providing iconic rides for tourists visiting the city.
paras.zh: 几代人以来，马车一直是中央公园和第五大道的主要交通工具，为游览这座城市的游客提供标志性的游乐设施。

paras.en: "Carriage horses have been pulling carriages in Central Park since the day the park opened in December 1858," said Hansen. "They've been living on Manhattan since 1625. The city would not be the city that it is, and Central Park would not be the park that it is, except for horses."
paras.zh: 汉森说：“自 1858 年 12 月中央公园开放以来，马车就一直在中央公园拉车。” “他们自 1625 年起就住在曼哈顿。这座城市不会是原来的城市，中央公园也不会是原来的公园，除了马。”

articles.title: Giants quarterback Jameis Winston leaves broadcasters floored with absurd snap count: 'What is he doing?'

paras.en: In one of the most critical moments of the New York Giants' loss, Jameis Winston decided to bust out one of the most absurd snap counts of all time.
paras.zh: 在纽约巨人队失利的最关键时刻之一，杰梅斯·温斯顿决定打出有史以来最荒谬的快球计数之一。

paras.en: Winston, who was trying to draw the Washington Commanders offside on fourth-and-1 on the Giants' own 11-yard line, decided to start singing in his cadence.
paras.zh: 温斯顿试图在巨人队自己的 11 码线上第四和一号线使华盛顿指挥官队越位，他决定开始按照他的节奏唱歌。

paras.en: "Set, we good, we good, we good. Get ready, get set, hut one, hut two, hut three. Who let the dogs out, woof, woof, woof, woof," Winston said in his snap count.
paras.zh: “准备好，准备好，准备好。准备好，准备好，一号小屋，二号小屋，三号小屋。谁把狗放出来了，汪，汪，汪，汪，”温斯顿在快速数数中说道。

paras.en: Shockingly, the Commanders didn’t jump offside, despite the Baha Men's classic song. Amazon Prime Video broadcasters Al Michaels and Kirk Herbstreit were floored by Winston’s snap count.
paras.zh: 令人震惊的是，尽管巴哈人唱了经典歌曲，但指挥官们并没有越位。亚马逊 Prime Video 广播公司 Al Michaels 和 Kirk Herbstreit 对温斯顿的快照计数感到震惊。

paras.en: "You gotta be kidding me!" Michaels said while bursting into laughter.
paras.zh: “你一定是在开玩笑吧！”迈克尔斯笑着说道。

paras.en: Giants coach John Harbaugh said he was aware that "Who Let the Dogs Out" would be part of Winston's cadence.
paras.zh: 巨人队教练约翰·哈博表示，他知道“谁放狗了”将成为温斯顿节奏的一部分。

paras.en: "It's part of the cadence. Yeah, it's part of the cadence. You know, teams do jump in those situations sometimes, so that was the idea."
paras.zh: “这是节奏的一部分。是的，这是节奏的一部分。你知道，团队有时确实会在这种情况下跳跃，所以这就是我们的想法。”

paras.en: The Giants took a delay-of-game penalty after the Commanders stayed onside before punting. New York eventually lost 24-21.
paras.zh: 在指挥官们在弃踢之前留在一边后，巨人队受到了延迟比赛的处罚。纽约队最终以24-21落败。

paras.en: Winston has continued to appear in games since being relegated to a backup role behind J.J. McCarthy. The Giants have used him as a short-yardage specialist on quarterback sneaks.
paras.zh: 自从被降级为 J.J. 的替补角色后，温斯顿继续出现在比赛中。麦卡锡。巨人队将他用作四分卫偷袭的短码数专家。

paras.en: Against the Philadelphia Eagles last week, Winston led an impressive touchdown drive in the team’s win while McCarthy was being evaluated for an injury. Fans could next see Winston and his cadence in action when the Giants (5-3-1) play the Jacksonville Jaguars (6-2) next Sunday.
paras.zh: 上周对阵费城老鹰队的比赛中，温斯顿在球队获胜时打出了令人印象深刻的达阵，而麦卡锡正在接受伤病评估。当巨人队（5-3-1）下周日迎战杰克逊维尔美洲虎队（6-2）时，球迷们可以看到温斯顿和他的节奏。

articles.title: Europe should not walk into Russia’s ‘traps’ on Ukraine talks, EU’s foreign policy chief Kallas says – as it happened
articles.author: Jakub Krupa

paras.en: Reported Russian demands on Ukraine, Europe have no chance of succeeding - snap analysis
paras.zh: 据报道，俄罗斯对乌克兰的要求，欧洲没有成功的机会——快速分析

paras.en: Meanwhile, German tabloid Bild has reported on what it says are the key Russian demands put forward in negotiations with Europe, Ukraine, the US.
paras.zh: 与此同时，德国小报《图片报》报道了俄罗斯在与欧洲、乌克兰和美国谈判中提出的关键要求。

paras.en: It includes a number of maximalist demands which would dramatically alter the security landscape for Ukraine and Europe.
paras.zh: 它包括许多极端主义要求，这些要求将极大地改变乌克兰和欧洲的安全格局。

paras.en: We already knew about some of them – for example, Russia’s demand to keep the occupied Ukrainian territories and the entire Donbas region, demilitarise Ukrainian ports and keep Ukraine out of Nato – but there are also some new ones, including a reported request that Nato should not have any bases in the Baltics and that Finland, which only joined in 2023, should be made to leave the alliance.
paras.zh: 我们已经知道其中一些——例如，俄罗斯要求保留被占领的乌克兰领土和整个顿巴斯地区、乌克兰港口非军事化以及将乌克兰排除在北约之外——但也有一些新的要求，包括据报道要求北约不应在波罗的海地区设立任何基地，以及要求2023年才加入的芬兰退出该联盟。

paras.en: The list also includes new proposals on Moldova, which Moscow reportedly wants to turn into a federal republic and then force referendums on the future of two of its regions, Transnistria and Gaugazia.
paras.zh: 该清单还包括关于摩尔多瓦的新提案，据报道莫斯科希望将摩尔多瓦转变为联邦共和国，然后强制对其两个地区德涅斯特河沿岸和高加齐亚的未来进行全民公投。

paras.en: If this list is true – which we do not know that and have not been able to independently verify it – it is probably fair to say that it’s just not going to work and will only anger Europeans at the time when the US wants to get them formally involved in the process.
paras.zh: 如果这份清单属实——我们不知道这一点，也无法独立核实——那么可以公平地说，它不会起作用，只会在美国想让欧洲人正式参与这一进程时激怒欧洲人。

paras.en: Ukraine has been repeatedly clear that it has no intention of giving away the temporarily occupied territories, and even less of signing off the parts that are actually still controlled by Kyiv.
paras.zh: 乌克兰多次明确表示无意放弃暂时占领的领土，更无意签署基辅实际控制的部分。

paras.en: And Finland’s defence minister Antti Häkkänen also made it clear that the demand on Finland’s Nato membership has no chance of succeeding.
paras.zh: 而芬兰国防部长安蒂·哈卡宁也明确表示，芬兰加入北约的要求没有成功的机会。

paras.en: “These matters are not up for negotiation. Russia knows that and it’s absolutely outrageous to even suggest this,” he said, quoted by Finnish public broadcaster yle. “Finland will not be forced out [of Nato],” he added.
paras.zh: 芬兰公共广播公司 yle 援引他的话说：“这些问题不需要谈判。俄罗斯知道这一点，甚至提出这样的建议绝对是无耻的。” “芬兰不会被迫退出[北约]，”他补充道。

paras.en: The chairman of the Finnish parliament’s foreign affairs committee, Johannes Koskinen, told reporters that “if such a paper or demand has been submitted, it will go straight into the bin,” IS reported.
paras.zh: 据《IS》报道，芬兰议会外交事务委员会主席约翰内斯·科斯基宁告诉记者，“如果提交了这样的文件或要求，它将直接被扔进垃圾桶”。

paras.en: Lithuanian foreign minister Kęstutis Budrys also made it clear earlier this week that Lithuania would block any agreement giving Russia the power to stop Nato deployments in the region.
paras.zh: 立陶宛外交部长肯斯图蒂斯·布德里斯本周早些时候也明确表示，立陶宛将阻止任何赋予俄罗斯权力阻止北约在该地区部署的协议。

paras.en: And, on that note, we will be closing the blog for today.
paras.zh: 并且，就此而言，我们今天将关闭博客。

paras.en: The EU’s foreign policy chief has warned against “walking into the traps that Russia is setting” as she said Moscow was trying to start a debate about European security in order to divert attention from its aggression (11:04, 16:54).
paras.zh: 欧盟外交政策负责人警告不要“走进俄罗斯设置的陷阱”，她表示莫斯科试图引发一场有关欧洲安全的辩论，以转移人们对其侵略行为的注意力(11:04, 16:54)。

paras.en: Her comments came on the sidelines of EU leaders’ meeting in Dublin, Ireland called to discuss the latest on Ukraine, including Europe’s representations in any future talks (9:53, 10:21, 10:39, 11:35, 11:52, 12:12, 13:41, 14:15), and AI (15:13, 17:32).
paras.zh: 她的评论是在爱尔兰都柏林举行的欧盟领导人会议间隙发表的，会议要求讨论乌克兰的最新情况，包括欧洲在未来谈判中的代表（9:53、10:21、10:39、11:35、11:52、12:12、13:41、14:15）和人工智能（15:13、17:32）。

paras.en: Several leaders also called for more support for Ukraine ahead of “tough, tough” winter as Russian attacks continue (10:30, 12:38).
paras.zh: 几位领导人还呼吁在俄罗斯继续发动袭击之际，在“艰难、艰难”的冬季到来之前为乌克兰提供更多支持（10:30、12:38）。

paras.en: The meeting comes amid increasingly heated debate on potential peace talks with Russia and Moscow’s maximalist demands (15:57).
paras.zh: 此次会议召开之际，关于与俄罗斯的潜在和平谈判以及莫斯科的最高要求的争论日益激烈 (15:57)。

paras.en: Belgian prime minister Bart De Wever will meet his coalition partners for crunch budget talks on Friday, as they seek to agree cost-cutting measures before a Monday deadline (17:19).
paras.zh: 比利时首相巴特·德韦弗 (Bart De Wever) 将于周五会见其联盟伙伴，进行紧缩预算谈判，他们寻求在周一最后期限 (17:19) 之前就削减成本措施达成一致。

paras.en: Dutch prime minister Rob Jetten is also holding crisis talks with his coalition partners after his minority government got into trouble this week over a tax reform deal with opposition parties (17:24).
paras.zh: 荷兰首相罗布·杰顿 (Rob Jetten) 也在与他的联盟伙伴举行危机会谈，此前他的少数党政府本周因与反对党的税收改革协议陷入困境 (17:24)。

paras.en: Sweden’s Centre party has emerged as kingmakers that could decide the next Swedish government, with two rival blocs set to present their offers by the end of the day today (11:35).
paras.zh: 瑞典中间党已成为可以决定下一届瑞典政府的国王制定者，两个敌对集团将在今天结束时（11:35）提出他们的提议。

paras.en: If you have any tips, comments or suggestions, email me at jakub.krupa@theguardian.com.
paras.zh: 如果您有任何提示、意见或建议，请发送电子邮件至 jakub.krupa@theguardian.com。

paras.en: I am also on Bluesky at @jakubkrupa.bsky.social and on X at @jakubkrupa.
paras.zh: 我还在 Bluesky 上@jakubkrupa.bsky.social 和 X 上@jakubkrupa。

paras.en: EU leaders warn 'independence cannot be outsourced' as they call for joint action on AI
paras.zh: 欧盟领导人警告“独立性不能外包”，呼吁对人工智能采取联合行动

paras.en: Back in Dublin, the leaders are still wrapping up their talks, with at least some of them seemingly inspired by what they heard about AI today.
paras.zh: 回到都柏林，领导人仍在结束会谈，至少其中一些人似乎受到了今天听到的有关人工智能的启发。

paras.en: After their session with Mistral AI founder, Artur Mensch, France’s Emmanuel Macron has warned fellow leaders that “our independence cannot be outsourced” as he called for more investments into AI.
paras.zh: 在与 Mistral AI 创始人 Artur Mensch 会面后，法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙 (Emmanuel Macron) 警告其他领导人，“我们的独立性不能被外包”，因为他呼吁对人工智能进行更多投资。

paras.en: “We have the talent, the energy and the technology. Now we need to invest more, make decisions faster and, above all, act together,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们拥有人才、精力和技术。现在我们需要加大投资，更快地做出决策，最重要的是共同行动，”他说。

paras.en: Macron added he would host another summit with ‘tech creators’ on 2 December in Paris, co-hosted with the Netherlands’ Jetten.
paras.zh: 马克龙补充说，他将于 12 月 2 日在巴黎与荷兰 Jetten 共同主办另一场“科技创造者”峰会。

paras.en: Poland’s DonaldTuskstruck a similarly urgent tone, saying “our next race is the AI race.”
paras.zh: 波兰的唐纳德·图斯克也用同样紧迫的语气说：“我们的下一场竞赛是人工智能竞赛。”

paras.en: “By joining forces, Europe gains much more scale, power and influence. By coordinating our efforts, we can all be 27 times more productive, access 27 times more services and speed up our growth,” he said.
paras.zh: “通过联合起来，欧洲获得了更大的规模、权力和影响力。通过协调我们的努力，我们的生产力可以提高 27 倍，获得的服务可以增加 27 倍，并加速我们的增长，”他说。

paras.en: “Let’s stop funding our ambitions separately, work together and secure Europe’s place in the AI revolution.”
paras.zh: “让我们停止各自资助我们的雄心壮志，共同努力，确保欧洲在人工智能革命中的地位。”

paras.en: Dutch PM Jetten locked in coalition crisis talks after disagreements over tax reform
paras.zh: 荷兰首相杰顿在税收改革问题上存在分歧，陷入联盟危机谈判

paras.en: Over in the Netherlands, prime minister Rob Jetten is also holding crisis talks with his coalition partners after his minority government got into trouble this week over a tax reform deal with opposition parties.
paras.zh: 在荷兰，总理罗布·杰滕(Rob Jetten)也在与他的联盟伙伴举行危机会谈，此前他的少数派政府本周因与反对党的税收改革协议而陷入麻烦。

paras.en: The terms of the deal angered the right-wing People’s Party for Freedom and Democracy, or VVD, which voted against the reform and expressed its frustration with the move.
paras.zh: 该协议的条款激怒了右翼自由民主人民党（VVD），该党投票反对这项改革，并对此举表示失望。

paras.en: Jetten skipped the EU summit in Dublin (11:52) and has been locked for several hours now with the other party leaders in hope of finding a way forward.
paras.zh: 杰顿缺席了在都柏林举行的欧盟峰会（11:52），并与其他政党领导人锁定了几个小时，希望找到前进的道路。

paras.en: “No one is waiting for endless political squabbling in The Hague or for new elections, and we must do everything in our power to find a way forward together,” he told reporters.
paras.zh: 他对记者表示：“没有人会等待海牙无休止的政治争吵或新的选举，我们必须尽一切努力共同寻找前进的道路。”

paras.en: Belgian government holds crunch budget talks to avoid collapse
paras.zh: 比利时政府举行紧缩预算谈判以避免崩溃

paras.en: Belgian prime minister Bart De Wever will meet his coalition partners for crunch budget talks on Friday, as they seek to agree cost-cutting measures before a Monday deadline.
paras.zh: 比利时首相巴特·德韦弗将于周五与他的联盟伙伴会面，进行紧缩预算谈判，他们寻求在周一最后期限前就削减成本措施达成一致。

paras.en: De Wever, a Flemish conservative, offered his resignation to King Philippe earlier this month after his five-party coalition failed to reach a deal on the 2027 budget.
paras.zh: 佛兰德保守派人士德韦弗本月早些时候向菲利普国王提出辞职，此前他领导的五党联盟未能就 2027 年预算达成协议。

paras.en: But the monarch refused to accept it and told him instead to report back on 16 November.
paras.zh: 但君主拒绝接受，并要求他于 11 月 16 日汇报。

paras.en: Coalition members are to gather on Friday evening and De Wever’s office has indicated talks could run into the weekend, AFP reported.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，联盟成员将于周五晚上聚集，德韦弗的办公室表示会谈可能会持续到周末。

paras.en: Spain’s two deadly train accidents this year have driven passengers away from the world’s second-largest high-speed rail network, a concern for a country heavily reliant on tourism and business travel, experts and business groups said, as reported by Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，专家和商业团体表示，西班牙今年发生的两起致命火车事故导致乘客离开世界第二大高铁网络，这对一个严重依赖旅游业和商务旅行的国家来说是一个担忧。

paras.en: According to competition watchdog CNMC’s data, the number of long-distance high-speed rail passengers fell 15% in January-June to 18.7 million following January’s high-speed train collision near the village of Adamuz in southern Spain that killed 46 people, with most travellers switching to rental cars and domestic flights. Based on Reuters’ calculations, that was almost six times the impact a 30-day closure of the line might normally be expected to have.
paras.zh: 根据竞争监管机构CNMC的数据，1月至6月，西班牙南部阿达穆兹村附近发生高铁相撞事故，造成46人死亡，长途高铁乘客数量下降15%，至1870万人次，大多数旅客改乘租车和国内航班。根据路透社的计算，这几乎是通常预计线路关闭 30 天所产生影响的六倍。

paras.en: The 28 October collision, which killed 69 people, shut the Madrid-Andalusia high-speed line for the second time in nine months, forcing its nearly 19,000 daily passengers to seek alternatives. The line remains closed.
paras.zh: 10 月 28 日发生的事故造成 69 人死亡，马德里-安达卢西亚高速铁路九个月内第二次关闭，迫使每日近 19,000 名乘客寻求替代方案。该线路仍然关闭。

paras.en: The impact of the latest crash is yet to be quantified but is likely to be heavier, experts say, as they fear further erosion of confidence in Spain, the world’s second-most visited country after France, as a safe travel destination.
paras.zh: 专家表示，最近这起事故的影响尚未量化，但可能会更严重，因为他们担心西班牙作为安全旅游目的地的信心会进一步受到削弱。西班牙是仅次于法国的世界第二大旅游目的地。

paras.en: “All accidents are serious, but when you have two within just nine months ... you have a strong impact on reputation,” said Juan Pedro Aznar, a researcher at Esade business school, adding that restoring confidence would require making technical fixes a political priority.
paras.zh: 埃萨德商学院研究员胡安·佩德罗·阿斯纳尔表示：“所有事故都很严重，但如果在短短九个月内发生两起事故……就会对声誉产生重大影响。”他补充说，恢复信心需要将技术修复作为政治优先事项。

paras.en: Canadian tourist Isobel Hamilton, 50, said the latest crash prompted her and her husband to change plans and travel outside Madrid by bus.
paras.zh: 50 岁的加拿大游客伊莎贝尔·汉密尔顿 (Isobel Hamilton) 表示，最近的事故促使她和丈夫改变计划，乘坐巴士前往马德里以外的地方。

paras.en: “We were uncomfortable about keeping a rail trip in our plans ... Even if everything had been restored and was running normally I probably would still have chosen to take the bus.”
paras.zh: “我们对在计划中保留铁路旅行感到不安……即使一切都已恢复并正常运行，我可能仍然会选择乘坐公共汽车。”

paras.en: Storm Charles passes Portugal without major damage
paras.zh: 风暴查尔斯经过葡萄牙，未造成重大损失

paras.en: Storm Charles has brought destructive weather to the Iberian peninsula this week, particularly in Portugal and the far south of Spain.
paras.zh: 查尔斯风暴本周给伊比利亚半岛带来了破坏性天气，特别是在葡萄牙和西班牙最南部。

paras.en: But despite the intense weather warnings, the storm passed over Portugal without leaving the destruction the country had widely feared in its wake, after the authorities ordered schools closed as a precaution, AFP noted.
paras.zh: 但法新社指出，尽管发出了强烈的天气警告，风暴还是席卷了葡萄牙，并没有给该国带来人们普遍担心的破坏，当局下令关闭学校作为预防措施。

paras.en: One person was wounded and four people were evacuated as a result of the storm, national civil protection chief Mario Silvestre told a press conference, while some flooding and falling trees were recorded.
paras.zh: 国家民防局长马里奥·西尔维斯特在新闻发布会上说，风暴造成一人受伤，四人被疏散，同时还记录到一些洪水和树木倒塌。

paras.en: Ex-helicopter engineer poised to be Germany’s first female president
paras.zh: 前直升机工程师有望成为德国首位女总统

paras.en: Germany has had 12 presidents since the end of the second world war, all of them men. Now, for the first time, the federal republic is on the brink of getting a female head of state. But Ilse Aigner, the lead candidate for the post, is unusual in more ways than one.
paras.zh: 自第二次世界大战结束以来，德国已有 12 位总统，全部为男性。现在，联邦共和国即将首次迎来一位女性国家元首。但该职位的主要候选人伊尔莎·艾格纳 (Ilse Aigner) 在很多方面都与众不同。

paras.en: “No law degree. No marriage. No penis,” is how the left-leaning Taz newspaper put it this week – a wry, if blunt, assessment of what a break with history the 61-year-old Bavarian represents.
paras.zh: “没有法律学位。没有婚姻。没有阴茎”，这是左倾的《塔兹报》本周的说法——对这位 61 岁的巴伐利亚人所代表的与历史的决裂做出了一种讽刺甚至直白的评价。

paras.en: Friedrich Merz, Germany’s Christian Democrat (CDU) chancellor, put Aigner forward as his candidate this week after months of speculation, saying it was “high time” a woman took up the role.
paras.zh: 经过数月的猜测，德国基督教民主党 (CDU) 总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨 (Friedrich Merz) 本周将艾格纳提名为候选人，并表示现在是女性担任这一职位的“最佳时机”。

paras.en: If elected in January, Aigner will succeed Frank-Walter Steinmeier in what is a largely ceremonial role but nonetheless Germany’s highest state position. And as she has the backing not only of Merz’s CDU but his Social Democrat partners and the opposition Greens, little is standing in her way.
paras.zh: 如果一月份当选，艾格纳将接替弗兰克-瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔，担任德国最高的国家职位，虽然主要是仪式性的职位。由于她不仅得到了默茨领导的基民盟的支持，还得到了他的社会民主党伙伴和反对党绿党的支持，所以几乎没有什么能阻挡她。

paras.en: Russia is ‘setting traps’ in Ukraine talks, EU foreign policy chief warns
paras.zh: 欧盟外交政策负责人警告俄罗斯在乌克兰谈判中“设置陷阱”

paras.en: The EU’s foreign policy chief has warned against “walking into the traps that Russia is setting” as she said Moscow was trying to start a debate about European security in order to divert attention from its aggression.
paras.zh: 欧盟外交政策负责人警告不要“走进俄罗斯设置的陷阱”，她表示莫斯科试图引发一场有关欧洲安全的辩论，以转移人们对其侵略行为的注意力。

paras.en: “We have one aggressor and one victim, and the aggressor does not have security concerns,” Kaja Kallas said on arrival at an EU leaders’ summit in Dublin. “Nobody has ever attacked them. They have attacked others. I mean, keep the focus, people.”
paras.zh: 卡贾·卡拉斯在抵达都柏林举行的欧盟领导人峰会时表示：“我们有一名侵略者和一名受害者，侵略者没有安全顾虑。” “从来没有人攻击过他们。他们攻击过其他人。我的意思是，大家要集中注意力。”

paras.en: In talks on the Ukraine war, Russia has revived its hardline demands for a total overhaul of European security – demands that were rejected in 2021 because they were seen as an infringement of the sovereignty of central and eastern European countries. The latest round of talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US were held this week in Abu Dhabi.
paras.zh: 在乌克兰战争谈判中，俄罗斯再次提出全面改革欧洲安全的强硬要求——这些要求在 2021 年被拒绝，因为它们被视为侵犯了中欧和东欧国家的主权。乌克兰、俄罗斯和美国之间的最新一轮会谈本周在阿布扎比举行。

paras.en: Donald Trump’s envoy and son-in-law, Jared Kushner, said on Thursday night that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to expand the next round of peace negotiations to include the Europeans. However, Russia quickly contradicted that assurance.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的特使兼女婿贾里德·库什纳周四晚表示，俄罗斯和乌克兰已同意扩大下一轮和平谈判，将欧洲纳入其中。然而，俄罗斯很快就反驳了这一保证。

paras.en: European leaders have long said they will support Ukraine in any peace talks, but want to see a ceasefire before negotiations. They also stress the continent has an extensive web of security agreements that Russia has violated.
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人长期以来一直表示，他们将在任何和平谈判中支持乌克兰，但希望在谈判前看到停火。他们还强调，非洲大陆拥有广泛的安全协议，而俄罗斯却违反了这些协议。

paras.en: Reported Russian demands on Ukraine, Europe have no chance of succeeding - snap analysis
paras.zh: 据报道，俄罗斯对乌克兰的要求，欧洲没有成功的机会——快速分析

paras.en: Meanwhile, German tabloid Bild has reported on what it says are the key Russian demands put forward in negotiations with Europe, Ukraine, the US.
paras.zh: 与此同时，德国小报《图片报》报道了俄罗斯在与欧洲、乌克兰和美国谈判中提出的关键要求。

paras.en: It includes a number of maximalist demands which would dramatically alter the security landscape for Ukraine and Europe.
paras.zh: 它包括许多极端主义要求，这些要求将极大地改变乌克兰和欧洲的安全格局。

paras.en: We already knew about some of them – for example, Russia’s demand to keep the occupied Ukrainian territories and the entire Donbas region, demilitarise Ukrainian ports and keep Ukraine out of Nato – but there are also some new ones, including a reported request that Nato should not have any bases in the Baltics and that Finland, which only joined in 2023, should be made to leave the alliance.
paras.zh: 我们已经知道其中一些——例如，俄罗斯要求保留被占领的乌克兰领土和整个顿巴斯地区、乌克兰港口非军事化以及将乌克兰排除在北约之外——但也有一些新的要求，包括据报道要求北约不应在波罗的海地区设立任何基地，以及要求2023年才加入的芬兰退出该联盟。

paras.en: The list also includes new proposals on Moldova, which Moscow reportedly wants to turn into a federal republic and then force referendums on the future of two of its regions, Transnistria and Gaugazia.
paras.zh: 该清单还包括关于摩尔多瓦的新提案，据报道莫斯科希望将摩尔多瓦转变为联邦共和国，然后强制对其两个地区德涅斯特河沿岸和高加齐亚的未来进行全民公投。

paras.en: If this list is true – which we do not know that and have not been able to independently verify it – it is probably fair to say that it’s just not going to work and will only anger Europeans at the time when the US wants to get them formally involved in the process.
paras.zh: 如果这份清单属实——我们不知道这一点，也无法独立核实——那么可以公平地说，它不会起作用，只会在美国想让欧洲人正式参与这一进程时激怒欧洲人。

paras.en: Ukraine has been repeatedly clear that it has no intention of giving away the temporarily occupied territories, and even less of signing off the parts that are actually still controlled by Kyiv.
paras.zh: 乌克兰多次明确表示无意放弃暂时占领的领土，更无意签署基辅实际控制的部分。

paras.en: And Finland’s defence minister Antti Häkkänen also made it clear that the demand on Finland’s Nato membership has no chance of succeeding.
paras.zh: 而芬兰国防部长安蒂·哈卡宁也明确表示，芬兰加入北约的要求没有成功的机会。

paras.en: “These matters are not up for negotiation. Russia knows that and it’s absolutely outrageous to even suggest this,” he said, quoted by Finnish public broadcaster yle. “Finland will not be forced out [of Nato],” he added.
paras.zh: 芬兰公共广播公司 yle 援引他的话说：“这些问题不需要谈判。俄罗斯知道这一点，甚至提出这样的建议绝对是无耻的。” “芬兰不会被迫退出[北约]，”他补充道。

paras.en: The chairman of the Finnish parliament’s foreign affairs committee, Johannes Koskinen, told reporters that “if such a paper or demand has been submitted, it will go straight into the bin,” IS reported.
paras.zh: 据《IS》报道，芬兰议会外交事务委员会主席约翰内斯·科斯基宁告诉记者，“如果提交了这样的文件或要求，它将直接被扔进垃圾桶”。

paras.en: Lithuanian foreign minister Kęstutis Budrys also made it clear earlier this week that Lithuania would block any agreement giving Russia the power to stop Nato deployments in the region.
paras.zh: 立陶宛外交部长肯斯图蒂斯·布德里斯本周早些时候也明确表示，立陶宛将阻止任何赋予俄罗斯权力阻止北约在该地区部署的协议。

paras.en: While there’s a lot of foreign policy discussion happening in Dublin, another key issue is the race in artificial intelligence,with EU leaders trying to strike a balance between not falling behind against the US and China while also trying to protect citizens from some of the associated risks.
paras.zh: 虽然都柏林正在进行大量外交政策讨论，但另一个关键问题是人工智能领域的竞赛，欧盟领导人试图在不落后于美国和中国之间取得平衡，同时也试图保护公民免受一些相关风险的影响。

paras.en: Roberta Metsola, president of the European parliament, said she was tired of hearing that the EU had “somehow lost the AI race”.
paras.zh: 欧洲议会主席罗伯塔·梅索拉 (Roberta Metsola) 表示，她厌倦了听到欧盟“不知何故输掉了人工智能竞赛”。

paras.en: “We have world class talent, we have a great... ecosystem from a technology perspective,” the president of the European Parliament told reporters before the summit began.
paras.zh: “我们拥有世界一流的人才，从技术角度来看，我们拥有一个伟大的……生态系统，”欧洲议会主席在峰会开始前告诉记者。

paras.en: It’s worth noting that while Anthropic and OpenAI often dominate headlines, Europe has its own frontier lab, Mistral, which focused on delivering an open-weight model.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，虽然 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 经常占据头条新闻，但欧洲有自己的前沿实验室 Mistral，专注于提供开放权重模型。

paras.en: For her part, foreign policy chief Kallas warned about a “dark side of AI”, citing the example of how its being used in warfare.
paras.zh: 外交政策负责人卡拉斯则以人工智能在战争中的应用为例，对“人工智能的阴暗面”发出警告。

paras.en: Europe needs to show it can 'contribute' before being allowed to join Ukraine talks, Russia says
paras.zh: 俄罗斯表示，欧洲需要证明它可以“做出贡献”，然后才能获准加入乌克兰谈判

paras.en: Meanwhile, the Kremlin said that Europe must show it is ready to contribute to the Ukraine peace process before a decision is made on letting Europeans join the negotiations.
paras.zh: 与此同时，克里姆林宫表示，在决定让欧洲人加入谈判之前，欧洲必须表现出愿意为乌克兰和平进程做出贡献。

paras.en: The comment by Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov suggests Russia has not yet committed to including Europeans in the next round of talks, despite US negotiators saying on Thursday that president Vladimir Putin had agreed to their participation, Reuters said.
paras.zh: 路透社称，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫的评论表明，俄罗斯尚未承诺让欧洲人参与下一轮谈判，尽管美国谈判代表周四表示，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京已同意欧洲人参与。

paras.en: Asked if peace talks would soon resume with the added participation of Europeans, Peskov said:
paras.zh: 当被问及和平谈判是否会在欧洲人更多参与的情况下很快恢复时，佩斯科夫说：

paras.en: “Once we understand their genuine intention and readiness to contribute to the peace process, then it will be possible to make a decision on holding dialogue on a Ukrainian settlement in an expanded format.“
paras.zh: “一旦我们了解他们为和平进程做出贡献的真实意图和意愿，就有可能做出以扩大形式就乌克兰问题解决方案举行对话的决定。”

paras.en: “If the Europeans really do have someone who is at least authorised in some way to talk, and if the Europeans really do have the desire to do so, then, of course, we will be ready to talk to them.”
paras.zh: “如果欧洲人确实有一个至少被授权以某种方式进行对话的人，并且如果欧洲人确实有这样做的愿望，那么我们当然会准备与他们对话。”

paras.en: 'Please, no surprises,' Merz urges Trump ahead of his meeting with Putin in China
paras.zh: 默茨在中国与普京会面前敦促特朗普“请不要感到意外”

paras.en: Speaking in Dublin, German chancellor Friedrich Merz pleaded for US president Donald Trump to create no surprises during expected talks about Ukraine next week with Russian president Vladimir Putin in China.
paras.zh: 德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨在都柏林发表讲话，恳求美国总统唐纳德·特朗普下周与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在中国就乌克兰问题进行会谈时不要制造意外。

paras.en: “Some here in Dublin fear this could turn into a ‘second Anchorage moment’,” said Merz on the sidelines of a meeting of EU leaders, as reported by Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，默茨在欧盟领导人会议间隙表示：“都柏林的一些人担心这可能会变成‘第二个安克雷奇时刻’。”

paras.en: “I therefore want to state our message to the United States very clearly: please, no surprises. Continue to play as part of ’Team Europe’ and ’Team Ukraine’”.
paras.zh: “因此，我想非常明确地向美国传达我们的信息：请不要感到意外。继续作为‘欧洲队’和‘乌克兰队’的一部分进行比赛”。

paras.en: Merz also said that Europe does not need to discuss the European security architecture with Russia, a new Russian demand in any peace process on Ukraine.
paras.zh: 默茨还表示，欧洲不需要与俄罗斯讨论欧洲安全架构，这是俄罗斯在任何乌克兰和平进程中的新要求。

paras.en: “Russia wants to talk about questions of a European security architecture. We do not need to discuss that, it already exists,” Merz said, adding it was a “given” his country would be part of any European delegation, AFP reported.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，默茨说：“俄罗斯想讨论欧洲安全架构的问题。我们不需要讨论这个问题，它已经存在了。”他补充说，俄罗斯“假定”将成为任何欧洲代表团的成员。

paras.en: German drone maker supplying Ukraine reports cyberattack
paras.zh: 向乌克兰供货的德国无人机制造商报告遭受网络攻击

paras.en: Meanwhile, German defence group Quantum Systems faced a cyberattack last month that prompted the German military to briefly ground its fleet of the company’s drones, with suspicion falling on Russia, sources told AFP.
paras.zh: 与此同时，消息人士告诉法新社，德国国防集团量子系统上个月面临网络攻击，促使德国军方暂时停飞了该公司的无人机机队，俄罗斯的嫌疑落在了俄罗斯身上。

paras.en: Attackers are increasingly targeting European defence firms supplying Ukraine for its fight against Russia.
paras.zh: 攻击者越来越多地将目标瞄准为乌克兰对抗俄罗斯提供物资的欧洲国防公司。

paras.en: Quantum, a producer of reconnaissance drones and other unmanned systems based near Munich, said “hostile actors” launched the cyberattack in late October.
paras.zh: 总部位于慕尼黑附近的侦察无人机和其他无人系统生产商 Quantum 表示，“敌对行为者”于 10 月底发起了网络攻击。

paras.en: “The threat was contained thanks to the swift response of our IT and security teams in close and transparent collaboration with the authorities,” it said in a statement.
paras.zh: 该公司在一份声明中表示：“由于我们的 IT 和安全团队与当局密切、透明的合作，做出了迅速反应，威胁得到了遏制。”

paras.en: There was no risk to operations of the firm’s systems, it said. The company declined to give further details.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，该公司系统的运营不存在任何风险。该公司拒绝透露更多细节。

paras.en: Denmark's Frederiksen urges more help for Ukraine to help it get through 'tough, tough' winter
paras.zh: 丹麦首相弗雷德里克森敦促为乌克兰提供更多帮助，帮助其度过“艰难”的冬季

paras.en: Fun aside, the host camera captured an interesting exchange between Ireland and Denmark’s Frederiksen, with the Danish PM stressing to the Irish leader the importance of agreeing on a winter support package for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 除了有趣之外，主持人镜头捕捉到了爱尔兰和丹麦弗雷德里克森之间有趣的交流，丹麦首相向爱尔兰领导人强调了就乌克兰冬季支持计划达成一致的重要性。

paras.en: She said more help was needed to “get them through a tough, tough winter.”
paras.zh: 她表示，需要更多帮助来“帮助他们度过一个艰难的冬天”。

paras.en: “So if everybody could put something on the table, that would be very welcome,” she said.
paras.zh: “因此，如果每个人都可以提出一些建议，那将非常受欢迎，”她说。

paras.en: Some other fun nuggets from the doorstep (10:53) include Croatia’s Andrej Plenković joking that Ireland’s Martin “is always here” rooted in the same spot where he welcomes the leaders.
paras.zh: 其他一些来自门口的有趣的金块（10:53）包括克罗地亚的安德烈·普伦科维奇（Andrej Plenković）开玩笑说爱尔兰的马丁“永远在这里”扎根在他欢迎领导人的同一个地方。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Poland’s Donald Tusk got a cheerful “dzień dobry” – good morning in Polish – from the official leading him through the building.
paras.zh: 与此同时，波兰的唐纳德·图斯克从带领他穿过大楼的官员那里得到了愉快的“dzień dobry”（波兰语早上好）。

paras.en: And if you’re wondering what the leaders are talking about between themselves on the doorstep, then I’m afraid the answer is very boring: it’s mostly the weather.
paras.zh: 如果你想知道领导人在门口谈论什么，那么恐怕答案很无聊：主要是天气。

paras.en: Several other leaders also remarked on how beautiful Dublin looks in the morning sun, with their arrival handler joking: “it’s always like that in Dublin in November… almost.”
paras.zh: 其他几位领导人也评论了都柏林在早晨阳光下的美丽，他们的抵达管理员开玩笑说：“十一月的都柏林总是这样......几乎。”

paras.en: The only two who had any, let’s say, doubts about the weather were, unsurprisingly, two southern leaders: Cyprus’s Nikos Christodoulides and Greece’s Kyriakos Mitsotakis.
paras.zh: 不出所料，唯一对天气有任何疑问的两个人是两位南方领导人：塞浦路斯的尼科斯·赫里斯托杜利德斯和希腊的基里亚科斯·米佐塔基斯。

paras.en: In contrast, Germany’s Friedrich Merz, Finland’s Petteri Orpo, Sweden’s Ulf Kristersson, Denmark’s Mette Frederiksen and Austria’s Christian Stocker even opted for a nice stroll to the venue together.
paras.zh: 相比之下，德国选手弗里德里希·梅尔茨、芬兰选手佩特里·奥尔波、瑞典选手乌尔夫·克里斯特森、丹麦选手梅特·弗雷德里克森和奥地利选手克里斯蒂安·斯托克甚至选择一起漫步到会场。

paras.en: This caused a bit of a diplomatic protocol challenge in terms of who should go through the door to see Ireland’s Micheál Martin first, with everyone stuck in an awkward cycle of pointing and “oh, please” until Merz eventually suggested Frederiksen go first, suggesting “ladies first.”
paras.zh: 这引起了一些外交礼节上的挑战，即谁应该先进门去见爱尔兰的迈克尔·马丁，每个人都陷入了指指点点和“哦，请”的尴尬循环，直到默茨最终建议弗雷德里克森先走，建议“女士优先”。

paras.en: “Lady first,” she said, with a bit of a side eye, and stepped ahead.
paras.zh: “女士优先，”她侧目说道，然后向前迈了一步。

paras.en: Apparently, last night’s dinner at the National Gallery, prepared by Mark Moriarty, was also “excellent,” I am sure you would want to know – so much so that France’s Emmanuel Macron went to see the chef to praise him.
paras.zh: 显然，马克·莫里亚蒂昨晚在国家美术馆准备的晚餐也“非常棒”，我相信你一定会想知道——以至于法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙专门去见这位厨师并称赞他。

paras.en: The food included smoked wild salmon from Cork, Wicklow-reared beef, cabbage grown in Dublin, and rapeseed oil produced in Donegal, RTÉ reported.
paras.zh: 据 RTÉ 报道，这些食物包括来自科克的熏制野生鲑鱼、威克洛饲养的牛肉、都柏林种植的卷心菜以及多尼戈尔生产的菜籽油。

paras.en: Either way, the doors to the meeting room are now closed, and the discussions under way.
paras.zh: 不管怎样，会议室的门现在已经关闭，讨论正在进行中。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Latvian PM Andris Kulbergs has a strong entry for the quote of the day competition, as he said “we, as Europe, have to grow some bigger balls.”
paras.zh: 与此同时，拉脱维亚总理安德里斯·库尔伯格斯（Andris Kulbergs）在当天的比赛中也有强有力的发言，他说：“我们，作为欧洲，必须种植一些更大的球。”

paras.en: “I think we as Europe have to grow some bigger balls, because we are bigger in size, … in military might, in all the economic aspects.
paras.zh: “我认为我们欧洲必须发展一些更大的球，因为我们的规模更大……军事力量，在所有经济方面。

paras.en: Look where is Russia: Russia is not capable of even taking such an, in size, in population, smaller power as Ukraine, which is showing a great, great spirit and fighting back [for the] fifth year.
paras.zh: 看看俄罗斯在哪里：俄罗斯甚至没有能力拿下乌克兰这样一个在面积、人口上都较小的国家，而乌克兰已经连续第五年表现出了伟大的精神和反击。

paras.en: And Russia is [now] raising points that we have no accept? Sorry, that’s the aggressor, losing on the frontline. We should be raising our expectations, what has to be done in terms of Ukraine’s security.”
paras.zh: 俄罗斯现在提出了我们不接受的观点？抱歉，那是侵略者，在前线失败了。我们应该提高我们的期望，以及在乌克兰安全方面必须采取的行动。”

articles.title: Former Hamas bodyguard convicted of Birmingham knife crime also wanted in Germany
articles.author: Rajeev Syal Home affairs editor

paras.en: A former Hamas bodyguard convicted of knife crime in the UK is wanted in Germany for allegedly plotting to murder Jewish people.
paras.zh: 一名在英国被判犯有持刀罪的前哈马斯保镖因涉嫌密谋谋杀犹太人而在德国被通缉。

paras.en: Details of the alleged plot can now be reported after Mohammed Alfatih, also known as Mohammed Naim, was found guilty on Friday of a knife attack on a bailiff outside his home in Birmingham.
paras.zh: 穆罕默德·阿尔法提赫（又名穆罕默德·纳伊姆）周五因在伯明翰家外持刀袭击一名法警而被判有罪后，现在可以报道涉嫌阴谋的细节。

paras.en: The 40-year-old was found guilty by a majority verdict of unlawful wounding, possession of two knives and criminal damage. He was cleared of the more serious charge of wounding with intent.
paras.zh: 多数人判决这名 40 岁的男子犯有非法伤人、持有两把刀和刑事毁坏罪，罪名成立。他被免除了更严重的故意伤害罪指控。

paras.en: He was under surveillance by a counter-terrorism unit when he attacked the bailiff last year.
paras.zh: 去年他袭击法警时，他正受到反恐部门的监视。

paras.en: Alfatih, the son of a senior Hamas official, could not be named during his trial because of reporting restrictions.
paras.zh: 阿尔法提赫是一名哈马斯高级官员的儿子，由于报道限制，他在审判期间无法透露姓名。

paras.en: He had been photographed working for a former leader of Hamas before being granted asylum in the UK in 2015 and British citizenship in 2020.
paras.zh: 他曾被拍到为哈马斯前领导人工作，随后于 2015 年在英国获得庇护，并于 2020 年获得英国公民身份。

paras.en: While detained for the attack on the bailiff in Birmingham, he was rearrested after authorities in Germany said he had been part of an alleged plot to attack Israeli targets in central Europe.
paras.zh: 他因袭击伯明翰法警而被拘留，但在德国当局称他参与了袭击以色列中欧目标的涉嫌阴谋后，他再次被捕。

paras.en: Alfatih, who was born in Germany, is expected to be extradited to the country after he has served his sentence in the UK, with his connection to Hamas stated in the German extradition request.
paras.zh: 出生于德国的阿尔法提赫预计将在英国服刑后被引渡到德国，德国引渡请求中指出了他与哈马斯的联系。

paras.en: German prosecutors charged seven suspected Hamas members in September over an alleged plot to target Jews or Israelis in Germany or Austria around the second anniversary of the 7 October attack on Israel.
paras.zh: 德国检察官于 9 月对 7 名疑似哈马斯成员提出指控，罪名是在 10 月 7 日以色列遇袭两周年纪念日期间，涉嫌密谋在德国或奥地利针对犹太人或以色列人。

paras.en: They said “Mohammed A” played a prominent role in transporting and storing weapons but was being prosecuted separately after UK authorities arrested him in London and noted he had not yet been returned to Germany.
paras.zh: 他们表示，“穆罕默德 A”在运输和储存武器方面发挥了重要作用，但在英国当局在伦敦逮捕他并指出他尚未返回德国后，他被单独起诉。

paras.en: German authorities said he was connected to Hamas’s leadership and was said to have produced a video in advance to take responsibility for the attack on its behalf.
paras.zh: 德国当局表示，他与哈马斯领导层有联系，并据称提前制作了一段视频，代表哈马斯对此次袭击负责。

paras.en: The attack was disrupted by Germany’s domestic intelligence service after a tipoff from the Mossad, Israel’s secret service.
paras.zh: 在以色列特工机构摩萨德的举报后，德国国内情报部门阻止了这次袭击。

paras.en: During a two-week trial at Birmingham crown court, the jury was shown video footage of Alfatih lashing out with a knife at the broken window of a van on 14 October 2025.
paras.zh: 在伯明翰刑事法庭为期两周的审判中，陪审团观看了阿尔法提赫于 2025 年 10 月 14 日用刀猛击一辆货车破碎窗户的视频片段。

paras.en: The bailiff, Kevin Bucknall, was left with cuts to his head and required hospital treatment. The defendant pleaded not guilty on the grounds of self-defence.
paras.zh: 法警凯文·巴克纳尔 (Kevin Bucknall) 头部受伤，需要住院治疗。被告人以正当防卫为由，表示不认罪。

paras.en: The jurors, who convicted Alfatih after being shown footage of him brandishing two large kitchen knives outside his home in Kings Heath, Birmingham, were not told of his links to Hamas.
paras.zh: 陪审员们在观看阿尔法提赫在伯明翰国王希思的家外挥舞两把大菜刀的镜头后对他定罪，但陪审员们并没有被告知他与哈马斯的联系。

paras.en: They were also not told Alfatih was under surveillance by a counter-terrorism unit after being released on bail on suspicion of a terror offence days before the bailiff was attacked.
paras.zh: 他们也不知道阿尔法提赫在法警遭到袭击的几天前因涉嫌恐怖犯罪而被保释，目前正受到反恐部门的监视。

paras.en: A government source said: “This is a staggering example of the loss of border control under the last Conservative government, who granted his asylum claim and gave him citizenship.
paras.zh: 一位政府消息人士称：“这是上届保守党政府失去边境控制的一个令人震惊的例子，上届保守党政府批准了他的庇护申请并给予他公民身份。

paras.en: “This Labour government has just introduced reforms that ensure those who gain citizenship must first show they are a good citizen and have contributed to this country.”
paras.zh: “本届工党政府刚刚推出了改革，确保那些获得公民身份的人必须首先证明他们是一个好公民，并对这个国家做出了贡献。”

articles.title: Microsoft scrambles to fix global outage affecting Teams and Outlook
articles.author: Mark Sweney, Josh Taylor, Aisha Down, Emma Elsworthy and Lauren Aratani

paras.en: Microsoft has said it is “deeply sorry” for a widespread outage that caused disruption to millions of users, organisations and businesses across the globe – and that it has “addressed the underlying issue”.
paras.zh: 微软表示，对于这次大范围的服务中断给全球数以百万计的用户、组织和企业造成了干扰，它“深表歉意”，并表示它已经“解决了根本问题”。

paras.en: The company said the outage was a “technical issue” not related to cyber-attacks or AI agents, and that it continued to gradually restore services.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，此次中断是一个“技术问题”，与网络攻击或人工智能代理无关，并将继续逐步恢复服务。

paras.en: The outage of Microsoft’s services, which began Thursday evening, lasted roughly 18 hours before services started to recover just before midday GMT on Friday. Microsoft said it was bringing back services gradually to ensure a stable restoration.
paras.zh: 微软服务的中断从周四晚上开始，持续了大约 18 个小时，直到格林威治标准时间周五中午之前服务开始恢复。微软表示，正在逐步恢复服务，以确保稳定恢复。

paras.en: Earlier on Friday, it said email queues were “significantly reduced and approaching normal levels” as it brought back services. More than 430 million people use Microsoft 365 apps, and more than 90% of Fortune 500 companies use Copilot, Microsoft’s AI chatbot, according to the company.
paras.zh: 周五早些时候，该公司表示，随着服务恢复，电子邮件队列“显着减少并接近正常水平”。据该公司称，超过 4.3 亿人使用 Microsoft 365 应用程序，超过 90% 的财富 500 强公司使用微软的 AI 聊天机器人 Copilot。

paras.en: On Friday, government agencies worldwide, from municipalities in France to the US House of Representatives, reported problems with Microsoft services. The issues were patchy, with some but not all users reporting problems with services including Microsoft Teams and Outlook email.
paras.zh: 周五，从法国市政当局到美国众议院，世界各地的政府机构都报告了微软服务的问题。这些问题参差不齐，部分用户（但并非全部）报告了 Microsoft Teams 和 Outlook 电子邮件等服务的问题。

paras.en: The outage website Down Detector showed an increase in Microsoft 365 problems at about 6pm GMT on Thursday, with nearly 130,000 reports of problems in 74 countries affecting access to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams as well as enterprise services such as SharePoint and OneDrive. Copilot was also affected.
paras.zh: 周四下午 6 点左右，停电网站 Down Detector 显示 Microsoft 365 问题有所增加，74 个国家/地区收到了近 13 万份问题报告，影响了对 Word、Excel、PowerPoint、Outlook 和 Teams 以及 SharePoint 和 OneDrive 等企业服务的访问。副驾驶也受到影响。

paras.en: Microsoft has suggested the outage may have been caused by problems with the settings applied to servers responsible for keeping Microsoft 365 up and running.
paras.zh: 微软表示，此次中断可能是由于负责保持 Microsoft 365 正常运行的服务器所应用的设置问题造成的。

paras.en: Microsoft’s executive vice-president of Copilot, Charles Lamanna, said: “We regret that today’s outages caused disruptions for our customers, and we are working to address the issue.”
paras.zh: 微软副总裁查尔斯·拉曼纳 (Charles Lamanna) 表示：“我们很遗憾今天的服务中断给我们的客户造成了干扰，我们正在努力解决这个问题。”

paras.en: The Microsoft outage also hit connectors used by OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s AI services.
paras.zh: 微软的中断还影响了 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的人工智能服务使用的连接器。

paras.en: OpenAI said it was investigating a problem with Microsoft connectors in which new connections might be broken and tools were not working as expected. Anthropic said it had identified an issue with an upstream provider affecting its Microsoft 365 connector.
paras.zh: OpenAI said it was investigating a problem with Microsoft connectors in which new connections might be broken and tools were not working as expected. Anthropic 表示，它已发现上游提供商存在影响其 Microsoft 365 连接器的问题。

paras.en: The outage has affected businesses and organisations across the world that use Microsoft products.
paras.zh: 这次中断影响了世界各地使用微软产品的企业和组织。

paras.en: In the UK, healthcare systems were disrupted and several British police forces urged people not to try to report crimes online and to phone them in instead.
paras.zh: 在英国，医疗保健系统受到干扰，几名英国警察敦促人们不要尝试在网上举报犯罪行为，而是打电话给他们。

paras.en: Some schools in the UK notified parents that reporting attendance or absence issues had to be done via phone. National Rail, which provides information across the UK network, warned people might not be able to access tickets that had been emailed to them.
paras.zh: 英国的一些学校通知家长必须通过电话报告出勤或缺勤问题。提供整个英国网络信息的国家铁路警告人们可能无法获取通过电子邮件发送给他们的车票。

paras.en: US government offices across the country have been affected by the outage, including congressional offices that heavily rely on Outlook email. The US House’s chief administrative officer that handles IT for the chamber sent out a “campus-wide alert” to staffers on Thursday about the outage, Politico reported.
paras.zh: 全国各地的美国政府办公室都受到了此次中断的影响，其中包括严重依赖 Outlook 电子邮件的国会办公室。据 Politico 报道，负责众议院 IT 事务的美国众议院首席行政官周四向工作人员发出了关于此次停电的“全院警报”。

paras.en: Multiple cities, including the City of Tampa, Florida, posted notices on their municipal websites to say that they were affected by the outage. Law enforcement offices across the US were also affected, with one sheriff’s county in Colorado saying it was unable to process bond payments because Outlook email was down, and requesting that anyone who needed to post bond do so in person.
paras.zh: 包括佛罗里达州坦帕市在内的多个城市在其市政网站上发布通知，表示受到停电的影响。美国各地的执法机构也受到影响，科罗拉多州的一名治安官表示，由于 Outlook 电子邮件无法正常运行，该县无法处理保释金支付，并要求任何需要缴纳保释金的人亲自办理。

paras.en: When stock market trading opened on Wall Street, shares in Microsoft dipped slightly, down 1.1% at $516.86.
paras.zh: 当华尔街股市开盘时，微软股价小幅下跌，下跌 1.1%，至 516.86 美元。

paras.en: The Indian airlines IndiGo and Akasa Air said their email support services were affected, and Taiwanese security firms, life insurers and investment trust companies said fund management services had been disrupted.
paras.zh: 印度航空公司 IndiGo 和 Akasa Air 表示，他们的电子邮件支持服务受到影响，台湾证券公司、人寿保险公司和投资信托公司表示，基金管理服务已中断。

paras.en: In financial markets some portfolio managers have been unable to check emails, making it hard to access on some trading platforms.
paras.zh: 在金融市场中，一些投资组合经理无法检查电子邮件，因此很难在某些交易平台上进行访问。

paras.en: In Japan, the shipping company Sagawa Express said it was unable to accept online reservations for some of its services at airports and train stations while Taisho, a leading pharmaceutical company, said it was having to handle orders by phone.
paras.zh: 在日本，航运公司佐川急便表示，无法接受机场和火车站部分服务的在线预订，而领先的制药公司大正则表示，必须通过电话处理订单。

paras.en: Microsoft last month reported an outage of its Azure cloud platform that affected a suite of productivity software and a range of industries worldwide.
paras.zh: 微软上个月报告其 Azure 云平台出现故障，影响了一套生产力软件和全球范围内的一系列行业。

paras.en: Mark Gregory, an associate professor in the School of Engineering at RMIT University in Melbourne, said the outage appeared to be affecting the network layer in Microsoft’s systems, and was potentially similar to the configuration issue that brought down Optus’s network in 2023.
paras.zh: 墨尔本 RMIT 大学工程学院副教授 Mark Gregory 表示，这次中断似乎影响了微软系统的网络层，可能类似于 2023 年导致 Optus 网络瘫痪的配置问题。

paras.en: He said that when some of the servers had configuration issues, it meant customers were forced to share a smaller pool of servers to access the cloud services.
paras.zh: 他表示，当某些服务器出现配置问题时，这意味着客户被迫共享较小的服务器池来访问云服务。

paras.en: “If you lose part of that pool, then all of the users are trying to access the remaining servers, and that overloads them. And then they go down. And so you end up with a cascading problem. Then it takes time to find the underlying problem, in this case, a misconfiguration in the network layer.”
paras.zh: “如果你丢失了该池的一部分，那么所有用户都会尝试访问剩余的服务器，这会使它们超载。然后它们就会宕机。最终会出现级联问题。然后需要时间才能找到根本问题，在这种情况下，是网络层的配置错误。”

paras.en: Gregory said businesses reliant on cloud services such as Microsoft 365 should have backup options.
paras.zh: Gregory 表示，依赖 Microsoft 365 等云服务的企业应该有备份选项。

paras.en: Associated Press and Reuters contributed to this report
paras.zh: 美联社和路透社对此报道作出了贡献

articles.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?

paras.en: A major Microsoft outage has impacted schools, healthcare systems, businesses, courts and governments around the world.
paras.zh: 微软的一次重大故障影响了世界各地的学校、医疗保健系统、企业、法院和政府。

paras.en: Services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot, are being restored almost 24 hours since issues first surfaced.
paras.zh: 自问题首次出现以来，包括 Teams、Outlook 和 AI 软件 Copilot 在内的服务已在近 24 小时内得到恢复。

paras.en: Microsoft said the outage was not a cyber-security incident and was caused by a technical issue. It has apologised for the disruption.
paras.zh: 微软表示，此次中断不是网络安全事件，而是由技术问题引起的。它已为造成的干扰道歉。

paras.en: Here's what we know about the services affected and what went wrong.
paras.zh: 以下是我们对受影响的服务和问题所在的了解。

paras.en: Some Microsoft 365 services have been affected by "connectivity problems" with problems reported in at least 74 countries.
paras.zh: 一些 Microsoft 365 服务受到“连接问题”的影响，至少 74 个国家/地区报告了该问题。

paras.en: From late on Thursday, customers reported varying levels of access - many were unable to send or receive emails, view certain files or details on their calendar apps.
paras.zh: 从周四晚些时候开始，客户报告了不同程度的访问权限——许多人无法发送或接收电子邮件、查看日历应用程序上的某些文件或详细信息。

paras.en: But some users were able to use Teams, messaging and online meeting functions without issues.
paras.zh: 但一些用户能够毫无问题地使用 Teams、消息传递和在线会议功能。

paras.en: As of Friday afternoon, Microsoft said it had seen "encouraging recovery progress" in Europe and improvement in North America.
paras.zh: 截至周五下午，微软表示，它已经看到欧洲的“令人鼓舞的复苏进展”和北美的改善。

paras.en: The company added that it was focused on "addressing the remaining areas of disruption" but warned "some users may still experience intermittent issues".
paras.zh: 该公司补充说，它的重点是“解决剩余的中断领域”，但警告“一些用户可能仍会遇到间歇性问题”。

paras.en: In a later statement, the company said it was continuing to see improvements "with email queues significantly reduced and approaching normal levels".
paras.zh: 在后来的一份声明中，该公司表示，“电子邮件队列显着减少并接近正常水平”，正在继续看到改进。

paras.en: The company attributed the ongoing outage to an issue during an earlier network capacity upgrade.
paras.zh: 该公司将持续中断归因于早期网络容量升级期间的问题。

paras.en: "We have addressed the underlying issue and continue to restore service to remaining customers and regions," it said on Friday.
paras.zh: 该公司周五表示：“我们已经解决了根本问题，并将继续恢复对剩余客户和地区的服务。”

paras.en: Will emails affected by the outage ever arrive?
paras.zh: 受中断影响的电子邮件会到达吗？

paras.en: Although services are beginning to resume, Microsoft has warned of continued "intermittent access issues", meaning some users will still struggle to load their inboxes and could experience "delayed email delivery".
paras.zh: 尽管服务已开始恢复，但微软警告称，仍会出现“间歇性访问问题”，这意味着一些用户仍将难以加载收件箱，并可能会遇到“电子邮件发送延迟”的情况。

paras.en: In other words, it is not quite safe to assume every email you send is going to arrive in its intended recipient's inbox right away.
paras.zh: 换句话说，假设您发送的每封电子邮件都会立即到达其预期收件人的收件箱是不太安全的。

paras.en: Earlier, Microsoft said it would be extending the "timeout window" to 48 hours "to help protect delayed messages as delivery catches up".
paras.zh: 早些时候，微软表示将把“超时窗口”延长至 48 小时，“以帮助保护延迟消息，因为交付赶上了”。

paras.en: The email timeout window refers to the amount of time Outlook will wait to receive an email.
paras.zh: 电子邮件超时窗口是指 Outlook 等待接收电子邮件的时间。

paras.en: When they do show up, the timestamp will be when they were delivered rather than when they were sent.
paras.zh: 当它们确实出现时，时间戳将是它们交付的时间，而不是发送的时间。

paras.en: Although email service Outlook appears to be resuming, the outage has so far lasted for more than 20 hours - in outage terms that is considered a long time.
paras.zh: 尽管电子邮件服务 Outlook 似乎正在恢复，但到目前为止，中断已经持续了 20 多个小时 - 从中​​断的角度来看，这已经被认为是很长一段时间了。

paras.en: Prof James Ferryman from the University of Reading's department of computer science said the details the company has disclosed provide some clues.
paras.zh: 雷丁大学计算机科学系的詹姆斯·费里曼教授表示，该公司披露的细节提供了一些线索。

paras.en: "What Microsoft has told us is that the part of its servers that sets up secure connections is getting swamped, and once that happens the server just stops answering," he said.
paras.zh: “微软告诉我们的是，其服务器中用于建立安全连接的部分正在被淹没，一旦发生这种情况，服务器就会停止响应，”他说。

paras.en: "The trouble is that this kind of failure snowballs.
paras.zh: “问题是这种失败会像滚雪球一样越滚越大。

paras.en: "One server falls over, its work gets passed to the next one, and meanwhile huge numbers of phones and laptops keep trying to get back in.
paras.zh: “一台服务器崩溃了，它的工作被转移到下一台服务器，同时大量的手机和笔记本电脑不断试图恢复。

paras.en: "You can't just turn it all back on at once. You have to bring it back bit by bit."
paras.zh: “你不能一下子把它全部重新打开。你必须一点一点地把它恢复过来。”

paras.en: The challenge is therefore not just fixing the fault, but managing the huge surge of devices trying to reconnect once services start coming back online.
paras.zh: 因此，挑战不仅在于修复故障，还在于在服务开始恢复在线后管理大量试图重新连接的设备。

paras.en: Gergely Orosz, a former leading software engineer at several major tech companies including Skype and Uber, said this could be the "most disruptive" business email outage "of all time".
paras.zh: Skype 和 Uber 等几家大型科技公司的前首席软件工程师 Gergely Orosz 表示，这可能是“有史以来”“最具破坏性”的商业电子邮件中断。

paras.en: He said it was still difficult to know just how many people have been affected by the disruption, but added he "cannot recall" an outage over business email ever taking this long to return to normal.
paras.zh: 他表示，目前还很难知道到底有多少人受到了此次中断的影响，但他补充说，他“不记得”曾经有过商业电子邮件中断花了这么长时间才恢复正常的情况。

paras.en: Australian cyber-security expert Troy Hunt told the BBC the outage could have far-reaching consequences.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚网络安全专家特洛伊·亨特 (Troy Hunt) 告诉 BBC，此次中断可能会产生深远的后果。

paras.en: "Microsoft is a massive part of the internet backbone and reminds us how critical email still is.
paras.zh: “微软是互联网主干网的重要组成部分，它提醒我们电子邮件仍然是多么重要。

paras.en: "Not only does this outage affect many people's ability to work but also things like the ability to communicate about appointments, purchase things that need verification, create or access accounts and services," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这次中断不仅影响了许多人的工作能力，还影响了沟通预约、购买需要验证的东西、创建或访问帐户和服务的能力。”

paras.en: In a statement, Microsoft said it was "deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our customers and partners.
paras.zh: 微软在一份声明中表示，“对于这一事件给我们的客户和合作伙伴造成的干扰深表歉意。

paras.en: "We know the trust they place in our services and take that responsibility extremely seriously. We are seeing broad recovery and stability across our services."
paras.zh: “我们知道他们对我们的服务的信任，并非常认真地对待这一责任。我们看到我们的服务广泛复苏和稳定。”

paras.en: More than 430 million people use Microsoft 365 apps according to Microsoft's website. The full scale of the outage has not been confirmed.
paras.zh: 根据微软网站的数据，超过 4.3 亿人使用 Microsoft 365 应用程序。停电的全面规模尚未得到证实。

paras.en: Microsoft 365 is used by companies worldwide and is expected to have a knock-on effect to other services.
paras.zh: Microsoft 365 被世界各地的公司使用，预计会对其他服务产生连锁反应。

paras.en: Tech giants OpenAI and Anthropic both earlier reported problems as a result of the outage.
paras.zh: 科技巨头 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 早些时候都报告了由于中断造成的问题。

paras.en: ChatGPT-maker OpenAI said it was investigating an issue affecting its connections to Microsoft's services, which had caused some tools to not work as expected.
paras.zh: ChatGPT 制造商 OpenAI 表示，它正在调查影响其与微软服务连接的问题，该问题导致一些工具无法按预期工作。

paras.en: From city governments in the US to Australian spy agencies, disruption across the globe has been widespread.
paras.zh: 从美国的市政府到澳大利亚的间谍机构，全球范围内的干扰已经广泛存在。

paras.en: Courts from Los Angeles to Texas earlier warned that communications might be delayed.
paras.zh: 从洛杉矶到德克萨斯州的法院早些时候警告称，通讯可能会延迟。

paras.en: In Canada, the public broadcaster CBC reported that a healthcare network running several hospitals in Toronto was experiencing email issues, but that patient care was not affected.
paras.zh: 在加拿大，公共广播公司 CBC 报道称，多伦多多家医院的医疗保健网络遇到了电子邮件问题，但患者护理并未受到影响。

paras.en: The government of Japan also said its shared IT platform had been disrupted.
paras.zh: 日本政府还表示，其共享 IT 平台已遭到破坏。

paras.en: Across the UK, GP surgeries, pharmacies, police and schools have been affected by the outage.
paras.zh: 在英国各地，全科医生诊所、药房、警察和学校都受到了停电的影响。

paras.en: Some GP surgeries had urged patients not to submit messages via their website while police forces were also earlier asking the public to call if they want to make a report.
paras.zh: 一些全科医生诊所敦促患者不要通过其网站提交信息，而警方早些时候也要求公众如果想举报，请致电。

articles.title: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge

paras.en: Senator Chuck Schumer is facing a challenge to his position as US Senate majority leader from his fellow Democratic Senator Chris Van Hollen, as the party prepares to take control of Congress after sweeping the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 参议员查克·舒默(Chuck Schumer)正面临民主党参议员克里斯·范·霍伦(Chris Van Hollen)对其美国参议院多数党领袖地位的挑战，该党准备在中期选举中大获全胜后控制国会。

paras.en: Van Hollen, 67, said in a post on X on Thursday that Americans voted for change earlier this month and "to deliver, we need new leadership".
paras.zh: 67 岁的范霍伦周四在 X 上发帖称，美国人本月早些时候投票支持变革，“为了实现这一目标，我们需要新的领导”。

paras.en: Schumer, 75, has led Democrats in the chamber since 2017, serving as both majority and minority leader. He was first elected to the Senate in 1999.
paras.zh: 75 岁的舒默自 2017 年以来一直在众议院领导民主党，担任多数党和少数党领袖。他于1999年首次当选参议员。

paras.en: Following the midterms earlier this month, his position has come under pressure by some left-wing Democrats who see him as too moderate and part of the party establishment.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候的中期选举之后，他的立场受到一些左翼民主党人的压力，他们认为他过于温和，属于党内建制派。

paras.en: Responding to the challenge, Schumer, who represents New York, said he welcomed "any discussion about the future of our caucus and the important work ahead".
paras.zh: 代表纽约州的舒默在回应这一挑战时表示，他欢迎“任何有关我们核心小组的未来和未来重要工作的讨论”。

paras.en: He added that he was "proud of what we've accomplished together" in the midterms, and he had "the votes to continue as Democratic leader".
paras.zh: 他补充说，他对中期选举中“我们共同取得的成就感到自豪”，并且他“有票数继续担任民主党领袖”。

paras.en: The vote on Senate leader will be held behind closed doors in early December and the winner will assume the role on 4 January, when Democrats take control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives after their midterms successes.
paras.zh: 参议院领导人的投票将于 12 月初进行闭门投票，获胜者将于 1 月 4 日就任，届时民主党在中期选举成功后将同时控制参议院和众议院。

paras.en: The move by Van Hollen, who represents Maryland, marks the most significant step by a high-profile Democrat to challenge the party's existing leadership following last week's midterms victory.
paras.zh: 代表马里兰州的范霍伦此举标志着一位备受瞩目的民主党人继上周中期选举胜利后挑战该党现有领导层的最重要一步。

paras.en: Announcing his plans to run in a post on X, he wrote that Americans had called on the party to "unrig an economy rigged against working people".
paras.zh: 他在 X 上的一篇帖子中宣布了自己的竞选计划，他写道，美国人呼吁该党“解除对劳动人民的操纵经济”。

paras.en: "We should not be preserving our institutions if they are not delivering for the American people," he said at a summit in Colorado hosted by majority Democrats. "And we should be making delivering for the American people the single mission of our government, even when that means shaking things up."
paras.zh: 他在科罗拉多州举行的由多数民主党人主办的峰会上表示：“如果我们的机构不能为美国人民带来好处，我们就不应该保留它们。” “我们应该把为美国人民服务作为我们政府的唯一使命，即使这意味着要改变现状。”

paras.en: He added: "This country does not belong to the people who can afford to buy influence. It belongs to all of us. And it's time we govern like that."
paras.zh: 他补充道：“这个国家不属于那些有能力购买影响力的人。它属于我们所有人。现在是我们这样治理的时候了。”

paras.en: In recent years, Van Hollen has taken positions popular with those on the left of his party.
paras.zh: 近年来，范霍伦采取了深受党内左翼人士欢迎的立场。

paras.en: In 2024, he supported restricting weapons shipments to Israel and criticised the Biden administration over its role in the war in Gaza.
paras.zh: 2024年，他支持限制向以色列运送武器，并批评拜登政府在加沙战争中扮演的角色。

paras.en: In an interview with MS NOW, Van Hollen - who has served in the Senate for nearly a decade - acknowledged that he was an "underdog" but added that he believed the race was "very much in flux".
paras.zh: 在参议院任职近十年的范霍伦在接受 MS NOW 采访时承认自己是“失败者”，但补充说他相信竞选“非常不稳定”。

paras.en: Independent Senator Bernie Sanders and Democratic Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed have both publicly come out in support of Van Hollen - while others have also called for new leadership.
paras.zh: 独立参议员伯尼·桑德斯和民主党当选参议员阿卜杜勒·赛义德都公开表示支持范·霍伦，而其他人也呼吁新的领导层。

paras.en: In a post on X, Sanders said he believed Van Hollen "will stand up to powerful special interests, take on the billionaire class and fight for working families".
paras.zh: 桑德斯在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，他相信范霍伦“将勇敢地面对强大的特殊利益集团，挑战亿万富翁阶层，并为工薪家庭而战”。

paras.en: El-Sayed said the challenger would bring "bold leadership" and lead with both "courage and experience".
paras.zh: 赛义德表示，挑战者将带来“大胆的领导力”，并以“勇气和经验”来领导。

paras.en: Others Democrats have publicly backed Schumer.
paras.zh: 其他民主党人公开支持舒默。

paras.en: Senator Jacky Rosen of Nevada said: "He has the experience and the fight to continue leading our diverse caucus at this crucial moment".
paras.zh: 内华达州参议员杰基·罗森表示：“他拥有在这个关键时刻继续领导我们多元化核心小组的经验和斗志”。

paras.en: Senator Kirsten Gillibrand said: "You will see, despite all the grumblings, enormous gratitude for the hard work he has done to get us to this position."
paras.zh: 参议员克尔斯滕·吉利布兰德 (Kirsten Gillibrand) 表示：“尽管有很多抱怨，但你会看到，人们对他为让我们达到这一地位所做的辛勤工作表示极大的感激。”

articles.title: Nvidia scandal fallout widens as Trump's treasury secretary blames cabinet colleague

paras.en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has blamed Howard Lutnick's Commerce Department for failing to properly oversee the export of high-spec AI chips, as the fallout from the Nvidia scandal widens to President Donald Trump's cabinet.
paras.zh: 随着英伟达丑闻的影响扩大到唐纳德·特朗普总统的内阁，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特指责霍华德·卢特尼克的商务部未能适当监督高规格人工智能芯片的出口。

paras.en: Pressure is building on Lutnick from across the political spectrum to explain his department's actions.
paras.zh: 来自各个政治派别的压力越来越大，要求卢特尼克解释其部门的行动。

paras.en: Jensen Huang was ousted as Nvidia CEO after revelations he had an affair with a businesswoman who was also allegedly a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋因与一名据称也是中国间谍的女商人有染而被免去英伟达首席执行官的职务。

paras.en: Megaspeed, the firm she worked for, had been probed by US government agencies over suspicions it was smuggling Nvidia chips into China, reports said, but it is not on a list of firms US companies are prevented from working with.
paras.zh: 据报道，她工作的公司 Megaspeed 因涉嫌向中国走私英伟达芯片而受到美国政府机构的调查，但该公司并不在美国公司被禁止与其合作的公司名单上。

paras.en: Bessent told CNBC several agencies "were in favour of putting Megaspeed on the entity list for months".
paras.zh: Bessent 告诉 CNBC，数月来多家机构“都赞成将 Megaspeed 列入实体名单”。

paras.en: "But Commerce has the pen... and you will have to ask them about their internal process," he added.
paras.zh: “但商务部有笔……你必须询问他们的内部流程，”他补充道。

paras.en: Bessent's comments come after Lutnick was called to testify before the Senate Banking Committee next month over the Commerce Department's role in allowing Nvidia to export its advanced chips.
paras.zh: 贝森特发表此番言论之前，卢特尼克下个月被传唤到参议院银行委员会就商务部允许英伟达出口其先进芯片的角色作证。

paras.en: Other congressional committees have asked both Lutnick and his department to retain all records relating to Nvidia and Huang.
paras.zh: 其他国会委员会已要求卢特尼克及其部门保留与 Nvidia 和黄仁勋有关的所有记录。

paras.en: Bessent said he was "frustrated" by delays in putting the company on the export control list and reports of leakage of AI chips into China.
paras.zh: 贝森特表示，他对该公司迟迟未能列入出口管制名单以及有关人工智能芯片泄漏到中国的报道感到“沮丧”。

paras.en: "President Trump made it very clear that China should not receive any Nvidia chips above H100s, so any leakage is very frustrating because it hurts our great companies in the AI race, because it gives the Chinese an advantage," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“特朗普总统明确表示，中国不应接收任何高于 H100 的 Nvidia 芯片，因此任何泄露都非常令人沮丧，因为这会伤害我们在人工智能竞赛中的伟大公司，因为它给中国带来了优势。”

paras.en: Last year, the Commerce Department had been investigating Megaspeed over suspicions it had been smuggling some of Nvidia's advanced AI chips into China, according to the New York Times. Megaspeed has been contacted for comment.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，去年，美国商务部一直在调查 Megaspeed，怀疑其将 Nvidia 的一些先进人工智能芯片走私到中国。已联系 Megaspeed 征求意见。

paras.en: There was also pressure on the Commerce Department to add it to the list, but separate reporting in the Financial Times said the department was delaying efforts to have the cloud computing firm included.
paras.zh: 美国商务部也面临着将其添加到名单中的压力，但英国《金融时报》的另一篇报道称，商务部正在推迟将这家云计算公司纳入名单的努力。

paras.en: However, Bessent also pointed the finger at Nvidia.
paras.zh: 不过，贝森特也将矛头指向了英伟达。

paras.en: "The story has been thus far of Jensen Huang's personal foibles," he told CNBC's Squawk Box programme, external.
paras.zh: “到目前为止，这个故事主要是关于黄仁勋的个人缺点，”他告诉 CNBC 的 Squawk Box 节目（外部）。

paras.en: "The real story here should be: Did Nvidia know their client, and was there a robust effort at Nvidia to make sure that there was no leakage and that they were selling to what were obviously pass-through shell companies?
paras.zh: “这里的真实故事应该是：英伟达是否了解他们的客户，英伟达是否做出了强有力的努力来确保不存在泄密，以及他们是否将产品出售给明显是通过空壳公司？

paras.en: "It's important that anyone at the company there be held accountable for that."
paras.zh: “重要的是，公司的任何人都要为此承担责任。”

paras.en: Bessent's pointed comments are a rare instance of internal debate within the Trump administration spilling out into the public view, although tensions have reportedly simmered between Bessent and Lutnick in the past.
paras.zh: 贝森特的尖锐言论是特朗普政府内部辩论进入公众视野的罕见例子，尽管据报道贝森特和卢特尼克之间的紧张关系过去一直在酝酿。

paras.en: In 2024, the two reportedly jostled for the role of treasury secretary ahead of Trump's return to the White House, and last year the pair butted heads over the administration's tariff policy, accoprding to US media.
paras.zh: 据报道，2024 年，两人在特朗普重返白宫之前争夺财政部长一职，据美国媒体报道，去年两人还就政府的关税政策发生了冲突。

paras.en: Huang has been summoned to testify before the Senate Banking Committee about his alleged affair with the former Megaspeed executive, who is suspected of being a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 黄已被传唤到参议院银行委员会就他涉嫌与被怀疑是中国间谍的Megaspeed前高管有染的事作证。

paras.en: The commerce secretary has also been summoned to appear before the committee in December.
paras.zh: 商务部长也已被传唤于 12 月份出席委员会会议。

paras.en: "Recent reports raise serious concerns about our national security and the protection of sensitive US technology," committee chairman, Republican Senator Tim Scott posted on X.
paras.zh: 委员会主席、共和党参议员蒂姆·斯科特在 X 上发帖称：“最近的报告引发了对我们国家安全和美国敏感技术保护的严重担忧。”

paras.en: Democrats on key congressional committees have asked the Commerce Department and Lutnick to keep all records relating to decisions to allow Nvidia to sell its advanced AI chips to Chinese companies, including all their communications with or about Nvidia and Jensen Huang.
paras.zh: 国会主要委员会的民主党人要求商务部和卢特尼克保留与允许英伟达向中国公司出售其先进人工智能芯片的决定相关的所有记录，包括他们与英伟达和黄仁勋的所有通信或有关英伟达和黄仁勋的所有通信。

paras.en: Ways and Means Committee Ranking Member Richard E Neal and Senate Finance Committee Ranking Member Ron Wyden are starting investigations into the way Nvidia was allowed to sell these chips.
paras.zh: 筹款委员会高级成员 Richard E Neal 和参议院财务委员会高级成员 Ron Wyden 正在开始调查 Nvidia 被允许销售这些芯片的方式。

paras.en: According to Neal and Wyden, Nvidia's advanced H200 chips could be sold to Chinese firms if they were first imported from their manufacturing facility in Taiwan into America for inspection.
paras.zh: Neal 和 Wyden 表示，如果 Nvidia 先进的 H200 芯片首先从台湾的制造工厂进口到美国进行检查，则可以将其出售给中国公司。

paras.en: A 25% tariff - a levy that is paid to the federal government - was imposed on those chips, under a section of the Trade Act that Neal and Wyden say is meant to allow the US president to take action against imports that risk national security.
paras.zh: 尼尔和怀登表示，根据《贸易法》的一部分，对这些芯片征收 25% 的关税（向联邦政府缴纳的税款），该部分旨在允许美国总统对危及国家安全的进口采取行动。

articles.title: Mitchell, Tractable to Transform Collision Intake Through Automated Vehicle Inspection and Estimating
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Mitchell announced plans to expand its collaboration with Tractable through a proposed, exclusive agreement focused on optimizing the vehicle intake process. By connecting Tractable’s LumaScanner vehicle inspection system with Mitchell’s automated estimating solution, Mitchell Intelligent Estimating, the companies intend to help North American multi-site operators and independent collision repair centers accelerate damage assessment and preliminary estimate creation.

“Every decision about a vehicle, whether to service it, repair it or sell it, depends on knowing its true condition,” said Venkat Sathyamurthy, CEO of Tractable. “Our ambition for LumaScanner is to make that knowledge available to everyone who relies on it, anytime, anywhere. Integrating LumaScanner with Mitchell’s intelligent solutions will bring that vision into the heart of collision repair, extending the value of the inspection into the estimating process itself.”

As a vehicle passes through, LumaScanner automatically inspects it and produces a condition report: a consistent, time-stamped record of the vehicle’s physical state. Once integrated with Mitchell’s cloud ecosystem, that condition report could feed Mitchell Intelligent Estimating to automatically generate a preliminary estimate for appraisers to review and edit.

Together with Mitchell’s existing mobile photo-capture capabilities, the planned offering would give repairers the flexibility to document vehicle damage through either a physical or digital intake process. In AI estimating, capturing high-quality images of the damaged vehicle increases the accuracy and completeness of the preliminary estimate.

With LumaScanner, the vehicle is driven or towed through the inspection system and the vehicle image set and condition report will be used to generate a preliminary estimate in minutes. This is designed to save time and assist in improving estimate accuracy and completeness.

“Our goal is to help collision repairers simplify the vehicle intake process by connecting innovative technologies that are designed to optimize key steps in the workflow,” said Olivier Baudoux, senior vice president of global product strategy and artificial intelligence at Mitchell. “Combining LumaScanner’s automated inspection capabilities with Mitchell’s advanced solutions, proprietary data and open, cloud-based platform is intended to give repairers a way to remove friction, improve productivity and safely return collision-damaged vehicles to the road.”
